name: PixPurge
tagline: Erase text, captions and watermarks from photos, or copy text out of images
description: PixPurge is a browser-based image cleanup site that removes unwanted text, date stamps and watermarks from photos and can extract readable text from screenshots and scans.
longDescription: PixPurge is a web app focused on cleaning up images. Its main tool detects and erases overlaid text such as captions, date stamps and labels, then fills the area so the background looks intact. A companion watermark remover handles logos and stamps, and a copy text tool reads printed text, screenshots and clear handwriting so you can paste the words elsewhere. The site also includes a general AI photo editor for prompt-based edits and image generation. It suits online sellers, marketers and everyday users who need quick fixes without desktop software. New accounts start with free credits, and paid monthly plans or yearly passes add more usage.
pros: Several cleanup tools in one place
Works in the browser with no install
cons: Paid plan prices are not shown up front
Removing watermarks requires rights to the image
moreContext:
Most image editors make you hunt for the right brush. PixPurge takes a narrower route: you upload a photo, mark the text or logo you want gone, and its AI rebuilds what was underneath. The same account also gives you a text extractor, which is handy when you need the words from a screenshot rather than the picture itself.

- Text removal built for captions, labels and date stamps on photos
- A separate watermark and logo remover that aims to keep the background intact
- Copy text from image for screenshots, receipts and scanned pages, including clear handwriting
- An AI photo editor for prompt-based edits when a simple erase is not enough
- Runs in the browser, so there is nothing to install

PixPurge is best for online sellers, social media managers and anyone who regularly reuses photos that came with unwanted text baked in. A practical tip: spend your free credits on your toughest image first, such as text over a busy pattern, to judge the fill quality before choosing a plan, and only remove watermarks from images you own or have permission to edit.

name: AlphaVue
tagline: AI stock research that builds bull and bear cases from SEC filings
description: AlphaVue turns a US stock ticker into a research dossier drawn from SEC filings, laying out the bull case, key risks, open unknowns and the conditions that would break the thesis.
longDescription: AlphaVue is a web-based research assistant for investors who buy and hold US public equities. You enter a ticker and, in roughly a minute according to the company, it reviews 10-K and 10-Q filings from SEC EDGAR and assembles a dossier covering revenue growth, margin trends, customer concentration and cash flow. Each claim is tagged with its source, and points it cannot verify are flagged as unknowns rather than guessed. The report also proposes measurable exit rules, such as a gross margin threshold, that would invalidate the thesis. A free plan covers a limited number of monthly analyses, while Pro adds higher limits, email alerts, daily briefs and saved thesis monitoring.
features: Quantified exit rules for each thesis
Thesis monitoring with alerts on Pro
pros: Cites primary filings for key claims
Flags unknowns instead of filling gaps
cons: Covers US public equities only
Free tier caps monthly analyses
moreContext:
A lot of AI stock tools stop at a summary. AlphaVue is built around a more disciplined question: what would have to be true for this investment to work, and what would prove it wrong? It pulls its evidence from SEC filings, labels where each point comes from, and writes down exit conditions you can actually check later.

- Research dossiers grounded in 10-K and 10-Q filings from SEC EDGAR
- Bull case, bear risks and open unknowns kept clearly separate
- Measurable exit rules, such as margin thresholds, attached to each thesis
- The company says calculations are checked with deterministic code rather than left to the model
- Pro adds email alerts, daily briefs and a running decision history

AlphaVue is best for self-directed investors who want a structured second look at a US stock before buying or while holding it. A practical tip: open one of the public sample dossiers first to see how the reports are organized, then run your own ticker and compare its unknowns list with your own notes. Treat the output as research support, not as financial advice.

name: SmartDevoir AI
tagline: French AI homework tutor that guides students step by step instead of giving answers
description: SmartDevoir AI, from SOS Scolaire Numérique, is a French-language study platform whose AI tutor uses questions and hints to walk learners through homework, revision and exam prep.
longDescription: SmartDevoir AI is an online learning platform published by SOS Scolaire Numérique. Students log an assignment and work through it with an AI tutor that responds with guiding questions and hints rather than finished answers, adjusting to the learner's level. Around the tutor sit revision sheets, quizzes and exercises, a calendar for planning study sessions and progress tracking by skill. It runs in a browser on phones and computers. Plans are monthly with no commitment and are split by level, from primary school through secondary school, plus family bundles and an adult plan for higher education, career changers and job seekers. Parental supervision options are offered for minors.
pros: Covers primary school through adult learners
cons: No free plan or trial listed
Interface and content are French-focused
moreContext:
Plenty of homework apps simply hand over the answer. SmartDevoir AI is designed around the opposite habit: its tutor asks questions and offers hints so the student does the thinking. For parents who worry that AI makes homework too easy, that approach is the main reason to look at it.

- A Socratic-style tutor that guides with prompts rather than complete solutions
- Revision sheets, quizzes and exercises alongside the tutor
- A study calendar and skill-level progress tracking
- Separate plans for primary, secondary and adult learners, plus family bundles for two to five or more children
- Browser access on phones and computers, with parental supervision options for minors

SmartDevoir AI is best for French-speaking families who want structured homework support that builds independence. A practical tip: since there is no free tier, have your child try it on real assignments during the first month and review the progress view together to see whether the hint-based style suits them. The company also notes that the AI can make mistakes, so important answers are worth double-checking.

name: Skeleton AI
tagline: Generate short skeleton narrator videos for TikTok, Shorts and Reels
description: Skeleton AI is a niche video generator for the popular skeleton explainer format, turning text prompts or images into vertical clips using models such as Veo, Kling and Seedance.
longDescription: Skeleton AI is a web app dedicated to one viral short-form style: videos fronted by an animated skeleton character. You type a prompt or upload an image, pick a video model such as Veo, Kling, Seedance or MiniMax, choose an aspect ratio and generate a clip sized for TikTok, YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels. Extra tools help with skeleton character images, hook ideas and planning a video workflow, and a gallery of examples can be reused as starting prompts. Generation runs on monthly credit subscriptions, with higher tiers adding HD and watermark-free exports, commercial use and priority processing. Narration and captions need to be added separately.
features: Choice of Veo, Kling, Seedance and MiniMax
pros: Several leading video models in one place
cons: No built-in narration, captions or music
HD and watermark-free exports need higher tiers
moreContext:
Some creators want a general video studio. Others just want to publish the same recognizable format every day. Skeleton AI is built for the second group, packaging the skeleton narrator style into a focused tool that lets you choose from several well-known video models without juggling separate accounts.

- Text-to-video and image-to-video built around a skeleton character
- A model picker that includes Veo, Kling, Seedance and MiniMax
- Output in 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1 for different platforms
- Helper tools for character images, opening hooks and workflow planning
- Monthly credit plans, with failed generations refunded on Starter and above according to the pricing page

Skeleton AI is best for faceless channel creators and social media managers who post short explainers or trend content on TikTok, Shorts and Reels. A practical tip: start on a lower tier, use the faster models for drafts, and save premium models for the clips you plan to publish. Keep a separate voiceover and caption tool ready, since the generator does not add narration or music.

name: Google Apps Script Copilot
tagline: AI coding assistant that lives inside the Google Apps Script editor
description: Google Apps Script Copilot is an independent Chrome extension that adds chat, inline completions, refactoring and agent-style multi-file edits to the script.google.com editor.
longDescription: Google Apps Script Copilot is a browser extension that places an AI side panel inside Google's Apps Script IDE. Developers can chat about their project, get inline code completions, run quick edits, refactor and debug, and let Agent or Plan mode apply changes across several files with a diff view and a revert option. Higher plans support MCP tools for Google Workspace and custom servers. The product is independent and not affiliated with Google. A free plan covers basic chat and a monthly allowance of inline suggestions, Plus and Pro subscriptions add premium models and higher usage, and a one-time lifetime license lets you bring your own API key.
features: Agent and Plan modes for multi-file edits
pros: Works directly in the Apps Script editor
Lifetime license option for BYOK users
cons: Limited to Google Apps Script projects
Requires Chrome and an extension install
moreContext:
General coding assistants rarely reach the browser-based Apps Script editor, which leaves many Google Workspace automators copying code back and forth. Google Apps Script Copilot fills that gap by running directly inside script.google.com, so suggestions and edits happen where the code actually lives.

- Chat that understands the files in your Apps Script project
- Inline completions and quick edits as you type
- Agent and Plan modes that propose changes across files, with diffs you can review and revert
- MCP support for Google Workspace and custom servers on Pro and lifetime plans
- Bring-your-own-key access to providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google on the lifetime license

It is best for analysts, admins and developers who automate Sheets, Gmail, Docs or Drive with Apps Script and want modern AI help without leaving the editor. A practical tip: start on the free plan to see how it handles your largest project, then use Plan mode before big refactors so you can check the proposed steps before anything is applied. Keep in mind that the tool is independent and not made by Google.

name: Fottory
tagline: AI dating profile photos generated from a few of your own selfies
description: Fottory creates new dating profile photos from one to four selfies, planning poses, outfits and settings while keeping your face, with pay-once photo packs and no subscription.
longDescription: Fottory is an AI photo service aimed at people building or refreshing a dating profile. You upload between one and four selfies, and it generates new images with planned poses, outfits and locations meant to look natural on apps such as Tinder, Hinge and Bumble, while preserving your own face. The first two photos are free and need no card. After that, you buy a one-time pack of 30, 100 or 200 photos, with no recurring subscription. The site also offers a free photo check tool for feedback on existing pictures and a separate profile writing service for bios.
features: Photos from as few as one selfie
pros: Two free photos with no card
One-time packs instead of a subscription
Options tailored to major dating apps
cons: AI-generated photos may not fully match how you look in person
Little public information about the company
moreContext:
Good dating photos usually mean a friend with a camera and an afternoon of trying. Fottory offers a shortcut: a handful of selfies in, a set of planned profile shots out, with poses and backgrounds chosen to look like real moments rather than studio portraits.

- Works from one to four selfies, so there is no long photo shoot
- Generated shots vary pose, outfit and setting while keeping your face
- Dedicated options for Tinder, Hinge and Bumble style profiles, for both men and women
- One-time packs of 30, 100 or 200 photos with no subscription to cancel
- A free photo check tool for feedback on pictures you already have

Fottory is best for people who want fresher dating profile pictures without booking a photographer. A practical tip: use your two free photos to test whether the likeness holds up, upload clear, well-lit selfies from different angles, and mix one or two AI images with genuine recent photos so your profile still represents you honestly. If you also struggle with the written side, the optional profile writing service can help with your bio.

name: Hostinger Reach
tagline: AI email marketing from Hostinger for creators and small businesses
description: Hostinger Reach is an email marketing tool that writes and designs campaigns from a short description, suggests campaign ideas and picks send times, on low-cost plans.
longDescription: Hostinger Reach is the email marketing service from web hosting company Hostinger. Instead of building newsletters by hand, you describe the email you want and the AI drafts the copy, builds the layout and applies your branding. It also suggests weekly campaign ideas based on your business, audience and season, writes subject lines and chooses send times. Ready-made templates cover ecommerce, newsletters and promotions, and contact lists and results tracking are built in. Plans are priced per month on a 12-month term and scale by recipients and monthly sends, with AI credits included on the Grow and Pro tiers. It targets creators and small businesses without marketing teams.
features: AI-generated emails from a short description
AI subject lines and send-time choice
cons: Entry Starter plan includes no AI credits
Advertised prices assume a 12-month term and renew higher
moreContext:
Email marketing platforms often assume you already know how to plan a campaign. Hostinger Reach is aimed at people who do not, pairing a simple editor with AI that drafts the email, proposes what to send next and handles timing. For existing Hostinger customers it sits alongside the hosting and website tools they already use.

- Describe an email in plain words and get a branded draft with copy and layout
- Weekly campaign suggestions shaped by your business, audience and season
- AI-written subject lines and automatic send-time choice
- Templates for ecommerce, newsletters and promotions
- Tiered plans by recipients and monthly sends, starting at a very low price point

Hostinger Reach is best for creators, solo founders and small shops that want to start sending regular emails without hiring help or learning a complex platform. A practical tip: the cheapest Starter tier has no AI credits, so pick Grow if the AI writing is the main draw, and check the renewal price before committing to a longer term.

name: ImaginPrompt
tagline: Turn any image into a ready-to-use prompt for Midjourney, DALL-E or Stable Diffusion
description: ImaginPrompt analyzes an uploaded picture and writes a detailed text prompt tuned for popular image generators, plus tools for enhancing prompts and describing images or video.
longDescription: ImaginPrompt is a prompt-writing tool for people who use AI image generators. Upload a photo or artwork and its vision model describes the subject, style, lighting and composition, then formats the result as a prompt for a chosen target such as Midjourney, DALL-E 3, Stable Diffusion XL, Leonardo AI or Adobe Firefly. Other tools expand rough text into fuller prompts, describe images, generate images and pull prompts from video. The site, run by SocialFlowz LLC, says it supports more than 15 languages and offers an API. A free Explorer plan includes several daily uses on each tool, and paid monthly plans add credits and commercial use.
pros: Daily free uses on every tool
cons: Commercial license only on higher tiers
Generated prompts still need manual tweaking
moreContext:
Recreating a look you like in an image generator often comes down to finding the right words. ImaginPrompt handles that step by reading a reference image and translating what it sees into a prompt shaped for the model you plan to use, which saves a lot of trial and error.

- Image-to-prompt output tailored to Midjourney, DALL-E 3, Stable Diffusion XL, Leonardo AI, Adobe Firefly and others
- A Magic Enhance tool that expands short ideas into detailed prompts
- Extra tools for describing images, generating images and extracting prompts from video
- Support for more than 15 languages, according to the site
- A free Explorer plan with daily uses, plus one-time credit packs that do not expire

ImaginPrompt is best for designers, marketers and hobbyists who build images from references and want a faster starting point. A practical tip: generate prompts for two different target models from the same image and compare them, since each model responds to wording differently. If you plan to use results commercially, check which plan includes a commercial license first.

name: Seedream 5.0
tagline: ByteDance's multimodal image model with reasoning, strong text rendering and editing
description: Seedream 5.0 is the latest image generation model from ByteDance Seed, built for text-rich graphics, sketch-guided editing, layer separation and photorealistic results in many languages.
longDescription: Seedream 5.0 is a family of image generation models from ByteDance's Seed research team, with the Pro version presented as its flagship. It combines reasoning with image generation, which helps with text-heavy outputs such as infographics, posters and educational graphics. It can follow spatial annotations and rough sketches for interactive edits, separate an image into layers and aims for realistic lighting and skin texture. Prompts and in-image text work in about a dozen common languages. You can try it through ByteDance's Dola chat assistant, the BytePlus playground or Dreamina, and developers can reach it through the BytePlus API.
pros: Strong at text-heavy graphics like infographics
Available in apps and via API
cons: Pricing varies by access route
Access is spread across several ByteDance and BytePlus products
moreContext:
Many image models make attractive pictures but stumble on layouts full of text. Seedream 5.0 targets exactly that weak spot, pairing generation with reasoning so it can lay out infographics, posters and labeled diagrams, while still handling photorealistic portraits and everyday scenes with care.

- Text-rich outputs such as infographics and educational graphics
- Interactive editing that responds to spatial annotations and sketches
- Layer separation for easier follow-up editing in design tools
- Realistic lighting, shadows and skin texture in photographic images
- Prompt and in-image text support for roughly a dozen common languages

Seedream 5.0 is best for designers, marketers and developers who need graphics with readable text or want another strong option alongside Western image models. A practical tip: try the same prompt in the BytePlus playground before wiring up the API, and use the annotation feature to point at the exact area you want changed instead of rewriting the whole prompt. Stick to the official ByteDance Seed, Dreamina or BytePlus pages, since many unofficial sites reuse the Seedream name.

name: Nano Banana Pro
tagline: Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 Pro Image model for precise image generation and editing
description: Nano Banana Pro is Google's image generation and editing model built on Gemini 3, known for legible text, consistent characters, multi-image blending and output up to 4K.
longDescription: Nano Banana Pro is the popular name for Gemini 3 Pro Image, a model from Google DeepMind for creating and editing images. It renders clear text for posters, diagrams and product mockups, can translate text inside a design and draws on Gemini's world knowledge for infographics and annotated visuals. It keeps up to five characters and up to fourteen objects consistent, blends multiple reference images and lets you adjust camera angle, focus, lighting and color grading. Output can be upscaled to 1K, 2K or 4K, and images carry a SynthID watermark. It is available in the Gemini app, Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, with higher limits on paid Google AI plans.
features: Up to 4K output with SynthID watermarking
pros: Fine control over lighting and camera
Available in the app and via API
cons: Free access is limited
Google notes it can struggle with small faces and fine detail
moreContext:
Google's earlier Nano Banana model became famous for quick, conversational photo edits. The Pro version adds Gemini 3 reasoning, which shows most in work that needs accuracy: readable text, labeled diagrams, product mockups and scenes that stay consistent across several edits.

- Clear text rendering, including translating or localizing text inside a design
- Consistency for up to five characters and up to fourteen objects in one workflow
- Blending of multiple reference images into a single composition
- Studio-style controls for camera angle, depth of field, lighting and color grading
- SynthID watermarking that helps identify AI-made or AI-edited images

Nano Banana Pro is best for marketers, designers and educators who need polished visuals with accurate text, and for developers building image features through the Gemini API. A practical tip: describe edits the way you would brief a photographer, naming the lighting, angle and mood you want, and check small faces and fine print closely since Google lists those among its known limitations. Use the official Gemini app or Google AI Studio rather than look-alike sites that borrow the name.

name: UserWay
tagline: AI accessibility widget, audits and monitoring to help websites meet WCAG standards
description: UserWay, part of Level Access, offers an AI-driven accessibility widget that fixes common issues on page load, plus audits, monitoring and VPAT reports for formal compliance programs.
longDescription: UserWay is a web accessibility platform owned by Level Access. Its best-known product is an accessibility widget that site owners add with a code snippet. The widget gives visitors on-page accessibility tools, and its AI-based automated remediation technology finds and fixes common accessibility issues each time a page loads. Beyond the widget, UserWay offers accessibility audits, ongoing monitoring of site pages, and VPAT and ACR reports that organizations often need for procurement. Plans are billed annually and priced by monthly page views, with monitoring sold as an add-on. A free trial and a free accessibility checker let teams see results before buying.
features: AI automated remediation on page load
pros: Quick install with a code snippet
Covers both quick fixes and formal programs
cons: Plans are billed annually only
An overlay widget does not replace fixing the underlying code
moreContext:
Making a website accessible usually means a long backlog of fixes. UserWay offers a faster first step through an AI widget that addresses common problems as each page loads, then gives larger organizations the audits, monitoring and documentation needed for a full accessibility program. According to UserWay, its parent company Level Access was named a Leader in Gartner's first Magic Quadrant for digital accessibility platforms.

- An accessibility widget installed with a short code snippet
- Automated remediation technology that uses AI to fix common issues on page load
- Professional audits and ongoing page monitoring for multiple sites
- VPAT and ACR reports for procurement and vendor reviews
- A free accessibility checker to see where a site stands today

UserWay is best for small businesses that want quick improvements and for organizations running formal compliance efforts across several sites or apps. A practical tip: run the free checker before and after installing the widget, then use audit findings to fix issues in your source code as well, since an overlay works best alongside real fixes in the underlying markup.

name: Trify3D
tagline: Turn text or images into textured 3D models using several AI engines
description: Trify3D generates 3D models from text prompts or images with engines such as Tripo3D, Meshy and Rodin, adding full PBR textures and exports for games, printing and product work.
longDescription: Trify3D is a browser-based studio for AI 3D generation. You describe an object or upload an image, choose a generation engine such as Tripo3D, Meshy or Rodin, and receive a mesh with a full PBR texture set of albedo, normal, roughness and metallic maps created in the same pass. Models export as GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL or FBX, depending on plan. The site also bundles dozens of file converters, browser viewers, a 3D text tool, an STL editor, low-poly generation and a tool for comparing engines side by side. New users get welcome credits, then choose a monthly or yearly plan or a one-time credit pack.
features: Multiple engines including Tripo3D, Meshy and Rodin
GLB, OBJ, STL and FBX export
pros: Compare several 3D engines in one place
Credit packs available without a subscription
cons: Retexturing existing meshes is not available yet
Higher mesh quality is reserved for pricier plans
moreContext:
The AI 3D field moves quickly, and each engine has different strengths. Trify3D's appeal is that you do not have to commit to one: it puts several generators behind a single account and even lets you compare their results, while handling textures and file formats for you.

- Text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation with Tripo3D, Meshy and Rodin
- A full PBR texture set produced alongside every mesh
- Export to common formats including GLB, OBJ, STL and FBX
- A large set of file converters, viewers, an STL editor and a 3D text tool
- Monthly or yearly plans plus one-time credit packs that suit occasional users

Trify3D is best for indie game artists, product designers, prototypers and 3D printing hobbyists who want quick starting models without learning a full modeling suite. A practical tip: use the comparison tool on your first few prompts to learn which engine handles your type of object best, then stick with it to save credits. The company is upfront that retexturing an existing mesh is still in progress, so plan around that for now.

name: Swapface
tagline: Desktop face swap app for live streams, videos and photos that runs on your own computer
description: Swapface is a Windows and Mac app that swaps faces in real time for streaming and in images, videos and GIFs, with processing kept on your local machine.
longDescription: Swapface is a desktop face swap application for Windows 10 or 11 and Apple silicon Macs. It handles live face swapping for streaming, along with single and multi-person photo swaps, full head swaps that include hair, and swaps in videos and GIFs. The developer says all processing and data stay on the user's own computer rather than in the cloud. It is aimed at streamers, meme makers and video creators who want character transformations or comedic edits for social media, marketing or film projects. The app is free to start, with free credits available and paid options on its pricing page. A usage policy is published on the site.
features: Photo swaps for one or several people
pros: Covers live, photo and video use
cons: Needs a capable Windows PC or Apple silicon Mac
Swapping real people's faces requires their consent
moreContext:
Most face swap services upload your media to a server. Swapface takes a different route, running as a desktop app so footage and photos are processed on your own computer, which also makes real-time swapping for live streams practical. It covers stills, clips and live video in one place, so creators do not need a separate tool for each format.

- Live face swapping designed for streamers
- Single-person, multi-person and full head swaps on photos
- Face swaps in videos and GIFs for memes, sketches and character work
- Local processing, which the developer says keeps data on your machine
- Native apps for Windows and Apple silicon Macs

Swapface is best for streamers, comedy creators and video editors who want character transformations without sending media to the cloud. A practical tip: test with your own face and usual lighting setup first, since even lighting tends to help real-time results, and only use other people's faces with their clear permission. Deepfake rules vary by country and platform, so label swapped content and read the site's usage policy before publishing anything.

name: Arttribe
tagline: One studio for AI images, video, music and voice built on leading third-party models
description: Arttribe gathers image, video, music and voice generation into a single browser workspace, giving creators and marketing teams access to several popular AI models under one account.
longDescription: Arttribe is a browser-based creative studio that brings four kinds of AI generation into one place: images, video, music and voice. Instead of signing up for separate services, users pick from a menu of third-party models, including GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, Kling, Veo 3.1, Sora 2 and ElevenLabs voices, and work inside dedicated Image, Video, Music and Voice studios. Supporting tools cover text to image, image to video, text to speech, song generation, voice cloning, sound effects, background removal and creative upscaling. The product is aimed at solo creators, ecommerce brands, agencies and marketing teams producing ads, social posts and product visuals. New users can start without a credit card, and the site recommends a desktop browser.
features: Image, video, music and voice studios
Access to multiple third-party AI models
pros: Several media types in one account
No credit card needed to start
cons: Plan prices are not shown without signing in
Best experience requires a desktop browser
moreContext:
Juggling a different subscription for every kind of AI output gets tiring quickly, and Arttribe is built around removing that friction. It places image, video, music and voice generation side by side, so a single campaign can move from a product shot to a short clip to a voiceover without leaving the workspace. The real draw is model choice: rather than locking you into one engine, it lets you switch between several well-known generators depending on the job.

- Separate studios for images, video, music and voice keep each workflow focused
- Lets you choose among models such as GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, Kling, Veo 3.1 and Sora 2
- Includes practical extras like background removal, creative upscaling and sound effects
- Supports text to song and voice cloning for audio work alongside visuals
- You can start creating without entering a credit card

Arttribe is best for small brands, agencies and solo creators who produce mixed media for ads and social posts and would rather manage one account than five. A practical tip: run the same prompt through two or three of the available models before committing to a style, since each engine interprets prompts differently and the comparison costs only a few minutes.

name: Panzoe
tagline: A connected AI assistant with daily briefings across work, home, health and learning
description: Panzoe links your email, calendar, documents and tasks to one AI assistant that delivers personalized daily briefings and specialist copilots for business, home, health, life and learning.
longDescription: Panzoe is an all-in-one AI assistant from a Canadian startup that aims to act as a personal operating system for both life and work. It connects to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Notion and GitHub, then pulls your email, calendar, documents and tasks into a shared memory it calls the AI Brain. From there it produces morning and evening briefings, triages inbox and calendar items, and offers specialist copilots for business, home, health, life and learning. Business users get tools such as an executive briefing, meeting intelligence, project reporting and an AI chief of staff. Panzoe can be explored for free with one introductory use of each major feature, while full access starts with a seven-day trial.
features: Integrations with Google, Microsoft 365, Notion and GitHub
Specialist copilots for different life areas
pros: Covers personal and business organization in one place
Context carries across different areas of life
Seven-day trial of the full platform
cons: Early-stage product still evolving
Free exploration only allows one use of each major feature
moreContext:
General chatbots start fresh every time, and that is exactly the gap Panzoe sets out to close. It keeps a shared memory of your calendar, inbox, documents and priorities, then uses it to brief you each morning and evening and to power a set of specialist copilots. The ambition to span work, home, health and learning in one connected place is what gives it a different feel from single-purpose assistants.

- Daily briefings summarize your calendar, inbox, tasks and priorities
- Connects to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Notion and GitHub
- Specialist copilots focus on business, home, health, life and learning
- Business tools include meeting intelligence, project reporting and an executive briefing
- The company says it encrypts data and does not sell it or use it to train AI

Panzoe is best for busy professionals and small business owners who want one assistant that understands both their work schedule and their household admin. A practical tip: connect your calendar and main inbox first and live with the daily briefing for a few days before adding more sources, so you can judge how useful the summaries are before the trial ends.

name: Project Z
tagline: AI chat workspace with its own models, custom personas and document canvas
description: Project Z is a browser-based AI workspace offering chat with its Z-Flash, Z-Vision and Z-Pro models, image generation, custom personas with knowledge vaults, projects and a document canvas.
longDescription: Project Z is a web-based AI workspace built around conversational chat. Users sign in with Google or Microsoft and choose between the service's own model tiers: Z-Flash for fast everyday answers, Z-Vision for image understanding and generation, and Z-Pro on the top plan. Beyond chat, the workspace includes projects for organizing conversations, saved memories, file uploads, a document editor called Z-Canvas, voice interaction and custom personas that can draw on their own knowledge vaults. A free plan offers a daily allowance of Z-Flash answers and a few projects, while paid tiers raise or remove the limits and add image generation and more personas. It suits individuals who want a single, simple AI chat workspace.
features: Chat with Z-Flash, Z-Vision and Z-Pro models
pros: Usable free plan with daily answers
Personas and projects keep work organized
cons: Little public information about the team or underlying models
Free plan has tight daily limits on uploads and answers
moreContext:
Project Z keeps things deliberately simple: one clean chat window, a model picker and a handful of organizing tools that make it feel more like a workspace than a single conversation. Its custom personas stand out, since each one can be paired with its own knowledge vault, which is handy for keeping separate assistants for separate jobs.

- Three model tiers let you trade speed for capability depending on the task
- Custom personas can draw on dedicated knowledge vaults
- Z-Canvas gives you a place to draft and edit documents next to the chat
- Projects and saved memories help organize longer pieces of work
- The free plan includes a daily allowance of Z-Flash answers

Project Z is best for individuals who want an inexpensive, all-in-one AI chat space with personas and a writing canvas, and who are comfortable with a newer, smaller provider. A practical tip: set up one persona per recurring task, such as email drafting or study notes, and attach only the files relevant to that persona, so its answers stay focused. As with any assistant, double-check important facts, which the app itself reminds you to do.

name: Anifun AI
tagline: Free anime art, manga page and anime video creation in one browser workspace
description: Anifun AI is a web studio for anime fans and storytellers, with tools to generate anime art, design original characters, build manga pages and turn stories or images into short animated videos.
longDescription: Anifun AI, short for "anime for fun," is a browser-based creative platform for making anime-style content without drawing skills. Its toolset spans an anime art generator, a photo to anime converter, an original character maker, a character sheet generator and a chibi sticker maker. For comics, it offers a manga canvas with panel templates, speech bubbles and fonts, an AI manga generator that builds full pages from a story idea, plus a colorizer and manga translator. Video tools turn text or still images into anime clips with voiceover, music and subtitles. The site describes the service as free to use, works on mobile browsers, and says users own what they create, including for commercial use.
features: Anime art and original character generator
Manga canvas with panel templates and speech bubbles
Text and image to anime video
pros: Covers art, comics and video in one place
Users own their creations, including commercial use
cons: Usage runs on daily credit allowances
Focused on anime styles, so less suited to other art directions
moreContext:
Anime fans often have a character or a story in mind long before they have the drawing skills to bring it to life, and Anifun AI is built for exactly that moment. It treats the whole creative chain as one workspace, so you can design a character, place it in a manga page and then animate a scene without switching apps. That end-to-end focus on one art style is what makes it feel more coherent than a general image generator.

- Original character maker and character sheets help keep a cast consistent
- The manga canvas includes 10 panel templates, 31 bubble styles and 28 fonts
- An AI manga generator drafts complete pages from a short story idea
- Anime video tools add voiceover, background music and auto subtitles
- Extras like a manga colorizer, translator and upscaler help finish pages

Anifun AI is best for hobbyist storytellers, fan artists and webcomic creators who want to sketch out anime ideas quickly. A practical tip: build your main character with the OC maker and save a character sheet before generating manga pages, since a fixed reference makes it much easier to keep the same face and outfit from panel to panel.

name: Shaku AI
tagline: B2B lead generation that finds companies showing live buying signals and runs outreach
description: Shaku AI watches for buying signals such as funding rounds, hiring surges and executive changes, scores matching companies against your ideal customer profile and sends personalized outreach from your mailbox.
longDescription: Shaku AI is an autonomous B2B lead generation platform for sales teams. You enter your website, and it drafts an ideal customer profile for you to approve. The engine then continuously monitors buying signals, including funding rounds, hiring surges, executive moves, technology stack changes, LinkedIn activity and buyer intent from review sites. Each lead arrives with a 0 to 100 fit score, the signal that surfaced it, notes on why to reach out now, and verified contact details where enrichment can confirm them. The AutoReach plan drafts and sends personalized email sequences from your own Gmail or Outlook account, tracks replies with sentiment analysis and pushes qualified leads into HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or Zoho.
features: Automated email sequences with CRM push
pros: Leads come with a clear reason to reach out
Integrates with major CRMs and Slack
cons: No permanent free plan after the trial
Outreach quality still depends on reviewing drafts and targeting
moreContext:
Static contact lists go stale fast, and much of their value depends on reaching people at the right moment. Shaku AI is built around timing: it watches for events that suggest a company is ready to buy, then explains in plain language why each lead matters this week. That focus on signals rather than raw volume is what distinguishes it from traditional lead databases.

- Tracks funding, hiring, leadership changes, tech stack shifts and review-site intent
- Scores every lead against your ideal customer profile with notes on how to pitch
- Verifies contacts and enriches work emails and phone numbers where possible
- Sends personalized sequences from your own Gmail or Outlook address
- The company says it requests send-only email permission and does not store reply content

Shaku AI is best for small and mid-sized B2B sales teams that want an AI SDR style workflow without hours of manual research. A practical tip: spend real time refining the ideal customer profile it drafts from your website during the free trial, because the fit scores and outreach angles are only as sharp as that profile.

name: BenchGen
tagline: Simulated business environments for benchmarking and training AI agents
description: BenchGen tests AI agents inside simulated digital twins of real business systems, capturing full decision trajectories and turning every evaluation run into training data.
longDescription: BenchGen is benchmarking infrastructure for teams building AI agents. Rather than judging agents on demos or static test sets, it creates isolated, simulated environments that mirror real operations, such as a digital twin of a bank with fraud detection, loan approval, KYC and trade execution modules. Agents take real actions against these sandboxed systems, and the platform records each step, verifies outcomes and turns the resulting trajectories into data for reinforcement learning. Teams can connect enterprise sources like CRMs, ERPs, databases and APIs, and deploy in the cloud or in air-gapped setups. BenchGen also publishes public model rankings across its benchmarks. It targets enterprises, government and AI developers, with access arranged through its sales team.
features: Evaluation runs converted into training data
pros: Tests agents in realistic multi-step workflows
Connects to real enterprise data sources
Public benchmark rankings for frontier models
cons: Pricing is not published and requires contacting sales
Aimed at enterprise teams rather than individual developers
moreContext:
AI agents that shine in a demo often stumble once they meet real APIs, long workflows and messy business rules. BenchGen tackles that gap by building sandboxed copies of the systems an agent will actually operate, so teams can watch it succeed or fail safely before anything reaches production. The twist is that every evaluation also produces training data, which closes the loop between testing and improvement.

- Builds simulated environments that mirror real business operations, such as a full bank
- Records every action and reward so failures can be replayed and studied
- Converts benchmark runs into trajectories usable for reinforcement learning
- Supports enterprise data connections and cloud or air-gapped deployment
- Publishes live rankings showing how frontier models score on its benchmarks

BenchGen is best for enterprise AI teams, research groups and regulated organizations that need evidence an agent will hold up in multi-step, high-stakes workflows. A practical tip: browse its public benchmark rankings before a sales call to see how different base models perform on tasks similar to yours, which helps frame what you want to evaluate.

name: Riffi
tagline: Brand-aware AI content creator and social scheduler for carousels, videos and memes
description: Riffi learns your business from your website or a short description, then helps you create branded carousels, videos, animated ads and memes and schedule them to connected social accounts.
longDescription: Riffi is an AI content assistant for creators and small businesses that combines creation and scheduling. You start by adding your website, a social profile or a short description, and Riffi builds a Brand Brain that remembers your audience, voice, products, colors, fonts and past content. From there it generates carousels, short videos, talking-head and animated ads, character videos and memes, which you can review and edit before saving. A Campaigns feature researches your goal, audience and competitors to suggest creative angles with linked sources. Finished posts can be scheduled or published to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, X and YouTube from one calendar. Plans are monthly subscriptions, with AI video generation billed in credits.
features: Brand Brain that remembers voice and assets
Carousel, video, ad and meme generation
pros: Creation and scheduling in one place
Keeps content consistent with your brand
cons: No free trial or free plan
AI video costs extra credits beyond the subscription
moreContext:
Most social tools either help you make content or help you post it, and Riffi tries to do both while remembering who you are. Its Brand Brain stores your audience, tone, products and visual style, so new carousels and videos start from your context instead of a blank prompt. That memory, combined with a built-in calendar, makes it feel like a small content team rather than a single generator.

- Learns your business from a website, social profile or short description
- Produces carousels, videos, animated and talking-head ads, character clips and memes
- Campaigns suggests creative directions backed by linked research sources
- Turns a reference hook into your own hook plus product demo video
- Schedules finished posts to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, X and YouTube

Riffi is best for small business owners, solo creators and lean marketing teams who want to post consistently without stitching together several tools. A practical tip: fill out the Brand Brain thoroughly before generating anything, adding real product photos and a few past posts you like, and check the credit quote before each AI video, since video costs vary by model and length.

name: InnerCanvas
tagline: AI reflection reports based on classic drawing psychology tests, never a diagnosis
description: InnerCanvas guides adults through 15 classic drawing exercises such as House-Tree-Person, then uses AI to produce a private reflection report on what the picture shows and what it cannot prove.
longDescription: InnerCanvas is a self-reflection app built on well-known projective drawing exercises. You pick one of 15 guided tests, including House-Tree-Person, the Tree Test, Draw-a-Person, Wartegg, Kinetic Family Drawing, Person-in-the-Rain and Bridge Drawing, then draw in the browser or upload a photo of a drawing. AI analyzes the image and returns a report covering what is actually visible, themes worth reflecting on, and the limits of what a drawing can tell you. The service stresses that it is private by default and never a diagnosis. Every account gets two free previews, and complete reports are bought one at a time or in a bundle, with no subscription. Reports are available in over a dozen languages.
features: Draw in the browser or upload a photo
Reports with sources and stated limits
pros: Clear about not being a diagnosis
Wide choice of classic drawing exercises
cons: Free use limited to two short previews
Projective drawing tests have limited scientific validity
moreContext:
Drawing exercises like House-Tree-Person have long been used as conversation starters about how people see themselves and their relationships, and InnerCanvas turns them into a gentle, guided experience you can do at home. What stands out is its honesty: each report separates what is actually in the picture from what might be worth thinking about, and spells out what a drawing cannot prove.

- Offers 15 guided tests covering the self, relationships, and stress and coping
- Lets you draw on screen or upload a photo of a paper drawing
- Reports include sources and explicit limits rather than confident labels
- Pricing is pay per report, with a bundle option and no subscription
- Available in more than a dozen languages, including Spanish, Arabic, Hindi and Japanese

InnerCanvas is best for curious adults who enjoy journaling or reflective exercises and want a structured prompt for thinking about themselves. A practical tip: use one of the two free previews on a test you are genuinely interested in, draw without overthinking, and treat the report as a set of questions to reflect on, not answers. Anyone dealing with serious distress should talk to a qualified professional instead.

name: Robylon
tagline: AI customer support agents that resolve tickets across email, chat, voice and WhatsApp
description: Robylon deploys AI agents that answer and act on customer requests over email, chat, phone and WhatsApp, connecting to your systems and handing off to people when needed, with a free starter plan.
longDescription: Robylon is a customer support automation platform from Zooid Tech. It lets businesses build, test and deploy AI agents that handle requests across email, web and in-app chat, voice calls and WhatsApp. Instead of only answering questions, the agents read the systems where information lives, such as order, billing or account tools, and take actions like processing exchanges or checking payment status. Anything they cannot finish is handed to a human with context attached. Robylon works on its own or alongside helpdesks like Zendesk, Freshdesk and Zoho Desk, with more than 40 integrations. It serves ecommerce, fintech, SaaS, logistics and gaming teams. Pricing is based on monthly AI credits rather than seats, starting with a free plan.
features: AI agents for email, chat, voice and WhatsApp
Knowledge base testing and gap analysis
pros: Credit-based pricing instead of per seat
Works standalone or with existing helpdesks
cons: Voice calls and major helpdesk integrations require the Business plan
Credits can run out quickly for high-volume teams
moreContext:
Plenty of support bots can recite a help article, but customers usually want something done, such as a swap, a refund status or a fixed subscription. Robylon is built around that idea, giving its AI agents access to the systems where answers live so they can take the action rather than just describe it. When a case needs a person, it hands over with the checking already done.

- Covers email, chat, voice and WhatsApp from one platform
- Agents can look up orders, billing and account data and act on them
- Hands unresolved cases to human agents with context attached
- Integrates with tools like Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Slack and Microsoft Teams
- Pricing scales by AI credits, with a free plan and paid tiers from $25 a month

Robylon is best for ecommerce, SaaS and fintech support teams that want to automate repetitive tickets without replacing their helpdesk overnight. A practical tip: start on the free plan with your chat widget and a well-organized knowledge base, then use the knowledge base testing and gap reports on paid plans to see which questions the agent struggles with before adding email or voice.

name: iMini AI
tagline: AI creative agent with dozens of top image and video models on one credit plan
description: iMini AI combines a creative agent, canvas and access to popular image and video models such as GPT Image, Nano Banana, Midjourney, Seedance, Kling and Veo for images, videos, slides and branding assets.
longDescription: iMini AI is a creative platform that gathers many leading image and video generation models behind a single account and credit balance. Image options include GPT Image models, Nano Banana variants, Seedream, Midjourney and Wan, while video options include Seedance, Kling, Veo, Sora 2, Hailuo and Vidu. On top of the models sits a creative agent that can take a brief from idea to finished deliverable, covering images, videos, presentations, brand identity, ecommerce assets and copy. A canvas workspace and tools such as background removal, object removal, image expansion, layer separation and upscaling support editing. A free plan offers limited use, and paid Pro, Max and Ultra plans provide monthly credits.
features: Access to many image and video models
Editing tools like upscaling and object removal
pros: Wide model selection under one subscription
Free plan to test before paying
cons: Credit costs vary by model and can add up
Unused monthly credits do not roll over
moreContext:
Keeping up with every new image and video model is almost a job in itself, and iMini AI is designed to spare you that work by putting a long list of popular generators behind one login. The part that makes it more than a model menu is its creative agent, which can take a brief such as a product launch and assemble the images, video, slides and brand assets around it.

- Offers image models like GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream and Midjourney
- Includes video models such as Seedance, Kling, Veo, Sora 2 and Hailuo
- A creative agent works from idea to final delivery across several formats
- Canvas, AI slides, deep research and writing tools sit alongside generation
- Editing helpers cover background and object removal, expansion, layer separation and upscaling

iMini AI is best for marketers, ecommerce sellers and content creators who want to compare models and produce mixed creative assets without juggling several subscriptions. A practical tip: check the credit cost shown before each generation and test new prompts on faster, cheaper models first, saving premium video models for final renders, since monthly credits reset and do not carry over.

name: Curbora
tagline: AI real estate photo editing with virtual staging, decluttering and disclosure labels
description: Curbora edits listing photos with AI enhancement, virtual staging, decluttering and day to dusk conversion, keeping originals attached and adding disclosure labels for MLS-ready exports.
longDescription: Curbora is an AI photo processor built for real estate listings. Agents and media teams upload property photos and choose a service: Photo Enhance for exposure, color and perspective fixes, Virtual Staging to furnish empty rooms, Declutter to remove personal items and temporary objects, or Day to Dusk to turn daytime exteriors into twilight shots. Its main focus is trust. Every edit stays paired with its original, staged images carry disclosure labels, and requests that would hide defects or change permanent features such as walls, windows or fixtures are blocked. Users review candidate images side by side before exporting finals. Pricing uses one-time credit packs with no subscription, and credits do not expire.
features: Decluttering and day to dusk edits
Side by side review before export
pros: No subscription and credits never expire
Originals stay attached to every edit
cons: No free plan to test the service
Limited to real estate photo workflows
moreContext:
AI can make a listing photo look stunning, but it can also make it misleading, and that is a real risk for agents who have to stand behind their marketing. Curbora is built around that concern. It improves and stages photos while keeping every original attached, labeling staged images, and refusing edits that would hide defects or invent features, which makes it a thoughtful fit for regulated listing platforms.

- Four focused services: enhance, virtual staging, declutter and day to dusk
- Blocks edits that alter walls, windows, fixtures, defects or other permanent facts
- Staged images come with disclosure context ready for listing packages
- Lets you review generated candidates against the source before exporting
- One-time credit packs never expire, and failed generations do not count against you

Curbora is best for real estate agents, photographers and listing media teams who want polished photos without risking complaints about misrepresentation. A practical tip: run Photo Enhance on every image first since it costs the fewest credits, then save the pricier Virtual Staging for the two or three empty rooms that matter most to buyers, such as the living room and main bedroom.

name: StoryDiffusion
tagline: Open-source research model for consistent characters across comics and long videos
description: StoryDiffusion is an open-source method from Nankai University and ByteDance that keeps characters consistent across a series of generated images and turns them into longer videos.
longDescription: StoryDiffusion is an open-source research project from Nankai University and ByteDance, presented as a NeurIPS 2024 spotlight paper. It tackles a common weakness of diffusion models: keeping the same character looking the same across many images. Its consistent self-attention technique lets a batch of generated images share identity and clothing details, which makes it suitable for comics and visual storytelling in different styles. A second component, an image semantic motion predictor, turns a sequence of consistent or user-supplied images into longer video clips with smooth transitions. Code is released on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license, with demos available. Running it locally requires a capable GPU and some technical setup.
features: Long video generation from image sequences
cons: Requires a GPU and technical setup to run locally
Research code with limited ongoing updates
moreContext:
Anyone who has tried to make a comic with an image generator knows the frustration of a hero whose face and outfit change in every panel. StoryDiffusion is a research answer to that problem. Its consistent self-attention approach lets a set of images share character details as they are generated, and a companion motion predictor stitches those frames into longer, coherent video.

- Keeps faces and outfits consistent across a sequence of generated images
- Produces comics in a range of art styles from a set of prompts
- Generates longer videos by predicting motion between consistent frames
- Accepted as a spotlight paper at NeurIPS 2024
- Released on GitHub under the permissive Apache 2.0 license

StoryDiffusion is best for developers, researchers and technically comfortable artists who want to experiment with consistent character generation or build it into their own pipelines. A practical tip: try a hosted demo first to see whether the results suit your style before investing time in a local install, and when you do run it yourself, keep your character description identical across every prompt in a batch for the most stable results.

name: Spytrend
tagline: Facebook, Meta and TikTok ad intelligence that maps competitors' full ad operations
description: Spytrend is an ad research platform for media buyers that tracks Meta and TikTok ads, groups them by advertiser through pixel, domain, page and IP links, and flags long-running creatives worth studying.
longDescription: Spytrend is an ad intelligence tool built for media buyers, agencies and ecommerce sellers. It collects public ads from Facebook, Instagram and TikTok and organizes them into 33 verticals, which the platform categorizes with AI. Its Webmasters view groups ads by pixel ID, landing domain, page ID and IP, so you can see an advertiser's full operation instead of a single banner. Filters for days active, live status and deduplicated creatives help surface campaigns that keep running. Additional sections cover viral Reels and TikTok content analysis with AI scripts, influencer research, shops and products, startup funding and search arbitrage. An MCP server lets AI agents query the data. A free account is available, with paid plans billed monthly or prepaid.
features: Ad grouping by pixel, domain, page and IP
MCP server access for AI agents
pros: Shows an advertiser's full funnel, not single ads
Large archive across Meta and TikTok
Many free research tools alongside paid plans
cons: Base plan includes only one category, with extras billed separately
Geared toward performance media buyers rather than casual marketers
moreContext:
Looking at a competitor's single ad tells you very little, while seeing every domain, page and creative tied to the same advertiser tells you how their whole funnel works. That is the core idea behind Spytrend. By linking ads through shared pixels, domains, page IDs and IPs, it gives media buyers a map of an operation rather than a pile of screenshots.

- Webmasters view groups ads by four kinds of identifiers into one advertiser profile
- Days-active tracking highlights creatives that have kept running, a useful market signal
- Deduplication collapses repeated copies of one banner into a single creative with usage data
- Covers Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, with separate sections for viral content, influencers and products
- An MCP server lets AI agents pull results directly, priced in tokens

Spytrend is best for performance marketers, agencies and ecommerce sellers who research competitors' paid social campaigns every week. A practical tip: start with the free account and free tools to learn the filters, then pick your single most important vertical for the Base plan, and use the days-active filter to build a shortlist before diving into individual advertisers.

name: SlidesPilot
tagline: AI PowerPoint generator that builds editable decks from PDFs, docs, links and videos
description: SlidesPilot turns PDFs, Word files, web pages, YouTube videos, notes or a simple topic into structured, editable PowerPoint presentations, with extra tools for converting, compressing and summarizing.
longDescription: SlidesPilot is an AI presentation tool focused on turning existing material into slides. You can start from a PDF, Word document, PowerPoint file, web page, YouTube video, image, NotebookLM content, pasted text or just a topic prompt. The app reads the source, picks out the key ideas, organizes them into a slide narrative and lays them out with concise copy, charts, tables and diagrams where they help. An AI presentation agent lets you refine content and design, and themes support custom fonts, colors and logos. Finished decks download as editable PPTX, open in Google Slides, export to PDF or PNG, or present online. Utility tools cover PPT compression, merging, conversion and summarizing. New users get free credits after signup.
features: Decks from PDFs, docs, links, videos or prompts
Charts, tables and diagrams from data
Editable PPTX and Google Slides export
pros: Grounds slides in your own source material
Many free conversion and utility tools
cons: Paid plan prices are only shown inside the app
Free credits are limited for regular use
moreContext:
Many AI slide makers start from a blank prompt and invent content to fill space, while SlidesPilot starts from the material you already trust. Feed it a report, research paper, lecture video or web page and it condenses and reorganizes the ideas into a presentation, rather than simply converting file formats. That source-first approach is what makes it useful for work where accuracy matters.

- Accepts PDFs, Word files, PPTX, web links, YouTube videos, images and NotebookLM content
- Builds a logical outline before designing slides
- Adds charts, tables and diagrams where the data supports them
- Themes and brand controls keep fonts, colors and logos consistent
- Exports editable PPTX, PDF or PNG, or continues in Google Slides

SlidesPilot is best for students, researchers, consultants and business teams who regularly need to turn long documents into clear presentations. A practical tip: upload the original source rather than a summary, then review the generated outline before the design stage, since correcting the structure early saves far more time than fixing individual slides afterward.

name: Wisaven
tagline: Task-based AI studio for product photos, slide decks, documents, songs and voice
description: Wisaven lets you start from a task, such as a product photo kit, a deck from one line or a birthday song, and produces finished images, videos, presentations, documents, music and voiceovers on one credit balance.
longDescription: Wisaven is a task-oriented AI creation platform. Instead of opening a blank prompt, you pick a job and fill in a short brief. Product tasks cover photo kits, listing copy, product videos and vertical ads with voiceover. Document tools draft reports, business plans and everyday documents, show AI edits as diffs you accept, and build full PowerPoint decks from a line of text, a Word file, a PDF or a web page. Music tools write songs with lyrics and vocals, and voice tools handle text to speech, voice cloning and transcription. General skills include image and video generation, background removal, translation and summarizing. Everything runs on one credit balance, with 30 free credits on signup and commercial use included.
features: Task-based workflows from a short brief
AI PPT from text, Word, PDF or web pages
Song writing with vocals and music videos
Voice cloning, text to speech and transcription
pros: Starts from practical tasks instead of blank prompts
Many content types on one credit balance
Commercial use included and no training on your content
cons: Monthly credits do not roll over
Breadth means fewer advanced controls than specialist tools
moreContext:
Wisaven takes a refreshingly practical angle on AI creation: you tell it what job you need done, and it walks you to a finished result. Whether that is a set of product photos for a listing, a slide deck from a single sentence or a personalized birthday song, each task comes with a guided brief, which lowers the barrier for people who do not want to learn prompt writing.

- Product tasks turn one photo into a photo kit, listing copy or a short video ad
- Builds downloadable PowerPoint decks from a line of text, a Word file, a PDF or a web page
- Document editing shows every AI change as a diff you can accept or reject
- Music and voice tools cover songs with vocals, text to speech and voice cloning
- The company says it does not train models on your content and you keep commercial rights

Wisaven is best for small online sellers, freelancers and busy professionals who need a mix of everyday content without subscribing to several specialist apps. A practical tip: use the 30 free signup credits on the one task you need most, such as a product photo kit, to judge output quality before choosing a plan, and remember that failed tasks refund their credits automatically.

name: DeeVid AI
tagline: AI video and image studio with a video agent, avatars, music and top generation models
description: DeeVid AI generates videos and images from text, photos or references using models like Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling and Nano Banana, with a planning video agent, AI ads, avatars, voice and music.
longDescription: DeeVid AI is an all-in-one creative platform centered on AI video. You can prompt with text, photos, video or audio and pick from models including Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling, Nano Banana and GPT Image. Its video agent acts like a director, planning and iterating on a piece from idea to final cut, while a drag and drop canvas handles precise edits. Tools cover image to video, AI ads from product images, an AI image generator, avatars made from a single photo, text to speech and royalty-free music, plus trend templates. New users receive free starter credits, free outputs carry a watermark, and paid tiers remove watermarks and add commercial use. Apps are available for web, iOS and Android.
features: Video agent that plans and iterates
Access to Veo, Sora, Kling and Nano Banana models
AI ad videos from product photos
Avatars, text to speech and AI music
pros: Many top models in one subscription
Covers video, images, avatars and audio
Available on web, iOS and Android
cons: Free outputs are watermarked and starter credits are small
Purchased credits are non-refundable
moreContext:
DeeVid AI is designed for people who want finished videos rather than a pile of separate clips. Its video agent works like a director, planning a piece, generating the shots and iterating on them, while a canvas editor lets you step in and adjust exactly what you want. Having several leading video and image models under one roof means you can pick the right engine for each shot.

- Video agent plans, creates and refines content from a single idea
- Lets you choose among models such as Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling and Nano Banana
- Turns product images into ad videos sized for different platforms
- Creates talking avatars from one photo, plus voiceovers and royalty-free music
- The company says it serves more than 30 million creators

DeeVid AI is best for social media creators, ecommerce sellers and marketers who produce short video regularly and want images, avatars and audio in the same place. A practical tip: spend your free starter credits on image to video with a strong product or portrait photo, since it shows the model quality quickly, and keep in mind that paid credits expire after a year.

name: FaceFusion
tagline: Open-source face swapping and face enhancement for images and video
description: FaceFusion is a popular open-source desktop application for face swapping, face enhancement and related face manipulation on images and video, run locally on your own hardware.
longDescription: FaceFusion is an open-source face manipulation platform that runs on your own computer. It can swap faces in images and video, enhance and restore faces, and apply related processors through a browser-based interface or the command line. The project supports a wide range of hardware accelerators, including NVIDIA CUDA, AMD, Intel OpenVINO, DirectML and Apple CoreML, and offers headless, batch and job queue modes for larger workloads. Installation uses Python and Conda and is described by the developers as requiring technical skills, though paid one-click installers are offered for Windows and macOS. The code is available on GitHub, documentation lives on its docs site, and the project publishes a usage disclaimer.
features: Face swapping for images and video
Batch, headless and job queue modes
pros: Free, open source and runs locally
cons: Manual setup requires technical skills
Face swapping carries serious consent and misuse risks
moreContext:
Among open-source face tools, FaceFusion stands out for how actively it is developed and how widely it runs. Because everything happens locally, your source images and videos never have to leave your machine, which matters for studios and creators working with unreleased footage. Its job system and command-line options also make it practical for batch work, not just quick experiments.

- Swaps and enhances faces in both still images and video
- Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and Apple hardware through multiple accelerators
- Offers a browser interface plus headless, batch and queued job modes
- Optional paid installers simplify setup on Windows and macOS
- Has a large community on GitHub, Discord and Reddit

FaceFusion is best for VFX hobbyists, video editors and developers who want a capable, local face processing tool and are comfortable with some setup. A practical tip: read the project's disclaimer before you start and only work with faces of people who have given clear consent, since realistic face swaps can easily cause harm and may be illegal in many places when used to deceive or impersonate.

name: AiPPT
tagline: AI presentation maker that turns topics, files and links into editable slides
description: AiPPT builds slide decks from a topic, pasted text, documents or URLs, then lets you refine them through chat and export to PPTX, PDF or images.
longDescription: AiPPT is a web-based presentation maker that generates complete slide decks from a short topic, pasted notes, uploaded PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel files, or a web link. It parses the source material, organizes it into slides with layouts and visuals, and applies a theme from its template library or one you upload. Edits can be made by typing plain instructions, such as rewriting a section or inserting a chart, and the tool adjusts typography and spacing automatically. Finished decks download as PPTX, PDF or image files that stay editable in PowerPoint and Google Slides. It suits students, educators, marketers and business teams who need a first draft of a deck quickly.
features: Slides from topics, files or URLs
Export to PPTX, PDF and images
pros: Editable output for PowerPoint and Google Slides
cons: Plan prices are not clearly shown on the website
Generated decks still need a fact and design review
moreContext:
What stands out about AiPPT is how many starting points it accepts. You can begin with a single sentence, a long report, a spreadsheet or a link, and the tool turns that material into a structured deck rather than a stack of blank slides. The conversational editor then lets you shape the result without hunting through menus.

- Document parsing that pulls key points out of PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets and web pages
- Plain-language editing for rewriting text, inserting charts or changing a theme
- Automatic refinement of typography, spacing and visual hierarchy on each slide
- Exports to PPTX, PDF and image formats that remain editable in standard presentation software
- Extra converters such as PDF to PPT and Word to PPT for quick format changes

AiPPT is a good fit for students, teachers, consultants and marketing teams who build decks often and want a solid first draft in minutes. A practical tip: upload your own source document instead of only typing a topic, since the slides will then reflect your real figures and wording, which makes the review pass much faster.

name: AIforASMR
tagline: AI video generator with a dedicated workspace for calm, sound-led ASMR clips
description: AIforASMR creates short AI videos from prompts and images, with an ASMR workspace offering presets for rain, candlelight, textures and other relaxing scenes.
longDescription: AIforASMR is an online video generation platform built around relaxing, sound-focused content. Its general video generator supports text-to-video, single-image animation and start-and-end-frame guidance, with the available modes depending on the model you pick. A separate ASMR Workspace offers templates and presets for scenes such as rain, candlelight and close-up textures, so creators do not have to write every prompt from scratch. Saved results live in a My Creations library, and the generator shows the expected credit cost before you submit a job. The platform runs on credit-based monthly subscriptions and is aimed at short-form creators who publish ambient or ASMR videos on social platforms.
pros: Focused presets for a specific niche
Clear credit cost shown up front
cons: No free plan listed
Few details on which models power each mode
moreContext:
Most AI video tools try to cover every genre, but AIforASMR leans into one: quiet, tactile, sound-led clips. That focus shows in its ASMR Workspace, where presets for rain, candlelight and close-up textures give creators a head start on the moods this audience looks for. It also keeps a general video generator on hand for clips that fall outside the ASMR niche.

- A dedicated ASMR Workspace with ready-made templates and scene presets
- Text-to-video, image animation and start-and-end-frame control, depending on the selected model
- Support for reference inputs on models that accept them
- An expected cost display before each job, which helps with credit planning
- A My Creations library that keeps past results in one place

AIforASMR suits short-form creators who run relaxation, sleep or satisfying-video channels and want a steady flow of on-theme clips without building every scene by hand. A practical tip: start from a template and change only one element at a time, such as the lighting or the texture, so you can see what each tweak does before spending more credits.

name: LobbyClip
tagline: Turns two photos into a short Hotel Lobby style AI duo video
description: LobbyClip places two people or pets into a stylized studio scene with a hanging mic and generates a short AI video with audio, paid per clip with no subscription.
longDescription: LobbyClip is a focused AI video generator for the Hotel Lobby trend, where two performers share a stylized studio set with a hanging microphone. You upload one photo for each side, choose from six scenes covering friends, couples, cats and dogs, then set the aspect ratio, resolution and a duration between 1 and 15 seconds. The service produces an MP4 with AI-generated audio, and the price stays the same regardless of clip length. A free photo layout preview works without an account, while video generation uses purchased credits. The site says generation runs through Kie.ai. It is built for people making playful social clips of friends, partners or pets.
features: Separate photo slot for each performer
1 to 15 second clips in three aspect ratios
pros: No account needed to try the layout
cons: Limited to one trend format
Maximum resolution is 720p
moreContext:
LobbyClip does one thing and keeps it simple. Instead of a blank prompt box, you get two photo slots, a handful of themed sets and a clear price, which makes it easy for anyone to join the Hotel Lobby video trend without learning a full video editor.

- Separate reference slots so each performer keeps their own look
- Six scenes split between people and animals, from an orange open-mic room to a rooftop at blue hour
- Portrait, landscape and square formats for different social platforms
- A flat price per clip whether it runs 1 second or 15
- Credits returned automatically when a generation is confirmed as failed

LobbyClip is best for friends, couples and pet owners who want a fun, shareable clip rather than a production tool. A practical tip that follows the site's own guidance: use one clearly lit, front-facing photo per performer, since well-lit, unobstructed faces give the model the best chance at a convincing result. Purchased credits never expire, so a small pack can cover several occasions.

name: 3D House Planner
tagline: Free browser-based 3D home designer with an AI layout assistant and BIM export
description: 3D House Planner lets you draw, describe or import floor plans and walk through them in 3D, with an AI assistant that builds rooms, roofs and furniture for you.
longDescription: 3D House Planner is a free web application for designing houses and apartments directly in the browser. You can sketch walls in 2D or 3D, import a floor plan image, DXF or IFC file, or describe a layout to the built-in AI assistant, which creates walls, doors, windows, roofs and furniture using the same editable tools as a human user. The 2D plan and 3D model stay in sync as you work. A catalog of objects and textures, terrain modeling and several rendering modes help with visualization.
