Projects are stored locally in the browser, and files export to formats including IFC4, DXF, GLB, OBJ and STL. It suits homeowners, students and designers.
features: AI assistant that builds layouts from text
IFC, DXF, GLB and OBJ import and export
pros: Free for personal and commercial use
Projects stay private in your browser
cons: No cloud sync between devices
Higher rendering modes need a strong GPU
moreContext:
It is rare to find a home design tool this capable that asks for nothing up front. 3D House Planner runs in the browser with no account, keeps projects on your own device, and still offers an AI assistant plus real BIM data that professional software can read.

- An AI design assistant that turns requests like a three-bedroom house with a gable roof into editable walls, rooms and furniture
- A 2D plan that updates when you change the 3D model, and the reverse
- IFC4 export with property sets, plus quantities, schedules and budgets in CSV
- Rendering modes from a light draft setting for laptops up to an Ultra mode with reflections and ambient occlusion
- Import of floor plan images, DXF and IFC files to start from existing drawings

3D House Planner is a great match for homeowners planning a renovation, architecture students and hobbyists who want a capable planner without a subscription. A practical tip: because projects live in browser storage, export your work to a file regularly so you have a backup if you clear site data or switch computers.

name: W3Surge
tagline: SEO and AI search visibility workspace for tracking rankings and AI citations
description: W3Surge combines keyword research, site audits and rank tracking with monitoring of how often a brand shows up in AI-generated answers.
longDescription: W3Surge is a visibility platform that covers both classic search engines and AI answer engines. It offers domain research, keyword workflows, site audits and rank tracking alongside modules for generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO), which measure how often a brand is cited in AI responses. An in-product AI assistant can query your W3Surge data and suggest next steps. Free tools let anyone check GEO readiness, featured-snippet structure and basic technical SEO without an account. Paid plans add more seats, deeper audits, AI answer tracking, multi-domain dashboards and API access. It is aimed at marketers, in-house SEO teams and agencies.
pros: Covers classic SEO and AI search together
cons: AI visibility tracking starts on the $199 Growth plan
Free tier is limited to 10 keyword lookups a day
moreContext:
Search is splitting between traditional results pages and AI-generated answers, and W3Surge is built to watch both at once. Rather than pairing a classic SEO suite with a separate AI visibility tracker, it puts keyword data, audits and AI citation metrics in one workspace.

- GEO and AEO modules that track brand citations and share of voice in AI answers
- Keyword research, competitor snapshots and rank tracking for classic search
- Site audits that flag crawl issues, broken links and indexation problems
- Free, no-account tools for checking GEO readiness and featured-snippet structure
- An AI assistant that answers questions using your own W3Surge data

W3Surge is best for marketing teams and agencies that want one place to report on both SEO and AI search presence. A practical tip: run the free GEO and site audit checks on your most important pages first, since they show whether paying for the Growth plan's AI answer tracking makes sense for your brand right now. Because billing is self-serve, you can move between plans or adjust seats without a sales call.

name: RestorePhoto
tagline: AI face restorer that sharpens blurry faces in old portraits and family photos
description: RestorePhoto improves facial clarity in faded or softly focused photos, with a before and after comparison and one free restoration every 30 days.
longDescription: RestorePhoto is a web tool that uses AI to restore faces in old portraits, wedding photos, childhood snapshots and scanned album pictures. You upload a JPG, PNG or WebP file, run the restoration, then compare the result with the original using a slider before downloading. The service concentrates on facial clarity and does not currently handle scratch repair, tear reconstruction or colorization. Sign-in is through Google, and each account gets one free restoration every 30 days. Beyond that, one-time packs and monthly plans add more restorations. Uploaded photos expire after 24 hours, and failed restorations are not charged. It suits families digitizing old photo collections.
features: AI face restoration for old photos
cons: No scratch repair or colorization
Requires Google sign-in
moreContext:
RestorePhoto keeps its scope narrow on purpose. Instead of promising to fix every flaw in an old print, it concentrates on the part people care about most, the faces, and is candid that AI may reconstruct details that were not visible in the original. That honesty makes it easier to trust what you are getting.

- Focused face restoration for faded, blurry or softly focused portraits
- A comparison slider so you can judge the result against the source before saving it
- A free restoration every 30 days, plus one-time packs that do not renew
- Automatic expiry of uploaded photos after 24 hours, and a delete option for stored results
- No charge when a restoration fails

RestorePhoto is a thoughtful choice for families working through albums of wedding portraits and childhood snapshots. A practical tip: scan prints at a high resolution and crop close to the face before uploading, then compare the output carefully with the original, since the site itself notes that fine facial details can change during restoration. Keep the original file safe as well.

name: Roblox Cube
tagline: Roblox's open-source foundation model for generating 3D objects from text
description: Roblox Cube is a generative AI system that creates 3D meshes from text prompts, available in Roblox Studio and as open-source code and weights for developers.
longDescription: Roblox Cube is the company's core generative AI system for 3D content, announced in March 2025. Its first capability, Cube 3D, generates 3D meshes from text prompts, and Roblox released a version of the model as open source on GitHub and Hugging Face so developers outside the platform can run, fine-tune and extend it. Inside Roblox, creators can access mesh generation in Roblox Studio and through an in-experience API, then refine results with standard tools. Roblox says the model is trained on native 3D data rather than reconstructing shapes from images, aiming for objects that work in game engines. It is aimed at game developers, 3D researchers and Roblox creators.
pros: Backed by a major game platform
cons: Running it locally needs technical setup and a capable GPU
Image input and scene generation are still on the roadmap
moreContext:
Roblox Cube is notable because a major game platform chose to share a version of its 3D foundation model openly. Developers can study the code, run the model on their own hardware and build on it, while Roblox creators get the same core technology inside Studio.

- Text-to-3D mesh generation through Cube 3D, the system's first capability
- Open-source code on GitHub and model weights on Hugging Face
- Access in Roblox Studio and through an in-experience API for creators
- Training on native 3D data, which Roblox says yields objects better suited to game engines
- A published roadmap toward scene generation and multimodal inputs

Roblox Cube is a strong pick for game developers, technical artists and researchers who want a text-to-3D model they can inspect and adapt. A practical tip: start with short, specific prompts that describe a single object, then bring the mesh into Studio or your usual 3D tool for scaling, materials and cleanup. Treat generated meshes as a strong first pass rather than final production assets, and expect to refine them.

name: Playground by Google
tagline: Google's experimental platform for making and sharing browser games by chatting
description: Playground lets adults in the US describe a game in plain language, refine its rules, physics and characters through chat, then share it or publish it to a public gallery.
longDescription: Playground is an experimental platform from Google, launched in October 2026, for building, playing and sharing games without writing code. Creators describe what they want in a chat box, starting from a blank canvas, a remixable starter prompt or guided support, and can then ask for changes to physics, rules, characters or environments. Games run in the browser on phones and laptops. Finished projects can stay private, be shared by link, or be published to the Explore gallery, which ranks games by ratings and play activity. Leaderboards, select multiplayer genres and Play Games profiles add social features. Creation is limited to US users aged 18 and over, with access tiered by Google AI subscription.
features: Edit physics, rules and characters by request
pros: Games play in a web browser on phone or laptop
Free to browse and play community games
cons: Creation limited to US users aged 18 and over
Creation limits depend on your Google AI subscription
moreContext:
Playground turns game making into a conversation. Instead of learning an engine, you describe the game you have in mind and keep asking for changes until it plays the way you want, which opens up game design to people who have never written a line of code.

- Three ways to start: a blank canvas, remixable starter prompts or guided concept support
- Iteration through chat, covering physics, rules, characters and environments
- Browser-based play on phones and laptops with nothing to install
- Sharing options that range from private drafts to link sharing and the public Explore gallery
- Social layers such as leaderboards, multiplayer in select genres and Play Games profiles

Playground is ideal for hobbyists, teachers and curious players who want to prototype small games for friends and family. A practical tip: start with a simple core loop, such as a single racing track or one quiz round, then add rules and characters one request at a time so each change is easy to test. Google describes the platform as experimental, so features and limits may change.

name: insMind AI Logo Generator
tagline: Generates editable logo concepts from a brand name, slogan and style preset
description: insMind's AI logo generator produces several logo options from a short description and style choice, with editing tools and PNG or JPG export including transparent backgrounds.
longDescription: The insMind AI Logo Generator is part of insMind's broader online design and photo editing suite. You enter a brand name, an optional slogan and a short description of the colors, tone or feel you want, choose a style preset such as Business, Vintage, Creative, 3D or Cute, and generate a set of logo concepts in seconds. Any result can be refined in the editor, where you can change text, resize elements and swap background colors, or regenerate for new ideas. Logos export as JPG or PNG, including transparent backgrounds. Free use covers exploration with lower-quality downloads, while a Pro plan adds high-resolution files. It suits small businesses, creators and side projects.
features: Logo concepts from a name and description
Style presets like Vintage, 3D and Cute
pros: Quick way to explore many concepts
Works inside a full design suite
Free to try without design skills
cons: High-resolution downloads require Pro
Logos should be checked for trademark conflicts before commercial use
moreContext:
The appeal of the insMind AI Logo Generator is how quickly it moves from a vague idea to a handful of usable directions. A brand name, a few words about the mood you want and a style preset are enough to produce several concepts, and each one opens in an editor rather than arriving as a locked image.

- Style presets including Business, Vintage, Creative, 3D and Cute
- Editing tools for text, sizing and background colors after generation
- Regeneration for fresh variations when the first batch misses the mark
- JPG and PNG export, with a transparent background option for use on any surface
- Access to insMind's wider toolkit for photos, graphics and marketing visuals

This tool is a friendly starting point for small business owners, creators and side projects that need a logo concept without hiring a designer. A practical tip: mention specific colors and one or two adjectives in your description, then pick your favorite concept and polish it in the editor. insMind's own help pages also suggest checking with a legal professional that a final logo does not conflict with existing trademarks.

name: CutoutClip
tagline: Removes video backgrounds online and exports transparent clips with no watermark
description: CutoutClip cuts people, pets, objects or cartoons out of short videos and GIFs, with free clips up to 10 seconds and a flat per-video price for longer ones.
longDescription: CutoutClip is a browser tool for removing the background from video without a green screen. You upload an MP4, MOV or animated GIF, choose whether the subject is a person or an object, pet or cartoon, and download the cutout as a transparent WebM. Clips up to 10 seconds are free, with three free clips per day and no signup. Longer videos, up to two minutes or 3,600 frames, cost a one-time fee per clip after a free five-second preview. Paid results include extra formats such as green screen MP4, MOV ProRes 4444 with alpha, GIF, WebP and alpha mattes. The site says it uses VEED's background removal model through fal.ai.
features: Background removal for people, pets and objects
pros: Free for short clips with no signup
Pay per video with no subscription
cons: Paid clips are capped at 2 minutes
Output is limited to 1080p
moreContext:
CutoutClip stands out for its straightforward pricing and unusual candor. Short clips are free, longer ones cost a flat fee per video, and its pricing page even points out when a free competitor matched its result in the team's own test, which is a refreshing approach for a paid tool.

- Subject modes for people and for objects, pets or cartoons
- A wide export list, including transparent WebM, MOV ProRes 4444 with alpha, GIF, WebP and alpha matte MP4
- Background swaps to green screen, solid colors, your own image or a blurred version of the original
- A free five-second preview so you can judge quality before paying
- Automatic refunds when processing fails, plus a seven-day refund window

CutoutClip suits video editors, social creators and designers who need a clean cutout for a single clip without committing to a subscription. A practical tip: preview the trickiest stretch of your footage, such as hair moving in the wind, since that is where background removal is most likely to struggle.

name: EaseMate AI
tagline: All-in-one AI assistant with chat, study tools, writing aids and media generation
description: EaseMate AI bundles chat with several leading language models, homework solvers, PDF chat, writing aids and image and video generators in one credit-based workspace.
longDescription: EaseMate AI is a web and mobile suite that gathers many AI tools under one account. Its chat assistant lets users switch between model families such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and Qwen. Around it sit study tools like math, physics and chemistry solvers, flashcard and quiz makers, mind maps and note taking, plus writing aids, PDF and document chat, citation help and resume checking. Creative features include image generation and editing, photo effects, background removal and AI video generation. A free Basic plan includes daily chat and limited image and video use, and paid tiers add monthly credits. It suits students and generalists who want many tools in one place.
features: Chat with multiple leading AI models
Math, science and quiz study tools
cons: Shared credits can be hard to predict across tools
Breadth means individual tools are less specialized
moreContext:
EaseMate AI takes the opposite approach to single-purpose apps. Instead of picking one chatbot, one homework helper and one image generator, users get a broad menu of tools that share a single account and credit balance, along with the option to switch between several well-known language models. A mobile app extends the same tools to phones.

- Model switching in chat across families such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and Qwen
- Study helpers including math and science solvers, flashcard makers and quiz generators
- Document tools such as ChatPDF, a summarizer, a citation generator and a resume checker
- Image creation and editing, photo effects and background removal
- AI video generation from text, images and scripts

EaseMate AI is a good match for students and busy generalists who would rather keep one subscription than juggle several. A practical tip: begin on the free Basic plan and note which tools you actually use in a typical week before upgrading, since credits are shared across chat, images and video and heavy media use drains them fastest.

name: BabyBumpShots
tagline: Turns everyday selfies into styled AI maternity, family and newborn portraits
description: BabyBumpShots generates maternity and family portraits from a few uploaded selfies, with dozens of themed styles from beach sunsets to studio looks, priced per photo.
longDescription: BabyBumpShots is an AI portrait service for expecting parents. You upload up to ten everyday photos, choose an aesthetic style, and receive maternity portraits that place you in settings such as golden-hour fields, cherry blossoms, minimalist studios, beaches or winter scenes. Packages also cover couple and family sessions, newborn and baby looks, and fine art studio portraits, and you can include a partner or older children by uploading their photos. Most images arrive within a few minutes, and pricing is pay-per-image with no subscription. The site says uploaded photos are deleted automatically within 24 hours. It suits parents who want maternity photos without booking a studio session.
features: Dozens of seasonal and studio styles
pros: Pay per image with no subscription
cons: Results depend on the quality of your selfies
AI portraits may not capture the authenticity of a real shoot
moreContext:
BabyBumpShots offers a gentle alternative to a formal maternity session. Rather than scheduling a shoot during the tiring final weeks of pregnancy, parents can upload a few everyday selfies from home and explore a wide range of looks, from sunlit meadows to clean editorial studios.

- A large style library spanning beach, autumn, winter, floral, boho and minimalist studio themes
- Couple and family presets for including a partner or older siblings
- Newborn and baby styles for the first weeks after birth
- Typical delivery in a few minutes, with larger batches taking longer
- Automatic deletion of uploaded photos within 24 hours, according to the site

BabyBumpShots is best for expecting parents who want keepsake portraits on a budget or who cannot easily get to a studio. A practical tip: upload clear, well-lit photos taken from a few different angles, and try one or two styles first so you can see how the results look before ordering a larger set. Pricing is a flat amount per image, so it is easy to keep the total in check.

name: ytZolo
tagline: AI toolkit for YouTube thumbnails, titles, scripts, voiceovers and music
description: ytZolo helps YouTube creators produce thumbnails, SEO titles, descriptions and scripts with AI, plus an audio studio for voiceovers, dubbing, music and sound effects.
longDescription: ytZolo is a web platform that gathers AI tools for running a YouTube channel. On the content side it generates thumbnails, search-friendly titles, descriptions, tags and video scripts. Its AI Audio Studio adds text-to-speech, multi-voice dialogue, voice changing, music and sound effect generation, voice isolation for noise removal, dubbing and forced alignment for syncing text to audio. Work runs on credits that reset monthly with each subscription tier, and outputs are kept in a history library. A free tier is available, with more tools and credits on paid plans. It is aimed at YouTubers and video marketers who want to speed up the packaging and production side of publishing.
features: Audio studio for voice, music and dubbing
pros: Covers packaging and audio in one tool
cons: Credit costs vary by task complexity
Pricing details are hard to find on the website
moreContext:
ytZolo is built around the work that happens before and after recording a YouTube video. Thumbnails, titles, descriptions and scripts can take as long as filming, and the platform pairs those text and image tools with a full audio studio so creators can handle voiceovers and music in the same place.

- Thumbnail generation aimed at improving click-through on YouTube
- Title, description and tag generators written with search visibility in mind
- Script writing to help structure a video before recording
- An AI Audio Studio with text-to-speech, multi-voice dialogue, voice changing, dubbing and voice isolation
- Music and sound effect generation for intros, transitions and background tracks

ytZolo is a fine fit for solo YouTubers and small channel teams who want to speed up the packaging side of publishing. A practical tip: generate several title and thumbnail options for each upload and compare them over time, since packaging is one of the easiest things to experiment with after a video goes live. Keep the strongest options in the history library so you can reuse what works on future videos.

name: MedResolve AI
tagline: Checks hospital bills for errors and gives you scripts for disputing charges
description: MedResolve AI compares a medical bill with your insurer's Explanation of Benefits, flags likely errors for free, and sells a step-by-step plan with call scripts per bill.
longDescription: MedResolve AI is a web service that helps US patients and their families review medical bills before paying them. You upload a hospital or doctor bill as a PDF or phone photo, optionally with the Explanation of Benefits from your insurer, and the tool checks for duplicate or bundled billing codes, prices well above Medicare and insurer rates, financial assistance eligibility, surprise out-of-network charges covered by the No Surprises Act, bills above a Good Faith Estimate, and refunds you may be owed. The free check shows what looks wrong and how much money is involved. A paid upgrade for that bill adds a step-by-step plan, word-for-word call scripts and a call log.
pros: Free check with no account or card
Flat fee instead of a cut of savings
You stay in control of every call
cons: Focused on the US healthcare system
Does not contact providers on your behalf
moreContext:
Medical bills can be hard to read, and MedResolve AI sets out to level the field for patients. It reads your bill alongside your insurer's Explanation of Benefits and explains in plain language what looks wrong, how much money is at stake, and exactly what to say when you call the billing office.

- Checks for duplicate charges, tests billed separately from a panel that already includes them, and routine supplies billed as extras
- Price comparisons against what Medicare and insurers typically pay
- Screening for hospital financial assistance, No Surprises Act protections and Good Faith Estimate overages
- Detection of insurance that was never billed, including secondary coverage and Medicaid
- A flat fee per bill or per year rather than a percentage of any savings

MedResolve AI is especially useful for patients, caregivers and adult children helping a parent sort through hospital paperwork. A practical tip: request an itemized bill with billing codes before uploading, since the site notes that itemized statements give the best results. The service also states that it is not a law firm or healthcare provider, so confirm important details with your insurer.

name: check-ride.ai
tagline: AI prep for FAA written tests and checkride orals with a voice examiner
description: check-ride.ai helps pilots prepare for FAA knowledge tests and practical exam orals, using coached practice questions and a voice AI examiner built on the ACS.
longDescription: check-ride.ai is an AI study platform for pilots working toward FAA certificates and ratings, including Private Pilot, Instrument, Commercial, CFI, CFII and ATP. Written prep coaches you through knowledge test questions and asks you to explain your reasoning, so lucky guesses do not count as mastery and every miss is explained. Mock oral prep uses a voice AI examiner that runs a full checkride oral tailored to your aircraft and airport, then grades each Airman Certification Standards element. A mastery board shows progress across every task. Both modes offer a free demo, and paid access is sold per rating and in session credits. It is built by the team behind Critique Labs AI.
pros: Built on the same ACS examiners use
Free demos without a credit card
Sessions can be paused and resumed
cons: Pricing is split between per-rating purchases and session credits
Covers FAA certificates only
moreContext:
Few study tools cover the checkride oral, which is often the part of flight training that makes pilots most nervous. check-ride.ai rehearses both FAA exams against the Airman Certification Standards, and its voice examiner gives students a realistic way to practice speaking answers out loud before meeting a designated pilot examiner.

- A voice AI examiner that runs a full oral tailored to your aircraft, airport and examiner
- Written prep that asks you to explain each answer, with explanations for every miss
- Grading at the level of individual ACS elements, including knowledge and risk management items
- A mastery board that shows strong and weak areas across all tasks
- Support for Private Pilot, Instrument, Commercial, CFI, CFII and ATP ratings

check-ride.ai is a great companion for student pilots and instructors preparing for knowledge tests and practical exams. A practical tip: try the free five-minute oral demo early in your training, not just the week before the checkride, so you can see which areas of operation need more ground study.

name: Wavoiq
tagline: AI agents that answer, qualify and follow up with customers on WhatsApp and Telegram
description: Wavoiq automates customer conversations on WhatsApp and Telegram, using AI to answer questions, qualify leads, sync them to a CRM and run broadcast campaigns.
longDescription: Wavoiq is an AI automation platform for businesses that talk to customers on messaging apps. On WhatsApp, it provides an AI sales agent and chatbot that answer enquiries around the clock, qualify leads, follow up automatically and hand off to a human when needed, plus marketing broadcasts through Meta's Cloud API. On Telegram, it adds community management, AI moderation and broadcast automation. Leads can be pushed into a CRM, and the platform lists 20 native integrations plus Zapier and n8n. Pricing is one flat monthly subscription with every feature included, with usage billed through pay-as-you-go credits. It is aimed at small businesses and agencies handling many client conversations.
pros: One flat plan with every feature
cons: Usage costs extra on top of the subscription
Limited to messaging channels
moreContext:
Wavoiq is built for businesses whose customers would rather send a message than fill in a form. It puts an AI layer on top of WhatsApp and Telegram so enquiries get an answer straight away, promising leads are qualified and passed to sales, and nobody waits for a team member to be free.

- An AI sales agent that qualifies leads and follows up on WhatsApp
- Support automation with a clean handoff to a human when a conversation needs it
- Telegram tools for welcoming members, moderating with AI and broadcasting updates
- CRM syncing, 20 native integrations and connections through Zapier and n8n
- Agency features for running several client accounts from one platform

Wavoiq is a sensible choice for small businesses, online shops and agencies that handle a steady flow of chat enquiries. A practical tip: use the 1,000 credits included in the first month to test the lead qualification flow on real conversations, and review the handoff rules carefully before switching on full automation. Pricing is a flat monthly fee plus usage, so costs follow the volume of real conversations.

name: Vitra.ai
tagline: Agentic content platform for creating, translating and personalizing media
description: Vitra.ai Universe brings video dubbing, image and document translation, website localization, voice cloning and content creation into one workflow platform.
longDescription: Vitra.ai Universe is an agentic content platform that aims to replace a stack of separate creation and localization tools. Teams can create and translate videos with dubbing, lip-sync and subtitles, generate and translate images, and localize documents, websites, mobile apps and developer formats such as XML, XLIFF and JSON. Supporting features include text-to-speech, voice cloning, transcription, a translation management system with memory and glossaries, style guides, quality control and an asset manager. AI agents can run repeat workflows, while human reviewers approve the output. New accounts start with 500 free credits, then move to a subscription or top-ups. Enterprise options include private AI deployment and white labeling.
pros: Covers many formats in one platform
cons: Paid plan prices are not listed publicly
The breadth of features takes time to learn
moreContext:
Vitra.ai Universe is ambitious in scope. Rather than offering one translation or dubbing tool, it tries to cover the whole content lifecycle, from creating a video or image to translating, personalizing, reviewing and publishing it across languages and formats, with AI agents taking on the repetitive steps.

- Video localization with dubbing, lip-sync, subtitles and voice cloning
- Image and document translation, plus website, mobile app and developer file localization
- A translation management system with memory, term bases, glossaries and style guides
- Quality control and review steps so people approve what AI agents produce
- Enterprise options such as private AI deployment and white-label setups

Vitra.ai is well suited to marketing, training and product teams that publish the same content in many languages. A practical tip: load your glossary and brand style guide before running your first project, since that context helps keep terminology and tone consistent across every output. New accounts receive 500 free credits, which is enough to run a small pilot project and see how the agentic workflows fit your team before choosing a subscription.

name: Memories.ai
tagline: Visual memory platform that indexes video so AI can search and recall it
description: Memories.ai turns large video libraries into searchable, structured memory, offering APIs for video search, summaries, transcription and embeddings, priced by usage.
longDescription: Memories.ai builds video understanding infrastructure that lets machines index and recall what they have seen. Its platform processes footage into structured data covering people, scenes, actions and spoken words, then stores it as persistent memory that can be searched or used in chat. Developers access it through an API with endpoints for visual search, video summaries, frame descriptions, embeddings, transcription and speaker diarization, plus ingestion from social video links. Use cases include searchable media archives, security and cross-camera analysis, and visual memory for robots and wearables. The company also publishes research and open-source agents. Pricing is usage-based, charged per inference and per unit of storage rather than per seat.
pros: Usage-based pricing with no seat fees
cons: Developer-oriented, so it needs integration work
Usage costs can be harder to forecast at scale
moreContext:
Memories.ai focuses on a problem most AI tools sidestep: remembering video over time. Instead of analyzing a single clip and forgetting it, the platform builds a persistent, searchable layer of visual memory, so footage can be queried long after it was recorded. The company says its team includes former scientists from Meta, Google and Nvidia.

- Indexing that captures people, scenes, actions and speech from raw footage
- APIs for visual search, summaries, frame descriptions and embeddings
- Transcription, speaker diarization and multimodal speaker recognition
- A transparent price list charged per inference and per unit of storage
- Applications across media archives, security cameras, robotics and wearables

Memories.ai is best for developers and product teams building media search, monitoring or physical AI products that need long-term video recall. A practical tip: use the pricing calculator on the site to estimate indexing and storage costs for a sample of your library before committing a large archive. Teams that only need occasional analysis can start small, since there are no seat licenses or per-user fees to pay up front.

name: FaceSwapAI
tagline: Swaps faces in photos, group shots, videos and GIFs with HD, watermark-free output
description: FaceSwapAI replaces faces in photos, group pictures with up to 10 faces, videos up to 10 minutes and GIFs, using one-time credit packs with no subscription.
longDescription: FaceSwapAI is a browser-based face swap tool covering single photos, group photos with up to ten faces, videos up to ten minutes and animated GIFs. You upload a clear source face and a target image or clip, confirm you have permission to use every face, and receive an HD result without a watermark. Each task shows its credit cost before you submit, and credits come in one-time packs that do not expire. The site also includes an AI image editor, upscaler, background tools, text-to-image and logo makers, plus helpers such as a file compatibility checker and cost calculator. Uploads and results are deleted automatically after 24 hours. An API is also available.
features: Photo, group, video and GIF face swaps
pros: Clear credit cost before each task
cons: No free generations beyond sample previews
Face swapping requires care around consent
moreContext:
FaceSwapAI covers more formats than many face swap tools, handling still photos, crowded group shots, long videos and GIFs in one place. It also takes consent seriously, asking users to confirm they have permission for every face before a swap runs.

- Group photo support for up to ten faces in a single image
- Video face swaps for clips up to ten minutes, plus GIF support
- HD results with no watermark and an exact credit cost shown before submission
- Helper tools such as a readiness check, a video frame picker and a commercial-use rights check
- Automatic deletion of uploads and results after 24 hours

FaceSwapAI is a good option for creators, meme makers and marketers who want polished swaps without a subscription. A practical tip: run the readiness check on your source photo first and choose a sharp, front-facing image, since input quality has the biggest effect on how natural the result looks. Always get permission from the people whose faces you use. Credits never expire, so a single pack can last across many projects.

name: AI Dubbing
tagline: Dub videos into other languages with voice cloning and lip sync
description: A browser-based dubbing tool that translates the speech in a video, generates new audio in another language and can match lip movements, with voice cloning and optional subtitles.
longDescription: AI Dubbing is a web app for translating spoken video content. You upload a clip, pick a target language and one of three dubbing models: an entry model covering 11 languages with full editing control, and two newer models that reach more than 170 languages, the latest aimed at the highest precision. The tool can clone the original speaker's voice from a short sample, adjust lip movements to fit the new audio and add subtitles. It targets marketers, online sellers, educators, trainers and creators who want to reach viewers in other languages. Usage is metered in credits per second of video, and free accounts are limited to short uploads.
features: Three dubbing models up to 170+ languages
Voice cloning from a short sample
cons: Free uploads capped at 15 seconds
Paid plan prices not clearly published
moreContext:
What stands out about AI Dubbing is how it splits the job across three models, so you can trade language reach against control. The original model keeps a smaller set of languages but lets you edit the result closely, while the newer models stretch to more than 170 languages for wider distribution. Voice cloning and lip sync sit in the same flow, which keeps a translated video feeling like the same person talking.

- Language choice is broad, with the site saying 30 languages are available free and a subscription opens up the full library.
- Voice cloning works from a clear recording, which the FAQ puts at roughly 10 seconds to 3 minutes.
- Lip movements are adjusted to the new audio, so dubbed footage looks less out of sync.
- Subtitles can be added alongside the dub for viewers who prefer reading.
- Credits are charged per second of video, so short clips stay inexpensive to test.

It suits course creators, small marketing teams and YouTubers who want to repurpose existing videos for new markets without hiring voice actors. A practical tip: start with a 15 second excerpt on the free tier, compare the three models on the same clip, then commit credits only to the one whose timing and voice match best.

name: Basalt
tagline: Describe an OT or cloud stack in plain English and get a compliant diagram
description: An AI copilot for system architecture that turns plain-language descriptions of cloud, hybrid and industrial stacks into diagrams, with checks against Purdue and IEC 62443 rules.
longDescription: Basalt is an architecture diagramming assistant built with industrial control systems in mind. Engineers describe a cloud, hybrid or OT/ICS environment in plain English and the AI draws it, then accepts follow-up prompts to change it. Before rendering, a deterministic linter checks the design against Purdue model and IEC 62443 rules and blocks invalid topologies. A library of vendor icons covers brands such as Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Cisco and AWS, and a text-based diagram language offers a code-first route with live preview. Exports include versioned PDF and Word files with the reasoning behind each zone and conduit. It is aimed at OT security engineers and critical infrastructure teams.
pros: Built specifically for OT and ICS work
Blocks topologies that break the rules
cons: Free plan limited to 5 diagrams and PNG export
Starter price is quoted on annual billing
moreContext:
Most diagram tools treat an industrial network like any other box-and-arrow drawing, and Basalt takes a different view. It pairs conversational AI drawing with a rules engine that knows the Purdue levels and IEC 62443 zones and conduits, so a design that crosses a boundary it should not is caught before it ever reaches a review meeting. That combination of speed and guardrails is the heart of its appeal.

- Plain-English prompts produce a first diagram, and further prompts edit it without redrawing by hand.
- A deterministic linter checks designs against Purdue and 62443 rules and refuses illegal topologies.
- More than 1,880 vendor symbols cover common industrial, networking and cloud equipment.
- Each change is tied to an entry in a compliance document, and the page says humans sign off on every change.
- A diagram-as-code language with live validation suits engineers who prefer text.

Basalt is best for OT security engineers, integrators and utilities that need diagrams auditors can follow, and it references frameworks such as NIST CSF and NERC CIP alongside 62443. The site notes it is free during early access, so a useful tip is to rebuild one existing network drawing there and compare what the linter flags against your last manual review.

name: Hitem3D
tagline: Turn photos, sketches or ideas into printable 3D models
description: An AI 3D model generator, branded Hi3D on its site, that converts images or text ideas into textured models, splits them for printing and sends them straight to popular slicers.
longDescription: Hitem3D, shown as Hi3D on its website, generates 3D models from photos, sketches or written ideas. After a model is created, users can refine it, split it into parts for easier assembly and prepare multi-color prints. Files export as STL, OBJ, 3MF, GLB and USDZ, and models can be sent directly to slicers including Bambu Lab, OrcaSlicer, Elegoo, Snapmaker and Creality. A print service can also produce and ship a chosen model in a selected material and size. The audience spans makers, 3D printing hobbyists, game and character artists and product designers, including people with no modeling background. Plans run on monthly credits, with a small lifetime allowance on the free tier.
features: STL, OBJ, 3MF, GLB and USDZ export
cons: Free tier is 100 lifetime credits
Plan prices not visible without signing in
moreContext:
Plenty of AI 3D generators stop at a mesh on screen, but Hitem3D keeps going until the model is ready for a printer. Splitting tools, multi-color preparation and one-click handoff to common slicers make it feel built for people who actually want a physical object on their desk, not just a preview.

- Generation starts from a photo, a sketch or a text idea, so you do not need modeling skills.
- Smart splitting breaks complex models into parts that are easier to print and assemble.
- Exports cover STL, OBJ, 3MF, GLB and USDZ, which fits printing, game engines and AR viewers.
- Models can go straight to Bambu Lab, OrcaSlicer, Elegoo, Snapmaker and Creality software.
- Paid tiers scale from 1,000 to 10,000 credits a month with higher concurrent task limits.

It is a good fit for hobbyists making figurines, cosplay parts or gifts, and for designers who want quick physical prototypes. The free plan includes up to 10 standard geometry models, so a practical tip is to test with a clean, well-lit product photo on a plain background, which tends to give image-to-3D tools the clearest shape to work from.

name: CheckAIContent
tagline: Free AI text detector with sentence highlights and writing helpers
description: A free web tool that estimates whether text was written by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or similar models, highlighting suspect sentences, plus a rewriter, tone changer and grammar checker.
longDescription: CheckAIContent is a browser-based AI content detector. Users paste text or upload a DOCX or PDF file, and the tool analyzes sentence structure, perplexity, burstiness and other linguistic patterns to return an AI probability score with sentence-level highlights. Alongside detection it offers three writing helpers: a paragraph rewriter, a tone changer and a grammar checker. The site is aimed at writers, bloggers and SEO professionals who want a quick read on how machine-like a draft looks. Detection works without signing up, and the site states plainly that its results are estimates meant for informational use rather than proof of authorship.
features: Rewriter, tone changer and grammar checker
pros: Extra writing tools in one place
cons: Results are estimates, as the site itself notes
Little public information about the team or limits
moreContext:
The appeal of CheckAIContent is how little friction it adds. You can paste a paragraph or drop in a document and get a score with highlighted sentences in one step, without creating an account. That makes it handy as a quick second opinion before you publish or submit something.

- Detection looks at signals such as perplexity, burstiness and sentence structure rather than a single keyword check.
- Sentence-level highlights show where the text reads most machine-like, which helps with targeted edits.
- DOCX and PDF uploads save you from copying long documents by hand.
- A paragraph rewriter, tone changer and grammar checker live on the same site for follow-up edits.
- The site is candid that scores are estimates, which sets sensible expectations.

It is best for bloggers, freelance writers and SEO teams who want a free spot check on drafts. Because no detector is fully reliable, a practical tip is to treat the score as a prompt for review: rework the highlighted passages in your own voice, then compare the result against a second detector before drawing any conclusions about authorship.

name: Coo
tagline: AI recruiting agent that finds and qualifies active and passive candidates
description: Cooper's AI sourcing agent searches a large profile pool, qualifies candidates against your hiring brief and delivers matches with reasoning, either standalone next to your ATS or inside Cooper.
longDescription: Coo is a recruiting agent from Cooper, an AI hiring platform that also offers screening, interviewing and applicant tracking. Recruiters start by writing a hiring brief covering skills, must-haves, team context and stage. Coo then searches beyond inbound applicants across what the company describes as more than 900 million profiles, weighs resume signals, fit, availability and intent, and sends qualified matches with an explanation for each. The recruiter reviews profiles and decides whom to contact. It can run on its own beside an existing ATS or within Cooper's platform. It targets startups, scaleups, agencies, high-volume and campus hiring teams, and distributed teams hiring across countries.
features: Works standalone or inside Cooper ATS
cons: Seat prices not published
Success fee of 5 to 10% of salary adds up for senior roles
moreContext:
Coo stands out by doing the sourcing legwork before anything lands in your inbox. Instead of waiting for applications, it works from a written hiring brief, searches widely for people who match and returns a short list with its reasoning attached, so recruiters spend time judging fit rather than hunting.

- Searches what the company says is a pool of more than 900 million profiles, including passive candidates.
- Qualifies candidates on resume signals, fit, availability and intent before surfacing them.
- Every match comes with an explanation, which makes it easier to trust or overrule the agent.
- Runs standalone next to an existing ATS or as part of Cooper, which also offers the Scout screening and Robin interviewing agents.
- Offers either success-based pricing at 5 to 10% of annual base salary or monthly seat access that starts with 100 free profiles.

It is well suited to startups, scaleups and agencies filling many roles without a large sourcing team. A practical tip: invest time in the hiring brief, spelling out true must-haves versus nice-to-haves, since the quality of the qualified matches depends on how clearly the role is described.

name: GirikVoice
tagline: Multilingual AI voice agents for calls, connected to Salesforce and other CRMs
description: Girikon AI's call automation platform detects a caller's language in real time, answers in that language, books appointments, qualifies leads and hands off to people when needed.
longDescription: GirikVoice is a multilingual AI voice agent platform from Girikon AI, a company that builds Salesforce-native customer engagement tools. It handles inbound support calls and outbound campaigns, qualifies leads, books appointments and answers common questions. The system identifies the caller's language as the conversation starts and responds in kind, escalating to a human agent when a call needs one. Outcomes are logged to the CRM, with integrations for Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics, Zendesk, Zapier and Google Calendar. It is designed for businesses serving customers across several markets and languages, such as financial services firms and global support teams. Pricing is quoted per customer based on team size and call volume.
pros: Covers both support and sales calls
cons: No public pricing, demo required
Language count varies across the site
moreContext:
GirikVoice is interesting because it comes from a team with long Salesforce experience, and that shows in how tightly calls tie back to CRM records. The headline capability is language detection at the start of a call, so a customer can simply speak their own language and get an answer in it without menus or transfers.

- Detects the caller's language in real time and replies in that language.
- Handles inbound support, outbound campaigns, lead qualification and appointment booking.
- Passes calls to a human agent when the conversation calls for it.
- Logs outcomes to Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics or Zendesk, with Zapier and Google Calendar support.
- Sits within a wider suite that includes GirikCTI telephony, GirikSMS messaging and the GirikIQ meeting co-pilot.

It is a natural fit for Salesforce-centered sales and service teams with customers across several countries. The site quotes different totals for supported languages, so a practical tip is to bring your exact list of required languages and accents to the demo and ask to hear test calls in each before signing.

name: Qwen3-TTS
tagline: Open-source text-to-speech models with voice cloning and voice design
description: Alibaba's Qwen team released this Apache-2.0 speech model family in 0.6B and 1.7B sizes, covering preset voices, voice design from text descriptions and voice cloning from a few seconds of audio.
longDescription: Qwen3-TTS is an open-source family of text-to-speech models from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team, released in January 2026 under the Apache-2.0 license. It comes in 0.6B and 1.7B sizes and three types: CustomVoice with nine preset voices and instruction-based style control, VoiceDesign for creating a voice from a written description, and Base for cloning a voice from about three seconds of reference audio. It speaks ten languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish and German, and supports streaming with very low latency. Developers install it through pip, download weights from Hugging Face or ModelScope, run a local web demo, or call hosted versions through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
features: Voice cloning from about 3 seconds of audio
pros: Hosted API option on Alibaba Cloud
cons: Needs Python setup and a capable GPU for best speed
Language list is narrower than some commercial services
moreContext:
Open speech models often force a choice between quality and flexibility, and Qwen3-TTS tries to offer both. Three model types cover the most common needs, from ready-made voices to cloning to designing a brand new voice from a sentence of description, and the permissive license means teams can build on it commercially.

- Base models clone a voice from roughly three seconds of reference audio and can be fine-tuned.
- VoiceDesign creates a voice from a natural-language description, and that voice can then be reused for cloning.
- Streaming generation starts audio almost immediately, which the team reports as latency as low as 97 ms.
- A pip package, a local web demo and vLLM-Omni support make it practical for developers.
- Real-time hosted versions are available through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio for teams that prefer an API.

It is best for developers building voice assistants, narration pipelines or accessibility features who want control over hosting and cost. A practical tip: start with the 0.6B model to prototype on modest hardware, then move to 1.7B when you need voice design or higher expressiveness, and always get consent before cloning anyone's voice.

name: Arcmira
tagline: Search and monitor what people say across podcasts and long-form YouTube
description: Arcmira indexes podcasts, interviews and long YouTube videos so you or your own AI agent can find timestamped moments, track topics and people over time and get alerts when they come up.
longDescription: Arcmira is a search and monitoring service for public spoken conversations. It indexes podcasts, interviews and long-form YouTube videos and maps who appears where, what they discuss and which brands get mentioned. Users ask questions in a built-in chat or connect their own AI assistant through an agent setup, and results come back as timestamped excerpts with source links. Other tools chart how coverage of a topic changes over time, rank the most mentioned people, companies and products, create shareable research briefs as PDFs, and run monitors that send alerts and a daily email digest. It suits researchers, journalists, analysts and marketers tracking public discussion.
features: Topic and person monitors with alerts
Connect your own AI agent or API
pros: Covers spoken media that text search misses
Works with your existing AI tools
Generous free credits to try it
cons: Free plan hides the newest 30 days of media
Higher tiers get expensive quickly
moreContext:
A huge amount of expert opinion now lives in podcasts and long interviews rather than articles, and Arcmira is built to make that material searchable. Instead of scrubbing through hours of video, you ask a question and get the exact moments, with timestamps and links, plus a sense of how much a topic is being discussed and by whom.

- Answers questions with video counts, selected moments and links back to the source.
- Shows how coverage of a topic rises or falls across time windows.
- Monitors topics or people and sends alerts plus a daily email digest.
- Ranks the people, companies, topics and products mentioned most in recent videos.
- Connects to your own AI through an agent setup or API, and its demo shows claims being checked against outside sources.

It is best for analysts, journalists, PR teams and investors who need to know what is being said out loud about a subject. The free plan includes 1,000 credits a month and two monitors, so a practical tip is to set one monitor on your company or a competitor and one on a key topic, then judge the daily digest for a week before upgrading.

name: EraseKit
tagline: Free in-browser AI object remover for photos, no account required
description: Paint over people, logos, text or timestamps and EraseKit fills the area using an inpainting model that runs in your browser, with a batch option for up to 30 images.
longDescription: EraseKit is a free web editor for removing unwanted objects from photos. You brush over the item you want gone, such as a stray person, a logo, a caption or a date stamp, and an image inpainting model creates a plausible fill from the surrounding pixels. The model runs locally through ONNX Runtime Web, using WebGPU where available and WebAssembly otherwise, so images are processed in the browser rather than uploaded for editing. An apply-to-all option repeats a selection at the same position across up to 30 images. It targets real estate, product and travel photographers, designers and anyone cleaning up personal photos, and it requires no account or subscription.
features: In-browser model via WebGPU or WebAssembly
Batch apply to up to 30 images
pros: Photos are processed on your device
Handy batch mode for repeated marks
cons: Batch mode does not track moving objects
Large fills can look invented, as with any inpainting
moreContext:
EraseKit takes a refreshingly simple approach to photo cleanup: open the page, paint over what you do not want and let a model fill the gap, all without creating an account. Because the model runs inside the browser, the editing happens on your own device, which many people will appreciate when working with personal or client photos.

- Removes people, logos, text and timestamps with a simple brush.
- Runs its inpainting model through ONNX Runtime Web, using WebGPU when the browser supports it.
- Apply to all repeats one selection across as many as 30 images at the same relative spot.
- The site currently has no subscription paywall and asks for no signup.
- It is upfront that fills are estimates and cannot reveal what was originally hidden.

It is a great fit for real estate agents, online sellers and travelers who need quick, private cleanups without paying for a full editor. A practical tip: paint slightly beyond the edges of the object, and for batches of photos taken from a tripod, such as product shots with the same watermark, use the batch option to save a lot of repetitive work.

name: Genie 3
tagline: Google DeepMind's world model that generates explorable worlds in real time
description: Genie 3 turns a text description into an interactive, photorealistic environment you can move through at 720p and 20 to 24 frames per second, now available to try through the Project Genie prototype.
longDescription: Genie 3 is a general-purpose world model from Google DeepMind. Given a text prompt, it generates a photorealistic or stylized environment that users can navigate in real time at 720p and 20 to 24 frames per second. Worlds stay largely consistent for several minutes, and users can trigger promptable events such as changing the weather or adding objects and characters. Public access comes through Project Genie, an experimental research prototype that also lets people start from an image. Reports from its launch say it rolled out first to adult Google AI Ultra subscribers in the United States, with short sessions. It interests game designers, researchers, educators and curious creators.
pros: Genuinely interactive, not a fixed clip
cons: Access limited to a costly subscription in select regions
Sessions are short and experimental
moreContext:
Most AI video tools hand you a finished clip, while Genie 3 hands you a place. You describe a scene and then walk around inside it, with the model generating each new view as you move, which makes it one of the clearest public looks at where interactive generative media is heading.

- Generates explorable environments from text, with Project Genie also accepting an image as a starting point.
- Runs in real time at 720p and 20 to 24 frames per second, according to DeepMind.
- Keeps worlds largely consistent for several minutes and remembers recent changes for about a minute.
- Promptable events let you alter weather or add objects and characters while exploring.
- Launch coverage says Project Genie works alongside Gemini models and the Nano Banana Pro image tool.

It is best for game designers, researchers, teachers and creative technologists who want to experiment with world models today rather than read about them. Since sessions are brief and access sits behind a premium plan, a practical tip is to plan prompts in advance, with a clear setting, style and a few events you want to try, so each session yields useful ideas.

name: ClipMode
tagline: Train your face once, then generate consistent photos and short videos
description: ClipMode trains a private model on your selfies so the same face appears across AI photo packs, headshots and 5-second video clips, including remixes of existing clip motion.
longDescription: ClipMode is an AI photo and video generator centered on one consistent person. Users upload reference selfies, the service trains a private model in about two minutes, and that model is then used across more than 90 photo packs and video templates. Outputs include headshots, social and dating photos, and 5-second video clips. A Clip Remix feature takes the motion and camera work of an existing clip and applies it to the trained face. The service is aimed at virtual influencers, faceless content operators, professionals who need headshots and anyone who wants a steady visual identity online. New users get a few watermarked credits, with a premium subscription and credit packs for more.
features: Private face model trained in minutes
pros: Keeps the same face across every output
cons: Free credits are few and watermarked
Premium plan is pricey for casual use
moreContext:
The hardest part of AI portraits is getting the same person to show up twice, and ClipMode is designed around solving exactly that. By training a private model on your own photos first, it can reuse your likeness across headshots, lifestyle shots and short videos, which is useful for anyone building a recognizable presence online.

- Trains a private face model in about two minutes, according to the FAQ.
- Offers more than 90 photo packs and video templates to pick from.
- Produces 5-second video clips as well as still images.
- Clip Remix applies the motion and camera movement from an existing clip to your trained face.
- Premium adds custom training, faster generations and commercial-use licensing, and credit packs start at $10.

It is best for creators running virtual influencer or faceless channels, and professionals who want updated headshots without a photo shoot. A practical tip: upload varied, well-lit selfies with different angles and expressions, since a richer reference set usually gives a trained model more to work with, and spend the free credits testing one photo pack before buying more.

name: Design.com
tagline: AI logo maker plus templates for cards, social posts, sites and more
description: Design.com generates logos from a prompt and offers AI-assisted templates for business cards, social graphics, flyers, presentations, websites, link-in-bio pages and other brand assets.
longDescription: Design.com is a branding and design platform built around an AI logo maker. You enter a business name or prompt, get logo options in seconds and adjust fonts, colors and layout, using AI prompts or chat to make changes. Beyond logos, it provides templates for business cards, social media graphics, posters, flyers, t-shirts, email signatures, letterheads, presentations and resumes, along with a website builder, link-in-bio pages, digital business cards, QR codes and domain names. AI helpers include a background remover and business and domain name generators. It is aimed at startups, small businesses and individuals in fields such as food, real estate, fitness and music who want a full brand kit in one place.
features: Templates for print and social assets
AI business and domain name generators
pros: One place for a whole brand kit
cons: Pricing details are not shown on the homepage
Template-led logos can look similar to others
moreContext:
What makes Design.com appealing is that it does not stop at the logo. Once you have a mark you like, the same platform carries it into business cards, social posts, a website, a link-in-bio page and even email signatures, which spares small businesses from juggling several tools to look consistent.

- Generates logo options from a prompt in seconds, then lets you fine-tune fonts, colors and layout.
- Supports changes through AI prompts or a chat-style editor.
- Covers print and digital assets, from flyers and t-shirts to presentations and resumes.
- Includes a website builder, digital business cards, QR codes and domain search.
- Adds AI helpers for removing backgrounds and brainstorming business and domain names.

It is best for founders, freelancers and local businesses that need a coherent brand quickly and on a small budget. A practical tip: before downloading, try your logo on a business card and a social post template inside the platform, since seeing it at small and large sizes is the quickest way to spot legibility issues.

name: Email Header Analyzer
tagline: Paste email headers to see SPF, DKIM, DMARC results explained in plain English
description: A free MailBoxInsights tool that checks authentication results, decodes Microsoft 365 spam stamps, maps delivery hops and delays, flags warning signs and uses AI to explain the findings.
longDescription: Email Header Analyzer is a free tool from MailBoxInsights, an email-focused site run by an Exchange and Microsoft 365 specialist. You paste a message's raw headers and the tool checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC and Microsoft compauth, decodes Microsoft 365 spam stamps such as SCL, BCL and filter verdicts, and lists each delivery hop with its delay. It also flags warning signs like Reply-To mismatches. The checks themselves run in code, and AI turns the results into a plain-English explanation. It helps anyone working out why a message landed in junk, arrived late or looks like phishing, and the page includes steps for copying headers from Outlook and Gmail.
features: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and compauth checks
pros: Deterministic checks with AI only for explanation
cons: Requires copying raw headers manually
Less tailored to non-Microsoft mail systems
moreContext:
Email headers are full of useful clues, but they are notoriously hard to read. This analyzer splits the work sensibly: code performs the actual authentication and routing checks, and AI is used only to explain what those results mean, which keeps the verdicts grounded while making them understandable for non-specialists.

- Checks SPF, DKIM, DMARC and Microsoft compauth in one pass.
- Decodes Microsoft 365 stamps, including SCL, BCL, spam category and filter verdict.
- Maps every delivery hop with its delay, which helps explain late messages.
- Flags warning signs such as a Reply-To that does not match the sender.
- The site says nothing you paste is stored, and it is not affiliated with Microsoft.

It is best for IT admins, help desk staff and small business owners troubleshooting junked or suspicious mail, especially in Outlook and Microsoft 365. The same site also offers an AI Outlook rule builder and an out-of-office generator. A practical tip: compare headers from a message that arrived correctly with one that went to junk, since the differences in authentication and spam scores usually point straight to the cause.

name: StyleMimic
tagline: AI ghostwriter that learns your writing style from a sample
description: Paste a sample of your writing and StyleMimic drafts posts, emails, replies, captions, newsletters and articles that sound like you, with reusable style profiles for multiple voices.
longDescription: StyleMimic is an AI ghostwriting tool that studies how you write and drafts new content in that voice. You paste a writing sample, and one post is enough to begin, then describe what you want to say. The tool produces a draft that you can revise with plain-language requests. Styles are saved as reusable profiles, and you can view, edit or delete the samples behind each one. It handles social posts, emails, replies, captions, newsletters and articles. The audience includes individual creators and professionals, ghostwriters juggling several client voices, and brands that want a consistent tone across writers. A free plan includes a monthly word allowance and multiple style profiles.
features: Style learning from a single sample
Drafts for posts, emails and articles
pros: Free plan with 5,000 words a month
cons: Paid tiers are announced but not yet available
Does not name the AI service behind it
moreContext:
Generic AI drafts often sound like everyone and no one, and StyleMimic is built to fix that. It learns from your own writing, starting with as little as a single post, and keeps that voice as a profile you can return to, which makes the drafts feel closer to something you would actually publish.

- Builds a style profile from a pasted sample, and you can add more samples over time.
- Lets you view, edit or delete the samples a style is based on, which keeps you in control.
- Revises drafts through plain-language feedback such as shorter or more casual.
- Free plan includes 5,000 words a month and up to 10 style profiles with no card required.
- Announced Starter and Pro tiers would raise limits, with top-up word packs that do not expire.

It is a strong fit for creators, consultants and ghostwriters who manage more than one voice. A practical tip: build each profile from a few pieces of the same type, such as several LinkedIn posts, because samples that match the format you want usually produce drafts that need fewer edits.

name: PostOnce
tagline: Post once on your main app and have it crossposted to your other accounts
description: PostOnce watches your main social account and republishes new posts to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Facebook and Pinterest, with MCP and API access for AI agents.
longDescription: PostOnce is a crossposting service for creators and businesses. You connect your accounts through each platform's own login, pick a main app and keep posting there as usual. When PostOnce detects a new post, it republishes it to your other connected platforms within about 20 minutes, using the platforms' official posting APIs. Supported networks include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest. Paid plans include a developer API and an MCP server, so posts can also be published from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or other agents. It is built for UGC creators, coaches, small businesses, realtors, theme pages and agencies managing many client accounts.
features: Automatic crossposting from a main app
Publishing from AI chat and coding tools
pros: No change to your posting habit
cons: No permanent free plan
Monthly pricing is shown in a confusing per-day format
moreContext:
The charm of PostOnce is that it asks almost nothing of you. Rather than learning a new scheduler, you keep posting in the app you already use, and the service quietly republishes each post across the rest of your accounts. For creators spread across many short-form platforms, that removes a tedious daily chore.

- Detects new posts on your chosen main app and shares them to other platforms, which the site says happens within 20 minutes.
- Supports TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest.
- Connects through each platform's official login and posting APIs.
- Includes a developer API and MCP on all paid plans, so agents in ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Codex can publish for you.
- Plans scale from 15 accounts on Creator to 200 on Agency, with a 7-day trial and no card required.

It is best for UGC creators, coaches, realtors and agencies who publish the same content to many audiences. A practical tip: choose the platform where you write the most complete captions as your main app, since that text travels with each crosspost, and review a few republished posts during the trial to confirm formatting on every network.

name: GLM-5.3-Flash
tagline: Z.ai's open-weights multimodal model built for efficient coding and agents
description: A mixture-of-experts model from Z.ai with about 320B total and 18B active parameters, a 1M-token context, image and video input, and MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face.
longDescription: GLM-5.3-Flash is a large language model from Z.ai, the company formerly known as Zhipu AI. It uses a mixture-of-experts design with about 320 billion total and 18 billion active parameters, and combines sparse and linear attention to cut long-context serving costs. Z.ai describes it as the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series, accepting text, images, video and files while producing text. It offers a 1M-token context window, up to 128K output tokens, function calling, structured output and a thinking mode. Developers can call it through the Z.ai API, use it in the GLM Coding Plan, or download MIT-licensed weights from Hugging Face.
pros: Open weights under a permissive license
cons: Self-hosting the full model needs serious hardware
Thinking mode cannot be switched off
moreContext:
GLM-5.3-Flash is notable for pairing frontier-style ambitions with an open license. Z.ai positions it for coding and long-running agent work, and its hybrid attention design is meant to keep long-context requests affordable to serve, which matters when an agent is reading a large repository or a stack of documents.

- Mixture-of-experts architecture with roughly 320B total and 18B active parameters.
- A 1M-token context window with up to 128K tokens of output, per Z.ai's documentation.
- Native multimodal input covering images, video, text and files.
- Function calling, context caching and structured JSON output for building agents.
- Weights are published on Hugging Face under the MIT license, and the model card says it outperforms GLM-5.2 at a fraction of the price.

It is best for developers and teams who want a capable coding and agent model they can either call cheaply by API or host themselves. A practical tip: try it first through the Z.ai API or HuggingChat on a real task from your codebase, then decide whether the faster FlashX variant or self-hosting makes more sense for your volume.

name: All in One Accessibility
tagline: AI-powered website accessibility widget with 90+ features and AI alt text
description: Skynet Technologies' widget adds screen reader, voice navigation, contrast and reading aids plus AI-generated image alt text to websites through one script, across hundreds of CMS and ecommerce platforms.
longDescription: All in One Accessibility is a website accessibility widget from Skynet Technologies, a digital accessibility and web services firm. Site owners install it with a short script or a platform app and manage it from a dashboard. The widget offers more than 90 features, including a screen reader, voice navigation, color blindness simulation and a Libras sign language option, in over 190 languages. AI generates alt text for images, which owners can edit, and supports image alt-text remediation. It works with platforms such as WordPress, Shopify and Wix, and with React, Vue and Angular apps. Paid add-ons include manual audits, remediation and VPAT reports for organizations pursuing WCAG compliance.
features: Works on WordPress, Shopify, Wix and more
cons: A widget alone does not make a site fully compliant
Pricing rises with page views
moreContext:
Accessibility work can feel overwhelming for small site owners, and All in One Accessibility offers a practical first step. A single script adds a toolbar of reading, navigation and display aids, while AI-generated alt text tackles one of the most common gaps on real websites: images with no description for screen reader users.

- Bundles more than 90 features, including a screen reader, voice navigation and color blindness simulation.
- Generates alt text for images with AI and lets owners edit it before it goes live.
- Supports more than 190 languages, plus a Libras sign language option.
- Installs on many CMS, LMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms and on React, Vue and Angular apps.
- Comes from Skynet Technologies, which the company says has been in business since 2002 and also offers audits and VPAT reports.

It is best for small and mid-sized businesses, schools and public sector sites that want visible improvements quickly. A practical tip: use the 10-day trial to review the AI alt text on your most important pages, and pair the widget with a manual audit, because overlays work best as a complement to fixing issues in the site code itself.

name: Tripo AI
tagline: Generate textured 3D models from text or a single image
description: Tripo, from the company VAST, turns a prompt or one image into a 3D model and offers Tripo Studio for refining it with tools such as smart low poly and HD textures, plus an API for developers.
longDescription: Tripo AI is a 3D generation platform built by VAST. Users describe an object in text or upload a single image, and Tripo produces a 3D model that can be refined and textured. Tripo Studio, its browser workspace, added features such as Smart Low Poly and HD Textures for paid subscribers, aimed at producing cleaner, game-ready assets. Generation runs on a credit system, with separate costs for draft models, refinement and export. A developer API exposes text-to-3D, image-to-3D, mesh refinement and texturing for apps and pipelines. It serves game developers, 3D artists, designers, educators and hobbyists who need models faster than traditional sculpting allows, with a free tier for basic use.
features: Smart Low Poly and HD Textures
pros: Fast route from idea to 3D asset
API for building it into pipelines
cons: Free tier is small
Advanced Studio features need a paid plan
moreContext:
Tripo has become one of the better-known names in AI 3D generation by focusing on assets people can actually use. Instead of stopping at a rough mesh, its Studio workspace adds tools for cleaner topology and higher quality textures, which matters for anyone dropping models into a game engine or a real-time scene.

- Creates 3D models from a text prompt or a single reference image.
- Tripo Studio adds Smart Low Poly and HD Textures, which the company introduced with Studio 1.0.
- A credit system separates the cost of drafts, refinement and export, so you pay for the steps you use.
- The Tripo API offers text-to-3D, image-to-3D, mesh refinement and texturing for developers.
- Its maker VAST was reported in July 2026 to have raised a large new funding round, a sign of continued investment in the product.

It is best for indie game studios, 3D artists and product designers who need many props or concept models quickly. A practical tip: generate quick drafts first to compare several ideas cheaply, then spend refinement credits only on the one or two models worth polishing in Studio.

name: ClipDance
tagline: Browser video studio running Seedance 2.0 and other models with native audio
description: ClipDance offers text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video using ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 and other third-party models, with 1080p output, synced audio, lip-sync and beat-sync editing.
longDescription: ClipDance is an independent web platform for AI video and image generation. Its main engine is ByteDance's Seedance 2.0, and it also offers other third-party models such as Veo 3, Kling V3 and Midjourney V8, while stating that it is not affiliated with ByteDance. Users can create clips from text, images or up to 12 reference inputs, extend or edit existing videos, and output 1080p video with synchronized native audio. Extra tools include lip-sync, beat-sync for music videos, video upscaling and image generation. It suits social creators, musicians and marketers making short clips. New accounts get a few free credits, and paid plans add monthly credits and higher quality output.
features: Text, image and reference to video
pros: Several leading models in one place
Clear note that it is independent of ByteDance
cons: Only 3 free credits to start
No named company behind the service
moreContext:
ClipDance gives creators an easy way into ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 model without any setup, and it adds useful editing tools around the raw generations. The ability to feed in up to a dozen reference images or clips helps keep characters, style and motion consistent, which is often the weakest point of short AI videos.

- Generates video from text, images or up to 12 reference inputs per project.
- Produces 1080p clips with synchronized native audio on paid plans.
- Includes lip-sync, beat-sync for music videos and video extension.
- Offers other models such as Veo 3, Kling V3 and Midjourney V8 alongside Seedance.
- States clearly that it is independent of ByteDance and simply provides access to the models.

It is best for TikTok and Reels creators, independent musicians and small marketing teams who want quick, polished clips. A practical tip: use the free credits on a short image-to-video test with a strong reference image, then compare annual and monthly billing, since the site advertises a 20% saving on yearly plans.

name: Loki.Build
tagline: AI landing page builder with a visual editor you can steer by prompt or by hand
