description: Loki.Build turns a prompt, brief or product description into a styled landing page, then lets you refine any section with AI or manual edits before publishing.
longDescription: Loki.Build is a landing page builder centered on AI generation. You describe an idea, paste a product description or drop in a brief, and it produces a branded page tailored to your category and audience. From there, a visual editor lets you change any block either by asking the AI or by editing directly, so you keep control over layout and copy. Pages can be published on a Loki.Build subdomain or, on paid plans, a custom domain, with SEO settings included. It suits founders, marketers and creatives who need polished single pages quickly. A free plan offers 15 credits a month, and paid tiers add credits, pages and domains.
pros: Mix AI edits with direct control
Clear credit and page limits per plan
cons: Free pages carry Loki.Build branding
Credit limits can constrain heavy iteration
moreContext:
What stands out about Loki.Build is how it treats AI as part of the editor rather than a one-shot generator. You start from a prompt or a product brief, but once the page exists you can keep reshaping individual sections with AI or by hand, which keeps the result from feeling locked in. The focus on landing pages, rather than full multi-page sites, keeps the workflow tight.

- Generates a complete landing page from a short prompt, brief or pasted product details
- Lets you edit any block with AI instructions or direct manual changes in the same canvas
- Keeps fonts, colors and styling consistent across every page in a project
- Includes publishing, custom domains on paid plans and built-in SEO settings
- Offers a permanent free tier with 15 monthly credits and two pages

Loki.Build is a good fit for founders, indie makers and marketers who need a polished page for a launch, campaign or waitlist without hiring a designer. A practical tip: write a detailed brief that covers your audience, offer and tone before generating, since a richer starting prompt usually means fewer credits spent on later revisions. Once you settle on a direction, switch to manual edits for small copy tweaks to save credits for bigger layout changes.

name: Lara Translate
tagline: Professional-grade AI translator for text, documents, images, audio and live speech
description: Lara Translate, built by Translated, translates text, files, images and audio across 200+ languages, with style options, glossaries, translation memories and an interpreter mode.
longDescription: Lara Translate is an AI translation platform from Translated, a professional translation company active since 1999. It handles plain text, documents in dozens of file formats with layout preserved, images, audio files and live conversations through a voice interpreter. Users can pick a faithful, fluid or creative style, add context to guide word choices, and rely on glossaries and memories so terminology stays consistent over time. An incognito mode keeps content from being stored or used for training. Lara is available on the web, iOS and Android, plus an API, CLI and MCP server for developers. A free plan covers light use, while Pro and Team plans raise character quotas.
features: Text, document, image and audio translation
pros: Backed by an established translation company
Developer access via API, CLI and MCP
cons: Free plan has a modest monthly character cap
Advanced quality tiers cost more
moreContext:
Lara Translate benefits from its roots in a long-running professional translation business. The company says the model is trained on real professional translations rather than scraped web text, and the product is designed to adapt to your terminology and corrections over time. That combination makes it feel aimed at people who care about consistency, not just quick gist translations.

- Covers text, full documents, images and audio files from one workspace
- Offers faithful, fluid and creative styles plus a field for adding context
- Supports glossaries and memories so preferred terms carry across projects
- Includes an incognito mode where content is not stored or used for training
- Provides an API, SDK, CLI and MCP server alongside web and mobile apps

Lara is best suited to freelancers, small teams and businesses that translate contracts, marketing material or support content regularly and want formatting kept intact. Developers building multilingual features will also appreciate the API access on every plan. A practical tip: set up a glossary with your brand names and product terms before translating a large batch, so the output stays consistent from the first file.

name: Darrow
tagline: Legal intelligence platform that surfaces emerging legal exposure before litigation
description: Darrow uses AI to scan regulatory filings, incident data and litigation patterns for hidden legal violations, giving law firms, insurers and compliance teams early, structured intelligence.
longDescription: Darrow is a legal intelligence company that applies AI to the problem of finding legal risk before it turns into a lawsuit. Its system ingests public signals such as regulatory filings, incident reports, market activity and litigation trends, interprets them through a structured legal knowledge base, and flags emerging exposure across dozens of practice areas. Plaintiff law firms use it to spot potential cases and build portfolios earlier, insurers use it to anticipate litigation exposure when pricing risk, and compliance teams use it to monitor their external footprint. Access is sold through demos and enterprise agreements rather than self-serve plans, so pricing is not published.
features: Case opportunity insights for law firms
Exposure monitoring for insurers and compliance
pros: Works upstream of traditional legal tools
Serves firms, insurers and compliance teams
cons: No self-serve plan or public pricing
Built for organizations, not individuals
moreContext:
Most legal software helps once a matter already exists. Darrow aims earlier in the timeline, looking for the signals that suggest a violation is forming so that the people responsible for it can act sooner. Describing itself as an AI lab focused on legal exposure, the company pairs data ingestion with a structured knowledge base that links laws, organizational weaknesses and enforcement outcomes.

- Ingests regulatory filings, incident reports and litigation patterns at scale
- Maps signals to a structured knowledge base of legal obligations and outcomes
- Helps plaintiff firms identify and prioritize potential cases earlier
- Gives insurers and compliance teams a view of exposure before it escalates
- Covers a wide range of areas, from consumer protection to privacy and employment

Darrow is best for plaintiff law firms, litigation funders, insurers and corporate compliance groups that want structured intelligence rather than another document tool. The company says its platform already serves dozens of organizations across the legal ecosystem. A practical tip: come to the demo with the specific practice areas or risk categories you care about, since that makes it easier to judge how well the coverage matches your work.

name: Animate Memories
tagline: Turn old photos into short animated videos with AI templates
description: Animate Memories brings still photos to life by turning them into short animated clips, with a library of templates for family, celebration, tribute and playful themes.
longDescription: Animate Memories is a web tool that converts a single photo into a short animated video using AI. You upload an image, often an old family picture or a portrait, then pick from a gallery of more than 100 templates grouped into themes such as family, celebration, tribute, kids and viral trends. The service also covers photo restoration, so faded or damaged images can be cleaned up as part of the process. It runs on credits, available as one-time packs or monthly subscriptions, with output quality ranging from standard definition up to 1080p on higher tiers. The site offers free credits for trying the service first.
features: Up to 1080p output on top tier
cons: Higher resolutions require pricier packs
Results depend heavily on photo quality
moreContext:
There is something genuinely touching about seeing an old family photo move again, and Animate Memories builds its whole experience around that moment. Instead of asking you to write prompts, it leans on ready-made templates, so even people who have never used an AI tool can get a result in a few clicks.

- Animates a single uploaded photo into a short video clip
- Offers more than 100 templates sorted into themes like family, tribute and kids
- Includes restoration features for faded or damaged pictures
- Sells credits as one-time packs or monthly subscriptions, depending on how often you create
- Provides free credits so you can test the output before paying

Animate Memories is best for anyone preparing a memorial slideshow, an anniversary surprise or a family history project, as well as people who simply want to share a fun clip of a vintage portrait. A practical tip: scan or photograph prints in good, even light and crop tightly around faces before uploading, since a clearer source image gives the animation much more detail to work with.

name: SongFinder
tagline: Free song identifier for links, audio files and half-remembered lyrics
description: SongFinder identifies music from a TikTok, YouTube or Instagram link, an uploaded audio or video file, or a few typed lyrics, and returns the title, artist, BPM, key and listening links.
longDescription: SongFinder is a free music identification tool that works in the browser without an account. You can paste a link from platforms such as TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Reddit or SoundCloud, upload an MP3, WAV or MP4 file, or type a few words of lyrics you remember. The service extracts an audio fingerprint and matches it against a large track database, with handling for sped-up edits and music playing under speech. Results include the song title, artist, album, tempo and musical key, along with a preview and streaming links. Uploads are processed in isolated containers and, according to the site, deleted within 24 hours.
features: Identify songs from social video links
cons: Less reliable on obscure or unreleased tracks
Browser-only, no dedicated mobile app
moreContext:
Hearing a great track in a short video and not knowing what it is happens to almost everyone, and SongFinder tackles that problem with very little friction. You do not need an account, a download or even the audio file itself, since a pasted link from a social platform is enough to start a search.

- Accepts links from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Reddit, SoundCloud and more
- Takes MP3, WAV and MP4 uploads, or a few lines of remembered lyrics
- Uses audio fingerprinting with handling for sped-up edits and talking over music
- Shows title, artist, album, BPM and musical key alongside listening links
- Deletes uploads within 24 hours, according to the site, and requires no signup

SongFinder is best for social media users, video editors and DJs who regularly need to track down a song from a clip. The extra details such as tempo and key are handy for anyone remixing or matching tracks. A practical tip: if a clip has heavy talking, try trimming to a section where the music is clearly audible for at least several seconds before uploading, which gives the matcher a cleaner sample.

name: Kvio.AI
tagline: One studio for AI video, images and music using Veo, Nano Banana, GPT Image and Lyria
description: Kvio.AI brings several leading generation models into a single credit-based workspace for making short videos, product visuals and songs, with a prompt library for inspiration.
longDescription: Kvio.AI is a creative workspace that gives access to third-party generation models from one interface. For video it offers Google Veo 3.1 with text-to-video, image references, extension and upscaling. For images it provides Nano Banana and GPT Image models with multiple aspect ratios and resolutions, and for music it uses Google Lyria to create songs with vocals or instrumentals from a description. Generations are paid with credits, the cost is shown before each run, and failed generations are refunded. New accounts receive a small batch of free credits, and monthly subscriptions start with a Starter tier for trying every model.
features: Nano Banana and GPT Image models
pros: Video, image and music in one place
Credit cost shown before each run
cons: Relies on third-party models rather than its own
Free credits cover only a couple of videos
moreContext:
Kvio.AI is useful mainly for its convenience. Rather than juggling separate accounts for video, image and music models, you work in one interface with a shared credit balance, and the site is upfront about which underlying models it uses. That transparency, plus a visible cost on every generation, makes it easier to budget creative experiments.

- Runs Google Veo 3.1 for text-to-video, reference images, extensions and upscaling
- Offers Nano Banana and GPT Image models with several aspect ratios and resolutions
- Creates songs with vocals or instrumentals through Google Lyria
- Shows the credit cost before generating and refunds credits when a run fails
- Includes a browsable prompt library across food, product, poster and UI themes

Kvio.AI is a good fit for social media creators, small brands and marketers who want to test short clips, product shots and background music without committing to several subscriptions. A practical tip: use the cheaper Lite or lower-resolution settings while you refine a prompt, then switch to the higher-quality model only for the final version to stretch your monthly credits further.

name: Modern Realty
tagline: AI CRM for real estate agents that drafts replies and ranks leads
description: Modern Realty is a real estate CRM that pulls texts, emails and social DMs into one inbox, drafts replies with AI, scores leads by buying signals and flags clients going cold.
longDescription: Modern Realty is a customer relationship manager built for real estate agents and small teams. It connects to your Twilio number, email and social messaging accounts so every conversation lands in one inbox, where AI prepares a draft reply you can send with a click. The system reads each message for buying signals such as pre-approval or moving timelines, scores leads accordingly and highlights who to call first. It also watches engagement patterns to warn you before a client goes quiet, and can take a listing link a client liked and find similar properties. Plans start with a 30-day free trial and no credit card.
features: Unified SMS, email and DM inbox
pros: Imports contacts from Follow Up Boss
cons: Pricing is high for solo agents
Requires your own Twilio and Resend accounts
moreContext:
Real estate agents spend a surprising amount of time retyping the same follow-ups, and Modern Realty is designed to take that work off their plate. Its main idea is simple: every incoming message gets an AI draft waiting for review, so the agent only has to read, adjust if needed and send.

- Collects SMS, email, Facebook Messenger and Instagram DMs into a single inbox
- Prepares personalized reply drafts as soon as a message arrives
- Scores leads in real time by detecting signals like pre-approval and move dates
- Alerts you when a client relationship is cooling, with a ready follow-up message
- Matches similar properties from a single listing link a client shared

Modern Realty is best for busy solo agents and small teams who handle many leads across channels and want a CRM focused on response speed rather than general sales features. A practical tip: import your existing contacts and connect every messaging channel during the free trial, so the lead scoring has enough real conversation history to show its value before you decide on a plan.

name: Pipedrive
tagline: Pipeline-focused sales CRM with an AI sales assistant built in
description: Pipedrive is a sales CRM organized around visual deal pipelines, with automation, email sync, reporting and AI features that summarize deals, predict win odds and suggest next steps.
longDescription: Pipedrive is a customer relationship management platform designed around the sales pipeline. Teams track deals as cards moving through stages, log activities, sync email and automate repetitive tasks such as follow-up reminders. Its AI Sales Assistant analyzes account data to surface winning patterns, common reasons for lost deals and seasonal trends, and it can answer questions about performance in plain language. AI-generated deal summaries and win probability predictions help reps decide where to focus. The platform also offers lead management, meeting tools, reporting, mobile apps, an API, an MCP server and a large integrations marketplace. A 14-day free trial is available without a credit card.
pros: AI insights built into the CRM
cons: Per-seat pricing adds up for larger teams
Advanced features sit on higher tiers
moreContext:
Pipedrive has long been known for keeping sales work visual and simple, and its AI features follow that same approach. Instead of a separate chatbot, the AI Sales Assistant sits inside the CRM and works from your own deal data, so the insights relate directly to the pipeline you are already managing.

- Organizes every deal as a card that moves through clearly defined sales stages
- Uses AI to highlight winning patterns, lost-deal reasons and seasonal shifts
- Predicts each deal's win probability and recommends next actions
- Summarizes deals and recent changes so teammates stay aligned
- Connects to many tools through its marketplace, API and MCP server

Pipedrive is best for small and midsize sales teams that want a focused CRM their reps will actually keep updated, without the complexity of a large enterprise suite. A practical tip: during the 14-day trial, import a real slice of your current deals rather than sample data, so the AI Sales Assistant has meaningful history to analyze and you can judge its suggestions fairly.

name: Ask BONBON
tagline: AI electrical code assistant for NEC and CEC questions with cited articles
description: Ask BONBON answers electrical code questions for the NEC and CEC with the relevant article cited, and adds field calculators and inspection support for electricians and contractors.
longDescription: Ask BONBON is an AI assistant built for electricians, contractors and inspectors who work with the US National Electrical Code and the Canadian Electrical Code. You type or speak a question and receive an answer that points to the specific code article, so the reasoning can be checked on site. The app also includes field calculators for common tasks such as voltage drop, wiring, loads, motors and solar, along with information on state amendments and inspection preparation. It runs on the web and on iOS and Android. A free plan includes a limited number of questions each month, and paid plans come with a 14-day free trial.
features: NEC and CEC answers with citations
pros: Mobile apps for job site use
cons: Free plan caps monthly questions
Limited to electrical codes
moreContext:
General chatbots can answer electrical questions, but they rarely point you to the exact clause you need to show an inspector. Ask BONBON is built around that requirement, returning answers tied to the relevant NEC or CEC article so electricians can confirm the guidance themselves rather than taking it on trust.

- Answers National Electrical Code and Canadian Electrical Code questions with the article cited
- Accepts questions by voice or text, which is handy with gloves on or hands full
- Includes calculators for voltage drop, wiring, loads, motors and solar work
- Covers state amendments and helps with inspection preparation
- Runs on the web plus iOS and Android, with a free plan and a 14-day trial on paid tiers

Ask BONBON is best for licensed electricians, apprentices, estimators and contractors who look up code requirements during the workday. Apprentices studying for exams may also find the cited answers useful for learning where rules live in the code book. A practical tip: always open the cited article and confirm which code edition your jurisdiction has adopted, since local adoption and amendments can change what applies to a specific job.

name: ego (lite)
tagline: Chromium-based browser that lets AI coding agents automate the web while logged in
description: ego (lite) is a free desktop browser for AI agents that imports your Chrome setup, keeps your logins, and gives agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor an isolated Space to run web tasks.
longDescription: ego (lite) is a Chromium-based browser from Citro Labs designed to be driven by AI agents. It imports your Chrome profile in one step, so sites you are already signed into stay signed in and agents inherit that access without re-authenticating. Agents connect through an ego-browser skill that works with command-line coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI, with no SDK or remote debugging setup. Tasks run in a separate Space so your own tabs and mouse stay untouched. The browser builds compact semantic page snapshots that can reach iframes and shadow DOM. It is free for individuals on macOS and Windows, with custom business plans.
features: Agent access with your existing logins
Skill for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
pros: No SDK or debugging setup needed
Browser data stays on your machine
cons: No Linux version yet
Requires your own model API key
moreContext:
Getting an AI agent to work on sites that require a login is often the hardest part of browser automation, and ego (lite) tackles it directly. Because it imports your Chrome profile, the agent starts already signed in to the tools you use, while working in its own Space so it never takes over the window you are using.

- Imports bookmarks, cookies and logins from Chrome in one click
- Lets agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI connect through a single skill
- Runs agent tasks in isolated Spaces, in parallel, without hijacking your mouse
- Produces compact page snapshots that reach iframes, shadow DOM and embedded widgets
- Keeps browsing data local and needs no account, with you supplying your own model key

ego (lite) is best for developers and technical operators who already use a coding agent and want it to handle web chores such as data collection, form filling or dashboard checks. The company publishes its own benchmarks comparing speed and cost with other browser tools, which are worth reviewing against your own tasks. A practical tip: start with a narrow, repeatable task on one site and watch the agent in its Space before handing it longer workflows.

name: echowin
tagline: Build and run AI phone and chat agents for business calls, web chat and WhatsApp
description: echowin is a platform for building AI voice and chat agents that answer calls, handle chats and WhatsApp, use tools and workflows, and report on conversations, with pay-as-you-go pricing.
longDescription: echowin is an all-in-one platform for creating AI agents that handle phone calls and chat conversations for businesses. You write agent instructions in plain English, add knowledge sources and workflows, connect tools such as inventory checks or follow-up texts, then test and deploy to phone numbers, web chat or WhatsApp. A dashboard tracks conversations, caller sentiment and agent health, and the platform includes an AI-native CRM, integrations, webhooks and a full API. Pricing is usage based, with free starting credits, a monthly fee per phone number and per-minute voice rates, plus discounted bundles. Agencies can resell agents through grey-label and white-label plans.
features: Phone, web chat and WhatsApp deployment
pros: No model training or infrastructure needed
cons: Per-minute costs grow with call volume
HIPAA compliance is a costly add-on
moreContext:
What makes echowin approachable is that an agent is defined mostly in plain language. You describe how it should greet callers, what to ask and when to transfer, then connect the tools it needs, without training models or managing telephony infrastructure yourself. The same workspace covers building, testing, deploying and monitoring.

- Lets you write agent behavior, accents and workflows in plain English
- Deploys one agent across phone numbers, website chat and WhatsApp
- Connects built-in tools, integrations, webhooks and a full API
- Tracks conversations, caller sentiment and an overall agent health score
- Offers grey-label and white-label plans for agencies serving multiple clients

echowin is best for local service businesses, multi-location operators and agencies that want an AI receptionist or support agent answering calls around the clock. Pricing is pay as you go, so small teams can start with the free credits before committing to a minute bundle. A practical tip: run a batch of test calls covering your most common caller questions before going live, and set a monthly spending cap in billing settings so usage stays predictable.

name: AI Lawyer
tagline: Legal AI assistant for consumers, students and lawyers, with research and document tools
description: AI Lawyer answers legal questions in plain language, researches laws by jurisdiction, summarizes and compares documents, and offers legal templates on web, iOS and Android.
longDescription: AI Lawyer is a legal assistant app from AI Lawtech, a company based in Poland. It lets users ask legal questions in conversation and receive simplified explanations, with web research used to gather information quickly. Document features cover summarizing agreements, comparing files, converting images to text and translating documents. A research tool produces summary reports about laws in a chosen country or jurisdiction, and a library of free templates covers common contracts and letters. The product serves consumers trying to understand their rights, law students and solo lawyers or firms looking to speed up routine work. It runs on the web, iOS and Android, with a free trial for new users.
cons: Not a substitute for a licensed attorney
Pricing is not shown publicly before signup
moreContext:
Legal language can be intimidating, and AI Lawyer tries to make it less so by answering questions conversationally and in the user's own language. It also gives working professionals a set of practical document tools, which helps it serve both people with a one-off question and those who handle paperwork every day.

- Answers legal questions in plain language and responds in the language you write in
- Researches laws in a specific country or jurisdiction and returns a summary report
- Summarizes agreements, compares documents and converts images to text
- Includes a free library of contract, letter and agreement templates
- Works across web, iOS and Android, with a student and teacher discount

AI Lawyer is best for consumers who want to understand a lease, contract or dispute before speaking to a professional, and for law students or solo practitioners looking to speed up first drafts and research. A practical tip: treat its answers as a starting point, verify citations against official sources, and consult a licensed lawyer before acting on anything with real legal or financial consequences.

name: Paintit.ai
tagline: AI interior and exterior design tool for redesigning, repainting and staging rooms
description: Paintit.ai reimagines interiors, exteriors and commercial spaces from a photo, preset or prompt, with real furniture suggestions, virtual staging and real paint colors from major brands.
longDescription: Paintit.ai is an AI design tool for visualizing changes to rooms and buildings. You start from a photo, a style preset or a written prompt and can redesign a space, repaint walls, stage an empty room or explore exterior and commercial looks. An AI chat helps refine ideas, and the tool can suggest real furniture pieces. Higher plans add 360-degree views, image to 3D, floor plans, CAD and DXF export, sketch-to-render, Pinterest board import and paint colors from brands such as Behr, Benjamin Moore and Dulux. It targets homeowners, designers and real estate professionals. A free plan includes starter credits, with Starter, Pro and Max tiers above it.
features: Room redesign from a photo or prompt
Real paint colors from major brands
pros: Free plan with no card required
Useful extras for real estate listings
cons: Advanced tools are limited to Pro and Max
Free outputs are lower resolution
moreContext:
Paintit.ai stands out for how much it connects AI visuals to real-world decisions. Instead of stopping at a pretty render, it can suggest actual furniture and apply paint colors from well-known brands, which makes it easier to move from an idea to a shopping list or a conversation with a contractor.

- Redesigns rooms from a photo, a style preset or a written prompt
- Stages empty spaces and repaints walls for listing photos or renovation planning
- Applies real paint colors from brands such as Behr, Benjamin Moore and Dulux
- Offers 360-degree views, image to 3D, floor plans and CAD or DXF export on higher tiers
- Includes an AI chat for guidance and a free plan with starter credits

Paintit.ai is best for homeowners planning a refresh, interior designers presenting early concepts, and real estate agents who need staged listing images quickly. A practical tip: shoot your room photo straight on, in daylight and from a corner that shows most of the space, since a clear, wide starting image gives the AI more accurate structure to work with.

name: Active Dictionary
tagline: AI reading companion that explains passages and helps you reuse new vocabulary
description: Active Dictionary helps learners understand articles, PDFs and captioned videos with in-context explanations, then save expressions and practice them through AI conversation and writing tasks.
longDescription: Active Dictionary is a language learning and reading tool that works alongside the material you are studying. You open a public text from its library or add your own articles, PDFs and captioned YouTube videos to a project. While reading, you can look up a word or ask the AI expert about a hard passage, getting a plain explanation and its meaning in context. Useful phrases can be saved to a personal dictionary with their source sentence, then practiced with an AI conversation partner or in writing tasks that suggest saved expressions. A browser extension and mobile app support saving and review. Public materials work without signing up.
pros: Works with your own articles and videos
cons: Published pricing and plan limits are unclear
Language coverage is not fully listed
moreContext:
Many vocabulary apps stop at definitions, but Active Dictionary is built around actually using the words you find. It keeps the explanation next to the original sentence, then brings saved expressions back into conversation and writing practice, so new language moves from recognition to active use.

- Explains difficult words and passages in context right beside the text you are reading
- Supports articles, PDFs and YouTube videos with captions, plus a public reading library
- Saves expressions with the sentence they came from into a personal dictionary
- Offers an AI conversation partner and writing tasks that draw on your saved phrases
- Includes a browser extension for saving while browsing and a mobile app for review

Active Dictionary is best for intermediate and advanced learners who read real material for work, study or personal interest and want to expand their active vocabulary. A practical tip: add a document you already need to read, such as a report or a course paper, and save only a handful of truly useful expressions per session, so your practice stays focused and the review list stays manageable.

name: BeMusic AI
tagline: AI music generator for full songs, instrumentals, covers and music videos
description: BeMusic AI turns a text prompt or your own lyrics into instrumentals or complete songs with AI vocals, and adds tools for extending tracks, covers, stem splitting and music videos.
longDescription: BeMusic AI is a web-based music generator. You describe a genre, mood, tempo or use case, or paste your own lyrics, and choose between an instrumental and a full song with AI vocals. The tool composes, arranges and mixes the track, which you can preview while it generates and download as MP3 or WAV. Beyond generation, it offers an AI lyrics writer, track extension, cover songs, vocal removal and stem splitting, and on higher plans AI singing photos, music videos and voice cloning. Usage runs on credits, with a short free trial and Creator, Pro and Studio plans. A commercial license is included from the Pro tier upward.
pros: Tracks up to eight minutes long
WAV downloads on all paid plans
cons: Commercial use requires Pro or higher
Free access is a short trial
moreContext:
BeMusic AI goes beyond simple prompt-to-song generation by bundling the editing tools people usually need right after. Once a track exists, you can extend it, make a cover, pull out the vocals or split it into stems, all from the same workspace, which keeps small music projects in one place.

- Creates instrumentals or full songs with AI vocals from a prompt or your own lyrics
- Writes lyrics for you and supports section tags such as verse, chorus and bridge
- Extends tracks, creates covers and separates vocals and stems
- Exports MP3 and lossless WAV, with tracks up to eight minutes
- Adds singing photos, music videos and voice cloning on higher plans

BeMusic AI is best for content creators who need background music, hobby songwriters testing ideas, and producers who want quick drafts to build on. A practical tip: if you plan to use tracks in monetized videos, ads or client work, check that your plan includes the commercial license, since the entry Creator tier does not, and keep a record of which plan you were on when each track was made.

name: NVIDIA Earth-2
tagline: Open family of AI models and tools for weather forecasting and climate simulation
description: NVIDIA Earth-2 is a platform of open weather and climate AI models, libraries and frameworks covering data assimilation, nowcasting, downscaling and 15-day global forecasts.
longDescription: NVIDIA Earth-2 is a collection of open models, libraries and frameworks for building AI-based weather and climate forecasting systems. The model family spans the full pipeline: global data assimilation to generate initial atmospheric conditions, medium-range forecasts for dozens of weather variables up to 15 days ahead, generative nowcasting of storms in the zero to six hour window, and CorrDiff for high-resolution downscaling, alongside FourCastNet 3. Developers use the Earth2Studio toolkit, published on GitHub, and model weights on Hugging Face to run, fine-tune and deploy forecasts on their own GPU infrastructure. It targets researchers, weather agencies, startups and industries such as energy and finance.
features: Medium-range global forecasts up to 15 days
cons: Requires GPU hardware and technical expertise
Not a ready-made consumer weather app
moreContext:
Weather and climate forecasting has traditionally depended on expensive physics simulations run on supercomputers. NVIDIA Earth-2 offers an alternative path with an open, end-to-end set of AI models, so organizations can build their own forecasting systems instead of relying solely on outside providers. NVIDIA says its models compare well with other leading open weather models on key benchmarks.

- Generates initial atmospheric conditions in seconds on GPUs through global data assimilation
- Forecasts dozens of weather variables up to 15 days ahead with the medium-range model
- Predicts hazardous weather in the zero to six hour window using generative nowcasting
- Downscales coarse data to high resolution with CorrDiff for local detail
- Ships open weights on Hugging Face and the Earth2Studio toolkit on GitHub

NVIDIA Earth-2 is best for meteorologists, climate researchers, national weather services and companies in energy, insurance or agriculture with in-house data science teams. A practical tip: start with Earth2Studio's example workflows on a single GPU to reproduce a known forecast before fine-tuning any model on your own regional data.

name: PDF Guru AI PDF Summarizer
tagline: Summarize long PDFs with AI, then chat with the document for details
description: PDF Guru's AI PDF Summarizer reads an uploaded PDF, produces a concise summary of the whole file, and opens a chat for translating, simplifying or extracting key points.
longDescription: The AI PDF Summarizer is part of PDF Guru, an online PDF suite that also covers editing, signing, converting and form filling. You upload a PDF of up to 100 MB, and the AI reads the full document and returns a summary regardless of length. A chat panel then lets you ask follow-up questions, translate passages, simplify technical sections, rephrase content or pull out key points. It is useful for students, researchers and professionals who need the gist of reports, papers or contracts quickly. Your first summary and a few chat questions are free, and continued use requires a PDF Guru subscription, which also includes the rest of the suite.
pros: Part of a full PDF editing suite
cons: Free use is limited to one summary
Subscription required for ongoing access
moreContext:
This summarizer is handy because it lives inside a broader PDF toolkit. After getting the summary, you can stay in the same place to edit, convert or sign the document, which saves moving files between several services when you are working through a stack of paperwork. The chat that follows each summary also makes it easy to check a specific clause or figure without rereading the whole file.

- Summarizes an entire PDF in one pass, even for long documents
- Opens a chat for follow-up questions about the file's contents
- Translates, simplifies or rephrases selected passages on request
- Accepts uploads up to 100 MB through a simple drag-and-drop page
- Sits alongside PDF Guru's editing, conversion, signing and form tools

The AI PDF Summarizer is best for students reviewing readings, analysts skimming reports and professionals who need a quick overview of contracts or manuals. A practical tip: use the free summary on your most demanding document first to judge quality, and read the subscription terms carefully before upgrading, including how renewals and cancellations work, so the cost matches how often you will actually use it.

name: MiniMax Agent
tagline: Desktop AI agent from MiniMax for coding, research and recurring work tasks
description: MiniMax Agent is a general-purpose AI agent from MiniMax that works on local projects, runs multi-step tasks, schedules recurring jobs and can be checked remotely.
longDescription: MiniMax Agent is the agent product from Chinese AI lab MiniMax, now presented on its site as MiniMax Code. It ships as a desktop app that can attach to a local project folder, read files, run commands, review diffs and debug pages in a built-in browser. A Coding mode covers software work while a Work mode handles research and documents. Larger jobs can be split across an Agent Team, and recurring tasks can be scheduled while the app is open. Users can approve permission requests remotely, add plugins, memory and Computer Use, and generate video with MiniMax's H3 Max model. It runs on MiniMax models or a custom provider.
features: Local project access with terminal and diffs
Agent Team for splitting large tasks
pros: Handles both code and research work
Remote approvals keep long tasks moving
Can use MiniMax models or your own provider
cons: Current plan prices are hard to find on the site
Scheduled tasks need the desktop app open
moreContext:
MiniMax built this agent to take on long, multi-step jobs instead of single chat replies, and the desktop version leans into that by working directly inside your own project folders. What stands out is how much of the loop it covers: reading code, running commands, checking results in a built-in browser and then reporting back while you approve the risky steps.

- Attaches to a local project so it can read files, run terminal commands and inspect changes
- Separate Coding and Work modes, so the same app handles development as well as research and documents
- Agent Team breaks a large request into parts that run side by side
- Remote Control and messaging integrations let you approve permissions away from your desk
- Can run on MiniMax models, a MiniMax API key or a custom model provider

It is a strong fit for developers and technical operators who want an agent that can both write code and produce research or documents without switching tools. A practical tip: start with a small, well-scoped task in a copy of your project, review the permission prompts it raises, and only then hand it longer scheduled jobs.

name: FromImage AI
tagline: Upload a photo, describe the change, and get a restyled or edited version
description: FromImage AI is a browser-based image-to-image editor that turns an uploaded photo into a new version based on a text prompt, from anime styles to product shots and headshots.
longDescription: FromImage AI is a web tool for transforming existing photos with text instructions. You upload a JPG, PNG or WebP file up to 10 MB, add up to three reference images, and describe the result you want, such as a watercolor look, a new background, a professional headshot or warmer lighting. Preset prompts give a starting point and can be edited. Standard generations are quick and cost one credit, while Pro mode costs three credits and outputs 2K images that stay closer to the original likeness. Any result can be used as the next reference, which makes step-by-step edits possible. Downloads carry no watermark.
features: Up to three reference images per result
pros: One free Standard image per day without sign-up
cons: Pro images use three times the credits
Weekly bonus credits expire at week end
moreContext:
Most image generators start from a blank prompt, but FromImage AI starts from a photo you already have. That makes it handy when you like a picture but want a different style, a cleaner background or a more polished look without learning a full editing suite.

- Accepts JPG, PNG and WebP uploads up to 10 MB with up to three reference images
- Two quality levels, with Pro mode producing 2K output that holds likeness more closely
- Preset prompts for common looks such as anime, watercolor and product photos, all editable
- Results can feed back in as the next reference for gradual, controlled edits
- Downloads come without a watermark, and there are related free tools for coloring pages and hairstyle changes

It suits casual creators, small sellers and anyone who wants quick restyles of existing photos. A useful tip: test an idea in Standard mode first, since it costs a third of the credits, and switch to Pro only for the final version you plan to keep or share.

name: MAI-Transcribe-2
tagline: Microsoft AI's speech-to-text model for fast transcription in 60 languages
description: MAI-Transcribe-2 is Microsoft AI's second-generation speech recognition model, offered through Azure Speech and Microsoft Foundry with diarization, timestamps and keyword biasing.
longDescription: MAI-Transcribe-2 is a speech-to-text model built in-house by Microsoft AI and released in September 2026. It transcribes audio in 60 languages, detects languages automatically in mixed recordings, labels speakers and adds word-level timestamps. Keyword biasing helps with industry terms and proper names, and output can be verbatim or cleaned of filler words for captions and notes. Developers reach it through the Fast Transcription API in Azure Speech by selecting the model, with files under 300 MB in WAV, MP3 or FLAC. It requires an Azure subscription and a Microsoft Foundry Speech resource, and it is currently a public preview.
features: Keyword biasing for names and jargon
pros: Clean mode suits captions and notes
cons: Public preview without an SLA
Needs an Azure subscription and setup
moreContext:
Microsoft has been building its own family of MAI models, and MAI-Transcribe-2 is its second-generation answer for turning recorded speech into text. Its appeal is breadth: one model covers 60 languages, copes with recordings that switch between languages, and returns speaker labels and timestamps that developers would otherwise have to add separately.

- Automatic language detection, including for mixed-language audio
- Speaker diarization and word-level timestamps built into the output
- Keyword biasing to improve accuracy on product names, people and technical terms
- A clean output style that strips disfluencies for readable captions and transcripts
- Available inside existing Azure Speech workflows through the Fast Transcription API

Microsoft says the model is much faster than several rival transcription models in its own testing, so it is worth benchmarking on your own audio. It is best for developers and teams already on Azure who need multilingual transcription at scale. Since it is still a public preview, keep a fallback model configured for production workloads until it reaches general availability, and use keyword biasing for any names your audio mentions often.

name: SafetyStack
tagline: AI-personalized RAMS and health and safety documents for UK trades
description: SafetyStack helps UK contractors produce risk assessments, method statements and other health and safety paperwork from templates that AI tailors to the specific site.
longDescription: SafetyStack is a UK health and safety documentation service aimed at trades and contractors. Its core output is RAMS, the risk assessment and method statement packs many clients ask for before work starts, alongside COSHH assessments, fire risk assessments and site inductions. Users pick from more than 205 templates across 11 categories, enter their site details, and an AI assistant suggests site-specific risks and draft controls grounded in UK regulations. Finished documents download as PDFs. Signed-in users can store named jobs, duplicate them and keep issued revisions. The site also offers free toolbox talks, calculators and permit builders, and it stresses that a competent person must review every document.
pros: Free to start with no card or sign-up
Saves time on repeat job paperwork
cons: Focused on the UK only
Documents still need review by a competent person
moreContext:
Paperwork is one of the least loved parts of trade work, and SafetyStack targets it head on by pairing a large template library with an AI helper that adapts each document to the job in front of you. The emphasis on UK regulations and the honest reminder that a competent person must sign off make it feel practical rather than flashy.

- More than 205 templates across 11 categories, from RAMS to COSHH and fire risk assessments
- An AI safety assistant that proposes site-specific hazards and draft controls
- A My RAMS area for named jobs, duplication and kept revisions
- Free extras such as toolbox talks, inductions, calculators and permit-to-work builders
- A sample finished PDF so you can see the output before starting

It is best for sole traders and small UK contractors who produce RAMS often and want a faster starting point. Paid company workspaces are only proposed for now, so the current tools are free. A good habit is to save each completed job in My RAMS, then duplicate it for similar sites and adjust only what has changed.

name: Anomaly AI
tagline: AI data analyst that builds dashboards and reports from large business datasets
description: Anomaly AI connects to spreadsheets, ad platforms and databases, cleans the data and produces dashboards and reports with calculations you can check.
longDescription: Anomaly AI is an AI data analyst designed for large spreadsheets and business datasets. It connects to Excel and CSV files, Google Sheets, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, MySQL, BigQuery and Snowflake. Once data is in, it cleans it, applies calculations and metric definitions, and builds interactive dashboards, Excel outputs and reports that can be refreshed or emailed on a schedule. Its main promise is analysis you can verify, with visible calculations rather than opaque answers. Teams can collaborate in shared workspaces. A free plan includes 50 monthly credits, and paid plans add more credits, with discounts for students and nonprofits.
features: Connectors for sheets, ads and databases
pros: Calculations are shown so results can be checked
Free plan needs no credit card
Half price for students and nonprofits
cons: Credit limits on the free plan are tight
SOC 2 is still in progress
moreContext:
A lot of AI analysis tools give quick answers that are hard to trust, and Anomaly AI tries to fix that by making its calculations visible. It is built for the messy, oversized spreadsheets and ad exports that slow down marketing and operations teams, and it turns them into dashboards and reports you can refresh.

- Connects to Excel, CSV, Google Sheets, GA4, major ad platforms, MySQL, BigQuery and Snowflake
- Cleans data and applies metric definitions before analysis
- Produces interactive dashboards, Excel builds and refreshable reports
- Scheduled email reports keep stakeholders updated without manual exports
- The company lists UK GDPR compliance and ICO registration, with SOC 2 in progress

It is a good match for marketers, analysts and small business teams who live in spreadsheets and ad dashboards but lack a dedicated data team. The free plan covers roughly 25 charts a month by the company's own estimate, enough to test it on a real dataset. Start with one well-defined question, such as weekly ad spend by channel, and check the shown calculations before sharing the dashboard.

name: Seylo
tagline: Project workspace that keeps your AI work organized and readable by Claude and ChatGPT
description: Seylo collects a project's scripts, prompts, images, files and decisions in one place and lets connected AI tools read and save work there over MCP.
longDescription: Seylo is a project workspace for people who create a lot of work with AI. Instead of leaving good scripts, prompts and images buried in chat history, you save them into a project as typed assets. Seylo records how items relate, such as which script led to which prompt and image, and shows the same project as a document list, gallery, status board or lineage map. Edits keep a version history, files can be attached and search runs across projects. It works on the web, iPhone and as a Chrome extension. On Pro, tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex can read projects and write output back over MCP.
features: Four project views including a lineage map
MCP connection for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
pros: Generous free plan for small projects
Clear record of how work evolved
cons: AI tool connections require Pro
Early-stage product built by one person
moreContext:
Seylo grew out of a simple frustration: the best things you make with AI tend to vanish into old conversations. Its answer is a workspace that stores that output as real project assets and remembers how each piece led to the next, which is a thoughtful touch for anyone iterating on scripts, prompts and visuals.

- Saves scripts, prompts, images and decisions as typed assets inside projects
- Tracks lineage, so you can see which prompt produced which visual
- Four views of the same project, including a status board and a lineage map
- Version history means edits never overwrite earlier work for good
- On Pro, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex can read projects and save results back over MCP

The founder is open on the site that Seylo is early and built by one person, and that features marked Soon do not exist yet, which is refreshing. It is best for solo creators and small teams producing content with several AI tools. Start on the free plan with one active project, and upgrade only when you want your AI assistant to read and write there directly.

name: UseResume
tagline: AI resume and cover letter builder with ATS checks and job-matched tailoring
description: UseResume builds ATS-friendly resumes and cover letters with an AI assistant inside the editor, and tailors documents to a pasted job description.
longDescription: UseResume is an online resume builder for job seekers. You can import an existing resume, which it parses automatically, or start from scratch in a drag-and-drop editor with ATS-oriented templates. An AI assistant sits inside the editor to add sections, write summaries, suggest keyword-rich bullet points and tighten wording. Pasting a job description produces a tailored resume and matching cover letter, and the company says each document goes through more than 30 quality checks before download. The product also includes an AI content detector, job application help and APIs for resume generation and parsing. It offers a free start, a monthly plan and a one-time lifetime option.
features: AI assistant inside the resume editor
Tailoring from a pasted job description
pros: Free to start without a card
cons: Lifetime plan caps AI credits at 100
Most AI features sit behind paid plans
moreContext:
Rather than offering AI as a separate chat box, UseResume places the assistant directly inside the document editor, so rewriting a bullet or adding a section happens where you are already working. The job-matching flow is the highlight: paste a posting and you get a resume and cover letter shaped around it.

- Imports an existing resume and fills the editor automatically
- AI suggestions for summaries, bullet points and ATS-friendly wording
- Job description tailoring that produces a resume and cover letter together
- More than 30 automated quality checks on each document, according to the company
- Developer APIs for resume generation, parsing and cover letters

The company says around 49,000 job seekers have used it. It is a sensible pick for active job seekers sending many applications who want each one tailored without rewriting from scratch. A practical tip: keep one master resume, then create a separate version for each job description so you can compare what changed and reuse the strongest bullets later. Run the built-in checks before every download.

name: Video to Text
tagline: Transcribe uploaded videos or social links into timestamped text in 99 languages
description: Video to Text converts uploaded video and audio files, or public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X links, into transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps.
longDescription: Video to Text is a web transcription tool at video2text.net. You upload a video or audio file, or paste a public link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or X, choose a language or leave it on auto detect, and the AI returns a transcript. It supports 99 languages, handles recordings that mix languages, identifies different speakers and adds timestamps. Common formats such as MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, MP3, WAV and FLAC are accepted. Transcripts export as TXT, SRT, VTT or CSV, which covers subtitles, notes and spreadsheets. New users get 30 free credits to test the full workflow before paying.
features: File upload or social media link input
TXT, SRT, VTT and CSV export
pros: Works directly from social video links
Free credits to try before buying
cons: Paid pricing is not clearly published
Small independent developer behind it
moreContext:
Video to Text keeps transcription simple: drop in a file or paste a link and get back a transcript you can actually use. The ability to pull directly from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X saves a download step for anyone working with social content.

- Accepts uploads in common video and audio formats, plus public social media links
- Supports 99 languages with automatic language detection and mixed-language handling
- Speaker diarization shows who said what in interviews and meetings
- Timestamped output speeds up subtitle creation and editing
- Exports to TXT, SRT, VTT and CSV for different workflows

It is a good fit for creators, students, podcasters and researchers who need quick transcripts or subtitle files without setting up a larger platform or installing software. The interface is also translated into more than a dozen languages. Use the 30 starter credits on a short, representative clip first, check the speaker labels, timestamps and accuracy on names, and then decide whether to buy more credits for longer recordings or regular use.

name: Ptero
tagline: Free, nonprofit AI chat with multiple models and local-first chat storage
description: Ptero is a free, nonprofit chat platform that lets you talk to several AI models without signing up, keeping regular conversations in your own browser.
longDescription: Ptero is a web chat platform that gives free access to multiple third-party AI models. It describes itself as nonprofit and states in its terms that it will not introduce paid plans or paywalls. You can start as a guest by picking a display name, or sign in for an account. Regular conversations are stored locally in your browser rather than on Ptero's servers, so clearing browser data removes them. Cloud storage is used only for projects and their custom files. The interface is available in about 20 languages, and the team shares news and gathers feedback through a Discord community. A developer section is also offered.
features: Access to several AI models in one chat
Projects with custom files in the cloud
pros: Free with a stated no-paywall policy
cons: Available models can change without notice
Clearing browser data deletes chat history
moreContext:
Ptero takes an unusual and welcome stance for an AI chat service: it says it is nonprofit and promises in its terms that it will always stay free, with no premium tiers. Pair that with local-first storage of your conversations and it becomes an appealing option for people who want to try different models without handing over an account or chat history.

- Several AI models available from one chat interface
- Guest access with just a display name, no sign-up required
- Regular chats are kept in your browser, not on Ptero's servers
- Projects with custom files for longer-running work, stored in the cloud
- Interface translations in about 20 languages and an active Discord for updates

It is best for students, hobbyists and curious users who want free access to multiple models, like comparing answers, and value privacy. Because chat history lives in your browser, export or copy anything important before clearing site data or switching devices, and use projects for material you need to keep across sessions.

name: AnyAIZero
tagline: AI text detector and humanizer with multi-dimension pattern reports
description: AnyAIZero combines an AI writing detector with a humanizer that rewrites machine-sounding text, plus free tools for grammar, summaries and paraphrasing.
longDescription: AnyAIZero is a web tool for checking and rewriting AI-generated text. Its detector, powered by what it calls DeepSense, runs more than 20 checks on sentence rhythm, vocabulary, transitions and structure, then shows which signals flagged AI patterns rather than giving a bare score. The humanizer rewrites text in modes such as Natural, Academic, Formal, Concise, Expand and Shorten, with 3,000 free words per day. Extra free tools cover grammar checking, summarizing, paraphrasing, translation and email help. The company says text is processed in real time and not stored. Paid plans add API access for detection inside learning platforms or publishing tools.
pros: Unlimited free detection on the web
Reports explain why text was flagged
Says it does not store submitted text
cons: Detector results are estimates, not proof
Humanizer capped at 3,000 free words daily
moreContext:
AnyAIZero puts detection and rewriting side by side, so you can check a draft, see exactly which patterns look machine-made, and revise it in the same place. The transparent reports are the strongest part, since they point to specific signals like uniform sentence length or stock transitions instead of a single opaque percentage.

- DeepSense analysis runs more than 20 independent checks on each text
- Sentence-level highlights show where AI patterns appear
- A humanizer with modes for academic, formal, informal, concise and expanded writing
- Free side tools for grammar, summaries, paraphrasing, translation and emails
- An API with per-word billing for schools, publishers and app builders

It works well for writers and editors who want to understand why a draft reads as AI-written and fix the tone. Treat any detector score as a signal rather than a verdict, and follow your school or employer rules on AI use. A good tip is to read the dimension report first and edit the flagged sentences yourself before reaching for the humanizer.

name: myNeutron
tagline: Personal AI knowledge base that carries your saved context into any chatbot
description: myNeutron saves pages, files, notes and AI chats as searchable Seeds and lets you feed that context into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini with one click.
longDescription: myNeutron is a personal AI knowledge base from Vanar, delivered as a web app and a Chrome extension that works in Chromium browsers. You capture webpages, PDFs, notes, files and useful AI conversations, and each item becomes a Seed. Seeds are organized automatically into Bundles that you can search by meaning or query with a built-in assistant. When you move to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, you can insert the relevant context instead of explaining a project again. Storage options include the cloud and, optionally, Vanar's blockchain. A free plan includes 50 monthly credits, and paid tiers raise limits, with payment by card or the VANRY token.
features: One-click capture of pages, files and chats
Context insertion for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini
pros: Free plan to try core features
cons: Credit system and crypto options add complexity
Still labeled beta
moreContext:
Switching between chatbots usually means repeating the same background every time, and myNeutron aims to end that by keeping a portable memory you control. Its Seeds and Bundles turn scattered pages, files and past AI chats into context you can search and reuse wherever you work.

- Captures webpages, PDFs, notes, files and AI conversations from a browser extension
- Organizes saved items into Bundles automatically
- Semantic search and an assistant that answers questions from your own saved material
- Inserts relevant context into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini without copying and pasting
- Isolated personal storage with OAuth sign-in, according to the company

It is well suited to researchers, consultants and heavy AI users who juggle several assistants on long projects. Note that the product is tied to Vanar's blockchain, with optional on-chain storage and token payments, which some users may prefer to skip. Start on the free plan, save Seeds for a single project, and see whether the context insertion saves you real time in your daily chats before upgrading.

name: WolframAlpha
tagline: Computational knowledge engine for math, science, data and step-by-step answers
description: WolframAlpha computes answers to questions in math, science, finance, nutrition and more from curated data and algorithms, with step-by-step solutions on Pro.
longDescription: WolframAlpha is a computational knowledge engine from Wolfram Research, the company behind Mathematica. Instead of returning web links, it interprets a typed question and computes an answer from curated data and the Wolfram Language. It covers algebra, calculus, statistics, physics, chemistry, units, finance, nutrition, geography and many other topics. Free use is available on the web and with a basic account. Pro plans add step-by-step solutions, practice problems with hints, guided calculators, longer computation time, file uploads and photo input in the mobile apps. Wolfram also offers APIs and LLM solutions so developers and AI systems can call its computations.
features: Guided calculators for finance and nutrition
cons: Step-by-step solutions need Pro
Phrasing can matter for complex queries
moreContext:
WolframAlpha has been answering questions by computation since 2009, long before chatbots became common, and that heritage is exactly why it stays useful. Rather than predicting text, it runs real calculations on curated data, which makes it a dependable companion for math, science and quantitative questions.

- Interprets plain-language questions and returns computed results with graphs and tables
- Covers math, physics, chemistry, statistics, units, finance, nutrition and geography
- Pro step-by-step solutions and practice problems with hints for learners
- Guided calculators for personal and professional tasks
- APIs and LLM solutions let developers and AI tools tap the same engine

It is a great fit for students, teachers, engineers, analysts and anyone who needs a trustworthy number rather than a plausible one. It also pairs well with chatbots: let a chatbot explain the concept, then verify the actual figures here. A helpful tip: when a query returns the wrong interpretation, check the "Assuming" notes near the top of the results and switch the interpretation instead of rewording the whole question.

name: Story Illustrator
tagline: iPhone app that writes short stories and illustrates them with AI images
description: Story Illustrator is an iOS app from Make My Comics that generates illustrated stories, with control over style, theme and image count, plus PDF export and audio playback.
longDescription: Story Illustrator is an iPhone app from Make My Comics for creating picture stories with AI. You choose a theme, an art style and how many images you want, and the app generates a story with matching illustrations. Speech bubbles can be added for a comic feel, and any illustration can be edited or regenerated if it does not fit. Finished stories download as PDFs for sharing or printing, and a later update added audio so you can listen to the stories you create. The app is free to download with in-app purchases, and its website lets visitors explore stories created with it.
features: Choice of style, theme and image count
pros: Simple way to make illustrated stories
Regenerate images that miss the mark
PDF export for printing or sharing
cons: Only available on iOS
Paid in-app pricing not listed on the website
moreContext:
Story Illustrator turns a simple idea into a short picture story on your phone, handling both the text and the artwork. That makes it an easy entry point for families, teachers and hobbyists who want illustrated tales without drawing skills or a design app.

- Generates a story together with a set of matching AI illustrations
- Lets you pick the art style, theme and number of images
- Speech bubbles give stories a comic book look
- Individual illustrations can be modified or recreated
- Exports stories as PDFs and can read them aloud with audio playback

It is a nice fit for parents making bedtime stories, teachers creating quick classroom reading material, and kids exploring creative writing with an adult nearby. The PDF export also makes it easy to print a finished story as a small keepsake booklet. A practical tip: keep the theme and style consistent within one story and regenerate only the images that drift, which helps the characters look more alike from page to page.

name: MomentRescue
tagline: Fix closed eyes in photos using a reference shot of the same person
description: MomentRescue repairs blinks in group shots and portraits by editing only the eye area, using an optional reference photo, and also removes shadows, people and glare.
longDescription: MomentRescue is a photo repair tool focused on rescuing shots that are almost perfect. Its main feature opens closed eyes: you upload a photo, tap the person who blinked, and optionally add another photo of that person with their eyes open so the AI can match their real eye shape and color. Only the eye area is edited and the original stays untouched. Other tools remove shadows, remove a person from a photo, reduce glasses glare and upscale images. It runs in the browser with Google sign-in, uses one-time credit packs instead of subscriptions, and keeps a 30-day photo history.
features: Open closed eyes with a reference photo
Edits limited to the selected eye area
pros: Reference photo keeps eyes looking like the person
No subscription and credits never expire
cons: One credit per person fixed adds up for groups
Still in beta with variable results
moreContext:
Everyone has a group photo ruined by one blink, and MomentRescue is built specifically for that moment. Its smartest idea is the optional reference photo: instead of inventing eyes, the AI looks at a real picture of the same person, which helps the fix look like them rather than a stranger.

- Opens closed eyes one person at a time, editing only the eye area
- Optional reference photo guides eye shape, color and expression
- Extra tools for removing shadows, removing people and reducing glasses glare
- An image upscaler with a free daily Standard 2x option and High Fidelity modes
- Pay-as-you-go credit packs that never expire, with a 30-day photo history

It is ideal for anyone with a cherished family, wedding, graduation or event photo that needs a small, careful fix. New accounts get one free credit to try it. For the best result, pick a reference photo with similar lighting, age and head angle, then zoom in on the eyelids and gaze before downloading the new PNG.

name: doloc
tagline: Translation API that updates localization files straight from your scripts or CI
description: doloc translates app localization files such as JSON, XLIFF, ARB and Android XML through a single API call, returning updated target files while keeping existing translations intact.
longDescription: doloc is a localization automation service for software teams that keep translation files in their own repository. Developers send a source file and the current target file to the doloc API with curl, a GitHub Action or an IntelliJ plugin, and get back the target file with missing strings filled in. Existing translations, placeholders and file structure are preserved, and prior translations are used as context to keep terminology consistent. Supported formats include JSON, XLIFF 1.2 and 2.0, ARB, Android XML and Properties, with guides for Angular, React Intl, Flutter and Android. Pricing counts unique source texts only, with unlimited requests and target languages.
features: Translation API callable from curl or CI
Supports JSON, XLIFF, ARB, Android XML and Properties
pros: No separate translation platform to manage
Pricing based on unique source texts, not languages
Free tier with 200 source texts per month
cons: No reviewer workflow or translator collaboration tools
Limited set of supported file formats
moreContext:
What we like most about doloc is how little it asks of a development team. Instead of moving strings into a separate localization platform, it treats the repository as the source of truth and fits into the build or release step you already run. A single request sends the source and target files, and the updated target file comes straight back, ready to commit.

- Keeps existing translations, placeholders and file layout untouched while filling only what is missing
- Uses earlier translations as context, which helps product terminology stay consistent from release to release
- Works with common formats such as JSON, XLIFF, ARB, Android XML and Properties
- Ships with integration guides for Angular, React Intl, Flutter, Android, GitHub Actions and JetBrains IDEs
- Bills by unique source texts, so adding another target language does not raise your plan tier

doloc is best for small and mid-sized software teams where developers own the localization files and want routine UI copy translated automatically. The team is open that it is not built for translator assignments or approval workflows, so larger localization programs may still want a full platform. A practical tip: run doloc as a CI step on your main branch so new strings arrive translated in the same pull request, then spot check a few key screens with a native speaker before each release.

name: Revelia
tagline: AI face reading, palm reading, astrology and numerology in one self-discovery app
description: Revelia uses AI to generate face and palm readings from photos, alongside birth charts, numerology, compatibility reports and an AI astrologer you can ask questions, all framed as entertainment.
longDescription: Revelia is a mobile app for self-reflection that combines face reading, palm reading, astrology, numerology and compatibility analysis. Users take a selfie and a photo of their palm, and the app's AI produces a personalized reading of personality traits, life path themes and relationship insights. It also builds a birth chart with daily, weekly and monthly forecasts, decodes life path and destiny numbers, and offers an AI astrologer chat that answers questions based on the user's chart. A free plan covers basic readings, while paid tiers add full readings and more questions. The company presents all readings as entertainment, not professional advice. It is available on Android now, with iPhone listed as coming soon.
features: Face and palm readings from photos
Birth chart with daily and weekly forecasts
AI astrologer chat based on your chart
Compatibility reports for couples and friends
pros: Many reading types in a single app
cons: iPhone version not yet available
Readings are for fun, not grounded in science
moreContext:
Revelia brings a lot of familiar self-discovery traditions together under one roof, which is its main appeal. Rather than juggling a horoscope app, a numerology site and a palm reading quiz, users get face, palm, birth chart and numerology readings in one place, plus a chat where they can ask follow-up questions about their own chart.

- Generates face and palm readings from a selfie and a palm photo taken on your phone
- Builds a full birth chart with Sun, Moon and Rising placements and recurring forecasts
- Offers an AI astrologer chat that answers personal questions from your chart details
- Includes compatibility readings for partners, friends, family and business relationships
- Lets users delete their photos and account, with the company stating photos are not sold

Revelia suits people who enjoy astrology and palmistry as a reflective or social pastime, such as couples who like comparing readings as a conversation starter. The company itself describes the readings as entertainment and self-reflection, so it is best treated that way rather than as guidance for health, money or legal choices. A practical tip: try the free birth chart on the website first to see whether the style of the readings appeals to you before moving to a paid tier, and use good lighting for the palm photo so the lines are clearly visible.

name: ReelDance
tagline: Online studio for AI image and video generation across many popular models
description: ReelDance is a browser-based studio for generating AI images and videos from text prompts or reference images, giving access to several third-party models under one credit balance.
longDescription: ReelDance is a web workspace for creating AI images and short videos. Users choose a model, write a prompt or upload a reference image, set the aspect ratio and other options, and generate. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video, and an image created in the studio can be used as the first frame of a video. The platform offers a range of third-party image and video models in one place, with formats suited to Reels, Shorts and YouTube. It targets creators, marketers, e-commerce sellers and designers. New accounts get a few free credits, and paid monthly plans provide a shared credit balance with watermark-free downloads.
features: Many image and video models in one workspace
Aspect ratios for Reels, Shorts and YouTube
pros: One credit balance covers images and video
cons: Only a few free credits on signup
Relies on third-party models it does not build
moreContext:
ReelDance is built around convenience: instead of signing up for separate image and video services, you get a single workspace and a single credit balance for several well-known generation models. That makes it straightforward to try the same prompt or reference image on different models and keep whichever result fits your project.

- Covers text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-to-video in one interface
- Lets you generate a still image first and then use it as the opening frame of a video
- Offers output formats sized for vertical social video and widescreen YouTube
- Shares one monthly credit pool across image and video generation
- Provides watermark-free downloads and commercial use on paid plans, subject to its terms

ReelDance is a good fit for social media creators, small marketing teams and online sellers who want quick product clips or short promotional videos without managing several subscriptions. Since it gives access to models built by other companies, results and costs depend on the model you pick. A practical tip: use the signup credits to test two or three models on the same reference image before choosing a plan, since some models handle faces or product details better than others, and check the credit cost of each model before running longer clips.

name: Vilix AI
tagline: Shared memory layer that carries context across Claude, Cursor, Codex and other AI tools
description: Vilix AI gives your AI assistants and agents one shared memory over MCP, so saved context, decisions and reusable skills follow you from one tool and session to the next.
longDescription: Vilix AI is a cross-tool memory service for people who work with several AI assistants. Users connect tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor and ChatGPT to a single Vilix account through MCP, and those tools can then save conversation exchanges and retrieve relevant context when needed, rather than loading an entire history into every prompt. It also supports Agent Skills, reusable step-by-step procedures that any connected tool can load, scoped globally or per project. Access uses OAuth or a personal API key, with per-user data isolation and full export or deletion. It is aimed at technical founders and automation operators, with a free plan and paid tiers for larger daily saving allowances.
features: Shared memory across connected AI tools
MCP connection for Claude, Cursor and Codex
Data export and full account deletion
pros: Free plan after a 7-day Pro trial
Open about data handling and deletion
cons: Requires MCP-capable clients
Free plan has a limited daily saving allowance
moreContext:
Anyone who switches between AI tools knows the cost of explaining the same project background again and again. Vilix AI tackles that directly by giving all of your connected assistants one shared memory store, so a decision made in a Claude session can be recalled later inside Cursor or Codex without pasting notes around.

- Connects supported AI clients to one account over MCP, with OAuth or a personal API key
- Retrieves only the context relevant to the current task instead of sending a full archive
- Stores reusable Agent Skills that any connected tool can load, globally or per project
- Keeps each user's data isolated and supports export and complete account deletion
- Maintains a public GitHub repository for its MCP connector
