Vilix AI is best for developers, technical founders and people running scheduled agents who rely on more than one assistant during the day. Its value grows with the number of tools you use, so a single-tool user may not need it. A practical tip: start the 7-day Pro trial by saving a short project brief, key architecture decisions and your coding conventions as memories, then check how well each connected tool recalls them before deciding which paid tier matches your daily volume.

name: Scanfile
tagline: AI file translator for PDFs, EPUB books, PowerPoint decks and subtitle files
description: Scanfile translates PDF, EPUB, PPT and PPTX, and SRT, VTT or ASS subtitle files with AI, detecting the format automatically and returning a translated file you can download.
longDescription: Scanfile is an online AI translation service built around whole files rather than pasted text. Users upload a document, and Scanfile identifies the format and sends it to the matching translator for PDFs, EPUB books, PowerPoint presentations or subtitles. After choosing source and target languages, users can review a free sample where available, see a credit estimate, and then download the result. Outputs include translated PDF pages, native EPUB files, editable PPTX decks, and translated or bilingual subtitle files with timestamps kept intact. Pricing uses one-time credit packs with no subscription, and credits do not expire. It suits students, researchers, publishers and video creators handling foreign-language files.
cons: No DOCX or XLSX support yet
Free allowance varies by file type
moreContext:
Scanfile focuses on a very practical problem: getting a translated file back in a format you can actually use. Instead of copying text into a translator and rebuilding the layout by hand, you upload the original and receive a translated PDF, EPUB, editable slide deck or subtitle file, depending on what you started with.

- Detects the file type on upload and opens the right translator without a second upload
- Delivers PowerPoint translations as editable PPTX files rather than flat images
- Keeps subtitle timestamps intact and can produce bilingual subtitle output
- Lets you translate selected PDF pages or ranges so you only spend credits on what you need
- Shows sample translations of real files so you can judge quality before uploading

Scanfile is well suited to students reading foreign-language papers, small publishers testing a translated book, and creators localizing video captions. The pay-as-you-go credit model works nicely for occasional use, since nothing renews monthly. A practical tip: download your results soon after translation, because files follow temporary access and expiry rules, and use the free sample on a few representative pages first to check how well terminology and formatting carry over for your document.

name: LumiYing
tagline: All-in-one AI video and image creation platform with a wide choice of models
description: LumiYing combines AI video and image generation and editing in one workspace, letting creators pick from several third-party models and guide results with image, video and audio references.
longDescription: LumiYing is a web platform for generating and editing AI videos and images. Users start from a text prompt, product shot, character image, video clip or audio reference, choose a model, and set options such as aspect ratio, resolution and duration. Video tools include text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video-to-video and clip extension, while image tools cover generation, prompt-based editing, relighting, virtual staging, ghost mannequin product shots and character sheets. The service also publishes tutorials and model comparisons. Pricing is based on one-time credit packs with no subscription, and credits do not expire, which suits creators and marketers with uneven workloads.
features: Text, image and reference to video
Image editing, relighting and virtual staging
Image, video and audio reference uploads
cons: No free plan listed
Depends on third-party models it does not build
moreContext:
LumiYing stands out for the breadth of its toolset. Alongside general video and image generation, it offers focused utilities such as ghost mannequin product photos, virtual staging, food photo editing and storyboard generation, which saves creators from hunting for separate single-purpose apps.

- Accepts image, video and audio references to guide characters, products, motion and sound
- Covers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video-to-video and clip extension
- Includes practical image tools for e-commerce, real estate and food photography
- Sells credit packs as one-time purchases with no subscription and no expiry
- Publishes a credit cost table and worked examples so you can estimate spending upfront

LumiYing is a good match for social media marketers, online store owners and independent creators who produce visuals in bursts rather than on a fixed monthly schedule. Because output quality depends on the underlying model you choose, it rewards a little experimentation. A practical tip: review the credit consumption table before starting, since video models cost far more per generation than image models, and draft your idea as a still image first so you only spend video credits once the composition looks right.

name: Upadz
tagline: AI ad generator that turns a product and ad inspiration into video and image ads
description: Upadz helps e-commerce brands research competitor ads, choose creative angles, and generate UGC-style video and static ads for Meta, TikTok and Google in one workflow.
longDescription: Upadz is an AI ad creation platform for e-commerce brands. It starts with ad discovery, letting users browse ads by industry, platform, format and country and save references. From a product URL and brand details, it generates customer insights, hooks, angles and concepts, then turns the chosen direction into static product creatives or UGC-style and product video ads. Users can edit, add voice and remix reference ads inside the tool, and create consistent AI influencer characters. A Media Buyer feature in beta connects launched creatives to performance tracking. A free plan includes a one-time credit allowance, and paid monthly plans add renewing credits.
features: Competitor ad discovery and saved references
UGC-style video and static ad creation
pros: Research and production in one workflow
Free first ad without a credit card
Built for Meta, TikTok and Google formats
cons: Paid plans were waitlist-only at last check
Free credits are a one-time allowance
moreContext:
Upadz tries to cover the whole creative loop for paid social, not just the generation step. It begins with studying the ads already running in your market, moves to picking an angle worth testing, and ends with a finished video or image ad, which keeps strategy and production connected rather than split across separate tools and freelancers.

- Lets you browse and save competitor ads filtered by industry, platform, format and country
- Generates customer insights, hooks and concepts from your product page and brand details
- Produces UGC-style videos, product videos and static creatives, with in-app editing and voice
- Offers AI influencers that keep the same face and look across multiple ads
- Includes a beta Media Buyer feature for launching ads and tracking creative performance

Upadz is best for direct-to-consumer and e-commerce brands that test new ad creatives every week and want more variations without a large production budget. A practical tip: use the free allowance to remix one proven competitor format for your own product, then compare two or three different hooks in a small test campaign before scaling. Keep in mind the company noted paid plans were opening soon at the time of review, so confirm availability on its pricing page.

name: Assistly
tagline: AI website chat assistant that answers visitors and captures leads around the clock
description: Assistly adds an AI chat assistant to your website and WhatsApp that learns from your own pages and files, answers visitor questions, and emails you new leads with their contact details.
longDescription: Assistly is an AI chat assistant for service businesses, SaaS companies and online stores. Owners enter their website address, and Assistly reads the most important pages each week along with uploaded files such as price lists, menus and FAQs. After pasting one line of code onto a site built with WordPress, Wix, Shopify, Webflow or similar, the assistant answers visitors in their language, says when it does not know, and collects names, phone numbers and emails. Leads land in a shared inbox with email alerts, and owners can take over any chat. A WhatsApp integration and in-chat booking are available, with a free plan and paid tiers with 30-day trials.
features: Learns from your website pages and files
Instant email alerts for new leads
pros: Free plan with 50 chats a month
One-line install on common site builders
Admits when it lacks an answer
cons: Free plan shows a Powered by Assistly badge
WhatsApp is a paid add-on on lower tiers
moreContext:
Assistly is designed for small business owners who want their website to answer questions and collect leads without a technical setup. You give it your web address, it reads your key pages, and after one line of code is added to your site it can respond to visitors at any hour and pass their contact details straight to your inbox.

- Rereads your website and uploaded documents weekly so answers stay current
- Saves a lead even when a visitor leaves only a phone number, and sends an email alert
- Lets you step in and reply as a person at any moment, with the AI stepping back
- Answers on WhatsApp through Meta's official connection, sharing the same knowledge as the site chat
- Works with WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, Webflow and GoDaddy sites

Assistly is a strong fit for local service businesses such as trades, clinics and agencies, as well as SaaS teams that get after-hours questions. A practical tip: upload your price list and a short FAQ in addition to your website, since those files tend to cover the exact questions visitors ask, then review the weekly summary of top questions to spot gaps in your site content.

name: KreadoAI
tagline: AI ad creative studio with talking avatars, video translation and image tools
description: KreadoAI creates video ads, avatar spokesperson videos, product images and ad copy from product inputs, with a large library of AI avatars, voice cloning and translation into many languages.
longDescription: KreadoAI is an AI content platform focused on ad creatives for e-commerce and app marketers. It turns product details into video ads, image ads and copy, and offers AI spokesperson videos with a library the company says includes over 1,000 avatars. Other tools cover text-to-video and image-to-video, PPT or PDF to avatar video, URL-to-video, batch TikTok videos, text-to-speech and instant voice cloning. Localization features translate videos and images, and image utilities include background removal, upscaling, inpainting and expansion. An AI Smart Canvas workspace and developer APIs are also available. A free plan includes a small K-coin allowance, with paid subscriptions for heavier use.
features: AI spokesperson and UGC avatar videos
pros: API and MCP access for developers
cons: Free plan limits video length and excludes commercial use
Paid prices not shown without signing in
moreContext:
KreadoAI packs a wide range of ad production tools into a single account, which is what makes it notable. Marketers can go from product details to a presenter-style video, translate it for another market, and resize the matching image ads for different platforms without switching services.

- Generates avatar spokesperson and UGC-style videos from scripts or product inputs
- Turns PPT or PDF files and product URLs into narrated videos
- Translates videos and images for international campaigns, with support the company says covers over 140 languages
- Provides text-to-speech and instant voice cloning for consistent narration
- Includes image utilities such as background removal, upscaling, inpainting and expansion

KreadoAI is best for e-commerce sellers, app marketers and agencies producing many short ad variations, especially for multiple regions. The free plan is useful for testing avatars and voices, but it excludes commercial use, so plan on a paid tier for campaigns. A practical tip: build one strong master video in your main language first, then use the translation tools to localize it, which is usually faster than scripting each market from scratch.

name: Dreamina
tagline: CapCut's AI creative platform for images, videos and talking avatars
description: Dreamina, from the CapCut team, generates AI images, videos and talking avatars from text or images, using models such as Seedream and Seedance alongside other leading options.
longDescription: Dreamina is an AI creative platform from CapCut for producing images, short videos and avatars. Image tools include text-to-image, restyling, remixing and art generation, with models such as Seedream and Nano Banana. Video tools cover text-to-video, image-to-video, sketch-to-video and reference-to-video, built on ByteDance's Seedance models plus options like Sora and Veo. Users can also create talking avatars from a photo or text and work in dedicated studios for marketing, cinematic and trend-based content. It targets social creators, marketers and storytellers making ads, product visuals and short dramas. Dreamina provides free daily credits, with paid memberships for more generations.
features: Text, image and sketch to video
pros: Direct access to Seedream and Seedance models
cons: Regular paid prices not clearly listed
Busy interface with many overlapping tools
moreContext:
Dreamina benefits from coming out of the CapCut team, which gives it close ties to ByteDance's own Seedream image models and Seedance video models. For creators already editing in CapCut, it offers a natural place to generate the raw images and clips before cutting them into a finished post.

- Provides first-party access to Seedream image models and Seedance video models
- Adds other well-known models, such as Nano Banana, Sora and Veo, for comparison
- Turns a portrait photo or text into a talking avatar for explainers and ads
- Includes sketch-to-video and reference-to-video for more control over motion
- Gives free daily credits so you can experiment before paying

Dreamina is best for social media creators, small brands and short-form storytellers who want image, video and avatar generation in one familiar ecosystem. Because offers and plan prices change often, check the pricing page for the current terms before subscribing. A practical tip: spend your daily free credits on still images to settle the look and composition first, then use your favorite image as the starting frame for image-to-video so each video generation is more likely to land on the first try.

name: AIPetGen
tagline: AI studio that turns photos of your pet into portraits, characters and short videos
description: AIPetGen generates new images and short animations of your dog, cat or other pet from a photo or description, keeping the animal recognizable while changing the style, scene or motion.
longDescription: AIPetGen is an AI image and video generator built specifically for pets. Users upload a clear photo of a dog, cat or other companion, or describe one in text, then choose a template or write a prompt to place the pet in a new setting, art style or costume. Templates range from royal and Renaissance portraits to watercolor, cartoon and anime looks. Output sizes go up to 4K, and an Animate mode creates short videos with support for extra reference images and audio clips. Signed-in users get one free 1K image each day, while higher resolutions and video use credits sold in one-time packs.
features: Pet photo to portrait or character
Style templates like royal and watercolor
pros: Focused on keeping the pet recognizable
cons: Video generation always uses credits
Results vary between attempts
moreContext:
AIPetGen does one thing and keeps it focused: making new pictures and clips of your own pet. Because the whole studio is built around a pet photo, the prompts, templates and guidance are all tuned to keeping your animal's face and markings recognizable while the scene, style or costume changes around it.

- Starts from your own photo, so results show your pet rather than a stock animal
- Offers ready-made ideas such as royal portraits, Victorian looks and military portraits
- Supports several aspect ratios and output sizes up to 4K for printing
- Creates short animations with optional reference images and audio clips
- Gives signed-in users one free 1K image per day, plus guest tries without an account

AIPetGen is a lovely option for pet owners looking for a fun profile picture, a personalized gift or a printable portrait. The low entry price on credit packs makes it easy to try without a subscription. A practical tip: upload a sharp photo where your pet's face fills much of the frame, and change only one detail per attempt, such as the background or the art style, so you can see what produces the best likeness.

name: Snap AI Studio
tagline: One credit plan for dozens of AI photo, video and audio models and tools
description: Snap AI Studio gives access to many image, video and audio models from providers like Google, OpenAI, ByteDance and Black Forest Labs under a single credit pool, with prices shown before you generate.
longDescription: Snap AI Studio is a multi-model creative platform that puts image, video and audio generation behind one subscription. The company says it offers 41 models and 85 tools and effects, including AI photoshoots, headshots, logos, image-to-video, lip sync and text-to-speech. Image models span Nano Banana, GPT Image, FLUX.2, Seedream, Recraft and others, while video options include Veo, Seedance, Kling, Hailuo, Sora and Runway. Users type a prompt or add a selfie, pick a model, and see the credit cost before spending. New accounts receive 60 free credits, and monthly plans provide renewing credits with commercial use and no watermark.
features: Image, video and audio models in one plan
Credit cost shown before each generation
pros: Low entry price for broad model access
cons: Premium video models use credits quickly
Wide choice can be overwhelming for beginners
moreContext:
Snap AI Studio's main draw is price transparency across a very large model lineup. Every generation shows its credit cost upfront, which makes it easy to compare a fast, inexpensive model against a premium one before committing, and the same credit balance works whether you are making a photo, a video or a voiceover.

- Brings image models such as Nano Banana, GPT Image, FLUX.2, Seedream and Recraft into one interface
- Includes video models such as Veo, Seedance, Kling, Hailuo, Sora and Runway
- Adds audio tools for text-to-speech and lip sync alongside visual generation
- Offers ready-made tools for photoshoots, headshots, logos and real estate videos
- Refunds failed generations automatically and labels gallery examples with the model and credits used

Snap AI Studio is best for creators and small businesses who want to try many models without separate subscriptions. A practical tip: use the 60 free signup credits on lighter image models to learn how prompts behave, and check the per-second credit rate before generating video, since premium video models can use a monthly allowance far faster than images.

name: MushirAI
tagline: AI co-founder that validates business ideas and builds launch plans and files
description: MushirAI acts as an AI co-founder for early founders, checking idea viability, modeling unit economics, and producing market research, financial and brand deliverables as Word and Markdown files.
longDescription: MushirAI is an AI business advisor for first-time founders and small business builders. Users describe an idea in a sentence or two, in their own language, and receive an instant viability scorecard. A lead co-founder agent then asks questions, checks the numbers and guides the user through a 12-phase roadmap covering starting, building, selling and scaling. Along the way, the company says 25 specialist agents produce deliverables such as market sizing with sources, budgets, revenue projections, brand identity and launch plans, exported as .docx and .md files. Every figure is presented as an editable estimate. A free plan includes daily credit refreshes, with an affordable monthly paid tier.
pros: Works in the language you write in
cons: Estimates still need real-world checking
Free plan limited to one active venture
moreContext:
MushirAI takes a hands-on approach to early business planning. Rather than handing back a long essay, it walks a founder through concrete phases and produces working documents, such as a launch budget or a twelve month revenue projection, that can be downloaded, edited and shared.

- Starts with a quick viability check before you spend money on an idea
- Guides you through a 12-phase roadmap with specific next steps for each stage
- Produces market research with sources, unit economics, brand identity and launch files
- Shows every assumption behind its numbers so you can change prices, costs and margins
- Exports deliverables as Word and Markdown files for use outside the app

MushirAI is best for aspiring entrepreneurs, side project builders and small business owners who want structure and finished planning documents without hiring consultants. Its numbers are estimates, so treat them as a starting point to verify with local suppliers, competitors and customers. A practical tip: begin with the free viability report, then challenge the co-founder with your real budget and location early on, since the roadmap and financial models become more useful the more specific your inputs are.

name: Darwin
tagline: Self-improving AI website chat that answers buyers and books meetings
description: Darwin is an AI sales chat for websites that answers buying questions from your pages, qualifies visitors, books meetings or collects quote requests, and tests its own openings to improve results.
longDescription: Darwin is an AI website chat built for B2B and service businesses that want more booked meetings and qualified requests. It answers visitor questions using the company's own web pages, asks qualifying questions, and lets buyers book a meeting or submit a request without leaving the chat. Its standout feature is self-improvement: each page tests different opening messages and keeps the one that books more meetings, either automatically or with approval. Analytics show which pages and traffic sources lead to meetings. Darwin integrates with Google Calendar, Calendly, HubSpot, Salesforce, Webflow, WordPress and Slack, and offers an API and MCP server. Pricing is credit based per booked meeting or qualified request, with unlimited chats.
features: Answers from your own web pages
In-chat meeting booking and quote requests
Automatic A/B testing of chat openings
pros: Pay only for meetings or qualified requests
cons: Paid plans start at a high monthly price
Credit costs add up for high-volume sites
moreContext:
Darwin's most distinctive idea is a chat that experiments on itself. Each page tests competing opening messages, measures which one leads to more booked meetings, and keeps the winner, either automatically or after you approve it. That turns the greeting most teams set once and forget into something that keeps getting better over time.

- Answers buyer questions using content from your own website pages
- Qualifies visitors and books meetings or captures quote and callback requests inside the chat
- Holds back new openings that look likely to perform worse, so results do not slip
- Reports visits, conversations and meetings by page and traffic source
- Connects with Calendly, Google Calendar, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Slack and more, plus an API and MCP server

Darwin is best for B2B companies, agencies and service businesses whose website goal is a booked call or a qualified request rather than general support. Because you pay per meeting or qualified request while chats stay free, costs track outcomes. A practical tip: start on the free plan with your pricing page, where buying intent is highest, and let the opening experiments run long enough to gather meaningful data before rolling Darwin out across the rest of the site.

name: Wikis.ai
tagline: Ask several leading AI models at once and compare their answers side by side
description: A multi-model AI workspace that sends one question to models like GPT, Claude and Gemini, shows the answers next to each other, and adds deep research reports and an AI Wiki of guides.
longDescription: Wikis.ai is a chat and research workspace built around comparison. You type one prompt, pick the models you want, and see their replies in a side-by-side grid so you can spot where they agree and where they differ, then continue the conversation with the model you prefer. A deep research mode searches the web, gathers sources and produces a structured report you can inspect and export. The site also publishes an AI Wiki of explainer guides that you can turn into a follow-up chat. One credit balance covers research and chats, with a free monthly allowance and paid tiers for heavier use.
pros: One subscription covers many model families
Makes disagreement between models easy to see
cons: Credit usage varies by model and task
Unused monthly credits do not roll over
moreContext:
Most chat apps give you one model's opinion and leave you to wonder what another would have said. Wikis.ai is built for exactly that second question: it puts several models in the same view so their answers can be read together. That makes it a practical way to sanity check a claim, compare writing styles, or see which model handles a certain kind of task best.

- One prompt goes to the models you choose, and the replies sit in a stable grid for easy scanning.
- A deep research mode gathers web sources and turns them into a structured report with sources you can open.
- The catalog spans GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Qwen, Kimi and other model families inside one account.
- The AI Wiki offers explainer guides that you can continue as a chat with your own follow-up questions.
- A single credit balance covers both chats and research, and the free plan includes 200 monthly credits.

Wikis.ai suits curious users, researchers and teams who want a second and third opinion before trusting an AI answer, without paying for several separate subscriptions. A practical tip: use the agreement view as a starting signal, then open the sources or ask a pointed follow-up wherever the models disagree, since that is usually where the facts need checking.

name: Contriqo
tagline: AI contract risk review for construction and infrastructure teams
description: Contriqo by Perfomir reads construction contracts with AI to surface risky clauses, notice obligations, time bars and possible claim pathways, then tracks project events against those terms.
longDescription: Contriqo is a contract intelligence product from Perfomir, an Australian AI software company, aimed at construction and infrastructure teams handling high-value commercial contracts. You upload contract documents and the AI breaks them into clause-level findings covering obligations, notice requirements, risk areas and potential claim exposure, summarized in an executive dashboard with a risk score. As the project runs, teams can submit events and see how each one relates to the contract terms, which helps keep notice deadlines and entitlement pathways in view. A free demo previews one contract, while paid annual plans add full intelligence, unlimited event submissions and PDF exports.
features: Notice trigger and time bar tracking
Project event monitoring against contract terms
Risk score dashboard with PDF export
pros: Keeps notice obligations visible during a project
Free demo needs no credit card
cons: Plans are billed yearly in Australian dollars
Basic tier covers only one contract
moreContext:
Construction contracts tend to hide their sharpest edges in notice clauses and time bars, and missing one can cost a contractor an entitlement it would otherwise have. Contriqo is designed around that specific problem rather than general document chat, which gives it a clear purpose for commercial and project teams.

- It turns a static contract into clause summaries, obligations and risk classifications that are easier to scan than the original document.
- Notice triggers and time bars are pulled out so they stay in view while the project is underway.
- Teams can submit project events and see how each one maps to contract terms and possible claim pathways.
- An executive summary and risk score give managers a quick read before they dig into details.
- The free demo lets a team preview one contract before committing to a paid plan.

Contriqo is best for contractors, subcontractors and commercial managers in construction or infrastructure who manage a few high-value agreements and want earlier warning of exposure. Perfomir itself notes that the output should be reviewed with professional judgment and does not replace legal advice, so a sensible tip is to treat its findings as a checklist for your contract manager or lawyer rather than a final position.

name: Aidrobe
tagline: Discover clothes picked for you and try them on your own photo with AI
description: An iPhone and iPad app that suggests clothing based on your taste and country, lets you preview each piece on your own photo with AI virtual try-on, and sends you to the brand to buy.
longDescription: Aidrobe is a clothing discovery and virtual try-on app for iPhone and iPad. It shows curated collections filtered by your country, favorite brands and the kind of clothing you want, so you start from a short list instead of an endless feed. When a piece catches your eye, you create an AI preview of it on your own photo, and if you like the result you open the brand or retailer in your browser to check sizing, delivery and returns before buying. Aidrobe does not sell the clothes itself. Some catalog items are always free to try on, and optional plans or credits add more try-ons, billed through the App Store.
features: AI try-on using your own photo
Free items always available to try
Links straight to the brand for purchase
pros: Clear that brands handle the actual sale
cons: Only available on iPhone and iPad
Paid plan prices are shown only inside the app
moreContext:
Online clothes shopping usually means guessing how something will look based on a model who is not you. Aidrobe tries to close that gap by putting the garment on your own photo before you commit, while keeping the actual purchase with the brand. The result is a calmer, shortlist-driven way to browse.

- Virtual try-on creates a preview of a selected piece on a photo you provide.
- Collections are tuned to your country and preferences, so you mostly see items you can actually buy locally.
- Free catalog items are always available, and the app shows the cost of any paid try-on before you spend.
- Purchases happen on the brand or retailer site, where that seller sets the price, delivery and return terms.
- The site also offers free outfit tools and guides, such as a capsule wardrobe planner and a dress code decoder.

Aidrobe is best for iPhone users who like shopping online but want more confidence before ordering, especially for occasion outfits. A practical tip: use a well-lit, front-facing photo for your previews, and still check the brand's size chart, since a visual try-on shows style and color better than exact fit.

name: ChatbotsAI
tagline: No-code AI chatbots trained on your website and documents for support and sales
description: A no-code platform for building AI chat agents that learn from your site, files and Q&A pairs, then answer customers, capture leads and hand off to humans when needed.
longDescription: ChatbotsAI is a no-code builder for website chat agents that handle customer support, sales and knowledge questions. You train a bot by crawling your site, uploading documents, adding specific URLs, entering business details such as hours and policies, or writing custom Q&A pairs. The finished agent is added to any website with one line of code, with domain whitelisting to control where it appears. It can collect visitor names and emails, analyze images or videos that visitors upload, and pass conversations to optional human assistants. A built-in sales CRM, conversation analytics and a REST API round out the platform, with a free starting tier and paid plans.
features: Training from site crawls, files and Q&A
Lead capture with CSV or CRM sync
pros: Several ways to feed in business knowledge
Free tier with no credit card required
cons: Lead capture is limited to higher plans
Feature set may be more than a small site needs
moreContext:
Plenty of tools promise a chatbot trained on your content, but ChatbotsAI stands out for how many ways it lets you feed that knowledge in and how much sits around the bot once it is live. Beyond answering questions, it tries to cover the steps that follow a chat, such as capturing a lead or tracking a deal.

- Bots can learn from a website crawl, uploaded documents, specific URLs, structured business details and custom Q&A pairs.
- Deployment takes a single line of code, and domain whitelisting keeps the bot from appearing on sites you did not approve.
- Visitors can upload photos or videos, which the platform analyzes with a vision model to answer questions about them.
- A built-in CRM with a drag-and-drop pipeline, tasks and an activity timeline keeps sales follow-up in the same place.
- An optional human assistant service and custom bot APIs extend the bot when automation is not enough.

ChatbotsAI is best for small businesses and agencies that want a support or sales bot plus light CRM features without stitching several tools together. A practical tip: start by training on your FAQ and policy pages, review the conversation logs after a week, and add Q&A pairs for the questions the bot handled poorly.

name: PixMind
tagline: One workspace for AI images, videos, avatars and audio using dozens of models
description: An AI creation platform that bundles many image, video and audio models under one account, with workflow templates for product photos, ad videos and marketing visuals.
longDescription: PixMind is an AI content workspace that gives one account access to a large catalog of third-party image, video and audio models, including Seedance, Wan, MiniMax, GPT Image, Nano Banana and Midjourney. It is aimed at e-commerce sellers, marketers and content creators who need product photos, ad videos and social visuals. Beyond direct generation, a workflow library offers reusable templates, such as short product spotlight commercials or animated explainer ads, that you copy and customize node by node. There are also avatar, audio and video editing tools and an API platform. New users get welcome credits, and paid memberships add monthly credits, higher resolutions and a commercial license.
features: Access to 50+ image, video and audio models
Editable ad and product workflow templates
pros: Many popular models in one subscription
Free daily trials on some models
cons: Lowest advertised price is for annual billing
Free plan lacks a commercial license
moreContext:
Keeping up with every new image and video model usually means juggling several subscriptions. PixMind takes the aggregator route, putting a broad lineup of models behind one credit balance, and then adds marketing-focused templates so the models are easier to point at a real job.

- The model catalog spans image, video, audio and language models from several providers in one account.
- A workflow library offers ready-made templates for UGC ads, animated ads, connected TV spots and product imagery.
- Copied templates become private workflows, so you can change any node without affecting the original.
- Paid tiers raise image and video resolution to 4K, remove watermarks and include a commercial license.
- An API platform with its own plans lets developers call the same models from their own apps.

PixMind is best for small e-commerce brands and marketers who want to test many models and produce ad creative without hiring a studio. A practical tip: try a few models on the same prompt using the free welcome credits before choosing a plan, since costs and quality vary noticeably from one model to the next.

name: Deduped
tagline: Hot AI repos on GitHub turned into step-by-step use cases with ready prompts
description: A free site and weekly email that turns trending AI repositories into concrete use cases, each with setup steps and a prompt you can hand to a coding agent, plus a short daily AI news brief.
longDescription: Deduped tracks the AI repositories gaining attention on GitHub and turns each one into practical use cases. Every use case explains what the repo does, the steps to install and run it, and a prompt you can paste into a coding agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Entries are tagged by topic and difficulty, from software and DevOps to sales, research and personal productivity. The site also publishes a short daily news brief that groups the same story from many sources into one item. A free Monday email covers the five hottest repos of the week, and an MCP server lets AI agents search use cases and repos directly.
features: Use cases with steps and agent prompts
Daily list of trending AI repos
pros: Completely free to browse and subscribe
Prompts are ready to paste into coding agents
cons: Use cases are generated, so verify before running
Focused on open-source repos rather than commercial tools
moreContext:
Trending GitHub pages tell you which AI projects are popular but rarely what you would actually do with them. Deduped fills that gap by translating hot repos into specific tasks, each paired with a prompt aimed at a coding agent, which makes exploring new open-source tools feel far less like guesswork.

- Each use case lists what a repo does, how to set it up and a prompt you can hand to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.
- Use cases are grouped by topic and labeled by difficulty, so beginners can find approachable starting points.
- The daily news brief collapses duplicate coverage so each story appears once.
- A free Monday email highlights the five hottest AI repos of the week with steps for each.
- An MCP server exposes tools for searching use cases, fetching hot repos and reading the day's news from an AI agent.

Deduped is best for developers and technically curious users who rely on coding agents and want a steady feed of open-source projects worth trying. A practical tip: read the repo's own README before running any generated prompt, and have your agent show its planned commands first, especially for anything that installs packages or touches your accounts.

name: ThumbnailCreator
tagline: AI YouTube thumbnail generator that builds designs from your video and face
description: An AI tool for YouTube creators that generates thumbnails from a video link, adds your trained face and style, and offers variations, editing tools and a thumbnail analyzer.
longDescription: ThumbnailCreator is an AI design tool made specifically for YouTube thumbnails. You paste a video link or describe the video, and it produces thumbnail options based on the actual content, with your face and preferred style applied. Creators can train the tool on their face, clone the look of an existing thumbnail, generate variations for A/B testing, and edit with natural language, layers, text overlays and background removal. Extra tools include a thumbnail analyzer, title generator, vertical thumbnail conversion and an upscaler. Plans are credit based, with one credit per thumbnail, a seven-day free trial on every tier, and an API for teams and agents.
features: Thumbnail generation from a video link
pros: Uses your own face for consistent branding
Seven-day free trial on all plans
cons: No permanent free plan
Advanced face training needs a higher tier
moreContext:
Thumbnails carry a lot of weight on YouTube, yet making them well takes design time many creators would rather spend on videos. ThumbnailCreator narrows its focus to that one asset, which lets it offer features general design apps lack, like starting from your actual video and keeping your face consistent across uploads.

- Pasting a video link gives the AI real context, so designs reflect what the video is about.
- Face training and person swap let you appear in thumbnails with different expressions without a new photo shoot.
- Style cloning helps a channel keep a recognizable look across many uploads.
- Batch variations make it easier to test several designs and keep the one that performs best.
- Editing tools cover natural language edits, layers, text overlays, background removal and upscaling.

ThumbnailCreator is best for YouTubers and agencies publishing several videos a week who want polished thumbnails without a dedicated designer. The company says annual plans deliver the full year's thumbnail credits up front. A practical tip: during the free trial, train your face early and generate a few variations for one upcoming video so you can compare them against your current thumbnails before deciding on a plan.

name: Iris
tagline: An AI thought partner for reflection and wellbeing that you text over iMessage
description: Iris is an AI companion for talking things through, reflecting and building wellbeing, available around the clock by text message over iMessage and RCS with no separate app.
longDescription: Iris is an AI thought partner focused on mental wellness that lives in your phone's messaging app. Instead of downloading another app, you text Iris over iMessage or RCS whenever you want to talk through a situation, reflect on your day or work on personal growth. The company says more than 50,000 people have texted Iris. It is positioned as a supportive conversation partner, and its privacy policy states clearly that it is not a medical or clinical service and is not a substitute for professional care, pointing users to crisis lines in an emergency. Access is through a subscription that begins with a free trial.
pros: Fits into an existing texting habit
cons: Subscription price is not listed publicly
Needs a phone that supports iMessage or RCS
moreContext:
A lot of wellness apps ask you to build a new habit around opening them. Iris goes the other way and meets you in the place you already check dozens of times a day: your text messages. That low-friction setup makes it easier to reach for when a thought needs sorting out, rather than letting it slide.

- Conversations happen over iMessage and RCS, so it feels like texting a friend rather than using software.
- It is available at any hour, which helps for late-night worries or quick check-ins between tasks.
- The focus is on talking, reflecting and growing rather than productivity or general question answering.
- Its privacy policy is direct about limits, stating it is not a clinical service and listing crisis resources.
- The company says more than 50,000 people have texted Iris so far.

Iris is best for adults who want a gentle, always-available space to think out loud and build self-awareness, alongside rather than instead of professional support. A practical tip: set a regular time, such as the end of the workday, to text Iris a short recap, since a consistent reflection habit tends to be more useful than occasional long sessions.

name: TaroMind AI
tagline: Calm AI tarot readings, free yes or no draws and a private reflection journal
description: A tarot site with free yes or no draws that need no sign-up, guided AI readings through two interpretive lenses, a 78-card library and a private journal for saved readings.
longDescription: TaroMind AI is a tarot reading site designed for slow, reflective use rather than quick fortune telling. Anyone can draw one or three cards for a yes or no question without an account, and the answer comes from a fixed, published card table rather than from the AI. Signing in adds AI interpretation that explains the cards in the context of your question without changing the verdict, plus guided readings through two lenses: a Jungian, archetype-based guide and a calmer guide drawn from Eastern ideas of balance. The site also has a full card library, spread layouts, a birth card calculator, guides, a private journal and a Portuguese version.
features: Free yes or no draws without sign-up
AI interpretation that never changes the verdict
pros: Transparent about what the AI does
cons: AI insight and journal need sign-in
Fair-use limits may apply to readings
moreContext:
Many AI tarot apps let the model invent both the answer and the explanation. TaroMind AI separates the two in a way that is unusually transparent: the yes or no result comes from a fixed card table, and the AI only adds context around it. That design suits people who use tarot as a prompt for reflection rather than a prediction engine.

- Yes or no readings follow published rules across all 78 cards, returning Yes, No, Maybe or Not Yet.
- Optional AI insight explains the drawn cards in relation to your question and suggests a grounded next step.
- Two guides, The Fool and The Sage, read the same spread through archetypal psychology or contemplative balance.
- A private journal lets signed-in users save readings and come back to them over time.
- The site includes a card library, spread layouts, a birth card calculator and learning guides.

TaroMind AI is best for tarot enthusiasts and journaling fans who want a calm space to think through decisions. A practical tip: phrase questions around one specific choice, as the site recommends, and use the three-card draw when you want more context about timing or mixed feelings.

name: Cronloop
tagline: Scheduled AI agents that run your recurring work and improve between runs
description: Cronloop runs unattended AI agents on a schedule. You describe the job in Markdown, connect the tools it needs, and each agent keeps memory and learns from one run to the next.
longDescription: Cronloop is a platform for recurring, unattended AI agents. You write the job description in plain Markdown, such as answering support tickets every five minutes or posting a competitor digest twice a day, connect the services involved, and set a schedule. Each run starts in a fresh sandbox where the agent can install what it needs and use any tool that offers an API, MCP server or CLI. Agents keep durable memory between runs and refine their approach over time. Cronloop runs on your existing ChatGPT or Claude subscription or your own API keys, and a hosted MCP server lets you manage agents from Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.
features: Schedules from every five minutes to weekly
Hosted MCP server for remote control
pros: Uses your existing model subscription or keys
Works with almost any API, MCP or CLI tool
Free plan covers up to three agents
cons: Free plan limits runs to hourly and 10 minutes
Model costs come from your own provider account
moreContext:
Most AI agents wait for you to ask them something. Cronloop is built for the opposite case: work that should simply happen on a schedule, whether or not anyone remembers to start it. Pairing that with memory between runs means an agent can get better at a routine job instead of starting from zero every time.

- Agents are described in Markdown, so setting one up feels like writing a short job brief.
- Every run gets a fresh sandbox, and agents can install packages and call any tool with an API, MCP server or CLI.
- Durable memory lets each agent carry lessons and context from one run to the next.
- It runs on your own ChatGPT or Claude subscription or on Anthropic and OpenAI API keys, keeping model usage with your provider.
- A hosted MCP server lets you create, start and review agents from Claude, ChatGPT or other MCP clients.

Cronloop is best for founders, operators and developers who have repetitive tasks in support, sales, content or engineering that they want handled in the background. A practical tip: start one agent on the free plan with a narrow job and a clear escalation rule, review its run history for a few days, then widen its scope once you trust the output.

name: AI Town
tagline: Open-source starter kit for a virtual town where AI characters live and chat
description: An MIT-licensed project from a16z that simulates a small town of AI characters who talk, socialize and form relationships, ready to customize and deploy as your own version.
longDescription: AI Town is an open-source starter kit, released by the a16z infrastructure team in 2023, for building a simulated town where AI-driven characters live, chat and socialize. It is inspired by the Smallville generative agents research from Stanford and Google. Characters hold conversations, remember past interactions and build relationships that shape their behavior. The project uses Convex for its game engine, database and vector search, runs a local model through Ollama by default, and can be pointed at cloud models that use an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers clone the repository, customize characters and the map, and deploy their own version. A live demo is hosted on Convex.
features: AI characters with memory and relationships
Local models via Ollama or cloud APIs
pros: Good foundation for agent simulation experiments
Can run fully on a local machine
cons: Requires developer setup to customize
Model and hosting costs fall on you at scale
moreContext:
Watching AI characters wander a pixel-art town and strike up their own conversations is oddly captivating, and AI Town makes that experience something any developer can build on. Instead of a closed demo, it offers the full codebase under a permissive license, which has made it a popular base for agent simulation experiments.

- Characters act on their own, holding conversations, remembering interactions and forming relationships over time.
- The design follows the generative agents idea popularized by the Smallville research from Stanford and Google.
- Convex handles game state, the database and vector search in one backend.
- By default it runs a local model through Ollama, and it can also use cloud models with an OpenAI-compatible API.
- The MIT license lets you modify, extend and deploy your own town for games, research or teaching.

AI Town is best for developers, researchers and hobbyist game makers who want a working foundation for multi-agent simulations rather than building one from scratch. A practical tip: try the hosted demo first to see how the characters behave, then start your own version locally with a small model so you can experiment with character prompts before paying for cloud inference.

name: Zoivu
tagline: Create original characters and keep them consistent across looks, comics and stickers
description: Zoivu is an AI character generator for building original characters from a short idea or a permitted photo, then reusing them in reference sheets, comics, stickers and scenes.
longDescription: Zoivu is a browser-based studio for people who create original characters, often called OCs. You can start from a few words, a random prompt or a single-subject photo you have permission to use, and the tool generates a character you can save and return to. From there, a conversational assistant called Character Director helps you explore new outfits and art styles, produce front, side, back and three-quarter reference views, and place the same character into comic pages, sticker packs, expressions and cinematic stills. It can also draft storyboard keyframes and prompts, though it does not output finished video files. Pricing runs on monthly credits.
features: Character creation from text or a photo
pros: Keeps one character consistent across outputs
cons: Free credits expire after 14 days
No finished video export
moreContext:
Most image generators treat every prompt as a fresh start, which makes it hard to draw the same character twice. Zoivu is built around the opposite idea: you create a character once and then keep working with that identity across new outfits, styles and stories. The Character Director keeps context in one conversation, so you do not have to restate every detail each time you ask for a new scene.

- Reference sheets with front, side, back and three-quarter views help keep designs consistent
- Comic pages, sticker packs and expression sets come from the same saved character
- Looks let you try outfits and art styles such as watercolor, clay or pixel art without losing the core design
- Photo-based creation works from a single permitted subject image
- Storyboard keyframes and prompts support planning for animation work done elsewhere

Zoivu fits writers, comic hobbyists, tabletop players and anyone who wants a recurring character for stories, avatars or chat stickers. The free Lite tier gives a small batch of credits that expire after 14 days, so plan a focused test first: build one character, generate its reference sheet, and judge how consistent it stays before choosing a paid plan.

name: HyCanvas
tagline: Open source, self-hostable design editor for graphics, slides, video and docs with AI
description: HyCanvas is an AGPL-licensed design platform covering social graphics, presentations, whiteboards and docs in one editor, with an AI studio that runs on your own provider key.
longDescription: HyCanvas is an open source design platform from HyScaler that positions itself as an alternative to Canva. A single infinite-canvas editor handles social graphics, presentations, simple video, whiteboards, documents, sheets and print layouts. Its AI studio can draft designs and slide decks from a prompt and supports chat-based edits, using an OpenAI, Anthropic or DeepSeek key that you supply, with no markup on usage. Teams get live cursors, comments, approvals, roles and a shared brand kit. You can use the hosted cloud version or self-host it as one container image plus PostgreSQL, and every feature is available on every plan without watermarks.
pros: Every feature free with no watermarks
cons: AI features need your own API key
Cloud plan prices not published
moreContext:
Plenty of design tools give away a basic editor and then charge for exports, fonts or background removal. HyCanvas takes a different route: the code is open source under the AGPL, every feature is on for every user, and paid cloud plans only cover hosting, storage, backups and support. That makes it an unusual option for groups that want full design capability without per-feature paywalls.

- A bring-your-own-key AI studio, so you pay your model provider directly
- Self-hosting as a single container image with PostgreSQL, plus local or S3 storage
- SSO through OIDC, TOTP multi-factor sign-in and encrypted AI keys for security-minded teams
- Real-time collaboration with comments, approvals and a shared brand kit
- An open file format and an MCP endpoint that AI assistants can connect to

HyCanvas suits schools, nonprofits, small businesses and in-house creative teams that care about data ownership or simply dislike watermark gates. The project is still at an early version number, so try the cloud version with a real brand kit and a short deck before moving a whole team over, and check the public GitHub roadmap to see which features are still in progress.

name: Delphi
tagline: Build an interactive AI version of your mind that other people can question
description: Delphi lets experts and creators turn their writing, podcasts and videos into a conversational digital version of themselves, and lets anyone ask those minds for advice.
longDescription: Delphi is a platform for creating interactive digital versions of real people. A creator uploads material such as books, articles, podcasts and videos, and Delphi builds a conversational profile that answers questions in that person's voice and cites the underlying sources. Visitors can browse the network by topic, from startups and careers to parenting and fitness, and ask several perspectives about a situation they face. Creating and hosting a basic Delphi on the network is free. Paid plans, billed annually, let professionals embed their Delphi on their own website, in Slack and other integrations, add voice calls, and build it into products through an API.
features: Digital mind built from your content
pros: Free to create a basic Delphi
cons: Paid plans cost thousands per year
Quality depends on how much material you upload
moreContext:
The idea behind Delphi came from founder Dara Ladjevardian, who built a digital version of his grandfather from a memoir so he could keep learning from him. That origin shows in the product: it is less a general chatbot and more a way to put a specific person's experience within reach of people who could never book time with them. Answers include citations back to the source material, which helps users see where advice comes from.

- A discovery network where people describe a situation and hear from several relevant experts
- Training from many formats, including books, podcasts, videos and written posts
- Creators choose what to share, can update their Delphi over time, and keep ownership of their content
- Paid tiers add integrations, voice calls, Slack access and an API for custom applications
- A managed Immortal tier for public figures who want hands-on help

Delphi works best for coaches, authors, investors, educators and other experts who field the same questions again and again. Start with the free version and feed it your most representative long-form material first, since richer source content tends to produce answers that sound more like you. Keep in mind that paid plans are billed annually at a business-level price.

name: Google AI Studio
tagline: Google's browser workspace for prototyping with Gemini models and getting an API key
description: Google AI Studio is a free web workspace for testing Gemini models, refining prompts and generating API keys before moving a project into your own code.
longDescription: Google AI Studio is Google's web-based environment for developers who want to work with Gemini models and the Gemini API. You can write and test prompts against different Gemini models, attach images, audio, video or documents as inputs, adjust settings such as temperature and system instructions, and request structured outputs. When a prompt works, the studio can generate matching code so you can call the same setup from your own application. It is also where developers create and manage Gemini API keys. Using the studio itself is free, while API usage beyond the free tier is billed on a pay-as-you-go basis through Google.
pros: Free to use in the browser
Fast way to try new Gemini models
Direct path to the Gemini API
cons: Limited to Google's models
Free tier data terms differ from paid usage
moreContext:
For anyone curious about building with Gemini, Google AI Studio is the shortest path from idea to a working request. It runs entirely in the browser, needs only a Google account, and lets you try prompts against Google's models before you write any integration code. Because it doubles as the place to create API keys, many developers start here even if they later move production work to Google Cloud's Vertex AI.

- Prompt testing with adjustable model settings and system instructions
- Multimodal inputs, so you can try prompts with images, audio, video and long documents
- Code snippets that reproduce your prompt setup in your own app
- API key creation and usage tracking in the same workspace
- New Gemini models and preview features typically appear here for testing

Google AI Studio is best for developers, students and product teams prototyping AI features on Google's stack. A practical tip: keep sensitive or production data out of free-tier experiments and read Google's data use terms for the free tier, since they differ from paid usage, then switch to a billed project when you are ready to ship.

name: Stivio
tagline: Turn a single photo into a short HD video with a plain-English motion prompt
description: Stivio is an image-to-video generator that animates product shots, portraits and old photos into 3 to 30 second MP4 clips using a choice of AI video models.
longDescription: Stivio is a web app that converts still images into short video clips. You upload a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo up to 10 MB, describe the motion and camera movement in ordinary language, and choose a clip length from 3 to 30 seconds. The service sends the job to one of six video models, including Kling, Seedance and Wan, and returns an HD MP4 in a few minutes that follows your photo's aspect ratio. Credits are charged per second, with the cost shown before you generate, and failed runs are refunded automatically. It is aimed at online sellers, social creators and families animating old pictures.
cons: Free tier output is watermarked
Animates single images rather than full edits
moreContext:
Stivio keeps image-to-video generation simple: one photo, one sentence, one clip. Rather than asking you to learn a single model's quirks, it gives access to several video models in the same interface and shows the exact credit cost on the Generate button before anything runs. That upfront pricing and the automatic refunds on failed generations make it easy to experiment without guessing at spend.

- A choice of six video models, including Kling, Seedance and Wan, in one place
- Clip lengths from 3 to 30 seconds with per-second credit pricing
- Watermark-free HD MP4 exports on paid plans, with commercial use included
- Finished videos hosted on a stable share link for a year
- A stated policy of not training on your uploads or selling them for advertising

Stivio is a good fit for e-commerce sellers turning catalog shots into product videos, marketers who need quick social clips, and anyone who wants to bring family photos to life. Photos with one clear subject animate best, so start with a clean product shot or portrait and a short, specific motion description before trying busier scenes.

name: Flowmaps
tagline: Map your app idea visually and hand AI builders a step-by-step build plan
description: Flowmaps is a visual planner that turns an app idea into a feature map with one clear instruction per feature for Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Claude Code and similar AI builders.
longDescription: Flowmaps sits in the planning step before you open an AI app builder. You describe your idea in a sentence or paste a website, and it lays out the features the app needs on a visual map, ordered by what to build first, including items beginners often forget such as security and onboarding. Each feature card gets a build instruction written for the tool you use, such as Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Cursor or Claude Code. As your builder completes steps, the board tracks progress. AI features run on your own Anthropic key with no markup. It is made by Emmerce & Media in the Netherlands.
features: Visual feature map from an idea
Example maps for common app types
pros: Free plan for a first project
cons: AI features need your own Anthropic key
Free plan limited to one project
moreContext:
AI app builders can write code quickly, but vague requests lead to guesses, rework and burned credits. Flowmaps tackles that problem upstream by helping you decide what to build and in what order before any code is generated. The result is a visual board of feature cards, each paired with a focused prompt, so you can feed your builder one clear step at a time.

- Idea-to-map generation from a single sentence or an existing website
- Build prompts tailored to Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0, Cursor, Claude Code and Codex
- Progress tracking, with support for building through Claude Code in the terminal
- Bring-your-own Anthropic key, billed directly by Anthropic with no added markup
- Plans stored in the European Union, with export and delete options in settings

Flowmaps is well suited to first-time founders, no-code makers and developers who want a clearer scope before prompting an AI builder. The free plan covers one project with up to 30 cards, which is enough to map a small MVP; try planning a single core feature end to end before deciding whether Pro's unlimited projects are worth it.

name: Makernice
tagline: One API key for AI video and image models with a price quote before every run
description: Makernice is a pay-as-you-go API that gives developers access to video and image models such as Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax H3 and Seedream, with each job quoted upfront.
longDescription: Makernice is a developer API that bundles several third-party video and image generation models behind a single key. Supported models include ByteDance's Seedance and Seedream, Kuaishou's Kling, Alibaba's Wan, Happy Horse and Qwen image models, and MiniMax H3. Every request first returns a price quote that stays locked for 12 minutes, and video is billed per second while images are billed per image from a prepaid US dollar balance that does not expire. Failed generations are not charged, and repeated requests with the same idempotency key avoid double billing. There is no subscription, and balances start from a $15 top-up.
features: Unified API for many video models
cons: No free credits to test
Moderation-blocked outputs are still billed
moreContext:
Integrating generative video into a product often means signing up with several vendors and juggling different billing models. Makernice consolidates that into one API with published prices and a public pricing endpoint, so you can show costs to your own users before they commit. The quote-first flow is the standout: you know the exact charge before a job runs.

- Price quotes locked for 12 minutes before each generation
- Per-second video and per-image billing from a prepaid, non-expiring balance
- No charge for failed generations, plus idempotency keys to prevent duplicate billing
- A single key covering models from ByteDance, Kuaishou, Alibaba and MiniMax
- Some models listed below the vendor's official list price, with the comparison shown

Makernice is best for developers and small teams adding AI video or image features to an app without managing multiple vendor accounts. There are no free credits, so start with the minimum top-up and a short, low-resolution test clip on a budget model to check latency and output quality. Note that outputs blocked by moderation for policy violations are still charged.

name: GetFloorPlan
tagline: Turn a floor plan sketch or blueprint into 2D and 3D plans, renders and virtual tours
description: GetFloorPlan converts uploaded floor plans, sketches or blueprints into furnished 2D and 3D plans, interior renderings and 360-degree virtual tours for property listings.
longDescription: GetFloorPlan is a service for real estate agents, developers and property marketers who need listing visuals. You upload an existing floor plan as a photo, sketch or blueprint, and AI rendering turns it into a clean 2D plan and a furnished 3D plan. Higher packages add a 360-degree virtual tour, interior renderings and your own branding, and the tours can be embedded on listing sites or viewed with VR headsets. A quality assurance team checks each result against the original plan, and the company says orders are delivered within 24 hours. Pricing is per plan or package rather than a subscription.
cons: Not instant, results arrive within a day
Package details are hard to compare before ordering
moreContext:
Professional floor plan visualization usually means hiring a 3D artist and waiting days. GetFloorPlan combines AI rendering with a human review step to turn a rough plan into a set of marketing visuals quickly. Because pricing is per order rather than a subscription, it suits agents who need visuals for some listings but not a monthly tool.

- 2D and furnished 3D floor plans generated from photos, sketches or blueprints
- Package options that add 360-degree virtual tours, interior renderings and branding
- Embeddable tours, plus a VR mode for viewing with a headset
- Human quality checks on every plan before delivery
- Bulk packages and an API for agencies and developers with larger volumes

GetFloorPlan is a strong fit for real estate agents, property developers and rental managers who want listings to stand out without a design team. A practical tip: upload the clearest, most complete plan you have, with room labels and dimensions where possible, since the human check compares results against your original. The company has offered a free demo plan, which is worth requesting before a bulk order.

name: Music Video AI
tagline: Generate beat-synced music video drafts from your song and a mood description
description: Music Video AI analyzes an uploaded track and builds a beat-synced video draft from your style prompt, which you can refine through an agent, a guided workflow or a timeline editor.
longDescription: Music Video AI is a web tool for musicians, producers and creators who need visuals for a release without a full editing workflow. You upload a song, and the app reads its rhythm, structure and mood, then uses your description of the visual world to plan scenes. Three modes are available: a conversational agent that acts as a video director, a step-by-step workflow with style, segment and timeline controls, and an editor for adjusting clip order and pacing around the track. Paid plans export 1080p video in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 without a watermark, and credits fund each generation.
pros: Built around the song, not just prompts
Multiple ways to refine a draft
cons: Paid plans are relatively expensive
Commercial rights vary by plan and model
moreContext:
Many AI video tools start from a text prompt and leave you to line footage up with the music yourself. Music Video AI starts from the track instead, using rhythm and structure analysis so the scene plan follows the song. That music-first approach makes it a practical shortcut for artists who want a visualizer, concept video or social teaser for a new release.

- Song analysis that maps rhythm, structure and mood into a scene plan
- An agent mode where you direct the video through conversation
- A guided workflow with style, segment and timeline controls
- A timeline editor for reordering clips and adjusting pacing
- Exports in widescreen, vertical and square formats at 1080p on paid plans

Music Video AI suits independent musicians, beatmakers and content creators releasing music on YouTube, TikTok or Instagram. Treat the first output as a draft rather than a finished video: the tool is designed for refinement, so plan time to adjust scenes in the editor. Also review the terms on commercial rights, since the site notes that usage rights depend on your plan and the underlying models.

name: fal.live
tagline: A continuous AI-generated TV broadcast where viewers help decide what happens next
description: fal.live is an experimental streaming site from fal that runs nonstop AI-generated channels, such as anime and sitcom, and lets viewers steer the story or pitch new channels.
longDescription: fal.live is an interactive showcase from fal, the generative media infrastructure company. It streams a continuous AI-generated broadcast across several themed channels, including anime, sitcom, soap opera, wildlife and a chaos channel, with an AI director shaping what comes next based on viewer input. Visitors can suggest ideas, pitch their own channel or apply to run one. The site is free to watch in a browser, asks visitors to confirm they are 18 or older before entering, and labels all content as AI-generated entertainment. It also highlights the MiniMax H3 video model available through fal's developer platform.
cons: Entertainment demo, not a creation tool
Some channels are password protected
moreContext:
Most AI video tools are about making a clip and downloading it. fal.live turns generative video into a shared, always-on viewing experience, closer to channel surfing than prompting. It works as a live demonstration of how quickly generative video can now be produced, since the broadcast keeps rolling while the audience nudges the story.

- Several themed channels running continuously, from anime to wildlife
- Audience participation that influences what the AI director does next
- Options to suggest a channel idea or apply to run your own
- Free browser access with no software to install
- A direct link to try the underlying video model on fal's developer platform

fal.live is best for the curious: people who want to see where AI-generated entertainment is heading, and developers evaluating fal's video models in a more playful setting. Treat it as an experiment rather than a production tool, and keep in mind the site's own note that content may contain errors. If you like what you see, the linked fal model pages are where you can generate video for your own projects.

name: Spreadcast
tagline: Automatic branded social posts for App Store apps from updates, reviews and milestones
description: Spreadcast watches your App Store listing and turns each new version, review and rating milestone into a branded social post, then publishes it to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and Facebook.
longDescription: Spreadcast is a social media automation tool built for App Store app makers. You paste your App Store link once, and it monitors the listing for new versions, reviews and rating milestones. Each event becomes a designed post using your app icon, brand colors and real screenshots in an iPhone frame. You can also describe a post in one sentence or upload your own images and video. On paid tiers, Spreadcast publishes the posts automatically to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and Facebook. The free plan covers one app and lets you download drafts to post yourself, while the Studio plan supports five apps and three seats.
cons: Built around App Store listings
Auto-publishing requires a paid plan
moreContext:
Indie developers often ship updates regularly but rarely find time to announce them. Spreadcast closes that gap by treating the App Store listing as the source of truth: when something changes, a post is drafted for you in your app's look and feel. It removes the blank-page problem that stalls a lot of app marketing.

- App Store monitoring for new versions, reviews and rating milestones
- Branded designs that use your icon, colors and real app screenshots
- One-sentence post creation, plus uploads of your own pictures and video
- Automatic publishing to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and Facebook on paid plans
- Free extras such as a brand kit generator that reads a website's colors, fonts and logo

Spreadcast is best for solo iOS developers, small studios and startups that want a steady social presence without hiring a marketer. Begin on the free plan with one app and review the drafts over a few release cycles; if the tone and design match your brand, upgrading to Pro lets the posting run without manual steps.

name: Waymark
tagline: AI video ad platform that builds on-brand commercials from a business website
description: Waymark creates TV and digital video ads by pulling a brand's assets from its website, writing the script with AI and adding voiceover, aimed at media sales and creative teams.
longDescription: Waymark is a Detroit-based AI video ad platform used largely by media companies, ad sales teams and creative departments. You enter a business's website, and Waymark gathers its logo, imagery and visual identity to assemble a branded video ad. AI scriptwriting drafts the copy, realistic AI voiceovers narrate it, and an editing suite lets users adjust scenes and text before downloading TV or digital quality files. Higher tiers add translations, format variations, templates, CRM automations and white labeling. A newer offering, Waymark Cinematic, targets higher-end ad production with generative AI. The Starter plan comes with a 7-day free trial.
pros: Fast spec ads for sales teams
cons: Expensive for small businesses
Starter plan limits final downloads
moreContext:
Waymark focuses on a specific, practical job: helping local and regional advertisers get a professional commercial on air quickly. Sales teams use it to create spec ads that show prospects what their campaign could look like, which the company positions as a way to shorten deal cycles. Waymark launched in 2017, and the company notes that the Financial Times included it among the fastest-growing companies in America for 2024.

- Brand customization that pulls assets directly from a website
- AI-written scripts and a library of AI voiceovers
- Unlimited draft generations on every plan, with a set number of final downloads
- Team features such as approval workflows, translations and video variations
- Enterprise options including white labeling, CRM automations and custom templates

Waymark is best for broadcasters, ad agencies and media sales teams that produce many short commercials for clients. It is priced for professional use, so take advantage of the 7-day trial with a couple of real client websites to see how much editing the drafts need before committing.

name: AIApply
tagline: Tailored resumes, cover letters, auto-apply and interview help for job seekers
description: AIApply helps job seekers tailor resumes and cover letters to each posting, automatically apply to matching roles, and practice or get live help with interviews.
longDescription: AIApply is a job search toolkit that uses AI across the application process. It finds roles that match your profile, generates a resume and cover letter tailored to each job description, and can submit applications for you through its Auto Apply feature, which runs on credits. Other tools include an AI resume builder that can start from a LinkedIn profile, a resume scanner that checks against applicant tracking systems, follow-up email drafting, mock interviews and an interview assistant. The site is available in more than a dozen languages, and a free plan covers core tools such as cover letters and the job board.
cons: Auto Apply consumes paid credits
Automated applications need careful review
moreContext:
Job hunting involves a lot of repetitive writing, and AIApply aims to handle most of it in one place. Instead of switching between a resume builder, a cover letter tool and a job board, you work from one profile that feeds every application. The company says more than two million people have used the platform, and it supports manual, hybrid and fully automated ways to apply.

- Job-specific resume and cover letter generation from a single profile
- Auto Apply, which finds matching roles and submits applications using credits
- An ATS resume checker with keyword gap suggestions
- Mock interview practice with AI feedback and a live interview assistant
- More than 40 free career tools, including a salary estimate calculator

AIApply suits active job seekers who send many applications, career changers rewriting their story for new roles, and anyone who dislikes writing cover letters. One practical tip: review every tailored resume before it goes out, especially with Auto Apply, so that every claim stays accurate and matches your real experience.

name: Websim
tagline: Describe a game or web app and build, remix and share it with AI in the browser
