- Interview scheduling and preparation sit in the same workspace as the candidate evidence.
- Each hire includes an editable, country-aware offer draft.
- Penroll says candidate data is hosted in the EU and that clear candidate consent is built into the product.

Penroll is best for startups and small businesses that hire a few people a year and want structure without a heavy applicant tracking system. A practical tip: try the sample workspace with fictional CVs first, then use the free first hire on a real role so you can see how the ranking explains its choices before buying a package.

name: Comet Browser
tagline: Perplexity's AI browser with a built-in assistant that can research and act on pages
description: Comet is a free Chromium-based browser from Perplexity with an AI assistant that answers questions about pages, manages tabs, summarizes content and completes web tasks.
longDescription: Comet is a web browser built by Perplexity on Chromium, so it supports most Chrome extensions, bookmarks and page translation. Perplexity search is the default engine, and the Comet Assistant sits alongside every page to answer questions, compare sources, draft emails, build study plans or carry out multi-step tasks such as shopping research. Other features include natural language commands for tab management, a summarize button, personal search across your browsing history, a Gmail connector for email and calendar questions and a built-in ad blocker. Comet first launched in limited release in July 2025 and became free to download in October 2025, with apps for Mac, Windows, iOS and Android.
features: Built-in ad blocker and Chrome extension support
pros: Free to download on desktop and mobile
cons: Agent features need careful permission settings
Asks for broad access to work well
moreContext:
Comet takes Perplexity's answer engine and makes it the center of the browsing experience. Instead of copying text into a separate chat window, you can ask about the page you are on, have the assistant compare coverage across sources or hand it a task that spans several sites. Because it is built on Chromium, switching from Chrome feels familiar.

- The assistant can summarize long pages, answer follow-up questions and act on content in context.
- Tab management works through plain language commands, which helps when research sessions sprawl.
- Personal search can surface pages from your own browsing history when you cannot remember where you saw something.
- A Gmail connector lets you ask about email and calendar items from the browser.
- Perplexity offers dedicated help pages for enterprise installs and assistant permission controls.

Comet is best for students, researchers and knowledge workers who spend most of the day reading and comparing information online. A practical tip: review the Comet Assistant permission settings before letting it act on sites where you are signed in, and keep sensitive tasks such as payments under your own control.

name: CVMakerFree
tagline: Free CV builder with an ATS score check, AI rewrites and many export formats
description: A free browser-based CV builder with a live page preview, an ATS score checker and AI help for bullets, summaries and cover letters. No account, watermark or download limit.
longDescription: CVMakerFree is a no-cost CV and resume builder that runs in the browser. You fill in sections on one side of the screen and watch a live preview of the printed page update on the other. An ATS score checker and a set of writing checks flag weak spots, while AI assistance can rewrite bullet points, draft a profile summary and write a cover letter for a specific job using only facts already in your CV. It offers ten single-column templates, imports existing .docx, PDF, text or JSON Resume files, and exports to PDF, Word, Europass, LaTeX, plain text or a JSON backup. Drafts are saved in your own browser rather than on the company's servers.
features: Live preview editor with ten templates
ATS score checker and writing checks
AI bullet rewrites and summary drafts
Export to PDF, Word, LaTeX and JSON
pros: No account, watermark or download cap
CV data stays in your browser
Imports existing Word and PDF resumes
cons: Templates are single-column only
Browser-only storage needs regular JSON backups
moreContext:
What stands out about CVMakerFree is how much it gives away without asking for anything in return. There is no sign-up wall, no watermark on the finished file and no cap on downloads, and the AI writing help is built to work only from the facts you have already entered. Where a number is missing, the site says it leaves a placeholder instead of making one up, which is a thoughtful choice for a document that recruiters will read closely.

- A live preview shows the printed page as you type, so layout surprises are rare
- The ATS score checker and fourteen writing checks point out weak or vague lines
- AI can sharpen bullet points, draft a summary and tailor a cover letter to a posting
- Exports cover PDF, Word, Europass, LaTeX, plain text and a JSON backup
- Existing CVs can be imported from .docx, PDF, text or JSON Resume files

It is best for job seekers, students and career changers who want a clean, recruiter-friendly CV quickly and without paying for a subscription. Because drafts are stored in your browser, a practical tip is to download the JSON backup after each editing session so you can restore your work on another device or after clearing browser data.

name: Img2Prompt
tagline: Turn any image into a detailed prompt for Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion and more
description: A free web tool that analyzes an uploaded image with AI and writes a prompt you can reuse in popular image and video generators, with selectable detail levels and formats.
longDescription: Img2Prompt is a free browser tool that reverse engineers images into text prompts. You drag in a JPG, PNG or WEBP file up to 10 MB, or paste an image URL, and the image is sent to an AI model that describes it. The result is a structured prompt covering subject, style, lighting, camera, color and negative prompts, formatted for the generator you pick, including Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, image-to-video tools or plain JSON. You can choose how detailed the output should be, regenerate it, copy it or download it as a text file. No account is required, which makes it handy for quick creative experiments.
cons: Images are sent to a third-party AI provider
Image generation feature not yet available
moreContext:
Img2Prompt focuses on one job and handles it with care: looking at a picture and explaining it in the language that image generators understand. Rather than returning a single block of text, it splits the description into subject, style, lighting, camera, color and negative prompt sections, which makes it easy to tweak one element without rewriting everything.

- Prompts can be formatted for Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E and image-to-video tools
- A structured JSON option suits people who keep prompt libraries or automate workflows
- Detail levels let you choose between a quick summary and a rich, descriptive prompt
- Results can be copied, regenerated or saved as a text file in one click
- No sign-up is required, so trying it takes seconds

It is best for designers, hobbyists and content creators who find a reference image they love and want to recreate its look in their own generator of choice. A practical tip: generate the same image at two detail levels and compare the results in your generator, since shorter prompts sometimes give the model more creative room while longer ones hold the composition more tightly. Keep in mind that uploads are processed by an outside AI provider, so avoid sending private photos.

name: AI Office Pro
tagline: AI project manager that turns client briefs into assigned tasks, QA and updates
description: An India-built AI office manager for agencies and small teams that converts client briefs into tasks, assigns work, flags risks and sends standups, with a human approving key steps.
longDescription: AI Office Pro is a project management platform built in India that acts as an AI office manager for service teams such as agencies. Clients submit briefs through an intake portal, and the system drafts requirements, breaks the work into tasks and assigns them based on each person's skills and workload, explaining its reasoning. It also runs QA checks, flags delivery risks, watches for signs of burnout and sends standups and client update emails, while a human approves important decisions. A master dashboard shows everything in one place, and the Business tier adds HR and CRM modules. The product is in early access, with a limited free plan and paid tiers billed in rupees.
features: Skill and workload based task assignment
pros: Covers intake to delivery in one tool
Explains why each task was assigned
cons: Early access with no public case studies yet
Free plan limited to one project and three tasks
moreContext:
AI Office Pro takes an interesting angle on project management: instead of giving you another board to maintain, it tries to act like an office manager that handles the routine coordination for you. Briefs come in through a client portal, and the AI turns them into requirements and tasks, then hands work to the right people with a short explanation of why. Keeping a person in the loop for important approvals is a sensible design choice for teams that are new to automation.

- A client intake portal collects briefs in a consistent format
- Task assignment weighs each team member's skills and current workload
- Risk detection and burnout signals help managers act before deadlines slip
- Standups and client update emails can go out automatically
- The Business plan adds HR and CRM modules alongside project work

It is best for small agencies and service teams in India that juggle many client projects and want less time spent on status meetings and manual handoffs. Since the product is still in early access, a practical tip is to start on the free plan with a single real project, check how well the generated tasks match your process, and only then invite the wider team on the Pro tier, which the company backs with a seven-day money-back guarantee.

name: Prompt Builder
tagline: Generate, optimize and save model-specific prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more
description: A prompt workspace that turns rough ideas into structured prompts tuned for a chosen AI model, improves existing prompts and keeps them in a searchable library with version history.
longDescription: Prompt Builder is a web app for writing better instructions for AI models. You describe a task in plain language, pick a target model such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Llama, Mistral or DeepSeek, and it produces a structured prompt suited to that model. An optimizer reviews prompts you already use, asks up to three clarifying questions and rewrites them. Reusable instructions store your preferred voice and constraints, version history lets you roll back changes, and a library keeps prompts searchable and pinned. A built-in assistant can run prompts directly, a Chrome extension works inside ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and team workspaces share folders of prompts. A small free tier is available, with paid credit plans above it.
pros: Supports a wide range of AI models
cons: Free tier covers only five prompts
Credit limits apply even on paid plans
moreContext:
Prompt Builder treats prompts as reusable assets rather than throwaway messages, and that mindset shapes the whole product. It does not stop at generating a prompt; it helps you refine it, remember the context behind it and find it again weeks later. The optimizer's habit of asking a few clarifying questions before rewriting is a nice touch, because vague requests are usually the reason prompts underperform.

- Prompts are tailored to the chosen model, from GPT and Claude to Gemini, Grok and open models
- Saved instructions apply your preferred tone and constraints to every new prompt
- Version history and follow-up suggestions make iteration feel low risk
- A Chrome extension brings the tools into ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini directly
- Team workspaces organize shared prompts into folders

It is best for marketers, developers, researchers and content teams who rely on AI models every day and want consistent results across people and tools. A practical tip: set up your reusable instructions first, covering brand voice, audience and format rules, so every prompt you generate afterward starts from the same baseline and needs fewer manual edits.

name: TTSReader
tagline: Read text, PDFs, ebooks and web pages aloud with free and premium AI voices
description: An online text-to-speech reader that plays text, documents and web pages aloud, remembers your place and offers premium AI voices with MP3 export, with no login needed.
longDescription: TTSReader is a text-to-speech service that reads content aloud in the browser and on mobile. You can paste text, open PDFs, DOCX, EPUB, TXT or CSV files, or enter a web page URL, then press play. It highlights the sentence being read, lets you edit while it plays, and remembers your text and position so you can pick up later. Voices come from the browser's built-in speech engine, which is free without usage limits, plus premium AI voices from Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and TTSReader's own models. Premium users can mix voices for dialog and export MP3 files. There are iOS and Android apps, a Chrome extension and an API.
features: Reads PDFs, ebooks and web pages
Premium AI voices with MP3 export
pros: Free system voices with no usage limits
cons: MP3 export requires premium
Premium pricing not shown on the homepage
moreContext:
TTSReader has been around since 2015, and it shows in the practical details. It remembers exactly where you stopped, highlights the sentence being spoken so your eyes can follow along, and lets you fix a typo without stopping playback. Those small comforts make it pleasant for long reading sessions, not just short clips.

- Works with pasted text, PDFs, DOCX, EPUB, TXT, CSV files and live web pages
- Free voices use the browser's own speech engine, so everyday listening costs nothing
- Premium AI voices from Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and TTSReader's own models sound more natural
- Multiple voices, languages and speeds can be mixed in one file for dialog
- Apps for iOS and Android, a Chrome extension and an API cover most setups

It is best for students, people who prefer listening to reading, readers with dyslexia or low vision, and anyone who wants to get through articles while commuting. A practical tip: try the free system voices on your device first, since quality varies by browser and operating system, then upgrade to premium only if you need more natural narration or downloadable MP3 files.

name: MagicSlides
tagline: Turn prompts, documents, videos and links into editable presentation slides
description: An AI presentation maker that builds designed decks from a topic, file, YouTube video or URL and exports them to PowerPoint, Google Slides or PDF in over 130 languages.
longDescription: MagicSlides is an AI presentation generator that turns source material into a ready-to-edit slide deck. You can start from a short prompt or topic, or upload a PDF, Word file, PowerPoint, image, audio or video file, and paste YouTube links or web URLs. The tool drafts slides in formats such as timelines, SWOT analyses, pros and cons and pitch decks, then exports to PPTX, Google Slides or PDF. It supports more than 130 languages and includes extras like turning a slide image into an editable slide and Excel data into charts. It also works through a Google Slides add-on, Figma plugin, Chrome extension, mobile apps and MCP connectors for AI assistants.
features: Decks from prompts, files, videos and URLs
PPTX, Google Slides and PDF export
Slide image to editable slide cloning
Add-ons for Google Slides, Figma and Chrome
pros: Accepts many kinds of source material
Exports into tools people already use
cons: Lower plans cap presentations and slide counts
Premium templates reserved for the top tier
moreContext:
MagicSlides earns its place by meeting people where their content already lives. Instead of insisting you start from a blank prompt, it will build a deck from a PDF report, a recorded talk, a YouTube video or a web page, and then hand it back as a regular PowerPoint or Google Slides file you can keep editing. That makes it a practical bridge between rough material and a presentation you can actually deliver.

- Inputs range from prompts and documents to audio, video, YouTube links and URLs
- Exports go to PPTX, Google Slides and PDF, with image and HTML options on the top plan
- A clone feature turns a screenshot of a slide into an editable one
- Excel data can be converted into charts for data-heavy decks
- Integrations include a Google Slides add-on, Figma plugin, Chrome extension, mobile apps and MCP connectors

It is best for teachers, students, consultants and marketers who need a solid first draft of a deck in minutes and prefer to finish it in familiar software. A practical tip: feed it your own document rather than a one-line topic, since slides built from real source material tend to need far less fact checking and rewriting afterward.

name: UltimateApp
tagline: A hub of free and pro AI generators for thumbnails, SVGs, book covers and product photos
description: A web platform bundling dozens of creative and business tools, including AI thumbnail, SVG, headshot and product photo generators, with an AI agent that picks the right tool for a request.
longDescription: UltimateApp is an online collection of creative and business utilities, many of them powered by AI. Its tools include a YouTube thumbnail generator, an AI SVG generator, a book cover maker, AI clothes swapping, AI product photography, an AI headshot studio and seasonal card makers, alongside practical apps such as an invoice generator. An AI agent accepts a plain-language request, picks the matching tool and runs it for you. Dozens of tools are free to use without registration, while a single Pro membership adds unlimited AI generations, HD and 4K exports, faster servers and commercial usage rights. It suits creators and small businesses who want many small tools in one place.
features: YouTube thumbnail and book cover generators
AI SVG and product photo creation
AI agent that routes requests to tools
Pro plan with 4K exports and commercial rights
pros: One subscription covers every pro tool
cons: Breadth over depth compared with specialist tools
Tool counts on the site are inconsistent
moreContext:
UltimateApp works like a toolbox you can open in a browser tab. Rather than signing up for a separate service every time you need a thumbnail, a vector icon or a quick product shot, you get a wide shelf of generators under one roof, and a large share of them can be used without creating an account. The AI agent is a handy shortcut: describe what you need in plain words and it chooses and launches the right tool.

- Creator tools include a YouTube thumbnail generator, book cover maker and AI SVG generator
- Commerce helpers cover AI product photography, clothes swapping and headshots
- Everyday business apps such as an invoice generator sit alongside the AI tools
- A single Pro membership adds unlimited AI generations, HD and 4K output and commercial use
- Free tools are available without registration for quick one-off jobs

It is best for YouTubers, self-publishing authors, Etsy sellers and small business owners who need lots of different visuals but do not want a stack of separate subscriptions. A practical tip: try the free version of each tool you rely on before upgrading, and check whether your use needs commercial rights, since that is one of the main things the Pro plan adds.

name: KaivorMusic.AI
tagline: AI song maker for full tracks, beats, covers, voice-overs and music videos
description: A browser-based AI music workspace that turns prompts or lyrics into songs, beats and background music, with tools to extend, edit and cover tracks plus voice-over and music video studios.
longDescription: KaivorMusic.AI is an online music creation workspace aimed at songwriters and content creators. You describe a style and mood or paste your own lyrics, and the AI produces full songs, beats or background tracks. The site says its full-song workspace now starts with Google's Lyria model. Editing tools let you extend a track, retry or compare takes, refine an existing song, and add vocals or instrumentals to a selected section, including over audio you upload. Extra studios cover AI song covers, voice-over narration for things like meditation or bedtime stories, and music videos built from singer images. Results are organized into a library and albums, and the service runs on monthly or longer credit plans.
features: Prompt and lyrics to full songs
Extend, edit and add vocals to sections
AI song covers and voice-over studio
Music video generator with singer images
pros: Covers songs, narration and video in one place
cons: No permanent free plan on the pricing page
Plan prices are shown in local currency only
moreContext:
KaivorMusic.AI stands out for how much it lets you do after the first draft of a song appears. Many music generators stop at producing a track, but this one treats generation as the starting point, with tools to extend a song, retry and compare takes, and swap in new vocals or instruments on just one section. According to the site, full songs now begin with Google's Lyria model, which gives creators access to a well-known engine through a friendly workspace.

- Songs can start from a text prompt or from lyrics you have written yourself
- Section editing lets you add vocals or instrumentals without regenerating the whole track
- An AI cover feature restyles an existing vocal song
- A voice-over studio handles narration for meditation, bedtime stories and similar content
- A music video generator pairs tracks with singer images in several aspect ratios

It is best for content creators, hobbyist songwriters and small studios who want songs, narration and simple music videos from one subscription. A practical tip: note the credit cost of each action before you start, since full songs use more credits than short clips or section edits, and plan your experiments around the shorter options first.

name: AIEnhance.io
tagline: Prompt-based AI photo editor with upscaling, restoration and background removal
description: A browser photo editor where you describe a change in words and AI applies it, plus upscaling, unblurring, old photo restoration and free background and object removal tools.
longDescription: AIEnhance.io is a browser-based AI photo editing suite. Its main tool works like a chat box for images: you upload a picture, describe the change you want, and a model applies the edit. Users can pick from several image models, including Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream, Qwen Image Edit, FLUX and Ideogram. Other tools generate images from text, upscale photos up to four times, unblur, restore old pictures, change hairstyles or expressions and create profile portraits. Background removal, object and watermark removal and a set of one-click photo effects cost no credits. New accounts get 20 free credits, and paid monthly plans or one-time credit packs cover heavier use.
pros: Several leading image models in one place
cons: Only 20 free credits for AI edits
Prompt edits use more credits than basic tools
moreContext:
AIEnhance.io makes photo editing feel more like giving instructions than pushing sliders. You describe what should change, such as a new background or a different expression, and the editor applies it using the model you choose. Offering several well-known image models side by side is a real plus, because each one handles certain edits better than others, and you can switch without leaving the site.

- Prompt editing runs on models such as Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream, FLUX and Ideogram
- Enhancement tools upscale up to four times, unblur and restore old photos
- Background, object and watermark removal and one-click effects do not consume credits
- Portrait tools change hairstyles and expressions or create profile pictures
- One-time credit packs do not expire, which suits occasional users

It is best for casual creators, online sellers and anyone fixing family photos who wants strong results without learning traditional editing software. A practical tip: run your free credit-free tools first, such as background removal, then save credits for prompt edits, and try the same instruction on two different models to see which one keeps faces and details most faithful.

name: Freebeat
tagline: Turn any song into a beat-synced AI music video on web, mobile or Mac
description: An AI music video generator that takes an uploaded track or a link from Spotify, YouTube, Suno and others and builds beat-synced story, performance, dance or lyric videos.
longDescription: Freebeat is an AI tool for turning songs into music videos. You upload an audio file or paste a link from services such as Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, Suno or Udio, then describe the look you want. The system analyzes beats, tempo, drops and song sections and builds a video that cuts and moves with the music, with lip sync and consistent characters. Modes include story videos, stage performances, dance clips and karaoke-style lyric videos, and an AI editor handles follow-up changes. Videos run from about 15 seconds to around six minutes in 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 formats. It runs in the browser and on iOS, Android and Mac.
features: Beat, BPM and drop synced visuals
Story, performance, dance and lyric modes
Imports from Spotify, YouTube, Suno and more
Apps for iOS, Android and Mac
pros: Visuals follow the structure of the song
Works with links instead of only uploads
cons: Free plan limited to essential features
Videos capped at roughly six minutes
moreContext:
Freebeat is built around the music first, which is what sets it apart from general video generators. It listens for beats, tempo changes, drops and song sections, then times cuts and motion to match, so the result feels edited to the track rather than simply placed on top of it. The company says it has served more than a million creators, and the range of formats suggests it has thought carefully about how musicians actually promote releases.

- Story Video and Stage Performance modes suit different kinds of releases
- Lyric videos highlight words in time with the vocals, karaoke style
- Tracks can come from uploads or links to Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, Suno, Udio and others
- Lip sync and consistent characters help longer videos hold together
- Apps for iOS, Android and Mac sit alongside the web version

It is best for independent artists, beatmakers and creators who need visuals for every release but lack a video budget. A practical tip: export a 9:16 cut of your chorus for short-form platforms alongside the full 16:9 video, since a strong 15 to 30 second clip is often what draws listeners to the complete song.

name: Noiz AI
tagline: AI voice studio for text to speech, voice cloning, voice design and music videos
description: A creator platform for expressive text to speech, voice cloning and voice design, with sound effects, AI music videos and APIs, plus a daily allowance of free credits.
longDescription: Noiz AI is a voice and audio creation platform for creators and teams. Its text-to-speech engine lets you control tone, pacing and emotion, and its voice cloning feature builds a voice from a short sample that can then speak in several languages. Voice Design creates new voices from a description, and a voice library offers ready-made options. Beyond speech, the platform generates sound effects and ambient audio, AI images and video, and music videos from songs and scripts. Noiz also co-developed YuE2, an open-weight song model, and offers developer APIs. Free accounts receive a daily credit allowance, with extra credits available to buy.
features: Emotion and pacing control for speech
Voice cloning from a short sample
Sound effects, music videos and APIs
pros: Speech, effects and video in one platform
cons: Plan details are hard to find on the site
No transcription or speech-to-text tools
moreContext:
Noiz AI is built for people who care about how a voice feels, not just what it says. Its speech engine gives you control over tone, pacing and emotion, so narration can sound calm, excited or dramatic depending on the scene. The ability to design a brand-new voice from a written description is a creative touch that goes beyond picking from a fixed list.

- Text to speech offers fine control over emotion, tone and pacing
- Voice cloning works from a short sample and can speak in multiple languages
- Voice Design generates original voices from a description
- Sound effects, ambient audio, AI video and music video tools sit alongside speech
- Developer APIs and the open-weight YuE2 song model, which Noiz co-developed, appeal to builders

It is best for video creators, podcasters, game makers and developers who need expressive voices and supporting audio without hiring voice talent for every project. A practical tip: the daily free credits reset each day, so use them to test a few emotion settings on a short paragraph before committing to a longer script, and only buy extra credits once you have found a voice and style that fits.

name: Perfect Corp.
tagline: AI and AR virtual try-on and skin analysis for beauty and fashion brands
description: Business software from the maker of YouCam that gives beauty, skincare, hair and fashion retailers AR virtual try-on, AI skin analysis and product recommendations online and in store.
longDescription: Perfect Corp. is a beauty and fashion technology company, known for its YouCam consumer apps, that sells AI and AR tools to brands and retailers. Its business solutions let shoppers virtually try on makeup, hair colors, eyewear, jewelry and other accessories through a camera, either on an e-commerce site or on in-store screens. AI skin analysis tools assess skin conditions in real time and pair the results with product recommendations, and a skincare assessment helps guide routines. An enterprise suite serves large brands, while an online plug-in is aimed at smaller e-commerce stores. Pricing is not published and is arranged directly with the company.
features: AR makeup, hair and accessory try-on
Enterprise suite and SMB e-commerce plug-in
pros: Covers beauty, skincare, hair and fashion
Works online and on in-store displays
Options for large brands and small shops
cons: No public pricing
Aimed at businesses, not individual shoppers
moreContext:
Perfect Corp. brings years of experience from its popular YouCam apps into tools that brands can put in front of their own customers. The core idea is simple and useful: let shoppers see how a lipstick shade, hair color, pair of glasses or piece of jewelry looks on them before they buy, whether they are browsing on a phone or standing in a store. Its skin analysis tools add a consultative layer, turning a quick camera scan into tailored product suggestions.

- Virtual try-on spans makeup, hair color, eyewear, jewelry, watches and other accessories
- AI skin analysis reports on skin conditions and links results to product recommendations
- Skincare assessment tools help shoppers build routines
- An enterprise suite serves global brands, while an online plug-in suits smaller e-commerce stores
- Case studies on its site describe deployments in brand stores and airport travel retail

It is best for beauty, skincare, eyewear and jewelry brands that want to bring the testing experience online or modernize their in-store counters. A practical tip: start with the one or two product categories where shoppers hesitate most over shade or fit, measure the effect on returns and conversions, and expand try-on coverage from there.

name: TikTok Symphony
tagline: TikTok for Business AI suite for generating, translating and scaling ad videos
description: TikTok's generative AI creative suite for advertisers, with a Creative Studio for video generation, avatars and dubbing, an agent that turns briefs into videos, automation and an API.
longDescription: TikTok Symphony is the generative AI creative suite inside TikTok for Business. Its Creative Studio helps marketers create ad videos by entering product details and assets or importing them from a URL, then generating, editing and exporting the results. Tools include image-to-video, avatar videos with digital presenters, and translation and dubbing into other languages. Symphony Agent turns a short brief into a video using insights from trends and top-performing ads, while Symphony Automation works inside Ads Manager to refresh creative at scale. An API connects the suite to a brand's own tools. Creative Studio is available to logged-in TikTok for Business users, and its videos carry an AI-generated label.
features: Creative Studio for ad video generation
Avatar videos and translation with dubbing
Symphony Agent from brief to video
Ads Manager automation and API access
pros: Built into TikTok's own ad tools
Draws on TikTok trend and ad insights
cons: Requires a TikTok for Business account
Mainly useful for TikTok campaigns
moreContext:
TikTok Symphony comes straight from the platform where the ads will run, which gives it a natural advantage: it is shaped around what works on TikTok. Symphony Agent draws on trends, top-performing ads and your brand goals to turn a short brief into a video, and the rest of the suite helps you adapt, translate and refresh that creative without starting over each time.

- Creative Studio generates and edits ad videos from product details, assets or a URL
- Avatar videos use digital presenters for voiceovers and product demos
- Translation and dubbing adapt existing videos for other markets
- Symphony Automation in Ads Manager helps counter creative fatigue at scale
- An API lets brands with their own tech stack connect directly

It is best for brands, agencies and small businesses that already advertise on TikTok, or plan to, and need a steady flow of fresh, native-looking videos. A practical tip: use the translation and dubbing tools on an ad that is already performing well in one market before generating new concepts, since localizing a proven video is often the quickest way to test a new region. Ad spend itself is billed separately through Ads Manager.

name: SuperNinja
tagline: Autonomous AI agent from NinjaTech AI that runs long tasks on its own cloud computer
description: An AI agent platform that takes a goal and works on it for hours or days in its own cloud workspace, connecting to thousands of apps and asking approval before irreversible actions.
longDescription: SuperNinja is an autonomous AI agent platform from NinjaTech AI, the company behind the Ninja AI assistant. Instead of answering single prompts, it accepts a goal and works toward it on a dedicated cloud computer, running for hours, days or weeks if needed. It can write code, research topics, draft content and analyze uploaded files, and it connects to more than 3,000 tools such as Gmail, Google Drive, HubSpot, GitHub and Stripe. Users can direct it from Slack, Microsoft Teams or WhatsApp, and it asks for approval before taking actions that cannot be undone. It works with models including Claude, GPT and Gemini, and an enterprise edition can run in a company's own cloud.
features: Long-running tasks on a cloud computer
Control from Slack, Teams and WhatsApp
pros: Works with several leading AI models
cons: Free plan runs one task at a time with limited credits
Autonomous runs need careful goal setting
moreContext:
SuperNinja reflects a shift from chatting with AI to delegating to it. You give it a goal rather than a single prompt, and it keeps working on a cloud computer of its own, checking in through the messaging apps your team already uses. The approval step before any action it cannot undo is a reassuring safeguard that makes handing over real work feel more comfortable.

- Tasks can run for hours, days or weeks without someone watching
- More than 3,000 integrations include Gmail, Google Drive, HubSpot, GitHub and Stripe
- Teams can direct it from Slack, Microsoft Teams or WhatsApp
- It can write code, run deep research, draft content and analyze files
- An enterprise edition deploys in a company's own cloud or on premises, with SSO and audit trails

It is best for operators, founders and small teams who have repetitive, multi-step work across many apps, from research reports to sales and support workflows. A practical tip: start with a well-defined goal that has a clear finish line and a short list of connected apps, review the first few runs closely, and widen its permissions only once the results match what you expected.

name: Fiscal.ai
tagline: AI-powered stock research terminal and financial data API, formerly FinChat
description: Formerly FinChat, Fiscal.ai combines an AI research terminal for investors with an API offering standardized financials, KPIs, estimates, transcripts and ownership data on global companies.
longDescription: Fiscal.ai, previously known as FinChat, is a financial data and research platform for investors and institutions. Its research terminal pairs an AI assistant with company financials, so users can ask questions about a business and get answers grounded in its filings, earnings calls and key metrics. For builders, the Fiscal.ai API delivers standardized and as-reported financial statements with long histories, segment and KPI data for thousands of large companies, stock prices, dividends, earnings events and transcripts, investor fund letters, insider and institutional ownership, and both its own and Street consensus estimates. Data can be traced back to the original filings, and coverage spans the US, Canada, the UK and Europe.
features: AI assistant grounded in company filings
Financial data API with free trial
pros: Answers trace back to source filings
cons: Some datasets are limited to US companies
Advanced data and API access cost extra
moreContext:
Fiscal.ai, the platform once known as FinChat, focuses on a detail that serious investors care about: knowing where every number comes from. Its data can be linked back to the original filing, and its AI assistant works from company reports and earnings calls rather than general web text, which makes answers easier to check. Pairing that research terminal with a developer API means the same data serves both individual analysts and teams building their own tools.

- Standardized and as-reported financials include long annual and quarterly histories
- Segment and KPI data covers the largest companies around the world
- Earnings transcripts, IR events and parsed investor fund letters add qualitative context
- Ownership data tracks insider and institutional holdings for US-listed companies
- Its own Agentic Consensus estimates sit alongside third-party Street consensus

It is best for self-directed investors, analysts and fintech developers who want company fundamentals and AI-assisted research in one place. A practical tip: when the assistant gives you a figure, open the linked source filing to confirm the context, especially for adjusted metrics, since companies often define non-standard KPIs in their own way.

name: ROAST
tagline: AI dating profile reviews and generated dating photos for Tinder, Bumble and Hinge
description: ROAST reviews your dating app photos, bio and prompts with AI plus expert input, then hands back a prioritized list of fixes and optional AI-generated dating photos.
longDescription: ROAST is a dating profile coaching service built for people using apps like Tinder, Bumble and Hinge. You upload your current photos, bio and prompt answers, and the service combines AI analysis with input from human dating experts to produce a ranked list of changes to make. Alongside the review, ROAST can generate new AI dating photos in a range of settings and styles, and it offers help with bio writing and conversation coaching. It is aimed at people who feel their profile underrepresents them, who match with the wrong people, or who are returning to dating apps after a break and want an outside opinion.
features: Dating profile review with prioritized fixes
pros: Focused specifically on dating app profiles
Pairs AI analysis with human expert input
Covers photos, bio and prompts together
cons: Subscription pricing with no free plan
Advice quality depends on what you upload
moreContext:
Getting honest feedback on a dating profile is surprisingly hard, since friends tend to be polite and strangers on the apps say nothing at all. ROAST fills that gap by looking at the whole profile at once, from the first photo to the last prompt answer, and turning its findings into a ranked to-do list. The mix of automated analysis and human dating experts is what sets it apart from simply asking a chatbot for tips.

- Reviews photos, bio and prompts together instead of judging a single picture
- Returns a prioritized list of fixes, so you know what to change first
- Generates new AI dating photos in different settings and styles
- Offers help with bio writing and conversation coaching
- The company says it has optimized hundreds of thousands of profiles since launching

ROAST is best for people who are active on Tinder, Bumble or Hinge but feel their matches do not reflect who they are, and for anyone returning to the apps after a long break. A practical tip: upload your full current profile, including weaker photos you are unsure about, because the review is most useful when it can compare your options and tell you which ones to drop.

name: DialNexa
tagline: Voice AI agents that run sales, collections and support calls in 70+ languages
description: DialNexa lets businesses deploy AI voice agents for inbound and outbound phone calls, covering lead qualification, payment reminders, support and campaigns, with strong Indian language support.
longDescription: DialNexa is a voice AI platform for building phone agents that handle business calls at volume. Teams use it for sales outreach and lead qualification, meeting booking, collections and payment reminders, customer support, feedback calls and status updates, with handoff to a human when needed. The company says its agents respond in under 300 milliseconds and speak more than 70 languages, including Indian languages and Hinglish. Agents connect to CRMs, calendars, helpdesks, WhatsApp, APIs and webhooks, and the platform reports campaign analytics, transcripts and conversion tracking. Pricing is per minute, with pay as you go, committed and enterprise volume tiers.
features: Inbound and outbound AI voice agents
pros: Covers sales, collections and support use cases
Pay as you go option with no minimum
cons: Pricing is per minute in Indian rupees
No free trial mentioned on the site
moreContext:
Phone calls remain the main channel for many businesses, especially in markets where customers prefer speaking to typing. DialNexa is built around that reality, offering voice agents that can make and take calls across sales, collections and support. Its focus on Indian languages and Hinglish is a real point of difference, since many voice AI platforms are tuned mainly for English.

- Handles both inbound calls and high-concurrency outbound campaigns
- The company says agents respond in under 300 milliseconds and support more than 70 languages
- Covers specific workflows such as promise-to-pay capture, lead qualification and meeting booking
- Connects to CRMs, calendars, helpdesks, WhatsApp, APIs and webhooks
- Provides transcripts, analytics and conversion tracking for each campaign

DialNexa is best for sales, collections, operations and customer experience teams, particularly in India, that handle large call volumes and want to reduce manual dialing. The pay as you go plan has no minimum commitment, which makes it easier to test. A practical tip: start with one narrow call type, such as payment reminders, review the transcripts closely, and tune the script before expanding to more complex conversations.

name: Magik Face
tagline: Train a personal face model and turn your photos into styled portraits and videos
description: Magik Face trains a custom AI model on your photos, then generates consistent portraits in styles like anime, fantasy and watercolor, plus short animated videos, using pay as you go credits.
longDescription: Magik Face is a web app for creating AI portraits of yourself or a consistent character. You upload a set of photos, the service trains a personal face model in a couple of minutes, and you can then generate images in a wide range of styles such as anime, fantasy, cyberpunk and watercolor. It also produces short videos with expressive animation from your images. No coding or prompt engineering is needed. Instead of subscriptions, Magik Face sells one-time credit bundles called Rubies, so users pay only for what they generate. It suits people making profile pictures, social posts or recurring characters.
features: Personal face model training in minutes
Portrait styles from anime to watercolor
Pay as you go credit bundles
pros: Keeps a character consistent across images
Simple flow with no prompting skills needed
cons: No permanent free plan
Results depend on the quality of uploaded photos
moreContext:
Many AI image tools struggle to keep the same face recognizable from one picture to the next. Magik Face tackles that by training a small personal model on your own photos first, so every portrait it produces afterward stays recognizably you, or recognizably your character. The credit-based pricing also appeals to people who only want a batch of images now and then rather than another monthly bill.

- Trains a custom face model quickly from your uploaded photos
- Offers a broad style range, including anime, fantasy, cyberpunk and watercolor
- Generates short animated videos in addition to still images
- Uses one-time Ruby credit bundles instead of subscriptions
- Requires no coding or detailed prompt writing

Magik Face is best for casual creators who want fresh profile pictures, themed portraits for social media or a consistent recurring character for a story or channel. A practical tip: upload a varied set of clear, well-lit photos with different angles and expressions, since a more varied training set usually gives the face model more to work with and produces more convincing results across styles.

name: Resume Worded
tagline: Instant AI feedback on resumes and LinkedIn profiles, scored against recruiter checks
description: Resume Worded scores your resume and LinkedIn profile against common recruiter screening checks, suggests line-by-line fixes, and compares your resume with specific job descriptions.
longDescription: Resume Worded is an AI career platform that reviews resumes and LinkedIn profiles. Its free Score My Resume tool grades a resume out of 100 and gives line-by-line feedback on issues recruiters and applicant tracking systems tend to flag. Paid features include AutoFix, which drafts rewrites of weak bullet points from your own experience for you to approve, and Smart Target, which compares a resume with a job description and shows matched and missing keywords. It also offers LinkedIn profile reviews, a cover letter writer, resume bullet samples and ATS-friendly templates. It serves job seekers, students and career services teams at universities and bootcamps.
cons: Monthly Pro billing is relatively expensive
Most rewriting tools sit behind the paid plan
moreContext:
Job seekers often send out dozens of applications without knowing why their resume is not getting callbacks. Resume Worded answers that question directly by grading a resume against the kinds of checks recruiters and screening software apply, then pointing to the exact lines that need work. It has been around since 2017, and the company says millions of job seekers have used it.

- Free Score My Resume review with a score out of 100 and detailed notes
- AutoFix drafts stronger bullet points from your own experience, and you approve each change
- Smart Target compares your resume with a job post and lists matched and missing keywords
- LinkedIn profile review covers the other half of most job searches
- Includes cover letter help, sample bullet points and ATS-friendly templates

Resume Worded is best for active job seekers, recent graduates and career changers who want concrete feedback rather than generic advice, and for career centers supporting many students. A practical tip: run the free score first and fix the obvious issues yourself, then use Smart Target with the specific job you want most, so you tailor your strongest application instead of polishing a generic version.

name: Visme
tagline: Create branded presentations, reports, infographics and more with AI design help
description: Visme is a browser-based design platform for presentations, documents, infographics, charts, social graphics and videos, with AI tools that generate drafts and keep work on brand.
longDescription: Visme is a web-based visual content platform aimed at business teams and non-designers. Users create presentations, reports, proposals, infographics, charts and data visualizations, social graphics, videos, forms and whiteboards from templates or from scratch in a drag-and-drop editor. Its AI Designer builds a first draft from a text prompt, and Brand Wizard pulls colors and fonts from a website URL to create on-brand designs. Other AI tools write text, generate images, resize layouts and edit photos. Teams can comment, collaborate in real time, store brand assets centrally and share or download finished work. A free plan covers basic use, with paid tiers adding assets and export formats.
features: Brand Wizard from a website URL
pros: Covers many content types in one editor
cons: AI credits are limited on lower tiers
Free plan restricts templates and export formats
moreContext:
Most teams need more than slides: they need reports, one-pagers, infographics and charts that all look like they came from the same company. Visme brings those formats into a single editor and adds AI tools that speed up the first draft. Its long-standing strength in data visualization makes it especially handy when a document needs to explain numbers clearly.

- Handles presentations, documents, infographics, social graphics, videos and forms in one place
- AI Designer produces a ready-to-edit design from a short text prompt
- Brand Wizard reads a website URL and applies its colors and fonts to new designs
- Built-in charts, maps and data widgets for visual reporting
- The company says tens of millions of creators and companies use the platform

Visme is best for marketing, sales and internal communications teams that produce a steady stream of branded material without a dedicated designer. The free plan is a good way to test the editor, though it limits templates and download formats. A practical tip: set up your brand kit or run Brand Wizard before creating anything else, so every template you open afterward starts with the right colors and fonts.

name: MiniMax Music 3.0
tagline: Open-weights music model from MiniMax that generates full songs with vocals
description: MiniMax Music 3.0 turns a song description and optional lyrics into a complete track of up to five minutes with vocals and arrangement, and its weights are available to self-host.
longDescription: MiniMax Music 3.0 is a text-to-music model from Chinese AI company MiniMax. Given a description of the style and optional lyrics, it generates a complete song in one pass, handling composition, arrangement, singing and production, for tracks up to about five minutes. Lyrics can include section tags such as verse, chorus and bridge, and a structured caption can set genre, tempo, key and vocal details. MiniMax released the weights and inference code in August 2026 on Hugging Face and GitHub under its own community license, with support in ComfyUI and Diffusers. It requires a CUDA GPU to run locally, and MiniMax points new users toward self-hosting rather than its hosted music API.
features: Full songs up to about five minutes
Section tags for verse, chorus and bridge
Control over genre, tempo and key
Runs locally via ComfyUI or Diffusers
pros: Open weights you can run on your own hardware
cons: Needs a capable CUDA GPU and technical setup
Custom community license to check before commercial use
moreContext:
Most capable song generators live behind a subscription and a web interface. MiniMax Music 3.0 stands out because MiniMax published the model weights, so developers and hobbyists with the right hardware can generate full songs with vocals on their own machines. It aims at complete, structured tracks rather than short loops, which makes it interesting for anyone exploring AI-assisted songwriting.

- Produces complete songs of up to about five minutes in a single generation
- Lyrics accept section tags, so verses, choruses and bridges land where you want them
- Structured captions can specify genre, tempo, key, vocal style and arrangement
- Weights and inference code are published on Hugging Face and GitHub
- Works with ComfyUI and Diffusers, and MiniMax documents a self-hosting path

MiniMax Music 3.0 is best for developers, researchers and technically comfortable musicians who want to experiment with AI music locally or build it into their own tools. MiniMax says the hosted music API is closed to new users, so self-hosting is the main route. A practical tip: read the community license before using output commercially, and start with short lyrics and a detailed style caption to learn how the model responds.

name: Free AI Image Generator
tagline: Generate and edit images from text prompts in the browser with no sign-up
description: Free AI Image Generator creates pictures from text prompts and edits uploaded photos in the browser, with a free model that needs no account plus extra tools like upscaling and background removal.
longDescription: Free AI Image Generator is a browser tool at freeaiimage.io for making images from written prompts and changing existing photos by describing the edit. Its basic model can be used without signing up, and results download directly. You can choose aspect ratios such as square, portrait, landscape and vertical video format. The site also bundles related utilities, including a background remover, upscaler, object remover, image extender, resizer and enhancer. Stronger models are available after signing in and use credits, which the site sells as one-time packs and monthly plans. It suits anyone who needs a quick image without installing software or creating an account.
pros: Basic generation works without an account
Several editing utilities in one site
cons: Free generation has usage limits
Underlying models and paid prices are not clearly listed
moreContext:
Sometimes you just need one image right now, without creating yet another account. Free AI Image Generator is built for exactly that moment: type a prompt, pick a shape and download the result. Bundling a set of everyday editing utilities next to the generator makes it a handy quick-stop tool rather than a full creative suite.

- Basic text-to-image generation works without signing up or logging in
- Upload a photo and describe the change you want for image-to-image edits
- Aspect ratio presets cover square, portrait, landscape and vertical formats
- Extra tools include a background remover, upscaler, object remover and image extender
- Signed-in users can access stronger models through credits

Free AI Image Generator is best for students, bloggers and small businesses who need occasional visuals for posts, slides or mockups and do not want to learn a complex tool. Because the free model has limits and the site does not detail which models power it, it works better for quick drafts than for polished brand work. A practical tip: keep prompts short and concrete, naming the subject, setting and style, and generate a few variations before choosing one to edit further.

name: Elyum
tagline: One studio for top video, image, audio and 3D models where you pay only for keepers
description: Elyum gathers leading AI video, image, audio and 3D models behind one credit balance, charges only for the takes you keep, and adds an agent, character tools and an MCP connection.
longDescription: Elyum is an AI creative studio that brings many generation models into one workspace, including video models such as Seedance, Kling and Veo alongside image, audio, music and 3D models. Everything draws from a single credit balance, and its pricing model means takes you discard are not billed, while kept takes come as full-quality files without watermarks for commercial use. The Elyum Agent can take a brief and handle generation and marketing tasks. Other tools build consistent presenters from photos, clone the pacing of a reference clip, and add captions, lipsync and avatars. It also connects to assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor through MCP.
features: Multiple video, image, audio and 3D models
pros: Many top models under one credit balance
Discarded takes do not cost credits
cons: Free plan generation is currently paused
Credit costs vary by model and length
moreContext:
Anyone who has used AI video tools knows that most generations miss, and paying for every failed attempt adds up fast. Elyum's central idea is that you are billed only for the takes you decide to keep. Combined with access to many leading models from one account, that makes experimenting less costly and comparing models much easier.

- Brings video models like Seedance, Kling and Veo together with image, audio, music and 3D models
- Charges only for kept takes, which then download without watermarks for commercial use
- Characters feature builds a consistent presenter from one or more photos
- Clone reuses the motion and pacing of a reference clip with your own product or presenter
- Connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other assistants through MCP

Elyum is best for advertisers, ecommerce sellers, content creators and small studios that produce lots of short video and want to try several models without juggling subscriptions. Note that the free plan's generation is paused for now, so testing starts on a paid tier. A practical tip: run the same prompt across two or three models first, keep only the strongest take, and use that model as your default for similar projects.

name: GnorixX
tagline: YouTube keyword research, video ideas and title packaging for creators
description: GnorixX helps YouTube creators research keywords, find video angles, plan recordings and package titles, descriptions and tags, with free keyword tools and credit-based AI features.
longDescription: GnorixX is a research and planning suite for YouTube creators. Its Keyword Explorer surfaces live autocomplete queries, viewer questions and long-tail topics, and a Title Scorer simulates how titles truncate on mobile and checks them against a quality checklist. AI-powered tools then suggest three video angles with reasoning, build a recording blueprint with a mobile-friendly title, opening hook and outline, and package a video with title options, a YouTube Studio description with chapters, tags and thumbnail ideas. Script tools help with short-form content too. It does not ask for YouTube account access or a browser extension. Keyword and title tools are free, while AI generations use credits.
features: Recording blueprint with hook and outline
pros: Keyword and title tools are free and unlimited
Covers planning from idea to upload
cons: Credit prices are not clearly published
Focused only on YouTube and short-form video
moreContext:
Many YouTube videos struggle not because of the content but because of the idea, title or opening seconds. GnorixX concentrates on the work that happens before you hit record and before you publish, helping creators pick topics people actually search for and package them so they read well on a phone screen. Its free keyword and title tools make it easy to try.

- Keyword Explorer shows live YouTube autocomplete queries, viewer questions and long-tail topics
- Video Opportunity Finder suggests three angles with reasons for each
- Video Blueprint drafts a mobile-safe title, an opening hook and a recording outline
- Packaging tool writes title options, a description with chapters, tags and thumbnail concepts
- Works without YouTube permissions or a browser extension

GnorixX is best for long-form YouTube creators and short-form creators on Shorts and Reels who want a structured way to plan videos and improve click appeal. Keyword exploration and title scoring are free, and the AI planning tools cost one credit each. A practical tip: research a topic in Keyword Explorer first, then feed the strongest query into the Blueprint tool so your title, hook and outline all target the same search intent.

name: Corvexa
tagline: AI website chatbot that qualifies B2B visitors and captures leads around the clock
description: Corvexa adds an AI sales chatbot to B2B websites that starts conversations, detects visitor intent, asks qualifying questions, scores leads and hands warm prospects to your sales team.
longDescription: Corvexa is an AI lead generation chatbot for B2B websites. Installed with a single script tag, it opens conversations proactively, offers quick-action buttons, detects what a visitor is looking for and asks qualifying questions, all without traditional forms. Leads are scored automatically and delivered by email, Slack or CRM, and higher plans add HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, Calendly and Google Calendar booking, human takeover of chats and returning visitor recognition. A knowledge base built from your own sources keeps answers relevant. It is aimed at SaaS, fintech, logistics, legal tech and professional services firms that rely on inbound website interest.
pros: Hands off to humans with full context
Free trial with no card required
cons: CRM integrations start on the Pro plan
Conversation caps on lower tiers
moreContext:
Most B2B websites get visitors who are curious but not yet ready to fill in a contact form, and many of them leave without a trace. Corvexa is designed for that gap, greeting visitors with a conversation instead of a form and working out whether they are worth a sales follow-up. Its focus on qualification and scoring, rather than general support, makes it a sales tool first.

- Starts conversations proactively with quick-action buttons for common intents
- Detects visitor intent and asks built-in qualifying questions
- Scores leads automatically and sends them by email, Slack or CRM
- Lets your team take over a chat with the full conversation history in view
- Installs with one script tag, and the company says setup can go live within 48 hours of onboarding

Corvexa is best for B2B companies such as SaaS, fintech and professional services firms that get steady website traffic but convert too little of it. The Starter plan covers lead capture basics, while booking and CRM sync sit on Pro. A practical tip: load your pricing page, case studies and FAQs into the knowledge base before launch so the bot can answer the detailed questions serious buyers tend to ask.

name: Notta
tagline: AI meeting notetaker that transcribes, summarizes and translates in 58 languages
description: Notta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and lectures in 58 languages, then produces AI summaries, action items and follow-ups, with a meeting bot or bot-free recording.
longDescription: Notta is an AI notetaker that turns spoken conversations into searchable transcripts and notes. It can join Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Webex calls as a bot, record on your device without a bot, or transcribe uploaded audio, video and YouTube links. Transcription covers 58 languages, with real-time translation and bilingual transcription available as add-ons. AI Notes generate summaries and action items, and Notta Brain answers questions across all your meetings and drafts follow-up emails, slides and documents. It runs on web, iOS, Android, Mac, Windows and Chrome, and integrates with Slack, Notion, Salesforce, HubSpot and calendars. A free plan includes 120 minutes monthly.
features: Ask questions across meetings with Notta Brain
pros: Available on web, mobile and desktop
cons: Free plan caps conversations at 3 minutes
Translation features cost extra
moreContext:
Notta covers the full path from a spoken conversation to something you can act on: capture, transcript, summary and follow-up. Its broad language support and choice between a meeting bot and bot-free recording make it flexible for international teams and for situations where a visible bot would feel awkward. It also reaches beyond online calls to uploaded files, YouTube links and in-person meetings.

- Transcribes in 58 languages, with real-time and bilingual translation available as add-ons
- Joins Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and Webex, or records locally without a bot
- AI Notes produce summaries and action items after each conversation
- Notta Brain searches across meetings and drafts emails, slides and documents
- The company states SOC 2 Type II certification and GDPR compliance

Notta is best for professionals, researchers, students and multilingual teams who spend much of the week in meetings, interviews or lectures. The free plan is useful for testing, though its three minute limit per conversation makes paid plans necessary for regular use. A practical tip: connect your calendar so the bot joins scheduled calls automatically, and review the action items right after each meeting while the context is still fresh.

name: AIProductAds
tagline: Turn one product photo into video ads and studio-style product images
description: AIProductAds creates short video ads with voiceover and studio product shots from a single product photo or a text prompt, using models like Veo, Kling and Seedance, sized for every major ad placement.
longDescription: AIProductAds is an ad creative generator for ecommerce. You upload a product photo, or describe a product in text, and it produces short video ads with synced audio and voiceover along with clean studio-style product images for listings and static ads. Videos run up to 15 seconds at up to 2K resolution in 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 formats, covering Reels, TikTok, feeds and YouTube. Under the hood it lets you choose from multiple generation models, including Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Seedream, GPT Image and Nano Banana. Pricing uses monthly credit subscriptions or one-time packs, with cost based on clip length and resolution.
features: Choice of multiple AI video models
pros: Starts from a single product photo
Exports in all common ad aspect ratios
cons: No permanent free plan
Clips are limited to 15 seconds
moreContext:
Producing fresh ad creative is a constant chore for online sellers, since platforms reward frequent new variations. AIProductAds shortens that cycle by turning the product photos you already have into short video ads and polished product shots. Letting you pick between several leading generation models is a practical touch, because different models suit different products and styles.

- Builds video ads from a product photo or a text prompt, with voiceover and synced audio
- Generates studio-style product images for listings and static ads
- Outputs up to 2K resolution in 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 formats
- Offers models including Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Seedream, GPT Image and Nano Banana
- Sells monthly credit plans as well as one-time packs that do not expire

AIProductAds is best for Amazon and Shopify sellers, DTC founders, performance marketers and agencies that need many ad variations without booking shoots. Credit costs rise with resolution, so drafts are cheapest at lower settings. A practical tip: generate several short low-resolution versions first to test hooks and angles, then render only the winning concept at full resolution for your live campaigns.

name: MomentSift
tagline: AI photo culling in the browser that groups shots and flags likely rejects
description: MomentSift sorts large photo batches in the browser, grouping similar shots and flagging blur, closed eyes and exposure problems, then lets you enhance, upscale and export your final picks.
longDescription: MomentSift is a browser-based photo culling tool. You import a folder and its AI groups similar shots by scene, flags likely rejects such as blurry frames, closed eyes and poor exposure, and gives each image a score, while you make the final choices and nothing is deleted automatically. Side-by-side comparison, keyboard shortcuts and undo speed up reviews. After culling, you can upscale images four times, restore faces, retouch portraits, and create new images from text or reference photos. It reads JPG, PNG, HEIC and many RAW formats, and exports to a ZIP or local folder with Lightroom XMP ratings. No installation is needed.
features: Automatic flagging of blur and closed eyes
pros: Runs in the browser with no install
You keep final control over every pick
cons: Free plan downloads are watermarked
Large RAW batches work best on desktop Chrome or Edge
moreContext:
After a wedding, a trip or a busy weekend, the hardest part of photography is often choosing which hundreds of shots to keep. MomentSift takes on that sorting work by grouping near-duplicates and flagging obvious misses, so you spend your time choosing between good frames instead of hunting for blur. Because nothing is deleted automatically, the AI stays an assistant rather than the final judge.

- Groups similar photos by scene so you compare like with like
- Flags blur, closed eyes and exposure issues, with a score for each frame
- Offers side-by-side comparison, keyboard shortcuts and undo for fast reviews
- Adds 4x upscaling, face restoration, portrait retouching and image generation
- Exports to ZIP or a local folder with Lightroom XMP ratings and reads many RAW formats

MomentSift is best for event and wedding photographers, travelers, parents and content creators who regularly come home with far more photos than they can review by hand. The free tier lets you cull 100 photos to test the workflow. A practical tip: run culling first on a full shoot, then use the Lightroom XMP export so your picks and ratings carry straight into your usual editing setup.

name: PhotoFig
tagline: Product photo studio for sellers with AI cutouts, backgrounds and shadows
description: PhotoFig helps online sellers clean up product photos at catalog scale, combining background removal, AI scenes, shadows and upscaling with batch workflows and a WooCommerce integration.
longDescription: PhotoFig is a browser-based product photo editor built for e-commerce sellers who need consistent images across a whole catalog. It removes backgrounds automatically and offers a manual brush to refine masks, then adds AI-generated backgrounds, realistic product shadows, a magic eraser for unwanted marks, and upscaling up to four times the original size. Batch workflows and a catalog resize tool apply the same treatment to many images at once, and a layered canvas editor handles final adjustments. Store owners on WooCommerce can push edited photos back to their shop after reviewing them, and higher plans add a REST API. A free plan covers a monthly allowance of cutouts and AI credits.
features: Automatic background removal with manual mask brush
pros: Free plan with monthly cutouts and AI credits
Built around catalog consistency rather than single edits
Review step before images go live in the store
cons: Store integration currently centers on WooCommerce
API access requires the Pro or Studio plan
moreContext:
Plenty of editors can cut out a single product, but PhotoFig is organized around the harder job of keeping hundreds of listings looking like they belong to the same shop. Its tools for cutouts, scenes, shadows and sizing are designed to run across a catalog, and the WooCommerce connection closes the loop by sending finished images back to the store after you approve them. The team says the product is made in Switzerland.

- Background removal pairs automatic masks with a manual brush, so tricky edges such as glass or hair can be corrected by hand.
- AI backgrounds and generated shadows give flat cutouts a grounded, studio-like look without a photo shoot.
- Magic Eraser and 4x AI upscaling help rescue older supplier photos with logos, marks or low resolution.
- Batch workflows and Catalog Resize apply one set of steps to many images, which keeps margins and aspect ratios consistent.
- A REST API on the Pro and Studio plans lets larger sellers wire the editor into their own pipelines.

PhotoFig is a strong fit for independent WooCommerce merchants and small marketplace sellers who manage a growing catalog without an in-house photo team. A practical tip: build one batch workflow from a handful of your best existing photos first, then run the rest of the catalog through it so every listing inherits the same background, shadow and crop settings.

name: Quizbot
tagline: AI quiz and question generator for teachers, trainers and students
description: Quizbot turns documents, links, videos, images, audio or a simple topic into quizzes with ten question types, then exports them to Word, PDF or LMS platforms like Moodle and Canvas.
longDescription: Quizbot is an AI question generator aimed at teachers, corporate trainers and students. You upload a source such as a PDF, Word file, slide deck, web link, video, image, audio clip or past exam, or simply type a topic, and it drafts questions in up to ten formats including multiple choice, true or false, fill in the blank and ordering. Quizzes can be edited and exported to Word, PDF, HTML or plain text, or sent to learning platforms such as Moodle, Canvas and Google Classroom. A set of student tools adds flashcards, self-quizzing, exam prep and an AI tutor. A free plan includes a monthly question allowance, with paid tiers and one-time question packs for heavier use.
features: Quizzes from files, links, video, audio or a topic
Ten question types including ordering and fill in the blank
Export to Word, PDF and LMS platforms
Student flashcards, exam prep and AI tutor
pros: Accepts a wide range of source formats
Direct export to Moodle, Canvas and Google Classroom
cons: Free tier is capped at a small number of questions per month
Generated questions still need a teacher's review for accuracy
moreContext:
Writing good assessment questions takes time, and Quizbot focuses squarely on that one task. Instead of a general chat window, it gives educators a structured way to feed in course material and get back editable quizzes in the format their classroom or learning platform already uses. The breadth of accepted inputs is the standout, since lecture recordings, slide decks and even old tests can all become fresh question banks.

- Source material can come from PDFs, Word and PowerPoint files, web links, videos, images, audio or a typed topic.
- Ten question types cover common needs, from multiple choice and true or false to fill in the blank and ordering.
- Exports to Word, PDF, HTML and text sit alongside LMS options such as Moodle, Canvas and Google Classroom.
- A separate student side offers flashcards, self-quizzing, exam preparation and an AI tutor for revision.
- Flexible pricing mixes monthly plans, yearly plans and one-time question packs, which suits seasonal teaching loads.

Quizbot is best for teachers, tutors and training teams who build frequent quizzes from existing material and want them ready for an LMS. A practical tip: generate more questions than you need from a single source, then keep the strongest ones and discard the rest, since curating a larger draft is faster than rewriting weak questions.

name: Voq
tagline: Chrome extension that reads web pages and AI chats aloud in a natural voice
description: Voq is a lightweight Chrome extension that reads articles, forum threads and AI chatbot replies aloud with a natural AI voice and word highlighting, free each day with no account needed.
longDescription: Voq is a text-to-speech browser extension for Chrome that turns web pages into audio. After installing it, you can have an article read from start to finish, jump to a specific section through a structured reading panel, or select any passage and play it with one click. Words are highlighted as they are spoken, which helps readers follow along. The extension handles dozens of languages and works on AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, as well as forums like Reddit and Hacker News. No sign-up is required. Listening is free within a daily budget, and an inexpensive subscription removes the daily cap while keeping the same voice.
features: Reads full pages or selected text aloud
Section jumping through a reading panel
Works on AI chatbots and forums
pros: No account, email or password needed
Very low price to remove the daily limit
Same voice quality on free and paid tiers
cons: Chrome only
Free daily listening budget is not clearly specified
moreContext:
Voq keeps text-to-speech refreshingly simple. There is no account to create and no dashboard to learn: you install the extension, open a page, and press play. What makes it especially handy today is its attention to AI chat interfaces, so long answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity can be heard instead of skimmed.

- Natural AI voice is the same on the free and paid tiers, so paying only removes the daily listening cap.
- Word-by-word highlighting helps with focus and makes it easier to follow dense technical text.
- A structured reading panel lets you skip straight to the section you care about instead of listening from the top.
- One-click playback of selected text works well for quick checks on forums like Reddit, Hacker News or Stack Overflow.
- Dozens of languages are supported for readers who browse in more than one language.

Voq suits students, researchers and anyone who reads a lot in the browser and wants to rest their eyes or listen while multitasking. A practical tip: the company says early subscribers keep their founding rate as long as they stay subscribed, so if you already rely on it daily, locking in the lower price early is worth considering.

name: SlidesAI
tagline: Turn text, notes or documents into editable decks for Google Slides and PowerPoint
description: SlidesAI generates structured, designed presentations from a topic, notes, a script or an uploaded document, working alongside Google Slides and PowerPoint with brand kits and slide-level AI edits.
longDescription: SlidesAI is an AI presentation maker that converts written material into slide decks. You start from a topic, rough notes, a script or an uploaded PDF or Word document, choose a theme, and it produces a structured presentation with layouts and optional AI images. Individual slides can then be rephrased, shortened, translated or regenerated. The tool works with Google Slides, where it is available as a Workspace add-on, and with PowerPoint, and brand kits let teams import their own PPTX templates and fonts. It was founded by Anurag Bhagsain in January 2023. A free plan provides monthly AI credits for shorter inputs, while paid plans raise input length, credits and model access.
features: Decks from topics, notes, scripts or documents
Brand kits with custom PPTX templates and fonts
Works with Google Slides and PowerPoint
pros: Output stays editable in familiar slide tools
Free plan with monthly AI credits
