cons: Free plan limits input length per presentation
Paid plan pricing is presented mainly as yearly billing
moreContext:
Many AI deck builders ask you to move into a new editor, but SlidesAI is designed around the slide tools people already use at work and school. Its output lands as real, editable slides, which matters when a presentation needs to be shared with colleagues, handed in for a class, or matched to a company template.

- Flexible starting points cover a short topic, a pasted script, meeting notes, or an uploaded PDF or Word file.
- After generation, slides can be rephrased, shortened, translated or regenerated one at a time rather than redoing the whole deck.
- Brand kits import an existing PPTX template and custom fonts so generated decks follow house style.
- Integration with Google Slides through the Workspace Marketplace and support for PowerPoint keep the result inside familiar software.
- Tiered AI models let heavier users pick more capable models for complex material on higher plans.

SlidesAI is a good match for teachers, students and business users who write first and design second, and who need decks that remain easy to edit afterward. A practical tip: paste structured notes with clear headings rather than a single block of prose, since well-separated sections give the generator a cleaner outline to turn into individual slides.

name: Loclay
tagline: Google Maps lead finder that enriches local businesses with AI-sourced contacts
description: Loclay pulls local businesses from Google Maps by category and city, then uses AI to read each company's website for emails, phone numbers, social profiles and named decision makers.
longDescription: Loclay is a lead generation tool for agencies and sales teams that sell to local businesses. You choose a business type, a country and up to 25 cities, and it runs a live search of Google Maps listings to collect names, phone numbers, websites and ratings. An AI step then visits each business's public website, reading the homepage and a few contact, about or team pages, to extract emails, extra phone numbers, social profiles and sometimes a decision maker's name. Each enriched contact is labeled with the page it came from, so you can check the source. Leads can be saved to lists and exported to CSV on paid plans, with a one-time free allowance to try it.
features: Multi-city Google Maps searches in one run
AI website reading for emails and socials
Source page shown for every contact
pros: Transparent sourcing for each enriched detail
Covers up to 25 cities per search
Free leads to test before paying
cons: CSV export requires a paid plan
Contact quality depends on what each business publishes on its own site
moreContext:
Local business prospecting usually means copying details from map listings and then hunting for an email on each website. Loclay combines both steps: it gathers listings from Google Maps and then has AI read the businesses' own sites to fill in the contact details. Its habit of labeling every enriched field with the page it came from is a thoughtful touch that makes the data easier to trust and verify.

- Searches can span many cities at once, which suits agencies covering a whole region or country.
- AI enrichment reads the homepage plus up to three contact, about or team pages for emails, phones and social links.
- Decision-maker names are pulled when a business lists them publicly, giving outreach a personal starting point.
- Saved lists and CSV export make it simple to move leads into a CRM or email tool.
- Plan tiers scale from thousands to well over a hundred thousand enriched leads per month.

Loclay works best for marketing agencies, web designers and B2B sellers whose customers are restaurants, clinics, trades and other local businesses. A practical tip: start with a narrow business type in a few cities, review how many leads come back with emails, and then widen the search once you know the enrichment rate for your niche. Always follow local rules on cold outreach.

name: Argorant
tagline: B2B contact data and outreach platform built for AI agents via MCP and API
description: Argorant combines a large B2B contact database, live email verification and mailbox-based campaigns, and exposes it all to AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT through MCP, an API and a CLI.
longDescription: Argorant is a sales prospecting platform that pairs a B2B contact database with built-in outreach. Users filter prospects by role, industry and location, verify work emails at the moment of export, and run email campaigns from their own connected mailboxes, with replies collected in a shared inbox and results tracked in analytics. What sets it apart is agent access: an MCP server, API and CLI let AI agents such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex parse an ideal customer profile from a prompt, pull leads and draft outreach. Data can be exported to CSV or a CRM. A 14-day trial needs no card, and teams can choose monthly plans or pay-as-you-go credit packs.
features: Mailbox-based campaigns with unified reply inbox
MCP server, API and CLI for AI agents
pros: Agent-native access for Claude, ChatGPT and custom agents
cons: Campaign sending requires a paid plan
Higher tiers are costly for small teams
moreContext:
Prospecting databases are common, but Argorant is built with AI agents as first-class users. Alongside a regular web app, it offers an MCP server, an API and a command line tool, so an agent can be told who to target in plain language and then search, verify and draft outreach on its own. For teams already working inside Claude or ChatGPT, that removes a lot of tab switching.

- The company says its database covers hundreds of millions of contacts across about 200 countries, with filters for role, industry and location.
- Emails are verified live when you export, which helps keep bounce rates down.
- Campaigns send from your own mailboxes, and replies land in one unified inbox with analytics.
- Agent integrations cover Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and custom agents through MCP.
- Flexible billing offers monthly seats or one-off credit packs that suit occasional use.

Argorant is well suited to founders, growth teams and agencies who want prospecting and cold email in one place and are experimenting with agent-driven sales workflows. A practical tip: begin with the no-card trial and a pay-as-you-go pack to test data quality for your market before committing to a monthly plan, and warm up new mailboxes before sending at volume.

name: Suparank
tagline: AI visibility tracker and GEO audit tool for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and AI Overviews
description: Suparank tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews mention and cite your brand, audits your site for GEO issues, and ties results to GA4 and Search Console in one chat workspace.
longDescription: Suparank is an AI search visibility platform for marketing teams. It runs the kinds of prompts buyers ask through ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews, then reports whether your brand is mentioned, where it appears, the sentiment of each mention and your share of voice against competitors. A GEO and technical audit crawls your pages and ranks the issues that may stop AI assistants from citing you, such as missing schema or thin answers. Connected GA4, Search Console and Bing Webmaster data shows real AI referral traffic, and an AI content studio drafts answer-first pages that can be published to WordPress. Everything is driven from a chat-style workspace.
features: Mention, sentiment and share-of-voice tracking across AI assistants
GEO and technical site audits with prioritized fixes
GA4, Search Console and Bing Webmaster connections
AI content studio with WordPress publishing
pros: Combines tracking, audits and analytics in one place
First question free with no credit card
Recommendations grounded in your own traffic data
cons: Gemini and Claude tracking start on the Growth plan
No permanent free plan
moreContext:
As more buyers get answers straight from AI assistants, a keyword ranking no longer tells the whole story. Suparank is built around that shift: rather than tracking blue-link positions, it checks whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews actually name your brand, and then helps you fix the reasons they might not. The chat-first workspace keeps measurement, diagnosis and content work in a single loop.

- Visibility reports show mentions, position, sentiment and share of voice against named competitors, refreshed weekly on paid plans.
- GEO and technical audits rank issues such as missing FAQ schema or thin pages by likely impact.
- Read-only connections to GA4, Search Console and Bing Webmaster tie AI referral traffic to your real numbers.
- The content studio drafts answer-first copy, stores it as reusable markdown and can publish to WordPress.
- Free utilities such as llms.txt and schema helpers are available for teams just getting started.

Suparank is a good fit for in-house SEO and content teams at growing companies who want one tool for AI search rather than several point solutions. A practical tip: connect GA4 and Search Console before your first audit, so the prioritized fix list reflects the pages that already bring in traffic and the changes you make can be measured afterward.

name: Botika
tagline: AI fashion models and backgrounds that turn product shots into on-model photos
description: Botika lets clothing brands swap mannequin or flat-lay product shots for AI-generated fashion models and backgrounds, with retouching rounds, video generation and a Shopify app for bulk updates.
longDescription: Botika is a generative AI service for fashion e-commerce. Brands upload photos of garments on mannequins, on real models or as flat lays, and Botika replaces them with AI-generated models and backgrounds so a collection can be shown on diverse people without a full photo shoot. Higher plans add the full model and background library, 4K output, custom background colors and footwear uploads, and every plan includes rounds of retouching handled by the team. Short product videos can be generated as well. Credits are used per photo or video and roll over while a subscription is active, and a Shopify app lets merchants update many store images in bulk.
features: Flat-lay and mannequin to on-model conversion
Shopify app for bulk photo updates
pros: Human retouching rounds included in plans
Unused credits roll over while subscribed
Reduces the need for frequent photo shoots
cons: Full model and background library requires a higher plan
Pricing shown on the site can be confusing between billing options
moreContext:
Showing a full clothing collection on models usually means booking studios, photographers and talent. Botika offers fashion brands another route by generating realistic models and settings around existing garment photos, and it pairs the AI with a human retouching step so outputs can be corrected before they go live. The company says this helps brands publish new collections faster and at lower cost.

- Mannequin, ghost and flat-lay photos can be turned into on-model images without reshooting the product.
- A library of AI models and backgrounds helps brands present items on a range of looks and settings.
- Retouching rounds with delivery windows are built into the plans, adding quality control beyond pure automation.
- Video generation creates short motion clips from the same products for social and product pages.
- The Shopify app is designed for bulk updates, which helps merchants refresh many listings at once.

Botika suits small and mid-sized apparel and footwear brands, especially on Shopify, that release collections often and want consistent model imagery. A practical tip: shoot your garments on a mannequin with even lighting and a plain backdrop, since cleaner source photos give the AI more accurate fabric detail to work with and reduce the number of retouch rounds you need.

name: BigIdeasDB
tagline: Startup idea and product research database built from real user complaints
description: BigIdeasDB mines complaints and reviews from sources like Reddit, G2, Upwork and app stores to surface validated problems and startup ideas, each with demand signals, competitors and a build guide.
longDescription: BigIdeasDB is a product research and idea validation platform for founders, indie hackers and product teams. It collects pain points from places where people describe problems in their own words, such as Reddit threads, G2 and Capterra reviews, Upwork job posts and app store reviews, and uses AI to organize them into a searchable database of problems and ideas. Each entry includes a problem summary, excerpts from real complaints, revenue estimates, competitive analysis and a step-by-step guide to building a solution. Companion tools include a build guide and a project workspace, and a hosted MCP server lets AI clients pull Reddit market signals directly. Users can start free and upgrade for full access.
features: Idea database sourced from complaints and reviews
Complaint excerpts, revenue estimates and competitor notes
Hosted MCP server for market signals
pros: Ideas grounded in real user frustrations
Covers several review and community sources
cons: Full access requires a paid plan
Complaints show pain, not proof that people will pay
moreContext:
Finding a problem worth solving is often the hardest part of starting a product, and BigIdeasDB tackles it by listening to what people already complain about online. Rather than brainstorming from scratch, founders can browse problems that show up repeatedly in reviews, forums and job posts, each backed by quotes from the people experiencing them.

- Sources include Reddit, G2, Capterra, Upwork and app store reviews, which together give a wide view of software and service frustrations.
- The company says its evidence base spans more than a million historical complaints, reviews and discussions.
- Each idea comes with real complaint excerpts, rough revenue estimates and a look at existing competitors.
- Build guides outline concrete steps from validation through to launch.
- A hosted MCP server lets tools like Claude bring Reddit market signals into an AI chat for deeper analysis.

BigIdeasDB is best for indie hackers, solo founders and product managers who want a research-driven starting point for their next product or feature. A practical tip: treat a promising idea as a hypothesis, then contact a few of the people behind the original complaints or run a small landing page test, since a frustrated post signals pain but not necessarily willingness to pay.

name: Gemini Omni
tagline: Google DeepMind's multimodal video model for generating and editing clips from any input
description: Gemini Omni is Google DeepMind's video model that creates and edits clips from text, images, audio or short video references, with conversational step-by-step edits in Gemini, Flow and the Gemini API.
longDescription: Gemini Omni is a family of multimodal video models from Google DeepMind, introduced at Google I/O in May 2026 with Gemini Omni Flash as the first release. It accepts text, images, audio and short video clips as references, alone or combined, and reasons across them to produce consistent footage. Users can edit a video through a conversation, with each instruction building on the last, transform a scene's style or action, swap characters or objects, transfer motion from one clip to another and extend shots into longer sequences. Drafts render at low resolution before final output and upscaling to 1080p or 4K. It is available in the Gemini app, Google Flow, YouTube Shorts, Google Vids, AI Studio and the Gemini API.
features: Image, audio, text and video references
Scene extension with first and last frame control
pros: Available across Gemini, Flow, YouTube and the API
Strong grasp of real-world physics and context
SynthID watermark and Content Credentials on outputs
cons: Requires a Google AI subscription in most apps
Features vary by plan tier and country
moreContext:
Google DeepMind describes Gemini Omni as doing for video what its Nano Banana model did for images: making generation and editing feel like a conversation. Instead of writing one perfect prompt, you can refine a clip in steps, and the model keeps the scene consistent as each change builds on the last. Its ability to combine image, audio, text and video references in one request is what sets it apart from earlier text-first video models.

- Conversational editing lets you adjust action, style or objects in an existing video through plain-language follow-ups.
- Multiple reference types can be mixed, including images, audio and clips of a few seconds.
- Motion transfer applies movement from one video to a character in a still image.
- Scene extension and first and last frame control help stitch shots into longer stories.
- Outputs from Google's apps carry an imperceptible SynthID watermark and C2PA Content Credentials.

Gemini Omni is a natural pick for creators already in the Google ecosystem, YouTube Shorts makers, and developers who want a video model through the Gemini API. A practical tip: work at the fast draft resolution while you iterate on edits, and only render and upscale once the motion and framing look right, which saves time and credits.

name: OpenClaw
tagline: Free, open-source personal AI assistant that runs on your machine and lives in your chats
description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI agent you install on Mac, Windows or Linux and message through WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and more to handle email, calendars, files, browsing and tasks.
longDescription: OpenClaw is an open-source AI assistant created by Peter Steinberger and now stewarded by the nonprofit OpenClaw Foundation. You install it on your own Mac, Windows or Linux computer with a script, npm or from source, then run an onboarding command to connect a model provider of your choice, whether hosted, subscription-backed or local. From there you talk to it through chat apps you already use, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal and iMessage. It keeps persistent memory about your people and projects, can browse the web, fill forms, read and write files and run shell commands with full or sandboxed access, and grows through community skills and plugins. The software itself is free.
features: Chat through WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Signal and more
Persistent memory of people and projects
Browser, file and shell automation with sandbox option
pros: Data stays on your own machine
Works with hosted or local models
cons: Setup is more technical than a hosted app
Model provider costs are separate
moreContext:
Most AI assistants live in a vendor's cloud and a dedicated app. OpenClaw flips that around: it runs on your own computer and meets you in the messaging apps you already open all day. Because the whole project is MIT licensed and has no paid tier, it has become a popular base for people who want a capable personal agent while keeping control of their data and choice of model.

- Around two dozen chat channels are supported, from WhatsApp and Telegram to Slack, Discord, Signal and iMessage.
- Persistent memory lets it remember your preferences, ongoing projects and the people you work with.
- Real computer actions include web browsing, form filling, file editing and shell commands, with a sandboxed mode for caution.
- Bring your own model, whether a hosted API, an existing subscription, a gateway or a model running locally.
- An extension ecosystem of community skills and plugins, plus the option to write your own, keeps expanding what it can do.

OpenClaw is ideal for developers, tinkerers and privacy-minded users who are comfortable with a terminal and want an assistant they fully own. A practical tip: start in sandboxed mode with a single chat channel, watch how it handles a few routine tasks, and only grant full shell and file access once you trust the skills you have installed.

name: Tale
tagline: Open-source project workspace where teams delegate tasks to AI agents and review results
description: Tale is an MIT-licensed workspace for teams to plan projects, hand tasks to agents like Claude, Codex or Gemini in persistent sandboxes, and approve deliverables with audit trails, self-hosted for free.
longDescription: Tale is an open-source project workspace that treats AI agents as members of the team. Projects bring together tasks, files and conversations, and any task can be delegated to an agent runtime such as Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor or OpenCode, using your own subscription or API-billed models. Agents work inside persistent sandboxes, and their output goes through a review and approval step with a full audit trail. Shared knowledge and connected sources give agents context, automations turn repeatable work into workflows, and an Arena view compares answers from two models. Admins manage roles, single sign-on, budgets and guardrails. It is built by Ruler GmbH in Switzerland and can be self-hosted for free.
features: Task delegation to Claude, Codex, Gemini and other runtimes
Persistent agent sandboxes with file review
pros: Full feature set free when self-hosted
Works with your existing model subscriptions
Swiss and EU hosting options for Enterprise
cons: Self-hosting needs infrastructure and setup
Paid Enterprise plan is priced per user in Swiss francs
moreContext:
Handing work to AI agents is easy; keeping track of what they did and whether it is good enough is harder. Tale focuses on that second part. It wraps agent work in the familiar structure of projects and tasks, then adds review, approval and audit trails so a team can see exactly what an agent produced before it is accepted.

- Runtime choice lets each task go to Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor or OpenCode, billed through your own accounts with no markup from Tale.
- Persistent sandboxes keep an agent's working files between sessions and make them easy to inspect.
- Governance tools cover roles, single sign-on, spending budgets and guardrails for larger teams.
- Automations package repeatable agent workflows, while Arena compares two models on the same question.
- The open MIT codebase means the Community edition includes every feature when you host it yourself.

Tale suits engineering, operations and research teams that already use several AI agents and want a shared, auditable place to coordinate them. A practical tip: begin by delegating small, well-scoped tasks with clear acceptance criteria, then use the review step to build a library of good examples before moving larger projects onto agents.

name: DeepKnit AI
tagline: AI workflow automation for document-heavy work in healthcare, insurance and legal
description: DeepKnit AI automates document-heavy operations by combining OCR, NLP and large language models with workflow orchestration, custom agents and optional human review for regulated industries.
longDescription: DeepKnit AI is an enterprise workflow automation platform for organizations that process large volumes of documents. It reads forms, PDFs, scanned pages and handwriting using OCR, ICR and natural language processing, then structures the extracted data into templates and moves it through orchestrated workflows that connect CRMs, ERPs, healthcare systems, databases and cloud or on-premise environments. Cross-document analysis can build timelines and insights from many files, and custom AI models and agents handle specialized steps, with optional human-in-the-loop review. Its ReviewGenX tool targets medical record review. The company focuses on healthcare, insurance, legal and other regulated sectors and states it has completed a SOC 2 Type II examination. Pricing is by quote.
features: Document understanding with OCR, ICR and NLP
cons: No public pricing or self-serve plan
Geared toward enterprise deployments rather than individuals
moreContext:
Insurance claims, legal case files and medical records often arrive as stacks of scanned pages, and turning them into usable data is slow manual work. DeepKnit AI concentrates on exactly that kind of workload, pairing document understanding with workflow automation so extracted information flows straight into the systems a team already uses. The company says its approach draws on more than two decades of experience with document-heavy operations.

- Document understanding covers typed forms, PDFs, images and handwriting through OCR, ICR and NLP.
- Cross-document analysis can assemble timelines and summaries from many related files, such as a patient's records.
- Template-driven output places extracted data into consistent structures for reporting and downstream tools.
- Broad integration connects to CRMs, ERPs, healthcare systems, databases and both cloud and on-premise setups.
- Human-in-the-loop review keeps people in control of sensitive decisions.

DeepKnit AI is best for operations leaders in healthcare, insurance, legal and financial services who need to automate document processing under compliance requirements. A practical tip: when you book a demo, bring a small, representative sample of your messiest real documents, since performance on handwritten or low-quality scans is the clearest test of fit for your workflow.

name: Browser Use
tagline: Open-source library and cloud platform for AI agents that operate real web browsers
description: Browser Use offers a popular MIT-licensed library for building browser-controlling AI agents, plus hosted web agents and stealth cloud browsers billed pay-as-you-go for developers.
longDescription: Browser Use is a developer platform for AI agents that work in a web browser. Its open-source Python library, released under the MIT license, lets a language model see pages, click, type and navigate to complete tasks such as data extraction, form filling, logins, shopping and travel booking. On top of that, the company runs hosted Browser Use Agents that take a task and return a result, and a cloud browser infrastructure that your own agents can drive through Playwright or Puppeteer over CDP, with features aimed at getting past bot protection. A separate Browser Harness project lets coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome. Cloud usage is pay-as-you-go after a small free credit.
features: MIT-licensed Python library for browser agents
Hosted web agents that complete tasks
Cloud browsers via Playwright or Puppeteer over CDP
cons: No fixed monthly plans for budgeting
Agent costs add a fee on top of model token prices
moreContext:
Browser Use has become one of the best-known open-source projects for letting AI models operate a real web browser, and the company built a hosted platform around that library. Developers can start with the free code on their own machines, then move to managed agents or cloud browsers when they need scale, reliability or protection against blocking.

- The open-source library is MIT licensed and, according to the site, counts well over a hundred thousand GitHub stars.
- Hosted Browser Use Agents accept a task in plain language and return the finished result.
- Cloud browsers connect through Playwright or Puppeteer over CDP, and the company reports strong results on bot-protected pages in its own testing.
- Browser Harness lets coding agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor work inside your actual Chrome profile.
- Pay-as-you-go billing charges for browser hours, proxy traffic and model tokens, with a free starter credit and no expiry on credits.

Browser Use is best for developers and AI engineers building agents that need to act on websites without official APIs. A practical tip: prototype locally with the open-source library first to tune prompts and task steps, then switch to cloud browsers once you hit sites with bot detection or need many sessions running in parallel.

name: Husnex
tagline: AI marketing suite for Meta, Google PMax and ChatGPT ads, creatives and social inbox
description: Husnex bundles AI agents and tools for paid media, including Meta ad audits, Google PMax and ChatGPT Ads agents, multilingual video hooks, a creative engine and an automated social inbox.
longDescription: Husnex is a marketing platform that brings several AI tools for paid advertising and social media under one roof. On the ads side it offers agents for Google Performance Max and ChatGPT Ads, an AI auditor that diagnoses Meta ad accounts, wasted-spend detection, an ads spy tool for competitor research and its own conversion tracking. For creative work, a creative engine and a video hooks tool produce ad variations in multiple languages. A social inbox uses AI to draft and automate replies to comments and messages, including Meta ad comments. Related products cover influencer, SEO and business tools. Pricing is not published, and access starts with booking a demo.
features: Google PMax and ChatGPT Ads agents
Multilingual video hooks and creative engine
AI social inbox and comment replies
pros: Covers several ad platforms in one suite
Combines creative production with campaign tooling
cons: No public pricing
Demo required before trying the product
moreContext:
Running paid media across Meta, Google and newer channels usually means juggling separate tools for audits, creatives and community replies. Husnex groups those jobs into one suite and adds AI agents for each platform, including support for ChatGPT Ads, a channel many marketing tools have yet to cover.

- The Meta AI Auditor reviews ad accounts to flag problems and wasted spend.
- Platform agents for Google Performance Max and ChatGPT Ads help manage and adjust campaigns.
- Creative tools generate ad concepts and short video hooks in several languages for international campaigns.
- The social inbox drafts and automates replies to comments and messages, including comments on Meta ads.
- Extra modules such as an ads spy tool and first-party tracking support competitor research and measurement.

Husnex is a fit for performance marketers and agencies managing multiple ad platforms who would rather centralize tools than stitch many subscriptions together. A practical tip: during the demo, ask to run the Meta auditor on a real account and compare its findings with your own recent optimization notes, which gives a quick sense of how much it would add to your existing process.

name: animx
tagline: One subscription for 40+ AI video and image models, from text and image to video
description: animx brings dozens of third-party video and image models into one credit-based workspace for text-to-video, image-to-video, image editing, upscaling and ad creation, with free starter credits.
longDescription: animx is a web platform that gives creators access to more than 40 AI video and image models through a single account and credit balance. Instead of subscribing to each provider separately, users pick a model for the job, such as Seedance, Kling, Wan or Veo for video and Flux, Seedream or Nano Banana for images, and generate from text prompts or reference images. The workspace also covers image editing, upscaling and ad creative production. New accounts receive free credits on sign-up that do not expire, and paid plans add monthly credit allowances, with the entry plan limited to lighter models and higher plans opening the full model catalog.
features: Access to 40+ video and image models
pros: Compare many models without separate subscriptions
Free sign-up credits that do not expire
Annual billing lowers the monthly cost
cons: Entry plan is limited to lighter models
Relies on third-party models rather than its own
moreContext:
With new video and image models arriving constantly, choosing which ones to pay for can be confusing. animx takes the aggregator approach, putting a large catalog of third-party models behind one credit balance so you can test several engines on the same idea and keep whichever result works best.

- The model catalog spans more than 40 options, covering popular video models like Seedance, Kling and Wan and image models like Flux and Seedream.
- Multiple workflows include text-to-video, image-to-video, image editing and upscaling in one workspace.
- Ad creation tools help marketers turn generated visuals into campaign assets.
- Starter credits are given on sign-up with no card required, and the site says they never expire.
- Tiered plans scale from a low-cost entry option to high-volume allowances for heavy users.

animx suits content creators, marketers and small studios who want to experiment across many generative models without managing a stack of subscriptions. A practical tip: spend your free credits running the same prompt through two or three different video models, note which one handles your style best, and then budget paid credits around that model.

name: Benchmark Email
tagline: Email marketing platform with an AI assistant for copy and images in the builder
description: Benchmark Email is an email marketing service for small businesses with a drag-and-drop builder, signup forms and automation, plus an AI Assistant that writes copy and creates images inside the editor.
longDescription: Benchmark Email is an email marketing platform aimed at small and mid-sized businesses. It provides a drag-and-drop email builder, templates, signup forms, contact list management, automation and reporting for newsletters and promotional campaigns. Its AI Assistant sits inside the email and form builders, where it can draft subject lines and body copy and generate images, drawing on a monthly allowance of AI credits. A free plan supports a limited number of contacts and monthly sends with a small AI credit budget, and paid plans raise contact limits, sending volume and AI credits, with prices that scale by list size. The company behind it is Polaris Software, LLC.
features: AI Assistant for copy and images
pros: Permanent free plan with AI credits
AI help built directly into the editor
cons: Free plan caps contacts and monthly emails
Paid price rises with list size
moreContext:
Benchmark Email has long focused on making email marketing approachable for small teams, and its AI Assistant follows the same idea. Rather than sending you to a separate writing tool, it lives inside the email and form builders, so drafting copy or creating an image happens right where the campaign is being designed.

- The AI Assistant writes subject lines and body copy and can generate images within the builder.
- AI credits are included on every plan, including the free tier, with larger allowances on paid plans.
- A drag-and-drop builder and templates help non-designers produce polished newsletters.
- Signup forms, list tools and automation cover the basics of growing and nurturing an audience.
- The free plan lets a small business run real campaigns before paying anything.

Benchmark Email is a good match for small businesses, nonprofits and solo marketers who want a straightforward newsletter tool with some AI help rather than a complex marketing suite. A practical tip: use the AI Assistant to produce two or three subject line options for each send and split test them on a slice of your list, since subject lines are where small wording changes most affect open rates.

name: Adobe Premiere Pro
tagline: Professional video editor with Firefly-powered Generative Extend and AI search tools
description: Adobe Premiere Pro is the industry-standard video editor, now with AI features like Generative Extend, natural-language media search, object masking, text-based editing and caption translation.
longDescription: Adobe Premiere Pro is a professional nonlinear video editor used for film, television, marketing and online video. Alongside its timeline, color and audio tools, it now includes a range of AI features. Generative Extend, powered by Adobe Firefly, adds frames to lengthen a clip and fills in ambient sound. Media Intelligence lets editors search footage by describing what they need in plain language, Object Mask selects and tracks a subject with a click, and Text-Based Editing builds rough cuts from an automatic transcript. Enhance Speech cleans dialogue, and captions can be translated into many languages. The desktop app requires a Creative Cloud subscription after a free trial, and a free Premiere mobile app is also available.
features: Generative Extend for clips and ambient audio
pros: AI features built into an established workflow
Works with the wider Creative Cloud apps
cons: Subscription required for the desktop app
Generative features use Firefly credits
moreContext:
Premiere Pro has been a mainstay of professional editing for two decades, and Adobe has been folding AI into it in ways that save time on the tedious parts of post-production rather than replacing the editor. The result is a familiar timeline with smarter tools around it, which makes it easy for experienced editors to adopt AI without changing how they work.

- Generative Extend uses Adobe Firefly to add a few extra frames or room tone when a shot ends too early.
- Media Intelligence powers a search panel where you describe a clip in everyday language instead of scrubbing through bins.
- Object Mask lets you click a subject to isolate and track it for color or effects work.
- Text-Based Editing turns a transcript into an editing surface for fast rough cuts of interviews and talks.
- Enhance Speech and caption translation help with clean dialogue and multilingual delivery.

Premiere Pro is best for professional editors, production teams and serious creators who need a full editing suite and want AI assistance inside it. A practical tip: run Text-Based Editing on long interview footage first to assemble a rough story from the transcript, then refine the cut on the timeline, which can shorten the first pass considerably.

name: REimagineHome
tagline: AI virtual staging, interior redesign and exterior makeovers for homes and listings
description: REimagineHome uses AI to stage empty rooms, redesign interiors, update landscaping and fix listing photos, with batch processing for real estate and shoppable designs built from real products.
longDescription: REimagineHome is an AI design platform from Styldod for homeowners, real estate agents and designers. Upload a photo and it can virtually stage an empty room, declutter a space, restyle surfaces or swap furniture while keeping the existing layout. Outdoor tools add landscaping, hardscaping, lawn replacement or a pool, and photo fixes include sky replacement, day-to-dusk conversion, object and snow removal, upscaling and straightening. Designs can be refined iteratively or guided by moodboards and reference images, and some can be made shoppable with real retail products. A listing workflow processes up to 50 photos at once and sorts them by room. New users get a few free designs before choosing a credit-based monthly plan.
features: Batch listing workflow for up to 50 photos
pros: Covers both interior and exterior edits
Free designs to try with no card
cons: Monthly credits expire each billing cycle
Per-plan prices are shown mainly at checkout
moreContext:
REimagineHome covers an unusually wide range of home photo work in one place. The same account can stage a vacant living room, redesign a kitchen, add a patio and lawn outside, and turn a daytime exterior shot into an evening one, which makes it practical for both homeowners planning changes and agents preparing listings.

- Virtual staging and decluttering keep the room's real layout while changing what fills it.
- Exterior tools handle landscaping, hardscaping, lawn replacement and pool additions.
- Photo fixes such as sky replacement, day-to-dusk conversion and object removal help listing images look their best.
- The batch workflow takes up to 50 listing photos at once, sorts them by room and exports a high-resolution gallery.
- Shoppable designs link staged rooms to real products from retailers for homeowners who want to buy the look.

REimagineHome is a strong fit for real estate agents, property marketers and homeowners exploring renovation ideas. A practical tip: shoot rooms from a corner at chest height with lights on and blinds open, since a wide, evenly lit view gives the AI more of the room's structure to preserve. Agents should also disclose virtually staged images in listings where local rules require it.

name: Best JobFinder
tagline: AI job search automation that collects, scores and auto-applies to jobs from 20+ boards
description: Best JobFinder gathers listings from LinkedIn, Indeed, Dice and other boards, scores them against your skills, tailors CVs and cover letters, auto-fills applications and tracks every reply in one place.
longDescription: Best JobFinder is a job search automation tool that runs as a web app, a Windows and macOS desktop app and a browser extension. It imports your CV from LinkedIn, runs saved searches across more than 20 job boards such as LinkedIn, Indeed, Dice and Greenhouse, and ranks results with an AI skill-match score. From there it can tailor CVs and cover letters, auto-fill application forms on supported platforms, track applications from first contact to offer and link incoming emails to the right job. Because it works inside your own signed-in browser sessions, it never asks for job board passwords. Premium adds an AI assistant, interview preparation and a career coach. A short free trial is available.
features: Tailored CVs, cover letters and auto-fill
pros: One place for search, applying and follow-up
Works in your own sessions without storing board passwords
Available on web, desktop and browser
cons: Free trial lasts only a few days
AI assistant and career coach require the Premium plan
moreContext:
Job hunting often means retyping the same details into dozens of forms and losing track of where you applied. Best JobFinder tries to pull the whole process into one dashboard, from finding openings across many boards to tracking replies, while running inside your own signed-in browser so job sites see ordinary activity from your account.

- Aggregated search pulls openings from more than 20 sources, including LinkedIn, Indeed, Dice and Greenhouse.
- Skill-match scores rank jobs against the skills and weights you set from your imported CV.
- Tailored documents produce CV and cover letter versions for specific roles, and auto-fill handles repetitive form fields.
- The pipeline tracker follows each application from new to offer and links related emails automatically.
- Interview prep and a career coach on Premium add study plans, practice exams and role roadmaps.

Best JobFinder is best for active job seekers applying to many roles, especially in tech and other fields where LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice dominate. A practical tip: spend time weighting your skills carefully after importing your CV, since those weights drive the match scores and keep auto-apply focused on roles that genuinely fit instead of sending applications everywhere.

name: Parall
tagline: AI agents that hold ongoing roles, watch your business tools and act with approvals
description: Parall deploys specialist AI agents that monitor connected tools like Gmail, Slack, HubSpot, QuickBooks and ERPs, act on changes, coordinate with each other and ask your team before consequential steps.
longDescription: Parall is an operations platform where AI agents take on persistent roles inside a company. You connect sources such as an ERP, Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Microsoft Teams, HubSpot, Intercom, Notion, Ramp and QuickBooks, and specialist agents for areas like inventory, logistics, finance or receipts watch those systems for changes. When something needs doing, the agents coordinate with one another and with people, request approval before consequential actions such as approving a delivery or posting a correction, and stay with work that runs for weeks. Feedback carries into future runs, and scheduled jobs handle recurring checks. Example uses include warehouse operations, customer onboarding and month-end close. Access starts with sign-up or a call.
features: Specialist agents for inventory, logistics and finance
Monitoring of ERPs, email, chat and CRM tools
pros: Agents learn from feedback over time
Broad set of business tool connections
Approval steps keep people in control
cons: No public pricing
Best suited to companies with established operational systems
moreContext:
Many automation tools run a task and stop. Parall is designed around agents that keep a standing role, like a teammate responsible for inventory or month-end reconciliation, watching for changes and following work through over days or weeks. Approval checkpoints before important actions make that ongoing autonomy easier to trust.

- Specialist agents for inventory, logistics, finance and receipts coordinate with each other on shared work.
- Wide connectivity reaches ERPs, Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Teams, HubSpot, Intercom, Notion, Ramp and QuickBooks.
- Approval requests bring in a human before actions such as approving a delivery or recording a correction.
- Learning from feedback means corrections you give carry into the agents' future runs.
- Scheduled checks handle routines such as a weekday morning review without manual prompting.

Parall suits operations, finance and supply chain teams at growing companies who spend a lot of time reconciling information across many systems. A practical tip: start by giving one agent a narrow, recurring responsibility, such as matching receipts to transactions, and keep approvals on until its suggestions are consistently right before widening its scope.

name: Muse
tagline: Meta's personal AI agent that handles email, bookings, shopping and plans for you
description: Muse is Meta's personal AI agent that works toward your goals and tasks, from sorting email and booking reservations to shopping and fitness plans, using its own secure cloud computer and your approval.
longDescription: Muse is a personal AI agent from Meta, launched in the United States in September 2026. Instead of only answering questions, it takes a goal or task and works on it, such as sorting email, booking reservations, shopping for deals, managing a calendar or building a fitness plan. Each user gets a dedicated Muse Secure VM, a persistent cloud computer with its own browser that the user can open at any time. You chat with it through the Muse app on mobile and Mac or through WhatsApp. Actions like sending emails or making purchases need your approval first, and a full audit trail shows what it has done. A free tier is offered alongside paid plans.
features: Goal-driven task handling across email, bookings and shopping
Dedicated Muse Secure VM with a full browser
Chat through the Muse app or WhatsApp
Action approvals and complete audit trail
pros: Free tier for most everyday use
Approval step before emails or purchases
Lets you watch and take over its browser
cons: Available only to adults in the United States at launch
Requires sharing considerable personal data to be useful
moreContext:
Muse is Meta's move from a chatbot that answers to an agent that acts. The standout design choice is giving every user a personal cloud computer, the Muse Secure VM, where the agent does its work in a real browser that you can open and take over whenever you like. Paired with approvals before sensitive actions, that makes its activity visible rather than hidden behind a chat window.

- Everyday errands such as sorting email, booking reservations, comparison shopping and calendar management are its core focus.
- The Secure VM is a persistent, isolated Linux machine with storage and a full browser for each user.
- Messaging access through the Muse app on mobile and Mac or directly in WhatsApp keeps the learning curve low.
- Approvals and an audit trail let you confirm emails or purchases first and review everything afterward.
- Longer-term goals like saving money or improving fitness can be turned into plans that the agent keeps working on.

Muse is best for busy adults in the United States who already live in WhatsApp and want help with routine personal admin. A practical tip: begin with low-stakes tasks such as organizing your inbox or researching a purchase, and review the audit trail for a while before letting it handle bookings or payments, so you can see how it interprets your instructions.

name: Epochal
tagline: Credit-based AI video and image studio with Veo, Kling, Seedance and more in one place
description: Epochal is a web workspace for turning text or photos into AI videos and images using a range of third-party models, plus tools like lip sync, face swap, hairstyle try-on and product videos.
longDescription: Epochal is a browser-based studio that gives access to many third-party video and image models through one credit balance. For video, it offers text-to-video and image-to-video with models such as Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan and Hailuo, along with lip sync, motion control, product videos and intro generators. For images, it supports models including GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX and Ideogram, plus editing tools like face swap, hairstyle try-on, clothes swap and line art. Each generation shows its credit cost upfront, and failed runs are refunded. Users can buy one-time credit packs that never expire or choose monthly or yearly subscriptions, with a discounted first pack for newcomers.
features: Text-to-video and image-to-video across many models
Lip sync, motion control and product videos
Credit cost shown before each generation
pros: One-time credit packs that do not expire
Wide choice of video and image models
cons: No free plan
Depends on third-party models rather than its own
moreContext:
Epochal is for creators who want to try several AI video and image models without committing to a subscription for each one. Its pay-as-you-go credit packs, which do not expire, make it easy to dip in for a project and come back later, and showing the credit cost before every run helps keep spending predictable.

- The model lineup spans well-known video engines such as Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan and Hailuo.
- Image models include GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX and Ideogram for stills and edits.
- Specialty tools cover lip sync, motion control, product videos, face swap and hairstyle try-on.
- Refunds on failed generations mean credits are not lost when a run errors out.
- Flexible buying options mix one-time packs with monthly or yearly plans for regular users.

Epochal suits hobbyists, social media creators and small marketers who generate video occasionally and prefer paying per use. A practical tip: test a prompt on a lower-cost model first to check composition and motion, then rerun the best version on a premium model like Veo, since credit costs per run vary widely between models.

name: Be My Eyes
tagline: Free app pairing blind and low-vision users with volunteers and an AI describer
description: Be My Eyes connects blind and low-vision people with sighted volunteers over live video, and its Be My AI feature describes photos in detail on request. The app is free for users.
longDescription: Be My Eyes is an accessibility app built for people who are blind or have low vision. Its original service routes a live video call to a sighted volunteer who can help read a label, check a color or find a way through an unfamiliar space. Be My AI adds an on-demand option: users take a photo and receive a detailed written description that they can ask follow-up questions about. The company says its volunteer community supports users in more than 180 languages. The app runs on iOS and Android, the site also lists desktop and smart glasses options, and it is free for users. Businesses can join a service directory to offer accessible customer support.
features: Live video calls with sighted volunteers
pros: Free for blind and low-vision users
Human help and AI help in one app
Long track record since its 2015 launch
cons: Volunteer response times can vary
AI descriptions can miss fine details
moreContext:
Few apps put AI to work on such a practical, everyday need. Be My Eyes started with a simple idea, letting a blind or low-vision person borrow a stranger's eyes for a minute over video, and it has since added Be My AI so users can get a detailed description of a photo without waiting for anyone. Having both options side by side is what makes it special: quick questions go to the AI, while tricky or sensitive moments can still go to a real person.

- Live video help from a large volunteer community, which the company says covers more than 180 languages
- Be My AI turns a photo into a rich written description and answers follow-up questions about it
- Free to use for blind and low-vision people, with no subscription to manage
- Available on iOS and Android, with desktop and smart glasses options listed on the site
- A service directory where businesses can offer accessible support to customers

It is best for blind and low-vision people who want dependable help with reading labels, sorting mail, checking colors or getting oriented in a new place. Sighted people can also sign up as volunteers. A practical tip: use Be My AI for quick reads like menus or packaging, and save volunteer calls for tasks that need back-and-forth guidance, such as setting up an appliance.

name: Huxly
tagline: Describe a mobile app in plain language and get a working iOS and Android build
description: Huxly is an AI mobile app builder that turns a written description into an Expo, Flutter or SwiftUI app, with live preview, backend functions and store publishing.
longDescription: Huxly is an AI app builder focused on native mobile apps. You describe what you want in plain language, and it generates a project in Expo (React Native), Flutter or SwiftUI that you can preview in the browser, including a cloud iOS simulator for SwiftUI builds. It can convert Figma designs, add backend and edge functions for things like auth, payments and webhooks, and deploy them to providers such as Supabase, Firebase, Netlify, Render or Railway. Finished apps can go out through TestFlight, the App Store and Google Play. An MCP connector lets assistants like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor work on a project. A small free plan is available, with paid tiers from $25 a month.
pros: Targets native mobile, not just web apps
MCP connector for outside AI assistants
cons: Free plan is limited to a few messages
Credit limits on paid tiers
moreContext:
Most AI app builders stop at a web prototype, so a tool aimed squarely at phone apps is a welcome change. Huxly takes a written idea and produces a real mobile project, then carries it through preview, backend setup and publishing. The choice between Expo, Flutter and SwiftUI also means you are not locked into one stack if you later hand the code to a developer.

- Generates apps in Expo (React Native), Flutter or SwiftUI from a plain-language brief
- Browser preview, with a cloud iOS simulator for SwiftUI projects
- Figma designs can be converted into working screens
- Backend and edge functions for auth, payments and webhooks, deployable to Supabase, Firebase, Netlify, Render or Railway
- Publishing through TestFlight, the App Store and Google Play, plus an MCP connector for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor

It is best for founders, designers and solo creators who want a phone app without learning native development, and for teams that need many quick builds. The free plan only includes a handful of messages, so a practical tip is to write a detailed first prompt that lists your screens, data and login needs before you start, which helps you get more out of each credit.

name: Chatxy
tagline: One chat window for GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and other models
description: Chatxy is a multi-model AI chat site where you switch between models from a dropdown, attach files, generate images and use small free writing tools, with a guest mode that needs no account.
longDescription: Chatxy is a web chat platform that puts models from several AI labs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and Perplexity, behind a single interface, along with a free model anyone can use. You pick a model from a dropdown, and you can turn on web search or attach PDF, Word and Excel files. It also generates and edits images and can export answers as PDFs, slide decks or spreadsheets. Guests get a small daily message allowance without signing up, a free account raises the limits, and paid access buys higher caps. The site states it is not affiliated with OpenAI, Google or Anthropic. A set of free tools covers grammar checks, summaries and paraphrasing.
features: Export to PDF, slides or spreadsheet
pros: Try several models without separate subscriptions
Free side tools for quick writing tasks
cons: Daily message caps on free use
Third-party access layer, not the model makers
moreContext:
Comparing answers from different AI models usually means juggling several tabs and accounts. Chatxy keeps them in one window, so switching from one model to another is a single dropdown choice. That makes it a handy place to test which model suits a task before you commit to any one provider.

- A single interface for models from labs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba and Moonshot, plus a free house model
- Web search and file attachments for PDF, Word and Excel documents
- Image generation and editing inside the same chat
- Answers can be exported as PDFs, slide decks or spreadsheets
- A dozen free tools, such as a grammar checker, summarizer and paraphraser, that work without an account

It is best for curious users and students who want to sample different models cheaply, and for anyone who needs an occasional answer without signing up. Keep in mind that Chatxy is an independent service that routes your prompts to the model you choose, and it says it is not affiliated with the labs themselves. A practical tip: run the same prompt through two or three models when accuracy matters, and treat the free daily allowance as a way to find the one you prefer.

name: Adobe Illustrator
tagline: Industry-standard vector design app with generative AI tools built in
description: Adobe Illustrator is the long-running vector graphics app for logos, icons and illustration, now with generative AI features that turn text prompts into editable vector artwork.
longDescription: Adobe Illustrator is a desktop and iPad application for creating vector graphics such as logos, icons, illustrations, typography and print layouts. Because the artwork is vector based, it scales to any size without losing quality. In recent versions Adobe has added generative AI features powered by its Firefly models, including generating editable vector graphics from a text prompt and creating patterns and recolor options. Plans include a monthly allowance of generative credits. Illustrator is sold by subscription, either on its own or as part of Creative Cloud, and Adobe offers a free trial. It is aimed at professional designers, agencies and students learning the craft.
features: Precise vector drawing and type tools
Works with other Creative Cloud apps
cons: Subscription only, no free plan
Steep learning curve for beginners
moreContext:
Plenty of AI image tools can make a picture, but very few produce artwork a designer can actually take apart and refine. Illustrator's generative features stand out because the results arrive as real vector shapes, layered and editable, inside the same app professionals already use for logos and print work. That keeps AI as a starting point rather than a dead end.

- Generative vector features, powered by Adobe Firefly, that create editable graphics from a text prompt
- Generative recolor and pattern tools for quickly exploring palettes and repeat designs
- Decades of mature drawing, typography and layout tools for precise work
- Native AI, SVG, PDF and EPS formats that print shops and agencies expect
- Tight links with Photoshop, InDesign and other Creative Cloud apps

It is best for professional designers, illustrators and agencies, and for students who want to learn the tool used across the industry. Newcomers should expect a learning curve. A practical tip: plans come with a monthly allowance of generative credits, so use prompts to explore early concepts, then finish the chosen direction by hand with the pen and shape tools to keep your credits for the ideas that matter.

name: LipSync.video
tagline: Web studio for AI lip sync, talking photos, avatars and video generation
description: LipSync.video matches speech to faces in photos and videos, and adds talking avatars, dubbing, text to speech and access to several video generation models in one credit-based workspace.
longDescription: LipSync.video is a browser-based studio built around AI lip syncing. You upload a video or photo, then add a script, an audio file or a recording, and the tool animates the mouth to match the speech. Beyond basic lip sync it offers talking and singing photos, avatar dialogue, video dubbing, talking cartoons and animals, text to speech in dozens of languages and voice cloning. The site also bundles third-party video and image models for generation, along with ad and product video tools. Work is paid for with credits, with subscription tiers starting at $9.99 a month and a one-time payment option. It is aimed at creators, marketers and social media teams.
features: Built-in text to speech in many languages
pros: Many lip sync formats in one place
Text, upload or recorded audio input
cons: Credit costs add up on longer clips
Basic lip sync mode only supports portraits
moreContext:
Lip sync tools often do one narrow thing, but this studio covers a surprising range of formats in a single place. You can make a portrait speak from a typed script, dub an existing clip into another language, or turn a pet photo into a singing greeting, all without leaving the browser. That breadth makes it a fun and practical sandbox for short social content.

- Two lip sync model tiers, a fast option for portraits and a more realistic option for varied characters
- Talking photos, singing photos, avatar dialogue and talking cartoon or animal modes
- Video dubbing, voice cloning and text to speech with emotion, speed and pitch controls
- Access to third-party video and image generation models from the same credit balance
- Ad tools for product videos and avatar-led marketing clips

It is best for creators, marketers and social media managers who want quick talking-head or dubbed clips without filming. A practical tip: credits are charged per second of output, so test your script on a short segment with the faster model first, then switch to the higher quality model for the final render once timing and voice are right.

name: niia
tagline: AI receptionist that books salon appointments over WhatsApp around the clock
description: niia is an AI receptionist for salons and spas that answers WhatsApp messages, books and reschedules appointments, and syncs everything to Google Calendar.
longDescription: niia is an AI booking assistant built for salons, spas and multi-branch beauty businesses. It connects to WhatsApp Business and replies to client messages at any hour, checking live availability and confirming bookings in the chat. Clients can reschedule or cancel by replying, and an automatic waitlist offers freed-up slots to the next person. The assistant uses the salon's own service menu and prices to answer questions, replies in more than 60 languages and flags complex conversations so staff can step in. Bookings sync to Google Calendar, and owners get a shared inbox and analytics dashboard. Plans start at $84 a month after a 14-day free trial.
pros: Clients book without an app or account
Answers use your own menu and prices
Staff can take over any chat
cons: Built for salons, not general businesses
No permanent free plan
moreContext:
Salon owners spend a lot of time answering the same booking questions while their hands are busy with clients. niia takes that load off by handling WhatsApp conversations itself, from checking open slots to confirming the appointment. Its focus on one industry shows in the details, like answers that reference your real service list and a waitlist that fills cancelled slots on its own.

- Books, reschedules and cancels appointments directly inside WhatsApp, with no app for clients to install
- Replies in more than 60 languages, including Arabic, Hindi and Tagalog, according to the company
- Two-way reminders that let clients move an appointment just by replying
- An automatic waitlist that offers freed-up times to the next client
- A shared inbox, analytics dashboard and Google Calendar sync, with an API for outside booking systems

It is best for independent salons, spas and multi-branch beauty businesses whose clients already message them on WhatsApp. A practical tip: before going live, load your full service menu with accurate durations and prices, since the assistant relies on that information to quote and schedule correctly, and use the 14-day trial to review how it handles your busiest days.

name: Ritual Engine
tagline: AI ad production stack from a working studio, from brief to finished video
description: Ritual Engine bundles the AI tools an ad studio uses for research, ideas, characters, product shots and video, all on one login and one shared credit balance.
longDescription: Ritual Engine is a set of AI production tools built by Ritual Ads, a creative studio, and opened up to other teams. Its live tools include Infinite Engine, which produces short films from a brief, along with Idea Lab, Character Designer, Product Studio, Image Studio, Video Studio and Location Builder. They draw on third-party generation models such as Kling and Seedance. All tools share a single login, a common credit balance and a library, so assets made in one tool can be picked up in the next. Pricing is pay-as-you-go credits rather than seats, and new accounts start with free credits. Developers can add their own tools through the Ritual SDK and CLI.
features: Brief to short ad film generation
pros: Built from a real ad studio workflow
Runs from Claude and other MCP assistants
cons: Credit prices not listed up front
Geared to ad work over general video
moreContext:
There is something reassuring about a toolset that its makers use on their own client campaigns. Ritual Engine comes out of Ritual Ads, a working creative studio, and it packages the same pipeline they rely on: research the market, develop an idea, build the characters and world, then shoot and cut. Keeping every step on one account and one library cuts down on the file shuffling that usually slows AI ad production.

- Seven live tools covering ideas, characters, products, images, video and locations
- Infinite Engine, which turns a written brief into a short film
- One login, one shared credit balance and one asset library across every tool
- Usable from Claude and other MCP assistants with the same account and credits
- A Ritual SDK and CLI for developers who want to ship their own tools into the platform

It is best for ad teams, brand marketers and small agencies who want to move from concept to finished creative in one place. Since the platform charges for output rather than seats, a practical tip is to spend your starter credits on Idea Lab and Character Designer first, locking in the concept and look before running the more credit-hungry video generation.

name: Legora
tagline: Collaborative AI platform for law firms to review, research and draft legal work
description: Legora, formerly Leya, is a legal AI platform that helps lawyers review documents, run research, draft and monitor regulation, with agents that can carry out multi-step legal tasks.
longDescription: Legora is a legal AI platform for law firms and in-house legal teams. Founded in Stockholm in 2023 under the name Leya, it rebranded as Legora in 2025. The product helps lawyers review large sets of documents in table form, research questions with cited sources, draft and edit inside Microsoft Word and keep work organized. Its Agent can plan, carry out and review multi-step legal tasks, while Monitors scan regulatory changes and surface what matters to a team. The company describes the whole system as an agentic operating system for legal work, with security and governance controls for firms. Pricing is not published, and access starts with a demo request.
features: Tabular review of large document sets
cons: No public pricing
Demo required before access
moreContext:
Legal teams spend huge amounts of time reading, comparing and summarizing documents, and that is exactly where this platform focuses. What sets Legora apart is its emphasis on collaboration: lawyers and AI work in shared spaces, so a review table or research thread can be passed around a team instead of living in one person's chat history. The company started as Leya in Stockholm in 2023 and rebranded as Legora in 2025.

- Tabular review that pulls answers from many contracts or filings into one comparable grid
- An Agent that plans, executes and checks multi-step legal work before handing it back
- Research that searches the web and cites the sources behind each answer
- A Microsoft Word add-in so drafting and editing stay in a familiar tool
- Monitors that scan regulatory changes and flag what is relevant to a team

It is best for law firms and in-house legal departments that handle high volumes of documents and want AI built around legal workflows rather than a general chatbot. Pricing is quoted after a demo. A practical tip: bring a real sample matter, such as a batch of contracts you have already reviewed, to the demo so you can compare the platform's output against work you know well.

name: ViewMade
tagline: Turn a one-line topic or a long video into captioned Shorts, Reels and TikToks
description: ViewMade researches a topic, writes and narrates a script and assembles a vertical video from real footage, and it can also clip long videos into captioned Shorts.
longDescription: ViewMade is a web studio for producing short vertical videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok. Give it a one-sentence subject and it researches the topic, writes a script, records an AI voice-over and builds the video from archive footage. It can also take a link to a longer video, find the strongest moments and cut them into captioned vertical clips, or lay your own commentary over a source video. Narration comes in 25 voices across five languages, with seven caption styles and automatic reframing from 16:9 to 9:16. Each export includes a thumbnail, title, description, tags and a media credits file. There is no free tier, and plans start at $29 a month.
features: Long video clipping into vertical clips
pros: Uses real footage rather than only generated visuals
Exports come with titles, tags and thumbnails
MCP endpoint for requesting videos from Claude
cons: No free tier
Narration limited to five languages
moreContext:
Running a faceless channel usually means stitching together research, scripting, voice work and editing by hand. ViewMade folds those steps into one request, and its choice to build videos from real archive footage gives results a grounded, documentary feel that many generated-visual tools lack. The extra publishing assets bundled with each export are a thoughtful touch for busy creators.

- Researched Shorts that start from a single sentence and come back fully scripted and narrated
- Clipping that scans a long video link and pulls the strongest moments into vertical clips
- Commentary mode that layers your narration over a source video and lowers its original audio
- 25 voices across English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and Turkish, plus seven caption styles
- Each 1080x1920 MP4 ships with a thumbnail, title, description, tags and a media credits file

It is best for creators running faceless YouTube, Instagram or TikTok channels, and for brands that want a steady flow of short explainers without filming. A practical tip: keep the media credits file that comes with each export, since it records where the footage came from and makes it easier to answer questions about sourcing later.

name: Jynno
tagline: AI studio for text and image to video, image editing and product ad creation
description: Jynno is a credit-based creative studio for AI video and images, with text and image to video, restyling, upscaling, photo editing tools and a Creative Agent for planning projects.
longDescription: Jynno is a web-based creative studio that brings AI video and image tools into one workspace. On the video side it offers text to video, image to video, reference to video, effects, restyling, upscaling and background removal. Image tools cover generation, photo editing, background and watermark removal, a magic eraser, upscaling and image to prompt. A Creative Agent helps plan and produce projects, and themed tools such as Ad Director and Story Studio turn product photos or ideas into ad videos and short stories. Usage runs on credits, which come with monthly memberships starting at $9.99 a month or as one-time credit packs.
features: Text, image and reference to video
pros: Video and image tools in one account
Credit packs available without a subscription
Ad and story templates for quick projects
cons: Brand kits reserved for higher tiers
Credits run down quickly on video
moreContext:
Jumping between a video generator, an image editor and an upscaler gets tiring fast. Jynno puts those jobs under one roof, so you can clean up a product photo, animate it into a clip and upscale the result without exporting files between services. The Creative Agent and story tools add a friendly layer of guidance for people who know what they want to say but not which tool to start with.

- Text to video, image to video and reference to video, plus effects and restyling
- Video upscaling and background removal for finishing touches
- Image generation and editing, with watermark removal, a magic eraser and image to prompt
- Ad Director and product ad tools that turn product photos into short promotional videos
- Monthly memberships or one-time credit packs, with discounts on annual plans

It is best for content creators, small online sellers and marketers who produce a steady mix of images and short videos. A practical tip: membership tiers differ in how many tasks run at once and whether credits roll over, so if you only create occasionally, start with a one-time credit pack and move to a membership once your monthly volume is clear.

name: AnyImageDetector
tagline: Check whether a photo is AI generated with a probability score and confidence level
description: AnyImageDetector analyzes an uploaded image or image link and returns how likely it is to be AI generated, with a confidence label, a free tier and a REST API for developers.
longDescription: AnyImageDetector is a web tool and API for estimating whether an image was created by AI. You upload a JPG, PNG or WebP file or paste a public image link, and it returns an AI probability score, a confidence level and a verdict of real, AI or uncertain. The site says it is built to catch output from popular generators such as Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Firefly, Imagen and FLUX, while noting that coverage varies and results should be treated as one signal. Uploaded files are not added to detection history by default. A free tier covers a handful of checks, and paid monthly plans add more images, history and API access.
features: AI probability score with confidence label
Upload or paste an image URL
pros: Low entry price for paid plans
No image storage for web checks
cons: Free tier covers only a few images
Results vary by generator and editing
moreContext:
Realistic fake photos now turn up in news feeds, dating apps and online marketplaces, and a quick second opinion can save a lot of trouble. AnyImageDetector offers that check in a few seconds, and it deserves credit for being upfront that its score is a probability rather than a final answer. That honest framing makes it a sensible tool for everyday verification.

- Returns an AI probability score, a confidence level and a plain real, AI or uncertain verdict
- Accepts JPG, PNG and WebP uploads up to 8 MB, or a public image link
- Aimed at output from widely used generators, including Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Firefly and FLUX
- Web uploads are processed for the check and not added to detection history
- A REST API that returns the same verdict as the web tool, for teams that need checks at scale

It is best for journalists, fact-checkers, marketplace moderators and everyday users who want to vet a suspicious image before sharing or acting on it. A practical tip: heavy cropping, compression or filters can weaken the signals any detector relies on, so test the highest quality version of an image you can find, and combine the result with a reverse image search.

name: EmailPal
tagline: Cold email platform with leads, inboxes and CRM, run by an AI agent you approve
description: EmailPal bundles US lead search, sending mailboxes, a sequencer, shared inbox and CRM on one plan, with an AI agent called Pal that finds leads and drafts emails for your approval.
longDescription: EmailPal is an all-in-one cold email platform for small businesses, agencies and SaaS teams. One subscription covers unlimited US business leads, sending mailboxes with managed warm-up and deliverability checks, a sequencer, a shared reply inbox and a CRM. Its AI agent, Pal, learns your business from your website, finds people who match your ideal customer, and writes sequences of one to five steps with A/B variants. Nothing sends, spends or launches without your approval, and replies are labelled but never answered by AI. Pal also reviews campaigns on a schedule and suggests changes. Paid plans start at $69 a month, and new users can try 25 free lead reveals.
features: Unlimited US lead search on paid plans
pros: Leads, sending and CRM on one bill
cons: Lead data limited to US contacts
Higher entry price than basic senders
moreContext:
Cold email usually means paying separately for a lead database, sending inboxes, a sequencer and a CRM, then wiring them together. EmailPal folds that whole stack into one subscription and adds an AI agent that does the legwork while you keep the final say. Its rule that replies are labelled but never answered by AI is a reassuring choice for anyone protecting their reputation.

- Unlimited US business leads on paid plans, filterable by role, industry and company size, with built-in verification
- Pal writes one to five step sequences with A/B variants after reading your website
- Managed mailboxes with warm-up and continuous SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks
- A shared reply inbox and CRM on the same login, with no open tracking
- Scheduled campaign reviews where Pal suggests pauses or scaling winners, but only acts after your click

It is best for agencies, SaaS founders and local service businesses selling to US companies who want a complete outbound setup without stitching tools together. A practical tip: use the 25 free lead reveals to test how well Pal understands your ideal customer, and refine your filters before committing to a paid plan and launching your first sequence.

name: ChatDOC
tagline: Chat with PDFs and other documents and get answers linked to their exact sources
description: ChatDOC lets you upload PDFs, Word files, scans, ebooks and web pages, then ask questions and get answers with clickable citations that point back to the original text, tables and formulas.
longDescription: ChatDOC is an AI document reader for asking questions about long files. You upload PDFs, DOC or DOCX files, scanned pages, EPUB books, Markdown, plain text or a web page, and it answers in plain language with footnote-style citations that jump to the exact passage.
