Its parser is designed to handle formulas, images and tables that span pages, and it can translate a file while keeping the original layout. Users can organize files into folders and ask questions across several documents at once. A free plan includes a limited number of questions and pages, and a Pro subscription removes those limits. The team also offers ChatPaper, an API and a PDF parser.
pros: Browser extensions for Chrome and Edge
cons: Free plan caps questions and pages
Pro price not shown on the homepage
moreContext:
The biggest worry with AI document tools is whether you can trust the answer, and ChatDOC tackles that head on. Each response comes with citations you can click to see the exact sentence, table cell or figure it came from, which turns checking into a quick habit rather than a chore. Its careful handling of messy layouts, like formulas and tables that break across pages, is another quiet strength.

- Clickable footnote citations that jump straight to the supporting passage
- A parser built for formulas, images and cross-page tables, plus OCR for scanned files
- Support for PDF, Word, scans, EPUB, Markdown, plain text and web pages
- Questions across whole folders of documents, not just one file at a time
- Translation that keeps the original layout intact, in more than 25 languages

It is best for students, researchers, analysts and professionals who regularly dig through reports, papers, manuals or contracts. The company says more than a million people use it. A practical tip: before relying on an answer for anything important, click through the citation and read the surrounding paragraph, since context around a quoted line can change its meaning.

name: Lyriccreator AI
tagline: Guided AI songwriting studio that builds structured lyrics from a single idea
description: Lyriccreator AI walks songwriters from a first idea through direction, song structure, hooks, verses and final polish, with style prompts for AI music tools and vocal studio features.
longDescription: Lyriccreator AI is a web songwriting studio that turns a short idea into finished, structured lyrics. Instead of producing one block of text, it guides you through steps: capturing the idea, setting a creative direction, choosing a song structure, then writing the hook, verses, pre-chorus or bridge and a final polish. Paid tiers add rhythm and meter checks, translation help, a hook wizard, a style creator that writes prompts for AI music generators, and a vocal studio for recording takes. Work runs on monthly credits with no daily song limit. A free plan offers starter credits for private use, and Standard costs $10 a month and allows commercial use of your own songs.
features: Style prompts for AI music tools
pros: Structured process instead of one text dump
Clear usage rights on each tier
cons: Free plan is for private use only
Client and ghostwriting rights need the top tier
moreContext:
Most lyric generators hand you a full song in one go, which leaves little room for your own voice. Lyriccreator AI takes a gentler approach, walking you through the craft of songwriting step by step so the final lyric still feels like yours. Starting from a single line, a feeling or an image, it helps shape a direction and structure before a single verse is written.

- A guided flow from idea to direction, structure, hook, verses, bridge and final polish
- Meter and rhythm checks that flag weak spots and help lines sit better on the beat
- A style creator that writes consistent prompts for AI music generators
- A vocal studio for recording and shaping takes against your lyrics
- Clearly stated usage rights per plan, from private use up to full commercial client work

It is best for songwriters, solo artists and bands who want help with structure and polish rather than a finished song written for them. Producers and agencies writing for clients will need the Professional tier for those rights. A practical tip: spend extra time on the first creative input step, since everything that follows builds on it, and a specific image or feeling gives far stronger results than a generic topic.

name: Reflect
tagline: Open-source networked note app with daily notes, backlinks and optional AI
description: Reflect is a note-taking app built around daily notes and backlinks, storing notes as local Markdown files, with an optional AI assistant that uses your own API key.
longDescription: Reflect is a note-taking app for people who like to connect ideas. Its current version, Reflect Open, is open source and keeps notes as Markdown files in a folder you choose, synced through iCloud Drive or Git. Each day starts with a daily note, and backlinks link related notes into a personal knowledge graph. You can save web clips, record audio memos and search past notes quickly. The optional AI assistant answers questions with links to your notes, summarizes text, pulls action items from meeting notes, fixes grammar and runs saved custom prompts, using your own provider API key. The Mac app is free, and the iPhone and iPad apps require a subscription.
features: Local Markdown files with iCloud or Git sync
AI answers linked to your own notes
pros: Free and open source on Mac
You own your files as plain Markdown
AI requests go straight to your provider
cons: AI needs your own API key and billing
Mobile apps require a paid subscription
moreContext:
Note apps often lock your writing inside their own servers, so it is refreshing to see one that hands control back to you. Reflect Open stores every note as a plain Markdown file in a folder you pick, and its AI features only run when you connect your own provider key. That makes it a thoughtful choice for anyone who values privacy and long-term ownership of their notes.

- Daily notes that give every day a natural starting page
- Backlinks that tie related notes together into a personal knowledge graph
- Local Markdown storage with your choice of iCloud Drive or Git for sync
- An optional AI assistant that answers questions with links back to source notes, summarizes and pulls out action items
- Web clips, audio memos and fast search for recalling past ideas

It is best for writers, researchers and knowledge workers who want a calm, connected notebook and are comfortable bringing their own AI key. Notes marked private are kept out of AI access, according to the company. A practical tip: if you mainly work on a Mac, start with the free app and Git sync, then add the paid iPhone app only once you find yourself wanting to capture ideas on the go.

name: Clever AI Detector
tagline: Free AI text checker with a probability score and sentence-level signals
description: Clever AI Detector estimates how likely a text was written by AI, showing an overall probability plus the individual sentences that drove the score, free and without sign-up.
longDescription: Clever AI Detector is a free web tool that estimates whether a piece of text was written by AI. You paste text or upload a file, between 80 and 10,000 words, and it returns an AI probability score along with highlighted sentences showing which parts read as machine-written. The site explains that it weighs signals such as predictable wording, regular rhythm and phrases common in AI output, and it stresses that results are a probability, not proof. Checks are unlimited, there are no ads, and signed-in users can keep a history of past checks. It works in English, Spanish and Portuguese and sits alongside a paraphraser and grammar checker on the same site.
pros: Honest about the limits of detection
cons: Less reliable on formal or heavily edited text
Supports only three languages
moreContext:
AI detectors are often sold as lie detectors, so it is refreshing to find one that is so candid about uncertainty. Clever AI Detector frames every result as a probability and shows the specific sentences that pushed the score up, which turns a vague verdict into something you can actually review. Being free, ad-free and unlimited makes it easy to keep in your regular editing routine.

- An overall AI probability score paired with sentence-level signals you can inspect
- Paste text or upload a file, with up to 10,000 words per check
- Unlimited checks with no ads and no paywall, according to the site
- Optional sign-in to keep a history of earlier checks
- Support for English, Spanish and Portuguese text

It is best for editors, content managers, SEO teams and writers who want a quick read on whether a draft sounds machine-made. The site says it ranked first on the GEDE education benchmark, though, like any detector, it can produce false positives. A practical tip: never treat a score as proof on its own, especially in school or hiring decisions; read the highlighted sentences, consider the writer's usual style and talk to them before drawing conclusions.

name: Ghosts
tagline: Research, drafting and fact-checking agents that write in your own voice
description: Ghosts runs a team of AI agents that research a topic, draft in your trained voice, fact-check the draft against its sources and shape it for where it will be published.
longDescription: Ghosts is a writing service for professionals who put their name, or a client's name, on published work. Each piece moves through a pipeline of agents: a short interview, a researcher that reads real sources, a planner, a writer trained on your own samples, a separate fact-checker that reads the draft against those sources, a line editor and a publishing editor. Writers learn from every edit you make, and you can review or undo each lesson. You can also bring in an existing draft to fact-check, humanize and tighten. It supports about 60 formats, from LinkedIn posts to speeches and book chapters, and works inside Claude through MCP. Plans start at $29 a month.
features: Writers trained on your own samples
pros: Fact-check report you can share with clients
cons: No free plan
Agency pricing only by quote
moreContext:
Readers have grown quick to spot generic AI prose, and Ghosts is built around that reality. Rather than one model producing a draft in one pass, it mirrors how a real editorial team works, with research first and a separate fact-checker reading the piece against its sources before it reaches you. That structure, plus writers trained on your own samples, is what makes its drafts feel considered rather than mass-produced.

- A pipeline of interview, research, planning, drafting, fact-checking, line editing and publishing editing
- A fact-checker agent that did not write the draft and checks statistics, dates and quotes against source text
- Writers trained on your samples that learn from each edit, with every lesson visible and reversible
- Draft import for fact-checking, humanizing, tightening and plain English passes you approve one at a time
- About 60 formats, a readiness check for search and AI answers, and access from Claude through MCP

It is best for ghostwriters, PR professionals, speechwriters, newsletter authors and agencies who write in many voices. A practical tip: feed the writer several strong samples of the exact voice you want, then make your edits on early drafts deliberately, since each correction becomes a lesson that shapes the next piece.

name: Aimusicgen
tagline: Turn a text description or your own lyrics into a song with vocals or instrumental
description: Aimusicgen is a browser-based AI music generator that creates songs from a description or lyrics, with a lyrics writer, song cover tool and free daily credits for signed-in users.
longDescription: Aimusicgen is a web app for making songs with AI. In Simple mode you describe the mood, story or sound you want, pick a genre and choose vocals or an instrumental. Custom mode lets you paste your own lyrics and describe the style separately. Extra tools include a lyrics generator that drafts editable lyrics from a topic, a lyrics to song tool, a genre and mood composer and an AI song cover generator that rewrites lyrics or switches the genre of an uploaded track. Songs can be downloaded and stay private unless you share them. Signed-in users get daily free credits, while paid plans from $14.90 a month add more generations, longer storage and commercial use rights.
features: Text to song with vocals or instrumental
Custom mode for your own lyrics
cons: No commercial rights on the free plan
Free songs are stored for only 7 days
moreContext:
Making a song usually takes instruments, recording gear and a lot of patience, but Aimusicgen lowers the barrier to a sentence or two of description. It keeps the experience simple for beginners while still giving lyricists a way to bring their own words, which makes it a pleasant starting point for casual music making.

- Simple mode that turns a short description of a mood or story into a full track
- Custom mode where you paste lyrics and set genre, mood and instruments separately
- A lyrics generator that drafts editable lyrics from any topic
- An AI song cover tool that can rewrite the lyrics or change the genre of an uploaded song
- Private creations by default, with downloads and optional sharing

It is best for hobbyists, content creators and anyone who wants a quick custom song for a video, gift or celebration. Paid tiers are needed if you plan to use tracks commercially, and they also keep songs stored longer. A practical tip: be specific in your prompt, naming the tempo, instruments and the feeling of the chorus, and download any free tracks you like soon, since free plan songs are only stored for a week.

name: iTranslate
tagline: Translate text, voice, photos and conversations across 100+ languages
description: iTranslate is a translation app for text, speech and camera input in more than 100 languages, with offline translation, a keyboard extension and companion apps for conversation and learning.
longDescription: iTranslate is a mobile and web translation service covering more than 100 languages. You can type text and get translations with alternatives and autocomplete, speak and hear your words translated aloud, or point your phone camera at menus, signs and cards to read them in your language. Offline packs work without an internet connection, which helps avoid roaming costs, and a keyboard extension translates inside messaging apps. The family also includes iTranslate Converse for two-way spoken conversations, iTranslate Voice, iTranslate Lingo for language learning and a web translator. The company describes privacy as a core value in how it builds its products. The core app is free, with a Pro subscription for advanced features.
features: Camera translation for signs and menus
pros: Covers text, voice and camera in one app
cons: Advanced features need a Pro subscription
Offline voice limited to a few languages
moreContext:
Travel and work across languages go much more smoothly when translation fits in your pocket, and iTranslate has spent years refining exactly that experience. What stands out is how many ways it accepts input: typing, speaking or simply pointing a camera at a sign. Offline support adds real peace of mind when you are abroad without reliable data.

- Text translation in more than 100 languages, with autocomplete and alternative phrasings
- Voice translation that listens and speaks the result aloud, with some languages available offline
- Camera translation for menus, signs, business cards and other printed text
- A keyboard extension that translates directly inside messaging apps
- Companion apps, including Converse for live conversations and Lingo for language learning

It is best for travelers, students, business professionals and healthcare or service staff who regularly communicate with people who speak other languages. A practical tip: download the offline language packs you will need before a trip while you still have Wi-Fi, so camera and text translation keep working when you land without a data connection.

name: Picturesque AI
tagline: One creative studio and credit wallet for 100+ image, video and music AI models
description: Picturesque AI brings image, video, audio and editing models from several providers into one workspace with a shared credit wallet, free daily credits and paid plans from $9 a month.
longDescription: Picturesque AI is a web studio that gives one account access to more than 100 generative models from different providers for images, video, audio, editing and motion control. Image Studio covers photorealistic portraits, product shots, logos and illustrations, Video Studio handles text and image to video, and an edit studio offers upscaling. A Director mode uses chat models to help plan projects. Each model page lists its credit cost and supported resolutions, and you can reuse prompts across models to compare results side by side. Your generation history stays in the workspace for later variations. The free tier provides daily credits, there is a low-cost trial, and paid plans start at $9 a month.
pros: Credit cost shown before you generate
One bill instead of many subscriptions
cons: Video models use credits quickly
Third-party models, not its own
moreContext:
Keeping up with every new image and video model can mean a stack of separate subscriptions. Picturesque AI gathers more than 100 of them behind one login and one credit wallet, so you can try a new release the day it appears without signing up somewhere else. Its habit of showing the credit cost and supported resolutions on each model page makes budgeting straightforward.

- Image, video, audio, edit and motion control studios in a single workspace
- Prompts that can be reused across models to compare outputs side by side
- Clear per-generation credit costs listed before you spend anything
- A Director mode that uses chat models to help plan a project
- Workspace history that saves past settings so you can branch new variations

It is best for marketers, ecommerce teams, filmmakers and freelancers who want to test several models for a brief without juggling accounts. The site notes that it is an independent studio, not an OpenAI or ChatGPT product. A practical tip: use the free daily credits on image models to settle the look of a concept, and save credits for video generation, which costs considerably more per result, until your direction is locked.

name: Marble
tagline: Generate explorable, editable 3D worlds from text, images, video or layouts
description: Marble is the world model app from World Labs that turns prompts, photos, videos or rough 3D layouts into persistent 3D environments you can edit, expand and export.
longDescription: Marble is the first product from World Labs, the spatial intelligence company founded by Fei-Fei Li, Justin Johnson, Christoph Lassner and Ben Mildenhall. It generates spatially consistent 3D worlds from text, single or multiple images, video clips, 360 panoramas or coarse 3D layouts. Once a world exists, users can edit specific elements, expand it outward or combine several worlds into a larger scene. Finished worlds can be exported as Gaussian splats, meshes or videos for use in game engines, VFX pipelines, design reviews and robotics simulation. Marble runs in the browser on a credit system, with a free tier for a few generations each month and paid plans that add more inputs and modes.
features: Text, image, video and panorama inputs
Export as splats, meshes or video
pros: Produces persistent 3D spaces, not just clips
cons: Free tier allows only a few worlds a month
Advanced modes require higher paid plans
moreContext:
Most generative tools stop at a flat image or a short video, but Marble produces a 3D place you can actually move through and keep working on. It comes from World Labs, a research-led company whose founders are well known in computer vision and graphics, and that pedigree shows in how much control the app gives over structure and layout. World Labs announced in September 2026 that it is joining AMD, so it is worth watching how the product evolves.

- Accepts text, photos, multiple images, video and 360 panoramas as starting points
- Layout-based generation lets you block out a scene before the model fills in detail
- Worlds can be edited piece by piece, expanded outward or merged with other worlds
- Exports as Gaussian splats, meshes or video, so results move into engines and editors
- Marble Labs offers tutorials, case studies and community examples for getting started

Marble is best for game designers, VFX artists, architects and robotics teams who need quick, explorable 3D environments for previs, prototyping or simulation. A practical tip: start with a single strong reference image on the free tier to learn how the model interprets space, then move to layout-based generation once you need precise control over where things sit.

name: Virse
tagline: Infinite AI canvas that puts references, 50+ models and design agents in one workspace
description: Virse is a creative workspace for designers and brand teams that combines an infinite canvas, an asset library, dozens of image and video models and an on-canvas AI agent.
longDescription: Virse is a collaborative AI design platform aimed at professional designers, studios and brand teams. Work happens on an infinite canvas where users gather references, generate images and video, and keep every version connected to the context that produced it. The platform offers access to more than 50 third-party image and video models, including FLUX, Seedream, Kling and Veo, alongside custom aesthetic models that capture a team's visual style. A built-in agent called Composer reads what is on the canvas and can carry out multi-step tasks such as producing scene shots from a product reference. Plans range from a free tier with 200 credits to paid personal and team seats.
features: Infinite canvas for references and outputs
Access to 50+ image and video models
Composer agent that acts on canvas context
Shared asset library and team seats
pros: Many leading models in one place
Keeps creative context connected across versions
cons: Credit system needs monitoring on heavy use
Free plan limits canvases and assets
moreContext:
Rather than offering a single model behind a prompt box, Virse treats AI generation as one part of a wider design process. References, mood boards, generated images and video all live on the same infinite canvas, so the reasoning behind a visual stays visible as a project moves from concept to final asset. That approach suits teams who iterate on product and campaign imagery together.

- Brings dozens of image and video models, such as FLUX, Seedream, Kling and Veo, into one interface
- The Composer agent reads images, text and connections on the canvas before taking action
- Aesthetic models help teams keep a consistent house style across outputs
- An asset library and multi-seat plans support studio and brand collaboration
- Interface is available in several languages, including Chinese, Spanish and Japanese

Virse is best for packaging, product, footwear and campaign designers who need many visual variations while keeping a clear link to their references. A practical tip: load your real product photos and brand references into the asset library first, then let Composer generate scene variations from them, which tends to give more consistent results than starting from a blank prompt.

name: Short.now
tagline: Turn long videos into captioned, speaker-tracked vertical shorts automatically
description: Short.now finds the strongest moments in podcasts, webinars and YouTube videos, then cuts them into captioned 9:16 shorts with hooks, titles and hashtags.
longDescription: Short.now is an AI clipping tool for YouTubers, podcasters, coaches and marketing teams who want to repurpose long recordings. Users paste a YouTube link or upload a file, and the system transcribes the audio, scores candidate moments on hook, flow and value, and explains each score. It then reframes clips to vertical format by tracking the active speaker, adds word-timed captions from style presets, and burns an opening hook onto the first frames. Paid plans add titles, descriptions, hashtags, exportable captions and direct posting to TikTok, YouTube and Instagram. A free plan gives three videos to start and one more each week, with no watermark.
features: Auto-posting to TikTok, YouTube and Instagram
pros: Free plan exports without a watermark
Pricing is per video, not confusing credits
Clear reasons behind each clip score
cons: Free plan caps videos at 30 minutes
Auto-posting requires Creator plan or higher
moreContext:
Short.now keeps the clipping workflow simple: upload one long video and get back a set of ready-to-post shorts. What sets it apart is transparency, because every suggested clip comes with a score and a short explanation, which helps creators decide what to publish instead of guessing. The pricing model is also easy to follow, since plans count uploaded videos rather than abstract credits.

- Tracks the active speaker and cuts between faces in two-person conversations
- Captions are timed word by word and can be edited or translated before export
- Writes an on-screen hook for the first second of each clip
- Generates titles, descriptions and hashtags on paid plans
- Offers a three-day money-back guarantee on the first payment

Short.now is best for podcasters, interviewers and educators whose content is mostly spoken, since the moment scoring relies heavily on what is said. A practical tip: set a target clip length before processing, then review the top-scored clips first and adjust in and out points manually, which saves time compared with scrolling through every suggestion.

name: Listomize
tagline: Free AI tools for writing and scoring e-commerce product titles, descriptions and keywords
description: Listomize offers free AI generators for product titles, descriptions and keywords, plus a listing optimizer and score checker for Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce and eBay sellers.
longDescription: Listomize is a set of AI writing tools built for online sellers. It includes a product title generator, a product description generator, a keyword generator, a listing optimizer that rewrites existing copy, and a listing score checker that rates overall quality. Sellers enter product details, choose the tool they need and review the suggestions before pasting them into their store. The tools are tuned for marketplace listings on Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce and eBay, with an emphasis on search-friendly wording. All available tools are currently free with no credit card required, and the company says premium plans may come later.
cons: No bulk or catalog-wide processing mentioned
Young product with a limited feature set
moreContext:
Writing listing copy is one of the most repetitive jobs in running an online store, and Listomize focuses narrowly on that task. Instead of a general chatbot, it offers separate tools for titles, descriptions, keywords and overall listing quality, each shaped around how marketplace search works. Everything available today is free, which makes it an easy tool to try.

- Separate generators for titles, descriptions and keywords keep each step focused
- The listing optimizer improves copy you already have rather than starting from scratch
- A score checker gives a quick read on how complete and clear a listing is
- Guidance is tailored to Amazon, Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce and eBay
- No payment details are required to start

Listomize is best for small sellers and solo shop owners who list products one at a time and want a faster first draft. A practical tip: run your current best-selling listing through the score checker first, then use the optimizer on weaker listings so you can compare results against something that already performs well.

name: RemoveMate
tagline: Automatic AI background removal and photo cleanup with free weekly credits
description: RemoveMate removes backgrounds from product, portrait and pet photos automatically, with extra tools for unblurring images and removing text, plus pay-once credit packs.
longDescription: RemoveMate is a web-based image editing service focused on background removal. Users upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image and processing starts right away with no prompt to write; the AI detects the subject, separates it from the background and shows a before and after preview for download. Related tools cover unblurring images and removing text or unwanted details, and the site notes that some AI edits use OpenAI's GPT Image 2. It suits online sellers, people updating profile photos and makers preparing portfolio shots. A free tier gives 10 credits every week without sign-up, and larger needs are covered by one-time credit packs that never expire.
pros: No sign-up needed for free credits
cons: Free tier is limited to 10 credits a week
Fine edges like hair may need manual checks
moreContext:
RemoveMate keeps background removal about as simple as it can be: drop in a photo and the cutout appears without any prompt or settings to fiddle with. Its pricing is also refreshingly direct, with a weekly free allowance and one-time packs instead of a monthly subscription, which suits people who only edit photos now and then.

- Processing starts automatically on upload, so there is nothing to configure
- Works well for product shots, portraits, pets and handmade objects
- Extra tools handle unblurring, text removal and small cleanups
- Purchased credits never expire, and unused packs can be refunded within seven days
- The site is upfront that AI edits can alter details and should be checked

RemoveMate is best for small online sellers, crafters and anyone who needs a clean cutout occasionally without committing to a plan. A practical tip: use a photo with good contrast between the subject and the background, then zoom into the preview around straps, fur or thin stems before downloading, since those areas are where touch-ups are most often needed.

name: ModiFace
tagline: L'Oréal's AI and AR platform for virtual makeup, hair color and skin analysis
description: ModiFace, a L'Oréal company, provides augmented reality try-on and AI skin diagnostics that beauty brands and retailers embed in their websites, apps and stores.
longDescription: ModiFace develops augmented reality and AI technology for the beauty industry. Its services include virtual try-on for makeup and hair color, selfie-based skin analysis powered by deep learning models trained on clinical skin datasets, personalized product recommendations and teleconsultation tools. Brands and retailers integrate these experiences into e-commerce sites, apps and in-store displays so shoppers can preview products on their own face before buying. The company began as a computer vision research project led by University of Toronto professor Parham Aarabi and was acquired by L'Oréal in 2018. It works with businesses rather than individual consumers, and pricing is arranged directly.
features: AI skin analysis from a selfie
pros: Long research track record in beauty AR
Covers makeup, hair and skin in one platform
cons: Built for brands, not individual users
No public pricing
moreContext:
ModiFace has spent many years on one problem: showing shoppers how a beauty product will look on them before they buy it. It grew out of academic computer vision research in Toronto, and since joining L'Oréal in 2018 its technology has powered try-on and diagnostic experiences across the group and partner retailers. The company says its tools have handled more than a billion virtual try-on sessions.

- Realistic color rendering for lipstick, foundation, eyeshadow and hair dye previews
- Skin analysis turns a single selfie into a structured assessment for routine suggestions
- Teleconsultation tools let beauty advisors guide customers remotely
- Experiences are built to run on phones, desktops and in-store screens
- The team states it trains models on a wide range of skin tones, facial features and hair types

ModiFace is best for beauty brands, retailers and marketplaces that want to add try-on or skin diagnostics to their digital shopping journey. A practical tip: when planning an integration, start with the product category where shade matching causes the most returns or hesitation, such as foundation or hair color, since that is where virtual previews tend to help shoppers most.

name: Amazon Nova
tagline: Chat with Amazon's Nova models and get a free API key to build agents
description: Amazon Nova is Amazon's family of foundation models, with a web app for chatting, generating text and code and trying agents, plus API and AWS access for developers.
longDescription: Amazon Nova covers both a consumer-facing playground and a portfolio of models and services for builders. On nova.amazon.com, people can sign in with an Amazon account to chat, write, generate code and try capabilities such as Nova 2 Lite, the Nova 2 Sonic speech-to-speech model and Nova Act for browser automation agents. Developers can request a free Nova API key to start experimenting, then move to AWS, where Nova models run through Amazon Bedrock with usage-based pricing. AWS also offers Nova Forge for building custom frontier models. Amazon says the technology grew out of work behind its own services, including Alexa+ and Amazon Ads.
features: Web chat for text and code generation
Nova Act for browser automation agents
Free API key with AWS Bedrock scaling
pros: Free to try with an Amazon account
Clear path from playground to production on AWS
Covers text, speech and agent use cases
cons: Production use runs through AWS pricing and setup
Smaller consumer ecosystem than leading chatbots
moreContext:
Amazon Nova gives a direct look at the models Amazon has built for its own products and now offers to everyone. The web app is a low-friction way to compare Nova against other assistants, while developers get a straightforward route from a free API key to full deployment on AWS. Amazon says tens of thousands of customers already use Nova models and services.

- Sign in with an existing Amazon account to start chatting right away
- Nova 2 Lite is positioned as a fast, cost-effective reasoning model for everyday tasks
- Nova Act focuses on reliable agents that automate browser-based workflows
- Nova 2 Sonic supports natural, real-time voice conversations
- Models include built-in content filters and safety controls for enterprise use

Amazon Nova is best for developers and teams already working in AWS who want to test models before wiring them into Bedrock, as well as curious users comparing assistants. A practical tip: prototype prompts in the free web app first, note which model handles your task best, and only then request an API key so your first AWS experiments start from a tested setup.

name: Microsoft Bing
tagline: Microsoft's search engine with Copilot AI answers, image creation and visual search
description: Microsoft Bing is a web search engine that layers AI features on top of classic results, including Copilot Search answers and the free Bing Image Creator.
longDescription: Microsoft Bing is Microsoft's general web search engine, covering web pages, images, video, news, maps and shopping. Its AI layer includes Copilot Search, an AI mode that generates summarized answers with links to sources, and Bing Image Creator, a free text-to-image tool that uses Microsoft's MAI image models and can also remix uploaded photos. Bing is the default search in Microsoft Edge and Windows and is free to use, with sign-in adding history and saved creations. It suits everyday searchers who want quick AI summaries alongside traditional results, and people who want free image generation without a separate account.
features: Image, video, news and map search
pros: AI answers sit alongside regular results
cons: AI summaries can still contain errors
Best experience tied to Microsoft accounts and Edge
moreContext:
Bing combines a mature, full-featured search engine with AI tools that most people can use without paying anything. You can switch between classic results and Copilot Search depending on whether you want a list of links or a synthesized answer, which makes it flexible for both quick lookups and broader research questions. Image generation is built in as well, so the same tab can serve as a light creative tool.

- Copilot Search gives AI-generated overviews with links back to sources
- Bing Image Creator offers free text-to-image generation and image remixing
- Covers web, images, video, news, maps, shopping and flights in one place
- Integrates with Microsoft Edge, Windows and Microsoft 365 apps
- Labels AI-generated content so it is clear when results come from a model

Bing is best for everyday users in the Microsoft ecosystem who want AI answers without a separate subscription. A practical tip: use Copilot Search for open-ended questions, then open the cited links to confirm key facts, and switch back to the standard results tab when you need to compare several sources quickly.

name: SynthID Detector
tagline: Google's free portal for checking media for SynthID AI watermarks
description: SynthID Detector is Google DeepMind's verification portal that scans uploaded images, video and audio for invisible SynthID watermarks left by participating AI generators.
longDescription: SynthID Detector is a web portal from Google DeepMind for checking whether a piece of media was created with AI tools that embed SynthID, Google's invisible watermarking technology. Users sign in, upload an image, video or audio file, and the portal reports whether a watermark is present. Launched in 2025 as a limited tool for journalists and researchers, it was opened to the public in October 2026, according to news reports, and now also recognizes watermarks from partners including OpenAI, NVIDIA and Kakao. It is free with daily usage limits. A negative result does not prove content is human made, since many generators do not use SynthID.
features: Watermark checks for images, video and audio
Recognizes marks from several AI vendors
pros: Detects an embedded signal rather than guessing from style
cons: Only finds watermarks from participating vendors
Daily limits and no bulk checking
moreContext:
Many AI detectors try to guess from patterns whether content was machine made, which can produce shaky results. SynthID Detector works differently: it looks for an invisible watermark that participating generators embed at creation time, so a positive match is a much stronger signal. Google built it around its own models and, according to news coverage, has extended it to content from OpenAI, NVIDIA and Kakao.

- Checks images, video and audio files for the SynthID watermark
- Part of Google DeepMind's broader work on responsible AI and provenance
- Recognizes watermarks from multiple AI companies, not only Google
- Free web access for anyone willing to sign in
- Usage rules limit daily checks and prohibit automated bulk scanning

SynthID Detector is best for journalists, fact-checkers, educators and curious users who want to verify whether a suspicious image or clip came from a major AI generator. A practical tip: treat a positive result as strong evidence but a negative result as inconclusive, and pair the check with reverse image search and source verification before drawing conclusions.

name: FreeMaker
tagline: Multi-model AI video, image, music and avatar maker with free starter credits
description: FreeMaker is a web studio that lets you generate videos and images with models such as Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance and Hailuo, plus AI music, avatars and effects templates.
longDescription: FreeMaker is an online creation platform that brings several third-party generative models into a single workflow. Users can turn text or images into video with models including Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance, Grok Imagine, Hailuo and Wan, create images with Nano Banana, and add AI music, voice and talking avatars. A library of effects templates and an agent-style workflow help assemble short clips for ads and social posts. New users get free credits on login and can earn more through daily check-ins, while Lite, Pro and Premium subscriptions add larger monthly credit allowances, higher resolution output, watermark-free exports and commercial use rights.
features: Access to Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance and more
AI image, music and avatar tools
pros: Many popular models under one login
Free credits to test before paying
cons: Credits run out quickly on premium models
Lower tier is limited to 720p output
moreContext:
Trying several of today's best-known video models usually means juggling separate accounts and subscriptions, and FreeMaker removes that hassle by putting them behind one login. You pick a model, enter a prompt or upload an image, and the platform handles the rest, which makes side-by-side comparisons easy for creators who are still finding the look they want. Image, music and avatar tools sit in the same workspace, so a full short clip can be assembled in one place.

- Switch between Veo 3.1, Kling, Seedance, Hailuo, Wan and other models in one interface
- Generates images, music, voice and avatars alongside video
- Templates and effects speed up common formats like product ads and social clips
- Daily check-in rewards add small amounts of free credits
- Paid plans remove watermarks and allow commercial use

FreeMaker is best for social media creators and small marketing teams who want to experiment across models before settling on one. A practical tip: spend your free credits on short test clips with the same prompt across two or three models, then subscribe only once you know which model suits your style, since premium models use credits much faster.

name: GetResponse
tagline: Email marketing and automation platform with built-in AI content generators
description: GetResponse combines email campaigns, automation workflows, landing pages, and course tools, with AI generators that help draft emails and pages faster.
longDescription: GetResponse is an email marketing platform for small businesses, ecommerce stores, and creators who want list building, campaigns, and automation in one account. Every plan includes unlimited monthly email sends and AI content generators that help write newsletters, subject lines, and landing page copy. Higher tiers add unlimited automation workflows, advanced segmentation, abandoned cart recovery, sales funnels, webinars, a website builder, and a course creator for selling knowledge products. Users build signup forms and popups to grow their audience, then send campaigns or set up triggered sequences. A 14-day trial gives access to premium features before choosing a monthly or annual plan, and an Enterprise tier covers dedicated IPs and SSO.
features: AI email and landing page generators
pros: Unlimited email sends on every plan
Long track record in email marketing
cons: Automation is limited on the Starter plan
Costs rise quickly on higher tiers
moreContext:
What we appreciate about GetResponse is how much of a small marketing stack it folds into a single login. Email campaigns, automations, landing pages, popups, and even webinars and online courses live side by side, so a solo founder or a small team can run a full funnel without stitching several services together. The AI generators sit inside that workflow rather than off to the side, which makes drafting a campaign feel quicker.

- Unlimited monthly email sends are included on every paid plan, so list growth does not push you into a new price bracket for sending volume.
- AI content generators help produce email copy, subject lines, and landing page text as a starting draft you can edit.
- The Marketer tier adds abandoned cart recovery, promo codes, and revenue reports that suit ecommerce stores.
- The Creator tier bundles a course creator, premium newsletter subscriptions, and webinars for people selling knowledge products.
- More than 170 integrations connect it to common ecommerce and CRM tools, according to the company.

GetResponse is a strong fit for small businesses, online stores, and creators who want email and automation in one place without stepping up to an enterprise suite. A practical tip: use the 14-day trial to build one real automation, such as a welcome series, so you can judge whether the Starter plan's single custom workflow is enough or whether you will need Marketer.

name: Google Translate
tagline: Free translation for text, speech, images, documents, and websites
description: Google Translate converts text, voice, photos, documents, and full webpages between languages on the web and mobile, with offline packs and live conversation mode.
longDescription: Google Translate is Google's free translation service for the web, Android, and iOS. It handles typed text, voice input, handwriting, photos taken with the camera, uploaded documents, and entire websites entered by URL. Document translation keeps the original formatting in place, and a conversation mode lets two people speaking different languages talk through one device. The mobile app can download language packs for offline use and offers a transcribe feature that translates ongoing speech. Saved phrases sync across devices for quick reuse. It is aimed at travelers, students, and anyone who needs a fast way to understand or communicate across languages, and it relies on Google's machine translation models behind the scenes.
features: Camera translation of signs and menus
pros: Works across web, Android, and iOS
Handles text, voice, images, and files
cons: Nuance and idioms can be lost in longer texts
Not a substitute for certified or legal translation
moreContext:
Few tools are as quietly useful as Google Translate. It covers nearly every way you might meet a foreign language in daily life: a menu photographed with your phone, a PDF from a colleague, a webpage, or a face-to-face conversation. Because it is free and available on every major platform, it often becomes the first translation tool people reach for and the one they keep.

- Camera translation overlays translated text on signs, labels, and menus in real time.
- Document upload translates files in place while keeping their original layout.
- Conversation and transcribe modes help two people talk, or follow a speaker, across languages.
- Offline language packs keep it working when you travel without a data connection.
- Saved translations sync between devices, which is handy for building a personal phrasebook.

It is best for travelers, students, and anyone who needs quick understanding rather than polished prose. A practical tip: before a trip, download the offline packs for the languages you expect to need, and for anything important, such as a contract or medical note, use the translation to grasp the meaning and then confirm with a fluent speaker.

name: Keeper
tagline: AI-assisted matchmaking service for people looking to get married
description: Keeper pairs human matchmakers with data and AI to introduce singles to vetted, mutually compatible matches, aimed at people seeking marriage rather than casual dating.
longDescription: Keeper is an AI-assisted matchmaking service for adults who want a long-term partner and marriage rather than casual dates. Members share detailed preferences and background, and Keeper combines human matchmakers with data such as personality and other predictive traits to propose introductions only when both people meet each other's standards. It also gathers feedback from people who match a member's preferences and turns it into suggestions on profile, photos, and presentation. The service operates mainly in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom and is English only. A free tier matches members with paying members, while the Marriage Bounty plan charges per match after both sides approve.
pros: Introductions only when both sides fit
cons: Network is limited outside the US, Canada, and UK
Free members may wait longer for matches
moreContext:
Keeper takes a refreshingly direct stance in a crowded dating market: it is built for people who want to marry, and it says so plainly. Instead of endless swiping, it blends human matchmakers with data and AI to make fewer, more deliberate introductions, and it only connects two people when each meets the other's stated standards.

- Matches are vetted in both directions, so introductions are meant to reflect mutual fit rather than one-sided interest.
- Members can describe any preference that matters to them, and the team discusses flexibility before making exceptions.
- Feedback from people who fit a member's preferences is turned into practical advice on profile, photos, and presentation.
- The Marriage Bounty model ties most of the company's revenue to members finding a relationship, according to Keeper.
- Matching can be paused at any time without penalty.

Keeper is best for adults in the US, Canada, or UK who are ready for a committed relationship and are willing to share detailed information about themselves. A practical tip: the more specific and honest your preferences and background are, the better Keeper can target introductions, so set aside time to complete your profile thoroughly before your first match.

name: Synthreel
tagline: Hands-free animated YouTube videos, from script to scheduled upload
description: Synthreel writes scripts, generates animated visuals, adds voiceover and captions, and publishes finished videos to your YouTube channel on a schedule you set.
longDescription: Synthreel is an AI video service for people running faceless YouTube channels. You create a channel profile with a niche, visual style, tone, and caption style, then chat with its script writer about a topic. The system drafts a script and style brief, generates animated scenes in looks such as dark anime, 3D animated, or cartoon, adds AI narration and word-by-word captions, and produces a thumbnail. Videos usually take 5 to 10 minutes to render. Once a YouTube account is connected, higher plans can publish automatically on a posting schedule and cut highlight clips for Shorts, TikTok, and Reels. A history tracker helps each new video cover a fresh topic.
pros: Covers scripting through publishing in one flow
cons: No free plan, and entry pricing is high
Low monthly video counts on the base plan
moreContext:
Synthreel aims at a very specific job: keeping an animated, faceless YouTube channel fed with new videos without you editing anything by hand. What stands out is how far it carries each video. It moves from topic conversation to script, visuals, narration, captions, thumbnail, and finally the upload itself, so the creator's role shifts toward choosing ideas and approving results.

- Each channel stores its own niche, tone, visual style, and caption look, so videos stay consistent over time.
- Visual styles include dark anime, cinematic, 3D animated, and cartoon looks.
- Captions and an opening hook overlay are burned into each video during generation.
- On Pro and Autopilot plans, finished videos can publish straight to YouTube on a schedule, and highlight clips can go to TikTok and Reels.
- A topic history helps avoid repeating subjects the channel has already covered.

Synthreel is best for creators or small media operators who want to run one or more animated channels with minimal production time. A practical tip: the setup screen asks for your channel niche, and the more specific you are (for example, a narrow history theme rather than just history), the more focused and distinct the scripts tend to be.

name: Photoreal AI
tagline: Browser workspace for AI image generation and reference-guided photo edits
description: Photoreal AI lets you create images from prompts or upload reference photos and describe changes, choosing from several image models plus extra tools like background and watermark removal.
longDescription: Photoreal AI is a web-based image workspace that covers both text-to-image generation and image-to-image editing. Users can upload up to four reference images, describe the change they want, and pick from several third-party image models, along with aspect ratio and quality settings. A prompt optimizer helps refine instructions, and a gallery of ready-made prompts offers starting points. Related tools include a transparent background maker, watermark remover, object eraser, and old photo restoration. It targets content creators, online sellers, designers, and marketers who want photo edits without desktop software. Usage runs on credits, sold as one-time packs that do not expire or through monthly and yearly subscriptions.
features: Edits guided by up to four reference images
Background, watermark, and object removal tools
pros: Combines generation and editing in one place
cons: Each generation consumes credits
Relies on third-party models rather than its own
moreContext:
Photoreal AI is useful because it puts several popular image models behind one simple editing screen. Rather than learning a different interface for each model, you upload a photo, describe what should change, and compare results, which suits people who care more about the finished picture than about the technology behind it.

- Reference-guided editing accepts up to four images, which helps when you want to merge a product, a person, and a setting.
- A model picker lets you switch between several image models and compare their output for the same prompt.
- The prompt optimizer and a curated prompt gallery give beginners a quicker path to usable results.
- Extra utilities cover transparent backgrounds, watermark removal, object erasing, and old photo restoration.
- One-time credit packs do not expire, which works well for occasional users.

It is a good match for social media creators, small online sellers, and marketers who need product shots or restyled photos without opening desktop editing software. A practical tip: since credit cost varies by model and quality setting, run a test edit on a lower setting first, then spend the higher-cost credits only on the version you plan to keep.

name: Tinta Piel
tagline: Virtual tattoo simulator that previews designs on your own photo
description: Tinta Piel's Spanish-language simulator places a tattoo design on a photo of your body, lets you adjust size and position, and offers an AI effect that blends the ink with the skin.
longDescription: Tinta Piel is a Spanish-language tattoo website whose main tool is a virtual tattoo simulator. You upload a photo of the body area, or use sample models, then add a design from its gallery or your own PNG or JPG. Each tattoo layer can be moved, rotated, scaled, mirrored, and made more or less opaque, and the result can be exported, all in the browser without installing an app. An optional AI effect renders the tattoo as if it were real ink, respecting skin lighting, curves, and texture, and takes a few minutes per generation. Manual compositions are free, a new account includes one free AI try, and more AI renders use paid credits.
features: Place designs on your own photo
Move, rotate, scale, and mirror layers
AI effect that blends ink with skin
pros: Manual previews are free with no account
Helps judge size and placement before a studio visit
cons: Interface and guides are in Spanish only
AI renders require paid credits after the first try
moreContext:
Tinta Piel solves a very human problem: committing to a tattoo you cannot easily undo. Its simulator lets you see a design on your own arm, leg, or back before you book a session, and the manual editor is free, so you can experiment with size and placement as much as you like before spending anything.

- You can work from your own photo or from sample male and female models in different body areas.
- Each design layer supports moving, rotating, scaling, mirroring, and opacity changes.
- The optional AI effect re-renders the tattoo to follow skin light, curvature, and texture for a more realistic preview.
- Compositions made without AI stay in your browser, and the site says AI photos are not published or used for model training.
- Credit plans range from a one-time pack to monthly and yearly options.

It is best for Spanish-speaking users planning a first or new tattoo who want a realistic sense of proportion before talking to an artist. A practical tip: finalize the size and position with the free manual tools first, then spend your AI credits only on the one or two layouts you are seriously considering.

name: LifeOS AI
tagline: Personal life operating system with an AI coach across five life areas
description: LifeOS AI tracks goals, habits, health, finances, and learning in one dashboard, with an AI coach that reasons across life areas and suggests actions you approve.
longDescription: LifeOS AI is a personal life management app built around a Life Wheel with five pillars: health, finance, productivity, relationships, and learning. Users set goals with milestones, track habits and streaks, log workouts, meals, sleep, and mood, and import bank statements to manage money. An AI coach looks across all these areas, generates priorities, and proposes actions that the user approves before anything changes. A dashboard rolls everything into an overall life score. Beyond individuals, LifeOS offers plans for coaches, therapists, advisors, and employers who want to work with clients or staff inside the platform. It was built in South Africa, priced in rand, and is currently in beta.
features: Bank statement import with AI extraction
pros: Covers health, money, and goals in one app
cons: Still in beta with no published reviews yet
Pricing in rand may be less familiar to users elsewhere
moreContext:
LifeOS AI takes the familiar Life Wheel exercise and turns it into a working dashboard. Instead of juggling a habit app, a budget tool, and a fitness log, you track all five areas in one place, and an AI coach looks for connections between them, such as how sleep or spending might affect a goal you set.

- Goals break down into milestones, and habits show streaks to keep momentum visible.
- Health logging covers workouts, meals, sleep, and mood in the same app as your goals.
- Bank statement import uses AI to extract transactions, saving manual data entry.
- The AI coach proposes actions but waits for your approval before applying them.
- Professional plans let coaches, therapists, and advisors invite and support clients inside the platform.

LifeOS AI suits people who like structured self-improvement and want one view of their whole life, as well as coaches who want to work alongside clients' real data. A practical tip: start with the free Explorer tier and fill in just one or two pillars, such as habits and health, before adding finances, so the AI coach has consistent data to work with from the beginning.

name: Business Pitch
tagline: Turn a short business idea into a structured pitch and shareable deck
description: Business Pitch expands a brief description of your idea into a complete pitch with value proposition, market context, summary, visuals, and a deck you can share.
longDescription: Business Pitch is a web tool that helps founders and entrepreneurs turn rough business ideas into presentable pitches. You type a short description of the concept, and its AI expands it into a structured package that includes a value proposition, a business summary, market breakdowns, brand visuals, and a pitch deck ready to share with investors, partners, or customers. The output draws on common pitch frameworks and value proposition design. The site also offers a browsable ideas section and lets you send finished pitches. A free plan allows three pitch creations per week, and paid plans raise the limit and remove ads, with the top tier adding weekly live pitch reviews.
features: Weekly live pitch reviews on top plan
pros: Fast first draft from a short prompt
cons: Market figures need independent checking
Limited deck customization compared with presentation tools
moreContext:
Business Pitch is built for the moment when an idea is still a sentence in your head and you need something you can actually show people. It takes that short description and returns a structured pitch with the sections investors and partners usually expect, which gives first-time founders a clear framework to react to and refine.

- A short idea description is enough to generate a full pitch package.
- Output covers a value proposition, business summary, market context, and brand visuals.
- A finished pitch deck can be shared directly with investors, partners, or stakeholders.
- The free plan includes three pitch creations per week, which is enough to test several concepts.
- The Founder tier adds weekly live pitch reviews for more hands-on feedback.

It is best for early-stage founders, students in entrepreneurship programs, and side-project builders who want a quick, organized first draft. A practical tip: treat the market numbers and claims in the generated pitch as placeholders, and replace them with figures from your own research before you present to anyone who will scrutinize the details.

name: AInvest
tagline: AI stock research app with chart analysis, signals, and backtesting
description: AInvest pairs market news, charts, and portfolio tracking with Aime, an AI assistant that reads chart patterns, runs event backtests, and builds custom dashboards on request.
longDescription: AInvest is an investing research platform available on the web, mobile, and a desktop terminal. Its AI assistant, Aime, recognizes chart patterns and summarizes whether a setup looks bullish or bearish alongside related news, and it can backtest how a stock reacted to past events such as earnings calls or Fed meetings. Users can describe what they want to monitor and have Aime assemble a dashboard of widgets. The platform also offers real-time US market data, news, earnings and macro coverage, screeners, and portfolio tracking, with options and crypto tools on higher tiers. A basic plan is free, and paid AIME+ plans add signals, more AI credits, and advanced options features.
features: Real-time US market data and news
pros: Free basic plan with real-time US data
Works on web, mobile, and desktop
cons: Paid tiers are expensive
AI signals are research aids, not guarantees
moreContext:
AInvest stands out for making technical analysis more approachable. Instead of reading candlestick charts on your own, you can ask its assistant Aime to scan a chart, draw the pattern, and explain in plain language what it sees, along with the news behind a move. That conversational layer sits on top of a fairly complete research platform.

- Aime identifies chart patterns and explains them in everyday language.
- Event backtesting groups similar past events, like earnings calls, and reports how a stock reacted.
- You can describe what you want to track and have Aime build a custom dashboard of widgets.
- The free plan includes real-time US market data, news, and portfolio tracking.
- A desktop terminal adds a dedicated workspace for people who watch markets daily.

It is best for self-directed retail investors who want research help and faster context on market moves. A practical tip: use the free plan for a while to see whether Aime's explanations fit how you research, and treat any signal or rating as one input among many, since the tool supports your own analysis rather than replacing it or professional advice.

name: Strategic Profiler
tagline: Behavioral negotiation prep with counterpart profiles and AI role-play
description: Strategic Profiler builds behavioral profiles of negotiation counterparts, generates tailored playbooks, and lets you rehearse against a simulated version of the other side.
longDescription: Strategic Profiler is a negotiation preparation platform for dealmakers in sales, M&A, venture capital, and corporate strategy. It analyzes a counterpart's public communication using methods from behavioral psychology and computational linguistics, such as language style matching and decision framing, to estimate how that person evaluates risk and makes decisions. The system uses a retrieval-augmented pipeline grounded in behavioral research, with several specialized agents contributing to each profile. From that profile it produces playbooks with suggested phrasing, meeting structure, and if-then contingencies. A live simulator lets users rehearse a pitch against a persona modeled on the counterpart. The free Starter plan covers a few profiles, and paid tiers add document uploads and voice practice.
features: Transcript and document analysis on paid plans
pros: Prepares you before the meeting, not after
Practice against a persona of the real counterpart
Free plan to test the approach
cons: Free plan limited to three unique people
Paid tiers are priced for professionals
moreContext:
Most sales AI tools analyze a conversation after it happens. Strategic Profiler flips that around and focuses on preparation, helping you understand a counterpart's likely decision style before you walk into the room. It leans on established behavioral research, such as language style matching and promotion versus prevention focus, rather than generic personality labels.

- Profiles are built from a counterpart's communication patterns to suggest how they weigh upside and risk.
- Playbooks include proposal phrasing, meeting structure, and if-then responses for likely objections.
- The simulator lets you rehearse against a persona modeled on the actual person you will meet.
- The company says a research-grounded retrieval pipeline is used to reduce made-up answers.
- Higher plans add document and transcript uploads and live voice conversation practice.

It is best for founders raising money, enterprise account executives, and M&A or partnership leads facing a small number of high-stakes conversations. A practical tip: use the free Starter plan on one upcoming meeting, then compare the playbook's suggestions with what actually happened, which is the quickest way to see whether the profiling style suits your deals.

name: Revtelic
tagline: Deal governance for B2B sales with AI health scores and mutual action plans
description: Revtelic turns sales call transcripts into qualification data, deal risk alerts, objective health scores, and shared mutual action plans that buyers and sellers work through together.
longDescription: Revtelic is a deal management platform for B2B revenue teams. Reps forward call transcripts or emails, and its multi-agent AI extracts qualification details for frameworks such as MEDDPICC, BANT, and CHAMP, flags deal risks by severity, and calculates a 0 to 100 deal health score based on verified buyer commitments and milestone progress rather than rep optimism. Each deal gets a shared deal board, a living mutual action plan where buyers and sellers own tasks, swap documents, and resolve questions, with engagement analytics showing buyer activity. Revtelic also offers a remote MCP server so assistants like Claude and ChatGPT can query deal data. Plans are usage-based with a 14-day free trial.
pros: All features included on every plan
Connects to AI assistants through MCP
cons: Pricing details are not shown upfront
Best value depends on steady transcript input
moreContext:
Revtelic focuses on a part of selling that often slips through the cracks: keeping complex B2B deals honest and moving. Instead of relying on a rep's gut feeling, it reads call transcripts and emails, fills in qualification fields, and scores deal health based on what the buyer has actually committed to.

- Qualification data for MEDDPICC, BANT, and CHAMP is extracted from conversations into one unified model.
- A risk matrix highlights blockers early and suggests collaborative ways to address them.
- Deal health scores from 0 to 100 weigh verified buyer commitments and milestone pace.
- Shared deal boards give buyers a place to see tasks, documents, and open questions, with engagement tracking for the seller.
- A remote MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, and custom agents work with your deal data.

Revtelic is best for account executives and sales leaders running multi-stakeholder deals with longer cycles. A practical tip: during the 14-day trial, forward transcripts from one active deal and share its deal board with the buyer, since the engagement analytics and health score become meaningful only once both sides are interacting with the plan.

name: Heyo
tagline: Fun AI effects that turn photos into short animated videos
description: Heyo applies AI effects to your photos and animates them into short clips, dances, cartoon looks, and motion posters for sharing on TikTok and Reels.
longDescription: Heyo is a mobile-first AI video effects app with a companion website. Users upload a photo, pick from a large library of trending effects and filters, and the app turns the still image into a short animated clip, such as a dance, a cartoon-style transformation, a playful motion poster, or a profile video. Effects are grouped into themes and refreshed with new trends, and finished clips are sized for social platforms like TikTok and Instagram Reels. Generations use points, and failed generations are refunded automatically. Heyo can be tried for free, while a VIP subscription through the app store adds a daily allowance of points for more generations.
features: Large library of AI video effects
Photo to animated clip in seconds
cons: Geared to novelty clips rather than serious editing
Subscription pricing is not published on the website
moreContext:
Quick, playful results are the whole point here. You pick a photo, choose an effect, and get back a short animated clip that is ready to post, with no timeline editing or prompt writing required. That simplicity makes it easy to keep up with social trends without learning a video tool, and it lowers the barrier for people who have never edited a clip before.

- A large and regularly refreshed effects library covers dances, cartoon looks, motion posters, and profile animations.
- A single photo is enough to create a short animated clip.
- Output is designed for vertical social formats like TikTok and Reels.
- Points spent on failed generations are refunded automatically, according to the company's FAQ.
- The app is available in many languages, including Spanish, Hindi, Japanese, and Korean.

Heyo is best for casual creators and social media users who want fun, shareable clips from their photos in seconds. A practical tip: clear, well-lit portraits with the face fully visible tend to animate more cleanly, so start with your best front-facing photo before trying group shots or busy backgrounds.

name: ImgAPI
tagline: One pay-per-image API for several leading image generation models
description: ImgAPI gives developers a single API key and endpoint for multiple third-party image models, billed per successful image, with a free web playground of three images a day.
longDescription: ImgAPI is an image generation API that puts several popular third-party models behind one key and one request format. Developers send a prompt of up to 10,000 characters, optional reference images, and settings for aspect ratio, resolution up to 4K, and quality, then poll an asynchronous task for the result. Billing is per successful image, and credits for failed tasks are released, with published per-image prices and 24-hour success rates for each model. A browser playground allows comparing models side by side and offers three free images a day without signing up, and paid accounts can check in daily for bonus credits. Documentation and model comparisons are available in English and Chinese.
features: Single API for multiple image models
Up to 12 reference images per request
pros: Free daily playground with no signup
cons: Depends on third-party models it does not control
Async polling adds integration steps
moreContext:
This service is a practical choice for developers who do not want to manage separate accounts and request formats for every image model they test. It offers one key, one task-based workflow, and clear per-image pricing, plus a public view of each model's recent success rate, which is a thoughtful touch when reliability matters.

- One API key covers several image models, so switching models is a parameter change rather than a new integration.
- Billing applies only to successful images, and credits for failed tasks are released.
- Requests support long prompts, up to 12 reference images, and resolutions up to 4K on supported models.
- A model status page shows prices and 24-hour success rates for each option.
- The browser playground gives three free images a day without an account and allows multi-model comparison.

It is best for app builders, agencies, and hobbyist developers who want to add image generation without committing to a single model vendor. A practical tip: run the same prompt across two or three models in the free playground first, then pick the cheapest model that meets your quality bar for production traffic.

name: ASOgenic
tagline: MCP server that brings App Store Optimization workflows to AI assistants
description: ASOgenic gives MCP-compatible AI clients tools to research App Store keywords, validate metadata limits, localize listings, manage screenshots, and publish to App Store Connect.
longDescription: ASOgenic is an App Store Optimization toolkit delivered as an MCP server for iOS teams. Once connected to an MCP-compatible AI client, it provides tools to research App Store keywords with Apple data, write metadata and check it against field and byte limits, adapt listings for different locales, manage screenshots and reusable media, set up a brand-new release, and submit to Apple review. Newer tools cover custom product pages and product page optimization experiments. Publishing follows a review-first process where changes are approved before going live. Apple credentials are entered only in the signed-in ASOgenic dashboard, not in chat or connection settings. The service is free for a limited time with 500 tool calls per month.
pros: Works inside the AI assistant you already use
Deterministic checks on character and byte limits
cons: Free access is described as limited time
Focused on Apple's App Store only
moreContext:
ASOgenic brings App Store Optimization into the AI assistant you already work with. Instead of switching between keyword tools, spreadsheets, and App Store Connect, an iOS developer can ask an MCP-compatible client to research terms, draft metadata, and prepare a release, while ASOgenic supplies the real data and validation behind each step.

- Keyword research uses Apple data rather than relying on a general chatbot's guesses.
- Metadata is checked deterministically against App Store field and byte limits before submission.
- Localization workflows help adapt search terms and listings for each market.
- Screenshot management, custom product pages, and product page experiments are supported in the same workflow.
- Publishing is review-first, and Apple credentials are entered only in the authenticated dashboard.

ASOgenic is best for indie iOS developers and small app teams who already use AI assistants and want a repeatable ASO routine. A practical tip: start with a single locale and run the full cycle of research, metadata validation, and review before expanding, so you can confirm the workflow fits your release process while the free allowance lasts.

name: XCrawl
tagline: Web scraping, crawling, and SERP API that returns LLM-ready data
description: XCrawl extracts clean JSON, Markdown, or screenshots from web pages, crawls whole sites, maps URLs, and pulls search results, with built-in proxies and MCP support for AI agents.
longDescription: XCrawl is a web data API aimed at developers building AI applications and agents. Its Scrape API turns a single page into structured JSON, clean Markdown, or a screenshot, while the Crawl API walks entire domains or sections with depth control and the Map API lists every discoverable URL. A SERP API collects search engine results for SEO and market research, and ready-made scrapers target sites like Amazon and YouTube. Headless browser rendering handles JavaScript-heavy pages, and rotating residential proxies help with blocking. SDKs for Python and Node.js, plus integrations with MCP, n8n, and Zapier, connect the data to agents and automations. New accounts receive 1,000 free credits without a card.
features: Scrape API with JSON and Markdown output
pros: Free starting credits with no card
cons: Credit costs vary by request type
Paid plan details are not listed on the homepage
moreContext:
XCrawl is designed for the stage of an AI project where you need real web data in a shape a model can use. It covers single pages, whole sites, URL discovery, and search results through a handful of focused endpoints, and returns clean Markdown or JSON so the output can go straight into a prompt, a vector store, or an agent.

- The Scrape API returns structured JSON, Markdown, or headless screenshots in one request.
- Crawl and Map APIs handle full domains, depth limits, and complete URL inventories.
- The SERP API gathers search engine results for SEO and market research.
- Rotating residential proxies and headless rendering help with dynamic and protected pages.
- An MCP server plus n8n and Zapier integrations make it easy to connect to agents and no-code flows.

XCrawl suits developers building retrieval pipelines, research agents, or monitoring tools that depend on fresh web content. A practical tip: use the 1,000 free credits to test your hardest target sites first, since credit usage depends on request complexity, and check the pricing in your dashboard before scaling up a crawl.

name: FreeTTS
tagline: Online text to speech plus free transcription and audio editing tools
description: FreeTTS turns text into natural speech with AI cloud voices and bundles free browser tools for transcription, vocal removal, voice enhancement, and audio editing.
longDescription: FreeTTS is an online audio workspace centered on text to speech. Users can generate speech with device voices, a local AI option, or higher quality AI cloud voices, which draw from a monthly character allowance. Alongside TTS, the site offers speech to text transcription for meetings, lessons, and drafts, a vocal remover that separates vocals from instrumentals, and a voice enhancer that reduces noise in recordings. Free browser tools for cutting, joining, compressing, and converting audio run locally without uploading files. A free plan includes 5,000 cloud characters and one hour of transcription per month, and paid subscriptions or one-time top-ups add more characters and remove ads.
features: AI cloud text to speech voices
Browser-based audio cutter, joiner, and converter
pros: Useful free tier and free audio tools
cons: Free plan shows ads
Free cloud character allowance is small
moreContext:
FreeTTS is handy because it gathers a whole set of everyday audio tasks under one roof. Text to speech is the headline feature, but the same site can transcribe a recording, strip vocals from a song, clean up a noisy voice track, or trim and merge files, which saves hopping between several single-purpose websites.

- AI cloud voices produce more natural narration, with device and local voices available as alternatives.
- Speech to text handles meetings, lessons, and recordings, with an hour per month on the free plan.
- The vocal remover separates vocals and instrumentals for karaoke or practice tracks.
- Cutter, joiner, compressor, and converter tools run in the browser without uploading your files.
- Paid plans offer monthly subscriptions or one-time top-ups, with a 7-day money-back guarantee, according to the company.

FreeTTS is best for students, teachers, podcasters, and video creators who need occasional narration and light audio cleanup without paying for several apps.
