A practical tip: draft and test your script with the free device or local voices first, then switch to cloud voices only for the final recording so your monthly characters go further.

name: Trip Planner AI
tagline: AI travel planner that builds editable day-by-day itineraries with live prices
description: Trip Planner AI turns your dates, destination and preferences into a full itinerary with timing, routes and budget estimates, then lets you swap activities or hotels and book through partner sites.
longDescription: Trip Planner AI is a web travel planner that drafts complete itineraries from a few inputs such as destination, dates, travel group and budget. Each plan lays out activities in order with timing, routes between stops and rough cost estimates. Travelers can then edit the plan by swapping activities, changing transport or upgrading hotels, and the itinerary adjusts around those changes. The site compares flight and hotel prices and links out to booking partners like Skyscanner, Booking.com and GetYourGuide. It supports family trips, couples getaways, road trips and multi-city routes, and companions can collaborate on the same plan. The product is connected to Layla, a personal AI travel agent from the same team.
features: Live flight and hotel price comparison
pros: Fast first draft of a whole trip
Covers road trips and multi-city routes
Keeps bookings and tips in one place
cons: Pricing details are not clearly published
Bookings happen on third-party partner sites
moreContext:
What we like about Trip Planner AI is how quickly it gets you from a vague idea to a workable plan. Instead of juggling tabs for flights, hotels and things to do, you answer a few questions and get an ordered schedule that you can reshape as your plans change. It sits alongside Layla, a travel agent style assistant from the same team, so the two share a focus on practical trip logistics.

- Itineraries include timing, routes and budget estimates rather than a loose list of attractions
- Swapping an activity or hotel updates the rest of the plan for you
- Price comparison links to well known booking partners such as Skyscanner and Booking.com
- Dedicated flows for family travel, couples, road trips and multi-city routes
- Group members can collaborate on the same itinerary in real time

Trip Planner AI is best for leisure travelers who want a structured starting point and are happy to fine-tune it themselves. It is especially handy for road trips and multi-stop journeys, where sequencing stops is the hardest part. A practical tip: generate a plan early, then share it with your travel companions so everyone can suggest swaps before you book anything, and always double-check opening hours and prices on the partner site before paying.

name: Agenty
tagline: AI-assisted web scraping, crawling and change monitoring without writing code
description: Agenty turns websites into structured data with no-code scraping agents, site crawling and page change alerts, with exports to JSON or CSV and an API with webhooks.
longDescription: Agenty is a web data extraction platform for teams that need structured information from websites without building scrapers from scratch. Users set up no-code agents that pull fields from pages, then run them on batches of URLs or on a schedule. The platform also crawls whole sites, discovers sitemaps and renders JavaScript-heavy pages. A change detection feature watches pages and sends alerts when content updates, which suits price and policy monitoring. Results can be cleaned with post-processing scripts and exported as JSON or CSV, or pulled through an API with webhooks. Common uses include competitor price tracking, MAP compliance checks and gathering location data. A local desktop edition is sold as a one-time license.
features: API, webhooks and JSON or CSV export
pros: Covers scraping, crawling and monitoring in one tool
One-time license option for local use
cons: Cloud plan prices are not shown on the pricing page
Complex sites may still need setup effort
moreContext:
Agenty stands out for bundling the three jobs most data teams end up needing: pulling fields from pages, crawling entire sites and watching pages for changes. Rather than stitching separate tools together, you can configure an agent once and then run it on a schedule, across a batch of URLs or through the API.

- No-code agents let non-developers define what to extract from a page
- The crawler handles sitemaps and JavaScript-rendered pages
- Change detection sends alerts when a watched page updates, useful for pricing and compliance work
- Post-processing scripts help clean data before it leaves the platform
- Exports to JSON and CSV, plus webhooks, make it easy to feed spreadsheets or internal systems

Agenty is a good fit for ecommerce teams, analysts and agencies that track competitor prices, minimum advertised price compliance or store location data on a regular basis. The local desktop edition, sold as a one-time license, is an appealing option for individuals who prefer not to pay a subscription. A practical tip: use the free starting credit to test your hardest target site first, since dynamic pages and login walls are where scraping tools differ most, and ask for the free data sample before committing to a larger plan.

name: Keevx
tagline: AI avatar videos, video translation with lip sync and product ad generation
description: Keevx creates avatar videos from scripts or topics, translates and dubs existing videos with lip sync, and turns product links or images into short ads for global audiences.
longDescription: Keevx is an AI video platform aimed at businesses and creators who produce marketing, training and product content for several markets. Users can generate scripts from a topic and pair them with a stock or cloned avatar and voice to produce presenter videos. A translation and dubbing tool localizes existing footage with voiceovers, subtitles and lip sync. For ecommerce, Keevx can build ads from product links or animate static product images with automatic camera movement. It can also analyze a popular video and produce a similar UGC-style version. The platform includes a library of public avatars, regional voices and templates, and users can clone their own appearance and voice for reuse.
features: Video translation and dubbing with lip sync
Product link and image to ad videos
pros: Combines avatars, dubbing and ads in one place
Large library of avatars and voices
Useful for localizing content into many languages
cons: Plan prices are not listed on the homepage
Cloned avatars need good source footage
moreContext:
Keevx earns attention for covering several video jobs that usually require separate subscriptions. You can produce a presenter-style avatar video, localize it into other languages with matching lip movement, and turn a product page into a short ad, all from the same workspace. That makes it a practical hub for small teams that publish to international audiences.

- Script generation from a topic shortens the path from idea to finished avatar video
- Translation and dubbing keep lip sync aligned with the new audio track
- Product links and still images can become short ads with camera motion and voiceover
- A viral video breakdown tool helps produce UGC-style variations
- Personal avatar and voice cloning creates reusable on-camera assets

Keevx is best suited to ecommerce sellers, marketers and training teams who need a steady flow of short videos in multiple languages without filming each one. The company says it supports a large number of languages and accents for dubbing, so it is worth checking that your target markets are covered. A practical tip: start the free trial with one existing video you already know performs well, translate it into a single new language, and review the lip sync and pronunciation closely before scaling up to a whole library.

name: PortLume AI
tagline: Company-specific mock interviews and post-interview debriefs for software engineers
description: PortLume AI helps software engineers prepare for specific companies with voice or text mock interviews, then analyzes interview notes or rejections to flag likely gaps and build a short practice plan.
longDescription: PortLume AI is an interview preparation tool built for software engineers targeting particular companies and roles. Users run mock interviews by voice or text and receive feedback on habits such as filler words, hedging and answers that never reach a result. After a real interview or a rejection, the debrief feature reviews the candidate's notes, lists the signals that may have shaped the outcome, rewrites one answer and proposes a seven-day practice plan. The product also offers company guides and a question bank covering more than 100 companies, a free rejection email decoder, and an application tracker with follow-up reminders. It was built by a solo founder in India and uses third-party AI providers.
pros: Free plan has no time limit
Paid packs are one-time with no renewal
cons: Focused on software engineering roles
USD pricing is shown only at checkout
moreContext:
PortLume AI takes a thoughtful angle on interview prep by caring about what happens after the interview, not only before it. Its debrief feature reads your own notes from a real interview or rejection and turns them into a short list of likely weak spots, a rewritten answer and a week of focused practice. That loop makes each interview a learning step rather than a dead end.

- Mock interviews by voice or text with feedback on filler words, hedging and missing results
- Debriefs that suggest likely signals behind an outcome and a seven-day plan
- Company guides and a question bank that show how many public reports back each entry
- A free rejection email decoder and an application tracker with follow-ups
- One-time Interview Packs that do not renew or store your card

PortLume AI is best for software engineers who are actively interviewing and want structured practice for a specific company. The free plan covers a monthly mock, prep plan and debrief, which is enough to judge whether the feedback style suits you. A practical tip: write down the questions and your answers right after each real interview while they are fresh, since the debrief can only be as useful as the notes you give it.

name: Numerous.ai
tagline: ChatGPT-style AI functions inside Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel
description: Numerous.ai adds an =AI function to Google Sheets and Excel so you can write, summarize, categorize and clean data across thousands of cells without managing API keys.
longDescription: Numerous.ai is a spreadsheet add-on that brings large language model features into Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel. After installing it, users call a simple =AI function in any cell to generate or transform text, which makes bulk work like writing marketing copy, summarizing feedback, tagging rows and cleaning messy data much faster. No personal API key is required, since usage runs through the Numerous subscription. The add-on caches results so repeated formulas do not trigger duplicate queries, which the company presents as a way to control cost. Plans cover individuals and small teams, with team members sharing one plan. Every plan starts with a seven-day free trial, and prices are listed for annual billing.
features: Works in Google Sheets and Excel
Result caching to avoid duplicate queries
cons: No permanent free plan
Listed prices assume annual billing
moreContext:
Numerous.ai appeals because it meets people where they already work. Instead of copying rows into a chatbot and pasting answers back, you write a formula and fill it down the column. That keeps your data, prompts and results side by side in the sheet, which makes bulk work easier to review and repeat.

- A single =AI function covers writing, summarizing, classifying and cleaning text
- Runs in both Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel
- No need to create or paste an API key from a model provider
- Caching means recalculating a sheet does not re-run identical requests
- Team plans let several people share one subscription

Numerous.ai is best for marketers, operations staff and analysts who handle lists of products, leads, survey answers or support tickets in spreadsheets. It turns tasks that would take an afternoon of manual tagging into a few formulas. A practical tip: test your prompt on ten rows first and refine it until the output format is consistent, then fill it down the full column, and convert finished results to plain values so later edits to the sheet do not change them.

name: Makiverse
tagline: Agent-guided AI studio for creating anime episodes and manga chapters from a pitch
description: Makiverse lets you pitch a story in a sentence and works with you to storyboard, cast and lay out manga pages or anime episodes, with extra generators for webtoons, GIFs and images.
longDescription: Makiverse is a browser-based creative platform for producing anime and manga with AI. Users begin with a short story pitch, and an agent helps break it into boards, cast characters and lay out each panel or shot. There are separate studios for starting an anime episode or laying out a manga chapter, along with generators for comics, manhwa, webtoons, short dramas, images, GIFs and video. Finished work can be published inside the platform, where others browse anime and manga titles, new releases and top lists. The site also runs a store for its in-app currency and a blog. It is aimed at storytellers who want to create visual fiction without drawing skills.
features: Anime episode and manga chapter studios
Webtoon, manhwa, GIF and image generators
Built-in library for publishing and browsing
pros: Turns a one-line idea into structured panels
Covers both static and animated formats
Community library for sharing finished work
cons: Plan prices are not clearly listed
Commercial usage terms are not spelled out on the homepage
moreContext:
Makiverse stands out by treating AI anime and manga as a storytelling process rather than a single image prompt. You pitch an idea, and an agent works alongside you to plan boards, settle on a cast and arrange panels or shots. That structure helps keep a story coherent across pages, which is often the hardest part of AI comics.

- Agent-guided workflow covers boarding, casting and layout
- Separate studios for anime episodes and manga chapters
- Extra generators for manhwa, webtoons, short dramas, GIFs and images
- A built-in library where creators publish titles and readers browse new releases
- Works in the browser, so there is nothing to install

Makiverse is best for hobbyist storytellers, fan fiction writers and social creators who have ideas for visual stories but not the drawing skills or time to illustrate them. It is also a fun way to prototype a comic concept before working with an artist. A practical tip: write a short character sheet with names, looks and personalities before you start, and reuse the same descriptions throughout, since consistent inputs make it easier to keep characters recognizable from panel to panel.

name: Lyria 3.5
tagline: Google DeepMind music model for full songs with vocals, lyrics and tempo control
description: Lyria 3.5 is Google DeepMind's music generation model, producing full tracks up to three minutes with vocals and lyrics, available in Flow Music, the Gemini app and the Gemini API.
longDescription: Lyria 3.5 is Google DeepMind's latest music generation model. From a text prompt, or even an uploaded image, it creates complete tracks of variable length up to about three minutes, with a beginning, development and ending. It can sing in several languages and styles, follow lyrics you write or generate lyrics around a theme, and cover genres from pop and funk to Motown and global styles. Prompts can specify tempo, key, vocal style and acoustic character for finer control. People can try it in Google Flow Music and the Gemini app, while developers can call it through the Gemini API with per-song pricing. Every track carries an inaudible SynthID watermark that identifies AI-generated audio.
features: Full songs up to about three minutes
Vocals and lyrics in several languages
pros: Available in consumer apps and via API
cons: API use is billed per song with no free API tier
Access and limits vary by Google product
moreContext:
Lyria 3.5 is notable for bringing a research-grade music model into everyday Google products. You can describe a song in a sentence, add your own lyrics, or even upload an image for inspiration, and get back a complete track rather than a short loop. Google says this version improves melody, lyric adherence and vocal quality over earlier releases.

- Generates full tracks of variable length, up to about three minutes
- Writes or follows lyrics and sings in several languages and styles
- Prompts can set tempo, key, vocal style and acoustic feel
- Reachable through Flow Music, the Gemini app and the Gemini API
- Every output is marked with SynthID so AI-generated audio can be identified

Lyria 3.5 suits creators who want quick custom music for videos, podcasts or demos, as well as developers who want to add song generation to their own apps. Because Google publishes per-song API pricing, it is easy to estimate costs for a product feature. A practical tip: be specific about structure and mood in your prompt, for example naming the tempo, the genre and where the chorus should land, and keep your own lyrics short and rhythmic so the vocals follow them more closely.

name: Faceless Brain
tagline: All-in-one suite of AI video, image, voice and writing tools for faceless content
description: Faceless Brain bundles dozens of AI tools for text-to-video, avatars, lip sync, image generation, photo editing, voice cloning and writing under a single credit-based account.
longDescription: Faceless Brain is a browser-based creative suite that gathers more than seventy AI tools under one account. Video tools cover text-to-video, lip sync, AI avatars, subtitles and short-form clip generation. Image tools include text-to-image plus logo, poster, banner and thumbnail makers, while photo editing handles face swaps, background and object removal, upscaling and colorizing. There are also fashion and portrait tools such as virtual try-on and headshots, product photography and ad creative generators, text-to-speech, voice cloning and dubbing, and writing helpers like a story generator and chat with PDF. Usage runs on monthly credits, with a free signup allowance and several paid tiers. It targets creators who run faceless social channels and small marketing teams.
pros: Covers video, image, audio and text
cons: Free plan has one-time credits and watermarks
Breadth means some tools are less deep than specialists
moreContext:
The sheer range of Faceless Brain is its biggest draw. Instead of paying for a separate video generator, voice tool, thumbnail maker and photo editor, you get all of them inside one account with a shared credit balance. For people who publish faceless channels, where every video needs a script, voiceover, visuals and a thumbnail, that consolidation saves both money and tab switching.

- Video tools cover text-to-video, lip sync, avatars, subtitles and short clips
- Image tools include logo, poster, banner and thumbnail makers
- Photo editing handles background removal, object removal, upscaling and colorizing
- Audio tools provide text-to-speech, voice cloning, dubbing and transcription
- Product photography and ad creative generators help small sellers

Faceless Brain is best for solo creators and small marketing teams who produce a lot of short-form content and value one bill over best-in-class depth in each category. The entry plan is inexpensive, so it is easy to try at a small scale. A practical tip: use the free signup credits to run one complete workflow, from script to voiceover to thumbnail, so you can see how many credits a typical video uses before you pick a plan.

name: Screenpipe
tagline: Local screen and audio memory that gives AI assistants context on your work
description: Screenpipe records your screen and audio on your own device, makes your work history searchable, and exposes it to AI agents through a local API and MCP server.
longDescription: Screenpipe is a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that keeps a private, searchable record of what you see and hear on your computer. It captures screenshots when the screen changes, extracts text through accessibility APIs with OCR as a fallback, and transcribes system and microphone audio locally with Whisper. Everything is stored in a local database by default. You can search your history in plain language, scrub back through your day, and let it spot recurring workflows to draft follow-ups, SOPs or automations. Privacy controls exclude apps, windows and URLs and redact sensitive fields. A local API and MCP server let assistants and agents use this context. The code is source-available.
features: Local screen capture with text extraction
Natural language search of your history
Local API and MCP server for agents
pros: Data stays on your device by default
Works on macOS, Windows and Linux
cons: Continuous recording uses disk space and resources
Commercial use requires a paid license
moreContext:
Screenpipe takes a local-first approach to a problem many people feel daily: forgetting where you saw something. It quietly records your screen and audio, turns them into searchable text on your own machine, and then makes that history available to the AI tools you already use. Founder Louis Beaumont started the project in 2024, and the code remains source-available for inspection.

- Captures text through accessibility APIs, with OCR as a fallback for other apps
- Transcribes meetings and system audio locally using Whisper
- Lets you search in plain language and jump back to the exact moment
- Detects recurring workflows and helps draft follow-ups, SOPs or automations
- A local API and MCP server connect your history to agents and assistants

Screenpipe is best for knowledge workers, developers and researchers who switch between many apps and want an assistant that understands their actual day. Teams can look at the business plan for device management, SSO and audit logs. A practical tip: set up exclusions for password managers, banking sites and private chats on day one, so sensitive windows are never captured, and review your storage settings after the first week of recording.

name: Turnitin
tagline: Academic integrity platform with similarity checking and AI writing detection
description: Turnitin helps schools and universities check student work for similarity and AI-generated writing, and its Clarity product shows the writing process alongside feedback tools.
longDescription: Turnitin is an academic integrity company whose tools are used by schools, universities and publishers. Its core service compares submitted work against a large database to produce similarity reports, and institutions can add AI writing detection that estimates how much of a submission may have been produced by AI tools. Turnitin Clarity, launched in 2025, adds a composition space where students draft assignments, with an AI assistant for feedback, while educators see revision timelines, pasted versus typed text and a summary of AI chat history. Products are licensed through institutions rather than sold to individual students, and pricing is negotiated per institution. Turnitin advises that detection scores should not be the sole basis for action against a student.
features: Similarity reports against a large database
Clarity writing space with process visibility
pros: Shows writing process, not just a score
Combines similarity and AI checks in one view
cons: Not available for individual purchase
Detection results can misidentify human writing
moreContext:
Turnitin has been part of academic life since 1998, and its newer tools reflect a shift from catching problems to understanding how students write. Alongside long-standing similarity reports and AI writing detection, the Clarity product gives students a place to draft with an AI assistant while giving teachers visibility into revisions, pasted text and AI chat use. That context supports conversations rather than verdicts.

- Similarity reports compare submissions against a large body of published and student work
- AI writing detection estimates the share of text that may be machine-generated
- Clarity records revision timelines and distinguishes typed from pasted text
- Educators see similarity, AI detection and submission metrics together
- Turnitin itself cautions against using detection results as the only evidence

Turnitin is best for schools, colleges and universities that want an institution-wide approach to academic integrity with integrations into their learning platforms. Individual students and writers cannot buy the AI detection product directly, so they typically access it through their school. A practical tip for instructors: treat any AI score as a starting point for a conversation, and pair it with drafts, revision history and a short discussion with the student before drawing conclusions.

name: Hashvix AI
tagline: AI studio that turns ideas or lyrics into full songs and short music videos
description: Hashvix AI generates complete songs with vocals from an idea, message or lyrics, offers remixing, stem splitting and audio-to-MIDI tools, and creates vertical music videos for social platforms.
longDescription: Hashvix AI is a browser-based music and video creation studio. Users describe an idea, message or story, or paste their own lyrics, and the song generator produces a full track with vocals, beat and arrangement. Text-to-music and lyrics-to-music modes cover different starting points. Additional tools extend an existing track, remix it, split it into stems for vocals, drums, bass and other instruments, or convert audio to MIDI for further editing in a music app. A music video generator then turns a song into a short vertical clip sized for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Usage runs on monthly credits, with a free tier and paid Creator and Pro plans.
pros: Song and video creation in one place
Free tier without a credit card
Useful utility tools like stems and MIDI
cons: Free tier credits are limited
Higher volumes need the Pro plan
moreContext:
What we like about Hashvix AI is that it thinks about what happens after a song is made. Beyond creating a full track from a prompt or your own lyrics, it gives you the pieces to keep working: stems, MIDI, extensions and remixes. Then it can wrap the result in a vertical music video ready for short-form platforms.

- Generates complete songs with lyrics, vocals and a beat from a short description
- Lyrics-to-music mode lets songwriters hear their words set to a track
- Stem splitting separates vocals, drums, bass and other instruments
- Audio-to-MIDI helps move ideas into a traditional music app
- A music video tool outputs clips sized for TikTok, Reels and Shorts

Hashvix AI is best for social creators, hobbyist songwriters and small brands that want a catchy custom song plus a matching clip without hiring musicians or editors. The free tier is enough to test the vocals and style options. A practical tip: write a short chorus yourself and use lyrics-to-music mode, since a clear, repeatable hook tends to produce a more memorable track than a fully generated song, and split stems if you want to rebalance the vocals later.

name: Beav
tagline: Local-first AI workspace for creators to collect sources and draft platform posts
description: Beav is a desktop workspace for content creators that saves posts and videos from social platforms, summarizes and tags them with AI, and drafts platform-specific content and avatar videos.
longDescription: Beav, formerly known as RedBox, is a local-first desktop app with a browser extension built for social media creators. The extension saves posts, videos, images and comments from platforms such as Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube and WeChat articles, keeping titles, authors and engagement numbers. Inside the app, AI summarizes and tags saved material, breaks down popular videos and suggests topics. A writing assistant drafts content tailored to each platform from an idea, link or product, and an avatar tool creates talking-head videos from a photo and voice recording. Product and store cards help with promotional posts. Files stay on your computer by default, and the app connects to AI tools like Codex and Claude Desktop.
features: Browser extension to save social posts and videos
AI summaries, tags and video breakdowns
Talking-head avatar videos from a photo
pros: Files stay on your own computer by default
cons: Strongest support for Chinese social platforms
AI features are billed in usage credits
moreContext:
Beav focuses on a part of the creator workflow that often gets messy: collecting inspiration. Its browser extension captures posts, videos and comments along with their engagement numbers, and the desktop app turns that pile into tagged, summarized research you can actually use. Keeping files local by default is a welcome choice for creators who care about owning their material.

- Saves content from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, WeChat articles and general web pages
- AI summaries, tags and video breakdowns help explain why a post worked
- Topic suggestions draw on what you have saved
- The writing assistant adapts drafts to each platform's style
- Avatar videos can be made from a single photo and a voice recording

Beav is best for creators and small teams who publish on Chinese social platforms as well as YouTube, and who want research and drafting in one desktop tool. The free personal plan and the one-time lifetime license make it easy to start without a subscription. A practical tip: spend a week saving the posts that perform best in your niche before asking Beav for topic ideas, since its suggestions are only as good as the library you build.

name: Voicare
tagline: AI clinical note assistant for UK and Irish healthcare practitioners
description: Voicare records patient consultations and drafts structured clinical notes for review, with built-in patient management and video consultations for clinics in the UK and Ireland.
longDescription: Voicare is an AI documentation assistant for healthcare professionals in the UK and Ireland. With one click, a clinician records a consultation, and Voicare produces a structured draft note that the practitioner reviews, edits and saves to their records system. It is designed for disciplines including physiotherapy, chiropractic, psychology, dentistry, audiology, optometry, occupational therapy, osteopathy and general practice, and can be adapted to other specialties. The platform also includes a patient management module for clinical histories and built-in video consultations that generate notes from the call. Voicare highlights GDPR compliance, EU data storage, granular access control and two-factor login. Pricing is per user per month, with a 14-day free trial.
pros: Built for many allied health disciplines
EU data storage and GDPR focus
No long-term commitment on the paid plan
cons: Focused on the UK and Ireland
No ongoing free plan
moreContext:
Voicare addresses one of the most draining parts of clinical work: writing up notes after every appointment. It listens to the consultation, then hands the practitioner a structured draft to review and approve, so the clinician stays in control of what goes into the record. Its focus on allied health professions, not only GPs, sets it apart from many medical scribe tools.

- One-click recording produces a structured draft note for each consultation
- Supports physiotherapy, psychology, dentistry, optometry, osteopathy and more
- A patient management module keeps clinical history in one place
- Video consultations run inside Voicare and generate notes from the call
- GDPR compliance, EU data storage, access controls and two-factor login

Voicare is best for independent practitioners and multi-clinician practices in the UK and Ireland that want to reduce admin time without changing how they run appointments. Monthly per-user pricing with no commitment keeps the barrier to trying it low. A practical tip: during the free trial, compare Voicare's drafts with your usual notes for a handful of typical appointments, adjust the structure to match your discipline, and tell patients at the start of each session that an AI assistant is helping with notes.

name: LivePlan
tagline: Business planning software with AI help for plans, forecasts and pitch decks
description: LivePlan guides founders through writing a business plan, building financial forecasts and creating pitch decks, with AI tools for idea testing, market research and lender-style plan review.
longDescription: LivePlan is business planning software from Palo Alto Software for founders and small business owners. It walks users step by step through writing a business plan and building financial statements and forecasts suitable for lenders and investors. AI features include an Idea Canvas that pressure-tests a business idea, market research with sourced insights, a plan builder that helps draft sections, a plan review that reads the document the way a lender might, and a pitch deck creator that pulls from plan data. Higher tiers add scenario planning, performance dashboards and integrations with accounting tools such as QuickBooks Online and Xero. LivePlan is a paid subscription and offers a 35-day money-back guarantee.
features: AI plan review from a lender's view
Pitch deck creator from plan data
cons: No free plan
Advanced forecasting needs the higher tier
moreContext:
LivePlan has long been a go-to option for people writing their first business plan, and its AI tools make the process less intimidating. Rather than staring at a blank template, founders get help testing an idea, researching their market, drafting sections and spotting weak points before a lender does. The finished plan then feeds directly into a pitch deck.

- Step-by-step guidance covers every section of a traditional business plan
- Financial forecasts and statements are formatted for lenders and investors
- The Idea Canvas helps pressure-test a concept early
- Plan review reads your plan the way a lender would and flags gaps
- Higher tiers connect to QuickBooks Online and Xero for actual-versus-plan tracking

LivePlan is best for founders preparing a loan or grant application, small business owners formalizing growth plans, and consultants or educators who help others write plans. The 35-day money-back guarantee gives room to try it on a real project. A practical tip: build your revenue and expense forecast before polishing the written sections, since the numbers often reveal assumptions you will want to explain in the narrative, and then run the AI plan review last.

name: PostPop
tagline: AI that writes and designs on-brand social posts and carousels from a topic
description: PostPop turns a topic into finished social posts and carousels that use your brand colors, fonts and logo, exporting every size for Instagram, LinkedIn, X and Facebook at once.
longDescription: PostPop is an AI tool for producing branded social media graphics. Users enter a topic, and it writes the copy and designs a post or carousel using a brand kit that can be built automatically from a website or from a one-sentence description. Eleven templates cover formats like carousels, quotes, listicles and how-to steps. Each design exports in the right sizes for Instagram, LinkedIn, X and Facebook, and a carousel can be converted into a vertical video. The writer flags statistics for you to check rather than inventing them. PostPop does not publish posts itself, so users export and schedule through their own tools. Agencies can switch between client brand kits.
features: Brand kit built from your website
pros: Keeps every post on brand automatically
Flags statistics for review instead of inventing them
Free plan to try it out
cons: Free plan adds a watermark
Does not schedule or publish posts
moreContext:
PostPop focuses on a narrow job and does it carefully: turning an idea into a clean, on-brand post you can publish today. It pulls your colors, fonts and logo from your website, writes the copy, lays out the design, and exports every platform size at once. We also appreciate that it flags statistics for you to verify instead of making numbers up.

- Builds a brand kit automatically from a website URL or a short description
- Eleven templates for carousels, quotes, listicles and step-by-step posts
- Exports Instagram, LinkedIn, X and Facebook sizes together
- Converts carousels into vertical videos for Reels or Shorts
- Agency plan supports multiple client brand kits and team seats

PostPop is best for founders, consultants and small marketing teams who post regularly on LinkedIn and Instagram and want consistent visuals without opening a design tool each time. Because it leaves publishing to you, it fits alongside whatever scheduler you already use. A practical tip: refine your brand kit once before generating posts, especially fonts and logo placement, and keep a running list of topics so you can batch a week of carousels in one sitting.

name: Tesla Wrap Generator
tagline: Independent AI tool for designing custom Tesla Paint Shop wraps with 3D preview
description: Tesla Wrap Generator creates custom wrap designs for Tesla's in-car Paint Shop from a text prompt or photo, previews them on a 3D car, and exports a correctly sized PNG.
longDescription: Tesla Wrap Generator is an independent web tool, not affiliated with Tesla, for designing custom wraps used by Tesla's Paint Shop feature, which changes how the car appears on the in-car screen and in the Tesla app. Users describe a design or upload a photo, choose style presets like livery, camo, anime, retro or chrome, and the AI places the artwork on each panel. A 3D preview shows seams and details before download, and the exported PNG matches Tesla's requirements. Free tools include official Paint Shop UV templates, the 3D preview and a PNG fixer that resizes, compresses and renames files. AI generation uses credits sold in one-time packs. Wraps do not change physical paint.
features: Style presets from livery to chrome
Free PNG fixer for Paint Shop rules
pros: Free templates and tools without an account
Clear about what wraps can and cannot do
cons: Only useful for Tesla owners
Designs are on-screen only, not physical wraps
moreContext:
Playful and well scoped, Tesla Wrap Generator is made for Tesla owners who enjoy customizing how their car looks in the Paint Shop feature. It handles the fiddly parts, such as mapping artwork to each body panel and matching Tesla's file rules, so you can focus on the design itself. The site is clear that it is independent of Tesla and that wraps only change the on-screen car.

- Generate a wrap from a text description or an uploaded photo
- Style presets include livery, camo, anime, retro and chrome looks
- A 3D preview lets you check seams before downloading
- Official Paint Shop UV templates are available for free
- The PNG fixer resizes, compresses and renames files to meet Tesla's requirements

Tesla Wrap Generator is best for Tesla owners who want a personal touch on their car's display, and for hobbyists who like experimenting with car liveries. Credit packs are one-time purchases that never expire, and new accounts get enough free credits for one full wrap. A practical tip: if you have a vinyl wrap idea for the real car, try it here first to see the overall look, and only upload artwork you have the rights to, especially if you plan to share it in the public gallery.

name: AdsCreator
tagline: AI ad generator that turns a website URL into on-brand image and video ads
description: AdsCreator reads your website to capture logo, colors, fonts, products and tone, then generates image and video ads sized for Meta, Google, YouTube and TikTok.
longDescription: AdsCreator is an AI ad generator for businesses that need a steady supply of paid social and display creative. Users paste a website URL, and the tool extracts brand elements such as logo, colors, fonts, products and tone of voice, which can then be adjusted. From there it produces image ads in common aspect ratios including 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 and 16:9, resizable with one click, and video ads in several animated, creator-review and motion-graphics styles with script, voiceover, music and captions included. Changes can be requested in plain language, such as shortening a headline. The Teams plan adds unlimited brand presets and shared workspaces. A seven-day free trial precedes paid plans.
features: Brand extraction from a website URL
Image ads in four aspect ratios
Video ads with script, voiceover and music
pros: Fast route from URL to ready ads
Covers both image and video formats
Shared workspaces on the Teams plan
cons: No permanent free plan
Monthly price is higher than annual billing
moreContext:
AdsCreator shines at the very first step of a campaign, when you need a batch of ad variations and do not yet have a designer or video editor lined up. By reading your website directly, it starts from your real logo, colors, fonts and products, so the first drafts already look like your brand rather than a generic template.

- Extracts brand details from a website URL, with options to adjust them
- Image ads come in 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 and 16:9, with one-click resizing
- Video ads include animated, creator-review and motion-graphics styles
- Scripts, voiceovers, music and captions are generated with each video
- Edits can be requested in plain language, such as shortening a headline

AdsCreator is best for small businesses, ecommerce brands and agencies that run ads on Meta, Google, YouTube and TikTok and want to test many creative angles quickly. Annual billing roughly halves the monthly price, which helps teams that advertise year round. A practical tip: during the seven-day trial, generate ads for a single product and run them as a small split test, then use the winning headline and visual style as the brief for your next batch.

name: Video Object Remover
tagline: Remove people, logos and objects from short videos by describing them in plain words
description: A browser tool that erases unwanted people, logos and objects from video clips. You type what should disappear and download the cleaned result, with no masking or timeline work.
longDescription: Video Object Remover is a web app for cleaning up short video clips. Instead of drawing masks frame by frame, you upload an MP4, MOV or WebM file, describe the person, logo or object you want gone in plain language, and the AI fills in the background across the clip. Files can be up to 200 MB, and full processing covers clips up to 60 seconds. A free, watermarked five second preview lets you check results before buying credits, and uploads are deleted within 24 hours. It suits creators, marketers and small teams who need quick fixes without opening a full editor.
features: API key and agent skill access
cons: Clips capped at 60 seconds
Free preview is short and watermarked
moreContext:
Removing a stray passerby or a visible logo from footage usually means masking and tracking by hand. Video Object Remover replaces that work with a single sentence: you say what should go, and the tool handles the rest. That makes it a practical option for people who need a quick fix rather than a full editing suite.

- Plain-language prompts take the place of frame-by-frame masks, which keeps the learning curve close to zero.
- A free five second preview shows how well the removal works on your own clip before you pay anything.
- Pricing is based on one-time credit packs, so occasional users are not locked into a monthly plan.
- Common formats such as MP4, MOV and WebM are accepted, with uploads up to 200 MB.
- The site says files are erased within 24 hours, and an API key plus an agent skill let developers automate cleanups.

It is best for social media creators, marketers and small businesses who occasionally need to clean up short clips such as product shots, travel footage or quick promos. A practical tip: trim your footage to the exact section you need before uploading, since processing is limited to 60 seconds and shorter clips use fewer credits.

name: Klyply
tagline: Offline Windows app that turns long videos into captioned vertical clips on your PC
description: Klyply is a Windows desktop app that finds the best moments in long videos and exports captioned short clips. Everything runs locally, so footage never has to be uploaded.
longDescription: Klyply is an AI clipping tool for Windows 10 and 11 that works entirely on your own computer. It transcribes a long video locally, scores candidate moments on hook strength, energy and pacing, and gives you a ranked shortlist with timecodes. From there it reframes footage to vertical, follows the active speaker or uses a split layout for two people, burns in captions, adds an AI-written hook and your branding, and exports to 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9 without a watermark. Licenses are time-limited or lifetime one-time purchases with no auto-renewal. It is aimed at podcasters, interviewers and creators handling sensitive or unreleased footage.
features: AI hook writer and brand kit
pros: Watermark-free exports in four aspect ratios
cons: Windows only
No free plan or trial
moreContext:
Most AI clipping services ask you to upload hours of footage to their servers. Klyply takes the opposite approach and does the transcription, scoring and rendering on your own Windows machine. That makes it a thoughtful choice for anyone working with client interviews, unreleased episodes or other material that should stay private.

- Local processing means no uploads, no API keys and no waiting on a cloud queue.
- Moments are ranked by signals such as hook strength, energy and pacing, so you start from a sorted shortlist instead of scrubbing manually.
- Speaker tracking reframes to vertical automatically, with a split-screen layout when two people are talking.
- Captions, an AI hook writer and brand settings are built in, and exports carry no watermark.
- Licenses are one-time purchases for three months, a year or lifetime, and the company says they never renew on their own.

Klyply fits podcasters, YouTubers and agencies who repurpose long recordings into shorts and prefer to keep files on their own hardware. A practical tip: start with the shortest license term to confirm your PC handles long videos at a comfortable speed, then move to a longer term if it fits your workflow.

name: SkaleAgents
tagline: DevOps review bots and infrastructure audits you can run from your AI coding assistant
description: SkaleAgents offers specialist DevOps bots, a prompt library and an MCP server for infrastructure reviews. Teams can run audits on pasted config or public GitHub files and schedule recurring checks.
longDescription: SkaleAgents is a platform for reviewing application code and infrastructure with specialist AI prompts. It includes a public directory of DevOps bots and prompts you can open in your own assistant, plus a hosted MCP server that connects clients such as Cursor, Claude Code and Claude Desktop through OAuth to call an architecture review tool. Organizations can run audit jobs by pasting infrastructure text and choosing DevSecOps, SRE, MLOps or scaling specialists, then review findings in a shared session. Scheduled audits can watch saved configs or public GitHub files and send webhook alerts. A Creator Studio lets users publish their own bots.
features: Library of DevOps bots and prompts
MCP server for AI coding clients
pros: Public bots and prompts are free to browse
Works inside tools developers already use
Covers security, reliability and scaling angles
cons: Paid plan prices are not clearly published
Review quality depends on the context you provide
moreContext:
Infrastructure reviews often wait until a senior engineer has time to read through config files. SkaleAgents packages that kind of review into specialist bots and audit jobs that you can call from the AI assistants you already use. The mix of a free prompt library and a hosted MCP server makes it easy to try before committing.

- A public directory of DevOps bots and prompts can be used without an account.
- The hosted MCP server connects to clients such as Cursor, Claude Code and Claude Desktop through OAuth.
- Audit jobs let you pick DevSecOps, SRE, MLOps or scaling specialists and review results in a shared session.
- Scheduled audits can watch saved infrastructure text or a public GitHub file and send webhook alerts when something changes.
- A Creator Studio lets you write your own bots and keep them private or publish them.

SkaleAgents is best for small platform teams, consultants and solo developers who want a second opinion on Terraform, Kubernetes or cloud setups without hiring a reviewer. A practical tip: start with the free public bots inside your coding assistant on a non-production config, and only set up scheduled audits once you trust the findings for your stack.

name: Meshy
tagline: Generate textured 3D models from text prompts, photos or sketches in under a minute
description: Meshy turns text descriptions and images into 3D models you can texture, rig, animate and export. It connects to tools like Blender, Unity and Unreal and offers an API.
longDescription: Meshy is an AI 3D creation platform for turning prompts, photos or sketches into usable 3D models. It offers text to 3D, image to 3D, AI texturing with PBR materials, automatic rigging and a library of animation motions, plus a chat-style 3D agent. Models export in common formats such as FBX, OBJ, GLB and STL. Plugins and bridges cover Blender, Unity, Unreal, Godot, Roblox and popular 3D printing slicers, and developers can use an API, MCP server or CLI. A free plan includes monthly credits under an attribution license, while paid plans add more credits, faster queues and private licensing.
pros: Fast results from a single photo or prompt
Wide export format and engine support
cons: Free plan assets require attribution
Complex models may still need manual cleanup
moreContext:
Building 3D assets has traditionally required modeling skills and a lot of time. Meshy shortens that process by producing a textured model from a short prompt or a single reference image, then letting you rig, animate and export it from the same place. Its broad set of integrations means the output can go straight into a game engine, a 3D editor or a slicer.

- Text to 3D and image to 3D cover both idea-first and reference-first workflows.
- AI texturing adds PBR materials to new or existing models.
- Auto rigging and a library of preset motions help bring characters to life without manual skinning.
- Plugins for Blender, Unity, Unreal, Godot, Roblox and 3D printing tools reduce import friction.
- An API, MCP server and CLI make it possible to fit generation into automated pipelines.

Meshy is best for indie game developers, 3D printing hobbyists, product designers and educators who need many assets quickly. A practical tip: for image to 3D, use a clean, well-lit photo of a single object on a plain background, since cluttered images tend to produce messier geometry. Remember that free plan models carry a CC BY 4.0 license, so credit Meshy if you use them publicly.

name: Restaurant Site Finder
tagline: Free AI location analysis that gives a GO or NO-GO verdict for a new restaurant site
description: Restaurant Site Finder analyzes any U.S. address for a planned restaurant concept. It maps competitors, spots market gaps and returns an opportunity score with a GO or NO-GO verdict.
longDescription: Restaurant Site Finder is a free web tool from restaurant supplier Horeca Store that helps people judge a location before signing a lease. You enter a U.S. address and your restaurant concept, and the tool scans the surrounding area using Google Maps and Places data. AI then looks at nearby competitors, review sentiment, cuisine saturation and gaps in the local market to build an opportunity report with a GO or NO-GO score. The report also suggests concepts that could work well in the area and a starter equipment checklist. It is aimed at first-time restaurant owners, operators planning a new location and consultants doing early research.
pros: Quick first read on a location
Uses review sentiment, not just counts
cons: Limited to U.S. addresses
Equipment suggestions point to the sponsor's store
moreContext:
Choosing the wrong location is one of the most expensive mistakes a new restaurant can make, and professional site studies are often out of reach for small operators. Restaurant Site Finder offers a free first look by combining map data with AI analysis of the competition around an address. The clear GO or NO-GO verdict gives people a simple starting point for deeper research.

- Any U.S. address can be checked against a specific restaurant concept.
- Nearby competitors are mapped, and cuisine saturation shows whether an area already has too much of the same thing.
- Review sentiment from Google Places data adds context beyond simple restaurant counts.
- The report suggests concepts that may fit gaps in the local market.
- A starter equipment checklist helps with early budgeting.

It is best for aspiring restaurant owners, food truck operators moving to a fixed site and consultants who want a quick screening tool before paying for a full feasibility study. A practical tip: run the same address with two or three different concepts, since comparing the scores can reveal which idea has the clearest opening in that neighborhood. Treat the result as a starting point and still visit the site at different times of day.

name: Loom
tagline: Screen recording with AI titles, summaries, filler word removal and video-to-doc workflows
description: Loom records screen and camera videos and uses AI to add titles, summaries and chapters, clean up filler words and turn recordings into docs, tickets and meeting notes.
longDescription: Loom is a video messaging tool, now part of Atlassian, for recording your screen, camera or both and sharing the result with a link. Its AI features automatically write titles, summaries and chapters, remove filler words and silences, and transcribe videos in more than 50 languages. AI workflows can turn a walkthrough into a written document, a pull request description, an SOP or a bug report in Jira or Linear. Loom can also record meetings and produce notes, action items and recap emails. A free Starter plan covers short recordings, while paid plans add unlimited videos, editing and the full AI feature set.
features: Video to doc and ticket workflows
pros: Very fast to record and share
Strong Jira, Confluence and Slack integrations
cons: Free plan limits video count and length
Full AI features require higher paid tiers
moreContext:
Short recorded videos often replace meetings, but they can still be slow to watch and hard to act on. Loom addresses that by layering AI on top of its recorder, so each video comes with a title, summary, chapters and a transcript, and can be converted into a written document or a ticket. That turns a quick walkthrough into something a team can search and reuse.

- Auto titles, summaries and chapters help viewers decide what to watch before pressing play.
- Filler word and silence removal tidies recordings without manual editing.
- AI workflows can draft SOPs, pull request descriptions and bug reports for Jira or Linear from a single video.
- Meeting recording produces notes, action items and recap emails.
- Integrations with Slack, Confluence, GitHub and Gmail fit Loom into existing team tools.

Loom is best for remote and hybrid teams, product and engineering groups, support staff and anyone who explains processes on screen. A practical tip: narrate each step clearly when recording a walkthrough you plan to turn into a doc, since the AI workflows follow what you say and show to build the written version.

name: GenImagePro
tagline: Turn one photo into product shots, photoshoots, edited images and short AI videos
description: GenImagePro is an image-to-image AI workspace that converts a single upload into product photos, fashion shoots, new backgrounds and short videos using ready-made styles instead of long prompts.
longDescription: GenImagePro is an AI image and video workspace built around image-to-image generation. You upload a product, clothing, food or portrait photo, pick a ready-made look such as studio, lifestyle or portrait, and download a high-resolution result. The platform also covers background removal and replacement, restyling, upscaling and lighting fixes, plus image-to-video for short ad and social clips. Dedicated workflows target ecommerce listings for Amazon, Etsy and Shopify, real estate visuals, headshots and restaurant menu photos. Paid weekly and monthly plans include commercial use, full-resolution downloads and no watermarks, and the site is available in many languages.
features: Preset styles for product and fashion shots
pros: Commercial use included on paid plans
Covers images and video in one place
cons: No permanent free plan
Monthly allowances do not roll over
moreContext:
Many sellers have decent product photos but lack the studio time to create a full set of listing images and ads. GenImagePro tackles that gap by letting a single upload become a range of styled visuals through preset looks rather than detailed prompts. The same workspace also handles edits, upscaling and short videos, which keeps the workflow in one tab.

- Ready-made styles for studio, lifestyle, portrait and food shots reduce the need for prompt writing.
- The site focuses on keeping products and faces recognizable across results.
- Background removal, replacement and restyling are built in alongside generation.
- Image to video turns a still into a short clip for ads or social posts.
- Paid plans include commercial use, full-resolution downloads and watermark-free output.

GenImagePro is best for ecommerce sellers, small brands, restaurant owners and real estate agents who need many polished visuals from limited source photos. A practical tip: try the weekly plan first during a busy product launch, then switch to monthly if you find yourself generating images every week, since the monthly plan works out cheaper per week.

name: AI Hairstyle
tagline: Preview 1,000+ real haircuts and hair colors on your own photo before a salon visit
description: AI Hairstyle lets you upload a selfie and try on curated real hairstyles and colors. It helps you compare looks for women, men and kids before deciding on your next cut.
longDescription: AI Hairstyle is a web app for previewing haircuts and hair colors on a photo of yourself. Instead of writing a text prompt, you browse a curated catalog of more than 1,000 real hairstyles, organized by length, texture, audience and style, and apply the one you like to your uploaded photo. Extra tools include hair color try-on, try-on from a reference photo and a face shape calculator. Photos are stored privately and deleted automatically within hours, according to the site. One free try-on credit is available after sign-in, and additional credits are sold in one-time packs or subscriptions, with one credit per hairstyle.
pros: Pick from real styles instead of writing prompts
One-time credits that do not expire
cons: Only one free try-on
Each style preview uses a credit
moreContext:
Deciding on a big haircut is easier when you can see it first. AI Hairstyle focuses on that one job, letting you place real, editor-picked hairstyles onto your own photo rather than guessing from a text prompt. The catalog approach makes it simple to compare several concrete options side by side.

- More than 1,000 hairstyles are grouped by length, texture, gender, age and occasion, including wedding and over 50 collections.
- Hair color try-on helps test shades such as copper, blonde or balayage without a salon commitment.
- A reference photo option lets you try a look you found elsewhere.
- A face shape calculator gives extra guidance on which cuts may suit you.
- One-time credit packs do not expire, which suits occasional use.

AI Hairstyle is best for anyone planning a noticeable change, from a first pixie cut to a new color, and for stylists who want to show clients a preview. A practical tip: upload a clear, front-facing photo with your hair pulled back from your face and good lighting, since that gives the AI the cleanest outline to work with and makes comparisons more reliable.

name: VidMage
tagline: Face swap, AI video and image tools on the web and Mac, including live swaps for calls
description: VidMage offers AI face swapping for photos, videos and GIFs, plus video, image and voice generation tools. Its Mac app processes media locally and supports real-time swaps.
longDescription: VidMage is a creative AI suite best known for face swapping across photos, videos and GIFs, including scenes with several faces. Beyond swaps, the web platform brings together text to video, image to video, upscaling, lip sync, talking photos, object removal, AI image generation and voice tools such as cloning and text to speech, with access to a range of third-party video and image models. A Mac app handles processing locally and adds real-time preview, partial facial feature swaps and live face swapping for video calls and streaming. Credits are charged per image or per second of video, and an API and MCP access are offered in beta.
features: Photo, video and GIF face swap
Voice cloning and text to speech
cons: Live and offline features are Mac only
Face swap tools require care around consent
moreContext:
VidMage started with face swapping and has grown into a broad toolkit for playful and creative video work. The combination of a web platform and a Mac app gives users a choice between cloud convenience and local processing, which is less common among tools in this space.

- Face swaps work on photos, videos and GIFs, with support for multiple faces in one frame.
- The Mac app runs swaps locally, previews them in real time and can swap only individual features.
- Live face swapping works with video call and streaming apps such as Zoom, Google Meet and OBS.
- The web suite adds video generation, lip sync, talking photos, upscaling and voice tools.
- Credits are charged per image or per second of video, and an API with MCP access is in beta.

VidMage is best for content creators, meme makers and hobbyists who want quick, entertaining edits, and for Mac users who prefer keeping media on their own device. A practical tip: the company states its tools are for creative and entertainment use, so only upload faces you own or have clear permission to use, and test on a short clip first to check quality before spending credits on longer videos.

name: QMS2GO
tagline: AI-built ISO 9001 quality management system for small and mid-sized manufacturers
description: QMS2GO builds and runs an ISO 9001 quality system for manufacturers, covering document control, audits, CAPA, suppliers and receiving, with a flat monthly price instead of per-seat fees.
longDescription: QMS2GO is quality management software for small and mid-sized manufacturers, distributors and quality consultants working toward ISO 9001 or API Q1. The company says a single voice or chat conversation can generate a complete quality system, including procedures, policies, registers, audit programs, training matrices and document control. Day to day, it manages audits, corrective and preventive actions, supplier records and receiving inspections in one place, with QuickBooks sync and compliance monitoring designed to keep evidence audit-ready. It is aligned to the ISO 9001:2026 revision and includes free transition resources. Pricing is a flat subscription rather than per seat, and demos are booked through the site.
pros: Flat pricing with no per-seat fees
cons: High starting price for very small shops
Demo required to get started
moreContext:
ISO 9001 projects often stall because of the sheer volume of documents and registers that have to be written and kept current. QMS2GO takes on that load by generating the core quality system from a conversation and then keeping the records connected as work happens. For smaller manufacturers without a large quality department, that can make certification far more approachable.

- Procedures, policies, registers, audit programs and training matrices can be drafted from a voice or chat session, according to the company.
- Document control, audits, CAPA, supplier management and receiving live in one system.
- QuickBooks sync connects quality records with existing business data.
- Content is aligned to the ISO 9001:2026 revision, with free guides, a crash course and a transition program.
- A flat monthly subscription avoids per-user charges as more staff get access.

QMS2GO is best for small and mid-sized manufacturers, distributors and quality consultants preparing for certification or the ISO 9001:2026 transition. A practical tip: gather your existing procedures, org chart and supplier list before the demo, since having real material on hand makes it easier to judge how well the generated system matches your operations.

name: SceneFlare
tagline: One studio for many AI image and video models, editing tools and visual effects
description: SceneFlare brings several leading AI image and video models together with reference workflows, editing tools and effect templates, and shows credit estimates before each generation.
longDescription: SceneFlare is a web-based AI visual studio that gathers multiple third-party image and video models in one interface. You can start from a task, such as product photography, headshots, virtual try-on or ad images, or pick a specific model and generate from a prompt or reference image. Image tools include background removal, upscaling, object and person removal, text editing inside images and mockup generation, while video tools and a library of effect templates cover motion and trend-style clips. Credit estimates appear before you generate, and results are saved for 30 days. Monthly, yearly and one-time credit plans are available.
features: Access to multiple image and video models
Task-based tools like try-on and headshots
Effect templates for photos and videos
pros: Compare many models without separate accounts
Clear credit cost before each job
Credit packs that do not expire
cons: No free plan listed
Results are stored for only 30 days
moreContext:
New image and video models arrive constantly, and keeping separate accounts for each one quickly becomes tiring. SceneFlare offers a single studio where you can switch between models, use task-focused tools and see the credit cost before you commit. That transparency is helpful for anyone trying to manage a creative budget.

- Multiple image and video models are available in one place, so you can compare outputs side by side.
- Task-based entry points such as product photography, virtual try-on and ad images simplify common jobs.
- Editing tools cover background removal, upscaling, object removal and text replacement inside images.
- A library of effect templates helps produce trend-style photo and video clips.
- Credit estimates appear before generation, and one-time credit packs stay available until used.

SceneFlare is best for content creators, small marketing teams and ecommerce sellers who want flexibility across models without juggling subscriptions. A practical tip: download anything you want to keep soon after generating, because the site saves results for 30 days, and run a quick test on a cheaper model before using premium video models on a final version.

name: Intellemo
tagline: AI video production with script, audio and storyboard approval before you pay for clips
description: Intellemo creates cinematic AI videos for product demos, ads and launches. You approve the script, voice and storyboard first, then pay by video second and revise single shots.
longDescription: Intellemo is an AI video production platform for businesses, D2C brands, marketers and creators. You describe your product, goal and audience, then define characters, products and visual references so scenes stay consistent. The system drafts a script, voice and storyboard, which you can review and revise before any paid generation happens. An AI agent picks suitable image and video models for each shot, and individual shots can be regenerated without redoing the whole video. Features include voice and character consistency, lip sync and narration. Pricing is based on seconds of generation capacity, and the storyboard stage is free to start.
pros: See the plan before paying for video
Fix one shot without regenerating everything
Usage shown in seconds up front
cons: Plan prices are not clearly listed
Per-second pricing can add up for long videos
moreContext:
AI video tools can burn through credits when a full clip has to be regenerated for one small mistake. Intellemo is built around checkpoints instead: you approve the script, audio and storyboard before paying for video, and later revisions can target a single shot. That structure gives marketing teams more control over both quality and spend.

- A staged workflow covers script, voice, storyboard, clips and final render, with review at each step.
- Characters, products and visual references are defined up front to keep scenes consistent.
- An AI agent chooses which image and video models to use for each part of the story.
- Lip sync, consistent narration and stable character identity support spokesperson and story formats.
- Usage is shown in seconds of generation capacity before you confirm a production step.

Intellemo is best for D2C brands, agencies and marketing teams producing product launches, explainers and short ads on a regular basis. A practical tip: spend extra time on the free storyboard stage, refining hooks and shot order there, since changes are cheapest before any video seconds are used.

name: SAM 3D
tagline: Meta's open models that rebuild 3D objects and human bodies from a single image
description: SAM 3D is a pair of open models from Meta. SAM 3D Objects reconstructs textured 3D objects from one photo, and SAM 3D Body estimates 3D human pose and shape.
longDescription: SAM 3D is a research release from Meta that extends the Segment Anything family into 3D. It has two models. SAM 3D Objects takes a single image, lets you select an object, and produces a posed, textured 3D reconstruction you can view from other angles, typically within seconds according to Meta. SAM 3D Body estimates 3D human pose and body shape from one image, handling unusual poses, partial occlusion and multiple people, with optional guidance from masks or keypoints. Anyone can try both in Meta's Segment Anything Playground in the browser, and model checkpoints and inference code are published on GitHub.
features: Open checkpoints and code on GitHub
pros: Free to try in the browser
Open models for developers and researchers
cons: Moderate output resolution
Reconstructs one object or person at a time
moreContext:
Getting a 3D model from an ordinary photo usually requires multiple angles or a dedicated scanning app. SAM 3D shows how far single-image reconstruction has come, and Meta has made it easy to explore by offering a browser playground alongside open code. Its pairing of object and human body models makes it useful for a wide range of experiments.

- SAM 3D Objects turns a selected object in one photo into a textured, posed 3D model.
- SAM 3D Body estimates human pose and body shape, even with occlusion or several people in frame.
- Masks or 2D keypoints can guide the body model for more control.
- The Segment Anything Playground lets anyone upload images and test results without installing anything.
- Checkpoints and inference code are available on GitHub for research and development work.

SAM 3D is best for developers, researchers, AR and VR builders and curious 3D hobbyists who want to experiment with single-image reconstruction. A practical tip: start in the browser playground with a clear photo where the object is fully visible, and review the license in each GitHub repository before using the models in a commercial project.

name: Glasp
tagline: Social web highlighter with AI summaries for articles, PDFs and YouTube videos
description: Glasp lets you highlight web pages and PDFs, save and organize notes, and share them with others. AI features summarize YouTube videos, articles and PDFs using models you choose.
longDescription: Glasp is a browser extension and web app for capturing and organizing what you read online. You highlight passages on websites and PDFs in different colors, add notes and tags, and everything is collected on your Glasp page, where it can be searched, linked and shared to platforms such as X, Slack and Teams. You can also follow other readers and see what they highlight. AI features summarize YouTube videos, web articles and PDFs using models such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Mistral, with customizable prompts. Paid plans add advanced summaries, PDF uploads, audio transcription, private highlights and Notion sync.
pros: Choice of AI models for summaries
Social discovery of other readers' highlights
cons: Best features need the browser extension
Some sync and privacy options are paid only
moreContext:
Reading on the web often leaves good ideas scattered across tabs and bookmarks. Glasp gathers highlights and notes from articles, PDFs and videos in one place, then adds AI summaries so you can review material quickly. Its social side, where you can follow other readers and browse their highlights, gives it a community feel that most note tools lack.

- Colored highlights on websites and PDFs are saved automatically to your personal Glasp page.
- AI summaries for YouTube videos, articles and PDFs can use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Mistral, with prompts you can customize.
- Tags, search and links make it easier to resurface old reading.
- Highlights can be shared to platforms such as X, Slack and Teams.
- Paid plans add PDF uploads, audio transcription, private highlights and Notion sync, and the company offers a student discount.

Glasp is best for students, writers, researchers and lifelong learners who read a lot online and want a lightweight way to keep what matters. A practical tip: customize the summary prompt early, for example asking for key takeaways plus quotes, so your saved summaries follow a consistent format that is easier to review later.

name: Keploy
tagline: Open source testing tool that turns real API traffic into tests and mocks
description: Keploy records real application traffic and replays it as API tests with auto-generated mocks for databases, queues and external services, so teams can catch regressions in CI.
longDescription: Keploy is a testing platform for backend and API teams. It captures incoming requests and outgoing dependency calls at the network layer using eBPF, so developers can record real traffic without changing application code. Those recordings become replayable test cases, and the calls to databases, caches, queues and third-party APIs become mocks that act as dependency sandboxes. Keploy can also generate API tests with AI from OpenAPI or Postman files and expand edge cases automatically. Tests run locally, in CI/CD pipelines or on Kubernetes, and flag response, schema, contract and performance regressions. The core record-and-replay engine is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.
features: Traffic record and replay via eBPF
AI test generation from OpenAPI or Postman
Regression detection in CI or Kubernetes
pros: No code changes needed to capture traffic
cons: Kubernetes and production recording are enterprise features
Free plan caps test generations and runs
moreContext:
Writing integration tests by hand is slow, and hand-made mocks drift away from how real services behave. Keploy takes a different route by listening to the traffic your application already handles and turning it into tests and sandboxes. Because capture happens at the kernel level with eBPF, you do not need to add an SDK or rewrite code to get started. The project also leans into a newer problem: checking code produced by AI coding agents before it ships.

- Records both incoming requests and outgoing calls, so tests reflect real usage
- Generates mocks for databases, queues, caches and external APIs automatically
- Produces human-editable YAML tests from OpenAPI or Postman specs
- Runs the same suites locally, in CI/CD or on Kubernetes
- Keeps the core engine open source under the Apache 2.0 license

Keploy is best for backend teams that ship APIs often and want regression coverage without a large test-writing effort. A practical tip: record a session against a staging environment with realistic data first, then review and trim the generated tests before wiring them into your pipeline. Starting on the free Playground plan is an easy way to see how well generated tests match your service before involving the wider team.

name: Deepfake Detector
tagline: Check whether a voice clip, video or image is real or AI-generated
description: Deepfake Detector analyzes audio, video and images and returns a verdict with a confidence score and the signals behind it, through a web app, browser extension or REST API.
longDescription: Deepfake Detector is a media verification service from Deepfake Detector Inc., based in Montreal. Users upload a voice recording, video clip or image, and the system estimates whether it is authentic or synthetic, returning a verdict such as Authentic, Likely Synthetic or Inconclusive along with a confidence score and the signals it weighed. Video is analyzed frame by frame, with clips up to ten minutes on paid plans. A browser extension lets people check media directly on a web page, and developers can call a single REST endpoint with SDKs for Python, Node, Go and Ruby. It serves individuals worried about voice-clone scams as well as newsrooms, fact-checkers and KYC teams.
features: AI video, image and voice detectors
Verdicts with confidence scores and signals
REST API with webhooks and SDKs
pros: Covers audio, video and images in one place
Free plan with 50 detections a month
Explains the signals behind each verdict
cons: Results are probabilistic, not definitive
API access starts on the $49 Starter plan
moreContext:
As voice cloning and synthetic video get easier to produce, a quick second opinion on suspicious media has real value. Deepfake Detector bundles separate detectors for voice, video and images behind one interface, and it is candid that its output is a probability rather than proof. Each result comes with the signals that drove the verdict, which helps users judge how much weight to give it.

- Separate detectors tuned for voice, video and still images
- A browser extension for checking media without downloading it
- PDF and CSV export of analyses on paid plans
- One REST endpoint plus webhooks for longer files
- Files purged after analysis, with EU data residency on higher tiers

It is best for fraud, identity and newsroom teams that need a repeatable screening step, and for individuals who want to sanity-check a suspicious voice message. A practical tip: treat Inconclusive results as a prompt for manual verification, such as calling the person back on a number you already know. Testing a few known-real and known-fake samples first also helps you learn how the scores behave on the kind of media you handle.

name: PromptDrive
tagline: Shared workspace for saving, organizing and running AI prompts
