description: PromptDrive gives individuals and teams one place to store, tag, share and reuse AI prompts, with a Chrome extension and the option to run prompts on ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini using your own keys.
longDescription: PromptDrive is a prompt management app for people and teams who rely on AI chat tools. Users save prompts with notes, sort them into folders and tags, and search the library when they need something. Variables turn frequently used prompts into templates that can be filled in for different clients, products or projects. Teams can comment on prompts, iterate together and share them privately or through public links. A free Chrome extension inserts saved prompts directly into ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Midjourney. On the Business plan, users can chat with OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models inside PromptDrive by connecting their own API keys.
features: Folders, tags and search for prompts
Chrome extension for major AI chats
Multi-model chat with your own API keys
pros: Free Personal plan with unlimited prompts
cons: Built-in chat requires your own API keys and fees
Private sharing needs a paid plan
moreContext:
Most people who use AI daily end up with prompts scattered across notes apps, docs and chat histories. PromptDrive treats those prompts as reusable assets, with structure, templates and team sharing. Its approach to model access is also refreshingly plain: instead of reselling tokens at a markup, the Business plan lets you plug in your own API keys.

- Unlimited prompt storage on the free Personal plan
- Variables that turn a good prompt into a reusable template
- A free Chrome extension that drops saved prompts into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Midjourney
- Comments and private sharing for team iteration
- One workspace to run prompts across OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models

PromptDrive is best for small teams, agencies and educators who want a shared prompt library without heavy setup. A practical tip: create a folder per client or workflow and add variables for names and context early, so prompts stay reusable as the library grows. Installing the free Chrome extension early also helps, because saved prompts are only useful if they are one click away while you work in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

name: Qorden AI
tagline: Multilingual meetings, AI dubbing and live voice translation on one platform
description: Qorden AI combines Qordenate video meetings with real-time translation, Dubbix AI dubbing, QDub voice translation and QSAP speech analytics, all built on a shared language engine.
longDescription: Qorden AI is a multilingual communication platform made up of four products. Qordenate is a video conferencing tool with built-in live translation across 33 languages. Dubbix handles AI dubbing, voice cloning and video localization without studio re-recording. QDub offers real-time voice-to-voice translation on web and mobile, and QSAP monitors contact center calls for compliance and agent coaching. The company highlights ISO 27001 and ISO 27018 certifications, encryption in transit and at rest, and private or sovereign cloud deployment on AWS. Its audience spans enterprises, government bodies, broadcasters, educators, creators and individuals who work across languages. Free tiers exist for Qordenate, Dubbix and QDub.
pros: Several products share one language engine
Free tiers on meetings, dubbing and translation
cons: Pricing is split across four products
Free Qordenate AI translation is a one-time trial
moreContext:
Language barriers show up in meetings, in recorded video and in customer calls, and most teams patch each one with a different tool. Qorden AI puts those cases under a single roof, with meetings, dubbing, live voice translation and call analytics drawing on the same language technology. The focus on certifications and sovereign cloud options also signals that it is built with regulated buyers in mind.

- Qordenate adds live translation to video meetings across 33 languages
- Dubbix localizes video with AI dubbing and voice cloning
- QDub translates speech in real time on phones and the web
- QSAP reviews contact center calls for compliance and coaching
- ISO 27001 and ISO 27018 certifications with private cloud options

It is best for organizations that run cross-border meetings or publish video in several languages and want one vendor for both. A practical tip: use the free Qordenate plan's AI trial sessions on a real multilingual meeting before deciding which paid tier fits your team. Since each product is priced separately, it is worth mapping which of the four you actually need, as many teams will only use one or two.

name: NovelShaft
tagline: AI novel writing studio where the author approves every change
description: NovelShaft helps fiction writers brainstorm, draft and revise long-form stories with AI that draws on the manuscript, outline and story notes, on the web and iOS.
longDescription: NovelShaft is a novel writing app for web and iOS built around long-form fiction projects. Writers can start from a scene, a character, a mood or an existing draft by typing or speaking, then work with AI conversations that reference the manuscript, outline and reference notes such as characters, world rules and timelines. Suggested changes appear in a review window before they apply, and project-wide undo protects earlier work. The editor supports horizontal or vertical text and read-aloud. Writers can import Word, PDF, Markdown and other files, then export to Text, Markdown, DOCX, PDF or EPUB 3, or publish privately, by link or publicly. An Android app is in preparation.
features: AI chat that reads your manuscript and notes
Review window before AI edits apply
Vertical or horizontal writing with read-aloud
Export to DOCX, PDF and EPUB 3
pros: Free plan with monthly AI credits
cons: Higher tiers cost $30 to $90 a month
Android app not yet available
moreContext:
Many AI writing tools leave useful ideas buried in chat history, far from the actual manuscript. NovelShaft keeps the AI tied to the project itself, so suggestions draw on your outline, characters and world rules. Its guiding idea is that the AI proposes while the author decides, and the product backs that up with a review step and project-wide undo.

- AI conversations grounded in the manuscript, outline and story notes
- A review window that shows changes before they touch your draft
- Vertical writing support, a nod to Japanese light novel culture
- Imports from Word, PDF, Markdown, spreadsheets and images
- EPUB 3 export plus private, link-only or public publishing

NovelShaft is best for novelists working on long projects who want help without handing over control of the prose. A practical tip: load your character and world notes before drafting, since the AI's suggestions can only draw on reference material it has been given. The free plan's monthly credits and the starter credits for new accounts give enough room to test this on a real chapter before paying.

name: Influvine
tagline: Find YouTube creators that fit your brief using plain-English search
description: Influvine searches YouTube for creators that match a plain-English brief, filters by size, country and recent activity, and uses AI to verify each channel's fit with a stated reason.
longDescription: Influvine is a YouTube influencer discovery tool for marketers, founders and agencies. Instead of building filter-heavy queries, users describe the kind of creator they want in plain English. The tool searches YouTube, narrows channels by subscriber size, country, upload recency and minimum views, then uses AI to read recent video titles and check whether each channel matches the brief. Every result comes with a reason, and channels that were dropped are logged with an explanation too. When a creator lists a public business email, Influvine surfaces it, and results can be exported to CSV. Plans are based on monthly search runs, and a done-for-you service is also offered.
features: Filters for size, country and recency
Public contact emails and CSV export
pros: Explains why channels were kept or dropped
cons: Covers YouTube only
Emails appear only when creators list them publicly
moreContext:
Finding the right YouTube creators usually means hours of scrolling and guesswork about whether a channel is still active. Influvine shortens that work by turning a written brief into a filtered, AI-checked shortlist. What stands out is the transparency: you see why each creator made the list and why others were cut, which makes the results easier to trust and refine.

- Briefs written in everyday language rather than complex filters
- Checks for upload recency and minimum views to skip dormant channels
- AI review of recent video titles against your brief
- Logged reasons for both accepted and rejected channels
- CSV export with publicly listed business emails

Influvine is best for startups and small agencies running YouTube sponsorships or product seeding. A practical tip: be specific in your brief about audience, niche and region, then read the dropped-channel reasons to tighten the next run. If a brief returns too few creators, loosen the size or country filters before rewriting the description itself. The free plan's ten runs are enough to test a few briefs and compare how the shortlists change.

name: SEOAgent
tagline: AI SEO agent that researches, writes, publishes and tracks your content
description: SEOAgent finds search queries your site can realistically win, drafts and scores articles, publishes them to your CMS and tracks rankings plus visibility in AI answer engines.
longDescription: SEOAgent is AI software that runs much of the content SEO workflow. It analyzes a website, scores how winnable each search query is for that domain, and groups topics into clusters. It then drafts articles with titles, meta descriptions and FAQs, checks them for SEO and AI search quality, and leaves them for human review. Approved pieces publish to WordPress, Ghost, Webflow, Shopify or Payload, or through a signed webhook and JSON feed, with automatic indexing submission. The platform also tracks rankings, runs site audits and monitors whether Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude mention or cite the brand. An MCP endpoint lets users drive it from Claude or Cursor.
pros: Covers research through publishing in one tool
Tracks citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity and more
cons: No free plan, with paid tiers from $99 a month
Generated articles still need human review
moreContext:
Content SEO involves a lot of steps that rarely live in one tool: research, writing, publishing, rank tracking and now visibility in AI answers. SEOAgent connects those steps into a single pipeline, starting with a practical question about which queries a given domain can actually win. Its tracking of AI answer engines alongside classic rankings reflects how search behavior is shifting.

- Keyword research scored by how realistic a ranking is for your site
- Drafts with titles, meta descriptions and FAQs checked before review
- Publishing to WordPress, Ghost, Webflow, Shopify, Payload or a webhook
- Monitoring of brand mentions and citations across five AI answer engines
- Whitelabel reports and an MCP endpoint for Claude or Cursor

SEOAgent is best for site owners and SEO agencies managing several sites who want one workflow instead of a stack of separate tools. A practical tip: use the free first research run on a new site to see which opportunities it surfaces before committing to a plan. Reviewing the first batch of drafts closely is also wise, since your edits are what keep the published voice consistent with your brand.

name: Instant Redesign
tagline: Paste a URL and get an AI redesign of every page as deployable HTML and CSS
description: Instant Redesign scans an existing website, rebuilds every page with a modern AI-generated design using your current content, and exports clean HTML and CSS you can host anywhere.
longDescription: Instant Redesign is a web tool for refreshing an outdated website without starting over. Users paste a site's URL, and the service reads its sitemap, structure, navigation, colors, fonts and content, then generates a redesigned version of each page. Users can pick a visual style or let the tool choose one that suits the site. After generation, they can request changes, and the tool re-renders the page while keeping layout, copy and structure intact. Finished designs download as responsive HTML and CSS files ready to deploy on any host. A free preview covers one full-page generation, while the Pro plan allows unlimited redesigns for one website.
pros: Uses your existing content and brand signals
No lock-in, since files host anywhere
cons: Free preview is limited to one page
Pro covers a single website
moreContext:
Plenty of small business sites work fine but look dated, and a full rebuild feels like too much effort. Instant Redesign aims at that gap by reading the site you already have and producing a modern version of every page from your own content. Because the output is plain HTML and CSS, you are not tied to a proprietary builder after the redesign.

- Scans the sitemap so the whole site gets redesigned, not just the homepage
- Pulls brand colors, fonts and imagery from the current site
- Lets you choose a style or have one selected automatically
- Supports follow-up edit requests that keep layout and copy intact
- Exports responsive, deploy-ready files

Instant Redesign is best for owners of small business or portfolio sites who want a fresher look without hiring an agency. A practical tip: use the free preview on your most important page first, and check how the generated design handles your real navigation and calls to action before upgrading. Keep a copy of the original site handy as well, so you can compare content and links once the new files are live.

name: My Resume Robot
tagline: Store your whole career once and get a tailored resume for every job
description: My Resume Robot keeps your full work history in one profile, then generates a focused resume and cover letter for each job posting you paste, with interview prep and an application tracker.
longDescription: My Resume Robot is an AI job search toolkit built around a single master career profile. Users import their history from PDF, Word, LinkedIn or job site profiles, then paste a job posting to generate a resume and cover letter focused on that role. A match score compares the resume with the posting and suggests truthful improvements, and an AI chat assistant helps refine wording and bullet points. Interview prep produces practice questions across five categories with STAR frameworks. An application tracker follows each job from saved to offer. Six templates are available, with export to PDF, DOCX or HTML. The free plan includes three tailored applications.
features: Master career profile with smart import
Tailored resume and cover letter per posting
pros: One-time passes as an alternative to subscriptions
cons: Free plan is capped at three tailored applications
Monthly plan costs $24.99
moreContext:
People with varied careers often struggle to fit everything on one resume, and rewriting it for every application is tiring. My Resume Robot solves that by keeping the complete history in one place and pulling out what matters for each job. Its founder built it after decades of self-employment across different kinds of work, which shows in its focus on tailoring rather than templates alone.

- A single profile that holds every role, skill and achievement
- Resumes and cover letters generated from a pasted job posting
- Match scoring with suggestions that stay truthful to your experience
- Interview practice questions with STAR answer frameworks
- A tracker covering saved, applied, interview and offer stages

It is best for job seekers whose experience spans different kinds of roles, from recent graduates to senior professionals. A practical tip: spend time making the master profile thorough before generating anything, since every tailored resume and cover letter draws from it. The free plan's three tailored applications are a good way to judge output quality on real postings, and the one-time passes suit a short, focused search better than a subscription.

name: Seedance 2.0
tagline: ByteDance's multimodal video model that generates sound and picture together
description: Seedance 2.0 from ByteDance Seed creates video with synchronized audio from text, images, audio clips and reference videos, giving creators control over motion, lighting and camera work.
longDescription: Seedance 2.0 is a video generation model developed by ByteDance's Seed research team and introduced in February 2026. It uses a unified architecture that generates audio and video together rather than adding sound afterward. Prompts can combine text with reference images, audio and video clips, which gives creators direction over performance, lighting, shadows and camera movement. ByteDance reports strong motion stability and leading scores on its own SeedVideoBench-2.0 tests for text-to-video, image-to-video and multimodal tasks. The official page offers access through the Dola assistant, a BytePlus playground and a developer API, and the model is also offered through many third-party platforms.
features: Text, image, audio and video inputs
pros: Official model from the ByteDance Seed team
Sound generated in sync with visuals
cons: Pricing varies by access route and is not listed on the model page
Drew copyright complaints soon after launch
moreContext:
Most video models treat sound as an afterthought, if they handle it at all. Seedance 2.0 generates audio and picture in a single pass, so dialogue, effects and motion line up from the start. It also accepts a rich mix of references, letting creators guide a shot with images, audio and existing clips instead of relying on text alone. That makes it easier to keep characters, voices and style consistent across shots.

- A unified architecture that produces video and audio together
- Mixed inputs combining text, images, audio and video references
- Control over performance, lighting, shadows and camera movement
- Official access through ByteDance's Dola assistant and the BytePlus playground
- A developer API for building it into products

Seedance 2.0 is best for filmmakers, advertisers and content teams who want directed, cinematic clips with sound. A practical tip: many sites resell access under the Seedance name, so start from ByteDance's official Seed page to find the genuine playground and API before choosing a third-party platform. Short test clips with one or two strong reference images are a sensible way to learn how the model responds before planning longer or more complex sequences.

name: Voice Memo Exporter
tagline: Bulk export and transcribe Apple Voice Memos on your Mac
description: Voice Memo Exporter copies your Apple Voice Memos, transcribes them locally on your Mac and combines them into one searchable master transcript in TXT, Markdown, DOCX or PDF.
longDescription: Voice Memo Exporter is a Mac app that turns a backlog of Apple Voice Memos into an organized, searchable archive. It copies the audio files, transcribes them on the device, preserves dates and metadata where available, and builds a single Master Transcript in TXT, Markdown, DOCX or PDF. The export folder also holds original audio, formatted and raw transcripts, metadata in JSON and CSV, and reports. Nothing is uploaded to the cloud, no Apple ID login is needed, and original recordings stay untouched. The combined transcript is designed to be pasted into assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude. It runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 12 or later and is sold as a one-time license.
features: Bulk export of Apple Voice Memos
Metadata exports in JSON and CSV
cons: Apple Silicon Macs only
Transcription is weaker on distant or noisy audio
moreContext:
Years of voice memos can hold ideas, interviews and family stories that are nearly impossible to search. Voice Memo Exporter pulls them all out of Apple's app and turns them into text you can read, search and reuse. It does the transcription on your own Mac, which matters for recordings that are personal or sensitive.

- Exports hundreds of memos in one pass while keeping originals unchanged
- Local transcription with no cloud upload and no Apple ID sign-in
- One combined Master Transcript in TXT, Markdown, DOCX or PDF
- Structured metadata files for anyone who wants to sort or analyze recordings
- A transcript format that works well as context for AI assistants

It is best for writers, founders and families with large memo libraries who value privacy. A practical tip: since the developer describes transcription as best-effort, spot-check older or noisier recordings against the audio, which stays in the export folder for reference. The $49 price is described as early pricing that may rise. Running a small batch first is a good way to see how long transcription takes on your Mac before exporting the full library.

name: PicOnTap
tagline: Edit photos by describing the change in plain language
description: PicOnTap is a browser-based AI photo editor where you upload an image and describe edits such as removing objects, swapping backgrounds or restoring old photos, using models like GPT Image and Nano Banana.
longDescription: PicOnTap is a web-based image editor driven by text instructions. Users upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo up to 10 MB, describe what they want changed, and an AI model applies the edit. Common tasks include removing objects or people with matching background fill, replacing backgrounds, recoloring details, restoring old photos and reducing glare or shadows. A brush lets users limit an edit to one area, and a comparison slider shows results against the original while earlier versions stay available. Users can choose among several image models, including GPT Image, Nano Banana and Seedream. Free daily credits reset each day, and paid plans add monthly credit allowances.
features: Brush to limit edits to an area
pros: Multiple leading models in one editor
Keeps earlier versions of each edit
cons: Free allowance is only 2 credits a day
Uploads are capped at 10 MB
moreContext:
Many photo fixes are simple to describe but fiddly to do by hand, like removing a stranger from a travel shot or cleaning up an old family print. PicOnTap lets you type the change and pick the model that handles it, instead of learning layers and masks. It also shows the credit cost before you submit an edit, so there are no surprises.

- Plain-language edits for removal, recoloring and background swaps
- Area brushing for local changes when a global edit is too broad
- Restoration tools for scratches, fading, glare and shadows
- Several models available, including GPT Image, Nano Banana and Seedream
- A comparison slider and saved version history

PicOnTap is best for online sellers, social media creators and anyone restoring personal photos who wants quick edits without design software. A practical tip: brush over the exact area you want changed for small fixes, since a tighter selection helps keep the rest of the image untouched. Trying the same edit with two different models is also worthwhile, since each one handles faces, text and fine detail a little differently.

name: Artificial Analysis
tagline: Independent benchmarks comparing AI models and API providers
description: Artificial Analysis publishes independent evaluations of language, image, video and speech models, comparing intelligence, speed and price so teams can pick the right model and provider.
longDescription: Artificial Analysis is an independent benchmarking site for AI models and the providers that serve them. Its Intelligence Index combines ten evaluations to compare language models on capability, speed and cost per task. Leaderboards cover language models, image and video generation and editing, text-to-speech and speech-to-text, with some rankings based on blind human preference votes. A providers leaderboard compares API hosts on speed, latency, price and accuracy. Specialized indexes track coding agents, cybersecurity and domain skills in areas like finance, law and healthcare. Tools such as a model recommender and Optima for custom benchmarks support deeper evaluation. The company is led by co-founders Micah Hill-Smith and George Cameron in San Francisco.
features: Leaderboards across text, image, video and speech
API provider speed and price comparisons
cons: Rankings shift often as new models appear
General benchmarks may not match your workload
moreContext:
Choosing an AI model involves trade-offs between quality, speed and cost, and vendor marketing rarely helps with that. Artificial Analysis fills the gap with independent measurements across many models and the providers that host them. Its coverage goes beyond chat models to image, video and speech, which makes it a useful single reference for teams building with several kinds of AI.

- An Intelligence Index that rolls ten evaluations into one comparable score
- Separate measurements of speed, latency and price per provider
- Blind preference rankings for image, video and speech models
- Domain-specific indexes for coding agents, cybersecurity, finance, law and healthcare
- A changelog that records each new model evaluation

Artificial Analysis is best for developers, product teams and researchers deciding which model or API provider to adopt. A practical tip: shortlist models on the leaderboards, then confirm with a small test on your own prompts, since a general benchmark cannot capture every use case. Checking the provider comparisons for your chosen model is worthwhile too, since the same model can differ in speed and price depending on who hosts it.

name: DoNotPay
tagline: Consumer toolkit for canceling subscriptions, disputing charges and beating red tape
description: DoNotPay offers a bundle of AI-assisted consumer tools for canceling subscriptions, requesting refunds, fighting spam calls, finding unclaimed money and handling routine paperwork.
longDescription: DoNotPay is a subscription service that bundles more than a hundred self-help tools for everyday consumer tasks. Members can cancel subscriptions, file chargebacks and refund requests, skip phone queues, appeal banned accounts and pursue warranty or airline compensation claims. Other tools target spam email, texts and robocalls, search for unclaimed funds and scholarships, and help with fee waivers. A bureaucracy section covers DMV appointments, FOIA requests, online faxing, mailing, notarization and passport photos. Virtual cards and burner phone numbers help protect against unwanted charges. The company, founded in 2015, states that it is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.
pros: Many consumer tasks in one membership
cons: Pricing is not shown on the homepage
Settled FTC charges over its past AI lawyer claims
moreContext:
Dealing with customer service lines, recurring charges and government forms eats up time that most people would rather spend elsewhere. DoNotPay gathers dozens of these chores into one membership and handles much of the letter writing and form filling for you. It has been around since 2015, which makes it one of the longer-running consumer automation services. The range is wide, covering everything from airline compensation to passport photos.

- Tools to cancel subscriptions and push for refunds or chargebacks
- Help with spam texts, emails and robocalls
- Searches for unclaimed funds, scholarships and fee waivers
- Practical services like online fax, mail, notarization and passport photos
- Virtual cards that guard against charges after free trials

DoNotPay is best for people who regularly fight subscriptions, fees and paperwork and want one place to handle them. A practical tip: treat its output as self-help rather than legal advice, as the company itself notes, and consult an attorney for anything with serious stakes. In 2025 the FTC finalized an order over the company's earlier marketing of its AI lawyer, so judge the tools on what they actually do.

name: LaunchVault
tagline: Bite-sized AI lessons, prompts and courses for busy beginners
description: LaunchVault teaches practical AI skills through short lessons, copy-ready prompts, micro-courses, workflows and cheatsheets, with a personalized daily feed based on your goals.
longDescription: LaunchVault is an AI learning platform aimed at beginners and busy professionals who want to understand and use AI without jargon. It organizes content into formats such as prompts, micro-courses, workflows, agent blueprints, tool guides, playbooks, challenges and cheatsheets across topics from prompting and agents to business uses, machine learning basics and ethics. Courses use short quizzes that must be passed before the next lesson opens. A personalized feed serves daily insights, prompts and lessons based on chosen goals and skill level. An agent blueprint builder, a glossary and a blog round out the site. The free plan includes daily prompts and the glossary, while paid tiers open the full library.
pros: Low entry price at $5 a month
Short formats that fit a busy day
cons: Full courses require the Creator plan or higher
A newer platform with little public track record
moreContext:
Learning AI can feel overwhelming when every tutorial assumes technical background. LaunchVault takes the opposite approach, breaking the subject into short lessons and ready-to-use prompts that fit into a few minutes a day. The quiz gates on courses add a bit of structure, so learners actually check their understanding before moving on. Everything is written in plain English, which keeps the focus on practical use rather than theory.

- Ten content formats, from cheatsheets to agent blueprints
- Coverage of prompting, agents, business uses, ML basics and ethics
- Quizzes you must pass before the next lesson opens
- A daily feed tailored to your goals and level
- A free glossary and blog that stay open to everyone

LaunchVault is best for students, freelancers, creators and small business owners getting started with AI. A practical tip: set your goals carefully during onboarding, since the personalized feed draws on them, and use the free plan for a week to see whether the daily format sticks before upgrading. Saving the prompts that work for you in the free tier's ten slots is a simple way to build a personal starter kit.

name: Tattoos AI
tagline: Generate custom tattoo design ideas from a text description
description: Tattoos AI turns a written tattoo idea into several design concepts in styles like dotwork, minimalist, watercolor and blackwork, with free extras such as a stencil maker and font generator.
longDescription: Tattoos AI is a web-based tattoo design generator. Users describe the tattoo they have in mind, choose from more than 18 styles such as dotwork, minimalist, watercolor or blackwork, select colors, and receive several concept designs. A surprise option picks a style automatically, and generated designs can serve as a starting point for further changes. The site also offers free tools that need no account, including a pain chart, stencil maker, tattoo font generator and a guide to symbol meanings. New accounts can create four designs at no cost, and subscriptions add unlimited designs with permanent cloud storage. Designs on the base plan appear in a public gallery, while Pro keeps them private.
features: Free stencil maker and font generator
Pain chart and symbol meanings guide
pros: Unlimited designs from $4.99 a month billed annually
cons: Base plan designs are public in the gallery
Monthly billing costs $14.99
moreContext:
Many people know roughly what tattoo they want but struggle to find a reference that matches the idea in their head. Tattoos AI turns a written description into several concepts in the style you pick, which makes it easier to explore directions before visiting an artist. The free planning tools, like the pain chart and stencil maker, add value even before you generate anything.

- More than 18 styles, including dotwork, watercolor and blackwork
- Several concept designs per prompt to compare directions
- A free stencil maker and tattoo font generator
- A symbol meanings guide and pain chart for planning placement
- Permanent cloud storage for saved designs on paid plans

Tattoos AI is best for people planning a first or next tattoo who want visual ideas to bring to their artist. A practical tip: add detail about subject, placement and line weight in your prompt, and treat the results as reference material for a professional artist rather than a final stencil. If privacy matters to you, keep in mind that base plan designs appear in the public gallery, so consider the Pro plan for personal or meaningful pieces.

name: China AI
tagline: One workspace for Chinese and global AI image and video models
description: China AI gives creators access to image and video models such as Seedream, Kling, Wan and Seedance alongside GPT Image and Veo, with text-to-video, image-to-video and editing tools on a credit system.
longDescription: China AI is a web platform that gathers leading Chinese generative models and popular global ones in a single workspace. Creators can generate images from text or reference pictures and make videos from prompts or still images, choosing among models such as Seedream, Kling, Wan and Seedance, as well as GPT Image and Veo. Additional tools cover text-to-speech, AI avatars, upscaling, background removal and 3D model generation. Images can be produced at up to 4K and videos in HD across different aspect ratios. Usage runs on credits, with costs that vary by model, resolution and settings, and paid plans include commercial use rights. It is aimed at creators and marketers.
features: Access to Kling, Wan, Seedance and Veo
pros: Many Chinese and global models in one account
cons: No free plan listed
Credit costs vary by model and can be hard to predict
moreContext:
Several of the strongest image and video models now come from Chinese labs, but signing up for each one separately can be awkward for creators elsewhere. China AI bundles those models with well-known Western options so you can compare results without juggling accounts. The extra tools for upscaling, avatars and 3D make it more of a general creative workspace than a single-model wrapper.

- Access to Seedream, Kling, Wan and Seedance from one dashboard
- GPT Image and Veo available alongside the Chinese models
- Image output up to 4K and HD video in multiple aspect ratios
- Side tools for text-to-speech, avatars, upscaling and background removal
- Commercial use rights included with paid plans

China AI is best for creators and marketers who want to test several video and image models under one subscription. A practical tip: check the credit cost of each model and resolution before running long batches, since prices differ across models and settings. Comparing the same prompt on two or three models at a lower resolution first is a cheaper way to find the one that suits your style.

name: MetaFyAI
tagline: Track and improve how your brand shows up in AI-generated answers
description: A visibility platform that measures how brands, products and locations appear in answers from assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, then suggests and publishes fixes.
longDescription: MetaFyAI is a generative engine optimization platform for brands that want to understand how AI assistants talk about them. It runs buying questions against AI channels, records whether your brand, products or locations are mentioned, and compares the results with tracked competitors. Modules cover prompt intelligence, brand intelligence, site audits, local visibility and benchmarking, and the MetaFyEdge feature applies reversible changes to your website based on its recommendations. Agents can assemble brand and competitor context to answer business questions. Plans are priced per workspace, start with a 30 day free trial, and scale by the number of brands, questions, competitors and cities tracked.
features: Buying question tracking across AI channels
pros: 30 day free trial on self-serve plans
cons: Starts at $149 per month
No permanent free plan
moreContext:
AI assistants increasingly answer shopping questions before anyone clicks a search result, and MetaFyAI is built around that shift. Rather than stopping at a visibility score, it follows a loop of measuring, explaining gaps, recommending changes and publishing them, so the insight and the follow-up live in one place. The reversible change layer is a thoughtful touch for teams wary of editing a live site.

- Buying questions are tracked across several AI channels, with plan limits on how many run each month.
- Competitor tracking shows where rivals are recommended and you are not.
- Local visibility checks how a brand appears in specific cities, useful for multi-location businesses.
- MetaFyEdge applies site changes that can be rolled back if results disappoint.
- Higher tiers add an agentic catalog and API access for larger product ranges.

It suits marketing and SEO teams at brands, retailers and multi-location businesses who already watch search rankings and now want the same view for AI answers. A practical tip: during the free trial, write your question set around real purchase intent, such as comparisons and "best for" queries, since those are the prompts most likely to influence a sale.

name: NovAd
tagline: Turn a product link into a batch of short presenter-style video ads
description: Paste a listing from Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop or an app store and NovAd drafts scripts and generates vertical video ads with presenters, handheld demos or try-on clips.
longDescription: NovAd is an AI video ad generator for online sellers and app marketers. You paste a product link and it reads the title, photos, price and reviews, drafts hooks and selling points, and offers the ad formats that fit the item: a classic presenter pitch, a product-in-hand demo, or a try-on clip for wearables. Every script line can be edited before credits are spent, and the output is sized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Amazon Ads. It accepts links from Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Shopify, the App Store, Google Play and most standalone stores. Pricing is credit based, with monthly plans and one-time credit packs.
features: Vertical exports for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
pros: Works from a single product URL
cons: No free plan listed
Subscription credits expire each period
moreContext:
NovAd focuses on one job that eats a lot of time for small sellers: getting from a product page to a stack of ad variations worth testing. Because it reads the listing itself, the scripts start from real product details and reviews instead of a blank prompt. It also filters ad types by product, so a try-on format only appears when the item is something you wear.

- One link produces a batch of ads, which suits creative testing on paid social.
- Three formats cover presenter pitches, handheld demos and try-on clips.
- Scripts are fully editable before generation, so claims and tone stay under your control.
- Credit prices are shown before each render, and the company says failed renders never cost credits.
- Inputs span Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopee, Shopify and app store pages.

It is best for ecommerce brands, dropshippers and app marketers who need fresh short-form creative every week without booking creators. A practical tip: start with the one-time Starter credit pack to test a handful of videos on your best-selling product, check which hooks hold attention in your ad dashboard, then move to a monthly plan once you know which format works.

name: Solvely
tagline: AI study companion for step-by-step homework help, notes and exam prep
description: Snap, upload or type a problem to get step-by-step solutions, then turn course materials and lectures into study guides, flashcards, quizzes and mock exams.
longDescription: Solvely is an AI study app for high school and college students. It solves homework problems submitted as photos, PDFs or typed text and explains each step, with answers cross-checked across several AI models according to the company. Beyond homework, it records and transcribes lectures, turns notes, slides and YouTube links into study guides, flashcards and adaptive quizzes, and builds exam prep plans with mock tests and cheat sheets. It covers math, sciences, humanities and test prep such as the SAT and ACT. Solvely runs on the web, iOS, Android and as a Chrome or Edge extension, with a free version and a paid Unlimited plan.
pros: Available on web, mobile and browser
cons: Unlimited use requires a subscription
Answers still need checking against coursework
moreContext:
Solvely has grown from a photo math solver into a broader study workspace, and that range is what sets it apart. A student can photograph a tricky problem, then stay in the same app to review lecture notes, drill flashcards or sit a mock exam before a test. Explanations are broken into steps, which makes it more useful for learning than a bare answer.

- Problems can be submitted as a photo, a PDF or typed text.
- Lecture recording produces transcripts and notes that can become study sets.
- Exam prep tools predict likely topics and generate practice tests and printable cheat sheets.
- A Chrome and Edge extension brings help into the browser alongside web and mobile apps.
- Free extras include calculators, a paraphraser and a grammar checker.

It is a good fit for high school and college students juggling several courses who want one place for practice and review. The company says answers are checked across multiple AI models, but a practical tip still applies: work through each step yourself and compare it with your textbook method, since instructors often expect a specific approach.

name: Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant
tagline: Summarize, question and work with PDFs using the AI assistant built into Acrobat
description: Adobe's generative AI assistant inside Acrobat summarizes documents with citations, answers questions across files and can create audio overviews and presentations from PDFs.
longDescription: Acrobat AI Assistant is the generative AI feature set inside Adobe Acrobat. It reads PDFs and other documents, produces summaries with citations that link back to the source text, and answers questions in a chat panel. In PDF Spaces, several files can be gathered into a shared workspace that the assistant analyzes together. Newer features generate podcast-style audio overviews, visual reports and presentations, and the assistant can help with editing, signing, redacting and compressing files. For individuals in the US, the full assistant is included in the Acrobat Studio plan, which offers a free trial, while student and teacher plans can add it separately.
features: Q&A across multiple files in PDF Spaces
pros: Built into a widely used PDF app
Citations make answers easy to verify
cons: Full assistant requires Acrobat Studio
Costlier than standalone PDF chat tools
moreContext:
For people who already live in Acrobat, the AI Assistant puts document Q&A where the files are, rather than in a separate upload site. Its citations are the standout: each summary point links back to the passage it came from, so checking a claim in a contract or report takes seconds. PDF Spaces extends this to collections of files, which helps with research packs and due diligence folders.

- Summaries and answers include clickable citations to the source text.
- PDF Spaces groups multiple documents into one shareable workspace for questions.
- Audio overviews turn a dense document into a podcast-style listen.
- It can draft presentations and visual reports from document content.
- Standard Acrobat tools for editing, signing and redacting sit alongside the assistant.

It is best for professionals in legal, finance, consulting and education who handle long PDFs every day and want answers they can trace. A practical tip: compare plans carefully, since in the US the full assistant comes with Acrobat Studio rather than Standard or Pro, and try the free trial on a real document set before committing.

name: Human Flow
tagline: AI recruiting copilot that scores candidates and preps interview briefs
description: A hiring assistant for startups and engineering teams that scores applicants against your criteria, writes interview briefs and analyzes interview transcripts.
longDescription: Human Flow is an AI recruiting tool aimed at startups and teams hiring for technical roles. It scores incoming applicants against the criteria you set for each role and surfaces strong matches in a pipeline view with a short AI summary per candidate. Before each call it generates an interview brief listing strengths to confirm and points to probe. A chat interface lets you ask questions across candidate profiles, interview transcripts and team feedback. The free Starter plan covers up to 50 candidates a month with scoring, briefs and email integration, while the Pro plan adds unlimited candidates, transcript analysis and deeper candidate research.
pros: Free plan with no credit card
cons: Free plan capped at 50 candidates a month
Limited public information about the company
moreContext:
Human Flow keeps its scope narrow, which is a strength for small teams without a dedicated recruiter. It handles the repetitive parts of early screening, ranking applicants and preparing for calls, and leaves the judgment to the hiring manager. The interview brief is a practical touch, giving interviewers a short list of what to verify before they join the call.

- Candidates are scored against criteria you define for each role, with a summary of why.
- A pipeline view highlights new matches for every open position.
- Interview briefs list strengths and specific points to probe.
- A chat panel answers questions across profiles, transcripts and team notes.
- The Pro plan adds transcript analysis and deeper research on candidates.

It is best for founders and engineering leads running technical hiring themselves. The vendor reports large time savings, but as with any AI screening tool, a practical tip is to treat scores as a starting point: write clear, job-related criteria, review a sample of lower-ranked applicants by hand, and keep people responsible for final decisions.

name: Subtitles.app
tagline: Transcribe, translate and subtitle video and audio files in your browser
description: Upload a file or paste a video link to get transcripts in 100 languages, translations into 120 and subtitle files or a subtitled video, with a free daily allowance and pay-as-you-go Pro.
longDescription: Subtitles.app transcribes audio and video and turns the result into subtitles; the old FreeSubtitles.AI address now redirects to it. You upload MP4, MKV, MOV, MP3, WAV or FLAC files, or paste a link from one of the many video sites its importer supports, and download the transcript as SRT, VTT or TXT. Transcripts can be translated, exported as a subtitled video and queried with an "Ask this video" feature. The free tier allows a few uploads per day of up to 30 minutes each. Pro is pay as you go at a per-hour rate, with higher accuracy, speaker identification, an editor, batch processing and API access.
cons: Free video exports are watermarked and capped at 5 minutes
Free tier limited to a few uploads a day
moreContext:
Subtitles.app stands out for how little it asks of you up front. There is no account needed for a first try, and paid use is metered by the hour instead of a monthly subscription, which suits people who caption videos in bursts. The same upload yields a transcript, a translation and a subtitled video, so one pass covers several deliverables.

- Transcription covers 100 languages and translation reaches 120.
- Subtitle files download as SRT or VTT, ready for YouTube and most editors.
- A link importer fetches media from a long list of video sites, saving a download step.
- An "Ask this video" feature answers questions about the content of a file.
- Pro adds speaker identification, an editor, batch jobs and API access.

It is best for creators, teachers and small teams who need captions or translated subtitles occasionally and would rather not pay for an idle subscription. A practical tip: run a short clip through the free tier first to check accuracy for your accent and audio quality, then buy a small credit top-up for longer files, since the site says credit never expires.

name: Oasis
tagline: Play a Minecraft-style world generated frame by frame by an AI model
description: A free browser demo from Decart and Etched in which an AI world model generates every frame of an open-world block game in real time from your keyboard and mouse input.
longDescription: Oasis is an experimental game from AI company Decart, built with hardware startup Etched and released as a free public demo in October 2024. Instead of running game code, it uses a world model trained on large amounts of Minecraft gameplay footage that predicts each next frame from your previous frames and keyboard and mouse input. Players can walk, jump, break blocks and collect items, and a later update let users start from their own uploaded image. Sessions are short, a queue may apply at busy times, and visual quality is limited. Its makers describe it as a research proof of concept for AI-generated interactive worlds.
pros: A hands-on look at world models
cons: Low resolution and short sessions
World layout can shift or be forgotten
moreContext:
Oasis is less a game to finish than a demonstration you can hold in your hands. Every frame on screen is predicted by a model reacting to your inputs, with no traditional engine underneath, which makes it one of the most direct ways to see what researchers mean by a playable world model. Its quirks, like terrain that changes when you look away, are part of what makes it interesting.

- Frames are generated live from your movement and actions rather than rendered from game code.
- Basic interactions such as jumping, mining blocks and collecting items work.
- A custom worlds option starts play from an image you upload.
- It runs in a web browser, with a queue at busy times.
- Etched said it would open source the model architecture and weights for research.

It is best for curious players, developers and students who want to understand where AI-generated games are heading. Expect rough visuals and short sessions, since its makers call it a proof of concept. A practical tip: try turning around or walking away and coming back, which shows clearly how the model remembers, and forgets, the world around you.

name: ReRender AI
tagline: Turn architectural photos, sketches and 3D screenshots into photoreal renders
description: A cloud rendering tool for architects and designers that turns a photo, hand sketch or 3D model screenshot into a photorealistic image in seconds, with lighting style options.
longDescription: ReRender AI is a web-based rendering tool for architecture and interior design concepts. You upload a photo, a sketch or a screenshot from a 3D modeling program, describe the look you want, and it returns a photorealistic image in a short time, with a choice of lighting styles. Because it works from images rather than full 3D scenes, it suits early concept work, client mood boards and quick design options rather than final production visuals. A free tier allows a few watermarked, public renders per day, and the Pro plan adds unlimited renders, watermark-free output, higher image quality and a private mode.
features: Renders from photos, sketches or 3D screenshots
cons: Free renders are watermarked and public
Less suited to precise, model-driven visualization
moreContext:
This rendering tool is built for the stage of a project when ideas change by the hour and a full rendering pipeline would slow things down. Rather than building materials and lights in a 3D scene, designers feed it a quick screenshot or sketch and get a realistic image they can show a client the same day. ReRender AI works as a handy companion to traditional rendering engines rather than a replacement.

- It accepts site photos, hand sketches and screenshots from modeling software.
- Several lighting styles let you compare daytime and evening moods.
- Renders arrive quickly, which suits exploring many options in one session.
- Pro removes watermarks and adds private mode for client work.
- The free tier allows a small number of renders each day for testing.

It is best for architects, interior designers and students who need fast concept visuals and mood images. Reviewers note that it works from images, so geometry can drift from your model. A practical tip: use clean, well-lit screenshots taken from the camera angle you want, and describe materials plainly in the prompt, since clearer inputs tend to keep the result closer to your design.

name: Shopify Sidekick
tagline: Shopify's built-in AI assistant for running and growing your online store
description: An AI assistant inside the Shopify admin that answers questions about your store data, writes product copy, edits photos and carries out admin tasks for you.
longDescription: Sidekick is the AI assistant built into the Shopify admin, and Shopify's former Magic page now leads to it. Merchants open it from the admin and ask questions in plain language. Because it has access to store data, it can analyze sales, draft discount codes, write product descriptions and take actions in the admin within each staff member's permissions. It offers roles for store design, photo editing, copywriting, technical setup and marketing, plus slash commands for tasks such as pricing strategy and low stock alerts. Recent updates added customer creation, checkout customization help and transparent background images. Sidekick is included with Shopify plans at no extra charge, with limits varying by plan.
pros: Works directly on your store data
cons: Only available to Shopify merchants
Usage limits vary by plan
moreContext:
The appeal of Sidekick is context. Generic chatbots can write a product description, but Sidekick already knows your catalog, orders and settings, so it can answer questions about your own store and then carry out the change in the admin. Shopify keeps adding capabilities through a public changelog, which makes it feel like a growing part of the platform rather than an add-on.

- It reads store data to answer questions about sales, products and customers.
- Roles cover design, photo editing, copywriting, technical setup and marketing.
- Slash commands speed up tasks like discount codes, email campaigns and shipping audits.
- Actions respect each staff member's admin permissions.
- It adapts to the store's language settings for non-English merchants.

It is best for Shopify merchants, especially solo founders and small teams, who want help with routine admin and content work without installing another app. A practical tip: start with a narrow request, such as asking which products sold slowest last month, and review any proposed admin change before confirming it, so you learn how Sidekick interprets your instructions.

name: Solo Fund AI
tagline: A structured decision log that walks solo investors through each idea
description: An educational tool for individual investors that runs each investment idea through a fixed five-step AI workflow and records assumptions, data gaps and exit conditions.
longDescription: Solo Fund AI is a decision-log tool for individual investors who want more discipline in how they evaluate ideas. Each idea passes through five fixed stations, producing a structured report with a judgment memo, a kill condition, data gaps, assumptions and a position size suggestion. Users can paste holdings, cost basis and current marks for a run, and past runs are kept in a history. The service describes itself as educational: it does not place trades, connect to brokers for trading or give personalized advice. New accounts receive 50 credits, a full analysis costs 8, and monthly plans add credits, risk presets and CSV or PDF exports.
features: CSV and PDF export on higher plans
pros: Free starting credits with no card
cons: Little public information about the team
Credits run out quickly with frequent use
moreContext:
Solo Fund AI takes an unusual angle on investing tools. Instead of predicting prices or picking stocks, it focuses on process, prompting you to write down why you are interested in an idea, what would prove you wrong and what information is missing. A decision journal like this is a familiar discipline in investing, and the tool gives individuals a structured way to keep one.

- Every idea runs through the same five stations, so reports are easy to compare over time.
- Reports include a kill condition, a clear rule for when the thesis has failed.
- Data gaps and assumptions are listed separately, making blind spots visible.
- Holdings can be pasted for a single run without linking a brokerage account.
- The company says prompts and holdings are not used to train public models.

It is best for self-directed investors who want to slow down and document their reasoning. It is an educational tool, not financial advice, and the site warns that model output can be incomplete or wrong. A practical tip: revisit old runs after a few months and compare what happened with the kill condition you wrote, since that review is where a decision log pays off.

name: DeVoice
tagline: Transcribe audio, video and YouTube links with noise reduction and AI summaries
description: A browser-based transcription service that cleans up noisy audio, identifies speakers and turns files or video links into editable transcripts, subtitles and AI summaries.
longDescription: DeVoice is a web platform for converting audio and video into text. You upload a file in one of more than 25 formats or paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X or Facebook, and it applies noise reduction before transcribing with speaker detection and word-level timestamps. Transcripts can be edited in the browser and exported as TXT, SRT, VTT, DOCX or CSV. AI summaries come in formats such as meeting notes, study notes and podcast show notes, along with mind maps. Extra tools handle noise removal, audio extraction, trimming, translation and dubbing. A free plan gives daily minutes, and paid plans start at $5 per month.
cons: Free plan limited to a few minutes a day
Cloud-only, no offline mode
moreContext:
DeVoice bundles a transcription engine with a small audio workshop, which is handy when recordings are less than perfect. Noise reduction runs before the speech is converted, so a busy cafe interview or a laptop microphone recording has a better chance of coming out readable. Pasting a social video link instead of downloading a file first also saves time.

- Transcripts include speaker labels and word-level timestamps you can click to jump to.
- Links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and Facebook can be transcribed directly.
- Summaries come in templates for meetings, study notes, podcast show notes and more.
- Separate tools cover noise removal, audio extraction, trimming and echo removal.
- Exports include SRT and VTT subtitles plus DOCX and CSV.

It is best for students, podcasters, journalists and small teams who need affordable transcripts and subtitles without a heavy subscription. The site says files are deleted after processing and not used for training. A practical tip: use the daily free minutes to test a typical recording, and if your audio is noisy, compare the basic and Pro noise removal options before choosing a plan.

name: Kalyvox
tagline: AI phone receptionist that answers calls, qualifies callers and books appointments
description: An AI voice agent for small businesses that picks up calls on your existing number, asks your screening questions, transfers to staff or takes messages, and books appointments.
longDescription: Kalyvox is an AI receptionist that answers a business's phone calls. You can forward your existing number or use one supplied by Kalyvox, and choose whether it handles every call, only missed calls or only after-hours calls. On each call it identifies the reason for calling, asks the questions you define, transfers the caller to an available team member or takes a message, and can book appointments into a connected calendar. Transcripts, dashboards and email alerts follow each call, and integrations include calendars and Zapier. It targets trades, clinics, law and accounting firms, restaurants and other phone-heavy businesses. Plans include a 7 day free trial, with per-minute usage billed on top.
features: Answers all, missed or after-hours calls
cons: Per-minute usage billed on top of plans
Monthly plans start near $100
moreContext:
Missed calls are lost customers for many trades and clinics, and Kalyvox is designed to close that gap without hiring a front desk. Its flexibility on when it answers is a sensible design choice: some businesses want it on every call, while others only need it for overflow or evenings. A built-in test mode lets owners hear the assistant before any real customer does.

- Answer modes cover all calls, unanswered calls or calls outside business hours.
- You write the screening questions, so callers are qualified the way your team would do it.
- Calls can be transferred to available staff or turned into messages.
- Appointments are booked directly into a connected calendar.
- Transcripts and alerts arrive after every call, with SMS alerts on higher plans.

It is best for plumbers, electricians, dental and veterinary practices, law offices and other small businesses where the phone drives revenue. A practical tip: start in missed-calls-only mode during the free trial, review the transcripts each day, and refine your questions before letting it answer every call, since per-minute charges add up with volume.

name: Manga Translator
tagline: Translate manga and comic pages into 100+ languages with automatic lettering
description: Upload manga pages, PDFs or archives and the tool reads the speech bubbles, translates the text and places it back on the art in a comic font, with an editor for fixes.
longDescription: Manga Translator is a web tool from Ficory LLC for translating manga, manhwa and comic pages. You upload images, PDFs or ZIP and TAR archives in batches, pick a source and target language from more than 100 options, and choose a translation model and engine such as GPT, DeepSeek or Grok. The tool reads the text on each page, translates it and places the result back on the artwork in one of about 15 font styles. An online editor lets you correct dialogue, move text boxes and import custom fonts, and finished chapters export as ZIP or PDF. Free users get a few credits per day, with paid monthly plans for heavier use.
features: Batch upload of images, PDFs and archives
Editor for text and layout fixes
cons: Machine translation still needs proofreading
Plan pricing tiers are confusing
moreContext:
Translating a comic is two jobs, the language and the lettering, and Manga Translator tries to handle both in one pass. After it translates a page, the text goes back into the bubbles in a comic-style font, and an editor is there for the inevitable fixes. Batch uploads and archive support mean a whole chapter can be processed at once instead of page by page.

- Uploads accept JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, PDF and ZIP or TAR archives.
- Users can choose among translation engines, including GPT, DeepSeek and Grok.
- Several models trade speed against detail, and two detect the source language automatically.
- The editor supports moving text boxes, changing fonts and importing your own typefaces.
- Developers can use an API for larger translation workflows.

It is best for readers who want to follow untranslated series and for small localization teams preparing drafts. A practical tip: translate a few sample pages with different engines first and compare the dialogue, since tone and slang vary between them, and make sure you have the right to translate and share the work you upload.

name: AudioTranscription.io
tagline: Browser-based AI transcription for audio, video and social media links
description: Upload a recording or paste a YouTube, TikTok or podcast link and get a timestamped transcript, subtitles and an AI summary in your browser.
longDescription: AudioTranscription.io is a web tool that converts speech in audio and video files into editable text. You can upload MP3, WAV, MP4, MOV and other formats up to 500 MB, paste a link from YouTube or social platforms, or record directly in the browser. The service detects the language automatically, can separate speakers, and adds timestamps and punctuation. Finished transcripts can be edited inline and exported as TXT, SRT, VTT, DOCX or JSON, and optional AI summaries turn the text into study notes, meeting recaps or chapter outlines. Guests can try it without an account, registered users get a daily free allowance, and a Pro subscription removes most limits for heavier users.
features: SRT, VTT, DOCX and TXT export
pros: Handles links from many social platforms
cons: Free accounts limited to TXT and SRT export
Guest history is kept only briefly
moreContext:
What stands out here is how little stands between you and a transcript. You can drop a file onto the page, paste a link from YouTube or TikTok, or record straight from your microphone, and the tool takes care of the rest without asking you to install software or sign up first. It is a practical option for anyone who needs text from spoken content on short notice.

- Accepts both uploaded files and links from popular video and podcast platforms
- Automatic language detection across dozens of languages
- Speaker separation, timestamps and an inline editor that plays back the original audio
- Exports to subtitle formats such as SRT and VTT for video editors
- Optional AI summaries in several styles, from meeting notes to study notes

It is best suited to students, journalists, podcasters and creators who transcribe regularly but do not want a heavy meeting platform. The company says files are deleted after processing, which is worth knowing if you handle interviews. A useful tip: sign in with a free account before starting a large batch, since registered users keep their history for 30 days while guest history disappears after a week.

name: AI Video Translator
tagline: Translate videos into 30+ languages with editable subtitles and AI dubbing
description: Upload a video, pick a target language, review the translated subtitles line by line, then export an MP4, SRT or TXT, with optional AI voice dubbing.
longDescription: AI Video Translator is an online tool for localizing video content. You upload a file of up to 60 minutes in formats such as MP4, MOV or WebM, choose one of more than 30 target languages, and the service transcribes and translates the speech into subtitle segments. An editor shows the original and translated text side by side so you can correct names, terminology and tone before export. Speakers are detected automatically, and you can pick from a large library of AI voices to produce a dubbed version. Output options include an MP4 with translated subtitles, SRT files and plain text transcripts. A free plan with monthly credits lets you test it, and paid tiers raise the minute limits.
features: AI dubbing with hundreds of voices
pros: Review step before anything is exported
cons: Free plan caps translation at a few minutes
Videos limited to 60 minutes each
moreContext:
This tool puts the review step at the center of video translation, which is exactly where it belongs. Instead of handing you a finished dub and hoping for the best, it lays out the source and translated text segment by segment so you can fix brand names, technical terms and phrasing before you export. That makes it a sensible pick for anyone who cares about getting the wording right.

- Side-by-side editor for checking translations in context
- Automatic speaker detection that keeps multi-person dialogue organized
- A large library of AI voices you can filter by language, gender and style
- Exports without a watermark, plus SRT and TXT files for other workflows
- Generate another language version from the same upload without re-uploading

It is a good fit for creators, marketers, educators and trainers who need subtitled or dubbed versions of existing videos without hiring a localization agency. Start with the free plan on a short clip to judge translation quality for your language pair, then move up a tier once you know the minutes you need each month.

name: Decktopus
tagline: AI presentation maker with rehearsal coaching and deck analytics
description: Describe your topic and Decktopus builds a complete, on-brand slide deck, then helps you rehearse with an AI coach and track how viewers engage.
longDescription: Decktopus is an AI presentation tool aimed at consultants, agencies, coaches, educators and founders who need professional decks without a designer. You describe what you are presenting and it generates the structure, written content and visual design in one pass, and it can also produce social carousels. Decks can be shared as live links, exported to PDF, PPT or PNG, and kept up to date in one place. A rehearsal feature called Loop uses AI to simulate audience questions and gives feedback on pacing and clarity as you practice out loud. Business plans add a shared workspace, brand kits, slide analytics and custom domains. New users receive free credits to try it, with paid plans after that.
features: Full deck generation from a prompt
pros: Covers creation, practice and sharing in one tool
Live links keep shared decks current
cons: No permanent free plan
Analytics and brand kits require Business tier
moreContext:
Most AI slide tools stop once the deck is built. Decktopus keeps going, with a rehearsal coach that lets you practice delivery and tracking that shows how a shared deck is received. That makes it feel less like a template engine and more like a presentation workflow.

- Generates structure, copy and design together from a short description
- Loop rehearsal mode simulates audience questions and comments on pacing
- Shareable live links so recipients always see the latest version
- Exports to PDF, PowerPoint and PNG when you need a file
- Business features such as brand kits, shared workspaces and slide analytics

It is best for consultants, coaches, agencies and founders who present often and want to spend less time on formatting. The free signup credits are enough for a short deck, so use them on a real presentation you have coming up to judge the output. If you plan to stay, compare the annual and quarterly options, since the monthly rate is noticeably higher. Students can also ask about the education discount the company advertises on its pricing page.

name: Andi
tagline: Ad-free AI search that answers questions with cited sources
description: Andi is a conversational search engine that returns direct, sourced answers instead of a page of links, with a strong emphasis on privacy and no ads.
longDescription: Andi is an AI search engine built around answers rather than lists of links. You type a question as you would to a knowledgeable friend, and Andi reads results from the web, summarizes them and points to the sources behind each claim. The interface mixes chat with visual result cards, so you can follow up or jump to the original pages. The company positions Andi as private and ad-free, and its privacy policy says it does not store personal data, cookies or search logs. It is free to use in the browser, and the team behind it, LazyWeb Inc. in San Francisco, also offers a developer API for building search into other products.
pros: Answers come with sources to verify
cons: Requires JavaScript and a modern browser
Smaller ecosystem than the largest AI search tools
moreContext:
Andi takes a calm, uncluttered approach to AI search. There are no ads competing for attention, answers arrive with their sources attached, and the privacy promises are front and center rather than buried in fine print. For people who miss simple search but want the speed of AI summaries, it hits a pleasant middle ground.

- Direct answers written in plain language rather than a list of blue links
- Citations that let you check where each statement comes from
- A privacy policy that says searches, IP addresses and cookies are not stored
- A chat-style flow for follow-up questions
- A developer API for teams that want answer-style search in their own apps

It is a good everyday search companion for students, researchers and anyone who values privacy. Andi was founded by Angela Hoover and Jed White and went through Y Combinator, according to public company profiles. A practical tip: phrase searches as full questions, since the engine is tuned to answer them directly, and open the cited sources whenever the topic matters.

name: Xelta AI
tagline: All-in-one AI studio for images, video, voice, ads and microdramas
description: Xelta AI brings image, video, audio and ad generation into one credit-based studio, with tools for microdramas, voice dubbing and social autoposting.
longDescription: Xelta AI is a creative platform that gathers many generation tools under one account. Users can produce images, videos, voiceovers and music from text prompts or reference media, and the studio offers guided flows for formats such as microdramas, movie trailers, comics and short courses. Marketing features include ad makers that build campaigns from a product link, UGC-style ads and reel creation, plus autoposting to Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and YouTube. Editing tools cover background removal, video stitching, lip sync and dubbing. The platform runs on credits that work across third-party models such as Flux, Seedream, Gemini image models and several video models. New users get free credits, with pay-as-you-go packs and monthly plans available.
features: Ad maker that works from a product URL
pros: Many creative formats in one account
cons: Credit costs vary by model and can add up
Large toolset takes time to learn
moreContext:
Breadth is the headline with Xelta AI. Rather than specializing in one medium, it collects image generation, video, voice, music, ad creation and social publishing into a single studio, with guided flows for niche formats like microdramas and comics. For creators who would otherwise juggle half a dozen subscriptions, that consolidation is appealing.

- Guided creation flows for microdramas, trailers, comics and short courses
- Ad tools that build campaigns from a product link or a template
- Voice dubbing, lip sync and AI music for finishing videos
- Autoposting to major social networks from the same workspace
- A shared credit balance across several image and video models

It suits solo creators, small marketing teams and agencies that produce a steady stream of mixed media. Use the free starter credits to test the specific workflow you care about, such as ad generation or reels, before choosing a plan, and keep an eye on which models consume the most credits so your monthly allowance lasts. The pay-as-you-go packs are a handy middle ground if your output varies a lot from month to month.

name: Patchwork Tattoos
tagline: AI tattoo generator and layout builder for patchwork sleeve ideas
description: Generate tattoo concepts with guided style, placement and subject controls, browse a gallery of ideas and arrange pieces into a patchwork layout.
longDescription: Patchwork Tattoos is a design tool for people planning a patchwork tattoo, the style where many small, separate pieces fill an arm, leg or back over time. Its AI generator creates a single tattoo concept from a text description, with controls for body placement, style such as fine line, blackwork or old school, and subject. You can also start from your own photo or sketch, make stencils, explore tattoo fonts and plan cover-ups. A Patchwork Builder lets you arrange gallery pieces into a combined layout and share it privately. Everyone gets two free concepts without signing up, browsing and the builder are free, and credit plans or packs cover more generations and 4K exports.
pros: Two free concepts with no signup
Builder and gallery are always free
cons: Free downloads carry a small watermark
Monthly plan prices are not shown upfront
moreContext:
This is a refreshingly focused tool. Instead of being a general image generator with a tattoo preset, it is designed around how patchwork collections are actually planned: one piece at a time, with attention to placement, style and how each design sits next to the others. The result is a planning space that tattoo fans can use before they sit down with an artist.

- Guided generator with placement, style and subject options
- Start from your own photo or sketch to turn it into a tattoo concept
- Patchwork Builder for arranging pieces into a combined layout
- Extra tools for stencils, tattoo lettering and cover-up ideas
- Private share links so you can send a plan to your artist

It is best for anyone collecting small tattoos over time or planning a sleeve and wanting a visual reference to discuss. Use the two free concepts to test styles you are curious about, then save your favorites in the builder. Treat the output as a starting point for conversation, since a professional artist will adapt any design to your skin and placement.

name: BlueDoAI
tagline: One API key for DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and Doubao models with usage billing
description: BlueDoAI offers an OpenAI-compatible API and console for accessing leading Chinese AI models for text, image, video and speech, billed by usage.
longDescription: BlueDoAI is a model access platform run by a Chengdu-based company that lets developers reach several Chinese AI model families through a single account and API key. Its catalog groups models from DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and Doubao, covering chat, reasoning, coding, image, video and speech tasks, including Doubao Seedance and Seedream for visual generation. The text API follows the OpenAI format, so existing code can point to its base URL with minimal changes. A console handles keys, balances and usage, and current prices are listed in a public model catalog. The company also offers Xiaolan Blue, a free Windows agent app that can connect to hosted models or a compatible local model service.
features: DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and Doubao models
pros: One key for several model families
cons: Catalog focused on Chinese model vendors
No free credits mentioned
moreContext:
BlueDoAI solves a specific headache: working with several Chinese model providers without managing separate accounts, keys and billing for each one. It wraps DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and Doubao behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so a developer can switch models by changing a single parameter.

- Unified base URL and a single key for text, image, video and speech models
- OpenAI-style chat completions endpoint that works with common SDKs
- Pay-as-you-go billing with prices published in a public model catalog
- Console for keys, balance and usage tracking in one place
- Xiaolan Blue, a free Windows agent that can use hosted or local models

It is best for developers and teams who want to test or deploy models such as DeepSeek or Doubao Seedance without integrating each provider separately. Before you commit, check the model catalog for current per-token or per-generation prices, and start with a small balance to compare latency and output quality against your current provider. Keep in mind that availability and pricing for each model can change, so recheck the catalog periodically.

name: Akool
