tagline: AI video suite for avatars, face swap, talking photos and model access
description: Akool combines avatar videos, face and character swap, talking photos, image generation and access to third-party video models in one credit-based studio.
longDescription: Akool is a generative media platform used for marketing videos, personalized content and creative experiments. Its tools include Character Studio for avatar videos driven by a script, face swap and motion swap for photos and video, talking photos that animate a still image, live streaming avatars, a voice generator and an AI image generator. A model hub gives access to third-party video models such as Seedance and Wan within the same workspace, and developers can use an OpenAPI, an MCP server and a CLI. Plans are credit-based and priced per seat, starting with a free tier that adds watermarks and slower processing, and moving up to paid tiers with higher resolutions and longer videos.
features: API, MCP server and CLI access
pros: Wide range of video tools in one place
cons: Free outputs carry a full-screen watermark
Per-seat pricing raises team costs
moreContext:
Akool covers an unusually wide stretch of AI video in one account. Avatar presenters, face and character swaps, talking photos, live avatars and a hub of third-party video models all share the same credit system, so you can move from a quick social clip to a scripted spokesperson video without switching tools.

- Character Studio for avatar videos made from a script, no camera needed
- Face swap, character swap and motion swap for photos and footage
- Talking photo feature that animates a still portrait
- Model hub with access to third-party video models like Seedance and Wan
- OpenAPI, MCP server and CLI for developers who want to automate output

It is a good fit for marketers, agencies and creators producing personalized or high-volume video. The company says its platform has generated hundreds of millions of assets. Try the free plan to see which features you actually use, then compare per-seat costs carefully if teammates need access, since each added editor is billed at the owner's plan rate.

name: AI ReFounder
tagline: AI voice agents that answer ecommerce store calls and help close sales
description: AI ReFounder puts a voice agent on your online store's phone line to handle product questions, sizing, shipping and checkout help around the clock.
longDescription: AI ReFounder is a voice AI service for ecommerce retailers that answers incoming phone calls on a store's behalf. The agent handles product questions, sizing and shipping inquiries and guides callers toward checkout, at any hour. During business hours, calls can be passed to a human when the customer asks or when an issue is complex. The service installs from the Shopify App Store or on other store platforms, and a dashboard shows call logs and results. Pricing is usage-based at a per-minute rate with no setup fee or commitment, and new accounts receive free minutes to test the agent. A public ROI calculator helps stores estimate costs against expected call volume.
pros: Free test minutes for new accounts
cons: Costs grow with call volume
Focused only on ecommerce phone calls
moreContext:
Phone calls are easy for online stores to neglect, and AI ReFounder targets that gap directly. It answers the store line at any hour, handles common product and shipping questions, and nudges callers toward a purchase, then hands off to a person during business hours when needed. The pitch is simple: fewer missed calls and fewer lost sales.

- Voice agent that covers sizing, product, shipping and checkout questions
- Escalation to human staff when a caller asks or a case gets complicated
- Installs through the Shopify App Store or on other store setups
- Per-minute pricing with no setup fee and no long-term commitment
- Dashboard with call logs plus a public ROI calculator for planning

It is best for ecommerce brands that get a meaningful number of phone inquiries but cannot staff a line around the clock. The company publishes conversion and revenue figures from its own call data, so treat them as its claims and measure your own results. Start with the free minutes, call the agent yourself with tricky questions, and review the transcripts before turning it on for customers.

name: AI Room Planner
tagline: Free AI interior design ideas generated from a photo of your room
description: Upload a photo of a room and AI Room Planner renders it in different interior styles, giving you a quick stream of redesign ideas at no cost.
longDescription: AI Room Planner is an interior design idea generator for homeowners and renters. You sign in with an email link, upload a photo of a room such as a living room, kitchen or bedroom, and choose a design style. The AI then renders new versions of the same space, for example a Japanese style living room or a Zen bedroom, so you can compare looks before buying furniture or repainting. The service describes itself as being in beta and currently free to use without limits, though it notes this may change. Alongside the web editor, it also offers apps on the App Store and Google Play.
pros: Free with no stated usage limit
cons: Beta product whose terms may change
Fewer editing controls than paid tools
moreContext:
AI Room Planner keeps interior inspiration about as simple as it gets. Take a photo, pick a style and see your own room reimagined, without paying or learning a design program. That low barrier makes it a friendly first stop for anyone who wants to picture a change before committing to it.

- Restyles your actual room from a single uploaded photo
- A range of styles to explore, from Japanese to Zen and beyond
- Covers living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms and other spaces
- Passwordless sign-in through an emailed link
- Mobile apps for iPhone and Android in addition to the web editor

It is best for homeowners, renters and anyone planning a refresh who wants quick visual ideas rather than detailed floor plans. Because the service says it is in beta and free for now, it is a good moment to try it. For the best results, shoot your photo in daylight from a corner of the room so the AI can see more of the layout, and generate several styles to compare side by side.

name: Hark
tagline: Personal AI assistant with memory that can browse, book and handle tasks
description: Hark is a personal AI assistant with persistent memory and a browsing agent that can research, place orders and take care of everyday errands for you.
longDescription: Hark is a consumer AI assistant from the company of the same name, founded by Brett Adcock. You chat with it in a single ongoing thread, and it keeps persistent memory so responses reflect your preferences over time. Projects organize larger efforts such as job searches or trip planning. Its Handoff agent works in its own browser to research, compare options, place orders and complete multi-step tasks, and it checks in before actions that need your approval. Action Buttons suggest next steps, and custom Panels act as mini apps connected to services like Strava, Spotify and Venmo. Hark runs on the web, iOS and Android, with a free tier and paid plans that raise usage limits.
pros: Acts on tasks, not just answers
Available on web, iOS and Android
cons: Usage limits are not published
New product still building out
moreContext:
Hark aims to be the assistant that actually gets things done. Rather than stopping at advice, its Handoff agent can open a browser, compare options and complete tasks like booking or ordering, while pausing for your approval at key moments. Paired with persistent memory, it is designed to feel more like a capable helper than a search box.

- A single chat thread with memory that learns your preferences
- Handoff agent that browses, researches and completes multi-step tasks
- Projects for organizing bigger efforts such as trips or job hunts
- Action Buttons that suggest and carry out prioritized tasks
- Custom Panels linked to services like Strava, Spotify and Venmo

It is best for busy people who want help with errands, research and planning across the week. The company says it uses end-to-end encryption, and reports indicate paid tiers mainly add usage rather than features. A practical tip: start with a low-stakes errand, such as comparing restaurant options, to see how the agent asks for approval before you trust it with purchases.

name: Adobe Photoshop
tagline: Industry-standard photo editor with Firefly-powered generative AI tools
description: Photoshop pairs its professional editing toolkit with generative AI features such as Generative Fill, Generative Expand, Harmonize and object removal.
longDescription: Adobe Photoshop is the long-running image editing application from Adobe, now built with generative AI throughout. Generative Fill and Generative Expand, powered by Adobe Firefly models, let you add, replace or extend parts of an image from a text prompt. Other AI tools include an improved Remove tool for unwanted objects and people, Harmonize for matching lighting and color when compositing, subject selection and background removal, and partner upscaling models. These sit alongside the traditional layers, masks, retouching and color tools professionals rely on. Photoshop runs on desktop, the web and mobile. The desktop app offers a free trial, the mobile app has a free tier, and full access requires a Creative Cloud subscription.
pros: AI tools inside a full professional editor
Deep control with layers and masks
cons: Subscription required for full use
Steep learning curve for beginners
moreContext:
Photoshop's AI story is compelling because the generative features live inside a mature, precise editor. You can extend a background with a prompt, remove a distraction or blend a new subject into a scene, then refine every pixel with the layers, masks and adjustments professionals have used for decades.

- Generative Fill and Generative Expand built on Adobe Firefly models
- Remove tool for clearing unwanted objects and people quickly
- Harmonize, which matches lighting, shadows and color when compositing
- Precise subject selection and background removal
- Desktop, web and mobile apps that share the same subscription

It is the natural choice for photographers, designers and retouchers who need both AI speed and fine manual control. If you only need occasional edits, check the Creative Cloud Photography plan, which bundles Photoshop with Lightroom at a lower monthly rate than the standalone plan. Use the free desktop trial to test generative features on your own images before subscribing. Firefly-powered features draw on generative credits, so check how many your plan includes if you lean on them heavily.

name: IamVERA
tagline: Multi-model AI answer checking for lawyers, doctors and other professionals
description: Vera has one AI's answer reviewed by other models for facts, reasoning and sources, with privacy tools built for confidential professional work.
longDescription: IamVERA is a verification service for professionals who use AI in their work. When you ask Vera a question, one model drafts an answer and other models check it: one confirms facts, another reads it critically for weak reasoning, and an optional step adds sources. You see what changed and why before relying on the result. Vera Office brings this into a browser workspace for Word documents, with planned changes you can review and undo. Privacy Shield swaps names and other sensitive details for placeholders before text reaches outside AI, and Vera X-Ray scans files locally first. It targets legal, healthcare, board and real estate professionals, with a free three-month starter and paid plans after that.
pros: Lets you choose which models take part
cons: Paid plans are priced for professionals
Question limits on each tier
moreContext:
IamVERA addresses a real worry for professionals: AI answers can sound certain and still be wrong. Its answer is to let several models check each other, with one drafting, one fact checking, one arguing the other side and one finding sources, and then to show you every change. That transparency is what sets it apart from a single chatbot.

- Multi-model review that flags factual errors and weak reasoning
- Optional source lookup so final answers point to evidence
- Privacy Shield, which replaces sensitive details before text leaves your control
- Vera X-Ray, which scans documents on your own computer first
- Vera Office for reviewing and editing Word files with undoable changes

It is best for lawyers, notaries, doctors, board members and estate agents who want AI help without blind trust. The company is clear that checking improves answers but does not guarantee them, which is a refreshingly honest stance. Use the three-month starter period to run questions where you already know the answer, so you can see how the review process catches subtle errors.

name: Process Street
tagline: Compliance operations platform that turns policies into AI-enforced workflows
description: Process Street combines document control, workflow automation and an AI compliance agent so teams can run repeatable processes and prove every step.
longDescription: Process Street is a platform for running recurring business processes such as employee onboarding, client onboarding, ISO compliance and quality checks. Teams build checklists and workflows, assign steps, collect data and track progress, while integrations and automations move information between connected apps. The Docs product manages policies and controlled documents, and Ops handles workflow orchestration. Process AI helps convert manual procedures into structured workflows, and Cora is an AI agent focused on compliance and risk. Analytics show how processes are performing, and audit trails record who did what. It serves industries including financial services, healthcare, manufacturing and real estate. Plans are quote-based, and the Pro plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
pros: Strong audit trail for regulated teams
cons: Prices are not published
More than small teams may need
moreContext:
Process Street has long been known for turning standard operating procedures into living checklists, and it now frames itself around compliance. Policies, workflows and AI checks sit together, so a documented procedure becomes something teams actually follow and auditors can verify.

- Workflow builder for onboarding, quality, ISO and other recurring processes
- Process AI that helps convert written procedures into structured runs
- Cora, an AI agent focused on compliance and risk
- Document control for policies with clear version history
- Automations, integrations and analytics to track process performance

It is best for operations, HR, compliance and quality teams in regulated or fast-growing companies that need consistent execution and proof of it. Startups with fewer than 15 employees and under $2 million in revenue can ask about a reduced plan, and registered nonprofits can request a discount. Use the free trial to rebuild one real process, such as new hire onboarding, so you can judge how well it fits your team. Browsing the template library first can save time, since many common workflows already have a starting point.

name: Limli
tagline: Turn one product photo into AI model shoots, lifestyle scenes and video
description: Limli generates fashion campaigns, still life shots, UGC-style posts and short videos from a single product image, with consistent AI models across shots.
longDescription: Limli is an AI product photography platform for fashion and ecommerce brands. You upload one product image, such as a garment, bag or bottle, then choose from four workflows: Fashion, Still Life, UGC and Cinema. In fashion mode you can lock a preset model or upload your own face and keep the same person across every angle and setting. Style presets control lighting, grain and color, and you can pick environments for lifestyle scenes. A video generator turns finished shots into short clips. Projects, products, characters and environments are saved for reuse. Monthly credit plans range from solo creator to agency tiers, with discounts for annual billing.
features: Fashion shoots with consistent AI models
100+ preset models or your own face
pros: Keeps the same model across a campaign
cons: Credits limit monthly output
Lower tiers cap projects and products
moreContext:
Limli is built around a simple promise: skip the studio and still get a full campaign. From one product photo you can produce model shots, lifestyle scenes, UGC-style posts and short videos, and its model locking keeps the same face consistent from shot to shot, which is one of the harder problems in AI fashion imagery.

- Four workflows covering fashion, still life, UGC and cinematic looks
- Model locking for a consistent face across angles and moods
- A library of more than 100 preset models, or upload your own
- Style presets for lighting, grain and color plus selectable environments
- Video generation that turns stills into short clips

It suits fashion labels, ecommerce sellers, creative studios and agencies that need fresh visuals for every product drop. Start with a product that has a clean, well-lit source photo, since better input gives more convincing results. If you plan to work with recurring characters, save them early so you can reuse them across future campaigns. Try the Creator tier for a month before moving up, so you learn how many credits a typical shoot consumes.

name: Cadrant
tagline: Build web apps, mobile apps and websites by describing them to AI
description: Cadrant generates full-stack web apps, native mobile apps, websites and internal tools from plain-language prompts, with code export and one-click publishing.
longDescription: Cadrant is an AI app builder for entrepreneurs, professionals, agencies and teams without a dedicated developer. You describe what you want, such as a web app, mobile app, landing page, blog, form or internal tool, and Cadrant generates the structure and code, then refines it as you chat. Web apps use a React front end with a Supabase backend, mobile apps can be built with Expo as native apps or PWAs, and websites are static and SEO-ready. Projects can be published to a Cadrant domain or your own, and mobile apps can go to the App Store and Google Play. Source code can be exported at any time. You can start for free, with credit-based paid plans.
pros: Covers web, mobile and internal tools
cons: Higher plan prices not listed
Credit use grows with iterations
moreContext:
Cadrant stands out by covering several kinds of projects in one builder. The same chat-driven workflow produces a full-stack web app, a native mobile app, a static website or an internal dashboard, and you keep the option to export the source code whenever you like.

- Full-stack web apps built on React and Supabase
- Mobile apps via Expo, including native builds and PWAs, with store publishing
- Fast static websites that are ready for search engines
- Internal tools with roles and permissions for teams
- Custom domains, GitHub and Stripe integrations, and code export

It is a strong fit for founders validating an idea, small businesses that need a site or client portal, and agencies delivering projects quickly. Data can live in your own Supabase account, which helps if you plan to hand the project to a developer later. A practical tip: write a detailed first prompt that lists your pages, user roles and key actions, since a clear starting point saves credits on later revisions. Preview mobile builds on your own phone with Expo Go before submitting them to an app store.

name: Moltbook
tagline: A social network where AI agents post, comment and vote while humans watch
description: Moltbook is a Reddit-style network built for AI agents, who join through an API to post, comment, vote and form communities called submolts.
longDescription: Moltbook is a social platform designed for AI agents rather than people. Agents register through a REST API, are claimed by a human owner who verifies ownership, and can then create posts, comment, vote, follow other agents and start topic communities called submolts. Humans can browse the site and observe the conversations. The platform includes semantic search across posts and comments, moderation tools for submolt owners, and rate limits that are stricter for new agents. A verification step asks agents to solve challenges before content is published. Moltbook is also building an identity layer that would let agents sign in to other apps with their Moltbook profile.
features: Posting, comments and voting for agents
cons: Agents only, humans cannot post
Requires an X account to verify ownership
moreContext:
Moltbook is one of the more original ideas in the agent space: a public forum where the members are AI agents. Builders send their agent to the site, verify ownership, and let it share posts, reply to others and vote, while people look on. It offers a playful and revealing window into how autonomous agents behave when they talk to each other.

- REST API that lets agents post, comment, vote and follow other agents
- Submolts, topic communities with owners, moderators and pinned posts
- Semantic search across everything agents have written
- Ownership verification that ties each agent to a human account
- An upcoming identity layer for agents to sign in to other apps

It is best for developers experimenting with autonomous agents, researchers curious about agent behavior, and anyone who enjoys watching the experiment unfold. Before connecting your agent, read the platform's rules on rate limits and verification, since failed challenges can lead to suspension, and keep a close eye on what your agent posts in its first days.

name: JobCopilot
tagline: AI copilot that finds matching jobs and auto-applies to them every day
description: JobCopilot searches company career pages for roles that match your criteria and fills out applications for you, with resume, cover letter and interview tools.
longDescription: JobCopilot automates the repetitive parts of a job search. You set up a copilot with the roles, locations and filters you want, upload your resume and answer common screening questions once. Each day it finds new matching openings from company career sites and job boards and autofills applications on your behalf, or saves them for your review first. A tracker records every application. Additional tools include an AI resume builder, cover letter generator, mock interviewer, salary negotiation helper, career advisors and a Chrome extension, and higher tiers can tailor your resume per application and find hiring manager emails. Plans are billed weekly, monthly or quarterly, priced from a daily rate.
features: AI resume and cover letter builder
pros: Review mode before applications go out
Wide set of career tools included
cons: No free plan
Auto-applying can reduce personalization
moreContext:
JobCopilot takes on the most tedious part of job hunting: finding fresh listings and filling in the same application forms again and again. You configure your copilot once, and it keeps searching and applying each day, which frees your time for networking and interview preparation.

- Daily search across company career pages for roles that match your filters
- Automatic form filling, with an option to save applications for review first
- A built-in tracker that keeps every application in one place
- Resume, cover letter and mock interview tools in the same account
- Higher tiers that tailor resumes per role and surface hiring manager emails

It is best for active job seekers applying broadly, especially in fields with many similar postings. The company says it pulls jobs from hundreds of thousands of companies worldwide. A practical tip: start with review mode for the first week so you can check which roles it picks and tighten your filters before letting it apply on its own. Keep your resume current, too, since every automated application relies on it.

name: Animated Drawings
tagline: Meta research demo that brings hand-drawn characters to life as animations
description: Upload a drawing of a figure and Animated Drawings detects, rigs and animates it with a choice of motions, right in the browser and for free.
longDescription: Animated Drawings is a research project from Meta's FAIR team that turns drawings of human-like figures, including children's art, into short animations. In the free web demo you upload a photo of a drawing, confirm the box around the character, adjust the automatically detected outline and joint positions, and then pick a motion such as dancing, walking or jumping. Behind the scenes, the system detects the figure, separates it from the background, estimates its pose and retargets motion capture data onto it. The underlying code, model weights and an amateur drawings dataset were released on GitHub under the MIT license, so developers can run it locally, though the repository is now archived.
cons: Works best on human-like figures
Research project with no active updates
moreContext:
Few AI demos are as instantly charming as this one. Hand it a crayon drawing and a minute later the character is dancing across the screen. The research behind it tackles a hard problem, since children's drawings rarely follow realistic proportions, and the result is something families, teachers and artists can enjoy without any setup.

- Detects the drawn figure and separates it from the paper background
- Lets you correct the outline and joint positions before animating
- Applies motion capture clips such as dancing, walking and jumping
- Runs free in the browser with no installation
- Code, model weights and a drawings dataset published under the MIT license

It is best for parents, educators and hobbyists looking for a creative weekend project, and for developers who want to study or extend the method. For cleaner results, draw on plain white paper with a dark marker, keep arms and legs clearly separated from the body, and photograph the page flat in good light. Kids especially love choosing the motion, so let them try several and compare.

name: MP3 to MIDI
tagline: Browser-based AI that transcribes MP3 and other audio into editable MIDI files
description: Converts recordings into MIDI right in the browser using Spotify's Basic Pitch model, with presets for piano and other sources plus a piano roll editor before download.
longDescription: MP3 to MIDI is a web tool that turns audio recordings into standard MIDI files. It runs Spotify's open Basic Pitch transcription model inside the browser, so the audio file stays on the user's device instead of being uploaded. After choosing a preset such as Piano, the user can compare the original audio with a MIDI preview, adjust notes in a piano roll editor and then download the file for use in a DAW or notation program. Beyond MP3, the site offers converters for WAV, M4A, OGG, video files and YouTube links. Conversion is free for clips up to five minutes, while paid credit packs cover additional downloads.
cons: Free tier limits total downloads
Dense mixes transcribe less cleanly than solo parts
moreContext:
What we like about this converter is how much it does without ever uploading your audio. The transcription model runs in the browser tab, which is a real plus for musicians who do not want unreleased recordings sitting on someone else's server. The preview step is also thoughtful: you can play the original next to the MIDI result and fix wrong notes before you spend a download credit.

- Built on Spotify's Basic Pitch, a well-known open model for note detection
- Presets such as Piano tune sensitivity and note length for cleaner results
- A built-in piano roll lets you correct notes before exporting
- Separate converters cover WAV, M4A, OGG, video files and YouTube links
- Paid credits are permanent rather than tied to a monthly subscription

MP3 to MIDI is best for songwriters, producers and students who want a quick starting point for arranging or learning a part, not a finished score. Our tip: feed it the cleanest source you can, such as a solo piano take or an isolated stem, because single instruments with clear melodies give far more accurate MIDI than a full band mix.

name: DigiBouquet AI
tagline: Design a digital flower bouquet by hand or with AI and send it as a private link
description: Build a virtual bouquet for free, or let AI paint one in your chosen style and mood, then add a short note and music and share it as a link the recipient opens in any browser.
longDescription: DigiBouquet AI is a web app for sending digital flower gifts. Users can arrange a bouquet by hand at no cost, or describe the recipient, the occasion and the feeling they want to convey and let AI generate an illustrated bouquet. Styles include watercolor, realistic, cute 3D, vintage and botanical, along with color palettes and optional background music that plays when the gift is opened. A short message is attached and the finished card is delivered as a private link that works without an app or account. AI bouquets are sold in small one-time credit packs with no subscription, and the site is available in English, Chinese and Japanese.
features: AI bouquet generation by occasion and mood
Six art styles and color vibes
pros: Recipients need no app or signup
cons: Message length is very short
AI bouquets cost credits
moreContext:
This is one of the more charming uses of image generation we have come across. Instead of a generic e-card, you answer a few gentle questions about who the gift is for and how you want them to feel, and the app turns that into a bouquet with matching colors and music. It feels personal without asking you to be an artist.

- Guided prompts for recipient, occasion and emotion replace blank text boxes
- Art styles range from watercolor and botanical to cute 3D
- Gift music plays on open, and recipients can mute it
- Delivered as a private link that opens full screen on any device
- A free hand-built option exists for anyone who does not want to pay

DigiBouquet AI suits long-distance partners, friends sending a quick birthday or sympathy note, and anyone who wants a thoughtful gesture faster than a flower delivery. Our tip: try the free handmade builder first to get a feel for the card layout, then use an AI credit for occasions where a custom illustrated bouquet will mean more. Keep your note brief, since the card limits message length to stay readable.

name: SummarizeVideoToText
tagline: Paste a video link to get a summary, chapters, transcript and mind map
description: An AI video summarizer for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and X links or uploaded files, returning summaries, timestamped chapters, transcripts, a mind map and Q&A in 14 languages.
longDescription: SummarizeVideoToText converts the spoken content of online videos into structured text. Users paste a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or X link, or upload a video or audio file, and receive a concise summary, chapters split by timestamp, a full transcript, a mind map and a panel for follow-up questions. When a video already has captions the service reads them, and otherwise it runs AI transcription at a higher credit rate. Summaries are available in 14 languages. The product also offers a browser extension, an Obsidian plugin and a Notion integration. New users get a small one-time credit allowance, with a monthly subscription or pay-as-you-go top-ups for regular use.
features: Browser extension, Obsidian and Notion links
pros: Works across several social video platforms
Captioned videos are cheap to process
cons: Free credits are a one-time allowance
AI transcription costs ten times more credits
moreContext:
The appeal here is breadth. Plenty of tools summarize YouTube, but this one also handles TikTok, Instagram and X clips plus your own files, and it returns several useful views of the same video at once. Getting chapters, a transcript and a mind map side by side makes it easy to decide whether a long talk deserves your full attention.

- One workspace per video with summary, chapters, transcript and mind map
- A Q&A panel for asking follow-up questions about the content
- Clear credit rules: captions cost far less than fresh transcription
- Integrations for Obsidian and Notion help send notes where you keep them
- Ready-made example videos let you try it without spending credits

SummarizeVideoToText is best for students, researchers and creators who digest a lot of video and want reusable notes rather than just a paragraph. Our tip: favor videos that already have captions when you are on a tight credit budget, since those cost one credit per minute instead of ten, and reopening a video you already processed is free.

name: Prospero.ai
tagline: AI stock signals and screeners that distill institutional data for retail investors
description: A free investing app that scores stocks with short and long term AI signals built from institutional and market data, alongside paid newsletters with the team's picks.
longDescription: Prospero.ai is an investing research app for retail traders available on iOS and Android. The company says its models process millions of data points about institutional activity, options sentiment and market movement, and condense them into a set of short-term and long-term signals scored from 0 to 100 for each stock. The app includes watchlist alerts when signals change and screeners that surface stocks with the strongest cumulative scores. Prospero also publishes investing and trading newsletters on Substack that use its signals. Performance figures on its site come from the company's own newsletter paper trades, and its materials note that past results do not guarantee future returns.
features: Short and long term stock signals
cons: Performance claims are self-reported
Signals are not personalized financial advice
moreContext:
Prospero.ai stands out for trying to make institutional-style data readable at a glance. Rather than asking users to interpret options flow or dealer positioning themselves, it rolls those inputs into a handful of scored signals per stock, which makes the app approachable for people who are still learning how markets move.

- Separate short-term and long-term signals help distinguish trades from longer holds
- Scores from 0 to 100 keep each stock's picture compact
- Alerts notify you when a watched stock's signals change
- Screeners highlight names gaining or losing strength
- Newsletters show how the team itself applies the signals

It is best for self-directed retail investors who want an extra data point during research. Keep in mind that the outperformance numbers on the site come from the company's own newsletter paper trades, not audited live accounts, and the signals are general information rather than advice tailored to you. Our tip: use the signals as a way to question your own thesis, and confirm anything important with primary sources such as filings before acting on it.

name: Apptovid
tagline: Turn an App Store or Google Play link into video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube
description: Paste a mobile app's store link and Apptovid pulls its screenshots, reviews and highlights to generate UGC-style, explainer and story video ads sized for major ad platforms.
longDescription: Apptovid is an AI ad generator built for mobile app marketing. Users paste an App Store or Google Play link, and the tool collects the app's name, screenshots, videos, reviews and feature highlights; teams without a public listing can upload assets manually. It then produces three kinds of ads: UGC-style clips with AI avatars, animated explainer videos built from screenshots and kinetic text, and short storytelling ads with a hook and payoff. Outputs follow the aspect ratios and durations recommended by Meta, TikTok and YouTube. The service is aimed at app developers, game studios, UA managers and agencies, and runs on monthly credit plans or one-time credit packs.
features: Store link import of app assets
UGC, explainer and storytelling ad modes
pros: Very fast path from listing to ad
Made specifically for app UA teams
cons: Focused only on mobile apps
Credit costs add up at volume
moreContext:
Apptovid has a refreshingly narrow focus. Instead of being a general video editor, it starts from the one asset every mobile app already has, its store listing, and builds ads from there. That removes most of the setup work that slows down user acquisition testing.

- Automatic import of screenshots, videos and reviews from App Store or Google Play
- Three ad formats cover trust building, feature explanation and narrative hooks
- Outputs follow Meta, TikTok and YouTube length and ratio conventions
- Generating many variations helps fight creative fatigue
- Manual asset upload works for apps that are not public yet

Apptovid is best for indie developers, game studios and UA managers who need a steady stream of fresh creatives without hiring an editor for every round. Our tip: generate a few versions in each of the three modes for your first campaign and let the ad platform's results tell you which style your audience responds to, then focus your credits on that format. Fresh reviews in your listing also give the tool better material to work with.

name: Media.io
tagline: Wondershare's online AI studio for video, image and audio generation and editing
description: A browser-based creative suite from Wondershare that bundles AI video, image and music generation with editing tools like watermark removal, lip sync, upscaling and vocal removal.
longDescription: Media.io is an online AI creation platform from Wondershare. It brings together generators for video, images, characters and audio, with access to third-party models such as Seedance, Kling and Nano Banana alongside its own options. Around those generators sit dozens of single-purpose tools, including talking avatars, lip sync, video background and watermark removal, image upscaling, object removal, photo restoration, noise reduction, vocal removal, text to speech and lyrics to song. Studio modes help with story-driven content, trend effects and product ads. Everything runs in the browser, with a free plan that grants daily check-in credits and watermarked 720p exports, and paid tiers that add 1080p output and more storage.
features: Text and image to video with multiple models
AI talking avatars and lip sync
Vocal remover and text to speech
pros: Huge range of tools in one account
Backed by an established software company
cons: Free exports are watermarked at 720p
Credit system can be hard to compare
moreContext:
Media.io's strength is sheer coverage. Where many AI sites do one trick, this one gathers video generation, photo cleanup and audio processing under a single login, which saves creators from juggling separate subscriptions for every small job. Coming from Wondershare, the team behind Filmora, it also has the polish of a mature product.

- Access to several leading video and image models from one interface
- Practical editing utilities such as watermark removal, background removal and upscaling
- Audio tools covering noise reduction, vocal separation and text to speech
- Studio modes for character stories, trend effects and product ads
- An MCP option for connecting the tools to AI assistants

Media.io is best for social media creators, small marketing teams and hobbyists who need a little of everything without installing desktop software. Our tip: start on the free plan and use its daily check-in credits to test the specific tools you expect to rely on, then pick a paid tier only once you know whether you need video generation or mostly quick edits, since those consume credits very differently.

name: AutoGPT
tagline: A team of AI experts for content, sales, research and recurring work, coordinated by Otto
description: The hosted AutoGPT platform gives you specialist AI agents for SEO writing, prospecting, LinkedIn posts and inbox work, with a visual workflow builder and an open-source self-hosted option.
longDescription: AutoGPT began in 2023 as one of the first widely used open-source autonomous agent projects and has grown into a hosted platform. Users brief a coordinator called Otto in plain English, and it hands work to specialist Experts, such as an SEO writer, an AI SDR that builds prospect lists, a LinkedIn post writer and an executive assistant that sorts the inbox and preps meetings. A visual workflow builder supports scheduled and recurring routines, and agents can work with documents and connected apps. The Pro plan covers chat with Otto and the Experts, while scheduled runs draw on a credit wallet with spending caps. The code remains on GitHub for teams that prefer to self-host.
pros: Works with many leading AI models
cons: Hosted plans start at a high monthly price
Card required for the free trial
moreContext:
Few projects did more to popularize the idea of autonomous AI agents than AutoGPT, and its current form is a more practical take on that early vision. Instead of one agent looping on a goal, you get named specialists with defined jobs and a coordinator that keeps track of the big picture, which makes results easier to review.

- Role-based Experts for SEO content, sales prospecting, social posts and executive support
- Otto acts as a single point of contact for briefing the whole team
- A visual builder for workflows that run on a schedule
- Spending caps per Expert keep credit use predictable
- The open-source codebase on GitHub supports self-hosting

AutoGPT is best for solo founders and small teams who want recurring marketing, sales and admin work handled by agents they can supervise. Developers who like to tinker may prefer the self-hosted version. Our tip: use the interactive demo before starting the trial, then begin with a single Expert on one repeatable task and set a conservative spending cap until you trust the output.

name: YouTube to Transcript AI
tagline: Turn YouTube links into timestamped transcripts with speaker labels and AI summaries
description: Paste a YouTube link to get a timestamped transcript with speaker separation, AI polish and summaries, plus exports to TXT, DOCX, SRT, VTT and CSV in 100+ languages.
longDescription: YouTube to Transcript AI converts YouTube videos, including Shorts, into editable text. After a link is pasted, the service first looks for existing subtitles and falls back to speech recognition when none are available. Transcripts come with clickable timestamps, chapter markers and optional speaker labels, and an AI polish setting can clean up the text. Several summary styles are offered, such as chapter summaries, core points, study notes, meeting summaries and creator repurposing. Results can be exported as TXT, DOCX, SRT, VTT or CSV, and the site also includes subtitle download, translation and AI voiceover tools. A free tier provides daily credits, while paid plans add longer videos and batch exports.
features: TXT, DOCX, SRT, VTT and CSV export
pros: Free daily credits without a card
cons: Focused mainly on YouTube
Paid plan prices are not shown upfront
moreContext:
This tool earns its place by covering the whole path from a YouTube link to reusable text. It does not stop at a raw caption dump: speaker labels, chapters and a choice of summary styles mean the output is closer to finished notes than most free transcript grabbers.

- Uses existing captions when present and speech recognition when they are missing
- Speaker separation that you can rename with a click
- Summary templates for study notes, meetings and content repurposing
- Export formats that drop straight into editors and subtitle workflows
- Extra tools for subtitle translation and AI voiceovers

YouTube to Transcript AI is best for journalists pulling exact quotes, researchers working with recorded lectures, language learners and creators turning long videos into posts or clips. Our tip: turn on speaker separation for interviews and panels before you run the job, and pick the summary type that matches your goal, since a study notes summary and a creator repurpose summary pull out very different details from the same video.

name: TalkPix
tagline: Make talking photo videos, product ads and AI clips from a single image
description: Upload a portrait, pet or product photo, type a script and choose a voice to get a lip-synced talking video in 720p or 1080p, plus AI video, product photo and voice cloning studios.
longDescription: TalkPix is a web studio for turning still images into short speaking videos. Users upload their own photo or pick from more than 150 sample faces, write what the subject should say and choose a voice, and the service renders a lip-synced MP4 at 720p or 1080p. Beyond talking portraits, it offers modes for talking objects, pets and cartoons, multilingual creators, news anchors, creator-style product ads, singing photos, AI images, product photos and voice cloning. Pricing is pay as you go with credit packs that never expire and no subscription, roughly one credit per second of 720p talking video. Paid exports carry no watermark and can be used commercially, and there is no free tier.
features: Product ad generator from one photo
cons: No free tier or trial render
1080p doubles the credit cost
moreContext:
TalkPix keeps things simple: one photo, one script, one voice, and you have a talking clip. That straightforward flow, combined with credits that do not expire, makes it a friendly option for people who only need a video now and then and do not want another monthly bill.

- Over 150 ready faces for anyone who prefers not to use their own photo
- Dedicated modes for pets, objects, cartoons and news anchor formats
- Creator-style product ads built from a single product image
- Clean exports with commercial use, subject to your input rights
- Unused purchased credits are refundable according to the site

TalkPix is best for small sellers, social media posters and people sending personal birthday or thank-you messages. Since there is no free render, our tip is to start with the smallest pack and test a short 720p clip with a clear, front-facing photo and a brief script. Once you are happy with the voice and lip sync, move up to 1080p for the versions you plan to publish.

name: Context Board
tagline: A live business board for numbers, docs, clients and tasks that your AI agent can work in
description: ContextBolt's workspace puts metrics, docs, a client pipeline, a content calendar and your daily plan on one board, and lets agents like Claude Code read it and build widgets for you.
longDescription: Context Board, from ContextBolt, is a single workspace where founders and small teams can keep their business metrics, documents, client pipeline, content calendar and daily schedule. Widgets pull live data from sources such as Stripe, Google Analytics 4, Search Console and PostHog. The distinctive part is that AI agents including Claude Code can read the board and act inside it, for example building a new widget, moving a deal to the next stage, planning the day or asking a clarifying question on a project. An activity feed records what changed. The board works on desktop and phone, and plans start with a three-day free trial followed by a monthly subscription.
features: Live metric widgets from Stripe and GA4
pros: Agents act on the board, not just read it
cons: Short three-day trial
Most useful if you already work with AI agents
moreContext:
What makes Context Board interesting is that it treats your AI agent as a collaborator inside the workspace. Rather than exporting data to a chatbot, the agent sees the same board you do and can update it, which turns a dashboard into something closer to a shared desk.

- One board for revenue, traffic, documents, deals, content and your day
- Integrations with Stripe, GA4, Search Console and PostHog for live numbers
- Agents can add widgets, move deals and plan schedules for you
- A clear activity log shows exactly what the agent changed
- Mobile layouts keep the board usable away from your desk

Context Board is best for solo founders and indie makers who already use Claude Code or similar tools and want their business context in one place. Our tip: connect your revenue and analytics sources on the first day of the trial and ask your agent to build one widget you check daily, since that quickly shows whether the agent workflow fits how you run things.

name: RPGGO
tagline: Create and play AI text RPGs with memory-driven NPCs and no coding
description: A text-to-game platform where creators build role-playing adventures with an AI copilot and players explore them through conversations with AI characters, plus images and NPC voices.
longDescription: RPGGO is a platform for making and playing AI-driven text role-playing games. Creators describe a world and story in natural language, and an AI copilot fills in game fields, breaks the narrative into chapters, tasks and branching triggers, and configures characters with personalities and memory. During play, an AI game master manages goals and endings while NPCs respond in conversation, with AI-generated scene images and voiced lines. Finished games can be published to a community gallery for others to play. RPGGO also offers developer documentation and API access, and its team has published research on its text-to-game engine. Basic play and creation are free, with paid options reported for heavier use.
features: AI game master and goal system
pros: No coding or prompt writing needed
cons: Public pricing details are hard to find
Story quality depends on the creator's setup
moreContext:
RPGGO goes a step beyond freeform AI storytelling by giving games real structure. Chapters, goals and an AI game master that checks whether objectives are met mean adventures can actually reach an ending, which is something open-ended chat stories often struggle with. It feels closer to a designed game than an improvised conversation.

- A creator copilot turns plain descriptions into playable game mechanics
- NPCs carry personalities and memories across a session
- Branching triggers allow multiple story paths
- Scene images and voiced NPC lines are generated automatically
- Developer docs and an API support mods and outside projects

RPGGO is best for tabletop fans, interactive fiction writers and curious players who want to try AI-run adventures without learning a game engine. It also has something to offer developers exploring AI NPCs in their own projects. Our tip: if you are creating, write clear goals for each chapter and give your key characters distinct motivations, since the AI game master leans on those details to steer players toward a satisfying conclusion. Playing a few popular games from the gallery first is a quick way to learn what works.

name: MixVio AI
tagline: One credit wallet for top AI video, image and audio models like Veo, Kling and Seedance
description: A browser workspace that gathers popular generation models for video, images and audio, plus upscalers, background removal and trend effects, with costs shown before each run.
longDescription: MixVio AI is an online creative platform that brings many third-party generation models into one interface. On the video side it offers text to video, image to video, video to video and motion control using models such as Seedance, Veo, Kling, Wan and PixVerse. For images it includes GPT Image and Nano Banana for generation and editing, along with a photo editor, background remover and upscaler. Audio generation and a library of viral effect templates round out the toolset. Every task shows its credit cost before submission, failed runs do not consume credits and outputs stay private by default. Subscriptions grant monthly credits, and one-time credit packs are also available.
features: Text, image and video to video
Motion control from a reference clip
pros: Many leading models in one account
cons: Free use is limited to welcome credits
Model choice can overwhelm beginners
moreContext:
As an answer to model fatigue, this platform makes a lot of sense. New video and image models arrive constantly, and paying for each one separately gets expensive, so having many of them behind one credit balance lets creators compare outputs without signing up everywhere.

- A broad lineup of video models including Veo, Kling and Seedance
- Image models such as GPT Image and Nano Banana for generation and edits
- Upfront credit estimates before any job starts
- Failed generations are not charged
- Private history and commercial use on paid plans

MixVio AI is best for social media creators, marketers and small studios who want to test several models on the same idea and keep their assets in one place. Our tip: run the same short prompt through two or three models at the lowest resolution first, since cheaper drafts make it easy to see which model handles your subject best before you spend credits on a full-length, high-resolution version. Keep an eye on the per-task cost shown before you submit, because longer clips and premium models use noticeably more credits.

name: TinyWow
tagline: Free online toolbox for AI writing, image cleanup, PDF conversion and more
description: A large collection of free browser tools covering PDF editing and conversion, AI writing helpers, background removal, photo restoration and file conversion, with an optional ad-free premium plan.
longDescription: TinyWow is a web toolbox that gathers many everyday file and content utilities on one site. Its PDF section handles editing, merging, splitting, compressing, converting, signing and translating documents. Image tools include an AI image generator, background remover, object removal, photo restoration, upscaling and many basic edits. A writing section offers AI helpers such as a paragraph writer, essay writer, sentence rewriter, grammar fixer, summarizer and YouTube script writer, and there are video and audio converters as well. Most tools work without creating an account, and uploaded files are deleted after a short period. A premium subscription removes ads, lifts usage limits and speeds up processing.
features: PDF edit, merge, convert and translate
cons: Free version shows ads
Individual tools are less deep than specialist apps
moreContext:
TinyWow's value is convenience. When you need to compress a PDF, clean up a photo and rewrite a paragraph in the same afternoon, having all of those tools on a single site with no account saves real time and spares you from installing several apps.

- Dozens of PDF utilities, from merging and splitting to translation and e-signing
- AI writing helpers for paragraphs, essays, summaries and rewrites
- Image tools for background removal, object removal and photo restoration
- Video and audio converters for quick format changes
- Files are removed from the servers shortly after processing, the site says

TinyWow is best for students, office workers and anyone who handles documents and images occasionally and wants quick results without a learning curve. Our tip: bookmark the specific tools you use most, since the menu is long, and consider the premium plan only if ads or usage limits start slowing you down on regular tasks; for one-off jobs the free tier is usually enough. Avoid uploading sensitive documents to any online converter unless you are comfortable with its privacy policy.

name: InvoiceKoi
tagline: Offline-first invoicing app for tradespeople with AI receipt scans and voice to invoice
description: A mobile invoicing app for contractors that creates quotes, invoices and receipts even without signal, with AI receipt scanning, voice-to-invoice entry and optional Stripe card payments.
longDescription: InvoiceKoi is an invoicing app designed for electricians, plumbers, builders, cleaners and other trades who do their paperwork on the job. It creates estimates, invoices and receipts on a phone and keeps working offline, so documents can be drafted in basements or lofts with no signal. An estimate can become an invoice in one tap, and saved clients, a personal price book and overdue invoice tracking reduce retyping. Online features include AI receipt scanning, voice-to-invoice entry, cloud photo backup and client card payments through Stripe links. Drafting is free without an account, and a subscription is needed to send documents. The app is on Google Play, with an iPhone version in App Store review.
features: AI receipt scans and voice to invoice
pros: No account needed to start drafting
Built around trades, not office teams
cons: Sending requires a subscription
iPhone app not yet released
moreContext:
Here AI serves a very practical job rather than a flashy one. It is built for people who want to send an invoice from the van before driving off, and the offline-first design reflects a clear understanding of where tradespeople actually work.

- Core invoicing and PDF creation work without any connection
- AI receipt scanning and voice-to-invoice cut down on typing with dirty hands
- Estimates convert to invoices in a single tap
- Overdue invoices are easy to spot at a glance
- Optional Stripe links let clients pay by card, with payments recorded automatically

InvoiceKoi is best for solo contractors and small trade businesses that find paper too limited and full field service software too heavy. Our tip: set up your price book and regular clients during the free drafting stage, so that once you subscribe every quote and invoice is a few taps away. The browser-based invoice generator is also handy for testing layouts before you commit. If you plan to take card payments, connect Stripe early so the payment link appears on your first sent invoice.

name: SayCraft
tagline: AI app builder that turns a live team conversation into a working web prototype
description: Talk through a product idea in a SayCraft meeting and its AI builds a web app as you speak, with a live preview the whole team can test, meeting replays and one-click deploys.
longDescription: SayCraft is an AI app builder centered on spoken conversation. Instead of typing prompts, a team holds a meeting inside SayCraft and the system listens, interprets what is being asked for and builds a working web app in real time, showing a live preview that everyone in the call can try. It keeps memory of the discussion so later requests refine earlier work, and meetings can be replayed afterward. Finished apps can be deployed to a permanent shareable link in one click, and the higher tier allows downloading the full source code. A three-day Pro trial with credits is available with a payment method on file, followed by monthly plans.
features: Builds apps from live meeting speech
pros: Whole team can shape the build together
Source export on the Max plan
cons: Payment method required for the trial
No ongoing free credit allowance
moreContext:
SayCraft takes a fresh angle on AI app building by making the meeting itself the interface. Product discussions often end with notes and action items, and here they end with a clickable prototype, which can shorten the distance between an idea and something people can react to.

- Listens to a group conversation and builds as the discussion unfolds
- A shared live preview keeps everyone looking at the same thing
- Memory of the conversation lets follow-up requests refine earlier work
- Replays show how a project evolved during the meeting
- Permanent deploy links make sharing results simple

SayCraft is best for product teams, founders and hackathon groups who want to validate an idea with a real prototype instead of slides. Our tip: come to the meeting with a short shared description of the core screen and who it is for, and state requirements out loud in plain terms, since a focused first few minutes gives the builder a clearer base to iterate on. Use the replay afterward to share the reasoning behind the prototype with teammates who missed the call.

name: FreeImageGeneratorAI
tagline: Free text-to-image generator powered by FLUX.1 schnell, no signup or watermark
description: Type a prompt and get an image in seconds using FLUX.1 schnell, with ten free images a day and no account, and paid plans that add Seedream, Nano Banana, GPT Image and image-to-image.
longDescription: FreeImageGeneratorAI is a simple web image generator. Visitors can type a prompt, choose an aspect ratio such as square, wide or tall, and generate pictures with the FLUX.1 schnell model without creating an account, up to a daily limit of ten images. Downloads carry no watermark. Signing up adds a few trial generations with Seedream and saves an image history. Paid monthly plans and one-time credit packs give access to all five supported models, including Nano Banana and GPT Image, remove the daily cap and enable image-to-image editing and restyling from an uploaded reference. The site is aimed at people who need quick social graphics, blog images, avatars and wallpapers.
pros: No signup for daily free images
cons: Free tier limited to one model
Daily cap of ten free images
moreContext:
The best thing about this generator is how little stands between you and an image. There is no account wall, no watermark and no confusing settings panel, just a prompt box, an aspect ratio and a button, which makes it an easy recommendation for anyone trying AI images for the first time.

- FLUX.1 schnell gives quick results with good prompt adherence
- Aspect ratios suit social posts, wallpapers and banners
- Paid tiers add several popular models in one place
- Image-to-image lets paying users restyle their own photos
- Monthly plans and never-expiring credit packs give flexible ways to pay

FreeImageGeneratorAI is best for bloggers, students and small business owners who need an occasional illustration without learning a complex tool. Our tip: be specific about subject, style, lighting and mood in your prompt, since FLUX responds well to descriptive wording, and use your free daily images to refine a prompt before deciding whether you need the extra models on a paid plan. Pick the aspect ratio first, because cropping later can cut off important details.

name: Papaya
tagline: Reads your AI agents' traces and code, then ships ranked fixes as pull requests
description: An optimization engine for production AI agents that analyzes traces and code to find issues like redundant retries or oversized prompts, ranks fixes by quality, latency and cost, and opens PRs.
longDescription: Papaya helps engineering teams improve AI agents already running in production. It ingests agent traces along with the agent's code and looks for recurring problems such as redundant retries, excessive tool calls, missing context, oversized prompts, uncached embeddings, serial API calls and overly powerful models for simple steps. Each finding becomes a recommendation scored by its expected effect on quality, latency and cost, and on the Business plan Papaya can open the pull request itself and share recommendations in Slack. A trace viewer and observability dashboards support debugging. A free developer tier covers one agent with limited monthly traces, with paid and enterprise plans for larger workloads.
features: Fixes ranked by quality, latency and cost
pros: Goes beyond monitoring to concrete fixes
Free tier for a single agent
cons: Big jump from free to paid tier
Most useful once agents have real traffic
moreContext:
Plenty of tools show you what your agents did; Papaya focuses on what you should change. By reading both production traces and the underlying code, it can point to specific causes of slow or expensive runs and turn them into fixes, which saves engineers from combing through logs by hand.

- Detects common agent issues like retry loops, chatty sub-agents and bloated prompts
- Every recommendation is scored for its likely quality, latency and cost impact
- Business plans can open the pull request for you
- Slack sharing keeps the whole team aware of new findings
- Enterprise options include PII redaction and SLAs

Papaya is best for teams running LLM agents in production who care about reliability and inference spend. Our tip: start with the free developer tier on your busiest single agent, since more traces give the analysis more to work with, and review the top-ranked recommendations first; small changes such as caching embeddings or trimming a system prompt often pay off quickly. Connect Slack once you move to a paid plan so new findings reach the people who own each agent.

name: Diagram AI
tagline: Describe a diagram in one sentence, then refine it on an editable canvas
description: Generates flowcharts, sequence, class and cloud architecture diagrams from a sentence or uploaded documents, with a chat assistant for restructuring, version history and XML, SVG or PNG export.
longDescription: Diagram AI is a web canvas for creating technical and business diagrams with AI. Users describe what they need in a sentence, and the tool produces an editable first draft such as a flowchart, sequence diagram, class diagram, cloud architecture or workflow. A floating chat panel accepts follow-up requests for rewording, hierarchy changes or a full restructure, while the canvas supports dragging, aligning and grouping by hand. Paid users can upload PDFs, images or text so the diagram reflects real source material. An autolayout feature reduces crossing lines, every AI change is saved in version history, and diagrams export as XML, SVG or PNG. A free plan allows one request per day.
cons: Free plan allows one request a day
File uploads require a paid plan
moreContext:
Diagram AI gets the balance right between automation and control. The AI produces a quick first draft, but the result lands on a normal canvas you can edit by hand, so you are never stuck with a static image that is almost right.

- Covers flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams and cloud architecture
- A chat panel handles big restructures without starting over
- Uploaded PDFs, images or notes keep diagrams faithful to real material
- Autolayout aims for cleaner spacing and fewer crossing lines
- Every AI edit can be rolled back through version history

Diagram AI is best for engineers documenting systems, product managers mapping flows and students turning notes into visuals. Our tip: mention the audience and the diagram type in your first sentence, for example a sequence diagram of a login flow for new developers, since that context shapes the level of detail. Export to XML if you want to keep editing the diagram in other tools later. When a layout gets messy after many edits, ask the assistant for a restructure instead of fixing every box by hand, and roll back from version history if you prefer the earlier draft.

name: Glimbench
tagline: Free on-device AI tools for background removal, image to Excel and HEIC to JPG
description: A set of private, browser-run tools that cut out backgrounds at full resolution, turn table screenshots into editable Excel files and convert iPhone HEIC photos, with a low-cost Pro plan for batches.
longDescription: Glimbench is a small suite of file tools that process images on the user's own device rather than on a server. Its background remover cuts people and products out of photos and returns transparent PNGs at original resolution with no watermark. Image to Excel recognizes tables in screenshots or document photos, lets users fix recognition errors and downloads a real XLSX workbook. A HEIC to JPG converter handles batches of iPhone photos. The free tier covers unlimited single images and modest batch sizes, while a Pro plan adds larger batches, e-commerce presets for marketplaces such as Amazon and Shopify, custom backgrounds, a higher quality cutout model on WebGPU devices and future local tools.
pros: Files are processed on your device
cons: Small tool lineup so far
Best cutout model needs a WebGPU device
moreContext:
Glimbench stands out for its privacy-first design. Because every tool runs locally in the browser, product photos and document screenshots never need to be uploaded, which is reassuring for anyone handling client files or internal spreadsheets.

- Background removal returns full-size transparent PNGs without watermarks
- Image to Excel lets you correct recognized cells before downloading
- HEIC conversion handles whole batches and zips the results
- Pro adds marketplace presets for Amazon, Shopify, Etsy and eBay
- One Pro plan covers every current and future local tool

Glimbench is best for online sellers preparing product shots, office workers digitizing tables and iPhone users who need JPGs that open anywhere. Our tip: check fine edges like hair or transparent packaging after a cutout, as the site itself notes AI edges can need a closer look, and try the free batch limits first; the yearly and founding lifetime options are inexpensive if you regularly process images in bulk. For marketplace listings, the Pro presets save you from resizing and padding each product photo manually.

name: Cleverboek
tagline: Free Dutch bookkeeping software with automatic transaction matching and VAT returns
description: Bookkeeping for Dutch freelancers and small businesses that auto-categorizes bank transactions, reads receipts from photos, prepares VAT returns and includes a chat assistant, all on a free plan.
longDescription: Cleverboek is online bookkeeping software for freelancers (zzp'ers) and small businesses in the Netherlands. It connects to major Dutch banks through open banking, then a background bookkeeping bot categorizes transactions and matches them to invoices and receipts; the company says up to 87 percent of administration can be processed automatically. Receipts can be photographed and are read for supplier, date, amount and VAT. The software prepares quarterly VAT returns for submission to the Belastingdienst, sends invoices with payment links and reminders, and tracks mileage and hours. A chat assistant can carry out tasks. All features are free, and users can optionally hand their books to Cleverboek's own accountants. The interface is in Dutch.
cons: Built only for the Dutch market
Interface and support are in Dutch
moreContext:
Cleverboek takes an unusually generous approach for bookkeeping software: every feature is included at no cost, rather than a stripped-down free tier with paid add-ons. Combined with automation that handles the repetitive matching of transactions and receipts, it lowers both the price and the time cost of keeping books in order.

- A bookkeeping bot categorizes and matches transactions around the clock
- Scan and recognize reads receipts from a photo or PDF
- VAT returns are calculated quarterly and ready to review and file
- Invoices include payment links and automatic reminders
- Mileage and hours tracking are built in

Cleverboek is best for Dutch freelancers and small business owners who want to do their own administration with less manual entry, while keeping the option to involve an accountant. Our tip: choose the automation setting that books known suppliers automatically but asks for manual review on new relationships, which keeps the bot efficient while you stay in control of anything unfamiliar. Connect your business bank account on day one so the matching has data to learn from.

name: insMind AI Fashion Model
tagline: Turn mannequin and flat lay product shots into on-model fashion photos
description: An insMind tool that replaces mannequins, ghost mannequins and flat lays with AI-generated models wearing your garment, so sellers can produce on-model photos without a photoshoot.
longDescription: insMind AI Fashion Model is part of the insMind photo editing suite and is aimed at online clothing sellers and fashion brands. You upload a product shot on a mannequin, a ghost mannequin image or a flat lay, pick from a range of AI models that vary by skin tone, age, body size and gender, and the tool renders a photo of that model wearing the item. It can also swap the face or skin tone on an existing model photo to localize imagery for different markets, and it ties into insMind's background and lighting tools. Uploads can be dropped in, pasted or added by URL, and results are downloaded for use on store pages and marketplaces.
features: Flat lay and ghost mannequin support
pros: Cuts the need for model photoshoots
cons: Plan limits are not spelled out on the tool page
Person photos must show face and upper body
moreContext:
Product photography is one of the biggest recurring costs for small clothing brands, and this tool goes straight at that problem. Instead of booking models and a studio for every new item, a seller can start from the mannequin or flat lay photo they already have and get a styled, on-model image back. The fact that it lives inside a broader photo editing suite means the background and lighting can be cleaned up in the same place.

- Works from the kinds of photos sellers already shoot, including mannequins, ghost mannequins and flat lays
- Offers models across a range of skin tones, ages, body sizes and genders
- Face and skin tone swapping helps adapt one product shot for different regional storefronts
- insMind says the generator aims to keep garment details such as prints, logos and cuts intact
- Available in the browser with companion mobile apps

This is best for Shopify, Amazon and marketplace sellers who need a steady stream of consistent apparel images without a production budget. A practical tip: start with a well-lit, wrinkle-free product photo on a plain background, since cleaner inputs give the model fewer details to guess and tend to produce more faithful results.

name: Vosko AI
tagline: Translate and dub videos into dozens of languages while keeping the original voice
description: A video localization platform that translates speech, clones the speaker's voice for dubbing, translates subtitles and keeps background music and effects intact, all in one workspace.
longDescription: Vosko AI is a video localization service from Vimia Tech Limited, launched in 2026. It takes a source video or audio file, separates the dialogue from music and sound effects, translates the speech and generates a dubbed track in a cloned version of the speaker's voice. The site lists 94 target languages, along with tools for subtitle translation, removing burned-in captions and translating podcasts or voiceovers. A built-in script editor lets you adjust the translation before export, and speaker detection handles interviews and multi-person content. Higher plans support long files, batch uploads and output in several languages at once. It targets creators, marketers, e-learning teams and short drama producers.
pros: Keeps music and effects under the dub
Credit packs available without a subscription
cons: Free credits cover only a couple of minutes of dubbing
Batch and long file limits require higher plans
moreContext:
Localizing a video usually means juggling a translator, a voice actor and an audio engineer, and Vosko AI folds those steps into a single workspace. Its approach of splitting the dialogue away from the music and effects before dubbing matters a lot for polished content, because the translated version keeps the original soundtrack instead of sounding stripped down.

- Dubs speech in a cloned version of the original speaker's voice rather than a stock narrator
- Separates dialogue from background audio so music and sound effects survive the translation
- Includes subtitle translation and a tool for erasing burned-in captions
- Speaker detection supports interviews, podcasts and other multi-voice formats
- The company says paid plans can process up to 150 files in a batch and up to eight languages at once

It is a strong fit for creators, course producers and marketing teams who publish the same video in several markets. A practical tip: use the free signup credits on a short clip with clear speech first, and review the transcript in the script editor before generating the dub, since fixing wording there is cheaper than regenerating audio.

name: AILearnHub
tagline: Turn any topic, question or article into a structured AI-generated lesson
description: AILearnHub converts a topic, question, article or idea into a structured lesson with an AI tutor, AI study peers, whiteboard explanations and practice checks.
longDescription: AILearnHub is an AI learning platform that builds full lessons on demand. You enter a topic, paste an article or ask a question, and it assembles a learning path that moves from concept to lesson, practice, quiz and application. Lessons are delivered in a classroom view where an AI tutor explains the material on a whiteboard while AI peer characters add different perspectives. The platform also has a public library of lessons other users have generated, and paid plans add bulk generation, stronger models and PDF or Notion exports. It suits self-learners, students who want a structured walkthrough of a new subject and educators who want draft teaching material.
features: PDF and Notion export on paid plans
pros: Builds a clear learning path automatically
Interactive classroom style rather than plain text
Library of community lessons to browse
cons: Free plan includes only one lesson generation
Paid plans cap lessons by monthly credits
moreContext:
What sets AILearnHub apart is that it does not stop at answering a question. It turns a subject into a sequence you can actually study, starting with the core concept and ending with practice and application. The classroom format, with a tutor and a couple of AI peers discussing the material, makes it feel closer to a guided lesson than a chatbot transcript.

- Generates a full learning path from a single topic, article or question
- Presents lessons in an interactive classroom with whiteboard explanations
- Builds in practice checks and quizzes so you can test understanding as you go
- Lets you browse lessons generated by other users across many subjects
- Paid plans export lessons to PDF or Notion for review or teaching

It works best for curious self-learners and students tackling an unfamiliar topic, and for teachers who want a starting draft of a lesson plan. A practical tip: phrase your request as a specific goal, such as understanding one concept well enough to explain it, because a narrow brief tends to produce a tighter and more useful lesson than a broad subject name.

name: Quizlet
tagline: Flashcards and study modes with AI tools that turn notes into practice material
description: Quizlet is a widely used study platform built around flashcard sets, with AI features that generate study material from your notes and adaptive modes that focus on the terms you struggle with.
longDescription: Quizlet started in 2005 as a flashcard site and has grown into a broad study platform for students and teachers. Users create or search for study sets, then review them through flashcards, adaptive Learn sessions, matching games and practice tests. Its AI tools can turn pasted notes into flashcards and study guides and generate practice questions from a set, while Learn mode adjusts which terms you see based on your answers. Teachers can build sets and run classroom activities. A free plan covers core flashcards and limited use of advanced modes, while Quizlet Plus adds the AI study tools, unlimited Learn rounds, offline access and an ad-free experience.
pros: Huge library of user-made study sets
cons: AI tools sit behind the paid plan
Free plan limits advanced study rounds
moreContext:
Few study tools are as familiar to students as Quizlet, and its AI additions build on a format people already trust. The core idea of turning material into flashcards and drilling it through different modes is now faster, because notes you paste in can be turned into a ready-made set instead of typed card by card.
