ComicStory AI is best for people making a personal gift, such as a proposal comic, a story starring a pet, or a birthday book where a child is the hero, as well as teachers and hobbyists who want a quick illustrated narrative. A practical tip: spend your free sign-up credits on a short template first so you can judge how well the character lock holds up with your own photo before you commit to a subscription or a longer multi-chapter book.

name: AIHub
tagline: One account for GPT, Claude, Gemini and other leading models, billed per message
description: AIHub puts 19 models from eight vendors in one chat window and bills each message in credits at the model's real cost, so you can compare answers and see exactly what you spend.
longDescription: AIHub is an all-in-one chat platform that gives you access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, Perplexity, DeepSeek and xAI under a single subscription. Rather than flat message caps, every reply is billed in credits that track each model's list price, and the cost appears next to the answer. You can send one prompt to two models at once and read the replies side by side, and a saved prompt library follows you from model to model. Accounts are free to create, but there are no trial credits: you start with the Pro plan or a small top-up, and top-up credits never expire.
features: 19 models from 8 vendors in one chat
Per-message cost shown on every reply
pros: Transparent pricing tied to real model cost
Easy to compare models on the same prompt
cons: No free trial credits to start
Premium models use credits quickly
moreContext:
The appeal of AIHub is how openly it handles cost. Many multi-model chat apps hide usage behind vague limits, while AIHub publishes a price list showing what a short message costs on each model and stamps the cost on every reply. That makes it easy to learn which model is worth paying for on which kind of task.

- Access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, Perplexity, DeepSeek and xAI in one place
- Ask two models the same question and read the answers side by side
- A public credit table that the company says follows OpenRouter list prices
- A prompt library you can send to whichever model is selected
- Top-up credits that do not expire, alongside a monthly plan

AIHub is best for people who already bounce between several AI subscriptions and would rather pay one bill, and for anyone who wants to test models against each other before settling on one. A practical tip: run your most common prompts through a cheaper model and a premium model side by side for a week. Once you see where the cheaper model is good enough, you can stretch the monthly credit allowance much further.

name: Bardiah
tagline: AI email designer that learns your brand and turns rough copy into responsive HTML
description: Bardiah remembers your logo, palette and voice, then drafts on-brand marketing emails through a chat. Refine in plain language and export clean HTML for Mailchimp, Klaviyo and other email tools.
longDescription: Bardiah is an AI email designer for founders, marketers and small agencies who want polished campaigns without a designer. You set up a brand profile once by uploading your logo, colors and a sample of your writing voice. From there you paste copy or describe the email you need, and Bardiah drafts a complete design that you refine through chat with requests like making the tone warmer or softening a call to action. Finished emails export as table-based responsive HTML or .eml files that work in Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Gmail and Outlook. Plans add version history, more projects, and an MCP server so you can design emails from AI assistants.
features: Brand memory for logo, palette and voice
MCP server for ChatGPT and Claude
pros: Emails stay on brand without style guides
Exports drop straight into common ESPs
cons: Free plan allows one email a month
Monthly email caps on every paid tier
moreContext:
Bardiah takes a refreshingly narrow approach: it does not try to be a full email platform, it just makes the email itself look right. You keep control of the words, and it handles layout, brand colors and the fiddly HTML that email clients demand. The name comes from the Arabic word for papyrus, a nod to the founder's view that an email should feel crafted rather than mass-produced.

- A stored brand profile means every draft starts with your colors, fonts and voice
- Edits happen through chat, so no template wrangling or drag-and-drop work
- Table-based HTML exports are built to render across major desktop and mobile clients
- Version history lets you roll back to an earlier design
- An MCP server lets you design emails from ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants

Bardiah is best for small brands, solo founders and agencies that care about how their emails look but do not have a designer on hand. A practical tip: spend extra time on the brand setup step, including a strong sample of your writing voice, since every later draft builds on that profile and the free plan only covers one designed email a month.

name: AGNT
tagline: Free, local-first agent workspace for coding, research and repeatable workflows
description: AGNT is a desktop agent operating system where you chat, build agents and wire visual workflows using your own AI subscriptions, API keys or local models. It runs free on Windows, macOS and Linux.
longDescription: AGNT is a local-first workspace for doing whole jobs with AI rather than asking one-off questions. The desktop app combines chat, an agent manager, a visual workflow builder and a canvas that mixes writing, charts, code, images and audio. You bring the models: supported AI subscriptions, API keys, or local models through Ollama and LM Studio. Workflows connect triggers, tools and code from a library of more than 119 tool nodes, and credentials stay in a local encrypted vault. The core app is free for personal use, education, nonprofits and small businesses, while paid cloud plans add remote execution, encrypted sync, webhooks and shared team vaults.
features: Visual workflow builder with 119+ tool nodes
Bring your own subscriptions, keys or local models
Cloud plans with remote runs and webhooks
pros: Free core app on all major desktops
Works with Ollama and LM Studio
Turns useful runs into reusable tools
cons: Larger businesses need a paid license
Model costs and limits depend on your provider
moreContext:
AGNT stands out by treating AI as a place to do the work rather than a box that returns answers. Chat, agents, workflows and a mixed-media canvas live in one desktop app, and the whole thing runs on your own hardware with whatever models you already pay for. Its source is published on GitHub, which adds a welcome layer of transparency.

- Runs locally on Windows, macOS and Linux, with Docker and self-hosting options
- Connects to supported AI subscriptions, API keys, or local models via Ollama and LM Studio
- Visual workflows link triggers, tools and code, with configuration shown beside the graph
- Credentials are kept in a local encrypted vault with audit receipts
- Optional cloud plans add remote execution, encrypted sync and shared team vaults

AGNT is best for developers, researchers and technical operators who want agent automation without handing every credential to a hosted service. Under its license terms, the free Community Core covers personal use, education, nonprofits and businesses under $1M in revenue with up to 10 people. A practical tip: start by running a single research or reporting job locally, and only turn it into a saved workflow once the result proves worth repeating.

name: GetBirthChart
tagline: Free birth chart calculator with readings and AI questions about your placements
description: GetBirthChart calculates your natal chart from birth date, time and place, then explains planets, houses and aspects. You can ask AI questions grounded in your own chart and buy full readings.
longDescription: GetBirthChart is an online astrology tool that builds a natal chart from your birth date, time and location using professional ephemeris data. The free chart shows your Sun, Moon and Rising signs, planets, houses and aspects, and lets you choose between Placidus, Whole Sign and Equal House systems. If you do not know your birth time, it leaves out the placements that depend on it instead of guessing. An Ask Your Chart feature answers questions about your placements with AI, with three free questions per chart. One-time purchases add a full natal reading with a PDF report, a yearly forecast, and compatibility readings for couples.
features: AI questions grounded in your chart
pros: Free chart takes about thirty seconds
Honest handling of unknown birth times
cons: Only three free AI questions per chart
Full readings cost extra per chart
moreContext:
GetBirthChart earns points for being upfront about how it works. It explains its house systems, uses ephemeris data for planetary positions, and simply omits time-dependent placements when you do not know your birth time rather than filling the gap with guesses. The AI feature is tied to your actual chart, so answers draw on your placements instead of a generic horoscope.

- Calculates Sun, Moon, Rising, planets, houses and aspects in a free chart
- Lets you switch between Placidus, Whole Sign and Equal House systems
- Ask Your Chart answers personal questions using your own placements
- Compatibility tools compare two charts with synastry and a composite chart
- Paid readings are one-time purchases and remove ads across your account

GetBirthChart is best for astrology enthusiasts and curious beginners who want a clear, well-explained natal chart and the option to dig deeper with AI. It also suits couples who want to compare charts. A practical tip: find your exact birth time on a birth certificate or hospital record before you start, since houses and your Rising sign need it and the free AI questions are far more useful with a complete chart.

name: Teasa
tagline: Interactive AI roleplay stories and one-on-one character chats in seven languages
description: Teasa lets you play creator-written stories with a cast of AI characters, take on quests, and message characters directly between adventures. It is free to play, with an optional monthly pass.
longDescription: Teasa is an AI character chat and interactive roleplay app. You step into stories written by creators, meet their cast of AI characters, and decide what you say and do as you explore, complete quests and reach relationship milestones. Between stories you can direct message any character one-on-one, and plans made in those chats can turn into new stories. Users can also create their own characters and import chats from a Character.AI data export. Teasa runs in a web browser, on Android and on Windows, supports seven languages, and is intended for ages 13 and up. Character DMs are free with an account, while Teasa Pass adds premium chat styles.
features: Unlimited character DMs on free accounts
pros: Large catalog of stories to play
Available on web, Android and Windows
cons: Best chat styles need a paid pass
Story quality varies by creator
moreContext:
Teasa blends two ideas that are usually separate: story-driven roleplay with quests and a cast, and casual texting with a single character. You can move between them freely, which gives conversations a sense of continuity and gives stories a personal thread. It feels closer to a choose-your-path game than a plain chatbot. The company says its English catalog holds thousands of creator-written stories.

- Interactive stories with a full cast, quests and relationship milestones
- Free, unlimited one-on-one character DMs with a free account
- Tools to create your own characters
- Import from a Character.AI data export so earlier chats can continue as stories
- Seven languages, including Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese

Teasa is best for fans of interactive fiction and character chat who want more structure than an open-ended chatbot, and for people moving over from Character.AI. A practical tip: start with a popular story rather than a blank DM, since the creator's setup gives characters a clearer personality and goal, then use DMs to continue with the characters you enjoy most.

name: TattooDrafts
tagline: AI tattoo design references, placement previews and briefs to bring to your artist
description: TattooDrafts turns a tattoo idea into four design references, a size check, and a one-page brief for your artist. It also offers free stencil, lettering, placement and pricing tools.
longDescription: TattooDrafts is a set of tattoo planning tools centered on an AI design assistant. You describe the tattoo, choose a style such as fine line, American traditional, blackwork or realism, and set the placement and size. The tool returns four reference designs, notes on which details will hold up at your real size, and a one-page brief your artist can redraw from. A try-on feature previews placement on the body, and a stencil maker produces PNG, SVG and PDF files. Free extras include a lettering font generator, Roman numeral and Morse code converters, a price calculator, a printable size chart and a pain chart by placement.
features: Four AI design references per idea
Stencil maker with SVG and PDF export
pros: Checks what holds up at real size
cons: Realistic previews cost credits
References still need an artist to redraw
moreContext:
TattooDrafts takes a thoughtful stance on AI in tattooing: it positions its designs as references and a brief for a human artist, not as finished flash. That framing respects the artist's role while helping clients walk into a consultation with a clear idea instead of a vague description. The surrounding free tools cover many of the practical questions people have before booking.

- Describe an idea and get four references in your chosen style, sized to your placement
- Guidance on which fine details will survive at the actual tattoo size
- Placement try-on previews, with realistic renders available on credits
- A stencil maker and gallery with PNG, SVG and PDF downloads
- Free calculators for price, size and pain by body placement

TattooDrafts is best for people planning their first or next tattoo who want to communicate clearly with an artist, and for anyone weighing size, placement and budget before booking. A practical tip: if you only have one tattoo in mind, the 7-Day Pass can be a better fit than a subscription, and the free preview sets are enough to test whether the style options match what you picture.

name: AI Study Sheet
tagline: iPhone and iPad app that masks key terms on your own notes for quick recall practice
description: AI Study Sheet imports photos and PDFs of textbooks or notes, hides likely key terms on the original page, and reveals answers after three seconds, so you can review without building flashcards.
longDescription: AI Study Sheet is an iOS study app from Toybird Labs that turns existing study materials into recall practice. You import photos or PDFs of textbooks, worksheets or notes, and the app reads the text, identifies likely study terms and overlays masks directly on the original layout, so diagrams and tables keep their context. In Auto mode the hidden answers reveal after three seconds, and you can adjust how many masks appear. Your own ratings and review timing help choose which pages to study next, and reminders bring you back when pages are due. Processing happens on device, and the interface supports ten languages. A one-time upgrade removes save limits.
pros: Keeps diagrams and tables in context
cons: Only available on iPhone and iPad
Free tier limits how many materials you save
moreContext:
AI Study Sheet solves a familiar chore for students: the hours spent turning notes into flashcards before any real studying begins. By hiding key terms directly on the page you already have, it keeps the visual context of charts and layouts that flashcards strip away. It also keeps your material on the device rather than uploading it to a server.

- Imports photos and PDFs of textbooks, worksheets and handwritten notes
- Suggests masks for likely key terms, which you can edit when needed
- Auto mode reveals answers after three seconds and adjusts the number of masks
- Uses your self-ratings and study timing to pick pages for review
- Ten interface languages and an option to back up materials and history to a file

AI Study Sheet is best for students preparing for exams with dense printed material, such as vocabulary lists, history notes or labeled science diagrams. A practical tip: rate pages honestly after each session, since those ratings drive which pages the app brings back, and turn on notifications so the review reminders can do their job.

name: Katteb
tagline: Goal-driven AI agents that plan and work daily toward a business target
description: Katteb runs AI agents that take a business goal with a number and a deadline, research the market, write a plan, and work on it every day with a morning report. One-off tasks are supported too.
longDescription: Katteb is an AI agent platform for small businesses, creators and agencies. You can hand an agent a one-time task, such as pulling sales data into a spreadsheet, or set a goal with an outcome, a target number and a deadline between 14 and 180 days. For goals, the agent first searches the web to study buyers, decision makers and competitors, writes a plan for free, and then works on it daily while tracking progress from your own tools. It can sign in to sites, use its own inbox, connect to Telegram and send a report every morning. Higher plans add more agents, schedules, hosted landing pages with lead forms and meeting booking.
features: Hosted landing pages with lead forms
pros: Free plan writing before you pay
Agent time included in plan price
Failed runs do not use agent time
cons: Agents require a paid plan
Weekly agent hours are capped
moreContext:
Katteb frames AI agents around outcomes instead of instructions. Rather than telling an agent what to do step by step, you state where you want to be, for example booking a set number of sales calls in a month, and the agent researches, plans and works toward that number every day. The company says more than 590,000 people have used Katteb, and the interface is available in English and Arabic.

- Clear split between one-off tasks and ongoing goals with deadlines
- Market research step that looks at buyers, decision makers and competitor pricing
- A plan written for free before any agent work starts
- Daily morning reports that track a number from your own tools
- Business plan adds multiple agents, hourly schedules and meeting booking on Google Calendar

Katteb is best for founders, consultants, store owners and small agencies who want help with repetitive growth work like prospecting, outreach and reporting. A practical tip: write goals with a specific, measurable number and a realistic deadline, and review the free plan the agent drafts before subscribing, since that plan shows how it intends to spend its agent time.

name: Jotted
tagline: Botless meeting recorder for Windows with local transcripts and AI notes
description: Jotted records meetings from your Windows desktop without a bot joining the call, transcribes every word on your computer for free, and offers AI summaries, action items and cloud backup on Pro.
longDescription: Jotted is a desktop meeting recorder for Windows that captures calls without sending a bot into the meeting. Because it records your screen and audio, it works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack huddles, Discord and other apps. The free version offers unlimited full HD recordings with no length limits and transcribes everything locally, with search and export. The Pro plan writes meeting summaries with decisions, groups action items by person, and adds an assistant called Quill that answers questions about one call or all of them. Pro also backs recordings up to the cloud and creates share links or branded PDF notes.
features: Records any meeting app without a bot
Free local transcription with no limits
AI summaries and action items on Pro
Share links and branded PDF notes
pros: Generous free plan with no watermark
Keeps full video, not just a transcript
Same price billed monthly or yearly
cons: Windows only for now
AI notes require the Pro plan
moreContext:
Jotted appeals to anyone tired of meeting bots announcing themselves on every call. It records from your own desktop, so it works with whatever meeting app is on screen, and it keeps the full video alongside the transcript so you can check exactly what was said. The free tier is notably generous, with unlimited recordings and on-device transcription.

- No bot joins the call, so recordings work even when you are not the host
- Free unlimited recordings in full HD with local transcription and search
- Pro summaries capture decisions and group action items by owner and date
- Quill answers questions across one meeting or your whole library
- Share links let others watch in a browser, with control over downloads

Jotted is best for freelancers, consultants, recruiters and sales teams on Windows who want a reliable record of client calls without extra subscriptions. Jotted includes consent reminders before recording, and a practical tip is to use them: tell participants you are recording, since that is expected or legally required in many places, and the full video makes it easy to settle any later disagreement about what was agreed.

name: SlideSpeak
tagline: AI presentation maker that builds editable PowerPoint decks from files, links or ideas
description: SlideSpeak generates editable PowerPoint presentations from a topic, document or link, applies your brand template, and can turn decks into narrated videos. It also offers an API and a Brand MCP server.
longDescription: SlideSpeak is an AI presentation tool built around the PowerPoint format. You can create a deck from a short prompt, a Word or PDF file, or a web link, then edit, rewrite and restyle slides in the browser without Office. Paid plans let you apply custom brand templates and brand kits so decks match company design. Beyond slides, SlideSpeak narrates presentations into videos with AI voices and presenters, translates them into many languages, and exports to PPT, PDF and more. Teams can generate decks programmatically through its API, and a Brand MCP server lets AI agents such as Claude create on-brand slides. A free plan includes starter credits.
features: Decks from prompts, files or links
pros: Useful set of free PowerPoint tools
cons: Free credits cover only a few decks
Custom templates are a paid add-on
moreContext:
SlideSpeak stands out by staying close to the format most offices already use. Instead of locking decks into a proprietary editor, it produces real PowerPoint files you can open and adjust anywhere. It has also grown into training content, turning slide decks into narrated videos and quizzes for onboarding and compliance programs, which widens its usefulness well beyond the sales pitch.

- Builds presentations from a topic, a document, a PDF or a web page
- Edits, rewrites and restyles .pptx files in the browser
- Brand kits and custom templates help keep decks on brand
- Converts decks into narrated videos and translates them for other languages
- An API and a Brand MCP server for teams automating slide creation

SlideSpeak is best for consultants, educators, students and corporate trainers who start from existing documents and need polished PowerPoint output quickly. A practical tip: before buying a custom template add-on, try generating a deck from one of your real reports on the free credits, then check how much restyling it needs to match your company look.

name: Video To Blog
tagline: Turn YouTube videos and recordings into SEO-ready blog posts with images
description: Video To Blog converts videos, podcasts and audio files into structured blog articles with screenshots, AI images and SEO metadata, then publishes them to your CMS or a hosted blog and newsletter.
longDescription: Video To Blog repurposes video and audio into written articles. You paste a YouTube link, upload a file or record audio, and the tool transcribes it and drafts a post of up to about 3,000 words in your chosen tone and point of view, with headings, FAQs and a table of contents. It can add screenshots from the video, stock photos, AI images and internal links, and it fills in metadata, keyphrases and image alt tags for SEO. A built-in editor includes readability and structure analysis. Posts export to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Medium, Wix and other platforms, or publish to a hosted blog and email newsletter.
features: YouTube links, uploads or recorded audio
Video screenshots and AI images in posts
Export to WordPress, Shopify and Webflow
pros: Strong fit for repurposing long videos
Free plan to test one video monthly
cons: Free plan limits videos to 30 minutes
Monthly-billed prices are not listed openly
moreContext:
Video To Blog is built for a simple but valuable job: giving content that already exists on video a second life as searchable text. It goes further than transcription by shaping the material into a structured article, pulling relevant frames from the video as images and handling much of the SEO groundwork. The company says users have created more than 500,000 articles.

- Imports from YouTube, uploaded video or audio files, or a live recording
- Matches your writing style using samples, with custom tone, point of view and calls to action
- Adds screenshots, stock images, AI images and video thumbnails to posts
- Analyzes keyphrases, readability and structure inside the editor
- Publishes to many CMS platforms or to a hosted blog and newsletter

Video To Blog is best for YouTubers, podcasters, course creators, churches and agencies that publish long-form video and want matching written content for search. A practical tip: upload a couple of your own existing blog posts as writing samples before generating, since the output will read much closer to your voice and need less editing.

name: HautechAI
tagline: Visual generative AI for fashion brands: virtual try-on, AI models and product shots
description: HautechAI creates photorealistic fashion and product imagery without photoshoots, including virtual try-on, reusable digital twins, model swaps and short brand videos, through a studio app or API.
longDescription: HautechAI is a visual generative AI platform for commerce, with a focus on apparel, beauty and accessories. Brands can show real garments on people with virtual try-on, create reusable digital twins of a person, generate AI models to present products, or swap the model in an existing photo. It also produces studio-style product photography and turns images into short brand or customer-style videos. Teams use it through a self-serve Studio, an API for developers, a node-based workflow tool called Liana, or an embeddable try-on widget. Pricing works on one-time credit packs that do not expire, with commercial rights on high-resolution outputs.
cons: Pay-per-generation costs add up for large catalogs
Aimed more at brands than casual users
moreContext:
HautechAI is built specifically for fashion and retail imagery, which shows in its toolkit. Rather than a general image generator, it offers features merchants actually need, such as putting real clothes on a model, keeping one model consistent across a catalog, and replacing models in existing photos. The company lists support from startup programs including Google for Startups, Microsoft for Startups and NVIDIA Inception.

- Virtual try-on that shows how real garments look on a person
- Digital twins for reusable, consistent models across campaigns
- Studio-free product photography and short brand or UGC-style videos
- Four ways to integrate: Studio, API, the Liana node workflow tool and a try-on widget
- Privacy-focused infrastructure with data centers in the US, Europe and Asia

HautechAI is best for apparel, beauty and accessories brands, marketplaces and agencies that need large volumes of consistent product imagery without booking repeated photoshoots. A practical tip: buy the smallest credit pack first and run a handful of your own products through try-on and model swap, since the platform shows the credit cost before each generation and you can compare results with your current photography.

name: Namelix
tagline: Free AI business name generator for short, brandable names with domain checks
description: Namelix suggests short, brandable business names using a custom language model. Filter by length, keywords and domain extension, save favorites, and it refines suggestions based on what you like.
longDescription: Namelix is a free business name generator from the team behind Brandmark.io. You describe your business idea or enter keywords, and its custom language model suggests short, brandable names rather than long combinations of dictionary words. Filters let you prioritize shorter names, require a specific keyword, or focus on a domain extension. As you save names you like, the algorithm learns your preferences and adjusts later suggestions. Namelix checks domain availability alongside each idea and links to Brandmark for creating a matching logo. It suits founders, side projects and anyone who needs a memorable name that has a realistic chance of an affordable domain.
features: Filters for length, keyword and extension
pros: Quick path to a matching logo
cons: Trademark checks are up to you
Invented names may need explaining
moreContext:
Namelix has become a go-to naming tool because it focuses on the kind of names startups actually want: short, unique and brandable. Instead of mashing dictionary words together, it invents names that sound like real brands, and it gets better as you tell it what you like. Being free with no sign-up hurdle makes it easy to explore dozens of directions in minutes.

- A custom language model tuned for short, brandable business names
- Filters to favor shorter names, include a keyword or target an extension
- Saved names feed back into the algorithm for better later suggestions
- Domain availability shown alongside ideas
- A direct link to Brandmark.io for designing a logo once you pick a name

Namelix is best for founders, freelancers and side-project builders at the naming stage who want a broad pool of original options fast. A practical tip: save several names you lean toward, even imperfect ones, early in a session so the recommendations adapt to your taste, and run a trademark search on your finalists before buying a domain.

name: Goblin Tools
tagline: Simple AI tools that break down tasks and ease overwhelm for neurodivergent users
description: Goblin Tools is a free collection of single-task AI helpers, such as Magic ToDo for breaking tasks into steps, Formalizer for adjusting tone, and Judge for reading the emotion in a message.
longDescription: Goblin Tools is a collection of small, single-purpose AI tools designed mainly to help neurodivergent people with tasks that feel overwhelming. Magic ToDo breaks a task into smaller steps with an adjustable level of detail, and Taskmaster helps you focus on one task at a time. Formalizer rewrites text in a different tone, Judge reads a message for emotional tone, Estimator guesses how long an activity will take, and Compiler turns a brain dump into actions. Professor explains topics, Consultant helps with decisions, and Chef builds recipes from ingredients. The website is free without ads, low-cost mobile apps help fund it, and an optional Pro subscription covers advanced features.
features: Compiler for turning brain dumps into actions
pros: Core website is free with no ads
cons: AI output can be inaccurate
Some advanced features need Pro
moreContext:
Few AI products use the technology with as light a touch as Goblin Tools. Each tool does one small job well, such as splitting a daunting chore into manageable steps or checking whether a message might come across as rude. It was built by software and data engineer Bram De Buyser, and its stated principle is that existing features will never be locked behind a paywall.

- Magic ToDo turns a vague task into steps, with a dial for how detailed the breakdown should be
- Formalizer and Judge help with writing and reading tone in messages
- Estimator and Taskmaster support time awareness and single-task focus
- Compiler converts a brain dump into a list of actions
- Mobile apps for Android and iOS, plus accounts that sync and share lists

Goblin Tools is best for people with ADHD, autism or executive function challenges, and for anyone who sometimes freezes in front of a big task. The site itself notes that results are guesswork from general models, so a practical tip is to treat each breakdown as a starting draft, then edit or remove steps until the list fits how you actually work.

name: Merlin AI
tagline: AI assistant and browser extension with access to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more
description: Merlin AI brings several leading AI models into one assistant that works in your browser and on mobile and Mac, with web research, file chat, image generation and summaries.
longDescription: Merlin AI is a multi-model assistant from Foyer Tech that you can use as a browser extension, a web app, or apps for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It lets you choose among models such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, or let Merlin pick one per message. The assistant searches the web with cited sources and can compile deep research reports, answers questions about uploaded documents and photos, and generates or edits images and short videos. Projects group related chats with shared files, and a crafts feature builds code, diagrams and small web pages with previews. A free plan includes daily query limits, while Pro raises limits and adds premium models.
features: Choice of ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini models
pros: Works in the browser and on Apple devices
Free daily queries to try it
cons: Usage on paid plans is subject to fair-use caps
Prices vary between web and app stores
moreContext:
Merlin AI is built around convenience: instead of keeping separate tabs and subscriptions for different chatbots, you get several leading models in one assistant that follows you around the web. Its browser extension is a big part of the appeal, putting summaries, writing help and research next to whatever page you are reading.

- Pick a model per conversation, or let Merlin choose automatically for each message
- Web research that shows sources, plus deeper report-style research
- A vault for reusing uploaded files across chats and projects
- Crafts that generate code, diagrams and small interactive pages with shareable previews
- Apps for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs alongside the browser extension

Merlin AI is best for students, writers and knowledge workers who want quick AI help across many websites and like switching between models without juggling accounts. A practical tip: check the current plan details on the official site before subscribing, since prices differ between the web and the App Store, and reports describe usage caps even on plans marketed as unlimited.

name: GPTExcel
tagline: Excel AI assistant for formulas, pivot tables, charts and data analysis
description: GPTExcel lets you upload Excel or CSV files and ask questions in plain English to get formulas, pivot tables, charts, summaries and even slide decks. It also generates SQL, regex and VBA scripts.
longDescription: GPTExcel is an AI spreadsheet assistant for data, finance and operations work. You upload an Excel or CSV file and ask questions in plain English, and it returns analysis, charts and written summaries. Dedicated agents build pivot tables and slide decks from your data, while generators produce Excel formulas, scripts, SQL queries, regular expressions and templates. The site also publishes worked guides, such as analyzing a sales report or a budget against actuals. Usage runs on credits: the free plan includes a monthly allowance and daily free tool runs on a fast model, and paid plans add larger files and access to stronger models.
features: Chat with Excel and CSV files
Pivot Builder and Slide Deck Builder agents
Formula, SQL, regex and VBA generators
pros: Useful free plan with daily tool runs
Low entry price for paid tiers
cons: File size limits on lower plans
Weekly credits do not roll over
moreContext:
GPTExcel focuses on the everyday spreadsheet work that eats time for analysts and small business owners: writing tricky formulas, building pivots and explaining what a dataset actually shows. Because you can upload a real file and ask in plain language, it serves both people who know Excel well and those who would rather not touch a formula bar. The company says more than 1.6 million people use it.

- Upload Excel or CSV files and get analysis, charts and summaries
- Pivot Builder and Slide Deck Builder agents turn data into reports and presentations
- Generators for formulas, scripts, SQL, regex and templates
- Three model tiers on higher plans, with credit costs shown per message
- Step-by-step guides covering sales, budget and HR analysis

GPTExcel is best for finance, operations and HR staff, small business owners and students who work with spreadsheets but want faster answers. A practical tip: use the cheaper fast model for routine formula requests and save the expert model for messy, multi-sheet analysis, which helps your credits last through the week.

name: Professional-Headshot.ai
tagline: AI headshot generator that turns your selfies into studio-style professional portraits
description: Professional-Headshot.ai turns photos you already have into studio-style headshots across several professional scenes. An AI agent handles styling and picks a recommended result, with unlimited edits on paid passes.
longDescription: Professional-Headshot.ai is an AI headshot generator for LinkedIn profiles, company pages and professional bios. You upload a photo or selfie, optionally add preferences, and an AI agent styles the image, checks the result and selects a polished headshot. A free option produces one watermarked preview without an account. Paid passes are one-time payments rather than subscriptions: they include unlimited generation and edits for seven or thirty days, multiple professional scenes from studio portraits to office and outdoor settings, a recommended headshot plus two alternatives per scene, and downloads without watermarks. The site is available in several languages and accepts common image formats up to 40 MB.
features: Headshots from existing photos or selfies
Unlimited edits during an active pass
cons: Free preview is watermarked
Paid access expires after the pass period
moreContext:
Professional-Headshot.ai keeps the headshot process short. Instead of uploading a large training set and sorting through hundreds of results, you start with photos you already have, and an AI agent does the styling and picks the strongest option for each scene. Paid access is a one-time pass, which suits people who need a new photo occasionally rather than every month.

- Works from a single existing photo or selfie in common formats
- An agent checks results and presents a recommended headshot with two alternatives per scene
- Unlimited generation and edits for seven or thirty days on paid passes
- Scenes range from classic studio portraits to office and outdoor settings
- Free watermarked preview with no sign-up required

Professional-Headshot.ai is best for job seekers, consultants, founders and professionals who want a clean profile photo without booking a studio. A practical tip: try the free preview with your best-lit, front-facing photo first, and if you buy a pass, upload a few varied photos early in the window so you have time to compare scenes and refine your favorite before access ends.

name: Texts from my ex
tagline: A GPT-powered roast of your chat history with a partner or ex
description: Upload a WhatsApp export or use the Mac app for iMessage, and get a playful, shareable report on your relationship with a compatibility score.
longDescription: Texts from my ex is a lighthearted relationship analysis tool from Amori, the team behind an AI dating coach app. You export a WhatsApp conversation without media and upload the ZIP file, or use the Mac app to read an iMessage thread with one contact. A GPT-based model then reads the conversation and returns a report covering attachment styles, communication patterns, intimacy, highlights and lowlights, cute moments and reasons the pairing may not work, along with a compatibility score. The tone is deliberately sassy and meant for sharing with friends. The site states it cannot see or save your chats. It suits curious daters looking back on a past relationship or checking in on a current one.
features: iMessage analysis through a Mac app
pros: No complicated setup for WhatsApp users
States that chats are not viewed or saved
cons: iMessage analysis requires a Mac
Playful tone is not a substitute for real counseling
moreContext:
What makes this tool fun is how it turns an old message thread into something you can laugh about with friends. Instead of a dry sentiment chart, it writes a cheeky report that names patterns in how two people talked to each other, then caps it with a compatibility score. It comes from Amori, a dating coach app that applies the same idea of reading texts to offer relationship feedback.

- Works with an exported WhatsApp chat, so there is nothing to install on a phone
- Offers a Mac app path for people whose conversations live in iMessage
- Covers several angles at once, including attachment style, communication and recurring friction points
- Produces a report designed to be shared, which suits group chats and social posts
- The site says it cannot see or save the conversations you upload

It is best for people who want a light, curious look back at a past relationship or a quick check-in on a current one, without treating the result as serious advice. A practical tip: when exporting from WhatsApp, choose the option without media, since the site notes that uploads containing images will not process correctly, and remember that the other person in the chat has not agreed to the analysis, so keep the shared version tasteful.

name: Recastia
tagline: Turn PDFs into videos, flipbooks, slides, landing pages and chatbots
description: Recastia uses AI to repurpose a single document into a narrated video, page-turning flipbook, browser presentation, landing page, podcast or chatbot you can share by link.
longDescription: Recastia is a document repurposing platform. You upload a PDF or similar file and choose an output: an online flipbook with realistic page turns, a video with an AI-written script, voiceover, captions and an optional avatar presenter, an interactive slide presentation, a responsive landing page, a video podcast, a translated PDF, a virtual exhibition or a chatbot that answers questions about the content. Finished pieces can be hosted, embedded or shared with a link or QR code, and custom domains are supported. The interface is available in many languages. It is aimed at marketers, educators, publishers and sales teams who already have brochures, catalogs, reports or pitch decks and want more engaging formats without rebuilding them from scratch.
features: PDF to narrated video with avatar
Landing pages built from uploaded files
pros: Many output formats from one upload
cons: Free plan carries Recastia branding
Upload page limits vary by plan
moreContext:
Recastia stands out for how much it squeezes out of a single file. Rather than focusing on one format, it treats your document as source material for a whole set of outputs, from a classic flipbook to a narrated explainer video or a chatbot that fields questions about the content. That makes it a practical hub for teams sitting on a library of PDFs that rarely get read.

- Flipbooks keep the original layout while adding a natural page turning experience
- Video output includes an AI-written script, voiceover, synced captions and an optional avatar presenter
- Presentations, landing pages and podcasts can all be generated from the same upload
- PDF translation and a document chatbot extend the reach of existing material
- Results can be hosted, embedded on a site or shared with a link or QR code

It is best for marketers, educators, publishers and sales teams who want to give brochures, catalogs, reports and pitch decks a second life without design or video skills. A practical tip: start on the free plan with one representative document, try two or three output types side by side, and see which one your audience actually engages with before upgrading to remove branding or raise page limits.

name: Tucky
tagline: Mac sticky notes docked to the screen edge with a built-in AI agent
description: Tucky keeps encrypted notes tucked along the edge of your Mac screen and adds an AI assistant you can call from any app to search, write or ask about your notes.
longDescription: Tucky is a native macOS notes app from coconutStudio that docks sticky notes along the edge of the screen. The notes stay out of the way until you reach over, then fan out so you can open one and write in live Markdown with checkbox tasks. Notes are encrypted and stored locally on the Mac. A built-in AI assistant can be summoned with a global shortcut from any app to search, write, rewrite or answer questions across your notes, and paid users can connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Docs, Sheets, GitHub and Notion and use voice dictation. The free tier includes monthly AI credits, and it requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon or Intel.
features: Notes docked to the screen edge
Connectors for Gmail, Calendar, GitHub and Notion
pros: Notes stay encrypted on your device
Free tier includes monthly AI credits
cons: macOS only, version 15 or later
Free tier limited to one default model
moreContext:
Tucky takes a small but clever idea, notes that live on the edge of your screen, and pairs it with an AI assistant that is always one shortcut away. Instead of switching to a separate notes window or chatbot tab, you reach to the side of the display, open a note and ask a question right there. It feels closer to a desk drawer than a full workspace app.

- Notes stay hidden along the screen edge until you need them, keeping the desktop clear
- Content is encrypted and kept in a local file on the Mac
- A global shortcut opens the assistant from any app, and another asks about the current note
- The app asks permission before sending a note's body to the AI, sending only titles by default
- Plus users get voice dictation in many languages and connectors for Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, GitHub and Notion

It is best for Mac users who jot quick notes all day and want light AI help without adopting a heavy knowledge base. A practical tip: sign in even if you only plan to use the free tier, since signing in lifts the cap from five local notes to unlimited notes and adds the monthly AI credit allowance.

name: Verifox
tagline: Email verification and finder with nine checks per address
description: Verifox checks email addresses for syntax, DNS, MX, SMTP, disposable, role, catch-all, domain age and authentication issues, and includes email finding tools, an API and an MCP server.
longDescription: Verifox is an email verification and discovery service for teams that send cold outreach or manage large contact lists. Each address runs through nine checks in parallel, including syntax, DNS and MX records, a live SMTP handshake, disposable and role account detection, catch-all handling with an AI confidence score, domain age and SPF, DKIM and DMARC authentication. Results come back as valid, risky or invalid with a per-check breakdown. You can paste single addresses, upload CSV files, use the real-time and bulk API, embed a form validation widget or connect AI agents through an MCP server. Email finder tools look up addresses from a name and domain or a LinkedIn profile. A free allowance of credits is available at signup.
features: Bulk CSV, API and MCP server
Email finder by name, domain or LinkedIn
cons: Heavy users need paid credits
Catch-all results remain probabilistic
moreContext:
Verifox focuses on a problem many outreach teams quietly struggle with: addresses on catch-all domains that basic verifiers simply label unknown. Its approach is to run a wider set of checks on every address and add an AI confidence pass for those uncertain cases, so you get a more usable verdict instead of a shrug. The site is also unusually candid about the limits of email verification.

- Nine checks run on each address, from syntax and MX records to a live SMTP handshake
- Catch-all addresses receive a confidence score rather than a blanket unknown label
- Domain age and SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks add context about sender quality
- Access options include a web checker, bulk CSV, a REST API, a form widget and an MCP server for AI agents
- Email finder tools cover name plus domain lookups, LinkedIn profiles and whole domains

It is best for sales teams, agencies and marketers who send cold email and want to protect their sender reputation before a campaign goes out. A practical tip: sign up with a work email to claim the larger free allowance the site advertises, then run a sample of your list first to see how many addresses land in the risky bucket before buying credits.

name: Photo2Skin
tagline: AI Minecraft skin generator from photos, images, text or Roblox avatars
description: Photo2Skin creates playable 64x64 Minecraft skins for Java and Bedrock from a selfie, character image, text prompt or Roblox avatar, with a 3D preview and skin editor.
longDescription: Photo2Skin is an AI tool for Minecraft players that generates real, wearable skin files rather than just Minecraft-style pictures. You can start from a photo of yourself, a piece of character art, a text description or screenshots of a Roblox avatar, compare generated variations and preview the result on a rotating 3D model. A built-in editor lets you paint pixels in 2D or directly on the model before downloading a standard 64x64 PNG for Java or Bedrock editions. Extra tools include photo pixelation, a real-world map generator, AI builds, a skin grabber and a community skin library. It runs on the web and as an iPhone and iPad app. It is not an official Minecraft product.
features: Photo, image, text and Roblox to skin
Java and Bedrock ready PNG export
pros: Free editor, library and skin grabber
cons: AI generation requires a subscription
Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft
moreContext:
Photo2Skin solves a specific annoyance for Minecraft fans: many AI tools make pretty pictures of blocky characters, but you cannot actually wear them in the game. This one outputs a proper skin file you can load into Java or Bedrock, and it gives you several ways to get there, from a selfie to a Roblox avatar you want to bring across.

- Four starting points: a photo, a character image, a text prompt or Roblox avatar screenshots
- A rotating 3D preview lets you compare variations before choosing one
- The editor supports painting individual pixels in 2D or on the 3D model
- Extras include pixel art from photos, a real-world map generator and AI-made builds
- The skin library, editor and skin grabber stay free, with credits only needed for AI features

It is best for younger players, parents and content creators who want a personal skin without learning pixel art from scratch. A practical tip: use a clear, well-lit photo with a plain background for the photo-to-skin option, then fine-tune small details like hair color or accessories in the editor rather than spending extra credits on more generations.

name: Tability
tagline: AI-assisted OKR and goal tracking platform for human and agent teams
description: Tability helps teams set, track and report on OKRs with AI goal editing, automated check-ins, strategy maps, dashboards and an MCP server for AI assistants.
longDescription: Tability is a goal management platform built around OKRs. Teams write objectives and key results with AI suggestions that improve wording and structure, then cascade them through a strategy map so every goal connects to company priorities. Regular check-ins, tasks and initiatives keep progress visible, and dashboards and presentation mode make reporting easier, with AI retrospectives summarizing results. Tabby, the built-in assistant, can automate check-ins and send proactive updates, while an MCP server lets people query and manage goals from Claude, ChatGPT and other clients. Integrations cover Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira and Linear, and a mobile app delivers alerts. Plans are priced per user with a 14-day trial, and read-only seats for stakeholders are free.
features: Slack, Teams, Jira and Linear integrations
pros: MCP access from popular AI assistants
cons: Per-user pricing adds up for large teams
No permanent free plan
moreContext:
Tability earns its place by keeping goal tracking focused. Rather than bolting OKRs onto a general project tool, it is built entirely around setting goals, checking in on them and reporting progress, and it uses AI to remove the chores that usually cause OKR programs to fade after the first quarter.

- AI suggestions help teams phrase objectives and key results more clearly
- A strategy map shows how team goals roll up to company priorities
- The Tabby assistant can automate check-ins and send proactive progress reports
- Dashboards, presentation mode and AI retrospectives cut down on manual reporting
- An MCP server lets people work with their goals from Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients

It is best for startups and growing companies that want a lightweight but disciplined way to run OKRs, especially teams already working in Slack, Teams, Jira or Linear. A practical tip: use the 14-day trial to run one real planning cycle with a single team, including at least two weekly check-ins, so you can judge whether the automated updates actually save time before rolling it out more widely.

name: Smacient Claude Connector
tagline: Pull live social, ads, search and app store data straight into Claude
description: Smacient connects Claude to live marketing data from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Maps, Amazon, app stores, ad libraries, Google Analytics and Search Console.
longDescription: Smacient's Claude connector gives Claude live access to marketing data so you can ask questions in plain English instead of exporting spreadsheets. After connecting it from Claude's connector directory, or adding the MCP URL in Claude Code, you can request things like recent posts from a public Instagram profile, top YouTube videos for a channel, LinkedIn company details, Google Maps reviews, Amazon or app store listings, competitor ads from the Meta and Google ad libraries, keyword planner data, or your own Google Analytics 4 and Search Console figures. Claude then fetches the data and analyzes it in the same conversation. Usage is billed with credits, with a monthly free allowance and paid credit packs that never expire.
features: Live social profile and post data
Meta and Google ad library lookups
Google Analytics 4 and Search Console access
Works in Claude.ai, Desktop and Claude Code
pros: Monthly free credits and non-expiring packs
cons: Only useful inside Claude
Heavy research consumes credits quickly
moreContext:
This connector shines because it removes the most tedious part of AI-assisted marketing analysis: gathering the data. Instead of pulling numbers from a dozen platforms into sheets and pasting them into a chat, you ask Claude directly and it retrieves fresh data before analyzing it. For marketers who already rely on Claude, that turns a half-day research task into a single conversation.

- Covers public social data from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn
- Pulls reviews and listings from Google Maps, Amazon, Google Play and the App Store
- Looks up competitor creatives in the Meta and Google ad libraries
- Connects your own Google Analytics 4 and Search Console data, plus keyword planner figures
- Listed in Claude's connector directory, with an MCP URL option for Claude Code

It is best for marketers, agencies and founders who use Claude for competitive research, content planning or campaign reviews and want live inputs instead of stale exports. A practical tip: start with the free monthly credits on one focused question, such as comparing engagement on a competitor's last 20 posts, and note how many credits it uses so you can estimate whether a paid pack makes sense.

name: Letomix Background Remover
tagline: Free in-browser background remover with no account or watermark
description: Letomix Background Remover separates the subject of a JPG, PNG or WebP image right in your browser and exports a transparent or colored PNG for free.
longDescription: Letomix Background Remover is a free web tool that cuts the subject out of a photo using a neural network model that runs in your browser. You upload a JPG, PNG or WebP file up to 12 MB, start processing, then choose a transparent result or a white, soft blue or custom colored background before downloading a PNG. There is no account, trial or watermark. According to the site, the image is processed on your device and is not sent to a Letomix server, although the browser downloads the model and code from external providers on first use, which can make the first run slower. It works best for product shots, avatars and simple social graphics with one clear subject.
features: JPG, PNG and WebP up to 12 MB
pros: Image stays on your device per the site
cons: First run is slower while the model loads
Hair, glass and low contrast may need touch-ups
moreContext:
What sets this tool apart is its privacy-minded design. Many free background removers upload your photo to a server, but Letomix runs the model inside your browser, and the site explains plainly what does and does not travel over the network. Combined with no account, no trial and no watermark, it is a refreshingly simple option for quick cutouts.

- Processing starts on your own device, and the site says the image is not sent to its server
- Exports a transparent PNG or adds a white, soft blue or custom background color
- Accepts JPG, PNG and WebP files up to 12 MB
- No signup, payment card or watermark on downloads
- Clear guidance on which photos work best and where manual touch-ups may be needed

It is best for small shop owners, students and anyone who needs a clean product photo or profile picture without paying for a design app. A practical tip: pick a photo with one obvious subject and a background that contrasts with it, and be patient on the first run while the model downloads, since later images process faster. The site also asks that you only edit images you have the right to use.

name: Vero
tagline: AI medical scribe with cited clinical answers, forms and coding
description: Vero drafts clinical notes from recorded, typed or uploaded visits and adds cited evidence answers, PDF form filling and ICD-10 coding in one workspace for clinicians.
longDescription: Vero is a clinical documentation platform built for doctors and other clinicians. Vero Scribe turns a recorded, typed or uploaded patient visit into a note that follows your own template and learns your style, with support for more than 60 languages and a telehealth mode for video calls. Vero Chat answers questions about the chart, Vero Evidence returns clinical answers linked to guidelines and studies with graded levels of evidence, and Vero Documents fills PDF forms, referral letters and sick notes from the visit. Newer modules cover coding and billing, including ICD-10 suggestions. The company is Canadian and reports SOC 2 Type II and PIPEDA compliance. Apps are available on desktop, iOS and Android.
features: AI visit notes from your templates
pros: Many tools in one clinical workspace
Free plan for trying real visits
cons: Free plan capped at 10 actions a month
Pro pricing aimed at practicing clinicians
moreContext:
Vero stands out by bundling several clinical chores into a single workspace instead of offering a scribe alone. The same visit that produces a note can also feed a referral letter, a filled PDF form and suggested codes, while an evidence tool answers clinical questions with sources attached. For busy clinicians, fewer tabs and less copying between systems is the real draw.

- Scribe drafts notes from recorded, typed or uploaded visits using your own templates
- Evidence answers link to guidelines or studies and grade the strength of the evidence
- Documents fills uploaded PDF forms plus referral letters and sick notes from the visit
- Coding and billing modules suggest ICD-10 codes alongside the note
- The company reports SOC 2 Type II and PIPEDA compliance and offers desktop, iOS and Android apps

It is best for family physicians, specialists and clinic teams, particularly in Canada, who want documentation, evidence lookup and paperwork in one place. A practical tip: set up your preferred note template before your first recorded visit and use the 10 free monthly actions on varied visit types, so you can judge how well the output matches your style before moving to the Pro plan.

name: Google Flight Deals
tagline: Describe your ideal trip in plain language and Google Flights finds deals
description: Flight Deals is an AI search mode inside Google Flights that turns plain-language trip descriptions into ranked flight bargains for flexible travelers.
longDescription: Google Flight Deals is an AI-powered search experience within Google Flights aimed at travelers who care more about saving money than about fixed dates or destinations. Instead of filling in airports and dates, you describe a trip in natural language, such as a week somewhere warm this winter with nonstop flights, and the tool searches Google Flights inventory to suggest matching destinations and fares. Results are ranked by how much you save compared with typical prices, and it can surface places you had not considered. Google says it runs on a custom version of Gemini. It launched in 2025 as a beta and has since expanded to many more countries and languages.
features: Built on Google Flights fare data
pros: Free with no extra signup beyond Google
Draws on a very large fare inventory
cons: Less useful when dates are fixed
Some niche prompts return thin results
moreContext:
Flight Deals is a nice example of AI making an existing tool friendlier rather than replacing it. Google Flights has long been strong for comparing fares, but it expects you to know where and when you want to go. This mode flips that around, letting you describe the kind of trip you want and letting the search do the brainstorming.

- Accepts conversational requests that mix timing, trip length, interests and flight preferences
- Ranks results by percentage saved, putting the strongest bargains first
- Suggests destinations you might not have searched for on your own
- Uses the same fare data that powers regular Google Flights
- Free to use and available in many countries and languages, according to Google

It is best for flexible travelers, students and weekend adventurers whose main goal is a good price rather than a specific city or date. A practical tip: include the things that matter most, such as nonstop only, a maximum trip length or a month, in your description, and once you find a promising fare, switch to the regular Google Flights view to set a price alert before booking.

name: Intuit Assist
tagline: Generative AI financial assistant built into TurboTax, QuickBooks and more
description: Intuit Assist brings generative AI recommendations and automation into TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks and Mailchimp for consumers and small businesses.
longDescription: Intuit Assist is the generative AI assistant Intuit has woven into its main products rather than a standalone app. In TurboTax it helps filers move through their return, for example by building a personalized checklist and supporting live tax experts. In Credit Karma it offers personalized guidance based on a member's own financial data. In QuickBooks it surfaces business insights, such as cash flow ideas, and handles routine bookkeeping work, while in Mailchimp it helps create and target email campaigns. Intuit introduced it in 2023, built on its in-house generative AI platform. Access depends on which Intuit product and plan you use, so there is no separate price for the assistant itself.
features: Personalized tax filing guidance in TurboTax
Business insights and automation in QuickBooks
Personal finance guidance in Credit Karma
pros: Works inside tools many people already use
Uses your own financial data for context
No separate subscription for the assistant
cons: Features vary by product and plan
Not available as a standalone assistant
moreContext:
Intuit Assist is notable because it lives where people already handle their money. Rather than asking users to copy financial details into a general chatbot, Intuit built the assistant into TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks and Mailchimp, so it can draw on the data those products already hold and act within them.

- In TurboTax it guides filers through their return and supports human tax experts
- In QuickBooks it highlights business insights and takes on routine bookkeeping tasks
- In Credit Karma it offers guidance based on a member's own financial picture
- In Mailchimp it helps draft and target email marketing campaigns
- It runs on Intuit's in-house generative AI platform, introduced in 2023

It is best for individuals and small business owners who already use Intuit products and want AI help without adding another app to their stack. A practical tip: treat the assistant's suggestions as a starting point, especially for taxes and accounting, and review the underlying numbers or ask a qualified professional before acting on anything with legal or financial consequences.

name: ImageTranslate.AI
tagline: Translate the text inside images while keeping the original layout
description: ImageTranslate.AI detects and translates text in images across 130+ languages, rebuilding the picture with the original layout for manga, product photos, menus and screenshots.
longDescription: ImageTranslate.AI is a web tool that translates text embedded in images. You upload a JPG, PNG or WebP file, pick a target language from more than 130 options and get back a new image with the translated text placed where the original was, preserving layout and style. Dedicated modes target manga and comics, e-commerce product images, light novels, menus, documents and screenshots, and paid plans add batch translation, custom prompts and a translation editor. You can choose among several underlying AI models. Extra tools include OCR, an image to text converter and a text remover, plus a Chrome extension and API access. A free tier provides daily credits, with paid plans for heavier or commercial use.
cons: Free tier limited to personal use
Advanced modes require a paid plan
moreContext:
ImageTranslate.AI tackles a job ordinary translators cannot: text that is baked into a picture. Instead of handing you a block of translated words, it rebuilds the image so the new language sits in the same spot as the original, which matters a lot for comics, product listings and menus where layout carries meaning.

- Supports more than 130 languages, including major Asian and European languages
- Specialized modes for manga, e-commerce images, light novels, menus and screenshots
- Lets you pick between several underlying AI models for translation
- Paid plans add batch processing, custom prompts and an editor for fine-tuning results
- Includes OCR, an image to text converter, a text remover, a Chrome extension and an API

It is best for online sellers localizing product images, manga readers and translators, and travelers or researchers dealing with screenshots and documents in unfamiliar languages. A practical tip: run a test image on the free daily credits first and check names, prices and small print carefully, then use the editor on a paid plan to correct terms that need a specific translation for your market.

name: Framer AI
tagline: AI agent that designs, builds and edits Framer websites with you
description: Framer AI creates editable pages, sections, copy and visuals from a prompt inside Framer, so you can keep refining in chat or take over on the visual canvas.
longDescription: Framer AI is the set of AI features inside Framer, the visual website builder. You describe a site, page or change you need, and Framer's AI agent generates editable pages, sections, copy and visuals directly in your project. You can keep refining through conversation, for instance asking it to restyle a hero section or swap an image, or switch to the canvas at any point to adjust layout and design by hand. Sites publish on Framer's hosting with options like a custom domain, CMS and localization, and an MCP server is available. A free plan includes AI credits for trying it out, and paid site plans add more monthly credits, bandwidth and custom domains.
features: Hosting with custom domains and CMS
cons: AI credits are capped per plan
Advanced sites can get pricey
moreContext:
The appeal here is that it does not trap you in a black box. The agent can draft a whole site or a single section from a prompt, but everything it creates lands as normal, editable Framer layers, so designers can take over on the canvas whenever the result needs a human touch. That balance between speed and control is the main reason it suits design-minded teams.

- Generates pages, sections, copy and visuals directly inside your Framer project
- Takes follow-up instructions in conversation, such as layout changes or image swaps
- Keeps the full visual canvas available for precise manual adjustments
- Publishes to Framer hosting with options for custom domains, CMS and localization
- Offers an MCP server for working with projects from other AI tools

It is best for designers, startups and marketers who want a good-looking marketing site or landing page quickly without handing over creative control. A practical tip: give the agent a specific brief that includes your audience, tone and the sections you need, then use the canvas for final spacing and typography tweaks rather than spending AI credits on small visual details.

name: Any Video Converter
tagline: Long-running video converter suite with built-in AI creation and enhancement
description: Any Video Converter converts, compresses, edits and downloads video and audio, and now adds AI image and video generation, enhancement, transcription and vocal removal.
longDescription: Any Video Converter is a desktop media toolkit for Windows and Mac from Anvsoft, first released in 2003. Its core is fast format conversion across a long list of video and audio types, along with compression, trimming, merging, subtitles, DVD and CD ripping and video downloading. Recent versions add AI features such as text to image, text and image to video with support for models like Seedance, video and photo enhancement, background and object removal, speech to text and vocal removal. A free edition covers basic conversion and editing, while Pro and Ultimate editions add advanced tools and AI capabilities. Companion AVCLabs products handle dedicated AI video and photo enhancement.
features: AI text and image to video
Speech to text and vocal remover
pros: Many tools in one desktop app
cons: Best AI features sit in paid editions
Windows and Mac only
moreContext:
Any Video Converter shows how a veteran utility can grow into the AI era without losing its roots. It began in 2003 as a simple, free converter, and it still handles that job well, but recent releases have layered in AI generation and enhancement so users can create and polish media in the same place they convert it.

- Converts between a very long list of video and audio formats with batch processing
- Adds compression, trimming, merging, subtitles, DVD ripping and video downloading
- Includes AI text to image and video generation, with support for models such as Seedance
- Offers AI enhancement, background removal, object removal and photo restoration tools
- Provides speech to text transcription and vocal removal for audio work

It is best for home users, hobby creators and small teams who want one desktop app for everyday media chores plus some AI extras, rather than juggling separate converters and editors. A practical tip: start with the free edition to confirm it handles your formats, then compare the Pro and Ultimate editions on the official comparison table, since many AI tools are only included in the higher tier.

name: Grok Build
tagline: Grok's terminal coding agent with plan mode, subagents and headless runs
description: Grok Build is the Grok team's agentic coding tool for the terminal, offering an interactive TUI, headless scripting, subagents, plan mode and support for AGENTS.md, MCP and custom models.
longDescription: Grok Build is a coding agent from the company behind Grok, launched in 2026. You install it with a single command on macOS, Linux, WSL or Windows, open a project and describe tasks in plain language; the agent reads the codebase, finds the right files and makes changes. It runs as a full-screen, mouse-friendly terminal interface, headlessly in scripts and CI, or inside other apps through the Agent Client Protocol. Features include plan mode for reviewing steps before code changes, parallel subagents with worktree isolation, sandboxing and permissions, hooks, skills, plugins, MCP servers and AGENTS.md support. It defaults to Grok models but accepts custom models. Access comes with a SuperGrok subscription or an API key.
features: Interactive terminal UI and headless mode
MCP, hooks, skills and AGENTS.md support
pros: Flexible TUI, headless and ACP modes
cons: Requires a paid SuperGrok plan or API usage
Newer tool still evolving quickly
moreContext:
Grok Build brings the Grok models into the terminal as a full coding agent rather than a chat window. It follows the pattern developers already know from other agentic CLIs, so teams can point it at a repository, describe what they want and review the plan before anything changes, while still having escape hatches for automation and custom setups.

- Plan mode lays out the steps for review before code is edited
- Parallel subagents can split work, using git worktrees to stay out of each other's way
- Headless mode with streaming JSON output fits scripts, bots and CI pipelines
- Supports MCP servers, hooks, skills, plugins and existing AGENTS.md files
- A config file lets you swap in custom models from other providers

It is best for developers already paying for SuperGrok, or teams using the xAI API, who want an agentic coding workflow comparable to other terminal agents. A practical tip: after installing, run grok inspect inside your project to see which instructions, skills, hooks and MCP servers it picked up, and start with a read-only prompt such as asking it to explain the repository before letting it make edits.

name: Tracetify
tagline: Trace how competitors got started with timelines built from 12 sources
description: Tracetify reconstructs a competitor's origin story, from first mentions to launch milestones, and adds SEO tools, competitor monitoring, AI visibility checks and an MCP server.
longDescription: Tracetify is a competitor research tool that focuses on history rather than just current rankings. Paste a company URL and it gathers data from 12 sources in under a minute to build a timeline of first mentions, launches, press coverage and other milestones, then offers a verdict on which moves you could still copy. Around that core it offers SEO tools including keyword difficulty, competitor finder, backlink lookups, site audits and Meta and Google ad timelines, plus daily sitemap monitoring, an AI visibility checker and an SEO agent that can query your Search Console in plain English. Tools also work from Claude Code, Cursor and Codex through MCP, and pricing is credit based.
features: Search Console SEO agent and MCP access
cons: Full analyses consume credits
Best suited to web-based businesses
moreContext:
Tracetify asks a question most SEO tools skip: not where a competitor ranks today, but how it got there. By stitching together early mentions, launches and coverage into a timeline, it helps founders and marketers see the sequence of moves behind a rival's growth, which is often more useful than a snapshot of current traffic.

- Builds a sourced timeline for a competitor from 12 data sources in under a minute
- Each number in a report links back to where it came from
- Daily sitemap diffs flag new competitor pages and email you when changes matter
- Includes keyword difficulty, competitor finder, backlinks, site audits and ad timelines
- Works from the website or inside Claude Code, Cursor and Codex through MCP

It is best for indie founders, growth marketers and agencies studying how comparable products found their first customers and traffic. A practical tip: browse the free public reports first to get a feel for the output, then spend credits on a full trace of the one or two competitors closest to your positioning, and connect Search Console, which the site says costs nothing.

name: Qwen3-Coder
tagline: Open-weight coding models from the Qwen team built for agentic software work
description: Qwen3-Coder is a family of open-weight code models from Alibaba's Qwen team, tuned for tool calling, long repositories and use inside coding agents.
longDescription: Qwen3-Coder is a series of large language models from Alibaba's Qwen team that focus on programming. The lineup includes a large 480B mixture-of-experts model, a lighter 30B variant and the newer Qwen3-Coder-Next, with weights published on Hugging Face and ModelScope. The models handle a native context of 256K tokens, which the team says can be stretched toward 1M, and they were trained with reinforcement learning on real execution tasks. Developers can run them locally, call them through hosted APIs, chat with them on Qwen Chat, or plug them into agents such as Qwen Code, Cline and Claude Code using the documented function call format.
cons: Large variants need serious GPU hardware
Setup takes technical know-how
moreContext:
What sets Qwen3-Coder apart is that a top tier coding model is available as downloadable weights rather than only through a paid API. The Qwen team trained it around agent behavior, so it is meant to plan, call tools and work through multi-step tasks instead of simply finishing a line of code. That focus shows in the documentation, which explains how to wire it into existing agent tools.

- Several sizes, from a laptop friendly 30B mixture-of-experts model to the much larger 480B flagship
- A 256K token native context that helps when an agent needs to read many files at once
- Compatibility with agent frontends such as Qwen Code, Cline and Claude Code
- Fill-in-the-middle support for classic editor autocomplete
- Quantized FP8 and GGUF builds that make local experiments more practical

Qwen3-Coder is best for developers and teams who want a capable coding model they can host themselves, fine tune, or route through their own infrastructure for privacy or cost reasons. It also suits tinkerers comparing open models against commercial assistants. A practical tip: start with the smaller 30B variant or the Next model through a local runner to judge quality on your own codebase, then move to the larger model only if your tasks clearly need it.

name: Atomic Bot
