tagline: Run open-source AI agents like OpenClaw and Hermes in the cloud or on your Mac
description: Atomic Bot hosts open-source agents such as OpenClaw, Hermes and Codex so they can run around the clock, with a free open-source app and paid cloud plans.
longDescription: Atomic Bot is a launcher and hosting service for open-source AI agents. Instead of installing agents like OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex, OpenCode or NanoClaw from the terminal, users pick one in the Atomic Bot app or web dashboard and start it locally on macOS or in the company's cloud, where it can keep working 24/7. Agents can switch between more than 100 models from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek and Qwen, and connect to apps like Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub and Telegram. The app itself is open source and free, while cloud plans bundle hosting and a monthly AI usage allowance.
cons: Desktop app is macOS only for now
Cloud usage allowance is modest on lower plans
moreContext:
Open-source agents have become powerful, but getting one running usually means a terminal, API keys and some patience. Atomic Bot removes most of that friction by turning agent setup into a menu choice. You pick an agent, pick a model and decide whether it runs on your own machine or on hosted infrastructure that stays online when your laptop sleeps.

- Support for a growing list of agents, including OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex, OpenCode and NanoClaw
- Model switching across providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek and Qwen, with the option to add your own API key
- Integrations with everyday tools such as Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Telegram and Google Calendar
- A skills marketplace plus MCP server support for extending what an agent can do
- A choice between local runs for privacy and cloud runs for always-on tasks

Atomic Bot is best for curious professionals and small teams who want to try personal agents for inbox triage, scheduling or research without becoming system administrators. Developers will also appreciate being able to compare agent frameworks side by side. A practical tip: begin with the free local app and your own API key to see which agent fits your workflow, then consider a cloud plan once you have a task that truly benefits from running around the clock.

name: SeeleAgent
tagline: Prompt-to-game agent for building playable 2D and 3D games, assets and trailers
description: SeeleAgent from Seele AI turns text or images into playable browser games and generates 3D models, sprites, worldbuilding and trailers in one workspace.
longDescription: SeeleAgent is a cloud workspace from Seele AI that builds games from a conversation. Users describe a game or upload an image, and the agent produces a playable 2D or browser-based 3D build in genres like RPG, platformer, puzzle, simulation and strategy. Beyond full games, the platform generates 3D models with textures and rigs, sprites and icons, lore and maps, visual novels and short trailers, and it offers a code editor for refining logic. Projects can be exported for further work, including Unity export on paid plans. A free tier provides credits to build and share, while Pro plans add faster generation, advanced models and commercial rights.
features: Text or image to playable game
pros: Covers many genres and asset types
cons: Commercial use requires a Pro plan
Pricing details are not clearly published
moreContext:
Game creation usually involves separate tools for code, art, 3D and video, and SeeleAgent tries to put all of them behind a single chat window. The breadth is what stands out: the same workspace can draft a playable prototype, produce rigged 3D models, write branching dialogue and cut a trailer for the finished result. The team behind it is based in Shenzhen and Hangzhou and is led by a founder who previously built NetEase Cloud Music.

- Playable first builds from a short prompt or a reference image, viewable right in the browser
- 3D asset generation with textures, materials, rigs and animations in common formats like FBX, GLTF and OBJ
- Dedicated helpers for RPG systems, visual novels, worldbuilding and multiplayer setups
- A built-in code editor for adjusting game logic after the agent's first pass
- A community space where creators share and play each other's projects

SeeleAgent is best for indie developers, educators and hobbyists who want to test game ideas quickly, as well as artists who need placeholder or production assets without a full pipeline. A practical tip: treat the first build as a prototype, then iterate with specific requests about mechanics or art style, and check licensing and asset quality before you publish anything commercially.

name: AI Room Makeover
tagline: Upload a room photo and preview a specific makeover before changing anything
description: AI Room Makeover edits a photo of your actual room based on a written request, letting you test furniture, colors, layouts and decor before you buy or move anything.
longDescription: AI Room Makeover is a web tool for previewing interior changes on a photo of a real space. Users upload a picture of a room, optionally add up to nine reference images of products, materials or colors, and describe the change they want, such as swapping a sofa, repainting cabinets or rearranging existing furniture. The tool generates an edited image that keeps the rest of the room as close to the original as possible, using GPT Image 2. There are focused modes for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, home offices and landscapes. A no-login trial shows a first result, and further images are bought as one-time credit packs that never expire.
features: Edits based on your own room photo
Up to nine reference images per request
Style presets like Scandinavian and Art Deco
cons: Pack prices are not shown before checkout
Results are visual previews, not floor plans
moreContext:
Many AI interior tools reimagine a room from scratch, which is fun but not always useful when you only want to see one change. AI Room Makeover leans the other way: you describe a single, specific edit and it tries to leave everything else alone. That makes it a practical way to answer questions like whether a green velvet sofa will work with your floor or whether moving the desk opens up space.

- Prompt-driven edits on a real photo, from paint colors to individual furniture swaps
- Reference image uploads so you can show the exact rug, material or product you are considering
- Layout mode that rearranges only the furniture you already own
- Room-specific tools for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, offices and outdoor spaces
- Pay-as-you-go credit packs with no recurring charge and a refund window for unused packs

AI Room Makeover is best for homeowners, renters and small design studios who want to test ideas before spending money or moving heavy furniture. A practical tip: shoot your photo in daylight from a corner so most of the room is visible, and describe one change at a time; small, precise requests tend to produce cleaner results than long lists of edits.

name: ProductShot AI
tagline: Turn one product photo into listing images, studio shots and ad creative
description: ProductShot AI generates white background photos, marketplace listing images, lifestyle scenes, on-model apparel shots and ad visuals from a single product upload.
longDescription: ProductShot AI is an image generator built for online sellers. After uploading a product photo, users can create clean white background images, centered marketplace listings, studio style shots, lifestyle scenes and campaign creative for ads and social posts. An apparel studio turns flat lay or hanger photos into on-model images and supports virtual try-on, and extra tools cover shadows, relighting, mockups, in-hand shots, food and skincare photography. Utility tools for background removal, enhancement and compression round out the set. New accounts start with free credits, and subscription plans or credit packs add more monthly generations and higher queue priority.
pros: Handles apparel as well as hard goods
cons: Aggressive countdown sales on pricing page
Credit costs vary by tool
moreContext:
Product photography is a recurring cost for small online stores, and ProductShot AI aims to cover most of those image needs from one upload. Its strength is variety: rather than a single background swap, it offers dedicated workflows for marketplace listings, apparel on models, lifestyle placements and ad banners, which saves sellers from stitching together several apps.

- Marketplace ready images with clean, centered compositions for stores like Amazon, Etsy or Shopify
- An apparel studio that turns flat lay or hanger photos into on-model shots, plus virtual try-on
- Niche generators for food, skincare, in-hand and mockup photography
- Relighting and shadow tools that help a cutout product look naturally placed
- Basic utilities such as background removal, enhancement and compression in the same account

ProductShot AI is best for independent sellers, dropshippers and small marketing teams who need a steady flow of listing and campaign images without booking a studio. A practical tip: start from the sharpest, evenly lit product photo you have, since every generated scene inherits its detail, and review labels and logos closely before publishing because small text is where AI edits most often slip.

name: Kaggle
tagline: Google's data science community with datasets, notebooks, models and competitions
description: Kaggle is Google's platform for machine learning practice, offering free cloud notebooks with GPUs, a huge library of datasets and models, competitions and AI benchmarks.
longDescription: Kaggle is an online community and workspace for data science and machine learning, owned by Google. Members can browse and publish datasets, run code in hosted Jupyter style notebooks with free GPU and TPU quotas, and download pretrained models from a shared registry that includes releases from Google and other labs. The platform is known for competitions in which companies and researchers post problems with prize pools, and it now also hosts AI model benchmarks and community leaderboards. Free courses cover Python, pandas, machine learning and deep learning. Core features cost nothing, with optional Google Cloud integration billed separately.
features: Hosted notebooks with free GPU and TPU
pros: Free compute for learning and prototyping
cons: Weekly accelerator quotas limit big training runs
Competition leaderboards can be intensely competitive
moreContext:
Few places let you go from finding a dataset to training a model on a GPU without paying anything, and Kaggle has offered exactly that for years. Its real value is the community: thousands of public notebooks show how other people approached the same data, which turns the site into a practical classroom as much as a tool. Under Google's ownership it has also become a venue for evaluating AI models through public benchmarks.

- Cloud notebooks with popular libraries preinstalled and free weekly GPU and TPU time
- A searchable library of public datasets that anyone can version and share
- A model hub with ready to use weights from major labs, including Google's Gemma family
- Competitions with prize pools that mirror real industry problems
- Free micro courses on Python, data cleaning, machine learning and more

Kaggle is best for students, aspiring data scientists and practitioners who want real data and free compute for learning, prototyping or building a portfolio. Experienced researchers also use it to benchmark ideas against strong peers. A practical tip: before starting a competition or project, read the top public notebooks and discussion threads, since they often reveal data quirks and baseline approaches that save days of work.

name: Guidde
tagline: Record a workflow once and get an AI-narrated how-to video with step guides
description: Guidde captures your clicks in a browser extension and turns them into step-by-step video guides with AI voiceover, captions and branding for training and support.
longDescription: Guidde is a documentation tool that converts screen workflows into how-to videos. Users install the browser extension, click through a process in any web app, and Guidde generates a video walkthrough with highlighted steps, written descriptions and an AI voiceover in a choice of voices and languages. Guides can be edited, branded, shared by link, embedded in help centers or exported as video, PDF or slides. Teams use it for employee onboarding, software training, customer support articles and internal process documentation. A free plan covers a limited number of videos, while Pro and Business plans add unlimited guides, brand kits, exports and team features.
features: Export to video, PDF or slides
Brand kits and sensitive info blur
pros: Creates guides far faster than manual editing
cons: Free plan limits the number of videos
Paid plans are billed per creator
moreContext:
Writing documentation is one of those tasks everyone postpones, and Guidde's appeal is that it turns doing the task into documenting it. You simply perform the workflow while the extension records, and the result is a narrated, step-by-step video with text that would have taken much longer to produce by hand. That makes it easier to keep help content current when software changes.

- Automatic capture of clicks and screens into ordered steps with highlights
- AI generated voiceover and descriptions that can be edited before sharing
- Multiple output formats, including shareable links, embeds, video files, PDFs and slide decks
- Branding controls and the ability to blur sensitive information in recordings
- Team review and version control for organizations maintaining large guide libraries

Guidde is best for customer success, IT, HR and operations teams who repeatedly explain the same software processes to new hires or customers. Solo consultants and educators can also use it to create quick tutorials. A practical tip: rehearse the workflow once before recording and close unrelated tabs, because a clean, deliberate run produces tighter steps and needs far less editing afterward.

name: NoteGPT
tagline: AI workspace for summarizing videos and PDFs, taking notes and generating slides
description: NoteGPT summarizes YouTube videos, audio and documents, transcribes recordings, and can produce notes, mind maps, slides, images and podcasts through an AI agent.
longDescription: NoteGPT is a web based AI workspace that started with YouTube video summaries and has grown into a broad study and work assistant. Users can paste a video link, upload audio, video or PDFs, and get transcripts, summaries, mind maps and translations, then chat with the content to ask follow-up questions. An AI agent can also draft documents, build slide decks and spreadsheets, run deep research, and generate images, videos and text-to-speech audio. A browser extension brings summaries to YouTube and other sites. The free plan offers a small monthly quota, and paid plans add unlimited basic tasks plus premium credits.
features: AI slides, docs and research agent
cons: Free quota runs out quickly
Feature set can feel crowded
moreContext:
What makes NoteGPT useful is how quickly it turns long media into something you can skim. Paste a lecture or interview link and you get a transcript, a structured summary and a mind map in one place, with the option to keep asking questions. The company says its user base numbers in the tens of millions, and the product has steadily added creation tools on top of its summarizing roots.

- Summaries and transcripts for YouTube, local audio and video files, and PDFs
- Chat with any processed source to pull out quotes, definitions or explanations
- Mind map and translation outputs that help with revision and multilingual study
- An agent that drafts slides, documents, spreadsheets and research reports
- A browser extension that adds summaries directly on YouTube pages

NoteGPT is best for students, educators and knowledge workers who consume a lot of video and long documents and want quick study notes or briefing material. A practical tip: use the free quota to test summary quality on a few videos from your own field before upgrading, and always check key facts against the transcript, since summaries can compress nuance.

name: Adobe Express Logo Maker
tagline: Generate logo ideas from a prompt and refine them in the Adobe Express editor
description: Adobe Express Logo Maker creates logo concepts from a text description or step-by-step choices, then lets you customize fonts, colors and icons in the free Express editor.
longDescription: Adobe Express Logo Maker is part of Adobe's browser and mobile design app. Users can describe the logo they want, such as a monogram or a handwritten wordmark, choose a style and optionally upload reference images, and the generator returns several concepts powered by Adobe's Firefly models using generative credits. A separate guided mode builds logo ideas from a business name and a few preferences without a prompt. Any result opens in the Adobe Express editor, where text, colors, icons and layout can be adjusted and exported. Basic use is free, and a Premium plan adds more generative credits, brand kits and premium assets.
cons: Generative credits are limited on free plan
Prompted results may need manual cleanup
moreContext:
Most AI logo generators stop at a handful of image files, while Adobe's version drops every concept straight into a full design editor. That matters because a logo rarely comes out perfect on the first try, and being able to tweak spacing, swap a font or recolor an icon in the same place saves a lot of back and forth. It also benefits from Adobe's Firefly models, which the company trains with commercial use in mind.

- Two ways to start: a free-form text prompt or a guided, step-by-step builder
- Optional reference image uploads to steer the visual direction
- Editing tools for typography, color, layout and icons inside Adobe Express
- Easy reuse of the finished logo across social posts, flyers and other Express templates
- Availability in the browser and on mobile devices

Adobe Express Logo Maker is best for freelancers, side projects and small businesses that need a clean mark quickly and want to keep designing related materials in one app. A practical tip: generate several rounds with short, concrete prompts that name the style and one key symbol, then simplify the chosen design in the editor so it still reads clearly at small sizes like a favicon or profile picture.

name: AI Fruit Video
tagline: Create short talking fruit videos, dramas and comedy clips from a story prompt
description: AI Fruit Video generates short vertical clips starring animated fruit characters, with story templates for dramas, roasts and news parodies and a choice of video models.
longDescription: AI Fruit Video is a web studio for making the talking fruit clips that circulate on short video platforms. Users type a story or pick an idea such as a breakup drama, motivational speech or fruit roast, optionally upload reference images or first and last frames, and choose a video model, duration, aspect ratio and resolution. The site routes generation through third party models, including Seedance and Grok Imagine Video, and a story workshop prepares prompts for planning multi-clip series in an outside chatbot. Generation always uses credits, which come from monthly subscriptions or one-time packs, and paid outputs are watermark-free for personal and commercial use.
features: Story prompt to fruit character video
pros: Focused templates for a popular trend
cons: No free generations
Clips are short and need stitching for longer stories
moreContext:
Anthropomorphic fruit dramas have become a recognizable short video genre, and AI Fruit Video is built entirely around making them. Instead of writing detailed prompts for a general video model, you start from story types like jealousy drama, news report or singing performance, and the site handles the character style. Its story workshop also helps plan a recurring cast, which is useful for creators building a series.

- Ready made story ideas that match common fruit video formats
- Access to several third party video models with different credit costs
- First frame, last frame and reference image uploads for more consistent characters
- Vertical 9:16 output suited to TikTok, Reels and Shorts
- Watermark-free paid generations with personal and commercial use allowed

AI Fruit Video is best for social media creators and small brands who want quick, playful clips that ride a specific trend without learning a full video editor. A practical tip: write a short character guide for each recurring fruit and reuse the same reference image across clips, which helps keep faces and colors consistent when you stitch several five second scenes into a longer episode.

name: Pokecut
tagline: Online AI photo editor for backgrounds, enhancement, portraits and image generation
description: Pokecut bundles AI background removal, photo enhancement, object replacement, ID photos, portrait retouching and image generation into one browser-based editor.
longDescription: Pokecut is an all-in-one AI photo editor that runs in the browser. Its toolset covers background removal and replacement, magic eraser, image extension, photo enhancement and text sharpening, batch editing, collage making and ID photo creation. Portrait and body tools handle makeup, skin, hair color and styling, while creative filters add looks like lofi or digicam effects. An image generator and image to image mode tap models such as Nano Banana and ChatGPT Image. Many basic tools can be used for free with limited credits, and SE, Pro and Ultra plans add monthly credits, HD downloads, no watermark and batch processing.
pros: Large catalog of tools in one place
cons: Best models and HD export need credits
Exact plan prices only appear at checkout
moreContext:
Pokecut stands out for sheer breadth. Rather than specializing in one edit, it gathers dozens of quick fixes and creative effects behind a single account, so you can remove a background, enhance a blurry shot and generate a new scene without switching apps. Access to newer generation models inside the same editor adds flexibility for creative work.

- Everyday cleanup tools such as background removal, magic eraser and image extension
- Enhancement options for sharpening faces, restoring old photos and clarifying text in images
- Batch editing for processing product or event photos in one pass
- Portrait, hair and body editing tools for social media and profile photos
- An ID photo maker and collage tool for practical, non-creative tasks

Pokecut is best for casual creators, social media users and small online sellers who need fast, varied photo edits rather than a professional desktop editor. A practical tip: try the free version of the specific tool you need before choosing a plan, since some tools consume credits at different rates, and use batch mode when editing many similar product shots to save time.

name: YuE2
tagline: Open-weight song generator that plans an editable score before rendering audio
description: YuE2 from the m-a-p research community turns lyrics and a style prompt into full stereo songs, writing an editable symbolic score first so melody and chords can be changed.
longDescription: YuE2 is an open-weight music generation model released by the Multimodal Art Projection (m-a-p) community in September 2026. Given lyrics and a style description, it first drafts a symbolic composition with melody, chords, key, tempo and song form, then renders that plan as 48 kHz stereo audio. Because the score is exposed, users can edit notes or structure and regenerate, and the same checkpoint supports zero-shot covers and agent-driven music edits. The 3B parameter model can run on a single 24 GB GPU according to its model card. Weights and code are free on Hugging Face and GitHub under a non-commercial license.
features: Runs on a single 24 GB GPU
cons: Non-commercial license limits use
Requires a capable GPU and setup
moreContext:
Most AI song generators hand you finished audio and little else. YuE2 takes a more musician friendly route by writing a symbolic score first and only then producing sound, so you can see and change the melody, chords and structure before rendering. That two stage design is what makes it stand out among open models, and the developers report benchmark scores that compare well with commercial services, though those results are their own.

- Full song output from lyrics and a style prompt, with vocals and accompaniment in stereo
- An editable intermediate score covering melody, harmony, key, meter, tempo and form
- Zero-shot cover generation and editing of existing pieces with the same checkpoint
- A 3B parameter size that fits on a single high end consumer GPU
- Open code and weights, plus a public listening arena for blind comparisons

YuE2 is best for researchers, hobbyist producers and developers who want to experiment with music generation locally and value control over the composition. A practical tip: download the weights only from the official m-a-p Hugging Face page rather than mirrors, and review the CC-BY-NC license before using any output in paid or published projects.

name: QOVES
tagline: Facial analysis and a personalized non-surgical plan for improving your appearance
description: QOVES analyzes six photos of your face with landmarking models and expert review, then delivers aesthetic scores, visualizations and a non-surgical improvement protocol.
longDescription: QOVES is a facial aesthetics service that combines automated analysis with human review. Members share details about their demographics, lifestyle and goals, then upload six photos of the face and head from set angles. Proprietary landmarking models map hundreds of facial points and run more than 160 aesthetic assessments, and a team member reviews each analysis before delivery. The result includes biometric scores, before and after projections, a written protocol letter and a glow-up plan focused on non-surgical changes such as grooming, skincare and lifestyle habits. Results arrive within 28 days, members can message a care team, and access is sold as an annual membership.
cons: No free option and prices not listed upfront
Results take up to 28 days
moreContext:
Plenty of apps will rate a face in seconds, but QOVES takes a slower and more structured approach. It pairs landmark detection models with a person who reviews each report, and the output is less a score than a plan: specific, non-surgical steps tied to the features it measured. The company says its plans draw on published research about appearance and perception.

- A guided intake that considers age, background, lifestyle and personal goals
- Detailed facial mapping that covers proportions, symmetry and skin related factors
- Visual projections that show the likely effect of recommended changes
- A written protocol letter and tracking so progress can be compared over time
- Messaging access to a care team during the membership year

QOVES is best for adults who want a detailed, research framed look at their facial features and prefer practical grooming, skincare and lifestyle guidance over cosmetic procedures. A practical tip: follow the photo instructions closely, with even lighting, a neutral expression and no filters, since the quality of the measurements depends heavily on consistent images, and keep in mind that aesthetic scores are guidance rather than a medical assessment.

name: Mel by Skymel
tagline: AI investigator that mines the open web into a knowledge graph and custom reports
description: Mel from Skymel gathers small signals from across the public web, links people, companies, places and events into a knowledge graph, and turns it into reports, datasets or monitoring.
longDescription: Mel is an open web intelligence agent from Skymel. Users describe what they want to find, collect or track, such as a market entry question, supply chain risk or a list of high-intent prospects. Mel then searches public sources for small, scattered signals and connects them into a knowledge graph of who, what, where and when around that goal. From the graph it produces custom intelligence reports, structured datasets with fields the user defines, or ongoing monitoring feeds that can be delivered to internal systems or other AI agents. No integration is required, and pricing is scoped per project, with investigations starting at $150.
pros: Outputs suit both people and agents
cons: No free tier or self-serve trial
Datasets and monitoring need custom quotes
moreContext:
Search engines and chat assistants answer questions one at a time, while Mel is built to assemble a picture. Its distinguishing idea is the knowledge graph: rather than returning a list of links, it maps how people, organizations, events and places relate to the goal you set, then reasons over those connections to produce its deliverables.

- Investigations that correlate many weak signals into a single, connected report
- Custom datasets where you define the entities, attributes and relationships to collect
- Monitoring that tracks changes over time and can push updates to apps or AI agents
- Use cases across AI, SaaS, go-to-market and industry research, from due diligence to prospect lists
- A project-based model that does not require connecting internal systems

Mel by Skymel is best for strategy, sales, investment and research teams who need a scoped piece of open web intelligence without hiring an analyst or building scrapers. A practical tip: write your request as a clear decision you are trying to make, including the region, time frame and types of entities you care about, since a sharper goal gives Mel a tighter graph and a more useful report.

name: Free Text to Speech Online
tagline: Browser-based text to speech with 100+ voices, speed and pitch control and MP3 download
description: Free Text to Speech Online reads typed or pasted text aloud with natural AI voices in 27 languages, with adjustable speed and pitch and free MP3 downloads.
longDescription: Free Text to Speech Online is a simple web tool for turning written text into spoken audio. Users paste or type text, pick from more than 100 AI voices across 27 languages and different genders, adjust speaking speed and pitch, and play the result in the browser with a waveform player. Finished audio can be downloaded as an MP3 for use in videos, podcasts, lessons or personal listening. The site needs no account and works on desktop and mobile browsers. The interface is available in many languages, and the service is funded by on-page advertising rather than paid plans.
cons: Ad-supported interface
No voice cloning or advanced editing
moreContext:
Sometimes you just need a paragraph read aloud or a short voiceover file, and a full studio subscription is overkill. Free Text to Speech Online covers that need with a no-frills page: paste text, choose a voice and download the audio. The absence of a signup step makes it one of the quicker options for one-off tasks.

- A broad voice library covering dozens of languages and both male and female voices
- Sliders for speed and pitch so narration can be slowed down for learners or tightened for videos
- In-browser playback with a waveform view for quick checks
- Direct MP3 downloads for use in editing software or presentations
- A multilingual interface that suits non-English speakers

Free Text to Speech Online is best for students, teachers and casual creators who need occasional narration, pronunciation checks or listening practice without paying for a voice platform. A practical tip: break long scripts into shorter sections and generate each one separately, which makes it easier to fix a single sentence and keeps playback responsive, then join the MP3 files in your editor.

name: Snipin AI
tagline: Turn event and webinar recordings into clips, summaries and a searchable content hub
description: Snipin AI processes conference, webinar and town hall recordings to find shareable clips, write session summaries and capture key moments for social channels.
longDescription: Snipin AI is an event content tool that converts long recordings into short, publishable material. Organizers upload sessions from conferences, virtual events, webinars, town halls, trade shows or festivals, and the AI detects clip-worthy segments, writes session summaries and extracts highlights such as speaker gestures, crowd reactions and stage moments. Teams review, approve or remove clips, then export them in formats for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other channels. Everything is organized in a searchable event content hub with engagement analytics. A free plan includes 120 video minutes, and paid options are sold per event or as subscriptions.
cons: Per-event plans add up for frequent events
Hosting periods are time limited
moreContext:
Events generate hours of footage that often sits unused once the venue empties. Snipin AI focuses on that specific problem, and its event orientation is what separates it from general clipping tools. It looks beyond spoken highlights to visual moments like audience reactions and stage action, which tend to perform well on social media and in sponsor recaps.

- Automatic detection of short, ready to post clips from multi-hour sessions
- Readable session summaries for attendees who missed a talk
- A searchable hub that stores clips, summaries and visuals for each event
- An approval workflow so teams control what gets published
- Exports sized for Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube, plus performance analytics

Snipin AI is best for event organizers, internal communications teams and marketers who run conferences, webinars or town halls and want post-event content without a dedicated editor. A practical tip: upload clean session recordings with good audio as soon as the event ends, and approve clips in batches by track or speaker so you can schedule a steady stream of posts while interest is still high.

name: HiNoter
tagline: Record, transcribe and summarize meetings, voice memos and videos into notes
description: HiNoter records or imports audio, video and YouTube links, then produces transcripts, structured meeting notes with action items, and lets you chat with your notes.
longDescription: HiNoter is an AI note taker for meetings and recordings. Users can record live, upload audio or video files, paste YouTube links or import PDFs, and HiNoter creates a transcript along with structured notes that list key takeaways, decisions and action items. An AI chat feature answers questions across past notes with references to the source, and transcripts can be translated across many languages. It connects with calendars and meeting tools and is used for sales calls, team syncs, interviews, lectures and content planning. The free plan allows one note and limited chat, while Pro adds unlimited recordings, summaries and search.
cons: Free plan is very limited
No monthly personal plan
moreContext:
HiNoter brings meeting recording, file transcription and note search together in one app, which suits people whose spoken information comes from many places. A call recording, a lecture video and a YouTube talk all end up in the same searchable library, each with a summary and a list of next steps.

- Live recording plus uploads of audio, video, PDFs and YouTube links
- Summaries that separate key points, decisions and action items
- Chat that answers questions across your note history and points back to the source
- Transcription and translation in many languages for international teams
- A shared team workspace with roles and centralized billing

HiNoter is best for consultants, sales reps, recruiters and students who capture a lot of spoken content and want quick, organized notes without manual typing. A practical tip: the free plan only covers a single note, so test it on a representative meeting with your usual audio setup, and if you subscribe, compare the weekly and yearly options carefully because the yearly plan costs far less over time.

name: Free Font Finder
tagline: Identify a font from an image and get free, commercially usable lookalikes
description: Free Font Finder measures the lettering in a screenshot, logo or photo and ranks matching fonts from 1,907 open-source families, with free alternatives for commercial typefaces.
longDescription: Free Font Finder is a no-signup web tool for identifying typefaces. Users drop in a screenshot, photo, logo or scanned page, select the word to analyze, and a vision model measures traits like stroke contrast, x-height, letter shapes and terminals. Those measurements are compared with 1,907 open-source font families, and ranked candidates are rendered live beside the original for visual comparison. When the evidence is weak, results are labeled as similar fonts rather than a confident match. Extra tools find fonts on live websites by reading their CSS, identify fonts in PDFs, and suggest free alternatives to popular commercial typefaces. Images are not stored.
cons: Matches only open-source families
Script and all-caps text are less accurate
moreContext:
Font identifiers often return a single name with misplaced confidence, and Free Font Finder deliberately avoids that. It uses AI only to measure the letterforms, then compares those numbers with real font files, and it says so when several families fit equally well. That transparency, plus a focus on fonts you can actually use for free, makes it a practical tool for designers on a budget.

- Measurement-based matching against 1,907 open-source families, mostly from Google Fonts
- Live previews of each candidate in your own sample text, so you can judge by eye
- A website font finder that reads the fonts a page declares instead of guessing from pixels
- Free alternative pages for well known commercial typefaces such as Futura, Gotham and Proxima Nova
- A privacy friendly approach with no signup and no stored images

Free Font Finder is best for designers, developers, marketers and students who need to match lettering from a screenshot or logo and want a free, commercially usable font as the result. A practical tip: crop your image to a single line of text in one font and make the letters at least 20 pixels tall, since mixed fonts, tilted photos and tiny text are the main causes of weak matches.

name: G-AGE AI
tagline: Bilingual AI study assistant built for Pakistani students in English and Urdu
description: A study companion for Pakistani students that answers questions, generates exam-style MCQs and helps compile notes, with support for English and Roman Urdu.
longDescription: G-AGE AI is a web and Android study platform aimed at students in Pakistan. Learners can ask questions in English, Urdu or Roman Urdu and get explanations framed around local boards, universities and careers. The app can turn a topic into practice multiple choice questions, save useful answers into a notes collection, and export selected notes as a PDF or reorganize them with AI. It also offers subject-specific mentor personas for areas such as law, economics and data science. A guest mode allows a few queries, signed-in users get a daily free allowance, and a Pro membership removes limits and adds one-on-one academic guidance over WhatsApp.
features: Questions answered in English or Roman Urdu
pros: Tailored to Pakistani curricula and context
Daily free allowance for signed-in users
cons: Pro pricing is not published on the site
Narrow focus on one country's students
moreContext:
Most study chatbots are written with American or European students in mind, so it is refreshing to see one shaped around Pakistani learners. G-AGE AI talks about local boards, admissions at universities like NUST and LUMS, and careers in the Pakistani market, and it is happy to switch into Roman Urdu when that is how a student naturally types.

- Turns any topic into a short set of practice MCQs with explanations
- Lets students save answers and compile them into a single set of notes
- Exports notes as a PDF without rewriting them, or reorganizes them with AI on request
- Offers mentor personas for fields such as law, economics, health and technology
- Runs in the browser and as an installable Android app

The tool is best for secondary and university students in Pakistan who want quick explanations and self-testing in a language they are comfortable with. A practical tip: sign in rather than using guest mode, since guests only get a handful of lifetime queries while registered users receive a daily allowance, and use the MCQ generator right after reading a topic to check what actually stuck.

name: Poko Motion
tagline: Desktop app that turns sites, docs and recordings into editable product videos
description: Poko reads a website, repo, PDF, slide deck or recording, writes a script, builds animated scenes and lets you revise the video by typing plain instructions.
longDescription: Poko Motion is a desktop video studio for Mac and Windows that produces product demos and launch videos from material you already have. You point it at a website link, a project folder, a PDF, a PowerPoint file, a research paper or a talking-head recording, and its AI agent drafts a script, picks what to show and assembles motion graphics scenes with voiceover. Edits happen in a chat panel with a live preview, so you can ask for a faster opening or a different ending without a timeline editor. Rendering runs locally on your computer. A free plan includes starter credits, and paid plans add monthly credits, parallel video slots and bring-your-own-key model options.
features: Website, repo, PDF and slides to video
Local rendering on Mac and Windows
Voice cloning and BYOK voice providers
pros: Starts from material teams already have
Edits by typing instead of a timeline
Projects and renders stay on your machine
cons: Free credits expire after two days
Projects do not sync between computers yet
moreContext:
Small teams often skip launch videos because hiring a motion designer costs more than the launch budget. Poko takes a different route: you hand it the product website, a slide deck or even the code repository, and an AI agent writes and builds the video for you, then waits for feedback in plain sentences.

- Accepts seven kinds of starting material, from a URL to a recording of you talking
- Shows each project as a live card on an Agent Canvas so several videos can be built at once
- Renders on your own computer with a bundled engine, so there is no cloud queue
- Supports Poko voices, voice cloning, and your own ElevenLabs or Cartesia keys on eligible plans
- Lets Pro and Agency users connect their own model subscriptions or local models

Poko is a strong fit for indie founders, marketing teams and small agencies that need launch videos, explainers and feature announcements on short notice. A practical tip: start from your live landing page rather than a blank prompt, since the agent can pull real copy and visuals from it, then make small typed edits, which the company notes usually cost less than the first render.

name: Melaya
tagline: Governed AI agent platform for browsers, desktops, Android phones and business tools
description: Melaya lets teams build crews of AI agents with any model, connect thousands of tools and require human approval before agents send, post or pay.
longDescription: Melaya is an agent platform made up of several connected products. Melaya Agents is a visual builder where you give each agent a model, scoped tools and shared memory, then schedule the workflow. Melaya Assistant is a chat interface that works across approved business apps such as CRMs, inboxes and documents. Separate control products let agents operate a real browser tab, desktop apps or an Android phone, and Melaya Marketing covers SEO, backlinks and ad accounts. Users can bring their own model keys or local models through Ollama and LM Studio. Human approval gates sit in front of consequential actions, and runs can be replayed step by step. A free Sandbox plan is available.
features: Approval gates before sends and payments
Browser, desktop and Android device control
Bring your own model or run local models
pros: Strong focus on approvals and replayable runs
Free Sandbox plan with no card
cons: Broad product range can feel complex at first
Higher governance tiers get expensive
moreContext:
What sets Melaya apart is its insistence that agents stay under human control. Instead of promising fully autonomous bots, it builds approval steps into the workflow so a person signs off before anything is posted, sent or paid, and every run can be replayed to see exactly what happened.

- Lets you swap the underlying model, from hosted labs to local Ollama or LM Studio, without rebuilding agents
- Offers a very large tool catalog and prebuilt subagent templates, according to the company
- Extends the same permissions to a real browser tab, desktop apps and a paired Android phone
- Exposes its tools to other assistants through an MCP server
- Sells individual products on their own or bundles the full platform

Melaya suits operations teams, agencies and technical founders who want to automate real work across many apps while keeping a clear audit trail. A practical tip: begin on the free Sandbox with a single agent and the Safe approval mode, connect only one or two apps, and review a few replayed runs before widening permissions or moving to a paid tier.

name: Talynce
tagline: AI recruiter that sources, phone screens and video interviews candidates
description: Talynce ranks resumes against a job, places first-round screening calls with an AI voice agent and scores one-way video interviews, all inside a built-in ATS and CRM.
longDescription: Talynce is a recruitment platform that automates the top of the hiring funnel. It parses resumes in your database, rates each skill on the evidence behind it and ranks candidates against a job description. An AI calling agent then makes first-round phone screens, and one-way video interviews are scored answer by answer against a shared rubric. Recruiters receive a ranked shortlist with supporting evidence, managed through a built-in applicant tracking system, client CRM and Kanban pipeline. Candidates get a self-service portal for updates. A free plan covers core ATS features for one user, while the paid plan adds the full platform, bulk uploads, outreach and REST API access per seat.
features: Built-in ATS, CRM and candidate portal
pros: Free plan with no time limit
Covers sourcing through interviews in one place
Sample screening calls available to hear before signing up
cons: Pricing is listed in Indian rupees plus GST
REST API requires a paid seat
moreContext:
Recruiters spend a surprising share of their week on first-round calls that end in a quick no. Talynce aims to take that layer off their plate by letting an AI voice agent run the initial screen, then handing back a ranked shortlist with the reasons behind each ranking.

- Reads the resumes you already hold and ranks your whole database against a new role
- Places real screening phone calls, with sample recordings published on the site
- Scores one-way video interviews answer by answer on one rubric
- Bundles an ATS, client CRM and Kanban pipeline so teams do not need separate tools
- Gives applicants a self-service portal, which the company says cuts status-update emails

Talynce is a good match for staffing agencies and in-house teams handling steady or high-volume hiring, especially in India, where its pricing is set. A practical tip: listen to the sample screening calls for roles similar to yours before rolling it out, and start on the free plan by uploading an existing batch of resumes so you can judge the ranking quality against hires you already know were strong.

name: Save Your App
tagline: AI site audit plus human testers to find why visitors are not signing up
description: Paste a URL to get an AI review across SEO, performance, UX, conversion, accessibility, trust and onboarding, with ranked fixes and ready-to-paste fix prompts.
longDescription: Save Your App is an audit service for websites, landing pages and web apps that are not converting visitors into signups. Its scanning engine checks a product across seven areas: technical SEO, performance, UX and navigation, conversion, accessibility, trust and security, and onboarding. Results land in a dashboard with an overall score, category breakdowns and a ranked list of issues, each paired with a prompt you can paste into an AI coding tool to apply the fix. Paid plans add a vetted human tester each month who signs up and walks through the product, logging friction points alongside the automated findings. A free plan includes a few basic scans.
features: Ranked fixes with copyable fix prompts
Monthly human tester on paid plans
pros: Combines AI analysis with real human testing
Fix prompts fit AI-assisted coding workflows
cons: Full human tests sit on the higher tier
Monthly scan limits on each plan
moreContext:
Many founders launch, share their product everywhere and then watch signups stall without knowing why. Save Your App tackles that with a mix of automated scanning and real people, so you see both the technical issues a crawler can spot and the confusing moments only a human notices.

- Checks seven layers, from technical SEO and page speed to onboarding and trust signals
- Ranks every issue by how much it is likely costing you
- Attaches a ready-to-paste prompt to each fix for use with AI coding assistants
- Includes a vetted human tester every month on paid plans, with notes in the same dashboard
- Tracks scores over time with re-scans and PDF reports

The service is best for indie hackers, SaaS founders and small teams who built quickly and now need to understand why traffic is not turning into users. A practical tip: run the free scan on your signup or pricing page first rather than the homepage, since that is where the company's examples show most visitors dropping off, then re-scan after shipping the top few fixes to confirm the score moves.

name: Hadaa
tagline: AI landscape design from yard photos, sketches or CAD drawings
description: Upload photos of your yard, a hand sketch or a DWG file and Hadaa returns photorealistic garden designs, a zone-matched planting guide and a contractor-ready plan.
longDescription: Hadaa is a browser-based landscape design tool for homeowners and professionals. Its Garden Autopilot takes several photos of a yard plus a short description of the desired feel and returns up to 22 photorealistic redesigns across multiple styles, followed by edits you request in plain language. A Sketch engine turns a napkin drawing or plan image into rendered views, and the Hadaa CAD Engine reads a .dwg file directly to model the garden and house in 3D. Projects also include a native plant list matched to your growing zone, a blueprint and a bill of quantities. Homeowners pay per project, while designers can subscribe to Studio plans.
features: DWG to 3D garden and house model
pros: Pay per project with no subscription for homeowners
Works on any device in the browser
Outputs plans a contractor can use
cons: Photorealistic renders are not free
CAD Engine requires the top Studio plan
moreContext:
Seeing a garden before you build it usually means paying a designer for concept drawings. Hadaa brings that step within reach of ordinary homeowners by working from a few phone photos of the actual yard, so the designs show your own space rather than a stock image.

- Produces a batch of redesigns across several styles from one set of yard photos
- Turns rough sketches or plan images into rendered views
- Reads DWG files directly in its CAD Engine to build a 3D model with the house included
- Recommends plants matched to your local growing zone, with quantities you can export
- Delivers a blueprint and bill of quantities alongside the images

Hadaa suits homeowners planning a backyard project and landscape designers who want fast concept visuals for clients. A practical tip: upload photos from several angles in good daylight, since the autopilot builds a more faithful picture of the space that way, and preview the free planting guide and blueprint before paying for renders to make sure the layout matches what you have in mind.

name: Scro
tagline: Build a consistent AI influencer that posts short videos in your own voice
description: Design an AI influencer, lock its face, wardrobe and voice, feed it your expertise, then generate Reels, Shorts and TikToks that stay on character every week.
longDescription: Scro is a studio for creating AI influencer characters for brands and creators. You start by designing the character's look in one of several art styles, from realistic to clay, watercolor or pixel art. Scro then locks the portrait and wardrobe so the character stays consistent across posts. You can record or upload your voice in one of 21 supported languages, and the platform generates short videos in that voice, filled with your knowledge, product stories and brand messaging. A library of lifestyle posts and outfits keeps the feed fresh. Output targets Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and TikTok, and free courses in Scro Academy cover hooks and posting formats.
features: Voice recording and cloning in 21 languages
pros: Keeps one character consistent across many posts
Built around Reels, Shorts and TikTok formats
cons: Paid plans start at a relatively high price
Credit-based usage needs monitoring
moreContext:
The hardest part of running a virtual spokesperson is keeping it recognizable from one post to the next. Scro is built around that problem, locking the character's face, outfits and voice so a brand can publish week after week with the same personality on screen.

- Offers character styles ranging from realistic portraits to clay, watercolor and pixel art
- Records your voice in the browser or from uploaded clips, with 21 languages supported
- Supplies a wardrobe and lifestyle post library so the feed does not repeat itself
- Covers product UGC, brand spokesperson and creator series use cases
- Includes free Scro Academy lessons on hooks, weekly formats and calls to action

Scro is best for small businesses, solo experts and agencies that want a steady stream of short videos without filming themselves. A practical tip: spend time on the soul step by feeding the character your real expertise and product details, then pick one repeatable weekly format, which is the approach the Academy courses recommend for building an audience.

name: Writon
tagline: AI article writer that drafts SEO blog posts and publishes them to WordPress
description: Add keywords and Writon drafts long-form articles with featured images and a quality score, then publishes to WordPress on demand or on an autopilot schedule.
longDescription: Writon is a content platform for bloggers, marketing agencies and in-house teams that publish search-focused articles. You enter target keywords, and it drafts long-form posts with featured images and a built-in quality score. Articles can be published straight to a connected WordPress site one at a time or on an autopilot schedule. Higher plans add in-article images such as charts and diagrams, more words per article and separate team workspaces for agencies. Users can connect Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 to view traffic inside the dashboard. It writes in several languages, including Arabic and Urdu, and offers pay-per-article credits or monthly subscriptions.
pros: Low entry price and pay-per-article option
Built-in quality score for each draft
cons: Auto-published AI posts still need human editing
Word and article caps vary by plan
moreContext:
Writon focuses on the full path from keyword to published post, which is where many small blogs lose time. Rather than stopping at a draft, it hands articles directly to WordPress and can keep a publishing schedule running in the background.

- Drafts long-form posts from keyword lists, including bulk generation
- Scores each article for quality before it goes live
- Creates featured images, and on higher plans charts or step diagrams inside the article
- Publishes to WordPress on demand or on autopilot
- Shows Search Console and Analytics 4 data inside the dashboard without changing your Google account

The tool is best for bloggers, niche site owners and agencies that manage several client sites and want a steady output of search content at a modest cost. A practical tip: start with the pay-per-article option or trial and review a handful of drafts closely before switching on autopilot, adding your own examples and checking facts, since search engines and readers both reward pages that show genuine first-hand insight.

name: 123 Cal
tagline: iPhone calorie and protein tracker that estimates macros from a meal photo
description: Snap a meal and 123 Cal estimates calories, protein, carbs and fats with a likely range, then lets you adjust portions and hidden extras before logging.
longDescription: 123 Cal is an iPhone app for tracking calories and macronutrients with less typing. You take a photo of a meal and its AI returns an estimate of calories, protein, carbs, fats and fiber, along with a likely range and the assumptions behind it. You can then correct portions or add items the camera cannot see, such as cooking oil. Packaged foods can be logged by scanning a barcode or reading a nutrition label with AI. The app tracks progress against daily calorie and macro targets, saves favorite meals for quick relogging, syncs with Apple Health and shows remaining totals on Apple Watch. It is free to download, and unlimited scanning requires a Pro subscription.
features: Apple Health and Apple Watch support
pros: Shows ranges and assumptions instead of a single number
Easy to correct portions and hidden ingredients
cons: iPhone only
Unlimited scanning needs a paid Pro plan
moreContext:
Photo calorie counters often present a single confident number, which can be misleading. 123 Cal takes a more honest approach by showing a likely range and the assumptions it made, then inviting you to fix anything the camera missed, like a spoon of butter in the pan.

- Estimates calories, protein, carbs, fats and fiber from one meal photo
- Lets you adjust portions and add hidden extras before saving
- Scans barcodes and reads nutrition labels for packaged foods
- Writes nutrition and water data to Apple Health with your permission
- Shows calories and protein remaining on Apple Watch

The app is best for iPhone users who want to hit a daily protein goal or keep a loose eye on calories without weighing and typing every ingredient. A practical tip: save the meals you eat most often, such as your usual breakfast, so they can be logged with a single tap, and take a moment to add cooking fats after each photo, since the company notes these are the details a picture cannot capture.

name: Sprout Social
tagline: Social media management suite with AI assist, listening and analytics
description: Plan and publish posts, manage every social inbox in one place, monitor brand conversations and report on performance, with AI help for drafting and replies.
longDescription: Sprout Social is a social media management platform used by marketing, customer care and communications teams. It brings publishing, a unified Smart Inbox, review management, keyword monitoring and reporting into one workspace across major social networks. AI features include an assistant called Trellis for turning data into insights, AI Assist for improving posts and replies, optimal send time suggestions and sentiment analysis in the inbox and reviews. Add-ons cover premium analytics, social listening across large volumes of public conversations, influencer marketing and employee advocacy. Plans are priced per seat, with mobile apps for iOS and Android, and a 30-day free trial is available without a credit card.
features: Publishing calendar with optimal send times
AI Assist for posts and replies
cons: Per-seat pricing adds up for larger teams
Listening and advanced analytics cost extra
moreContext:
Sprout Social has long been a standard choice for teams that treat social media as both a marketing and a customer service channel. Its newer AI features build on that base, helping teams draft content, prioritize messages and make sense of large amounts of performance data. Mobile apps for iOS and Android mean the inbox travels with the team.

- Collects messages from connected networks into one Smart Inbox with tagging and sentiment
- Plans and schedules posts with suggested send times
- Uses the Trellis AI agent to summarize performance and surface insights
- Offers social listening that analyzes public conversations around your brand and competitors
- Provides presentation-ready reports and competitor benchmarks

Sprout Social is best for in-house marketing teams, agencies and enterprises that manage many profiles and need collaboration, approval workflows and solid reporting. A practical tip: use the 30-day trial to connect your real profiles and run one full reporting cycle, and decide early whether you need the listening add-on, since it is priced separately and is often the feature larger teams value most.

name: Teal
tagline: AI resume builder and job tracker that tailors applications to each posting
description: Build resumes, match them against job descriptions for missing keywords, write AI bullet points and cover letters, and track every application in one board.
longDescription: Teal is a career platform for job seekers that combines an AI resume builder with job search organization tools. Users create and edit resumes from templates, then compare a resume against a specific job description to see which keywords and skills are missing. AI features help write achievement bullets, professional summaries and cover letters. A job tracker and browser extension let users save postings from job boards, record contacts and follow each application through its stages. The free plan covers core resume building and tracking, while the Teal+ subscription adds unlimited AI writing, full keyword matching and deeper resume analysis, with weekly, monthly and quarterly billing options.
features: AI resume and cover letter writing
pros: Useful free plan for building and tracking
Keeps the whole job search in one place
cons: Best AI features sit behind Teal+
Short billing periods can cost more over a long search
moreContext:
Job searching involves far more admin than most people expect, from tailoring resumes to remembering which company you applied to and when. Teal tackles both halves of that work, pairing resume writing help with a tracker that keeps the whole search organized. The free plan is generous enough to get real value before deciding whether to pay.

- Compares your resume with a job description and highlights missing keywords
- Writes and refines achievement bullets, summaries and cover letters with AI
- Saves postings from job boards through a browser extension
- Tracks contacts, stages and notes for each application
- Lets you keep multiple tailored versions of your resume

Teal is best for active job seekers, career changers and recent graduates who apply to many roles and want each application tailored without starting from scratch. A practical tip: build one complete master resume first, then duplicate it for each role and use the keyword matching against that specific posting, editing AI suggestions so every bullet still reflects work you actually did.

name: Wonderplan
tagline: Free AI trip planner that builds editable itineraries around your budget
description: Tell Wonderplan where you are going, your interests and budget, and it drafts a day-by-day itinerary with lodging ideas that you can reorder and save as a PDF.
longDescription: Wonderplan is a web-based AI travel planner. You enter a destination, travel dates, budget and interests, and it generates a personalized day-by-day itinerary with places to visit and suggested accommodation. The plan appears on a single page where you can reorder stops, add new destinations or remove items you do not want. Finished itineraries can be downloaded as PDFs for offline use during the trip, and saved or bookmarked plans stay organized in one account space. The service is aimed at independent travelers who want a starting plan quickly without assembling it from many travel sites. Wonderplan states that the planner is currently free to use.
features: Drag to reorder, add or remove stops
pros: Quick first draft of a full trip
Easy to edit the plan afterward
cons: No booking built into the planner
The site notes it is free only for now
moreContext:
Planning a trip often means juggling a dozen browser tabs before a single day is mapped out. Wonderplan shortcuts that process by producing a complete itinerary from a few preferences, then letting you shape it rather than starting from a blank page.

- Builds a day-by-day plan based on your interests, dates and budget
- Suggests places to stay that fit your stated preferences
- Lets you reorder, add or drop stops directly on the itinerary page
- Exports the plan as a PDF so it is available without a connection
- Keeps your own trips and bookmarked plans together in one place

Wonderplan is best for independent travelers, weekend explorers and anyone who wants a solid first draft of a vacation in minutes. A practical tip: be specific about your interests and pace when you create a plan, for example noting that you prefer two or three sights a day, then check opening hours and travel times for each stop before you go, since AI-generated plans should always be confirmed against current local information.

name: WeatherNext 3
tagline: Google DeepMind's global AI weather model with hourly, high-resolution forecasts
description: An ensemble AI forecasting model from Google that uses satellite data to produce hourly global forecasts, available in Google products and for enterprise use on Google Cloud.
longDescription: WeatherNext 3 is the latest global weather forecasting model from Google DeepMind and Google Research, announced in September 2026. It is an ensemble model that draws on raw satellite imagery alongside traditional analysis data, which lets it produce forecasts for every hour of the day. Google says it predicts surface variables such as temperature and humidity at up to 5 km resolution, with other variables like wind at coarser grids, and it covers energy-relevant fields such as cloud cover and solar radiation. The model feeds forecasts into Google Search, Maps and Gemini, and enterprises can access its data through BigQuery, Earth Engine, Google Maps Platform and Cloud Storage.
features: Data access via BigQuery and Earth Engine
pros: Reaches users through Search, Maps and Gemini
Covers variables useful for renewable energy
cons: Enterprise data access runs through paid Google Cloud services
Not a standalone consumer app
moreContext:
Weather forecasting has traditionally relied on expensive physics simulations run a few times a day. WeatherNext 3 shows how far AI models have moved that field, generating forecasts every hour and pulling satellite observations directly into the model rather than waiting for them to be processed into standard analysis data.

- Produces an ensemble of forecasts, which helps express uncertainty rather than a single guess
- Delivers fine-grained surface forecasts, according to Google, at up to 5 km resolution
- Covers cloud cover and radiation for wind and solar operators
- Flows into everyday Google products as well as enterprise data services
- Can be explored through Google's interactive Weather Lab

WeatherNext 3 is most relevant for data scientists, energy and logistics teams, researchers and developers who want high-resolution forecast data inside tools they already use, such as BigQuery or Earth Engine. Everyday users benefit indirectly through Search and Maps. A practical tip: start in Weather Lab to compare forecasts for locations you care about, then move to the BigQuery or Earth Engine datasets once you know which variables your project needs.

name: Google Pics
tagline: Google Workspace app for AI image generation and object-level editing
description: Create images from prompts or edit existing ones from Drive, Photos or your device, with precise object editing and built-in access from Docs, Slides and Drive.
longDescription: Google Pics is an AI image generation and editing app inside Google Workspace, introduced at Google I/O 2026. It is built on Google's Nano Banana image models, with Gemini powering editing. Users can generate new visuals from a text prompt or upload images from Google Drive, Google Photos or a computer and modify them. Editing works at the object level, so individual elements can be moved, resized or changed, and text within an image can be edited or translated. Pics runs as a standalone web app and inside Docs, Slides and Drive, with files saved and shared through Drive. It is available on Workspace Business Standard and higher plans and to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.
features: Integration with Docs, Slides and Drive
pros: Works inside tools many teams already use
Precise edits instead of full regeneration
cons: Requires a qualifying Workspace or Google AI plan
Aimed at design graphics more than photo retouching
moreContext:
A common frustration with image generators is having to regenerate an entire picture just to fix one detail. Google Pics addresses that with object-based editing, letting you adjust a single element while leaving the rest of the composition alone, and it does this inside the Workspace apps where many people already build documents and presentations.

- Generates images from prompts or edits uploads from Drive, Photos or your device
- Moves, resizes or changes individual objects in a scene
- Edits and translates text inside an image while keeping the design intact
- Opens directly from Google Docs, Slides and Drive
- Shares images through links so teammates can make their own edits

Google Pics is best for teams and individuals already on Google Workspace or a Google AI subscription who need social graphics, invitations, mockups or presentation visuals without switching to a separate design tool. A practical tip: start from an existing image in Drive when you can, then refine it with targeted object edits, which tends to give more predictable results than generating every visual from scratch.

name: MedASR
tagline: Google's open-weight speech-to-text model tuned for medical dictation
description: A 105M-parameter Conformer speech recognition model from Google's Health AI Developer Foundations, trained on physician dictations for clinical transcription apps.
longDescription: MedASR is a speech-to-text model released by Google as part of its Health AI Developer Foundations collection. Based on the Conformer architecture with about 105 million parameters, it was trained on roughly 5,000 hours of de-identified physician dictations spanning radiology, internal medicine and family medicine. It accepts mono 16 kHz audio and outputs text transcriptions. Google positions it as a foundation for developers building healthcare voice tools such as radiology dictation and clinical note capture, with output that can be passed to generative models like MedGemma for summarization. The weights are available on Hugging Face and Vertex AI Model Garden, with notebooks for quick start and fine-tuning.
features: Conformer model trained on medical dictation
Runs locally or on Vertex AI
Pairs with MedGemma for downstream tasks
cons: A developer model, not a ready-made app
Governed by Health AI terms rather than a standard open license
moreContext:
General speech recognition models often stumble over drug names, anatomy and radiology terms. MedASR was trained specifically on physician dictations, which gives developers a starting point that already understands much of the language clinicians use every day.

- Focuses on medical dictation across radiology, internal medicine and family medicine
- Uses a compact Conformer design of about 105 million parameters
- Can be run locally, deployed on Vertex AI or downloaded from Hugging Face
- Comes with Google notebooks for getting started and fine-tuning
- Feeds transcripts into models such as MedGemma for summaries or question answering

MedASR is best for healthcare software teams, researchers and startups building dictation, scribing or documentation tools who are comfortable working with models directly. A practical tip: test it on a sample of your own de-identified recordings before committing, and plan a fine-tuning pass if your users have strong accents, noisy rooms or unusual medication names, since Google's model card notes that performance varies on terms outside the training data. Always keep a clinician review step for any patient-facing records.

name: WordToResume
tagline: Free AI resume builder that turns a plain-text prompt into a PDF resume
description: Write about yourself or paste an old CV, pick one of three templates, and download a clean A4 PDF resume with no signup or watermark.
longDescription: WordToResume is a free, browser-based resume builder that replaces the usual long form with a single text box. You type your name, education, skills and work history in your own words, or paste notes, a Word document's text or an existing CV, and the AI organizes it into resume sections. You then choose between Classic, Modern and Executive templates, adjust the color and font, preview every A4 page and download a PDF. There is no account, credit card or watermark involved. The tool is aimed at students, interns, career changers and job seekers who want a presentable resume quickly without learning a design tool.
features: Three free templates with color and font options
Free PDF download with no watermark
pros: Accepts messy notes or an old CV
cons: Only three templates
No cover letter or job tailoring tools
moreContext:
Most free resume builders hide the download button behind a signup wall or a paywall, and WordToResume deliberately goes the other way. Instead of asking you to fill in dozens of fields, it lets you describe yourself in a few rough sentences and handles the structure for you. That makes it a friendly starting point for anyone who finds a blank resume template intimidating.

- A single prompt box accepts short notes, long histories or a pasted CV, so you never have to retype your experience field by field.
- Three templates (Classic, Modern and Executive) can be paired with a choice of colors and fonts.
- Every page is previewed before download, which helps you catch awkward page breaks early.
- The PDF is free, carries no watermark and does not require an account.
- Dedicated starting pages cover first resumes, no-experience resumes and converting ChatGPT text into a formatted document.

It is best for students, recent graduates and job seekers who need a tidy, printable resume today rather than a full career platform. A practical tip: list your projects, coursework and part-time roles in plain sentences in the prompt, then review the generated wording carefully and edit any claims so every line matches your real experience before you send it to an employer.

name: Danelfin
tagline: AI stock and ETF analytics that rates each asset with an explainable AI Score
description: Danelfin scores US and European stocks and ETFs from 1 to 10 using technical, fundamental and sentiment signals, and shows which factors drive each rating.
longDescription: Danelfin is an AI-powered investment research platform for self-directed investors. Its models analyze a large set of technical, fundamental and sentiment indicators for stocks and ETFs, then assign each asset an AI Score from 1 to 10 that estimates its chance of outperforming its benchmark over the following months. The platform emphasizes explainability, listing the signals that pushed each score up or down. Users can browse rankings, read stock and ETF reports, track portfolios and receive top-pick newsletters. A free tier offers limited reports, while paid Plus and Pro plans add unlimited access and extra tools. Danelfin states that its scores are not personal investment advice.
features: AI Score ratings for stocks and ETFs
pros: Shows the reasoning behind each score
Free tier for trying the ratings
cons: Backtested results do not guarantee future returns
Advanced tools require a paid plan
moreContext:
What sets Danelfin apart from many stock screeners is its focus on explaining its own ratings. Rather than handing you a mysterious buy signal, it breaks each AI Score into the technical, fundamental and sentiment factors behind it, so you can judge whether the reasoning fits your own view. That transparency makes it a useful second opinion for investors who still want to do their own homework.

- A simple 1 to 10 AI Score summarizes many data points into a number that is easy to compare across companies.
- Explainable signals show which indicators lifted or lowered each rating.
- Rankings span stocks and ETFs in US and European markets.
- Portfolio tracking lets you see the scores of the holdings you already own.
- The company publishes backtests and clearly notes that past performance is not a promise of future results.

Danelfin is best for self-directed retail investors who want a structured, data-driven filter before digging into individual companies. A practical tip: treat the AI Score as a starting point for research, read the listed signals and the underlying filings yourself, and remember that the platform says its ratings do not replace professional investment advice or your own due diligence.

name: Emergent
tagline: Chat with AI agents that design, code and deploy full-stack web and mobile apps
description: Describe an app in plain language and Emergent's agents build the frontend, backend and database, then host it, with GitHub sync and exportable code.
longDescription: Emergent is an AI app-building platform where you describe what you want and a team of AI agents plans, codes, tests and deploys it. It handles full-stack projects, including web apps, mobile apps, websites, landing pages, dashboards, internal tools and simple CRMs, and includes built-in hosting with databases and APIs already configured. Users keep ownership of the generated code and can push it to GitHub or host it elsewhere. The platform targets founders, small business owners, agencies, product managers and operations teams who want working software without hiring developers. A free plan includes a small monthly credit allowance, and paid tiers add more credits and advanced model features.
pros: Builds both web and mobile apps
You own and can export the code
Free plan for trying it out
cons: Credits run out quickly on larger projects
Advanced context and agents need the Pro tier
moreContext:
Emergent stands out among prompt-to-app builders for how much of the stack it takes on. Its agents do not stop at a pretty frontend; they set up the backend, database and hosting, and they support mobile apps alongside web projects. For non-technical founders that means a real, clickable product can exist before any engineer is hired.

- Multiple AI agents split the work of planning, coding, testing and deploying.
- Templates and builders cover websites, landing pages, SaaS products, dashboards, forms and CRMs.
- Hosting with databases and APIs is included, so a project can go live from the same workspace.
- Generated code belongs to you and can be synced to GitHub or moved to your own servers.
