- Higher tiers add a larger context window, custom agents and system prompt editing for more complex builds.

It is best for founders validating an MVP, agencies prototyping client tools and operations teams building internal apps. A practical tip: write a short spec before you start, listing the main screens, user roles and data you need, and feed it to the agents in stages so your monthly credits go toward refinement rather than repeated rebuilds.

name: Tencent Hunyuan 3D
tagline: Tencent's AI engine for turning text, images and sketches into 3D models
description: Hunyuan 3D generates textured 3D assets from prompts, reference photos or sketches, with topology tools and OBJ or GLB export for game engines and 3D printing.
longDescription: Hunyuan 3D is Tencent's generative 3D platform, built on its in-house Hunyuan 3D models, which Tencent has also released as open source. Through the global web app, creators can generate 3D assets from a text description, a single image, up to four multi-view images or a sketch refined with text attributes. Tools for model editing and smart topology produce cleaner triangle or quad meshes, and results export as OBJ or GLB files for use in Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender or 3D printing. Tencent says individual users get a daily allowance of free generations, while enterprises can integrate the model through the Tencent Cloud API with prepaid or pay-as-you-go credits.
cons: Paid API pricing lives on Tencent Cloud
Complex assets may still need manual cleanup
moreContext:
Few 3D generators come with the research depth that Tencent brings to Hunyuan 3D. The underlying models were released openly, and Tencent says they have been downloaded millions of times on Hugging Face, which has made them a familiar name among 3D and game developers. The global web app wraps that research in a friendly interface that anyone can try.

- Several input types are supported: text prompts, a single photo, up to four multi-view images or a sketch with text attributes.
- Smart topology helps produce meshes with triangle or quad faces that are easier to edit and animate.
- Exports in OBJ and GLB drop straight into Unity, Unreal Engine and Blender.
- Tencent says individual users receive a set number of free generations every day.
- Businesses can call the same models through the Tencent Cloud API.

It is best for indie game developers, 3D artists, e-commerce teams needing product models and hobbyists preparing files for 3D printing. A practical tip: when generating from photos, supply multiple angles of the same object on a plain background, since the multi-view option tends to give the model far more shape information than a single image.

name: Applyace
tagline: AI job search autopilot that finds new roles and applies with tailored materials
description: Applyace scans company career sites for fresh openings and submits applications for you with a customized resume, cover letter and screening answers for each job.
longDescription: Applyace is an automated job application service for active job seekers. You upload your resume once and set preferences such as role, location, salary floor, visa needs, blocked companies and seniority. The platform then monitors company career sites for newly posted roles, often before they reach the big job boards, and applies on your behalf. Each application gets a resume adjusted for the role, a custom cover letter and screening answers based on your experience. Every submission appears in a dashboard with a receipt, and you can pause activity at any time. The company offers an interview guarantee and promises a refund if it ever fabricates an answer.
features: Per-job tailored resume and cover letter
pros: Filters for salary, location and companies
cons: Pricing is not published upfront
Applications go out without per-job approval
moreContext:
Job hunting often turns into an exhausting loop of copy, paste and submit, and Applyace is built to take that loop off your plate. Its pitch is quality as well as volume: rather than firing the same resume everywhere, it writes materials around each specific posting and pulls listings directly from employer career pages.

- You set your preferences and filters once, including salary floors, excluded locations, blocked companies and seniority caps.
- Roles are found on company career sites, which the company says helps you apply before listings spread to large job boards.
- Each application includes a tailored resume, a custom cover letter and answers written for that role's questions.
- A dashboard logs every submission with a receipt, and a single control pauses everything.
- The company offers a 30-day interview guarantee and a full refund if it ever invents an answer.

It is best for experienced professionals running a broad, time-sensitive search who would rather spend their energy on interviews than forms. A practical tip: set strict filters on day one, then review the first batch of submissions in your dashboard to confirm the tone and claims match how you want to present yourself before letting it run at full speed.

name: Advelum
tagline: AI ad generator that turns product photos into image and short video ads
description: Upload product photos and either a reference ad or a text idea, and Advelum generates image ads or videos up to 15 seconds in multiple sizes using one-time credit packs.
longDescription: Advelum is an AI ad creation tool for independent online stores and small marketing teams. You upload up to five photos of a product and then either supply a reference ad whose lighting, composition or motion you like, or describe a setting in plain language. The AI places your product into a new scene and outputs still image ads or videos up to 15 seconds long, in several aspect ratios for different placements. Results are saved in a personal library so inputs can be reused for the next campaign. Pricing uses one-time credit packs that never expire, with no subscription, and the terms allow commercial use of generated ads.
features: Image ads and videos up to 15 seconds
cons: Account and credits required to generate
Video length capped at 15 seconds
moreContext:
Small brands often spot an ad style they love but lack the budget to reshoot their own product in that look. Advelum is built around exactly that wish: show it an ad you admire and a photo of your product, and it reworks the scene so your item takes center stage. The approach keeps creative direction in your hands while removing the studio and editing steps.

- Reference mode borrows lighting, composition or camera motion from an ad you supply.
- Idea mode works from a plain-language description when you have no reference at hand.
- Up to five product photos help the model capture shape and detail accurately.
- Outputs include still images and videos up to 15 seconds in several sizes for different placements.
- Credit packs are one-time purchases that never expire, and failed generations return their credits.

It is best for independent ecommerce sellers and lean marketing teams that need fresh creative for launches, offers and seasonal promotions without hiring an editor. A practical tip: shoot your product on a clean background from a few angles before you start, and always zoom in on the result to confirm labels, logos and fine details were reproduced correctly before you publish the ad.

name: Layla
tagline: AI trip planner that drafts your itinerary and hands it to human travel experts to book
description: Chat with Layla about dates, budget and style to get a full itinerary, then a real travel expert refines and books hotels, flights and activities with no planning fee.
longDescription: Layla is an AI travel planner from Berlin-based Layla AI GmbH that combines conversational planning with human travel experts. You describe where you want to go, your dates, budget and travel style, and Layla builds a day-by-day itinerary with hotels and experiences. A travel expert then gets to know your preferences, finalizes the plan and books hotels, flights, transfers and activities as a package. The site says planning is free and nothing is added on top of the trip price, and it offers a package price guarantee plus 24/7 support during travel, including over WhatsApp. Ready-made trip ideas can also be remixed to suit your own plans.
features: Human travel expert review and booking
pros: Handles hotels, flights and activities together
cons: Recommended minimum budget per night
Bookings run through Layla rather than your own accounts
moreContext:
Plenty of chatbots can sketch an itinerary, but Layla pairs its AI with people who actually book the trip. That hybrid model is what makes it distinctive: the AI handles the hours of research and route building, and a travel expert reviews the plan, confirms details and takes care of reservations. For travelers who want a polished trip without dozens of open tabs, that combination is reassuring.

- A natural conversation captures your dates, budget and style, then turns them into a structured, day-by-day plan.
- Travel experts specialize in areas such as family travel, adventure, honeymoons and luxury stays.
- Hotels, flights, transfers and experiences are booked together as one package.
- The site says planning is free and no fee is added when experts book the trip.
- Support is available around the clock while you travel, including through WhatsApp.

It is best for couples, families and busy professionals planning multi-stop leisure trips who would welcome a human safety net. A practical tip: start by remixing one of the ready-made trips closest to your idea, then tell Layla exactly what to change, such as pace, hotel style or budget, before handing it to an expert.

name: Photoshoot.si
tagline: AI photo studio for selfie photoshoots, headshots and product shots across top models
description: Upload a few selfies or a product photo and generate full multi-look photoshoots, headshots and edits, choosing from 22 image models on one shared credit balance.
longDescription: Photoshoot.si is an online AI photo studio that bundles many leading image models behind a single credit plan. You upload one to four selfies or a single product photo, pick one of its ready-made tools, such as an AI headshot generator, portrait generator or product photo tool, and choose a model like Nano Banana, GPT Image 2, FLUX.2 or Seedream. Tools with multiple looks run a full shoot, producing one image per look while keeping the same face. Credits are shared across all models and tools, failed generations are refunded automatically and uploads stay private to your account. New users get free starter credits, and monthly plans add larger credit allowances.
features: 22 image models on one credit pool
38 preset tools for headshots and products
pros: Many top models under one plan
Credits roll over and do not expire
cons: Premium models use credits quickly
Free credits only cover a few images
moreContext:
Instead of locking you into one image model, Photoshoot.si lets you pick from a long roster of them and pays for all of them from the same credit balance. Each tool comes with its model and prompt already chosen, so you get the benefit of the newest generators without having to learn prompt engineering. The photoshoot format, which renders a whole set of looks with a consistent face, is especially handy for profile and personal branding images.

- Full shoots generate one photo per look in a single click, keeping your likeness consistent across the set.
- The roster includes models from Google, OpenAI, Black Forest Labs, ByteDance, Recraft, xAI and others.
- Preset tools cover LinkedIn headshots, portraits, product photos, background removal and upscaling.
- Every model page lists its credit cost, and failed images are refunded automatically.
- Subscription credits roll over month to month and top-up credits never expire.

It is best for professionals refreshing their headshots, creators who want varied profile photos and small sellers who need product imagery. A practical tip: upload three or four well-lit selfies taken from slightly different angles, and test a look on a cheaper model first before running a full shoot on a premium one.

name: Image to Calendar
tagline: Turn photos, screenshots and PDF schedules into editable calendar events
description: Upload a timetable, flyer, syllabus or roster, review the events the AI extracts, and download one ICS file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook.
longDescription: Image to Calendar is a web tool that reads schedules from images and PDFs and converts them into calendar events. You upload a photo, screenshot, flyer or PDF of up to ten pages, and the AI extracts titles, dates, times, timezones, locations, notes and repeat rules. Every event can be edited before export, and the result downloads as a single standard ICS file that imports into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook and other apps. One conversion can cover up to 100 events. It suits students with class timetables, parents with sports seasons and workers with shift rosters. The first conversion is free without an account, and further use runs on one-time credit packs.
features: Single ICS export for any calendar app
pros: Works with any calendar app via ICS
cons: No direct calendar sync, only file export
Ongoing use requires buying credits
moreContext:
Retyping a semester timetable or a season of practice dates into a calendar is tedious and error prone, and this tool tackles that chore directly. Point it at a photo, screenshot or PDF and it does the transcription, then pauses so you can check every entry before anything reaches your calendar. That review-first approach is a thoughtful touch for a task where a single wrong date matters.

- Accepts JPG, PNG and WebP images plus PDFs of up to ten pages.
- Extracts titles, dates, times, timezones, locations, notes and recurring rules.
- Each event stays editable before you export the final file.
- Exports one standard ICS file that works with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook and others.
- The site says uploaded files are processed in memory and not permanently stored.

It is best for students importing class schedules, parents juggling school and sports calendars and shift workers handling rotating rosters. A practical tip: crop the image so only the schedule is visible and make sure it is sharp and well lit, then double-check the timezone and repeat rules in the review screen, since those are the details most likely to need a quick correction.

name: Audio Cleaner AI
tagline: Online AI tool that removes noise, echo and unwanted sounds from audio and video
description: Clean up recordings in the browser by removing background noise, echo, hum, breaths and wind, plus stem splitting, transcription and other audio tools on a credit system.
longDescription: Audio Cleaner AI is a browser-based audio cleanup suite. Its core noise remover strips background noise, echo, reverb, static, buzz, wind, breaths, mouth sounds and hum from audio and video files, and it can also trim silences and filler words or apply enhancement and normalization. Beyond cleanup, the site offers stem splitting and vocal removal, speech-to-text, audio translation, voice changing and a podcast maker. It supports more than 20 formats, including MP3, WAV, MP4 and MOV. New users receive free credits on signup with small daily top-ups, while subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide more processing time, priority queues and longer file storage.
features: Breath, silence and filler word cleanup
Support for 20+ audio and video formats
pros: Runs in the browser with no install
Handles both audio and video files
Wide set of extra audio tools
cons: Free credits are limited
Pricing details are not shown upfront
moreContext:
Good content is often let down by a noisy room, a humming fan or wind on an outdoor mic, and Audio Cleaner AI focuses on rescuing that kind of recording quickly. Because it runs in the browser and accepts video files as well as audio, you can clean the soundtrack of a clip without exporting it to a separate editor first. The wide menu of targeted removers lets you fix one specific problem without flattening the whole track.

- Dedicated removers target background noise, echo, reverb, static, buzzing, wind, breaths and mouth sounds.
- Silence and filler word cleanup tightens spoken content such as interviews and lectures.
- Stem splitting and vocal removal separate voices, drums, bass and other instruments.
- Two cleanup models are offered, including a newer alpha model aimed at complex noise.
- Extra tools cover transcription, audio translation, voice changing and podcast creation.

It is best for podcasters, video creators, teachers recording lessons and musicians who need quick cleanup without a full studio workflow. A practical tip: run a short test clip through both available models and compare them before processing a long file, since the right choice depends on how heavy and varied the noise in your recording is.

name: Make
tagline: Visual automation platform for building workflows and AI agents across thousands of apps
description: Design automations and AI agents on a visual canvas, connect thousands of apps or any API, and build by drag and drop, by prompting or from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini via MCP.
longDescription: Make is a visual automation platform, formerly known as Integromat and now part of Celonis, for connecting apps and running multi-step workflows. Users build scenarios on a drag-and-drop canvas, linking triggers and actions across thousands of prebuilt app integrations, with custom HTTP calls for anything that has an API. Newer features add AI agents that pursue goals with defined tools and limits, an AI assistant for building by prompt and an MCP server for running automations from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini. Developers can add JavaScript or Python where needed. A free plan includes a monthly credit allowance, with Core, Pro, Teams and Enterprise tiers for heavier use.
pros: Very flexible branching and data mapping
cons: Credit-based billing can be hard to predict
Complex scenarios have a learning curve
moreContext:
Make has long been a favorite of people who find simple trigger-and-action tools too limiting. Its visual canvas shows every branch, filter and data transformation in a workflow, which makes complex automations easier to reason about and debug. Recent additions bring AI agents and assistant-driven building into the same environment, so classic automations and agentic workflows can live side by side.

- The drag-and-drop canvas supports routers, filters, iterators and error handling for multi-branch logic.
- The company says thousands of apps are supported out of the box, and any API can be added through custom calls.
- AI agents work toward goals using tools and limits you define, and their reasoning is shown.
- An MCP server lets you build and trigger automations from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.
- Role-based access, audit logs and team workspaces support larger organizations.

It is best for operations teams, marketers, agencies and technically curious solo founders who want powerful automation without writing a full application. A practical tip: build and run each new scenario with a small test dataset first, then watch the execution history to see how many credits each run consumes before you schedule it to run at scale.

name: JN-AI
tagline: Conversational website builder that creates and publishes a full site from a chat
description: Describe your business in plain English or Spanish and JN-AI builds a responsive, SEO-ready website you can edit by chat, preview privately and publish on your own domain.
longDescription: JN-AI, from JN TechCorp LLC, is an AI website platform for small businesses that want a site without code. You describe your business in a conversation and it generates a complete, responsive first version, often within a minute. You can also bring an existing site through an authorized URL or uploaded files and rebuild it as an editable structure. Changes are requested in plain language or made with simple clicks, and every revision stays in a private draft until you approve it. Sites support English and Spanish with localized URLs, metadata and hreflang, and you connect a domain you already own to publish. Paid plans add custom domains, more AI credits and storage.
features: Import of an existing site from an authorized URL
Private drafts with approval before publishing
pros: Bilingual sites out of the box
cons: Free access is a short starter window
Commerce costs extra as an add-on
moreContext:
What makes JN-AI pleasant to use is how carefully it keeps the business owner in control. Every generated page and every change starts as a private draft, and nothing reaches your live domain until you approve it. Combined with native English and Spanish support, it is a practical option for local businesses serving bilingual communities.

- A single conversation produces a complete, responsive first draft of the site.
- An existing website can be rebuilt into an editable version from an authorized URL or uploaded files.
- Edits happen in plain language, or with a simple click on basic elements.
- English and Spanish versions include localized URLs, metadata and hreflang tags for search engines.
- Domain connection is guided, and the platform says it never changes DNS records automatically.

It is best for small business owners, freelancers and service providers who want a professional site without hiring a developer or learning a page builder. A practical tip: gather your logo, brand colors, service list and a few approved photos before your first conversation, since giving JN-AI real assets up front produces a draft that needs far fewer revision credits later.

name: Harvey
tagline: Enterprise AI platform for legal research, document review and agentic legal work
description: Harvey gives law firms and in-house legal teams AI agents, secure document vaults, legal and tax research, and contract intelligence in one enterprise platform.
longDescription: Harvey is an AI platform built for legal and professional services teams. Its suite includes agents that carry out multi-step legal tasks, Vault for storing and bulk-analyzing documents, Knowledge for researching legal, regulatory and tax questions, contract intelligence for review and negotiation, horizon scanning for regulatory change, intake routing and shared Spaces for collaborating across organizations. A connector library and custom MCP support let firms bring their existing tools in. Harvey serves large law firms, mid-size firms and corporate legal departments across practice areas such as litigation and transactional work. Pricing is not published, and access is arranged through a demo with the sales team.
pros: Broad suite covering research to review
cons: No self-serve plan or public pricing
Aimed at firms rather than individuals
moreContext:
Harvey has become one of the most prominent names in legal AI by building specifically for the way lawyers work rather than adapting a general chatbot. Its platform spans research, drafting support, document review and workflow orchestration, all wrapped in the security and controls that firms handling confidential client matters expect. The company reports thousands of customers worldwide, including many of the largest US law firms.

- Purpose-built agents take on complex legal tasks end to end, with review by the team.
- Vault stores and organizes large document sets for bulk analysis during diligence or discovery.
- Knowledge supports research across legal, regulatory and tax questions in multiple domains.
- Contract intelligence and horizon scanning help with negotiations and tracking regulatory change.
- Shared Spaces let firms and clients collaborate securely across organizations.

It is best for law firms, corporate legal departments and professional services organizations ready to adopt AI across many practice areas. A practical tip: start with a focused pilot, such as contract review or diligence in Vault, measure the time saved against your current process and use those results to plan a wider rollout and training program for attorneys.

name: Base44
tagline: AI app builder that turns plain-language ideas into working apps, sites and agents
description: Describe an app, website, game or AI agent and Base44 builds it with backend, authentication, database, payments and hosting already included.
longDescription: Base44 is a vibe coding platform, now part of Wix, that builds working software from natural-language descriptions. You describe an app, website, internal tool, game or AI agent, and Base44 generates it with backend, storage, authentication, payments, analytics and hosting already set up, so there are no servers or databases to configure. A visual board lets you review pages, leave notes and send instructions to the AI, while design controls apply colors and fonts across the whole app. Built-in marketing tools include an SEO and GEO dashboard. The free plan includes a small monthly credit allowance, and paid tiers add more credits, custom domains, code editing and GitHub integration.
features: Visual board for feedback and edits
pros: No setup for databases or hosting
cons: Message credits limit heavy iteration
Code editing and GitHub need a paid plan
moreContext:
Base44's main appeal is how much infrastructure it quietly handles for you. Authentication, a database, file storage, payments and hosting come ready from the first prompt, which removes the setup work that usually stalls non-developers. The result is a short path from an idea to something real users can sign in to and pay for.

- Everything needed to run an app ships built in, including backend, auth, storage, analytics and payments.
- The same prompt-driven workflow builds apps, websites, games, tools and AI agents that connect to other services.
- A shared board lets you see every page, sketch ideas and send instructions straight to the AI.
- Design settings update colors and fonts across the entire app at once.
- Built-in SEO and GEO tools help your product get found in search and AI assistants after launch.

It is best for entrepreneurs, small teams and operations staff who want to ship internal tools or customer-facing apps without hiring engineers. A practical tip: begin with a narrow first version that covers one core workflow, confirm it works end to end with real data, and only then ask the AI for extra features so your monthly credits stretch further.

name: New Lantern
tagline: Cloud radiology workspace combining worklist, image viewer and AI reporting
description: New Lantern gives radiology practices one browser-based workspace for the worklist, image viewing and AI-drafted reports, aiming to cut time spent switching between systems.
longDescription: New Lantern is a cloud platform for radiology groups that replaces separate worklist, viewer and reporting software with a single workspace. Its browser-based viewer supports 3D reconstruction, mammography, PET/CT and hanging protocols that adapt to each radiologist's preferences, while priors are linked so comparison studies scroll together. The reporting assistant, called Curie, takes dictated positive findings, places them in the right sections, fills in normal findings and drafts an impression in the reader's own style for review and sign-off. OCR pulls numbers from technologist worksheets into reports. The product is sold to practices through demos rather than self-serve plans, and also includes practice management and analytics.
pros: Combines three tools in one login
Reports drafted in the reader's style
cons: Pricing only available through a demo
Built for practices, not individuals
moreContext:
New Lantern takes on a very specific frustration: radiologists often juggle a worklist, a separate image viewer and a reporting tool that do not talk to each other well. Bringing those three pieces into one cloud workspace is the core idea, and the AI is aimed at the most repetitive part of the day, which is turning findings into a complete report.

- Curie lets a radiologist dictate only the positive findings, then fills in normal sections and drafts the impression for review.
- The viewer runs in the browser and includes 3D reconstruction, mammography layouts and PET/CT fusion.
- Hanging protocols and prior linking are designed so comparison reads need less manual setup.
- OCR pulls values from handwritten technologist worksheets for exams like DEXA and ultrasound.
- Practice analytics sit in the same login as the clinical tools.

The company says its platform is used by radiology groups in the United States, and it was backed by a Series A led by Benchmark in 2024. It is best for imaging practices that want to modernize their reading room software as a whole rather than add one more point solution. A practical tip: when you book a demo, bring a list of your most time consuming study types so you can see how the reporting drafts handle them.

name: PixNova AI
tagline: All-in-one web toolbox for AI image editing, video effects and face swap
description: PixNova AI bundles dozens of browser tools for image editing, face swap, image to video, talking photos, upscaling and room design, paid for with credit packs instead of a subscription.
longDescription: PixNova AI is a web platform that gathers a wide set of AI creative tools under one account. On the image side it covers inpainting, background blur, upscaling, photo enhancement, watermark removal, headshots, hairstyle and clothing changes and text to image, including access to third-party models. Video tools include image to video, text to video, frame interpolation, video enhancement, face swap and lip sync for talking or singing photos. There are also audio tools such as voice cloning and vocal removal, plus room and floor plan generators. Instead of subscriptions, PixNova sells one-time credit packs that do not expire, and it offers daily free credits so new users can try tools first.
features: Image to video and text to video
Face swap and talking photo lip sync
pros: Huge range of tools in one place
cons: Free credits must be used the same day
No refunds on credit purchases
moreContext:
The appeal of PixNova AI is breadth without commitment. Rather than paying for separate apps for upscaling, face swap, talking photos and quick video clips, you get a long menu of tools in one browser tab and pay only when you buy a credit pack. For casual creators who dip in and out, that one-time model can feel friendlier than another monthly bill.

- Dozens of tools span image editing, video effects, audio and even interior and garden design.
- Video options include image to video, frame to video, video extension and lip sync for photos.
- Paid credit packs are one-time purchases, and the site says purchased credits never expire.
- Every paid pack includes unlimited image generation according to the pricing page.
- Free daily credits let you test a tool before spending anything.

PixNova AI is best for social media users and small creators who want quick fun edits and short clips without learning professional software. A practical tip: claim free credits only when you have a task ready, since the site notes they expire at the end of the day, and check the per-tool credit cost before running longer video jobs.

name: ElevenReader
tagline: Read-aloud app that turns PDFs, articles and ebooks into natural audio
description: ElevenReader, from ElevenLabs, converts uploaded PDFs, documents, ebooks and articles into lifelike narration and includes a large library of audiobooks on web and mobile.
longDescription: ElevenReader is a listening app from ElevenLabs that reads text aloud using its speech models. You can upload PDFs, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown or plain text files, or open articles, then choose from more than a thousand voices and play them back at up to four times speed with bookmarks and a sleep timer. Listening syncs between web and mobile. The app also includes a catalog of audiobooks, with premium titles on the paid tier. The free plan covers about ten hours of text to audio each month, while Ultra removes most of that limit, adds offline downloads and custom voice creation, and filters headers and footers out of imported files.
features: Upload PDFs, EPUBs and docs to listen
cons: Heavy listeners will need the paid plan
Offline listening is paid only
moreContext:
ElevenReader brings the voice quality ElevenLabs is known for into a simple consumer reading app. Instead of using an API or a studio tool, you drop in a file or article and press play, which makes high quality narration practical for everyday reading, studying and catching up on long documents.

- Uploads support PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown and TXT, so most reading material works without conversion.
- Voice choice is wide, with more than a thousand options and narration across many languages.
- Playback tools include speeds up to 4x, bookmarks and a sleep timer.
- Progress syncs between the web app and mobile, so you can switch devices mid chapter.
- The Ultra plan adds smart imports that skip headers, footers and filler, plus custom voices.

ElevenReader is best for students, commuters and anyone with a backlog of PDFs or long articles they would rather hear than read, including people who benefit from audio for accessibility reasons. A practical tip: try a few voices on the same page before committing to a long book, because a voice that suits fiction may feel different on dense technical documents.

name: CodeMate AI
tagline: AI coding agent, app builder and PR reviewer with self-hosted options
description: CodeMate AI offers an in-IDE coding agent called CORA, a prompt and Figma to app builder, automated pull request reviews and a research assistant, with on-premises options for enterprises.
longDescription: CodeMate AI is a suite of developer tools from an India-based team. CORA is its coding agent for VS Code and JetBrains, handling chat, inline edits, debugging, refactoring and knowledge bases built from GitHub repositories or web pages. BUILD turns prompts and Figma designs into deployable full-stack apps in the browser, with source code download. A pull request review agent checks code quality and security on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, and Work helps with research and planning across connected tools. A free plan includes core CORA features, paid plans are priced per product, and enterprise customers can deploy on premises with custom models.
features: CORA coding agent for VS Code and JetBrains
Figma and prompt to app builder
pros: Free plan with core agent features
cons: Pricing split across several products
Smaller ecosystem than major rivals
moreContext:
CodeMate AI stands out for leaning into data control. Its pitch centers on keeping code and models where your organization wants them, with on-premises deployment and an on-device coding agent the company has demonstrated on Snapdragon laptops. For teams that cannot send source code to a public cloud, that focus is genuinely useful.

- CORA works inside VS Code and JetBrains with chat, inline edits, debugging and refactoring help.
- Knowledge bases can be built from GitHub repositories and web URLs for more relevant answers.
- The PR review agent connects to GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps.
- BUILD converts Figma designs and prompts into apps you can deploy or download as source code.
- CORA Pro can be bought by the day or week, which makes short trials inexpensive.

CodeMate AI is a good fit for developers and enterprises, especially in regulated settings, that want an AI coding stack with self-hosting options, and for educators through its Academy product. A practical tip: start on the free CORA plan inside your usual IDE, then try a single day of Pro on a real task before choosing a monthly plan or the bundled Max subscription.

name: ERNIE
tagline: Baidu's multimodal foundation models and the ERNIE Bot assistant
description: ERNIE is Baidu's family of large language and multimodal models, including ERNIE 5.0 and 5.1, available to consumers through the ERNIE Bot assistant and to developers through Baidu's cloud.
longDescription: ERNIE is the model family developed by Baidu, one of China's largest technology companies. The latest generation, ERNIE 5.0, is described by Baidu as a natively multimodal model that handles text, images, video and audio in one framework, using a mixture of experts design where only a small share of parameters is active for each token. Baidu has since released ERNIE 5.1 with upgrades to agent tasks, reasoning and writing, as well as ERNIE-Image for text to image generation. Consumers use the models through the ERNIE Bot assistant on Baidu's Wenxin site, which is aimed at Chinese-language users, while developers can access them through Baidu's cloud platform.
features: Multimodal text, image, video and audio model
cons: Consumer app is mainly in Chinese
Less English documentation than Western rivals
moreContext:
ERNIE matters because it is one of the leading Chinese model families, and Baidu has pushed it toward a single model that understands text, images, video and audio together rather than bolting separate models onto a chatbot. Baidu publishes technical reports and leaderboard updates on its ERNIE blog, which makes it easier to follow how each version changes.

- ERNIE 5.0 is presented by Baidu as a unified multimodal model trained from scratch, with a mixture of experts architecture.
- ERNIE 5.1 focuses on agent tasks, reasoning and creative writing, according to Baidu.
- Baidu reports that ERNIE 5.1 Preview ranked as the top Chinese model on the LMArena text leaderboard at the time of its release.
- ERNIE-Image adds an open-weights text to image model to the family.
- The ERNIE Bot assistant gives everyday users free access to the models.

ERNIE is best for people and businesses working in Chinese, or teams who want to compare Chinese frontier models with Western ones. A practical tip: start with the English ERNIE blog to see which model version is current, then open ERNIE Bot through the link there, using browser translation if you are not comfortable with the Chinese interface.

name: NVIDIA Nemotron
tagline: NVIDIA's open model family for building efficient agentic AI systems
description: Nemotron is NVIDIA's family of open models, including Nemotron 3 Nano and Super, with published weights, training data and recipes for building agents, retrieval and speech applications.
longDescription: NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open AI models aimed at developers building agents. Models come in Nano, Super and Ultra sizes, from compact models for focused sub-agents to larger ones for complex multi-step reasoning and tool calling. The Nemotron 3 generation uses a mixture of experts design for efficiency, and the family also includes vision language, speech recognition, text to speech, embedding, reranking and safety models. NVIDIA publishes weights, training datasets and techniques on Hugging Face under its open model license, which allows commercial use and modification. Developers can prototype on free API endpoints at build.nvidia.com or deploy optimized versions through NIM microservices.
features: Nano, Super and Ultra model sizes
pros: Commercial use allowed under open license
cons: Not a ready-made chat app for consumers
Optimized NIM deployment needs an enterprise license
moreContext:
Nemotron is notable for how open NVIDIA has made it. Alongside model weights, the company publishes training datasets and techniques, which gives developers more insight into what they are building on than many open-weight releases provide. The family is organized around agents, with sizes meant to play different roles in a larger system.

- Three tiers, Nano, Super and Ultra, cover lightweight sub-agents up to heavy multi-step reasoning.
- Nemotron 3 Super is a mixture of experts model with a long context window, released in March 2026.
- Companion models handle speech recognition, text to speech, embeddings, reranking and content safety.
- The NVIDIA Open Model License permits modification and commercial deployment of derivatives.
- Free endpoints on build.nvidia.com let you test models before setting up your own infrastructure.

Nemotron is best for developers and enterprises who want open models they can fine tune and self-host, particularly teams already running NVIDIA GPUs. A practical tip: prototype on the free hosted endpoints first to see which size meets your accuracy needs, then download that model from Hugging Face, since a smaller Nano model is often enough for narrow sub-agent tasks.

name: Quibim
tagline: AI imaging biomarkers for radiology diagnosis and drug development
description: Quibim builds AI software that turns MRI, CT and PET scans into quantitative imaging biomarkers, with diagnostic tools for prostate, brain, liver, breast and lung plus a research data platform.
longDescription: Quibim is a medical imaging AI company whose name stands for quantitative imaging biomarkers in medicine. Its clinical products, sold as software as a medical device, support radiologists in specific reads: QP-Prostate for prostate MRI with PI-RADS workflows, QP-Brain for brain volumetry and white matter lesions, QP-Liver for fat and iron quantification, QP-Breast for breast cancer detection on MRI and QP-Lung. QP-Insights is a cloud platform for storing and analyzing imaging and multi-omics data alongside health records for research. Hospitals use the diagnostic tools, while biopharma teams work with Quibim on patient selection, trial endpoints and real world evidence. Access is arranged through demos and partnerships.
features: Prostate MRI analysis with PI-RADS support
pros: Serves both clinics and pharma research
cons: No self-serve pricing
Availability depends on regional clearances
moreContext:
Quibim is interesting because it treats medical images as data to be measured, not just pictures to be read. Its software extracts quantitative markers from scans, which supports both everyday diagnosis and research questions such as which patients are most likely to respond to a therapy. That dual role sets it apart from single-purpose detection tools.

- QP-Prostate segments the gland, flags suspicious lesions and helps keep reports aligned with PI-RADS guidelines.
- QP-Brain and QP-Liver produce measurements such as brain volumes, white matter lesions and liver fat and iron levels.
- QP-Breast is described by the company as the first AI tool to detect breast cancer via MRI in Europe and the UK.
- QP-Insights manages imaging and multi-omics data for radiomics research in the cloud.
- The company says it holds ISO 27001 certification and processes data in line with HIPAA and GDPR.

Quibim is best for radiology departments that want organ-specific decision support, and for biopharma teams running imaging-heavy clinical trials. A practical tip: confirm which products carry regulatory clearance in your country before planning clinical use, since approvals differ by region and product.

name: Hot Reach AI
tagline: Writes personalized cold email first lines from LinkedIn profiles
description: Hot Reach AI generates a personalized opening line for each prospect from their LinkedIn profile URL, in single or bulk CSV mode, so outreach starts with a relevant intro.
longDescription: Hot Reach AI is a small, focused tool for cold outreach. Instead of writing whole emails, it produces the personalized first line that opens a message. You paste a LinkedIn profile URL in the browser, or upload a CSV with a column of profile URLs for bulk mode, and the service generates an intro for each prospect and appends the results as new columns in your file. Processing takes a few minutes depending on volume. It works on prepaid credits rather than a subscription, and credits are refunded automatically for any profile it cannot process. It is built and supported by an independent developer, with a free option to try it first.
features: First lines from LinkedIn profile URLs
pros: Pay as you go, no subscription
cons: Only writes the opening line
Pricing not clearly published
moreContext:
Hot Reach AI is refreshingly narrow. It does not try to be a full sales platform; it handles only the personalized intro, which is often the most tedious part of writing cold emails at volume. Because the output lands back in your own CSV, it slots into whatever sending tool you already use.

- Single mode works from one LinkedIn URL pasted into the browser.
- Bulk mode takes a CSV with a column of profile URLs and returns the same file with new first line columns.
- Credits are prepaid, so there is no monthly commitment.
- Credits are refunded automatically for any profile the tool fails to process.
- Support is handled directly by the developer through chat or X.

Hot Reach AI is best for founders, freelancers and small sales teams who already have a list and an offer, and just want a relevant hook at the top of each message. A practical tip: review a sample of generated lines before sending a whole campaign, and edit any that reference details a prospect might find too personal, since a natural tone matters more than cleverness in cold outreach.

name: TrendEdge
tagline: AI stock research with sentiment signals and a plain-English analyst
description: TrendEdge is a stock research platform for retail investors that tracks social sentiment, technical and alternative data, and includes Ask Warren, an assistant that answers market questions with cited data.
longDescription: TrendEdge is a research platform aimed at retail investors who want more context on individual stocks. It combines social sentiment from Reddit, X and StockTwits with technical indicators, fundamentals and other alternative signals across thousands of US-listed stocks. Its assistant, Ask Warren, takes plain-English questions about movers, sectors or your portfolio, shows which data sources it is pulling, and answers with prose, tables and charts drawn from platform data. Other features include AI price forecasts with a published track record, event alerts, a fear and greed index and mock trading for testing ideas. TrendEdge states that its content is for research and education, not investment advice.
features: AI forecasts with published track record
pros: Shows reasoning and sources behind answers
cons: No clear free plan
Forecasts are not investment advice
moreContext:
TrendEdge brings together the kinds of signals retail investors usually chase across many tabs: social chatter, technical charts, fundamentals and news driven events. Its most useful touch is transparency. Ask Warren shows which data it is using as it works, and the platform publishes a track record that scores its own forecasts against real market returns.

- Ask Warren answers natural language questions about stocks, sectors and portfolios with cited platform data.
- Sentiment tracking follows discussion on Reddit, X and StockTwits, including popular retail communities.
- Alerts flag market moving events such as central bank commentary.
- Mock trading lets you test strategies with simulated portfolios before risking money.
- Sector pages group stocks by themes such as semiconductors, AI and energy.

TrendEdge is best for self-directed investors who want a research starting point and like seeing the evidence behind a signal. It is not a licensed advisor, and the site itself says nothing on it is a recommendation to buy or sell. A practical tip: use the published forecast track record and the evidence breakdown to judge how much weight to give any single signal, and treat it as one input alongside your own research.

name: Reply.io
tagline: Multichannel sales outreach platform with an AI SDR agent
description: Reply.io runs automated email, LinkedIn, call and SMS sequences, adds a B2B contact database, and offers Jason AI, an agent that prospects and handles replies on your behalf.
longDescription: Reply.io is a sales engagement platform for teams that run outbound prospecting. It builds automated sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, SMS and WhatsApp, with a built-in B2B contact database, deliverability tools, reporting and integrations with CRMs through an API. Its AI SDR, Jason AI, is designed to research leads, write and send personalized messages, respond to replies and book meetings, with pricing based on active contacts rather than seats. The core plans start with email-only outreach and step up to multichannel sequences, while agencies get a dedicated tier. A 14-day trial covers the main features so teams can test sequences before paying.
features: Email, LinkedIn, call and SMS sequences
cons: LinkedIn and calls cost extra on base plan
AI SDR is priced well above seat plans
moreContext:
Reply.io has been around since the mid 2010s and has grown from an email sequencing tool into a full outbound platform. What makes it notable today is the range of options: you can run classic multichannel sequences yourself, or hand prospecting to Jason AI, an agent that writes messages, answers replies and books meetings.

- Sequences can mix email, LinkedIn steps, calls, SMS and WhatsApp in one flow.
- Jason AI is sold on contact volume with unlimited users, which suits teams that want an agent rather than more seats.
- A built-in B2B database helps find contacts without a separate data tool.
- Reporting, API access and integrations connect outreach activity to your CRM.
- A 14-day trial includes the database, multichannel sequences and integrations.

Reply.io is best for sales teams and agencies that run steady outbound programs across several channels and want automation that can scale. A practical tip: start on the email plan and warm up your sending domains properly before adding LinkedIn and call steps, since deliverability problems are harder to fix once a large sequence is running.

name: Klodsy
tagline: AI outfit planner and virtual try-on app for your own wardrobe
description: Klodsy is a mobile app that digitizes your closet, suggests outfit combinations with AI and shows how looks would appear on your own photo or a digital model.
longDescription: Klodsy is a fashion app for iOS and Android built around your existing clothes. You photograph or upload items to build a digital wardrobe, add a photo of yourself or pick a digital model with a chosen body type, and the app generates previews of outfits on that model. An AI outfit generator suggests combinations, Freestyle Mode creates looks from a text description, and Stylist Canvas arranges pieces into collages. Influencer Mode produces social-ready outfit photos, and Studio Shot turns flat-lay clothing images into product-style photos, which also suits small resellers. The app is free to download with a free first look, and a premium subscription or credit packs add more generations.
cons: Most generations require credits or premium
Mobile only for the full experience
moreContext:
Klodsy focuses on a daily problem rather than a novelty: deciding what to wear from clothes you already have. By turning your closet into a digital wardrobe and letting you see combinations on your own photo, it shifts outfit planning from trying things on to browsing previews on your phone.

- The digital wardrobe keeps clothing photos and saved outfits organized in one place.
- Virtual try-on works with your own photo or a digital model with selectable body type and gender.
- Freestyle Mode builds a look from a written description, useful for planning around an event.
- Stylist Canvas lets you arrange items into collages for mood boards or sharing.
- Studio Shot converts flat-lay photos into model shots, which the company pitches to online sellers.

Klodsy is best for people who want to get more use out of their wardrobe, plan outfits ahead for trips or events, or create content for fashion accounts and secondhand listings. A practical tip: photograph clothes on a plain background in good light when building your wardrobe, since cleaner input images usually give more convincing try-on results and save credits on retries.

name: HIX.AI
tagline: AI agent workspace for research, slides, images, video and writing
description: HIX.AI is a credit-based workspace where AI agents handle deep research, slide decks, marketing assets, images, video and long-form writing, with access to several leading chat models.
longDescription: HIX.AI started as an AI writing suite and has grown into an agent workspace that handles multi-step creative and research tasks. From one prompt it can run deep research and produce a report or slide deck, assemble marketing kits with copy, images and video, analyze spreadsheets or write long articles. The workspace includes chat access to a range of third-party models, reusable skills and scheduled tasks, and agents can coordinate several steps automatically. HIX also offers browser extensions, desktop apps and its HIX Editor for writing. A free plan includes a small monthly credit allowance, while Pro and Max subscriptions add more credits and advanced model access.
features: Deep research reports and slide decks
pros: Many content types from one prompt
cons: Small free credit allowance
Credit costs vary by task type
moreContext:
HIX.AI has shifted from a collection of writing tools into a workspace where agents take on whole projects. Ask for a product launch kit or a research briefing, and it plans the steps, gathers information, and returns finished pieces such as a report, slides, social copy and visuals. That end-to-end approach is what sets it apart from a plain chatbot.

- Deep research agents turn complex topics into structured reports or slide decks with real-time web access.
- Marketing workflows produce on-brand copy, images and video in one flow.
- The chat area offers several leading third-party models in one subscription.
- Reusable skills and scheduled tasks help repeat workflows without re-entering prompts.
- Browser extensions and desktop apps bring HIX tools into the places you already write.

The company says more than ten million people have used its products. HIX.AI is best for marketers, students and small business owners who produce many content formats and prefer one subscription over several tools. A practical tip: check how many credits slide and video generations use before starting large projects, since those cost more than chat, and use the free credits to test one complete workflow first.

name: Molmo
tagline: Ai2's fully open multimodal models for image and video understanding
description: Molmo is a family of open multimodal models from Ai2 that understand images, multiple images and video, with pointing, counting and tracking skills, plus free weights, data and a playground.
longDescription: Molmo is a family of open vision language models from Ai2, the Allen Institute for AI. The models answer questions about images, sets of images and videos, write detailed captions, and can point to or count objects, which is useful for grounding answers in what is actually on screen. Molmo 2 extends this to video tracking and long video question answering, with 4B and 8B variants and a 7B version built entirely on Ai2's open Olmo language model. Ai2 releases weights, code, evaluation tools and many of the training datasets, so researchers can inspect and adapt every part. Anyone can try the models for free in Ai2's online playground.
cons: Research focus, not a polished consumer app
Self-hosting needs GPU resources
moreContext:
Molmo stands out for how much Ai2 shares. Many open-weight models release only the final weights, but Ai2 also publishes training datasets, code and recipes, and one Molmo 2 variant uses a fully open language backbone so every component can be examined. Its pointing ability, where the model marks the exact spot it is talking about, makes answers easier to check.

- Molmo 2 handles single images, multiple images and video, including tracking objects across frames.
- Pointing and counting let the model show where things are instead of only describing them.
- The 4B and 8B models are sized to run on a strong workstation for research and prototyping.
- Ai2 released new open datasets for dense video captions, long-form video questions and tracking.
- A free playground lets anyone try the models in a browser without setup.

Molmo is best for researchers, students and developers building vision features who value transparency and want to fine tune or audit their models. A practical tip: start in the Ai2 playground with your own images or short clips to see how pointing performs on your use case, then download the matching variant from the Molmo page when you are ready to run it locally.

name: Rosebud AI
tagline: Make and share browser games by describing them to an AI
description: Rosebud AI lets you build 2D and 3D browser games, visual novels and interactive stories by chatting with an AI, with asset generators, free hosting and code export on paid plans.
longDescription: Rosebud AI is a browser-based game maker where you describe the game you want and its assistant, Rosie, writes and edits the code. You can start from templates for platformers, RPGs, cozy games, visual novels and 3D worlds, then refine by chatting. Built-in generators create 2D sprites, sprite sheets, 3D models, skyboxes, sounds and music, and AI characters can be added as NPCs. Finished games are hosted for free and can be shared, played and remixed by the community. Everything runs on credits: the free plan includes a weekly allowance, while paid tiers add private projects, in-browser code editing, commercial rights, code download and Windows export.
cons: Premium models use credits quickly
Commercial rights need 10x Dev or higher
moreContext:
Rosebud AI makes game creation feel like a conversation. Instead of learning an engine first, you describe a mechanic or a world and watch it appear in the browser, then keep adjusting it by chatting with Rosie. Pairing that with asset generators and free hosting means a playable, shareable game can come together in one session.

- Templates cover platformers, RPGs, visual novels, cozy games and 3D scenes.
- Asset tools generate sprites, sprite sheets, 3D models, skyboxes, sounds and music.
- AI NPCs can hold conversations inside your game.
- Games are hosted for free and can be remixed by other creators, which helps beginners learn from examples.
- Paid plans add private projects, code viewing, code download and Windows builds for Steam.

Rosebud AI is best for hobbyists, students, teachers and indie creators who want to prototype ideas quickly, and it offers a version for educators as well. A practical tip: remix an existing community game that is close to your idea and change it step by step, since small focused edits use fewer credits than asking for a whole new game at once.

name: Neutone Morpho
tagline: Real-time tone morphing plugin that resynthesizes any sound in a new style
description: A machine learning audio plugin for your DAW that reshapes incoming sound into a different timbre in real time while keeping its overall shape, with the option to train your own models.
longDescription: Neutone Morpho is a desktop audio plugin from Neutone that uses machine learning to resynthesize incoming audio into a different sonic character as it plays. A drum loop can come out sounding like djembe, violin or an old radio broadcast while keeping its rhythm and dynamics. Pre-processing controls change what the model hears, and post-processing shapes the result. Producers and sound designers can buy curated model packs or upload their own recordings to train a private model through a no-code dashboard, using a paid training token. It runs on macOS 12 or later and Windows 10 or 11, and Neutone lists testing in Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Bitwig, Studio One, Cubase and Reaper.
pros: Free version with five models to keep
Train models on your own sounds without a GPU
cons: Custom training needs paid tokens
Needs a fairly modern CPU such as Apple M1
moreContext:
What sets Morpho apart is that it treats machine learning as an instrument rather than a generator. Instead of producing finished tracks from prompts, it listens to whatever you feed it and plays that performance back through a new timbre, so your timing and phrasing stay yours. That makes it feel closer to a creative effect pedal than an AI music tool.

- Works live inside common DAWs, so you can automate and resample it like any other effect
- Pre-processing lets you nudge pitch, dynamics and tone to steer how the model responds
- Custom training turns your own recordings into a private model that only you can use and that you keep ownership of
- Neutone says it trains its models only on sounds it has rights to and credits sources in the model browser
- A free version with five models stays usable after the trial of the full library ends

Morpho suits producers, sound designers and experimental musicians who want unusual textures that still follow their playing. A practical tip: feed it simple, clearly articulated material first, such as a dry drum loop or a single synth line, since clean input makes it much easier to hear how each model reshapes the sound before you move on to dense mixes.

name: Clico
tagline: One AI workspace for chat, writing, images, video, music and simple web apps
description: Clico brings several third-party chat, image and video models into one workspace on the web, on Mac and as a Chrome extension, so you can research, write and create from a single prompt box.
longDescription: Clico is an AI workspace that combines chat with creative generation. From one composer you can talk to a choice of third-party language models, or let an Auto mode pick one, then switch to tools that generate images, edit photos, turn stills into video, make music, or build websites and small browser games through conversation. It comes as a web app, a Mac desktop app that works across other applications, and a Chrome extension that sits beside the page you are reading. Templates and a prompt gallery help newcomers get started. A free plan includes monthly credits and selected models, while paid plans add more credits, video tools and wider model access.
features: Access to multiple chat, image and video models
Web app, Mac app and Chrome extension
pros: Works beside other apps and web pages
cons: Video generation requires a paid plan
Credit costs vary by model and can run out quickly
moreContext:
Clico is built for people who would rather not juggle a separate subscription for every model. It gathers chat, image and video models behind one composer and lets you move from brainstorming a brief to generating visuals without switching tabs. The three ways to use it, on the web, on a Mac and as a Chrome extension, mean the assistant can follow you to wherever you are working.

- Lets you pick a specific model or hand the choice to an Auto mode
- Covers images, photo edits, image to video, music, websites and browser games from one place
- Personas shape the tone and approach of chat responses
- Ready-made templates give a quick starting point for product videos and stylized clips
- Paid plans include downloading the source of generated websites and games

Clico is a good fit for creators, marketers and curious generalists who want broad model access at a single price and enjoy experimenting across formats. A practical tip: start on the free plan to learn how many credits your usual tasks consume, especially image and video generation, before choosing between the Pro and Max tiers, since the main difference between them is the monthly credit allowance.

name: Pine AI
tagline: AI agent that makes calls to cancel subscriptions, lower bills and chase refunds
description: Pine AI handles tedious customer service tasks for you, phoning companies to cancel subscriptions, negotiate bills, dispute charges and request compensation, then reporting back on the outcome.
longDescription: Pine AI is a personal assistant agent focused on life admin that usually means long hold times. You describe what you need, such as canceling a subscription, lowering a cable or phone bill, getting a refund or fixing a travel problem, and Pine contacts the company by phone, chat or forms to work through it. It can also join a meeting on your behalf to ask prepared questions. The service runs on monthly credits, and higher plans add business negotiation and batch calling for several tasks at once. Pine says it encrypts user data and uses personal details only for the call, with approval. It is available on the web and as a downloadable app.
pros: Covers bills, refunds, travel and subscriptions
cons: Paid plans are expensive for occasional use
Outcomes depend on each company's policies
moreContext:
Most AI agents promise to save time on screen work. Pine aims at a chore almost everyone dreads: sitting on hold with a utility, airline or subscription service. Handing that conversation to an agent that keeps pushing for a refund or a lower rate is a practical, easy to understand use of AI.

- Handles common requests like cancellations, late fee waivers, refunds and bill reductions
- Can attend a vendor call and ask your prepared questions so you do not have to sit through it
- Higher plans include business negotiation and batch calling for several tasks in parallel
- The company says it keeps data encrypted and uses only essential details, temporarily and with approval
- The company reports tens of thousands of users and millions of dollars saved, figures it publishes on its site

Pine is best for busy people and small teams with a backlog of billing disputes and account changes they keep postponing. A practical tip: gather account numbers, recent bills and the outcome you want before starting a task, since giving the agent clear facts and a target makes a successful negotiation much more likely and avoids extra back and forth.

name: Endless Visual Novel
tagline: Browser storytelling game where AI generates the story, art, characters and music
description: An AI storytelling game from Helsinki studio Augnition in which the plot, characters, visuals and soundtrack of a visual novel are generated as you play, with paid tiers for building your own worlds.
longDescription: Endless Visual Novel is a story game developed by Augnition, a small research and development company in Helsinki. Instead of following a fixed script, it generates the narrative, characters, artwork and music of a visual novel on the fly as you make choices. Free players can explore AI-generated worlds and a set of Official Worlds curated by the developers. The Voyager and Creator subscriptions add world generation from short prompts, customization of characters and locations, free-text dialogue and the ability to share custom worlds. The game is played in the browser and is currently in an open alpha, so features and pricing may still change.
pros: Free tier to try the core experience
cons: Still in open alpha
Creating your own worlds requires a subscription
moreContext:
Text adventure games have used language models for a while, but Endless Visual Novel goes further by generating the whole package of a visual novel: the writing, the character art, the backgrounds and the music. The result feels closer to a traditional anime-style game than a chat window, which makes it approachable for players who enjoy the genre.

- Generates graphics, music, story and characters during play rather than ahead of time
- Official Worlds give free players a polished, developer-tuned starting point
- Paid tiers let you describe a world in a few words and have the game build it
- Free-text dialogue lets you respond in your own words instead of picking options
- Custom worlds can be shared with other players

It is best for visual novel fans, hobby writers and anyone curious about AI-driven games who wants something more structured than open-ended chat. A practical tip: begin with an Official World to learn how the game handles choices and pacing, then try the Voyager trial if you want to build your own setting, and remember that alpha software can change between sessions.

name: Textero AI
tagline: AI essay writing assistant that drafts papers with real, checkable citations
description: Textero helps students plan and draft essays and research papers with sourced citations, alongside tools for outlines, PDF summaries and essay feedback.
longDescription: Textero AI is a writing assistant aimed at students working on essays, research papers and other assignments. You describe a topic and requirements, and it drafts text supported by citations from real sources that you can review. Separate tools generate outlines, summarize uploaded PDFs, grade or review an essay and flag likely AI-written text. The site publishes pages on how the tool works, its limitations and ethical use, encouraging students to treat drafts as a starting point. A free plan includes a small daily allowance of credits, while Premium plans billed monthly, quarterly or yearly remove those limits and allow unlimited PDF uploads.
pros: Citations make sources easy to verify
Free daily credits to try it
Cheaper per month on longer plans
cons: Free plan is limited to a few credits per day
Drafts still need careful editing and fact checking
moreContext:
A common weakness of general chatbots for schoolwork is invented references. Textero puts citations at the center of its drafts, pointing to real sources that a student can open and check, which makes the output a more honest starting point for academic writing. The company also publishes guidance on limitations and ethical use rather than presenting the tool as a shortcut.

- Produces structured drafts tied to sources you can review
- Outline generator helps break a large assignment into manageable sections
- PDF summarizer speeds up reading long articles and course material
- Essay review gives feedback before you hand work in
- The company says more than 300,000 students have used it

Textero is best for high school and university students who want help getting past a blank page and organizing research. A practical tip: use the outline and PDF summary tools first to shape your own argument, then treat any generated draft as raw material to rewrite in your own voice, and always open each cited source to confirm it supports the claim, since your school's academic integrity rules still apply.

name: Docus AI
tagline: AI health assistant for lab result explanations, with tools for doctors and labs
description: Docus offers an AI doctor chat and lab test interpretation for individuals, plus separate platforms that help clinicians and diagnostic labs explain results and plan follow-ups.
longDescription: Docus AI is a health technology platform built around explaining medical information. Individuals can ask health questions in an AI doctor chat and upload lab results for plain-language interpretation of biomarkers, with long-term memory of past conversations. A doctor platform adds an AI medical assistant, a research assistant, generated SOAP notes and AI-assisted patient messaging. For diagnostic labs, Docus provides software that produces clinical and patient-friendly reports, suggests follow-up tests and sends reminders. Paid second opinions from human doctors are offered separately. Free plans exist for individuals and doctors, with paid tiers raising message and patient limits, while lab pricing is quoted on request.
pros: Free plans for patients and doctors
cons: Not a replacement for a doctor's diagnosis
Free patient plan allows only a few messages per week
moreContext:
Lab reports are full of abbreviations and reference ranges that leave many people confused. Docus focuses on turning those numbers into explanations people can follow, and it extends the same idea to clinicians and labs so the patient and the professional work from a shared understanding of a result.

- Upload a lab report and get a plain-language breakdown of each biomarker
- Long-term memory keeps context from earlier conversations and results
- Doctors get an AI assistant, research help and auto-drafted notes and reports
- Lab software produces both clinical reports and patient-friendly versions
- Paid second opinions from human specialists are available separately from subscriptions

Docus is most useful for people who want to understand their test results before or after an appointment, and for small practices or labs looking to speed up result communication. A practical tip: bring the AI explanation and any questions it raises to your own physician rather than acting on it alone, since an AI summary works best as preparation for a conversation with a professional who knows your history.

name: MagicQuill
tagline: Open-source image editor that turns brush strokes into precise AI edits
description: A research image editing system from HKUST and Ant Group where you sketch to add, remove or recolor parts of a picture and a multimodal model guesses your intent and suggests the prompt.
longDescription: MagicQuill is an interactive image editing system presented at CVPR 2025 by researchers from HKUST, Ant Group and partner universities. Instead of writing long prompts, you draw on an image with simple strokes to add an element, erase an object or change a color. A multimodal language model reads those strokes, predicts what you want and fills in a suggested prompt, and a diffusion model then applies the local edit. The code is open source with a Gradio interface, Docker setup and a ComfyUI custom node, and it runs on GPUs with about 8 GB of VRAM. Hosted demos on Hugging Face and ModelScope let you try it without installing anything.
features: Stroke-based add, erase and recolor edits
Hosted Hugging Face and ModelScope demos
pros: Edits stay local to the area you draw
cons: Local use needs a capable GPU
Research project with no formal product support
moreContext:
Most AI image editors still depend on wording a prompt just right. MagicQuill flips that around by letting your brush strokes carry the intent, then asking a multimodal model to work out what you meant. Drawing a rough shape and having the system suggest what it should become feels more natural than describing a change in text.

- Three focused brush types cover adding content, removing objects and changing colors
- The guessing feature proposes a prompt from your sketch, which you can accept or edit
- Changes are applied only to the region you mark, leaving the rest of the image intact
- A ComfyUI node lets it slot into existing node-based workflows
- The team has since released a MagicQuill V2 with layered editing controls

MagicQuill is a great match for hobbyists, illustrators and researchers who are comfortable with open-source tools and want fine control over local edits. A practical tip: try the Hugging Face demo first to see whether the stroke workflow suits you, and if you install it locally, turn off the automatic prompt guessing on slower machines, as the project notes this can speed things up considerably.

name: Writers Brew
tagline: Mac writing assistant that rewrites, replies and translates in any app
description: A macOS app that brings AI writing presets, text utilities, snippets and OCR to any text field, using your own OpenAI key, for a one-time license fee.
longDescription: Writers Brew is a native macOS writing assistant that works wherever you can type. You highlight text in any app and trigger it from a keyboard shortcut, the menu bar, a Spotlight-style launcher or integrations with Raycast and PopClip. It offers more than 30 AI writing presets for rewriting, summarizing, explaining, replying and translating, and you can save your own prompts as presets. Alongside the AI features it includes non-AI text utilities such as find and replace or line sorting, a TextExpander-style snippets system with fillable forms, and OCR to pull text from images. It uses your own OpenAI API key and is sold as a lifetime license.
pros: One-time purchase instead of a subscription
Works across native, browser and Electron apps
cons: Requires your own OpenAI API key
macOS only
moreContext:
Writers Brew stands out by combining an AI writing helper with the small text tools that Mac power users often buy separately. One shortcut can rewrite a paragraph, while another expands a snippet or extracts text from a screenshot, all without leaving the app you are in. Because it relies on your own OpenAI key and a one-time license, it can work out much cheaper than subscription writing tools for light or moderate use.

- Highlight and transform text in practically any macOS app, including browsers and Electron apps
- Build your own presets so recurring prompts are a keystroke away
- Snippets support smart placeholders like the date or clipboard, plus custom form fields
- Utilities handle quick jobs such as extracting emails, sorting lines and changing case
- The developer reports thousands of paying users

Writers Brew suits Mac users who write a lot of email, notes and documents and like keyboard-driven workflows. A practical tip: set a monthly usage limit in your OpenAI account before connecting your key, and create a few personal presets for the replies or edits you make most often, since that is where the app saves the most time.

name: CastReader
tagline: Read-aloud browser extension for web pages, Kindle books, PDFs and AI chats
description: A text to speech extension for Chrome and Edge that reads articles, Google Docs, Kindle books and PDFs aloud in natural voices, and can explain dense text in another language.
longDescription: CastReader is a browser extension for Chrome and Edge that turns on-screen text into speech. With one click it reads web articles, Google Docs, Kindle books in the browser, PDFs, uploaded Word or text files and replies in AI chat tools, scrolling the page as it goes. Beyond word-for-word reading, a Quickread mode explains the content in the language you prefer while a moving pen highlights key points, which helps with research papers and foreign-language news. Users can also create a personal voice clone. The free plan includes daily listening minutes and a few explanations, and the Pro plan adds unlimited listening, more premium voices, MP3 export and device sync.
features: One-click read aloud on most sites
pros: Free plan needs no login to start
cons: Free listening capped at 20 minutes a day
Currently limited to Chrome and Edge
moreContext:
Plenty of extensions can read a web page aloud, but CastReader adds a twist that is genuinely useful for learners: it can explain what it is reading instead of only reciting it. Hearing a dense paper or a French news story summarized in plain English, with a moving pen marking the key points, makes difficult material easier to follow.

- Works on articles, Google Docs, Kindle web books, PDFs and AI chat replies
- Quickread mode explains content across languages rather than translating word for word
- Personal voice cloning lets you listen in a voice you create yourself
- Pro adds unlimited listening, faster playback, MP3 export and sync across devices
- Free use starts without creating an account

CastReader is a strong pick for students, researchers, language learners and anyone who reads a lot on screen or benefits from listening for accessibility reasons. A practical tip: try Quickread on a long or technical article you have been putting off, and keep the regular read-aloud mode for content you want to hear in full, since switching between the two depending on the material gets the most out of the free daily minutes.

name: Sakana Fugu
tagline: Multi-agent system from Sakana AI delivered as a single model API
