description: Sakana Fugu coordinates a pool of frontier models behind one OpenAI-compatible API, routing and combining them to handle coding, reasoning and other complex multi-step tasks.
longDescription: Sakana Fugu is a product from Tokyo-based Sakana AI that packages a multi-agent system as if it were one model. Rather than fixing roles or workflows by hand, Fugu learns to assemble agents from a pool of strong models and coordinate them for each request, an approach grounded in the company's research on learned model orchestration. Developers call it through an OpenAI-compatible API, so existing clients and coding tools work by changing the endpoint and key, and it is also offered through services such as OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway. Variants include Fugu, Fugu Ultra, Fugu Max and a security-focused Fugu Cyber. It is not yet available in the EU or EEA.
features: Variants for speed, quality and security
pros: One API instead of many vendor integrations
Control over which models join the pool
cons: Not available in the EU or EEA
No free tier mentioned
moreContext:
Sakana Fugu takes an unusual angle on the race between model vendors. Instead of training one bigger model, Sakana AI built a system that learns how to combine several existing frontier models and presents the result through a single endpoint. For teams worried about depending on one provider, that design is appealing in its own right.

- Works with existing OpenAI-style clients by swapping the base URL and API key
- Handles model selection and switching per task, which simplifies integrations
- Lets you exclude specific providers or models to meet privacy or compliance needs
- Offers variants tuned for low latency, maximum quality, cost-performance or cybersecurity work
- Builds on two research papers the company presented at ICLR 2026

Fugu is best for developers and engineering teams building coding agents or reasoning-heavy workflows who want strong results without managing several model contracts. A practical tip: start with the default Fugu variant for everyday requests and reserve Fugu Ultra for genuinely hard multi-step problems, since the company notes Ultra trades longer response times for quality and costs more per token.

name: Outplay
tagline: Sales engagement platform with AI research, multichannel outreach and coaching
description: Outplay helps sales teams automate prospecting with AI-written sequences across email, phone, social and SMS, plus account research agents, a dialer and revenue intelligence.
longDescription: Outplay is a sales engagement and automation platform for outbound teams. Reps build multichannel sequences that combine email, calls, LinkedIn and SMS, with AI help for writing emails and full sequences. A custom sales agent can research accounts before outreach, while a built-in dialer, centralized inbox and CRM integrations keep activity in one place. For managers, Outplay adds conversation coaching and revenue intelligence that flags deal risks. A free forever plan covers manual email outreach and click-to-dial for individuals, and paid tiers add unlimited emails, more channels, a power dialer and team permissions, each with a seven-day free trial.
pros: Covers email, phone, social and SMS
cons: Multichannel features start on the per-user Growth tier
Feature-rich setup takes time to learn
moreContext:
Outplay brings together the pieces outbound teams usually stitch from separate tools: sequencing, dialing, research and coaching. Its newer AI features, such as a sales agent that researches accounts before reps reach out, aim to cut the time spent searching so more of the day goes to actual conversations.

- Sequences can mix email, calls, LinkedIn steps and SMS in one cadence
- AI writing helps draft both single emails and full sequences
- Built-in dialer, voicemail drop and centralized inbox reduce tool switching
- Revenue intelligence highlights deal risks for managers
- Customers often mention responsive support, and the company says thousands of salespeople use it

Outplay is a good fit for startups and mid-sized sales teams that want enterprise-style sales engagement without the price of the biggest platforms. A practical tip: begin with the free plan or a seven-day trial using a single short sequence and your own CRM connected, so you can check deliverability and reporting before rolling it out to the whole team and committing to per-user pricing.

name: Relevance AI
tagline: Platform for building and running teams of specialist AI agents across a business
description: Relevance AI lets companies design, deploy and monitor teams of AI agents for sales, support and operations work, with an assistant called Invent that helps turn processes into agents.
longDescription: Relevance AI is an enterprise platform for building an AI workforce of specialist agents. Teams map out workflows such as pre-meeting research, nurturing inbound leads or escalating at-risk renewals, then build agents that carry out those tasks using tools, triggers and more than 2,000 integrations. Invent, the platform's AI solutions engineer, helps non-technical staff identify what to automate and turn their expertise into reliable agents that improve over time. The platform includes calling and meeting agents, evaluations, A/B testing, analytics, SSO, role-based access and audit logs. An embedded deployment team helps customers launch their first agents, and pricing is arranged through sales.
cons: Pricing is not published
Aimed at companies rather than individuals
moreContext:
Relevance AI focuses less on single chatbots and more on whole teams of agents that take over defined pieces of work. Its pitch is that the people who know a process best, rather than engineers, should be able to turn that knowledge into agents, and the Invent assistant is designed to guide them through it.

- Invent helps spot automation opportunities and build agents from plain descriptions
- Agents connect to more than 2,000 integrations and can run on enterprise triggers
- Calling and meeting agents extend automation beyond text-based tasks
- Evaluations, A/B tests and analytics help teams check that agents perform reliably
- SSO, role-based access and audit logs support security and compliance reviews

Relevance AI is best for sales, customer success and operations leaders at growing companies who want to scale output without adding headcount. A practical tip: start with one narrow, repetitive workflow such as preparing meeting briefs, measure the time saved with the built-in analytics, and only then expand to multi-agent processes, which matches the phased rollout the company itself recommends.

name: LogoCreatorAI
tagline: AI logo generator for startups and solopreneurs with pay-per-logo credits
description: LogoCreatorAI generates logo concepts from a chosen style, concept and colors, delivering transparent PNG files you can download from your dashboard, priced with credit packs.
longDescription: LogoCreatorAI is a simple web tool that uses AI to produce logo designs for startups, freelance designers and solopreneurs. After signing in with an emailed magic link, you choose a style, describe a concept and pick colors, and the tool generates up to ten logos in one batch. Each result is a 1024 by 1024 PNG with a transparent background that you download from your dashboard. Pricing uses credit packs rather than a subscription, with one credit per logo, and the site recommends generating several options because AI results vary. It is meant for quick concept work rather than full brand identity systems.
cons: No vector files mentioned
Results vary and may need several tries
moreContext:
LogoCreatorAI keeps logo generation refreshingly simple. There is no long brand questionnaire or bundled website builder, just a few choices about style, concept and color followed by a batch of options. For founders who need a placeholder mark or a starting point to brief a designer, that directness is a real time saver.

- Generates multiple concepts at once so you can compare directions side by side
- Delivers transparent PNG files ready to drop onto slides, websites or social profiles
- Credit packs mean you pay only for the logos you generate, with no recurring fee
- Magic link sign-in avoids yet another password
- Designers can use it to spark ideas before refining a concept by hand

LogoCreatorAI is best for early-stage startups, side projects and solopreneurs who want fast, affordable logo ideas. A practical tip: follow the site's own advice and generate three or four logos per idea with small changes to the concept wording, then take your favorite to a vector editor or a designer if you need scalable files for print or signage.

name: TalkingAvatar
tagline: Lip-synced talking avatars, voice cloning and video redubbing from one app
description: TalkingAvatar turns photos, designs or your own footage into lip-synced talking avatars, with voice cloning, video redubbing and a live avatar that can stand in for your webcam.
longDescription: TalkingAvatar is an avatar and voice tool from DreamWorld Limited that produces lip-synced talking-head videos. Users can pick an avatar from a library, design a new one, turn a photo or product image into an avatar, or upload their own video and have it rewritten and redubbed with a cloned voice. A streaming mode lets an AI double replace the camera feed in apps such as Zoom, Twitch and TikTok while it lip-syncs to the user's voice. It can also take NotebookLM podcast audio, split the speakers and match each to an animated face. It runs online and as a Windows download, with a free tier and paid credit plans.
features: Photo to avatar and avatar designer
Voice cloning with a voice library
Live avatar for Zoom and streaming
pros: Covers avatars, voice and dubbing in one place
Webcam replacement mode for meetings and streams
Free tier with no card required
cons: Paid plan prices are not shown clearly on the site
Voice and face cloning calls for care with consent
moreContext:
What sets TalkingAvatar apart is how many ways it gives you to put a speaking face on content. Rather than only offering stock presenters, it lets you start from a photo, a product shot, a designed character or your own existing video, then pair it with a cloned or library voice. The live streaming mode is an unusual extra that goes beyond prerecorded clips.

- Redub and rewrite older videos with a cloned voice instead of reshooting them
- Stream mode lets an AI double lip-sync to your voice in Zoom, Twitch or TikTok
- One-click faces for NotebookLM style podcast audio, with speakers matched automatically
- Product avatar and photo to avatar options for marketing and ecommerce clips
- Available both in the browser and as a Windows app

It is best for creators, marketers and educators who want talking-head videos or multilingual versions of existing clips without booking a camera session. A practical tip: start on the free tier with a short script, and only clone voices or faces you own or have clear permission to use, since the tool is capable of convincing results.

name: HeriBase
tagline: Coin and banknote identifier app with values, expert appraisals and collection tools
description: HeriBase, formerly HeritCoin, identifies coins and banknotes from photos, shows reference values and lets collectors request paid expert appraisals and track their collections.
longDescription: HeriBase is a mobile app for coin and banknote collectors, previously known as HeritCoin. You photograph both sides of a coin and the AI suggests a match, which you then confirm against the date, lettering, design and mint mark. The app shows reference prices, tracks the estimated value of your collection over time and offers a 3D view for rotating and sharing coins. For harder cases, users can pay for appraisals from named numismatic specialists, and a marketplace supports buying and selling with other collectors. It is available on iOS and Android, with free daily scans and an optional subscription.
features: Reference values and collection value tracking
pros: Honest guidance on checking each match
Human experts available for tricky pieces
cons: Expert appraisals cost extra
Subscription pricing is shown only in the app
moreContext:
HeriBase stands out for how carefully it frames what a photo match can and cannot tell you. Its help center explains that a suggested identification still needs to be checked against the coin in hand, and it publishes the scope of its own accuracy testing rather than making blanket claims. That makes it a thoughtful companion for collectors at any level.

- Identifies both coins and banknotes from photos of each side
- Tracks the estimated value of a whole collection over time
- Optional paid reviews from numismatic specialists in areas such as euro, U.S. and world coins
- A marketplace for buying and selling with other collectors
- 3D collection views that can be rotated and shared

It is best for hobby collectors, people sorting an inherited coin jar and anyone curious whether a piece is worth a closer look. A practical tip: shoot both sides in even light with the whole coin in focus, then compare the date and mint mark yourself before trusting a value, and use an in-hand grading service before any significant sale.

name: Gauth
tagline: AI homework helper with step-by-step solutions, live tutors and visual learning
description: Gauth solves homework questions from a photo or typed prompt with step-by-step explanations, and adds live tutors, courses and a visual exploration tool called Atlas.
longDescription: Gauth is a study app and website, formerly known as Gauthmath, that helps students work through homework in math, calculus, chemistry, biology, business and social science. Students upload or paste a question, and Gauth AI returns a worked solution broken into steps with notes on how and why each step follows. When the AI explanation is not enough, students can reach human tutors around the clock. Gauth Atlas turns topics into zoomable visual explanations tied to sources, and the Academy section offers courses. Basic use is free, while Gauth Plus adds unlimited answers and more features for a monthly fee.
features: Live human tutors around the clock
pros: Covers math and many science subjects
Explains the reasoning behind each step
Human tutor option when AI falls short
cons: Unlimited answers require a subscription
Easy to lean on answers instead of learning
moreContext:
Gauth combines fast AI answers with a few extras that make it more than a solver. Each solution is laid out in steps with short explanations of the logic, and students can escalate to a live tutor when a problem still does not click. The newer Atlas feature adds a visual way to explore a subject, with images linked back to sources.

- Snap or paste a question and get a worked solution in seconds
- Step-by-step explanations that cover both how and why
- Human tutors available at any hour for extra help
- Atlas lets students zoom into topics visually and follow their curiosity
- Covers calculus, chemistry, biology, business and more, not just basic math

It is best for high school and college students who want to check their work or see how a tricky problem breaks down. A practical tip: try the problem first, then use Gauth to compare your steps and find exactly where you went wrong, which builds far more skill than copying the final answer.

name: Healing Journey
tagline: Around-the-clock AI therapy chat for stress, anxiety and relationship worries
description: Healing Journey offers private, judgment-free chats with AI therapist personas for anxiety, stress, relationships and habits, available at any hour in up to 10 languages.
longDescription: Healing Journey is a web platform, currently in beta, where people can talk through what they are feeling with AI therapist personas at any time of day. It is designed for everyday struggles such as stress, anxiety, relationship strain and unwanted habits, and it aims to offer a judgment-free space to vent, reflect and get coping suggestions. The company says conversations are encrypted and anonymous, that its model is a custom fine-tune, and that mental health professionals supervise the approach. It supports up to 10 languages. New users can start with free sessions, and paid plans add more options.
features: Several therapist personas to choose from
pros: Available late at night when others are not
Low-pressure space to put feelings into words
cons: Not a replacement for licensed care or crisis support
Paid plan prices are not published on the site
moreContext:
Healing Journey is built around a simple idea: sometimes you just need somewhere to put your thoughts into words, right now, without worrying about being judged. Its chat interface is calm and low pressure, and it is available at hours when friends or a regular therapist may not be. The team frames it as a complement to human care rather than a substitute.

- Always-on access for late-night worry or a stressful workday
- Conversations the company says are encrypted and anonymous
- Topics range from anxiety and stress to relationships and habits
- Up to 10 languages for people more comfortable outside English
- Free sessions so you can see if the format suits you

It is best for adults who want a private outlet to reflect, vent or practice coping strategies between other forms of support. A practical tip: use it alongside, not instead of, a qualified professional, and if you are ever in crisis or thinking about self-harm, contact a local emergency number or crisis line right away.

name: Deforum
tagline: Open-source Stable Diffusion toolkit for keyframed AI animation
description: Deforum is an open-source project that uses Stable Diffusion to create evolving AI animations, mainly through a feature-rich extension for the AUTOMATIC1111 WebUI.
longDescription: Deforum is a community-built, open-source toolkit for making animations with Stable Diffusion. It began as a Google Colab notebook and grew into an extension for the AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI, which is now its most complete version. Artists write prompts that change over time and control 2D and 3D camera motion with math-based keyframes, with depth models for 3D movement, video input for style transfer and frame upscaling. Companion tools include Parseq for audio-synced keyframing. The extension is free under the AGPL license and runs locally on your own GPU or in Colab. Its hosted Deforum Studio web app is not accepting new users.
pros: Very fine control over motion and timing
cons: Steep learning curve for new users
Needs a capable GPU or Colab setup
moreContext:
Deforum earned its reputation as one of the early tools behind the dreamlike, morphing AI animations seen in music videos and visual art. Its strength is control: instead of a single prompt and a button, you script how prompts, zoom, rotation and camera paths change frame by frame. That depth has kept it popular with artists who want a specific look and are happy to experiment until a sequence feels right.

- Math-based keyframing for zoom, angle, translation and strength
- 3D motion using depth estimation for a sense of camera travel
- Video input mode for restyling existing footage
- Parseq support for syncing motion to music and beats
- Open-source code under the AGPL license with an active community

It is best for digital artists, VJs and musicians who are comfortable with Stable Diffusion and want frame-level creative control. A practical tip: start from a shared community settings file and change one parameter at a time, rendering short low-resolution tests before committing to a full-length animation, since long renders can take a while.

name: OpenManus
tagline: Open-source Python framework for building general-purpose AI agents
description: OpenManus is an MIT-licensed, open-source framework from MetaGPT contributors for building general AI agents that browse the web, call tools through MCP and run multi-agent flows.
longDescription: OpenManus is an open-source project for building general-purpose AI agents, started in March 2025 by contributors from the MetaGPT team as an open alternative to invite-only agent products. It is written in Python and is configured with a TOML file where you add the model, endpoint and API key of the LLM you want to use. Agents can automate a browser, connect to external tools through the Model Context Protocol, and optionally run a data analysis agent. An experimental multi-agent flow coordinates several agents on one task. It is free under the MIT license and runs locally or in Docker.
features: General agent you can run locally
pros: Works with your choice of LLM provider
cons: Requires Python setup and your own API keys
Multi-agent mode is still marked unstable
moreContext:
OpenManus grew out of a simple goal: give developers a general-purpose agent they can run and modify themselves, without waiting for an invite. The project quickly became one of the most watched agent repositories on GitHub, and it remains a practical starting point for anyone who wants to see how a tool-using agent is put together, from planning steps to calling tools and reading results.

- Clear, readable Python code that is easy to study and extend
- Bring your own model through an OpenAI-style configuration
- Built-in browser control and MCP support for connecting tools
- Optional data analysis agent for charts and quick reports
- Docker support for keeping experiments isolated

It is best for developers, researchers and tinkerers who want a hackable agent framework rather than a polished consumer app. A practical tip: run it inside Docker or a separate virtual environment with a spending limit on your API key, and start with small, well-defined tasks so you can watch how the agent plans before trusting it with longer jobs.

name: Brave Leo AI
tagline: Privacy-focused AI assistant built into the Brave browser
description: Brave Leo is an AI assistant built into the Brave browser that summarizes pages, answers questions and drafts text without requiring an account, with an optional Premium tier.
longDescription: Brave Leo is the AI assistant inside the Brave browser on desktop, Android and iOS. Users can ask it to summarize the page in the current tab, explain a PDF or Google Doc, translate text, draft emails and essays, or help with code, and it can draw on Brave Search for current information. Brave says Leo does not retain chats or use them to train models, and no account is needed. It offers models from several providers, temporary chats, local chat history, tab organization and a Bring Your Own Model option for local or remote models. Leo is free, and Leo Premium adds more models and higher limits.
features: Chat with any open tab or PDF
pros: No account needed for the free tier
cons: Only available inside the Brave browser
Best models and higher limits need Premium
moreContext:
Brave Leo puts an assistant right where people already read and research: the browser tab. You can ask about the page in front of you, summarize a long document or have it draft a reply without copying text into a separate app. What makes it distinct is Brave's privacy approach, with no login required and a stated policy of not keeping chats or training on them.

- Summarize or question any webpage, PDF, Google Doc or Sheet
- Answers enhanced with Brave Search for fresher information
- Bring Your Own Model lets you plug in local or remote models
- Temporary chats that disappear when closed
- Tab organization that groups pages by topic

It is best for Brave users and privacy-minded readers who want quick help with what they are browsing. A practical tip: type a question in the address bar and choose Ask Leo for the fastest access, and try the free tier for a while before upgrading, since Premium mainly adds more models and higher usage limits.

name: CorpusIQ
tagline: Source-cited business answers from your own data inside ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity
description: CorpusIQ connects business systems such as Shopify and QuickBooks to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Slack, so you can ask about sales, ads or cash and see where each number came from.
longDescription: CorpusIQ is a data layer that lets AI assistants answer questions about a company's own numbers. After authorizing connectors to tools such as Shopify and QuickBooks, users ask questions in plain English inside ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Slack, and CorpusIQ returns an answer with its sources and the calculation rules applied, such as removing refunds from revenue. It connects through the Model Context Protocol, and its connectors are read-only, so it does not change the underlying systems. The company says it does not train models on customer data. Plans start at a monthly price for one user, all with the full set of 40+ connectors and a 30-day free trial.
features: Answers with sources and calculation rules
Works in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Slack
cons: Paid after the trial, priced per seat
Depends on a separate AI assistant subscription
moreContext:
CorpusIQ tackles a real pain point for small teams: asking an AI assistant about revenue or ad spend and not knowing whether to trust the answer. Instead of a new dashboard, it brings your business data into the assistants people already use, and it shows where each figure came from and which rules were applied. That transparency is its standout quality.

- Ask questions in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Slack instead of learning a new tool
- Source-cited answers that show the systems and fields behind each number
- Saved definitions, so metrics like revenue are counted your way every time
- Read-only connectors that do not alter your connected systems
- MCP server access for teams that want to wire it into other clients

It is best for founders, ecommerce operators and finance or marketing leads at small and mid-sized businesses who want quick, trustworthy answers without a data team. A practical tip: start with the demo company, then set up your key metric definitions early, since consistent rules are what make the answers dependable over time.

name: HitPaw AI Audio Enhancer
tagline: Desktop AI tool that cleans noise, echo and distortion from recordings
description: HitPaw AI Audio Enhancer, part of HitPaw VoicePea for Windows and Mac, removes background noise, hum and echo from recordings and helps restore and normalize audio.
longDescription: HitPaw AI Audio Enhancer is a feature of HitPaw VoicePea, the company's desktop audio app for Windows and Mac. It uses AI to reduce background noise, hums, hisses and echo, repair distorted or damaged recordings, balance frequencies and keep volume levels consistent. Users can adjust settings for each file and process several files at once, working with common formats such as MP3 and WAV. HitPaw also offers a browser-based version for quick fixes without installing software. It is aimed at podcasters, streamers, video creators and anyone cleaning up meeting or interview audio. A free download is available, with paid monthly, yearly and perpetual licenses.
features: AI noise, hum and echo removal
pros: Online version for quick one-off fixes
cons: Full features require a paid license
Bundled in a larger voice app you may not need
moreContext:
For recordings made in less than ideal conditions, this tool offers a straightforward way to rescue them. It sits inside HitPaw VoicePea, so the same app that handles voice changing also offers a focused cleanup tool for noisy podcasts, echoey rooms and hissy interviews. The appeal is that it hides the technical side behind a few clear options.

- Removes background noise, hums, hisses and room echo in one pass
- Repairs distortion and damage in older or clipped recordings
- Processes several files at once to save time on big batches
- Adjustable settings for when the default result is too strong
- A browser-based option for quick fixes without installing anything

It is best for podcasters, streamers, video creators and remote workers who need cleaner voice audio without learning a full editing suite. A practical tip: run a short test clip first and compare it with the original on headphones, then dial back the strength if voices start to sound thin, since lighter cleanup often sounds more natural.

name: i10X
tagline: One subscription for leading chat, image and video models plus a task agent
description: i10X bundles chat access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others with image and video generation, a Superagent for multi-step tasks and a custom agent builder.
longDescription: i10X is an AI workspace that gathers many leading models behind a single subscription. Users can chat with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Perplexity, Meta and others, and switch between them within the same platform. Its Superagent handles multi-step jobs such as building a slide deck, drafting a marketing campaign or running deep research. The platform also includes image and video generation, more than 500 prebuilt mini-agents, a builder for custom agents and chatbots, knowledge bases and over 100 integrations with email, meetings and documents. A free plan offers limited daily use of basic models, while paid plans add monthly credits.
features: Chat with many leading LLMs in one place
pros: Free plan for trying basic models
cons: Credit system takes time to understand
Top plans get expensive for heavy use
moreContext:
i10X is built for people tired of juggling separate logins and invoices for every AI model. It places a wide range of chat models alongside image and video generators in one workspace, so comparing answers or switching tools does not mean switching apps. The Superagent and mini-agents add a layer of automation on top of plain chat.

- Access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and more under one plan
- Superagent that can produce decks, campaigns and research reports
- Image and video generation using several well-known models
- More than 500 ready-made mini-agents plus a custom agent builder
- Knowledge bases and 100+ integrations for working with your own files and tools

It is best for freelancers, marketers and small teams who use several AI tools every week and want them consolidated. A practical tip: start on the free plan to learn how credits are consumed by different models, then pick a paid tier based on your real usage, since image and video generation draw down credits much faster than text chat.

name: Altered
tagline: Speech-to-speech voice changer for content creation and live calls
description: Altered changes a recorded or live voice into a different curated or custom voice while keeping the original timing and inflection, with a studio app for media work and a real-time changer for calls.
longDescription: Altered builds voice AI around speech-to-speech morphing, where you perform a line yourself and the software re-renders it in another voice. Altered Studio is the content creation app: it brings voice morphing together with text to speech, voice cloning and other voice tools in one editor aimed at media production. RealTime Pro is a separate low-latency changer for voice and video calls that can shift perceived age, gender and accent, offers voice skins for games and VR avatars, isolates the speaker from background noise and includes voice restoration for people with dysphonia. A free plan gives a few minutes of morphing each month under an attribution license, with paid Creator and Professional plans for commercial work.
features: Real-time changer for voice and video calls
Local voice cloning and text to speech
pros: Keeps the pacing and emotion of your own delivery
Covers both offline production and live calls
Free plan to test voice morphing
cons: Free plan allows only 3 minutes of morphing a month
Listed paid prices are billed annually
moreContext:
Most voice tools start from typed text, which can flatten timing and emotion. Altered takes the opposite approach: you act out the line, and the software swaps the voice while holding onto your pacing, pauses and inflection. That makes it a good fit for anyone who wants performance control but needs a different sounding voice, whether for a character, a narrator or an anonymized speaker.

- Speech-to-speech morphing that follows your own delivery rather than a script
- A studio app that groups morphing, text to speech and cloning in one place
- A separate real-time product for voice and video calls with low latency
- Accent conversion aimed at call centers and voice skins aimed at gamers
- Voice restoration features intended for people living with dysphonia

Altered is best suited to podcasters, game and animation teams, and voice performers who want to direct a take themselves and then change who it sounds like. A practical tip: record your source lines in a quiet room with a consistent microphone distance, since cleaner input gives the morphing engine more to work with and reduces artifacts in the converted voice. The free plan requires attribution and limits commercial use, so check the license before publishing client work.

name: TRELLIS
tagline: Microsoft's open source model family for generating 3D assets from images
description: TRELLIS is Microsoft Research's open source 3D generation project. Its latest release, TRELLIS.2, turns a single image into a textured 3D mesh with PBR materials that can be exported as GLB.
longDescription: TRELLIS is a research project from Microsoft that generates 3D assets with a structured latent representation. The original model, presented as a CVPR 2025 spotlight paper, produced assets from text or image prompts in several output formats. TRELLIS.2 is a 4 billion parameter image-to-3D model built on a sparse voxel format called O-Voxel, aimed at shapes with complex topology and sharp details. It outputs meshes with base color, roughness, metallic and opacity maps, and can also texture an existing 3D shape. Code and weights are released under the MIT license, with a Hugging Face demo for quick tests. Running it locally needs Linux and an NVIDIA GPU with at least 24GB of memory.
features: Textured meshes with full PBR material maps
GLB export and a hosted Hugging Face demo
pros: Open source code and weights under MIT
Strong handling of fine detail and complex shapes
Free to try through the online demo
cons: Local use needs a 24GB NVIDIA GPU on Linux
Research tooling with no polished end-user app
moreContext:
Many image-to-3D services are closed products built on models you cannot inspect. TRELLIS stands out because Microsoft published the research, code and weights openly, so developers and studios can run it themselves, study how it works or build it into their own pipelines. The second generation focuses on cleaner geometry and complete material maps, which matters when assets need to drop into a game engine or renderer without heavy cleanup.

- MIT license for both the model and the code, which allows commercial experimentation
- PBR outputs that include roughness, metallic and opacity, not just a color texture
- A sparse voxel design intended to preserve sharp edges and complex topology
- A separate texturing workflow for meshes you already have
- A public Hugging Face Space for testing before installing anything

TRELLIS is best for technical artists, researchers and developers who are comfortable with Python and GPUs and want a capable open model rather than a subscription tool. A practical tip: start with the hosted demo using a clean, well-lit product shot on a plain background, and only set up a local install once you know the results suit your style. Note that unofficial sites use the TRELLIS name, so get the code from Microsoft's own GitHub and project pages.

name: Logo Diffusion
tagline: AI logo generator that works from prompts, sketches or photos and exports vectors
description: Logo Diffusion creates logos from a text prompt, a rough sketch or a photo, lets you edit single elements with a magic editor, and exports clean SVG vectors, transparent PNGs, mockups and short logo animations.
longDescription: Logo Diffusion is a logo design tool built around generative AI. You can start from a few words, upload a hand-drawn sketch to turn into a finished mark, or convert a photo of a face or product into a logo. A library of preset styles covers looks such as line art, mascots, monograms, badges and engraved designs, and style transfer can pick up the texture of any reference image. The magic editor changes only the part you describe, so a design can be refined step by step. For delivery there is a vectorizer that outputs grouped SVG shapes, a logo-aware background remover, generated mockups and logo animation. A free plan gives a small monthly credit allowance with watermarked previews.
features: Text, sketch and image to logo
pros: Real vector files instead of only raster images
Sketch input keeps your own concept in charge
Commercial license stays after you cancel a paid plan
cons: Free downloads are small and watermarked
Free generations are public with no commercial license
moreContext:
A lot of AI logo makers stop at a pretty PNG, which leaves the hard part of vectorizing and cleanup to you. Logo Diffusion is designed around the full path from idea to usable brand file. You can steer it with a sketch rather than only a prompt, adjust one element without regenerating the whole design, and leave with SVGs made of grouped shapes rather than messy auto-traced fragments.

- Three starting points: text, a sketch or a photo of a person or object
- A large set of preset logo styles plus style transfer from any reference image
- Targeted edits that leave the rest of the design untouched
- A background remover tuned to keep thin letterforms intact
- Generated mockups and animation for presenting a logo to clients

Logo Diffusion is best for freelancers, small agencies and founders who want more control than a template logo maker offers but do not want to draw every mark from scratch. A practical tip: sketch the rough layout of your idea on paper, photograph it and use Sketch to Logo, since a simple drawing usually communicates composition far better than a long prompt. Remember that free plan outputs are public, so keep client concepts on a paid plan.

name: Agent Opus
tagline: AI video agent from OpusClip that turns ideas, scripts or audio into social videos
description: Agent Opus, from the team behind OpusClip, generates complete short videos from an idea, a script or an audio file, using remixable formats and your brand assets to produce ads, explainers and story videos.
longDescription: Agent Opus is a video generation product from Opus, the company behind the OpusClip clipping tool. Rather than cutting existing long videos, it creates new short videos from scratch. You start with an idea, a script or an uploaded audio track, and the agent assembles a finished video with visuals, voice and pacing aimed at social platforms. A library of formats such as AI ads, explainers, personal narratives, audio-to-video and B-roll enhancement can be remixed as starting points. Brand assets, voice and style can be uploaded once so later videos and ad variants stay consistent. Pricing is credit based, with a small free allowance and paid Pro and Max plans that add custom avatars and voice clones.
features: Idea, script or audio to finished video
Brand kit for consistent ad variants
Custom avatars and voice clones on paid plans
pros: Generates new videos rather than only clipping old ones
Format library gives a fast starting point
Free tier to test before paying
cons: Free credits cover only a couple of short videos a month
Listed plan prices assume annual billing
moreContext:
OpusClip made its name by finding the best moments inside long videos. Agent Opus applies that same focus on social performance to a different job: making a video when you have no footage at all. You give it an idea, a script or a voice recording, and it handles the visual assembly, which lowers the effort for creators and marketers who need a steady stream of short content.

- Several entry points, including turning an existing audio track into a video
- Ready-made formats for ads, explainers and narrative videos that can be remixed
- Brand assets uploaded once and reused so videos look consistent
- Automatic ad variants for testing different versions of a campaign
- Monthly credits that roll over for an extra month on monthly plans, according to the help center

Agent Opus is best for solo creators, small brands and performance marketers who want regular short-form videos without filming or editing. A practical tip: set up your brand assets and preferred voice before generating anything, then start from one of the built-in formats close to your goal, since a strong template usually needs fewer credits to reach a usable result than a blank prompt.

name: Wondershare Repairit
tagline: Repairs corrupted videos, photos and documents and restores old photos with AI
description: Wondershare Repairit fixes damaged video, photo, audio, Office, PDF and archive files on Windows, Mac or online, and adds AI tools for photo restoration, colorization and video and image upscaling.
longDescription: Wondershare Repairit is file repair software from Wondershare, the company behind Filmora. Its core job is fixing files that will not open or play properly: videos from cameras, drones and phones, including recordings cut off by power loss, plus photos, audio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF documents, and ZIP or RAR archives. The company says it supports more than 100 formats and can process files in batches. Alongside repair, Repairit includes AI features for restoring and colorizing old photos, enhancing faces, upscaling video and images, and removing objects or watermarks. It runs as a desktop app for Windows and Mac and as an online service, and repaired files can be previewed before purchase.
features: Repair for video, photo, audio and document files
AI old photo restoration and colorization
pros: Handles many file types in one tool
Available on Windows, Mac and the web
cons: Saving repaired files requires a paid license
Pricing varies by platform and is not shown clearly up front
moreContext:
A corrupted wedding video or a spreadsheet that refuses to open is stressful, and generic editing tools rarely help. Wondershare Repairit focuses on that specific problem, then layers AI enhancement on top so you can not only recover a file but also improve how it looks. Being able to preview the repaired result before buying is a fair way to judge whether it can rescue your particular file.

- Broad format coverage across video, photos, audio, Office files, PDFs and archives
- Batch processing for repairing many clips or images at once
- Advanced repair mode that uses a healthy sample file from the same device
- AI photo restoration, colorization and face enhancement for old prints
- Desktop apps for Windows and Mac plus a browser-based online version

Repairit is best for photographers, videographers and everyday users who need to recover damaged media or documents without technical knowledge. A practical tip: work on a copy of the damaged file rather than the original, and if a video from a camera or drone will not repair normally, try advanced mode with another clip recorded on the same device and settings, since the sample helps rebuild missing structure.

name: Hidden Door
tagline: AI story game platform for playing and building interactive fiction worlds
description: Hidden Door lets you play AI-narrated stories set in worlds such as Dracula, Sherlock Holmes and Oz, chat with characters, play with friends, and build and share your own story worlds.
longDescription: Hidden Door is a story game platform from a Brooklyn team founded in 2020 by Hilary Mason and Matt Brandwein. Players step into worlds built from classic and contemporary fiction, including Dracula, Sherlock Holmes, Pride and Prejudice, The Call of Cthulhu and The Land of Oz, and make choices while an AI narrator keeps the story consistent with the setting, its characters and its rules. Formats include interactive fiction, private character chats, social games with friends, comics and audio series. Creators can build their own worlds in the Atlas studio or start from a one-line idea, and publish them publicly or share with friends. Playing the catalog is free, while a Creator subscription is needed to make and share worlds.
features: AI-narrated stories in established fiction worlds
Atlas studio for building your own worlds
pros: Free unlimited play across the catalog
Narration respects each world's rules and cast
Tools for writers to publish their own worlds
cons: World creation and sharing need a paid plan
Creator plan pricing is not listed publicly
moreContext:
Open-ended AI storytelling can drift quickly, with characters forgetting who they are and plots losing their shape. Hidden Door tries to solve that by grounding play in defined worlds that carry their own characters, relationships and rules, so a story in a Victorian mystery still feels like a Victorian mystery several scenes later. It also treats authors as partners, giving them tools to build worlds that other people can play.

- A catalog of worlds based on well-known fiction, from gothic horror to Oz
- Several ways to play, including solo fiction, character chats and group games
- An instant world feature that expands a one-line idea into a playable setting
- A dedicated world-building studio for writers and creators
- Free play across every world, with paid features reserved for creators

Hidden Door is best for readers, tabletop roleplayers and writers who enjoy guided storytelling more than freeform chatbots. A practical tip: begin with a world based on a book you already know well, because familiarity makes it easier to see how the narrator stays faithful to the source, and then try the instant world prompt to sketch a setting of your own.

name: YouCam Makeup
tagline: Virtual makeup, hair and outfit try-on app with AI photo editing
description: YouCam Makeup, a consumer app from Perfect Corp., lets you try on makeup, hairstyles, hair colors and outfits virtually, retouch and reshape selfies, and use AI tools such as an editing agent and image-to-video effects.
longDescription: YouCam Makeup is a mobile beauty and photo app from Perfect Corp. Its augmented reality camera previews lipstick, blush, eyeshadow, foundation and eyeliner live, and hundreds of full makeup looks can be applied in one tap. Beyond makeup, it offers hairstyle and hair color try-on, an AI clothes changer, face retouching such as blemish and wrinkle removal, face and body reshaping, and creative AI tools for text-to-image, image-to-image, headshots and short animated videos. An AI agent can carry out edits and give beauty suggestions from plain-language requests. The app is free to download on iOS and Android, with a Premium subscription that removes ads and opens exclusive looks and unlimited photo features.
features: Hairstyle, hair color and outfit try-on
AI agent for edits and beauty advice
pros: Large library of makeup looks and shades
Free core filters and retouch tools
Available on both iOS and Android
cons: Many looks and tools sit behind the Premium paywall
Subscriptions auto-renew and cannot be canceled mid-period
moreContext:
Trying a bold lipstick or a new hair color in real life takes time and money, and Perfect Corp. built its reputation on beauty AR that lets you preview those choices first. YouCam Makeup is the company's consumer app, and it puts the same face tracking work behind a fun everyday camera, then adds a growing set of generative AI tools for editing and creating images.

- A live camera that applies makeup in real time rather than only on still photos
- Hair, hairstyle and outfit try-on in the same app as makeup
- Detailed retouching for skin, eyes, nose, lips and face shape
- An AI agent that performs edits from typed or spoken requests
- Generative extras such as AI headshots and short animated photo effects

YouCam Makeup is best for beauty fans, content creators and shoppers who want to experiment with looks before buying products or booking a salon. A practical tip: test shades in the live camera under natural daylight rather than indoor lighting, because color accuracy on screen changes a lot with the light in the room. Check the subscription terms in your app store before starting a trial, since plans renew automatically.

name: Image to 3D AI
tagline: Online 3D model generator from images, multi-view shots, text or sketches
description: Image to 3D AI is a web tool that turns photos, multi-view images, text prompts or sketches into textured 3D models using Hunyuan3D and Tripo3D, with extra tools for textures, 3D text and file conversion.
longDescription: Image to 3D AI is a browser-based service for creating 3D models without modeling software. You upload a single image or several views of the same object, type a text prompt or draw a sketch, and the site generates a textured model using third-party engines including Hunyuan3D and Tripo3D. Paid plans add PBR materials, control over face count and export format, and a private license for generated assets. The site also bundles helper tools: an AI texture generator, a 3D text generator, a 3D file converter and an online viewer. It targets game developers, 3D printing hobbyists, designers and educators. New accounts receive free credits plus a small daily login bonus, with monthly plans and one-time credit packs.
features: Image, multi-view, text and sketch to 3D
Choice of Hunyuan3D or Tripo3D engines
PBR materials and custom face counts
pros: No software install or modeling skills needed
Several input methods in one place
Free signup credits and daily bonus credits
cons: Relies on third-party models rather than its own
Textured models use many credits per generation
moreContext:
Getting a usable 3D model used to mean hours in Blender or a photogrammetry rig with dozens of photos. Image to 3D AI packages several modern generation engines behind one simple web page, so you can go from a single picture or a quick sketch to a downloadable model in minutes. Offering a choice between engines is handy, since each tends to handle different kinds of objects better.

- Four ways to start: one image, multiple views, a text prompt or a sketch
- Access to Hunyuan3D and Tripo3D from a single account
- Paid options for PBR materials, face count and export format
- Extra utilities for textures, 3D text, file conversion and previewing
- One-time credit packs for occasional users who do not want a subscription

Image to 3D AI is best for indie game developers, makers preparing files for 3D printing and designers who need quick concept models. A practical tip: use the multi-view option when you have photos of the object from the front, side and back, because extra angles reduce guesswork about hidden surfaces and usually give cleaner geometry than a single image.

name: GOODY-2
tagline: Satirical chatbot that politely refuses to answer anything at all
description: GOODY-2 is a parody AI chatbot from the art studio BRAIN that treats every question as too risky to answer, poking fun at overcautious AI guardrails with elaborate, deadpan refusals.
longDescription: GOODY-2 is a satirical chatbot made by BRAIN, a Los Angeles art studio led by Mike Lacher and Brian Moore, and launched in early 2024. It works like a normal chat interface, but its single rule is that it will not help with anything. Ask it a simple math question, why the sky is blue or for a road trip plan, and it explains in earnest, formal language why answering could cause harm. The project is a comment on the tension between safety and usefulness in AI assistants, and it drew coverage from outlets such as TechCrunch, Wired and NPR. It is free to use in the browser and needs no account.
features: Sample prompts to start a conversation
Short promotional film explaining the joke
pros: Sharp, memorable commentary on AI guardrails
Useful conversation starter for AI ethics talks
cons: Intentionally provides no useful answers
Novelty wears off after a few prompts
moreContext:
Not every AI project is meant to be productive. GOODY-2 is a deliberately useless chatbot, and that is the point: by refusing every request with a polished justification, it turns a common frustration with AI assistants into a running joke. The creators said they built it after noticing how hard it is to balance responsibility with helpfulness, and the result is a thoughtful piece of satire you can actually talk to.

- A working language model interface rather than a static parody page
- Refusals that are carefully reasoned, which makes the humor land
- A clear illustration of what happens when caution outweighs usefulness
- No account, cost or setup needed to try it
- Made by BRAIN, a studio known for playful interactive projects

GOODY-2 is best for teachers, speakers and teams discussing AI safety who want a light way to open the conversation, and for anyone who enjoys tech humor. A practical tip: try asking it something completely harmless, such as a basic fact or a recipe, and compare its answer with a mainstream assistant, since the contrast is what makes the commentary clear. Do not expect it to complete real tasks.

name: Article.Audio
tagline: Paste an article link and listen to it as natural-sounding audio
description: Article.Audio converts web articles into spoken audio from a pasted link, with a long list of languages and regional voices, so you can listen to reading material instead of scrolling through it.
longDescription: Article.Audio is a simple text-to-speech web app from Thundercontent, a maker of AI content tools. You paste the link to an online article, pick a language and a voice, and the service extracts the text and reads it aloud as audio you can play in the browser. The language menu covers more than 100 languages and regional variants, from several Arabic and English dialects to Bengali, Catalan and Burmese, with multiple named voices to choose from. Support for pasted text, PDF documents and photos is listed as coming soon for Pro users. Signing in with Google or email is required, and a Pro upgrade is offered for the full feature set.
pros: Very quick to use with just a link
Helpful for reading on the go or eye strain
cons: Text, PDF and photo inputs are not live yet
Pro pricing and free limits are not published
moreContext:
Long reads pile up in browser tabs, and not everyone has time to sit and read them. Article.Audio keeps the idea of listening to the web as simple as possible: paste a link, choose a voice and press play. There is no editor to learn or project to set up, which makes it a handy option when you just want to hear a single article during a commute or a workout.

- One-step conversion from an article URL to spoken audio
- A long list of languages and regional accents for non-English content
- Several voices per language so you can pick a comfortable listening style
- Runs entirely in the browser after a quick sign in
- Built by Thundercontent, which also makes other AI writing and audio tools

Article.Audio is best for students, busy professionals and people who prefer listening to reading, including those who find long screen reading tiring. A practical tip: match the voice's regional variant to the article's origin, such as a British English voice for a UK publication, because pronunciation of names and places tends to sound more natural. For heavier use or document uploads, compare it with fuller text-to-speech apps.

name: Endel
tagline: Personalized adaptive soundscapes for focus, relaxation and sleep
description: Endel generates endless, personalized soundscapes for focus, relaxation, sleep and activity that adapt in real time to signals like time of day, weather, location and heart rate.
longDescription: Endel is a sound wellness app that uses generative AI to compose audio environments instead of playing fixed tracks. You choose a mode such as Focus, Relax, Sleep or Activity, and the app builds an ongoing soundscape that changes with inputs like the time of day, local weather, location, walking pace and, on supported devices, heart rate. Timed scenarios and binaural beats are available for structured sessions, and there are dedicated programs for people with ADHD. Endel runs on iOS, Android, Apple Watch, Mac and Windows, on the web, and on Alexa, Apple TV and Fire TV devices. It has collaborated with artists including James Blake. Access is through a paid subscription.
features: Focus, Relax, Sleep and Activity modes
Real-time adaptation to time, weather and heart rate
Apps for phone, watch, desktop, web and TV
pros: Sound never repeats like a looping playlist
Available on almost every device type
Research-backed approach to focus and calm
cons: Requires a paid subscription after any trial
Prices vary by region and plan
moreContext:
Focus playlists eventually become familiar enough to distract you, and sleep tracks end just as you drift off. Endel avoids both problems by generating sound continuously, shaping it around what time it is, what the weather is doing and, with a watch, how your body is responding. The company frames this work around neuroscience and has published a whitepaper on its focus results, and it says the app has been downloaded more than 4 million times.

- Generative soundscapes that keep evolving instead of looping
- Context signals such as weather, location, movement and heart rate
- Programs designed with ADHD and attention in mind
- Broad platform support, including a standalone Apple Watch app and smart speakers
- Artist collaborations that bring a musical edge to functional sound

Endel is best for remote workers, students and light sleepers who want background sound that supports a routine without choosing tracks. A practical tip: try the timed scenarios for work sessions, which pair a set focus period with a break, rather than leaving a soundscape running all day, and review the subscription terms in your app store before a trial ends since plans renew automatically.

name: UnboundAI
tagline: All-in-one AI studio for social posts, product photos, copy and graphics
description: UnboundAI bundles AI tools for social media templates, product photography scenes, marketing copy and graphic design in one workspace for creators and small businesses.
longDescription: UnboundAI is a web-based content platform that gathers several generative AI tools in one place. Users can build social media posts from templates for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and X, create product photos by uploading one image and describing a new background, generate blog posts, sales emails and ad copy, and design graphics from text prompts. It also includes chat-based consultants for marketing, business, design and other topics. The platform says it combines well-known image and language models with its own models. A free plan comes with monthly credits, while paid tiers add more credits, premium presets, photo tools and project exports for individuals and teams.
features: AI copywriting for ads and emails
pros: Many content tools under one login
cons: Credit limits on lower tiers
Team features still rolling out
moreContext:
Small teams often juggle separate apps for captions, product shots and social graphics. UnboundAI tries to collapse that stack into a single workspace, so a shop owner or freelancer can move from an idea to a ready-to-post asset without switching tools.

- The Scene Builder turns one uploaded product photo into new styled shots by describing the setting you want.
- Social templates cover the major networks, which helps keep sizes and layouts right for each platform.
- Copywriting tools handle common marketing formats such as blog posts, cold emails, ad text and thread ideas.
- Chat consultants offer quick guidance on marketing, business and design questions alongside the creative tools.
- A free plan with monthly credits makes it easy to test the workflow before paying.

UnboundAI is best for solo founders, ecommerce sellers and social media managers who want broad coverage rather than one specialized tool. A practical tip: use the free credits to try the product photo builder with your best-selling item first, since that feature tends to show the clearest time savings compared with a traditional photo shoot.

name: Avaturn
tagline: Turn a selfie into a realistic, rigged 3D avatar for games and apps
description: Avaturn creates realistic 3D avatars from a single photo, with customizable looks and exports for Blender, Unity and Unreal, plus SDKs for adding avatar creation to your own product.
longDescription: Avaturn is a 3D avatar creator that uses generative AI to turn a 2D selfie into a recognizable 3D character. Users can adjust body type, hairstyle, clothing and accessories, then export the avatar as a 3D model for tools such as Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, Maya and Cinema 4D. Avatars ship with a standard humanoid rig, ARKit blendshapes and visemes, so they work with Mixamo animations and VTubing software. For developers, Avaturn offers plugins for web, Unity, Unreal, iOS and Android along with an API and SDK, letting games, metaverse projects and marketing campaigns invite users to create their own in-experience characters.
features: Web, Unity, Unreal and mobile SDKs
cons: Developer Pro plan is costly
Full body scans need Enterprise
moreContext:
Getting a convincing likeness into a game or virtual space usually requires a 3D artist. Avaturn shortens that path to a single selfie, then hands back an avatar that is already rigged and ready to animate in the tools studios rely on.

- Photo-based generation produces avatars that resemble the person rather than a generic cartoon.
- A standard humanoid rig with ARKit blendshapes and visemes supports facial animation, lip sync and Mixamo motion.
- Exports work with Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, Maya and Cinema 4D, which fits existing pipelines.
- Plugins for web, Unity, Unreal, iOS and Android let players create themselves inside your experience.
- Branding, custom garments and your own user management are available on the developer plan.

Avaturn is best for game studios, metaverse builders and agencies running interactive campaigns who want user-generated avatars without building the technology in-house. A practical tip: create a test avatar from a well-lit, front-facing photo first, then load it into your target engine to confirm the rig and materials behave as expected before committing to a paid integration.

name: AnyLogo
tagline: AI logo maker that also builds a brand kit, mockups and social graphics
description: AnyLogo generates logo concepts from your brand name across several AI image models, then turns the chosen design into a brand kit, mockups and social media graphics.
longDescription: AnyLogo is an AI branding tool for founders and creators who need a logo and matching identity quickly. Users type a brand name, pick preferred styles, and the tool generates options using several AI image models side by side so different directions can be compared. A selected logo can be refined in plain language, adjusting colors, layout and details. From there, AnyLogo builds a brand kit with color palettes and typography, places the logo into photorealistic mockups, and produces social media graphics. The site also lists logo animation and brand video tools. New accounts receive free credits to try the workflow before buying more.
features: Logo options from multiple AI models
Brand kit with colors and fonts
pros: Compares several model styles at once
Goes beyond the logo to full branding
cons: Paid pricing is not clearly published
Results still need a designer's eye
moreContext:
Many logo generators stop once a mark is on screen. AnyLogo treats the logo as the first step, carrying the chosen design straight into the colors, fonts, mockups and social assets a new brand needs to look consistent from day one.

- Running one prompt across several AI image models gives a wider spread of visual directions to choose from.
- Refinement happens in plain language, so changing colors or layout does not require design software.
- The brand kit gathers palettes and typography that match the selected logo.
- Mockups place the logo into realistic scenes, which helps judge how it looks on real products.
- Extra tools for logo animation and brand videos extend the identity into motion.

AnyLogo is best for founders, side-project builders and small creators who need a credible identity quickly and on a modest budget. A practical tip: generate options in two or three contrasting styles before refining, because comparing very different directions early makes it easier to spot the look that genuinely fits your brand.

name: Claude in Chrome
tagline: Anthropic's browser extension that lets Claude read pages and act across your tabs
description: Claude in Chrome is Anthropic's official extension that lets Claude read the page you are on, then click, type and fill forms to complete web tasks while you stay in control.
longDescription: Claude in Chrome is a browser extension from Anthropic that brings Claude directly into Google Chrome. It can read the page you are signed in to and then navigate, click, type and fill in forms to carry out multi-step tasks, such as pulling numbers from an analytics dashboard or gathering research across several sites. Tasks can run in the background while you work on something else. The extension connects with other Anthropic products: it can hand web research to Claude Cowork to produce reports or spreadsheets, and pair with Claude Code to test web apps during development. It is available to subscribers on Claude's paid plans.
features: Reads and summarizes the current page
Works with Claude Code and Cowork
pros: Acts inside sites you are signed in to
Ties into the wider Claude ecosystem
cons: Requires a paid Claude plan
Chrome only
moreContext:
Copying text between tabs and a chatbot is slow, and Claude in Chrome removes that step. Because it works inside the browser you already use, Claude can see the same pages you see and take actions on them, turning a description of a chore into a series of clicks and form entries.

- It works within sites where you are already signed in, so it can reach dashboards and web apps you rely on.
- Background tasks keep running while you move on to other work.
- Pairing with Claude Cowork turns browser research into finished documents, spreadsheets or decks.
- Developers can connect it with Claude Code to test and iterate on web apps in a real browser.
- Anthropic designed it so you decide what happens next, keeping a person in the loop on actions.

Claude in Chrome is best for Claude subscribers who spend much of the day in web apps and want help with repetitive research and data entry. A practical tip: start with read-only jobs such as summarizing or extracting data from a dashboard, then move on to form filling once you are comfortable with how it handles your sites.

name: TradeOS
tagline: Build AI trading agents that watch markets and flag setups matching your rules
description: TradeOS turns trading rules written in plain language into AI agents that monitor stocks, forex, commodities and crypto around the clock and flag setups that fit your plan.
longDescription: TradeOS is an AI trading workflow platform for retail and professional traders. Users describe their strategy, technical indicators and risk rules in everyday language, and the platform builds agents that watch markets continuously and flag setups that match. It supports tools such as MACD, RSI, ATR breakouts, support and resistance zones, multi-timeframe analysis and chart patterns, and the company says it covers more than 13,000 assets across stocks, commodities, forex and crypto. TradeOS states that it does not predict prices or place trades for you, leaving every decision with the trader. Plans start with a free trial, and team and enterprise options include API access.
pros: Clear stance that decisions stay with you
cons: Not a broker or auto-trader
Research credits cap heavy use
moreContext:
Writing trading scripts is a barrier for many traders who know exactly what setup they want to see. TradeOS lets them describe that setup in ordinary words and hands the watching to AI agents, which is useful for anyone who cannot sit in front of charts all day.

- Strategies are written in plain language instead of code, covering indicators, timeframes and risk rules.
- Agents keep monitoring markets around the clock and flag matches against your own criteria.
- The company says coverage spans over 13,000 stocks, commodities, forex pairs and crypto assets.
- Multi-timeframe analysis and spread charts are included on higher tiers.
- TradeOS states plainly that it does not forecast prices or guarantee returns, which keeps expectations realistic.

TradeOS is best for self-directed traders who rely on technical analysis and want an assistant that watches for their setups rather than one that trades for them. A practical tip: begin with one well-defined strategy during the free trial and compare its alerts with your own chart reading before adding more agents. As with any trading tool, it is not financial advice.

name: Tugan.ai
tagline: Team of AI marketing agents that create and publish content across your channels
description: Tugan.ai learns your product from a link, then uses a set of AI agents to plan, create, schedule and publish marketing across social, email, SEO and ads.
longDescription: Tugan.ai is an AI marketing service aimed at apps, SaaS products, online courses and shops. Users paste a link, and the system studies what is being sold and who buys it. Six specialized agents then share the work: a strategist drafts the plan, a scout finds trending posts in the niche, a director proposes ideas, a critic checks drafts for robotic tone, an operator schedules and publishes, and an analyst doubles down on what performs. Supported channels include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, email, SEO, AI search and ads. Posts go to an approval inbox by default, with optional autopilot per channel.
features: Publishing across social, email and SEO
pros: Covers many channels in one service
Starts from just a product link
cons: Premium pricing for small businesses
Less hands-on creative control
moreContext:
Keeping several marketing channels active every day is hard for small product teams. Tugan.ai approaches the problem as a staffing question, assigning distinct AI agents to planning, research, ideas, review, publishing and analysis so content keeps flowing while founders keep building.

- Onboarding begins with a single link, and the agents work out the product and audience from there.
- A dedicated critic agent reviews drafts to cut generic, machine-sounding writing.
- Channel coverage runs from short-form video and social networks to email, SEO, AI search and ads.
- An approval inbox keeps a human in charge, with autopilot available channel by channel.
- The analyst agent shifts effort toward the content that brings results.

Tugan.ai is best for app makers, SaaS founders, course creators and shop owners who want consistent multichannel marketing without hiring a full team. A practical tip: keep the approval inbox on for the first few weeks and edit drafts freely, since your feedback is the quickest way to bring the voice closer to your brand before switching any channel to autopilot.

name: ChartPixel
tagline: Upload a spreadsheet and get AI charts, written insights and slide-ready exports
description: ChartPixel turns Excel and CSV files into cleaned data, charts with plain-language explanations, forecasts and a chat interface for asking questions about your data.
longDescription: ChartPixel is a no-code data analysis tool from a London-based company. Users upload Excel or CSV files, pull tables from websites or connect sources such as Typeform, and the platform cleans the data, chooses columns and chart types, and produces visualizations across more than twenty chart formats, including maps. Each chart comes with a written explanation and key takeaways supported by statistics, along with forecasts, statistical tests and comment sentiment analysis. A chat feature answers questions about the dataset. Results can be shared by link, embedded or exported to PowerPoint. The company says it does not train on user data. A free plan covers one project.
pros: Says it does not train on your data
cons: Free plan limited to small files
Row and column caps on lower tiers
moreContext:
Many people have data but little time or training to analyze it. ChartPixel focuses on that gap, taking a raw spreadsheet and returning cleaned data, sensible charts and written explanations that point out what actually matters, so beginners can get useful answers without learning a BI tool.

- Automatic cleaning and column selection remove much of the tedious preparation before charting.
- Every chart comes with plain-language takeaways backed by statistical checks, so findings are easier to explain to others.
- Forecasting, statistical tests and sentiment analysis of text comments go beyond basic charting.
- PowerPoint export with one click makes it easy to drop results into a presentation.
- The company states it does not train on user data or send raw data to outside language models.

ChartPixel is best for students, researchers, survey creators, journalists and small business owners who need quick, explained analysis of tabular data. A practical tip: tidy your column headers before uploading, because clear names help the tool pick better chart types and produce more accurate written insights.

name: NVIDIA Cosmos
tagline: Open world foundation models and tools for building physical AI systems
description: NVIDIA Cosmos is an open platform of world foundation models, datasets and tooling that helps developers build and train AI for robots, autonomous vehicles and video analytics.
longDescription: NVIDIA Cosmos is a development platform for physical AI, the kind of AI that powers robots, autonomous vehicles and industrial vision systems. It provides open world foundation models that can reason about video, simulate environments, generate synthetic training data and support robot policy development. The current generation is offered in several sizes for data center and edge use. Around the models, NVIDIA supplies tools for curating data, building datasets, evaluating results and tokenizing video, along with post-training scripts. Developers can download models and datasets from Hugging Face and GitHub, try them in an online playground, and deploy them as APIs through NVIDIA NIM. The models use an open license.
pros: Strong NVIDIA tooling around the models
Multiple sizes from edge to data center
cons: Needs serious GPU resources
Aimed at specialists, not casual users
moreContext:
Training robots and self-driving systems on real-world footage alone is slow and expensive. NVIDIA Cosmos gives developers world models that can understand and simulate physical environments, so teams can generate training data and test behavior in ways that would be costly or risky to capture for real.

- Open world foundation models cover reasoning about video, simulating worlds and generating synthetic data.
- Several model sizes target everything from large data center runs to edge devices.
- Supporting tools for curation, dataset building, evaluation and tokenization cover much of the data pipeline.
- Post-training scripts on GitHub help teams specialize models for their own robots or vehicles.
- NVIDIA NIM provides a path from experimentation to production APIs on NVIDIA hardware.

NVIDIA Cosmos is best for robotics engineers, autonomous vehicle teams and computer vision researchers who already work with GPU infrastructure. A practical tip: try the smallest model in NVIDIA's online playground before downloading weights, which gives a quick sense of whether Cosmos fits your use case before you commit compute time.

name: Maia
tagline: AI relationship app that helps couples talk, resolve conflicts and plan time together
description: Maia is an iPhone app for couples that offers a shared private space to chat or talk with an AI guide about conflicts, communication and plans, plus quizzes, games and date ideas.
longDescription: Maia is an AI relationship app designed for two partners to use together. Couples share a private space where they can chat with Maia by text or voice, whether for a quick daily check-in or a harder conversation about something that has been bothering them. The app draws on relationship research and therapeutic frameworks to offer suggestions for resolving disagreements, communicating better and planning shared experiences. It also includes quizzes and games, conversation prompts, joint goals and reminders for important dates. Maia aims to serve new couples, long-distance pairs and married partners alike. The iPhone app is free to download, with premium features offered through in-app purchases.
features: Shared chat and voice space for couples
cons: iPhone only
Not a substitute for a licensed therapist
moreContext:
Most AI chat apps are built for one person at a time. Maia is designed around the couple, giving two partners a shared, private space where an AI guide can help them talk through tension, check in regularly and find fresh ways to spend time together.

- Text and voice conversations let couples choose between quick check-ins and longer guided sessions.
- Suggestions draw on relationship research and therapeutic frameworks, according to the company.
- Quizzes, games and conversation prompts give partners low-pressure ways to learn more about each other.
- Joint goals and reminders for special dates help keep shared plans on track.
- Its advice adapts as the couple keeps using the app together.

Maia is best for couples who want a structured, approachable way to communicate more often, whether they are newly together, long-distance or married for years. A practical tip: try a short voice session on a small, low-stakes topic first, so both partners get comfortable with the format before bringing bigger issues to it. For serious relationship difficulties, a licensed counselor remains the right resource.

name: OpenAI Playground
tagline: OpenAI's browser workspace for testing prompts, models and settings before coding
description: OpenAI Playground is a web interface on the OpenAI developer platform for trying prompts, system instructions, tools and model parameters before moving them into API code.
longDescription: OpenAI Playground is part of the OpenAI developer platform and gives builders a browser-based place to experiment with OpenAI models without writing code. Users pick a model, write system instructions and messages, and adjust parameters such as temperature and maximum output length to see how responses change. The Playground supports defining tools and function calls, saving prompts with variables for reuse, and comparing outputs from different models side by side. Once a prompt behaves as intended, developers can carry the configuration into their application through the API. Access requires an OpenAI platform account, and usage is billed against API credits at standard per-token rates.
pros: Quick path from test to API
cons: Usage billed as API credits
Limited team collaboration features
moreContext:
Before building on a language model, developers need a fast way to see how a prompt behaves. OpenAI Playground provides that sandbox directly on the OpenAI platform, so a prompt, a set of instructions and a choice of model can be tested and tuned in the browser before anyone writes integration code.
