- Parameter controls such as temperature and output length make it easy to see how settings shape responses.
- System instructions and multi-turn messages let you rehearse realistic conversations with a model.
- A compare view runs the same prompt across models to judge quality, tone and cost tradeoffs.
- Tool and function definitions can be tested before wiring them into an application.
- Saved prompts with variables help teams reuse tested setups.

OpenAI Playground is best for developers, product managers and prompt engineers who are prototyping features on OpenAI models. A practical tip: set a monthly spending limit in your platform billing settings before heavy experimentation, since every Playground request draws on the same API credits as production traffic.

name: Refraction
tagline: AI coding helper for bug checks, tests, docs, refactors and code conversion
description: Refraction generates unit tests, documentation, regexes, SQL and CI/CD configs, detects bugs and converts code between languages, with extensions for popular editors.
longDescription: Refraction is an AI code assistant built by the software studio Twistag and powered by OpenAI models. Developers paste or select code and choose a task: detecting bugs and suggesting fixes, refactoring to modern practices, adding inline documentation or types, writing unit tests for a chosen framework, inserting debug statements or pulling hardcoded values into variables. It can also generate functions, SQL queries, regular expressions, Mermaid diagrams, CI/CD pipelines and Content Security Policies from plain-language descriptions, and convert code or CSS between languages and frameworks. The company says it supports 56 languages. Extensions are available for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, Visual Studio, Sublime Text, GitHub and the terminal.
pros: Wide range of focused coding tasks
cons: Free tier limited to 10 uses
Code history is stored on its servers
moreContext:
Rather than one open-ended chat box, Refraction organizes AI help into a menu of specific developer chores. That task-first design makes it quick to pick the job you need, from writing tests to generating a regex, without crafting a detailed prompt each time.

- Unit test generation targets the testing framework you choose.
- Documentation, type annotations and debug statements can be added to existing code in one step.
- Conversion tools translate code between languages and CSS between frameworks.
- Plain-language generators cover SQL queries, regexes, Mermaid diagrams, CI/CD pipelines and Content Security Policies.
- Extensions bring the tools into VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, Visual Studio, Sublime Text, GitHub and the terminal.

Refraction is best for individual developers and small teams who want an inexpensive helper for routine tasks like tests, docs and refactors. A practical tip: use the free uses on the chores you find most tedious, such as test writing, to judge output quality, and remember to review generated tests carefully before relying on them in your pipeline.

name: Pairokay
tagline: Credit-based AI writer that turns a keyword or URL into SEO-ready articles
description: Pairokay generates blog posts, product descriptions and social content from a keyword or a source URL, with SEO optimization and campaign mode for scheduled publishing.
longDescription: Pairokay is a web-based AI content generator built around a simple input: you give it a keyword or a URL, and it writes an article or other piece of copy around it. The site says output is optimized for search, supports several tones and languages, and can cover blog posts, product descriptions and social media posts. A campaign mode lets you queue up content runs and manage a content calendar instead of generating one piece at a time. Pricing uses prepaid credit packs rather than a subscription, with larger packs lowering the cost per article. It suits bloggers, affiliate site owners and small marketing teams who need volume.
features: Article generation from a keyword or URL
pros: No subscription, pay per credit pack
Cost per article drops on larger packs
cons: Little public detail on the models used
No free plan to test before buying
moreContext:
What stands out about Pairokay is how little setup it asks for. You hand it a keyword or a page URL and it returns a full draft, so there are no long prompt templates to learn. The pricing is also refreshingly direct: you buy a pack of credits once and spend them as you go, which can be easier to justify than another monthly subscription.

- Starts from either a keyword or an existing URL, which helps when you want to riff on a topic you already rank for
- Builds keyword placement into each draft so posts come out closer to publish-ready for search
- Campaign mode lets you line up a batch of content and keep a calendar instead of generating piece by piece
- Credit packs scale from a small starter bundle to enterprise volume, with the per-article cost falling as you go up
- Handles several formats, including blog posts, product descriptions and short social posts

Pairokay is best for bloggers, niche site builders and lean marketing teams who need a steady flow of SEO content without hiring extra writers. A practical tip: start with the smallest pack, run a few articles on topics you know well, and edit them carefully before scaling up, since any AI draft benefits from a human pass on facts, voice and internal links.

name: CreatorKit
tagline: AI clones, avatar actors and product visuals for video ads, plus a free AI Santa maker
description: CreatorKit creates marketing videos with AI clones and AI actors, generates product photos and ads, and offers a free seasonal tool for personalized Santa videos.
longDescription: CreatorKit is an AI content studio aimed at brands and agencies that need ad creative at volume. Its core feature is the AI Clone, a digital version of a real person that can present scripted videos, alongside a library of AI actors and influencers for user-generated style ads. The platform also produces AI product videos, product photos and ad variations from existing images. A seasonal AI Santa tool lets anyone pick a template, type a message and receive a personalized Santa greeting video. There is a free plan with a small download allowance, and paid tiers raise download limits and add custom actors and support.
features: AI Clone videos of a real presenter
Library of AI actors and influencers
AI product photos and product videos
pros: Covers video, photo and ad creative in one place
Fun, shareable Santa tool for the holidays
cons: Free plan caps downloads at a handful per feature
Custom actors and clones need higher tiers
moreContext:
CreatorKit brings together the main kinds of ad creative an online brand needs, from presenter-style videos to clean product shots, and puts them behind one login. Its AI Clone feature lets a founder or spokesperson record once and then appear in many scripted videos, which can save a lot of filming time. The holiday AI Santa tool shows a lighter side of the same technology and gives people an easy way to try it.

- AI Clones turn a real person into a reusable on-camera presenter for scripted ads
- A library of AI actors and influencers covers user-generated style content without hiring creators
- Product photo and product video tools work from images you already have
- The free plan allows unlimited generations, with downloads limited per feature area
- AI Santa lets anyone choose a template, write a message and get a personalized greeting video

CreatorKit is a strong fit for e-commerce brands, performance marketers and small agencies that need to test many creative variations quickly. A practical tip: use the free tier to generate freely and only download your strongest versions, since the plan counts downloads rather than generations, then move up a tier once a format proves it converts.

name: Explee
tagline: AI outbound agent that researches your market, finds hot leads and writes cold emails
description: Explee runs outbound prospecting with AI agents that refine your ideal customer profile, find high-intent buyers, send personalized emails and book demos on pay-as-you-go pricing.
longDescription: Explee is an AI outbound sales platform from a London-based company. You start with your website URL, and its agents research your market, tighten your ideal customer profile, find prospects showing buying intent, write personalized emails and work toward booked demos. The company says no SDR team or separate email infrastructure is required. Alongside the outreach agent, Explee sells bulk B2B company and decision-maker data by region, with semantic search and custom AI enrichment. Pricing is pay-as-you-go with no subscription, and new users receive $30 in free credits to try the outreach agent.
features: AI agents that research markets and refine your ICP
Personalized cold email writing and sending
Bulk B2B company and contact datasets
pros: No subscription, pay only for usage
cons: Costs per lead vary widely by market
You remain responsible for data privacy compliance
moreContext:
Explee is built for founders and small teams who want outbound sales to run without assembling a stack of separate tools. Instead of buying a lead list, warming domains and writing sequences by hand, you point it at your website and its agents handle research, targeting and outreach. The pay-as-you-go model means you can test it on real campaigns before committing a budget.

- Starts from your website to infer who you sell to, then sharpens that ideal customer profile
- Looks for prospects showing buying intent rather than sending to a broad list
- Writes personalized emails and works toward booked demos
- Takes care of sending infrastructure, so no separate inbox setup is needed
- Offers bulk company and decision-maker datasets for the US, EU and other regions, with semantic search and AI enrichment

Explee is best for solo founders and early-stage B2B companies that do not have an SDR team yet. A practical tip: use the free starting credits on a narrow segment you understand well, review the emails it writes, and compare the cost per hot lead against your current channels before widening the campaign.

name: Manychat
tagline: Chat marketing automation for Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger and TikTok with AI replies
description: Manychat automates conversations in Instagram DMs, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, TikTok and SMS, with AI features that understand intent and help build flows for sales and support.
longDescription: Manychat is a chat marketing platform that lets businesses and creators automate conversations on social and messaging channels, including Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, TikTok and SMS. Users build flows in a visual editor to reply to comments and DMs, capture leads, run giveaways and guide customers toward a purchase. Its AI features add intent recognition, AI-generated replies and an assistant that helps draft flows. Billing is based on the number of contacts who interact with your account each month, with a free plan for small audiences and paid tiers that raise contact limits. Integrations connect captured data to tools such as CRMs and email platforms.
features: Visual flow builder for DM and comment automation
AI intent recognition and generated replies
Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, TikTok and SMS channels
Lead capture with CRM and email integrations
pros: Very popular with creators and small brands
Visual builder is approachable for non-developers
cons: Costs scale with active contacts
AI features and channel fees can add to the bill
moreContext:
Manychat has become a go-to tool for creators and brands that sell through Instagram and other messaging apps. It turns comments and DMs into automated conversations, so a post that asks followers to comment a keyword can instantly send a link, collect an email or start a sales flow. Its AI layer helps those conversations handle questions that do not match a fixed button or keyword.

- Visual flow builder makes it practical to design DM journeys without writing code
- Covers Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, TikTok and SMS from one workspace
- AI intent recognition helps route free-text messages to the right answer
- Comment-to-DM automations are well suited to launches, giveaways and lead magnets
- Integrations pass captured contacts on to CRMs, email tools and spreadsheets

Manychat is best for creators, coaches, e-commerce shops and local businesses that get steady inbound interest on social channels. A practical tip: start with one comment-triggered flow tied to a single offer, track how many people complete it, and only then add AI replies and extra channels, since pricing grows with the number of active contacts you engage.

name: Visual Field Test
tagline: At-home online visual field screening with AI summaries you can share with your eye doctor
description: Visual Field Test runs a browser-based peripheral vision screening in about five minutes per eye, maps missed points and gives plain-language AI summaries and trend tracking.
longDescription: Visual Field Test is a web app for home perimetry, the kind of peripheral vision check commonly used to monitor glaucoma and related conditions. You cover one eye, fix your gaze on a central cross and click whenever a flash appears. The app maps the points you saw and missed, offers a simple screening mode and an advanced threshold mode with decibel values and indices such as mean deviation, and adds a plain-language AI summary. Results are saved, compared side by side and charted over time, with printable PDF reports and read-only sharing for doctors or family. It is available in 30 languages and is positioned as a screening aid, not a diagnosis.
features: Simple and advanced threshold test modes
Printable PDF reports and doctor sharing
pros: Takes only a few minutes per eye at home
Clear reports to bring to appointments
cons: Screening only, not a medical diagnosis
Ongoing tracking features require a subscription
moreContext:
Visual Field Test brings a version of a clinic peripheral vision exam to an ordinary computer screen. The appeal is consistency: you can repeat the same short test every few weeks and see whether anything has shifted, then bring organized results to your eye care professional instead of relying on memory. The AI summary explains each result in plain words, which makes the numbers far less intimidating.

- Simple mode gives a quick screening, while advanced mode measures sensitivity per point in decibels
- Reports include a threshold map, total deviation, probability map and global indices such as MD and PSD
- Comparison view highlights points that were newly missed or recovered between tests
- Trend charts by week, month and year make gradual changes easier to spot
- Read-only sharing lets a doctor or family member view your history, and tests can be deleted at any time

Visual Field Test is best for people who have been told to watch their peripheral vision, such as those with a glaucoma diagnosis or family history, and want structured data between visits. A practical tip: test in the same room, lighting and seating distance each time, and always follow your eye doctor's advice, since a home screening cannot replace a clinical exam.

name: Together Chat
tagline: Free chat app from Together AI running open-source models hosted in North America
description: Together Chat is a free web chatbot from Together AI that uses open-source models for answers, reasoning, coding, web search with citations and image generation.
longDescription: Together Chat is a consumer chat app built by Together AI, the company known for its inference platform for open-source models. Launched in 2025 with DeepSeek R1 as its headline reasoning model, it routes everyday questions, coding help and image prompts to open models running on Together's own infrastructure in North America. The app can search the web, summarize what it finds and cite sources in its answers, and it can generate images from text. It runs in the browser and can be installed as a progressive web app on phones. Together AI offers it free of charge, and usage limits may apply.
features: Chat with open-source reasoning and coding models
Installable as a mobile web app
pros: Showcases open models in one simple interface
cons: Fewer features than paid assistants
Model lineup and limits are set by Together AI
moreContext:
Together Chat gives everyday users a simple way to try strong open-source models without setting up an API key or running anything locally. It comes from Together AI, a company whose main business is serving open models to developers, so the app doubles as a friendly window into that ecosystem. Hosting in North America was a notable part of its launch for people who wanted to try DeepSeek R1 on infrastructure outside China.

- Routes tasks such as reasoning, coding and general questions to open models suited to each
- Searches the web and cites its sources in answers
- Generates images from text prompts within the same chat
- Works in any browser and can be added to a phone home screen as a web app
- Free to use, which makes it easy to compare open models against paid assistants

Together Chat is best for curious users, students and developers who want to see what open models can do before building with them. A practical tip: if you like the results, the same models are available through Together AI's developer platform, so you can move from casual chatting to building your own app with familiar behavior.

name: Dia 1.6B
tagline: Open-weights text-to-dialogue model that voices two speakers with laughs and pauses
description: Dia 1.6B from Nari Labs is an open-weights text-to-speech model that generates realistic two-speaker dialogue from a script, with nonverbal sounds and audio-prompted voice cloning.
longDescription: Dia 1.6B is a 1.6 billion parameter text-to-speech model released by Nari Labs under the Apache 2.0 license. Rather than reading one line at a time, it generates a whole conversation in a single pass from a transcript that marks speakers with [S1] and [S2] tags. It can produce nonverbal sounds such as laughter, coughing and throat clearing, and it can condition on a short audio sample to copy a voice, tone or emotion. Weights are hosted on Hugging Face, the model works with Hugging Face Transformers, and a hosted demo Space is available. It currently supports English only and runs best on a GPU.
features: Two-speaker dialogue generation in one pass
Nonverbal sounds like laughs and coughs
Voice cloning from a short audio prompt
Apache 2.0 open weights on Hugging Face
pros: Free and open for commercial use under Apache 2.0
cons: English only
Needs a GPU and some technical setup
moreContext:
Dia 1.6B caught attention because a small team released an open model that handles conversation, not just narration. You write a script with speaker tags, and it returns audio where two voices trade lines with natural timing, plus laughs or sighs where you ask for them. For developers and podcasters who want to experiment without per-character fees, that is a rare combination.

- Generates multi-turn dialogue in a single pass from a tagged transcript
- Supports nonverbal cues such as laughter, coughing and throat clearing
- Clones a voice or tone from a 5 to 10 second audio sample plus its transcript
- Open weights under Apache 2.0, with Hugging Face Transformers support
- A free demo Space lets you hear results before installing anything

Dia 1.6B is best for developers, researchers and audio hobbyists who are comfortable with Python and want a local dialogue voice model. A practical tip: follow the project's guidance on input length, since very short scripts can sound unnatural and very long ones speed up, and alternate speaker tags strictly for the cleanest output. Nari Labs has since released a successor, Dia2, which is worth a look too.

name: ZenMux
tagline: Unified API gateway for 100+ AI models with auto routing and built-in output insurance
description: ZenMux gives developers one API key for Claude, GPT, Gemini and other models, with OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoints, automatic failover, model routing and compensation for bad outputs.
longDescription: ZenMux is an AI model gateway run by a Singapore-based company. Developers connect once and reach more than 100 models from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek and Qwen, using OpenAI, Anthropic or Vertex AI compatible protocols. ZenMux says models come only from official providers or authorized cloud partners, and it keeps multiple channels per model with automatic failover. An Auto Routing option picks a model per prompt based on quality and cost. A distinctive insurance program compensates users for hallucinated output, high latency or low throughput. It also includes usage analytics and a chat studio, with pay-as-you-go billing.
features: OpenAI, Anthropic and Vertex AI compatible endpoints
Auto Routing by quality and cost
pros: Unusual compensation policy for bad results
cons: Adds a service fee on top of model costs
Another vendor sits between you and providers
moreContext:
ZenMux tackles a common headache for teams building with AI: every model provider has its own account, billing and quirks. By putting more than 100 models behind one key and familiar API formats, it lets you swap or compare models with a one-line change. Its insurance program, which pays out when outputs are hallucinated or performance falls short, is an unusual commitment for a gateway.

- Works with existing OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs, so migration is mostly a base URL change
- Keeps several provider channels per model and fails over automatically when one is slow or rate-limited
- Auto Routing chooses a model per request to balance quality and cost
- Dashboards show usage and spending across all models in one place
- The company says it sources models only from official providers or authorized cloud partners

ZenMux is best for developers and startups running multi-model apps or agents who want reliability without managing many contracts. A practical tip: point a staging environment at ZenMux first, compare latency and costs against your direct provider accounts, and review its compensation terms so you know how to file a claim if outputs go wrong.

name: VISBOOM
tagline: AI fashion photoshoots that put your clothing and shoes on virtual models
description: VISBOOM turns flat-lay or on-model product photos into on-model fashion shoots, with a large AI model library, shoe try-on, background swaps and face or pose changes.
longDescription: VISBOOM is an AI content platform for fashion and apparel e-commerce. You choose or generate an AI model, upload a product image, and the platform produces an on-model photoshoot, then lets you change the background to built-in or AI-generated scenes. Clothing try-on accepts both flat-lay and on-model inputs and draws on a library the company says holds more than 10,000 models and poses. Shoe try-on shows footwear in full-body or close-up shots, and model swap tools change faces and hairstyles in existing photos. It is aimed at online retailers, brand teams, photographers and designers who need catalog imagery without a studio.
features: Clothing try-on from flat-lay or on-model photos
Shoe try-on in full-body and close-up views
Background swap with indoor, outdoor and AI scenes
AI model, face and hairstyle swap
pros: Cuts the need for physical photoshoots
cons: Pricing is not clearly listed on the site
Fashion focus limits use for other products
moreContext:
VISBOOM focuses squarely on one expensive task in fashion retail: getting products onto models in good-looking photos. Instead of booking talent, a studio and a photographer for every new item, a brand can upload a product image and generate on-model shots across different looks and settings. That focus shows in details like separate tools for clothing and for shoes.

- Accepts flat-lay or on-model product photos as the starting point for try-on
- Draws on a library the company says includes more than 10,000 models and poses
- Shoe try-on handles both full-body and close-up compositions
- Background swap places shoots in built-in scenes or custom AI environments
- Model swap changes faces and hairstyles to fit different markets or campaigns

VISBOOM is best for fashion e-commerce teams, apparel and footwear brands and marketplace sellers who refresh catalogs often. A practical tip: start with clean, well-lit product photos on a plain background, since the quality of your input image has a big effect on how convincing the generated on-model shot looks, and review fabric details closely before publishing.

name: monday.com
tagline: Work management platform where teams and AI agents plan projects, CRM and workflows
description: monday.com is a visual work platform for projects, CRM, dev and service teams, now adding AI agents, the Sidekick assistant, AI columns and an AI workflow builder.
longDescription: monday.com is a cloud work management platform used to plan projects, track tasks and run processes on customizable boards, with products for work management, CRM, software development, service desks and email campaigns. Its AI layer includes the Sidekick assistant, AI agents, AI columns that fill in or summarize data, a meeting notetaker, a no-code app builder called Vibe and an AI workflow builder on higher tiers. Paid plans include monthly AI credits, with extra credits available to buy. The free plan supports up to two seats and three boards, and paid plans start at three seats. It suits teams of almost any size.
features: AI columns and AI workflow builder
Products for CRM, dev and service teams
pros: Highly visual and easy to adopt
AI credits included in paid plans
cons: Paid plans require a minimum of three seats
Advanced AI features sit on higher tiers
moreContext:
monday.com has long been known for colorful, flexible boards that teams can shape around almost any process, from marketing calendars to hiring pipelines. Its recent push brings AI into those same boards, so assistants and agents can work on the data teams already keep there rather than in a separate tool. That makes AI adoption feel like an extension of existing habits.

- Boards, dashboards and no-code automations adapt to projects, CRM, IT tickets and HR workflows
- Sidekick and AI agents can answer questions and handle tasks using board data
- AI columns summarize, categorize or fill in information across many items at once
- Higher tiers add a notetaker and an AI workflow builder, and Vibe helps build simple apps
- Separate products for CRM, dev, service and campaigns share the same platform

monday.com is best for teams that want one visual hub for projects and operations, with AI layered on top as they grow. A practical tip: start on the free plan or the Pro trial with a single real workflow, then check how many AI credits that workflow uses each month before choosing a paid tier, since credits are allotted per plan.

name: DaVinci AI
tagline: One subscription for top image and video models like Veo, Kling, Flux and Nano Banana
description: DaVinci AI bundles leading image and video generation models with editing tools such as upscaling, object removal and auto-resize, on the web and in iOS and Android apps.
longDescription: DaVinci AI is a generative media suite that puts many third-party image and video models in one workspace, including Sora, Veo, Kling, Seedance, Seedream, Flux and Nano Banana. Users can generate images from text, edit them, turn product photos into short videos, upscale assets for high-resolution formats, replace or remove objects and resize designs for different social and ad placements. The service runs on the web and in mobile apps for iOS and Android. Plans are credit-based subscriptions that set monthly limits on images and videos and raise queue priority on higher tiers. It targets creators, marketers and designers.
features: Access to many leading image and video models
Upscaling and object removal or replacement
Auto-resize for social and ad formats
pros: Web plus iOS and Android apps
Editing and generation in one workspace
cons: Introductory prices renew at higher rates
No clear free plan on the site
moreContext:
DaVinci AI is built for people who do not want to pick a single favorite model. It gathers well-known image and video generators into one place, so you can try the same idea in several engines and keep the result you like best. Because the suite also covers common edits, a project can go from first draft to a resized ad without leaving the app.

- Switch between models such as Veo, Kling, Seedance, Flux and Nano Banana from one interface
- Turn still product photos into short commercial-style videos
- Upscale images for large or premium ad placements while keeping detail
- Remove or swap objects and auto-resize designs for each social or ad channel
- Use the same account on the web and in iOS and Android apps

DaVinci AI is best for content creators, social media managers and small marketing teams who produce visuals every week and want variety in their tools. A practical tip: note that plan prices shown as introductory renew at a higher monthly rate, so estimate how many images and videos you really produce before choosing a tier, and compare models on a few test prompts to learn which suits your style.

name: RambleFix
tagline: Speak freely and get back a polished email, note or post in your own voice
description: RambleFix turns spoken rambling into clean writing in any app, removing filler words and false starts, and adds meeting transcription, summaries and minutes on web, Mac and iPhone.
longDescription: RambleFix is a voice-to-text writing tool that cleans up how people actually talk. You press a hotkey on Mac or use the browser or iPhone app, speak loosely, and it returns text without filler words and false starts, or turns the ramble into a finished email, note or social post in your tone. Text appears at your cursor in any app. Beyond dictation, it records and transcribes meetings, produces summaries, action items and minutes, and transcribes uploaded audio files with timestamps. It supports more than 30 languages. The company says recordings are deleted after transcription and are not used to train AI. A free tier covers 1,000 words a month.
features: Filler word and false start cleanup
pros: Free monthly word allowance with no card
Output reads like edited writing, not raw transcript
cons: Free tier is small for heavy dictation
Desktop app is Mac only
moreContext:
RambleFix is designed around a simple observation: most people speak faster than they type, but raw transcripts are messy. It keeps the speed of talking and fixes the mess, removing filler words, restarts and tangents so what lands on the page reads like something you would actually send. That makes it useful for everyday writing, not just note taking.

- A Mac hotkey drops cleaned-up text straight at your cursor in any app or website
- Can turn one spoken ramble into an email, note or social post in your tone
- Records and transcribes meetings, then produces summaries, action items and minutes
- Transcribes uploaded audio such as interviews with timestamps
- The company says recordings are deleted after transcription and not used to train AI

RambleFix is best for busy professionals, founders and writers who think out loud and want polished text without heavy editing. A practical tip: speak in full thoughts rather than pausing after every phrase, then read the result once before sending, and use the free 1,000 words a month to see whether your typical messages fit before upgrading.

name: GanttPRO
tagline: Gantt chart project planning with a free AI maker that drafts plans from a description
description: GanttPRO is online Gantt chart software for project planning, and its free AI Gantt chart maker turns a short project description into tasks, milestones and dependencies.
longDescription: GanttPRO is a project management tool centered on Gantt charts, with features for resource workload, portfolios, time tracking and budgets on higher tiers. Its free AI Gantt chart maker lets you describe a project in plain language, including goals, timeframe and teams, and generates a work breakdown with phases, tasks, suggested dependencies, milestones and generic role assignments. You can then open the draft in GanttPRO to edit and manage it, and export to PDF, PNG, XML or Excel. Continuing work in the app starts with a 14-day free trial with no card required, followed by per-user subscription plans.
features: AI Gantt chart generation from a text description
Tasks, milestones and dependencies drafted automatically
Workload, portfolio, time and budget management
Export to PDF, PNG, XML and Excel
pros: Free AI maker for quick first drafts
Mature Gantt editor for refining plans
cons: No permanent free plan for the full app
AI output needs review for real dates and owners
moreContext:
GanttPRO pairs a dedicated Gantt chart editor with an AI helper that removes the blank page problem. Instead of building a schedule task by task, you describe the project in a few sentences and get a structured draft with phases, dependencies and milestones to work from. Because the result opens in a full Gantt tool, the AI output becomes a real plan rather than a static image.

- The free AI maker turns goals, timeframe and team details into a work breakdown structure
- Drafts include suggested dependencies and milestones, not just a flat task list
- The editor supports workload, portfolio, time and budget views on higher plans
- Plans export to PDF, PNG, XML and Excel for sharing with stakeholders
- A 14-day trial lets teams test the full app with no card required

GanttPRO is best for project managers, agencies and operations teams who plan with timelines and dependencies. A practical tip: give the AI maker a detailed prompt with scope, key deliverables, roles and anything to exclude, since detailed descriptions produce more precise breakdowns, then assign real people and dates once the draft is in the editor.

name: IdeaBuddy
tagline: AI-assisted business planning with financial projections, canvas and idea validation
description: IdeaBuddy guides founders from idea to business plan with a step-by-step workflow, financial forecasts, a business model canvas, validation tools and AI writing help.
longDescription: IdeaBuddy is all-in-one business planning software for entrepreneurs, startups, incubators and business schools. It walks users through each stage of developing an idea with a step-by-step guide, then helps build a business model canvas, financial projections and a written business plan from industry templates. AI assistance suggests and improves text as you go, using a monthly allowance of requests. Users can invite collaborators and mentors, validate ideas and export plans to PDF, Word or Excel. A free plan includes one idea, one collaborator and a small number of AI requests, while paid tiers expand limits and white label options serve accelerators and schools.
features: Business model canvas and plan builder
AI writing assistance for plan sections
pros: Exports to PDF, Word and Excel
cons: Free plan limited to one idea and few AI requests
Plans still need your own market research
moreContext:
IdeaBuddy turns business planning into a guided process rather than a blank document. It breaks the work into clear stages, from shaping the concept to forecasting finances and writing the plan, so new founders always know what to tackle next. Its AI assistant helps put rough thinking into clear language, which is often the hardest part of writing a plan.

- A step-by-step guide takes an idea through development, validation and planning
- Financial planning tools help build projections and forecast performance
- A one-page canvas captures the business model before you commit to a full plan
- AI assistance drafts and improves text within each section of the plan
- Collaborators and mentors can be invited, and plans export to PDF, Word or Excel

IdeaBuddy is best for aspiring entrepreneurs, early-stage startups and programs such as incubators and business schools that coach many founders. A practical tip: complete the canvas and financial sections before polishing the written plan, since the numbers often change the story, and save your limited AI requests for the sections you find hardest to write.

name: machineko
tagline: Chat with AI street cats from Tokyo's old neighborhoods, each with its own personality
description: machineko is a Japanese web app where you talk with AI-driven street cat characters from Tokyo districts like Yanaka and Kuramae, each with a distinct temperament.
longDescription: machineko, written as 町猫 in Japanese, is a small conversational web app built around fictional street cats. Each cat has a name, age, home neighborhood in Tokyo's older districts such as Yanaka, Kuramae and Nezu, and a personality, from a quiet lookout to a gruff old-timer or a curious young explorer. You pick a cat and chat with it, and replies stay in character, which can mean silence, bluntness or odd remarks. The creators describe it as neither an adoption site nor a game nor a service for children, just a place for people curious about what a cat might say. It offers Japanese and English interfaces.
features: Roster of street cat characters with distinct personalities
cons: Mainly designed for Japanese speakers
Conversations may be stored for service improvement
moreContext:
machineko stands out for its restraint. Instead of a do-everything chatbot, it offers a cast of neighborhood cats, each rooted in a real corner of old Tokyo and written with a clear personality. Some are chatty, some are aloof and some barely answer, which makes each conversation feel closer to meeting an actual stray than talking to an assistant.

- Each cat has a name, age, neighborhood and temperament that shapes how it replies
- Settings draw on Tokyo districts such as Yanaka, Kuramae, Nezu and Sendagi
- The app shows how many cats are around that day, which adds a small sense of place and season
- Clear framing from the creators: not an adoption site, not a game and not aimed at children
- Switch between Japanese and English from the interface

machineko is best for cat lovers, fans of Japanese neighborhood culture and anyone who enjoys quiet, character-driven AI experiences. A practical tip: try chatting with a few different cats rather than sticking with one, since the personalities vary a lot, and keep in mind the site notes that conversations may be saved and analyzed to improve the service.

name: Overchat AI
tagline: All-in-one AI app with GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok plus image and video tools
description: Overchat AI lets you chat with many leading language models from one account and adds image generation, video tools and writing utilities on web, iOS and Android.
longDescription: Overchat AI is a multi-model assistant from Boiler Labs, based in the UAE. From one interface you can talk with models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral and Meta, generate images with several popular image models, and use a set of extra tools for video generation, writing, paraphrasing and photo effects. It runs in the browser and in iOS and Android apps, with desktop apps and browser extensions listed as coming soon. A free plan offers daily access to basic models, while the Pro plan adds advanced models, image generation, custom chatbots and a monthly credit allowance. The company states it is not affiliated with OpenAI.
features: Chat with GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok
pros: Many frontier models under one plan
Low yearly price compared with monthly
Free daily access to basic models
cons: Free plan limits are tight
Credit system can make heavy use hard to predict
moreContext:
Trying several leading chat models without paying for each one separately is the core appeal here. You can ask the same question to different models, keep using whichever answers best and move on to image generation in the same app. For people who like to compare assistants, that flexibility is the main draw.

- Brings models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral and Meta into one chat interface
- Pro adds image generation with several well-known image models
- Custom chatbots let you set up assistants for recurring tasks
- Extra tools cover writing, paraphrasing, video generation and photo effects
- Available in the browser and on iOS and Android, with desktop apps listed as coming soon

Overchat AI is best for students, freelancers and curious users who want broad model access on a budget. A practical tip: the yearly Pro plan costs far less than twelve monthly payments, so try the free tier for a week first, and if you upgrade, keep an eye on how quickly advanced models use your monthly credits.

name: Replay
tagline: Free desktop app from Weights for AI vocal conversion, stem splitting and voice training
description: Replay is a free, offline desktop app by Weights for AI audio production, letting musicians separate stems, convert vocals with RVC voice models and train their own models.
longDescription: Replay is a desktop application from Weights, the AI voice platform, built for musicians and producers. It runs offline on your own computer, with downloads for Mac, Windows and Linux, and is free to use. Its main workflows include separating a song into stems such as vocals and instruments, converting a vocal performance into a different voice using RVC voice models, and training your own voice model from recordings. Models can come from the Weights library or other sources. Because processing happens on-device, audio does not need to be uploaded to a server. Using Replay requires a Weights account.
features: Stem separation for vocals and instruments
Vocal conversion with RVC voice models
pros: Runs locally on Mac, Windows and Linux
No need to upload audio to the cloud
cons: Performance depends on your computer's hardware
Requires a Weights account
moreContext:
Replay brings several AI audio tasks that usually live on separate websites into one free desktop app. Producers can split a track into stems, swap the voice on a vocal and train a custom voice model without paying per minute or uploading files to a server. Running locally also means you can keep working with large projects without waiting on an online queue.

- Separates songs into stems such as vocals and instrumentals for remixing or practice
- Converts vocals using RVC voice models, either from Weights or from other sources
- Lets you train your own voice model from your recordings
- Processes audio on-device, with builds for Mac, Windows and Linux
- Free to use, with ongoing version updates from Weights

Replay is best for home producers, cover artists and hobbyists experimenting with AI vocals who have a reasonably capable computer. A practical tip: train or use voice models only from voices you own or have permission to use, and start with short clean vocal stems, since well-separated, dry vocals give voice conversion far better results.

name: Paradigm
tagline: Agentic research spreadsheet that scores every account against your go-to-market criteria
description: Paradigm runs AI agents across a spreadsheet of companies to research each account live, enrich data and score fit, helping sales and GTM teams find real opportunities.
longDescription: Paradigm is an AI research platform for go-to-market teams. You work in a spreadsheet-style sheet where columns act as AI agents: one can research companies on the live web, another can score them against your criteria and another can summarize insights, and groups of columns can be saved as reusable workflows. The company says it runs fresh research rather than relying only on cached databases. Usage is measured in credits that cover research, enrichment and generated outputs, with connectors to bring in your own data. Plans start with an Individual tier, followed by a Business tier with team features and an Enterprise tier with SSO and custom data sources.
features: Spreadsheet columns powered by AI agents
Live web research for each account
pros: Applies your own playbook across a whole market
Fresh research instead of stale lists
Flexible for many GTM research tasks
cons: High starting price for individuals
Credit costs vary with research depth
moreContext:
Paradigm treats account research as something you can run in parallel instead of one tab at a time. You define what a good customer looks like, and AI agents work row by row through a sheet of companies, gathering current information and judging fit. That helps teams separate accounts that look right on paper from those with real signals worth pursuing.

- Each column can act as an agent that researches, scores or summarizes
- Research runs live on the web, which the company says goes beyond cached data
- Columns can be grouped into workflows and reused across new lists
- Connectors bring your own data into the sheet alongside agent results
- Business and Enterprise tiers add team features, SSO and custom data sources

Paradigm is best for founders, revenue operations teams and sales leaders who want to apply a detailed targeting playbook across thousands of accounts. A practical tip: test your scoring prompt on a small sample of companies you already know well, check the agent's reasoning against your own judgment, and only then run it across your full list to keep credit use under control.

name: LingBot-Map
tagline: Open-source model that rebuilds 3D scenes from ordinary video as it streams
description: An open-source 3D foundation model from Robbyant, Ant Group's embodied AI unit, that estimates camera pose and depth frame by frame to reconstruct spaces from plain RGB video.
longDescription: LingBot-Map is a streaming 3D reconstruction model released by Robbyant, the embodied intelligence company within Ant Group. It takes regular camera footage and, as each frame arrives, predicts the camera position and a depth map, building up a point cloud of the scene without LiDAR. Its Geometric Context Attention keeps a compact memory made of an anchor frame, a local window of recent views and a compressed trajectory history, so per-frame cost stays close to flat on very long videos. The code is on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 license, with weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope, demo scripts and evaluation tooling for researchers and robotics developers.
pros: Works from a standard RGB camera
cons: Needs an NVIDIA GPU and Python setup
Aimed at researchers rather than casual users
moreContext:
What stands out about LingBot-Map is how it treats 3D reconstruction as a memory problem. Instead of storing every past frame, it keeps a small structured state that the model learns end to end, which lets it keep up with long walkthroughs, drives and aerial footage. Robbyant publishes the model openly, so anyone with a capable GPU can try it on their own video.

- Rebuilds a scene incrementally while video is still playing, rather than waiting for a full batch
- Uses only RGB input, which lowers the hardware bar compared with LiDAR rigs
- Ships with demo scripts, a windowed mode for very long clips and an offline rendering pipeline
- Includes evaluation scripts for public benchmarks such as KITTI and Oxford Spires
- Released under Apache 2.0 with weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope

LingBot-Map is best for robotics engineers, AR developers and computer vision researchers who want a strong open baseline for camera-only mapping. A practical tip: start with the example scenes in the repository to confirm your CUDA and PyTorch versions match the recommended setup, then move on to your own footage and experiment with the keyframe interval to balance speed and quality.

name: Mercer
tagline: AI fashion design workspace, formerly Cala, that connects concepts to production
description: Mercer, previously known as Cala, gives fashion brands AI design tools, collection management and team collaboration in one platform, with production and logistics services on its top plan.
longDescription: Mercer is the renamed version of Cala, a platform built for independent designers, small fashion houses and established apparel brands. Teams can start from inspiration photos, sketches, CADs, tech packs or a text prompt, then use the AI Designer tool for product variations, text-to-image concepts and brush-based edits. An AI Influences feature can be trained on past collections or mood boards to keep new designs on brand. Around the design tools sit collection storage, comments, measurements, task assignment and print-ready exports. Paid plans scale by AI credits and editor seats, and the Enterprise tier adds access to the company's manufacturing network, logistics handling and design services.
features: AI Designer with text-to-image and variations
Print-ready PDF exports and share links
pros: Path from concept to manufacturing on Enterprise
cons: No free plan listed
Production network access limited to the top tier
moreContext:
Most AI image tools stop at a pretty picture, but Mercer is organized around the way a fashion collection actually moves from idea to sample. The platform, which used to operate as Cala, keeps creative files, measurements, notes and tasks next to the AI generation tools, so a design team can work in one place instead of passing attachments around.

- AI Designer tool covers product variations, text-to-image concepts and paintbrush-style edits
- AI Influences can be trained on reference imagery to keep new pieces consistent with a brand
- Comments, measurements and task assignment live directly on creative and technical files
- Designs can be shared with partners through links or print-ready PDFs, even without an account
- The Enterprise plan connects to manufacturing, bulk logistics and branding services

Mercer suits emerging labels, independent designers and small fashion teams that want structure around AI-assisted ideation, while larger brands may look at the Enterprise tier for production support. A practical tip: upload a few strong reference images from a past collection before generating new concepts, since the brand-trained influence feature works best when it has a clear visual direction to learn from.

name: Seed3D
tagline: ByteDance Seed model that turns a single image into simulation-ready 3D assets
description: Seed3D is ByteDance Seed's 3D generation model that creates detailed meshes with PBR textures from one image, aimed at games, digital content and physics simulation for embodied AI.
longDescription: Seed3D is a family of 3D generation models from ByteDance's Seed research team. Version 1.0, introduced in October 2025, uses a diffusion transformer to produce geometry, textures and physically based materials from a single input image, with assets that can be imported into simulators such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Seed3D 2.0 adds a coarse-to-fine geometry pipeline, a unified PBR material model, and tools for scene layout planning, part decomposition and articulation, so objects can move and interact in physics engines. ByteDance offers access through its Volcano Engine cloud platform, and the team has published technical reports describing the methods and evaluations.
cons: Access mainly through Volcano Engine cloud
No simple consumer app or public price list
moreContext:
Seed3D is interesting because it aims past good-looking 3D models and toward assets that behave correctly inside a physics simulator. ByteDance's Seed team designed it so a single photo can become a watertight mesh with realistic materials, and the second version extends that to whole scenes and objects with moving parts.

- Generates geometry, textures and PBR materials together from one image
- Outputs are meant to drop into simulation platforms used for robot training
- Seed3D 2.0 adds scene layout planning so several objects can be arranged coherently
- Part-aware decomposition and articulation let doors, drawers and similar parts move
- The team reports strong results in human preference studies, according to its own paper

Seed3D is best for game studios, 3D content teams and robotics groups that need large volumes of realistic assets and are comfortable working through a cloud API. A practical tip: read the Seed3D 2.0 technical report before integrating it, since it explains which features target single objects and which support full scene construction, which helps you plan a pipeline around the right capability.

name: ZeroGPT
tagline: AI content detector with sentence highlighting plus a suite of writing tools
description: ZeroGPT checks text for signs of AI generation and highlights suspect sentences, and adds image and video detection, plagiarism checks, paraphrasing, summarizing, grammar and translation tools.
longDescription: ZeroGPT is a web-based AI detection service that estimates how much of a passage was likely written by a language model. Users paste text or upload files, and the tool returns a percentage gauge with the sentences it considers machine-written highlighted. Beyond text detection, the site offers AI image and video detectors, a plagiarism checker, and writing helpers such as a paraphraser, summarizer, grammar checker, translator, word counter and email generator. A free tier covers basic checks, while paid personal and business plans raise character limits, enable batch file checks and PDF reports, and remove ads. Developers can also access detection and other features through a pay-as-you-go API.
features: Batch file checks with PDF reports
pros: Many writing tools in one account
cons: Detection scores can produce false positives
Larger limits require a paid plan
moreContext:
ZeroGPT has become one of the more recognizable names in AI text detection, largely because it lets people run a quick check for free with no account. Its results view is easy to read: a gauge shows the estimated share of AI-written text, and the specific sentences behind that score are highlighted.

- Highlights individual sentences instead of giving only a single overall score
- Detects AI-generated images and videos alongside text
- Paid plans support batch uploads and downloadable PDF reports
- Bundles a plagiarism checker, summarizer, paraphraser, grammar checker and translator
- Offers a pay-as-you-go API for teams that want detection inside their own systems

ZeroGPT is a good fit for educators, editors and content managers who want a fast first screen on submitted text, plus a handful of everyday writing utilities in one place. A practical tip: treat any detector score as a starting point for a conversation rather than proof of authorship, and compare results on longer passages, since short snippets give detectors very little signal to work with.

name: Thunderbit
tagline: AI web scraper for Chrome that pulls structured data from any site in a click
description: Thunderbit is an AI web scraping extension and web app that reads a page, suggests columns and exports clean data to Sheets, Airtable, Notion or Excel, with templates for popular sites.
longDescription: Thunderbit is a browser-based scraping tool built for sales, operations, real estate and marketing teams that need web data without writing selectors. In the Chrome or Edge extension, the AI reads the current page and proposes fields to extract, and it can follow subpages, handle pagination and process bulk URL lists. Users can ask the AI to summarize, categorize, translate or reformat values as they are scraped. Pre-built templates for sites such as Amazon, eBay and Google Maps return consistent fields without using AI credits. Results export to Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion or Excel, and developers can use a web scraper API, CLI or MCP server.
features: Export to Sheets, Airtable, Notion and Excel
pros: No CSS selectors or coding needed
Free tier to try it out
cons: Credit limits on lower plans
Works best inside Chrome or Edge
moreContext:
Thunderbit takes a lot of the fiddly setup out of web scraping. Instead of mapping selectors by hand, you open a page, let the AI suggest columns, and run the extraction, which makes building a list from a directory, marketplace or search page a quick job for non-technical teams.

- AI reads the page structure and proposes the fields to capture
- Follows links into subpages and handles multi-page results
- Can summarize, categorize, translate or reformat values while scraping
- Templates for common sites return the same fields every time without spending AI credits
- Sends results straight to Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion or Excel, with an API and MCP server for developers

Thunderbit is best for sales reps building lead lists, operations teams tracking listings and marketers gathering research data who want results in a spreadsheet fast. A practical tip: check whether a pre-built template exists for the site you need before using the AI scraper, since templates are faster, more consistent and do not draw down your credit balance.

name: Supermeme.ai
tagline: AI meme generator that turns a short idea into editable memes
description: Supermeme.ai matches a written idea with fitting meme templates and drafts captions you can edit, with brand kits, watermark removal, an API and an MCP server on paid plans.
longDescription: Supermeme.ai is a meme creation tool for marketers, social media managers and anyone who wants to turn a situation or joke into a shareable image. You describe an idea in plain language, and the AI picks suitable templates, writes captions and returns several options to choose from, in image or GIF form. Captions and text placement stay editable before download. Free accounts get a small monthly allowance of creation credits, while paid plans add more credits, logo branding through brand kits, watermark removal or custom watermark text, creation history, and request allowances for the API and MCP server so memes can be generated from other tools and bots.
pros: Fast way to get meme ideas
Developer access for bots and apps
cons: Free plan includes a watermark
Captions still need a human check for tone
moreContext:
Supermeme.ai solves a very specific creative problem: you know the joke, but not which meme format fits it. Type a situation, such as a client asking for one tiny change, and the tool proposes several templates with captions already written, which you can then adjust before sharing.

- Returns multiple meme options from a single prompt, in images or GIFs
- Keeps captions and text placement editable so you can refine the wording
- Brand kits add a logo badge and styled headers or footers for company accounts
- Paid plans remove the Supermeme watermark, with custom watermark text on higher tiers
- An API and MCP server let teams generate memes from their own tools and chat bots

Supermeme.ai fits social media managers, community builders and marketing teams that post often and want a quick, lighthearted format in their content mix. A practical tip: write your prompt as a specific scenario your audience will recognize rather than a general topic, and review the language before posting, since humor and phrasing can land differently across regions.

name: DeepMotion
tagline: AI motion capture that turns video or text prompts into 3D character animation
description: DeepMotion offers Animate 3D, which converts ordinary video into 3D animation with body, face and hand tracking, and SayMotion, which generates character motion from text prompts.
longDescription: DeepMotion is an AI animation company that has worked on physics simulation and body tracking since 2014. Its Animate 3D product performs markerless motion capture: upload a video and it produces a 3D animation of the people in it, with options for multi-person tracking, foot locking, physics filtering and face and hand tracking, exported as FBX, BVH, GLB or video files. SayMotion generates animation from text descriptions. A Rotoscope Pose Editor helps clean up results, and custom characters can be applied to the motion. A free plan with monthly credits is available, and paid tiers raise clip length, resolution, frame rate and the number of people tracked. An API and real-time SDK are offered for businesses.
features: Multi-person body, face and hand tracking
cons: Clip length and quality limits on lower tiers
Results may need cleanup for complex motion
moreContext:
DeepMotion makes motion capture available to people who have never seen a mocap stage. You can record a dance, a fight move or a walk cycle on a phone, upload it to Animate 3D, and get back an animated 3D skeleton ready for a game engine or 3D package. Its SayMotion tool goes a step further by building motion from a written prompt.

- Captures full body motion from regular video, with face and hand tracking options
- Tracks several people in one clip, with the count rising on higher plans
- Physics filtering, foot locking and motion smoothing help reduce jitter and sliding
- Exports to FBX, BVH, GLB and video formats used across common 3D tools
- Offers an API and real-time SDK for companies building their own products

DeepMotion is a strong pick for indie game developers, VTubers, educators and XR artists who need believable animation without a mocap budget. A practical tip: film with a steady camera, good lighting and the full body in frame, since clean source video makes a noticeable difference in the quality of the captured motion.

name: Turbologo
tagline: AI logo maker that builds a matching brand kit, cards and social templates
description: Turbologo lets you design a logo with AI for free, then pay once to download files, with higher packages adding a brand book, business documents, social media designs and more.
longDescription: Turbologo is an online logo maker aimed at small business owners and founders without design experience. You answer a few simple questions, the AI suggests logo options, and you can edit fonts, colors and layout in the browser for as long as you like at no cost. Payment is only needed when you download, and it is a one-time charge rather than a subscription. Higher packages include vector and print-ready files, unlimited extra logos, and a full brand kit with a brand book, business cards, letterheads, email signatures and social media templates. The company, founded in 2018, also offers a business name generator, AI website builder and credit-based AI image generations.
features: AI logo generation from simple questions
Brand kit with fonts, colors and variations
Business cards, letterheads and social templates
pros: Broad set of brand assets in higher packages
cons: Downloads require payment
Cheapest package is a low-resolution file
moreContext:
Turbologo is built around a simple promise for new businesses: you can design and tweak your logo for free and only pay when you are happy with it. That pay-once model is a relief for founders who do not want another monthly subscription just to get a logo and a few branded materials.

- Generates logo ideas from a short set of questions about your business
- Lets you edit layout, fonts and colors in the browser before paying
- Turns the final logo into a brand kit with matching palettes, fonts and variations
- Higher packages add a brand book, business documents, signage mockups and social media templates
- Also includes a business name generator and an AI website builder that reuses your brand style

Turbologo is best for solo founders, freelancers and small shops that need a professional-looking identity quickly and on a fixed budget. A practical tip: compare the packages before downloading, because the entry option is a single low-resolution file, while vector and print-ready formats, which you will want for signage and merchandise, come with the mid-tier package.

name: Llama Coder
tagline: Open-source app generator from Together AI that builds small apps from a prompt
description: Llama Coder is a free, open-source tool from Together AI that writes small React apps from a single prompt and previews them live in the browser, using open models hosted on Together.
longDescription: Llama Coder is an open-source project created by Together AI that works much like an artifacts feature in a chat assistant: you describe an app idea, and it generates the code and shows a working preview right away. It started on Meta's Llama models and now lets users pick from open models hosted on Together AI, such as DeepSeek variants. You can attach a screenshot for reference and iterate on the result. The project is built with Next.js and Tailwind, renders previews in a sandboxed iframe, and is published on GitHub under the MIT license, so developers can study the code or run their own copy with a Together API key.
features: Choice of open models on Together AI
pros: Free to use in the browser
Good showcase of open model coding
cons: Best suited to small, single-page apps
Self-hosting needs your own API keys
moreContext:
For quick app prototyping, Llama Coder offers a friendly way to see what open-source language models can do in practice. Type something like a sourdough timer or an expense tracker, and within moments you get working code and a live preview you can click through, all without installing anything.

- Generates a complete small app from one natural language prompt
- Renders the result in a sandboxed browser preview so you can test it immediately
- Lets you switch between open models served on Together AI
- Accepts screenshots as visual references for the app you want
- Fully open source on GitHub under the MIT license, with clear setup steps

Llama Coder is best for developers, students and tinkerers who want to prototype small ideas fast or learn how a prompt-to-app tool is put together. A practical tip: if you like the generated app, copy the code into your own project early and keep iterating there, since the tool shines for first drafts rather than large, multi-page applications that need routing, databases and authentication.

name: KnowMyFace
tagline: AI face analyzer that maps your features and suggests hair and makeup styles
description: KnowMyFace analyzes a front-facing selfie to estimate face shape, feature types, face age and visible skin traits, then offers hairstyle and makeup guidance, with full reports sold per photo.
longDescription: KnowMyFace is a personal appearance analysis tool. You upload a clear, front-facing photo of yourself and receive a free result showing your main face shape and feature types along with selected evidence. A paid Complete Report expands this with 41 explainable face and feature measurements, separate left and right brow and eye results, face-shape context, visible cosmetic skin observations, an estimated face age and an attractiveness score. It also gives personalized guidance on hairstyle structure and makeup placement for brows, eyes, nose, lips and blush. Reports are bought one at a time or in small packs that include friend codes, and arrive as a downloadable PDF.
features: Face shape and feature type detection
pros: Explains the evidence behind each result
cons: Attractiveness scores are subjective
Accuracy depends on photo quality and lighting
moreContext:
KnowMyFace turns the familiar question of which haircut or makeup style suits me into a structured report. Rather than returning a single label, it shows the measurements and visual evidence behind its face shape and feature calls, which makes the recommendations easier to understand and question. The free result lets you see whether the approach is useful before paying anything.

- Identifies face shape and individual feature types such as brows, eyes, nose and lips
- Provides 41 measurements in the complete report, including separate left and right results
- Suggests hairstyle structure and placement based on your proportions
- Gives makeup guidance for brows, eyes, nose, lips and blush
- Uses one-time report purchases rather than a recurring subscription

KnowMyFace is best for people planning a new haircut, learning makeup, or simply curious about how their facial proportions are described. A practical tip: use a well-lit, straight-on photo with hair pulled back and no heavy filters, and treat the attractiveness score lightly, since the styling guidance is the most useful part of the report.

name: Dokie AI
tagline: AI presentation maker that builds designed, interactive decks from your content
description: Dokie AI turns prompts, PDFs, documents and data into structured slide decks with generated visuals and charts, supports brand templates, and can be connected to AI agents.
longDescription: Dokie AI is a presentation generator that starts from content and lets the layout follow. You can write a prompt or upload PDFs, documents and data, and Dokie organizes the material into slides, adds generated or searched images, and turns numbers and ideas into charts and logic diagrams. It also creates animated, interactive story-style presentations. Edits are made by describing the change you want, and paid users can upload their own templates and themes to stay on brand. Decks export to PDF, PPTX and PNG. A credit system powers AI tasks, with a free plan that includes welcome and daily credits and paid tiers for heavier use.
features: Slides from prompts, PDFs and docs
Charts and logic diagrams from data
Custom brand templates on paid plans
pros: Daily free credits on the free plan
cons: Credit costs add up for heavy editing
Brand templates require a paid plan
moreContext:
Dokie AI focuses on a common pain point: you have the content, but turning it into clean slides takes far too long. It reads your prompt or source files, decides on structure, and produces decks that look ready to present, then lets you refine them by simply describing what should change. That makes it practical for revisions late in a project, when time is short.

- Converts PDFs, documents and data files into structured slide decks
- Generates or finds images that match the context of each slide
- Turns figures and concepts into charts and logic diagrams
- Builds animated, interactive story-style presentations in addition to standard decks
- Can be added to AI agents so a deck is produced straight from a conversation

Dokie AI suits consultants, founders, marketers, teachers and students who present often and would rather spend time on the message than the formatting. A practical tip: upload your company template early if you are on a paid plan, so every new deck starts on brand and you avoid spending credits restyling slides later.

name: BlogNLP
tagline: AI writing assistant for blog posts, marketing copy and SEO-minded content
description: BlogNLP helps bloggers, marketers, students and small businesses draft blog posts, copy and other content with AI templates, a chat assistant and translation, on a free plan or low-cost premium tier.
longDescription: BlogNLP is a web-based AI writing tool built around templates for common content tasks. You enter a topic or short outline, the AI drafts content with SEO considerations in mind, and you edit the result to fit your voice. The template library covers blog posts, marketing copy, email campaigns, product descriptions and academic drafting, and a chat feature handles open-ended requests. Translation into more than 29 languages is powered by DeepL. A free plan lets new users try the tool, while the Premium plan adds unlimited generations across all features, access to its GPT-4o based model, the full template set and early access to new features, billed monthly or yearly.
cons: Drafts need editing for originality
Fewer advanced SEO tools than dedicated suites
moreContext:
BlogNLP keeps AI writing simple and affordable. Instead of a sprawling suite, it offers a focused set of templates and a chat assistant that help you get from a blank page to a workable draft quickly, with a single premium plan that removes generation limits. Signing in takes a moment with a Google account, so trying it costs very little time.

- More than 75 templates for blog posts, marketing copy, emails and product descriptions
- A chat assistant for open-ended writing requests and brainstorming
- Translation into over 29 languages using DeepL
- Drafts shaped with search visibility in mind for blog content
- Flat monthly or yearly premium pricing with unlimited generations

BlogNLP works well for solo bloggers, small business owners, students and lean marketing teams who want help producing regular content without paying for an enterprise writing platform. A practical tip: give the tool a short outline with your key points and target keyword rather than a single topic word, then edit the draft in your own voice before publishing so it reads naturally and reflects your expertise.

name: The AI Scientist
tagline: Sakana AI's open-source agent that runs ML experiments and writes research papers
description: The AI Scientist from Sakana AI is an open-source system in which language models generate research ideas, write and run experiment code, analyze results and draft full papers with automated review.
longDescription: The AI Scientist is a research automation system released by Tokyo-based Sakana AI in August 2024, built with collaborators at the University of Oxford and the University of British Columbia. Given a starting template, it uses large language models to brainstorm ideas, check novelty, write and execute experiment code, plot results, and write a paper in LaTeX, followed by an automated peer review step. The first version relies on templates such as NanoGPT, 2D diffusion and grokking. The AI Scientist-v2 drops the template requirement and uses an agentic tree search guided by an experiment manager. Both versions are on GitHub, need Linux with NVIDIA GPUs, and use API keys for supported models.
features: Automated idea generation and novelty checks
cons: Requires GPUs and paid model API usage
Runs model-written code, so sandboxing is needed
moreContext:
The AI Scientist is one of the most ambitious open research agents available. Sakana AI built it to handle the entire cycle of a machine learning study, from forming an idea to running experiments and writing a paper, and the team shares example outputs so you can judge the quality for yourself.

- Generates research ideas and checks them for novelty against existing literature
- Writes experiment code, runs it and produces plots from the results
- Drafts complete papers in LaTeX and scores them with an automated reviewer
- Version 2 explores open-ended problems with an agentic tree search instead of fixed templates
- Sakana AI says a paper produced by v2 passed peer review at an ICLR 2025 workshop

The AI Scientist is best for machine learning researchers, labs and advanced students who want to study or extend automated discovery systems. A practical tip: follow the project's own advice and run it inside a sandbox such as a Docker container, since it executes code written by language models, and start with one of the provided templates before attempting open-ended runs.

name: Remail
tagline: All-in-one AI browser assistant for email replies, chat, reading and writing
description: Remail is a Chrome extension and web app that drafts and replies to email, offers chat with several AI models, summarizes pages, PDFs and YouTube videos, and helps with LinkedIn content.
longDescription: Remail is an AI assistant that travels with you across the web through a Chrome extension and a web app. Its email assistant composes and replies to messages in many languages, can draw on your own knowledge base, and works inside Gmail. A sidebar lets you chat with models such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, compare their answers side by side, and ask questions about web pages, PDFs, images and YouTube videos. Writing tools help rewrite or expand text, and extra features cover translation, image generation, mind maps and LinkedIn post and carousel creation. Paid plans are usage based, starting with a seven-day free trial, and the same plans are offered under the Nily AI name.
features: AI email compose and reply in Gmail
Chat and compare multiple AI models
Chat with pages, PDFs and YouTube
pros: Many AI tools in one extension
cons: No permanent free plan listed
Broad feature set can feel crowded
moreContext:
Remail started with email and grew into a broad browser assistant. The appeal is having one sidebar that can draft a reply, summarize the article you are reading, explain a PDF and compare how different AI models answer the same question, without switching tabs or juggling subscriptions.

- Composes and replies to email in many languages, with optional use of your own knowledge base
- Lets you query several leading AI models and compare their responses at once
- Summarizes and answers questions about web pages, PDFs, images and YouTube videos
- Includes writing, translation, image generation and mind map tools
- Generates LinkedIn posts and carousels for people building a presence there

Remail is best for professionals who spend their day in the browser and inbox and want a single assistant for quick writing and reading tasks. A practical tip: set up the knowledge base with your common answers, product details or policies before using the email assistant, since replies become far more accurate when the AI can draw on your own information.

name: Atlassian Rovo
tagline: Atlassian's AI for search, chat and agents across Jira, Confluence and connected apps
description: Rovo brings AI search, chat, agents and a builder called Studio to Atlassian Cloud, drawing on Jira, Confluence and connected tools so teams can find answers and automate work.
longDescription: Rovo is Atlassian's AI layer for its Cloud products. It uses the Teamwork Graph to pull context from Jira, Confluence, Loom and third-party tools connected through Rovo connectors, so people can search across systems, ask questions in chat and get answers grounded in company knowledge. Rovo agents can draft content, handle next steps in workflows and keep projects moving, and Studio lets teams build their own agents and automations. Rovo is available in Atlassian apps, on desktop and mobile, as a browser extension, through MCP and in the command line via Rovo Dev. It is included with Standard, Premium and Enterprise Cloud plans, with usage measured in Rovo credits.
features: Studio for building agents and automations
pros: Deeply integrated with Jira and Confluence
Admin controls over AI data access
Available across desktop, mobile and browser
cons: Requires a paid Atlassian Cloud plan
Usage is limited by monthly credit allowances
moreContext:
Rovo stands out because it sits directly on top of the tools many teams already use to plan and document their work. Instead of exporting tickets and pages into a separate AI product, Rovo reads context from Jira, Confluence and connected apps through Atlassian's Teamwork Graph, so its answers and actions reflect real projects and people.

- Searches across Atlassian apps and connected third-party tools from one place
- Chat answers draw on company knowledge with permissions respected
- Agents can draft content, suggest next steps and help move workflows forward
- Studio gives teams a way to create their own agents and automations
- Works in Atlassian apps, on desktop and mobile, in a browser extension, via MCP and in the terminal

Rovo is best for organizations already invested in Jira and Confluence that want AI grounded in their existing work data. A practical tip: connect the other tools your team relies on, such as shared drives or chat apps, through Rovo connectors early, because search and agent answers improve noticeably when Rovo can see the full picture.

name: CoTester
