It can read the current page, summarize YouTube videos, articles and PDFs, draft Gmail replies, rewrite or translate text, and answer questions with web search sources. Beyond chat, it includes a library of ready-made commands, page and price monitoring, scheduled tasks and scraping that can trigger Make, Zapier or n8n. Users can connect cloud models through HARPA's own token plans, log in with existing ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini web sessions, bring their own API keys, or run local models. It suits marketers, researchers and anyone who does repetitive work in the browser.
features: Page-aware AI chat on any site
pros: Bring your own keys or local models
cons: Advanced automation needs a higher plan
Feature-dense interface takes time to learn
moreContext:
What we like about HARPA AI is how much it packs into a single browser sidebar. Instead of switching between a chatbot tab and the page you are reading, you press a shortcut and the assistant already knows the context. The flexibility on models is also notable, since you can use HARPA's own token balance, an existing web session, your own API keys or a local model.

- Summaries of long YouTube videos, articles and PDFs without leaving the page
- A Gmail helper that sorts mail, condenses threads and drafts replies
- Page and price trackers that alert you when something changes
- A library of ready-made commands for SEO, writing, recruiting and more
- Scraping and webhook triggers that connect to Make, Zapier and n8n

HARPA AI is a strong fit for marketers, researchers, recruiters and online sellers who repeat the same browser tasks every day and want an assistant that can act on what is on screen. The company says hundreds of thousands of professionals use it. A practical tip: start with the built-in commands and the page monitor before building custom automations, since they show how HARPA reads pages and will help you write better prompts for your own workflows later.

name: Zoviz
tagline: AI branding platform for logos, brand kits, social content and simple websites
description: Zoviz helps small businesses create a logo and full brand kit with AI, then reuse that identity across business cards, social posts, video ads and websites.
longDescription: Zoviz is an AI branding and content platform aimed at small businesses and solo founders. You start by entering a brand name, and the logo maker generates options built from human-designed elements that export as editable vector files. From there, Zoviz expands the logo into a brand kit with matching business cards, letterheads and social templates. Additional workspaces cover AI images and video in Canvas, social posts, content plans and video ads in Studio, and a builder for websites, link-in-bio pages and digital business cards. Developers can also access logo generation through an API and an MCP server. Previewing designs is free, while downloads require a paid plan.
features: AI logo maker with vector files
Social posts and video ad creation
pros: API and MCP access for developers
cons: Downloads require a subscription
Many workspaces can feel broad for logo-only needs
moreContext:
Zoviz stands out because it treats a logo as the starting point rather than the finish line. Once your mark is ready, the same colors, fonts and style flow into business cards, social templates, video ads and even a small website, which saves a lot of manual matching for a new business.

- Logos built from human-designed elements and exported as editable vector files
- A brand kit that carries your identity into stationery and marketing designs
- Studio tools for social posts, monthly content plans and short video ads
- A website builder plus link-in-bio pages and digital business cards
- An API and MCP server for teams that want branding inside their own apps

Zoviz is best for founders, freelancers and small shops that need a complete starter identity without hiring an agency for every asset. You can explore templates and preview logos and brand kits before subscribing, and the company says you only pay when you want to download final files. A practical tip: spend time refining the logo and color choices first, because every later template in the brand kit inherits them, so a few extra minutes at that stage pays off across all of your assets.

name: Vocalist.ai
tagline: AI vocal transformation, pitch correction and stem splitting for music producers
description: Vocalist.ai lets producers turn a rough vocal into a different singer or rapper performance, correct pitch and split stems, using licensed voice models cleared for commercial use.
longDescription: Vocalist.ai is a set of AI vocal tools built for music production. Transform converts a dry input vocal, even a phone voice memo, into the voice of one of its singer or rapper models, with controls to help the result sit in a track. Tune applies natural or hard-tuned pitch correction on its own or inside a transformation. Split separates vocals and instrumentals from a mixed song and can remove reverb. The company says its voice models are trained with singer consent and revenue sharing, and paid outputs are royalty-free for commercial use. Previews and Tune and Split are unlimited on paid plans, while credits cover transformed downloads.
pros: Royalty-free commercial use on paid plans
cons: No permanent free plan
Credits needed for transformed downloads
moreContext:
Vocalist.ai keeps its scope tight around vocals, and that focus shows. Three tools cover the most common production tasks: changing the voice, fixing pitch and pulling stems apart. The emphasis on consent-based voice models is also a welcome point for artists who want to release work commercially without worrying about where a voice came from.

- Transform turns a dry vocal or phone demo into a professional singer or rapper model
- Tune offers natural correction or a hard-tuned modern effect
- Split isolates vocals and instrumentals and can strip reverb
- Unlimited previews let you audition every model before spending credits
- Unused credits roll over while a subscription stays active

Vocalist.ai is best for songwriters, beatmakers and producers who need demo vocals, alternate voices or cleaner stems without booking a session singer. The seven-day trial includes all tools and a small number of transform credits, though trial outputs are meant for evaluation rather than release. A practical tip: record your input vocal dry, with no effects and minimal room sound, since a clean source gives the voice models more to work with and makes the transformed take easier to mix.

name: AutoResponder
tagline: Android auto-reply bot for messaging apps with optional ChatGPT and Gemini replies
description: AutoResponder is an Android app that sends automatic replies on WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Signal and Viber using custom rules or connected AI models.
longDescription: AutoResponder is a family of Android apps that answer incoming chat messages automatically. Users create rules that match messages exactly, by similarity or with patterns, then send single, multiple or random replies, welcome messages or out-of-office notes. Rules can target specific contacts, run at set times and pause per conversation. The PRO tier adds connections to OpenAI's ChatGPT, Google's Gemini and Dialogflow for AI-written replies, plus Google Sheets, custom web servers and Tasker or MacroDroid actions. Separate versions exist for WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Signal and Viber. It is made by TK Studio in Germany and is popular with small businesses that sell or support customers over chat.
features: Webhooks, Google Sheets and Tasker support
pros: Generous free tier with unlimited rules
cons: Android only
AI connections require PRO
moreContext:
AutoResponder solves a simple, very common problem: answering the same chat questions over and over on your phone. It runs on Android and watches notifications from messaging apps, then replies based on the rules you set, so a small business can stay responsive on WhatsApp or Instagram without staring at the screen all day.

- Flexible matching with exact, similarity and pattern-based rules
- Optional AI replies through ChatGPT, Gemini or Dialogflow on the PRO tier
- Targeting by contact, time window and custom conditions
- Integrations with Google Sheets, your own web server and Tasker or MacroDroid
- Dedicated versions for WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, Signal and Viber

AutoResponder is best for shop owners, freelancers and community managers who handle a steady stream of repeat questions in chat apps. The company says its WhatsApp version alone has passed millions of downloads, and many PRO features can be tried for free inside the app. A practical tip: start with a few exact-match rules for your most frequent questions and a welcome message, then add an AI connection only for open-ended messages, so routine answers stay predictable while the model handles the rest.

name: Noty.ai
tagline: Meeting assistant that transcribes calls and turns them into summaries and to-dos
description: Noty.ai records and transcribes meetings in real time, writes a shareable summary afterward and builds AI to-do lists so action items get assigned and tracked.
longDescription: Noty.ai is an AI meeting assistant that captures conversations and turns them into follow-up work. During a call it shows a live transcript where you can highlight key moments and leave comments. After the meeting it produces a summary of the main points, which can be edited, shared or exported to Docs, PDF or text. Noty also generates to-do lists from what was discussed so tasks can be assigned and tracked, and a chat feature lets you ask questions about past meetings. Global search covers all stored transcripts. A Pro plan is billed per user, with a discounted plan for schools, universities and nonprofits, and new users get a seven-day trial.
pros: Focus on action items, not just notes
cons: No permanent free plan
Monthly hour and AI credit limits
moreContext:
Noty.ai puts its attention on what happens after a meeting ends. Plenty of tools produce a transcript, but Noty leans into turning that conversation into a task list you can assign and follow up on, which is where many meeting notes usually stall.

- Live transcription with the option to highlight moments and add comments
- Summaries generated after each call and ready to share
- To-do lists drawn from the discussion, with tracking for assigned tasks
- Global search and chat for finding details from earlier meetings
- Exports to Docs, PDF and plain text

Noty.ai is best for busy individuals and small teams who run frequent internal meetings and want follow-ups to happen without a separate note-taker. Schools, universities and nonprofits can apply for a lower-priced plan. The company says more than 100,000 people have used it. A practical tip: during the trial, use the highlight feature on decisions and deadlines as they come up in the call, since those marked moments make the generated summary and task list noticeably more useful to your team.

name: Kilo Code
tagline: Open-source AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, the terminal and the cloud
description: Kilo Code is an open-source coding agent that runs in VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, a CLI, a desktop app and the cloud, with access to hundreds of models at provider cost or with your own keys.
longDescription: Kilo Code is an open-source AI coding agent available as a VS Code extension, a JetBrains plugin, a command-line tool, a beta desktop app and cloud agents you can start from a browser, Slack or a phone. It can plan features, edit files across a codebase, run commands and tests, debug, and review pull requests. Kilo connects to more than 500 models through its gateway with no markup on inference, and also supports bring-your-own keys and local models. Individual use of the platform is free, with inference billed separately, while Teams and Enterprise plans add usage analytics, shared agents, centralized billing, SSO and audit logs. It suits developers who want model choice without lock-in.
features: Agents for IDE, CLI, desktop and cloud
Access to 500+ models with no markup
Planning, debugging and code review modes
Bring your own keys or local models
cons: Model usage is billed separately
Many surfaces and options to configure
moreContext:
Kilo Code appeals to developers who like to see what their tools are doing. The agent is fully open source, and its pricing model separates platform access from model costs, so you pay providers' rates through the gateway or use your own keys instead of paying a markup.

- One agent across VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, the terminal, a desktop app and the cloud
- More than 500 models available, including frontier, open-weight and local options
- Dedicated planning, debugging and code review workflows
- Parallel agents in isolated worktrees for running tasks side by side
- Slack and mobile access for starting and checking cloud agents remotely

Kilo Code is best for individual developers and engineering teams who want an agentic coding assistant with model freedom and an auditable codebase. The company says millions of developers use it, and the individual plan costs nothing beyond inference. A practical tip: start with the automatic model routing while you learn the workflow, then pin specific models for tasks where you have a clear preference, such as a cheaper model for small edits and a stronger one for planning larger features.

name: Medeloop
tagline: Agentic analytics platform for clinical research on real-world patient data
description: Medeloop lets researchers ask clinical questions in plain language and get traceable cohorts, statistics and manuscript-ready findings from preloaded real-world data or their own datasets.
longDescription: Medeloop is a clinical research analytics platform built around AI agents. A researcher describes a question in plain language, and the system maps clinical concepts to the data, drafts a study protocol, checks feasibility such as cohort size and statistical power, and lets the user review cohorts, code sets and methods before anything runs. Validated queries then execute and return cohorts, statistics, figures and a written narrative. Users can work with Medeloop's preloaded, de-identified claims data or deploy it on their own EHR, claims or registry data, where computation runs inside the organization's environment. Pricing is based on study bundles or subscriptions, with a free starting tier.
features: Federated runs on your own data
pros: Each analysis step can be reviewed
Data can stay inside your environment
cons: Study pricing is significant for individuals
Built for specialist research teams
moreContext:
Medeloop addresses a slow part of health research: getting from a clinical question to an analysis that holds up. It keeps a human in the loop at every stage, so researchers can see and edit the protocol, cohorts and statistical methods before any query runs, which matters a great deal in a field where methods are scrutinized.

- Plain-language questions grounded against clinical concepts in the data
- Feasibility checks on cohort size, coverage and statistical power up front
- Traceable outputs including cohorts, statistics, figures and a written narrative
- Preloaded claims data, which the company says covers hundreds of millions of patient records
- Federated execution so an organization's own data stays in its environment

Medeloop is best for health systems, life sciences teams and academic researchers who run comparative effectiveness, treatment pattern or prevalence studies. You can start free with a few research threads, and studies can then be bought one bundle at a time or through a subscription. A practical tip: use the free threads to test a question you already know the approximate answer to, so you can judge how the agent's cohort definitions and methods line up with your own approach.

name: Sologo
tagline: AI logo generator with clear licensing for commercial and trademark use
description: Sologo generates logos from a name, an image or a sketch, then exports vector files, brand kits, mockups and animations, with licensing options up to exclusive ownership.
longDescription: Sologo is an AI logo generator that pays special attention to usage rights. Users can create logos from a brand name, an uploaded image or a hand drawing, in many input languages, and then edit them using traceable fonts and graphics. Paid members can download PNG, JPG, SVG and PDF files and use the results commercially, and tools for brand kits, AI mockups, brand-style images, background removal, vectorizing and logo animation extend a logo into marketing assets. Some eligible icon-based logos can be bought outright with exclusive rights, after which they are removed from the store. Sologo also offers trademark search and registration services for China and Hong Kong.
features: Logo from name, image or sketch
cons: Free plan cannot download for commercial use
Trademark service limited to China and Hong Kong
moreContext:
Sologo takes a thoughtful angle on AI logos by putting rights front and center. Many generators leave it unclear whether you can register or own the result, while Sologo uses traceable fonts and graphics and spells out tiers from commercial use to a full exclusive buyout.

- Three ways to start: from a brand name, an existing image or a sketch
- Vector downloads in SVG and PDF alongside PNG and JPG
- Brand kits, AI mockups and brand-style images built from your logo
- Logo animation for websites, social media and campaigns
- An exclusive buyout that delists the logo from the store once purchased

Sologo is best for entrepreneurs and small businesses that care about registering their mark or want certainty that nobody else will use the same logo. New accounts receive a small set of free credits for exploring designs, and a paid membership covers downloads and monthly credits. A practical tip: if you plan to file a trademark, compare the exclusive buyout with the standard membership license before launching, since switching after you have printed materials and built a following is far more disruptive.

name: AI Ease
tagline: All-in-one AI photo and video tools, from face swap to image-to-video
description: AI Ease bundles AI photo editing, portrait tools such as face swap and headshots, text-to-image and image-to-video generation with access to many third-party models.
longDescription: AI Ease is a web-based creative platform that combines dozens of AI photo and video tools. On the image side it offers an enhancer, object and background removal, photo restoration, outpainting, recoloring and style transfer, plus portrait tools like face swap, hairstyle and outfit changers, headshot and passport photo makers. For generation, it provides text-to-image and image-to-image using models such as Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream, along with text-to-video and image-to-video powered by models including Kling, Veo, Seedance and Wan. Template-based video effects create short clips from a single photo. Several basic features are free, and paid memberships or credit packs cover premium and video tools.
features: Text and image to video generation
cons: Video features use paid credits
Large menu can be hard to navigate
moreContext:
AI Ease is useful mostly for its breadth. Rather than picking one specialty, it gathers everyday photo fixes, playful portrait effects and access to popular image and video models under one account, which saves hopping between separate apps for each small job.

- Photo cleanup tools such as enhancement, restoration and object removal
- Portrait features including face swap, hairstyle changes and headshot makers
- Text-to-image and image-to-image with a choice of third-party models
- Image-to-video and text-to-video using models like Kling, Veo and Seedance
- One-tap video effect templates for short social clips

AI Ease is best for casual creators, social media users and small sellers who want quick results without learning professional editing software. Basic image tools can be used for free, while members get unlimited use of most image features and credits cover video generation. A practical tip: only use face swap and portrait tools on photos of yourself or people who have agreed to it, and try the free image tools first to get a feel for output quality before buying credits for video.

name: Google Vids
tagline: Google's AI video creator and editor built into Workspace
description: Google Vids helps people build videos with Gemini, from templates, Slides decks or screen recordings, with AI clips, avatars, voiceovers and transcript-based editing.
longDescription: Google Vids is a video creation and editing app from Google Workspace. Users can start from templates or stock media, convert a Google Slides presentation into a video, or record their screen, camera and audio directly in the browser. Gemini features generate video clips from prompts, animate still images, create customizable avatars and produce scripted voiceovers in many languages. Editing works on a timeline or by changing the transcript, with captions, transitions and automatic translation available. Files from Drive and Photos can be added, and projects are shared with Google-style permissions or exported to YouTube. Anyone with a Google account can try it, while higher limits come with Workspace or Google AI plans.
features: Edit video by editing the transcript
Share with Drive permissions or export to YouTube
pros: Free to try with a Google account
Works well with Drive, Slides and Photos
cons: Creation and editing are desktop only
Advanced features need a paid plan
moreContext:
Google Vids brings video into the same collaborative habits people already have with Docs and Slides. Colleagues can comment, edit and share a project with familiar permissions, and the Gemini features help fill in the parts that usually slow down workplace video, such as writing a script or recording a voiceover.

- Slides-to-video conversion for turning existing presentations into clips
- Built-in screen, camera and audio recording in the browser
- Gemini-generated clips, animated images, avatars and voiceovers
- Transcript-based editing along with captions and automatic translation
- Direct access to Drive and Photos assets and export to YouTube

Google Vids is best for teams that already work in Google Workspace and need training videos, product updates, onboarding walkthroughs or internal announcements without a dedicated editor. It can be tried for free with a Google account, with advanced features and higher limits available on select Workspace and Google AI plans. A practical tip: start by converting a Slides deck you have already presented, then add an avatar or voiceover, since that reuses polished material and shows quickly how the AI tools fit your existing content.

name: AI Resumma
tagline: Summarize text, PDFs, Word files and slides, then translate them into 20+ languages
description: AI Resumma condenses long text, articles, PDFs, Word documents and PowerPoint files into short summaries and also offers translation, grammar checking and rewriting.
longDescription: AI Resumma is an online toolkit centered on summarization and translation. Users can paste text, enter an article link or upload DOCX, PDF and PPT files, and the service returns a condensed version that keeps the main points. Translation covers plain text, images and PDFs across more than 20 languages. The site also includes a grammar checker, a text rewriter, image-to-text extraction, keyword extraction, language detection and simple text statistics and comparison tools. It is designed for students, researchers and professionals who need to get through reading quickly. Paid usage runs on credit packs that never expire, with costs based on character count or file size, and higher tiers include API access.
features: Text, article, PDF, Word and PPT summaries
cons: Credit costs scale with document size
Fewer advanced options than research tools
moreContext:
AI Resumma keeps things simple, and that is part of its charm. You paste text or drop in a file, and a few moments later you have the key points. Having translation and light writing tools on the same site makes it a handy stop for anyone juggling documents in more than one language.

- Summaries for plain text, web articles, PDFs, Word files and PowerPoint decks
- Translation of text, images and PDFs across more than 20 languages
- A grammar checker and rewriter for cleaning up your own writing
- Image-to-text extraction and keyword tools for quick analysis
- Pay-as-you-go credit packs that do not expire, with API access on higher tiers

AI Resumma is best for students, researchers and office workers who regularly need the gist of long material without committing to a monthly subscription. The credit model suits occasional users who might summarize a batch of files one week and nothing the next. A practical tip: for long PDFs or slide decks, check the credit cost by file size before uploading, and consider summarizing the most relevant sections as pasted text, which can be cheaper and gives more focused results.
